{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":8,"lineType":2,"content":"臣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"等謹案：三命通會十二卷，原本不著撰人","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966414900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"姓名，卷首但題育吾山人著。","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966414900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"明史藝文志有","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966431284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"萬民育三命會通十二卷，與此本卷數相合，","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966431284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"惟以通會作會通為稍異。","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966431284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"今考世所傳星學","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966447668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"大成，専論五星者，為萬民英所撰，已著於録。","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966447668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505678615674943"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"此本専論子平，亦出民英之手。","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966464052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"藝文志葢因","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966480436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"育吾山人之號，誤以民英為民育，又通會二","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966480436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"字傳寫互倒，遂有不同，其實即此書也。","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966480436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"自明","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966496820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"以来二百餘年，談星命者皆以此本為總彚，","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966496820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"㡬於家有其書？","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966496820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"中間所載仕宦八字，往往及","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966513204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"明季之人，葢後来坊刻所攙入，亦已非原本","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966513204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"之舊。","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966513204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"特以其闡發子平之遺法，於官、印、財、禄、","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966529588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"食、傷之名義，用神之輕重，諸神煞所係之吉","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966529588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505678389133324"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"凶，皆能採撮羣言，得其精要，故為術家所恒","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966529588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"用，要有未可遽廢者。","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966529588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"至其立論，多取正官、正","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966545972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"印、正財，而不知偏官、偏印、偏財亦能得力；知","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966545972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"食神之能吐秀，而不知傷官之亦可出竒。","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966545972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"是","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966562356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"則其偏執之見，未能圓徹。","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966562356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"且胎元等論，施之","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966578740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"今日，亦多有不驗。","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966578740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"言命學者，但當得其大意","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966595124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"而變通之可矣。","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966595124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"若所引珞琭子，與今永樂大","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966611508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"典中所輯完本，其文迥殊，則其時秘冊僅存，","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966611508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505621338390563"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"外間末由窺見，遂誤信依託之本，固未足以","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966611508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"為病也。","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966611508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"乾隆四十四年九月恭校上。","logicSentenceId":"7636784299966627892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"8","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"老子曰：無名天地之始，有名，萬物之母。有物混成，先天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"地生。列禦寇曰：有形生於無形。天地之初，有太易，有太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"初，有太始，有太素。太易者，未見氣；太初者，氣之始；太始","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"者，形之始；太素者，質之始。氣與形質合而未離，曰渾淪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505622781181978"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"歴紀","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_1","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"云：未有天地之時，混沌如鷄子，溟滓始芽，鴻濛滋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"萌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"律厯志","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_2","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"云：太極元氣，函三為一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_3","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_4","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"有太極，是生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"兩儀，兩儀生四象，四象生八卦，八卦定吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"易疏","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_5","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"云：太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"極謂天地未分之前，元氣混而為一。蒙泉子曰：太初者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"理之始也；太虛者，氣之始也；太素者，象之始也；太乙者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"數之始也。太極者，兼理氣、象數之始也。由數論言之，可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"見渾淪未判之先，只一氣混合，杳冥昏昧，而理未嘗不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"在其中，與道為一，是謂太極。莊子以道在太極之先，所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505667702226981"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"謂太極，乃是指天地人三者氣形已具而未判者之名，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"而道又别是一懸空底物，在太極之先。不知道即太極，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"太極即道，以其理之通行者言，則曰道；以其理之極至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"者言，則曰太極，又何嘗有二邪？向非周子啓其祕，朱子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"闡而明之，孰知太極之為理，而與氣自不相離也哉！所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"謂太極者，乃陰陽動靜之本體，不離於形氣而實無聲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"臭，不窮於變化而實有凖則。故一動一靜，互為其根，分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"陰分陽，兩儀立焉。儀者，物也。凡物未始無對，而亦未嘗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505678389215244"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"獨立。天以氣覆而依乎地，地以形載而附乎天。有理斯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":36,"lineType":1,"content":"有氣，陰陽之謂也；有氣斯有形，天地之謂也。天地不生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"於天地，而生於陰陽；陰陽不生於陰陽，而生於動靜；動","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"靜不生於動靜，而生於太極。蓋太極者，本然之玅也；動","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"靜者，所乘之機也；陰陽者，所生之本也。太極，形而上，道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"也；陰陽，形而下，器也。動靜無端，陰陽無始，此造化所由","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"立焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":42,"lineType":2,"content":"栢齋何子曰：天，陽之動者也，果何時動極而靜乎？地，陰之靜者也，果何時靜極而動乎？天不能生地，水不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505621338439715"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":45,"lineType":2,"content":"能生火，無智愚皆知之，乃謂陰陽相生，不亦誤乎？蓋天地水火，雖渾然不可離，實燦然不可亂。故陰之與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":46,"lineType":2,"content":"陽，謂之相依則可，謂之相生則不可；謂之互藏其宅則可，謂之互藏相生則不可。此言的有見也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"51","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"夫天地未立，道本天地；天地旣立，則太極之理散在萬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"事，由是而五行生焉。五行一陰陽，五殊二實，無餘分也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽一太極，精粗本末，無彼此也。五行質具於地，而氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"行於天。以質而語，其生之序，則水、火、木、金、土。而水、木陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"也，火、金陰也。又統而言之，則氣陽而質陰也。又錯而言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"之，則動陽而靜陰也。蓋五行之變，至不可窮，然無適而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505678615707711"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"非太極之本然也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":56,"lineType":2,"content":"栢齊何子曰：五行一陰陽，陰陽一太極。周子固謂太極不外乎陰陽，陰陽不外乎五行矣。自今論之，水水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":57,"lineType":2,"content":"也，火火也，金木水火土之交變也，土地也，天安在乎？有地而無天，謂造化全可乎？若以謂天即太極，故朱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":58,"lineType":2,"content":"子以上天之載釋太極，天道流行釋陰陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":58,"lineType":2,"content":"觀易","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_6","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":58,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":58,"lineType":2,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_7","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":58,"lineType":2,"content":"有太極，是生兩儀，兩儀生四象，四象生八卦，八卦之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":59,"lineType":2,"content":"中，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":59,"lineType":2,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_8","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":59,"lineType":2,"content":"有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":59,"lineType":2,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_9","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":59,"lineType":2,"content":"，則天地皆太極之分體明矣。以天為太極之全體，而地為天之分體，豈不誤甚也哉？其説似","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":60,"lineType":2,"content":"有理也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"72","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"夫五行之生，各一其性；四時之行，亦有其序。春以生之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"夏以長之，秋以肅之，冬以藏之。春而夏，夏而秋，秋而冬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505667702259749"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"冬而復春，而相循無窮。葢五行異質，四時異氣，而皆不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"外乎陰陽。陰陽異位，動靜異時，而皆不離乎太極。至於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"所以為太極者，又無聲臭之可言，是性之本體然也。故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"五行各一其性，所謂各具一太極也；四時自有其序，所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"謂運用一太極也；五行四時週而復始，所謂統體一太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"極也。而性之無所不在，又可見矣。夫天下無性外之物，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"而性無不在，此無極二五所以混融而無閒，所謂玅合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":72,"lineType":1,"content":"者也。無極是理，二五是氣。真以理言，太極無妄之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505678389231628"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"精以氣言，陰陽五行不二之謂也。凝者，聚也，氣聚而成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"形也。葢性為之主，而陰陽五行為之經緯錯綜，又各以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"類凝聚而成形焉。陽而健者成男，則父之道也。陰而順","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"者成女，則母之道也。是人物之始，以氣化而生者也。氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"聚成形，則形交氣感，遂以形化，而萬物生生變化無窮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。鮑魯齋曰：天地以氣交而生人物，觀其所交，則氣之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"所至，可以知其類之所從出矣。天氣交乎地，於人為男，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"於物為牡。地氣交乎天，於人為女，於物為牝。男女牝牡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505664967278618"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"又自交而生生化化不窮。人物旣生，氣隨天地之氣升","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"降交感。人得天地之中氣，四方之氣無不感。物得天地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"之偏氣，而亦各隨所感。故觀天地之氣交，可以知人物","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"之初生矣。觀天地之氣感，可以知人物之相生矣。朱子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：乾道成男，坤道成女，凝體於造化之初。二氣交感，化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"生萬物，流行於造化之後，此理之常也。若姜、嫄、簡狄之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"生稷、契，則又不可以先後言矣，此理之變也。張九韶曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"論人物始生於天地肇判之初，則由氣化而後有形化。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505682059067426"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"張子所謂天地之氣生之是也。論人物始生於結胎受","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"形之初，則由精氣之聚而後有是物。朱子所謂陰精陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"氣聚而成物是也。由是言之，則人也，物也，氣也，形也，孰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"有出於陰陽之外哉？夫命禀於陰陽，有生之初，非人所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"能移，莫之為而為，非我所能必。於是有生而富，生而貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"者；有生而壽，生而夭者；有生而貧，生而賤者；有生而富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"貴雙全，巍巍人上者；有生而貧賤兼有，落落人下者；有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"生而宜壽而反夭閼，有生而宜夭而反長年。之數者，謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505687008624651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"由於所積而然與？亦由於所性而然與？謂由於所積，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"貧可以致富，賤可以致貴，夭可以致壽，古之所謂人能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"勝天者也。謂由於所性以得乎富貴者終於富貴，貧賤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"者終於貧賤，壽夭者終於壽夭，古之所謂命不可移也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"夫謂之積，則不可專以為命；夫謂之性，則不可專以為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"人。將以付之於所積與，未知命之所禀富貴、壽夭、貧賤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"何如也？將以付之於所性與，未有富貴、壽夭、貧賤可坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"待者，而人為似不可缺也。或曰：命禀有生之初。誠哉是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505678389248012"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"言也。何人生天地之中，有五行八字相同，而富貴貧賤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"壽夭之不一，其故何也？答曰：陰陽二氣交感之時，受真","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"精玅合之氣，凝結為胎，成男成女，得天地父母一時氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"候。是以禀其清者為智為賢，禀其濁者為愚為不肖。智","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"者賢者，由是或富或貴或壽，必有所得，所謂徳足以獲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"福也。愚者不肖者，不能自奮，日益昏蔽，則貧賤與夭有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"不能免，所謂下愚不移是也。其富貴兩全者，原禀清輕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣，生逢得令之時，兼以財官亨通，祿馬旺相，其運與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505667702243365"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"限，甚吉甚祥，縱有少晦，不係駁雜。其貧賤兼有者，原禀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"重濁之氣，生逢失令之時，刑衝駁雜，無些順美，雖無禍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"患侵擾，未免蹇滯不前。又有富而貧，貧而富，貴而賤，賤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"而貴，壽而夭，夭而壽者。又有為賢為智而反貧賤，為愚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"不肖而反富貴者。天地間之人，萬有不齊，此亦四時五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"行，偏正得失，向背淺深之氣之所致也。故當時元氣雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"禀輕清，然而生於衰敗之時，行休囚之運，富者損失財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"源，貴者剝官退位，壽者夭閼不祿。其元氣雖禀重濁，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505622781198362"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"人生中和之令，行旺相之運，貧不終貧而為富，賤不終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"賤而為貴，夭不終夭而為壽。雖然修為在人，人定勝天，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"命禀中和，性加積善，豈但一身享福已哉！而子子孫孫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"榮昌利達，理宜然也。命值偏枯，性加積惡，非惟自身值","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"禍已也，而子子孫孫落落人下，得非報與！由前言之，雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"係於命，亦在於人之積與不積耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_10","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：積善之家，必有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"餘慶；積不善之家，必有餘殃。殆此之謂與！耕野子曰：天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"一氣爾，氣化生水，水中滓濁，積而成土，水落土出，遂成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505662085857280"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"山川。土之剛者成石而金生焉，土之柔者生木而火生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"焉。五行具，萬物生，而變化無窮矣。浚川子曰：天地之初，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有陰陽二氣而已，陽則化火，陰則化水，水之渣滓便","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"結成地，渣滓成地即土也。何至天五方言生土？水火土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之大化，金木者，三物之所自出，金石之質，必積久","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"而後結，生之必同於人物，謂金之氣生人，得乎？且天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"地之間，無非元氣之所為，其性其種已各具太始之先。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"金有金之種，木有木之種，人有人之種，物有物之種，各","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505664967344154"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"各完具，不相假借，不相凌犯，而謂五行逓互相生，可乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"今五行家以金生水，厥類懸絶不侔，厥理顛倒失次，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"知木以火為氣，以水為滋，以土為宅，此天然至道。而曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"水生木，無土將附木於何所？水多火滅土絶，木且死矣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"夫安能生？周子惑於五行家之説，而謂五氣順布，四時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"行焉。不知日有進退，乃成寒暑，寒暑分平，乃成四時，於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"五氣之布何與焉？其曰春木、夏火、秋金、冬水，皆假合之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":162,"lineType":1,"content":"論，土無所歸，配於四季，不知土之氣在天地内，何日不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505664967327770"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"然，何處不有？何止流行於季月之晦？季月之晦尚有，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"孟月之朔即滅，其滅也歸於何所？其來也，孰為命之？天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"一生水，乃緯書之辭，而儒者援以入經。水火者，陰陽始","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"生之玅物也，故一化而為火，日是也，再化而為水，雨露","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。今曰天一生水，地二生火，戾於造化本然之玅，可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"乎？其折朱子以四時流行之氣論五行，天地奇偶之數","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"論五行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"太極圖","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_11","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"陽變陰合而生水火木金土，論五行。其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"折五行配四時，如五行家四時各主其一，春止為木，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505662085939200"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"水火土金之氣，孰絶滅之？秋止為金，則水火土木之氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"孰留停之？土惟旺於四季，則餘月之氣，孰把持而不使之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"運？又安有今日為木，明日為火，又明日為土為金為水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"乎？按王氏之説有理，而非達觀之見。珞琭子曰：以為有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"也，是從無而立有；以為無也，天垂象以示文。夫天垂日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":180,"lineType":1,"content":"月五星、三垣、二十八宿之象，觀天王會通，其立名分野，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"是亦人為之耳，而義象符合。至災祥占卜，或屬類某事，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"或指見某方，應於某年月日，如探左契。雖天道玄遠，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505662085971968"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"不外人事與五行。陰陽家以十干十二支分為五行，因","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"日與天會而為歲，月與日會而為月，日有三十，時有十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"二，以人生年月日時所得干支，立為四柱，以推一生吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"凶，亦理之自然者也。王氏以春屬木，而土何在？不知五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"行旺相死休囚，各主其當時不當時用事不用事而言，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"非為春木旺而土則無。十干十二支錯綜為六十甲子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"週而復始，不假安排，即造化之所在也。非為今日屬木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"明日屬火，便非天道之自然。不思人立而天從之，人感","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505674975166464"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"而天應之，即天象立名分野之義，天人合一之道也。觀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"一日有早午晏晚，自有溫凉寒熱氣候，是金木水火土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"備於一日，五行之不相離如此。謂今日木，明日火，又何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":198,"lineType":1,"content":"莫而非天道之自然也耶？且朝廷造厯，頒之天下，其載","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"一年三百六十五日，中間一年之神煞方位，每月之天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"行徳旺，而一日之中，又有黑黃吉凶，事之宜與不宜，人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"遵之則福，違之則禍，是果無理强造，而率天下以必從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"哉？又相人術，觀氣色之青黃赤白黑，而决禍福應於某","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505674975150080"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"年月日時，青則甲乙，黃則戊己，赤則丙丁，白則庚辛，黑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"則壬癸，一毫不爽。察病亦然，觀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"素問","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_12","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"可見。是干支雖所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"以紀日，而造化不外是也。又人之精神夢寐，預兆吉凶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"占之者或以意斷，或以物象，或以字解，或以音叶，皆人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"為之也，而吉凶不能外焉。是有是人而後有是夢，因是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"夢而求是人，造化且不外，而况干支五行，自有天地，便","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"有此理，因有此理，便生是人。人與天一也，外人以言天，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"外天以言人，皆誣矣。若伏羲畫卦，仰觀俯察，遠稽近取，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505678389264396"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"是得天地人物之理，而八卦所由作也。今之談陰陽者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":216,"lineType":1,"content":"雖窮極天地之變，探索人物之微，彰往察來，因著知微，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"與天地合其徳，與日月合其明，與四時合其序，與鬼神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"合其吉凶，亦豈能外干支五行而別有造化，以盡天地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"人物之大哉？今王氏知尊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_13","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"而不信陰陽家説，是知有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"理而不知有數也。理數合一，天人一理，神而明之，存乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"其人焉耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"225","lineNum":222,"lineType":8,"content":"論五行生成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505721040945171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"天高寥廓，六氣回旋，以成四時；地厚幽深，五行化生，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"成萬物。可謂無窮而莫測者也。聖人立法以推步者，蓋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"不能逃其數。觀其立數之因，亦皆出乎自然，故載於經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"典，同而不異。推以達其機，窮以通其變，皆不離於數内。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"一曰水，二曰火，三曰木，四曰金，五曰土者，咸有所自也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"水，北方子之位也。子者，陽之初一，陽數也。故水曰一。火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"南方，午之位也。午者，陰之初二，陰數也。故火曰二。木居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"東方，東，陽也；三者，奇之數，亦陽也。故木曰三。金居西方，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505662085955584"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"西，陰也；四者偶之數，亦陰也。故金曰四。土應西南長夏，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"五者，奇之數，亦陽也。故土曰五。由是論之，則數以陰陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"而配者也。若攷其深義，則水生於一，天地未分，萬物未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"成之初，莫不先見於水。故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"靈樞經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_14","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：太一者，水之尊號，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"先天地之母，後萬物之源。以今驗之，草木子實未就，人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"蟲胎卵胎胚，皆水也，豈不以為一？及其水之聚而形質","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"化，莫不備陰陽之氣在中而後成。故物之小而味苦者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"火之兆也。物熟則甘，土之味也。甘極而反淡，淡，本也。然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505678615740479"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"人稟父母陰陽生成之化，故先生二腎。左腎屬水，右腎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"屬火。火曰命門，則火之因水而後見，故火曰次二。蓋草","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"木子實大小雖異，其中皆有兩以相合者，與人腎同，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽之兆。是以萬物非陰陽合體，則不能化生也。旣陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"陽合體，然後而春生而秋成，故次三曰木，次四曰金。蓋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"水有所屬，火有所藏，木有所發，金有所別，莫不皆因土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"而後成也，故次五曰土。木居於東，金居於西，火居於南，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":252,"lineType":1,"content":"水居於北，土居於中央，而寄位四維，應令四季，在人四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505706637738011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"支。故金木水火皆待土而後成。兼其土數五以成之，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"水六、火七，木八，金九。土常以五之生數不可至十者，土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"不待十以成。是生成之數，皆五以合之。明大衍之數由","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"是以立，則萬物豈能逃其數哉！三陰三陽，正化者從本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"生數，對化者從標成數。五運之紀，則太過者其數成，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"及者其數生。各取其數之生成多少，以占政令。氣化者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"復著之述作，蓋明諸用也。周子曰：五行之序，以質之所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"生而言，則水本是陽之濕氣，以其初動為陰所陷，而不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505706637754395"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"得遂，故水陰勝。火本是陰之燥氣，以其初動為陽所檢，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"而不得達，故火陽勝。蓋生之者微，成之者盛。生之者，形","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"之始，成之者形之終也。然各以偏勝言也。故雖有形而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"未成質，以氣升降，上不得而制焉。木則陽之濕氣浸多，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"以感於陰而舒，故發而為木，其質柔，其性暖。金則陰之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"燥氣浸多，以感於陽而縮，故結而為金，其質剛，其性寒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"土則陰陽之氣各盛，相交相摶，凝而成質。以氣之行而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"言，則一陰一陽，往來相代。木火、金水土者，各就其中而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505706637803547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"分老少耳，故其序各由少而老。土則分旺四季，而位居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"中者也。此五者若參差，而造化所以為發育之具，實並","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"行而不相悖。蓋質則陰陽交錯，凝合而成；氣則陰陽兩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"端，循環不已。質曰水火木金，蓋以陰陽相間言，猶曰東","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"西南北，所謂對待者也。氣曰木火金水，蓋以陰陽相因","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"言，猶曰東南西北，所謂流行者也。質雖一定而不易，氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"則變化而無窮，所謂易也。程子曰：動靜，陰陽之本也。五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"行之運，則參差不齊矣。張子曰：木曰曲直，能旣曲而反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505706637787163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"伸也。金曰從革，一從革而不能自反也。水火，氣也，故炎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"上潤下，與陰陽升降，土不得而制焉。木金者，土之華實","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"也，其性有水火之雜，故木之為物，水漬則生，火然而不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"雜也，蓋得土之浮華於水火之交也。金之為物，得火之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"精於火之燥，得水之精於水之濡，故水火相待而不相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"害，鑠之反流而不耗，蓋得土之精實於水火之際也。土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"者，物之所以成始而成終也，地之質也，化之終也，水火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"之所以升降，特兼體而不遺者也。又曰：陽陷於陰為水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505662086037504"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"陰附於陽為火。朱子曰：五行之序，木為之始，水為之終，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"而土為之中。以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"河圖","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_15","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_16","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"之數言之，則水一木三而土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"五，皆陽之生數而不可易者也。故得以更迭為主，而為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之綱。以徳言之，則木為發生之性，水為貞靜之體，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"而土又包育之母。故水之包五行也，以其流通貫徹而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"無不在也。木之包五行，以其歸根反本而藏於此也。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"夫土，則水火之所寄，金木之所資，居中而奠四方，一體","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"而載萬類者也。又曰：水火清，金木濁，土又濁。邵子曰：金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505662086053888"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"火相守則流，木火相得則然。從其類也。水遇寒則結，遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"火則渴，從其所勝也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"307","lineNum":307,"lineType":8,"content":"論五行生尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"308","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"五行相生相尅，其理昭然。十干十二支，五運六氣，歲月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"日時，皆自此立，更相為用。在天則為氣，寒暑燥濕風；在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"地則成形，金木水火土。形氣相感，而化生萬物，此造化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"生成之大紀也。原其玅用，可謂無窮矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"木主於東，應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"春。木之為言，觸也，陽氣觸動，冒地而生也。水流趨東，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505678389346316"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"生木也，木上發而覆下，乃自然之質也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"火主於南，應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"夏。火之為言，化也，燬也，陽在上，陰在下，燬然盛而變化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物也。鑽木取火，木所生也，然火無正體，體本木焉，出","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"以應物，盡而復入，乃自然之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"金主於西，應秋。金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"之為言，禁也，陰氣始禁止萬物而收斂。披沙揀金，土所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"生也，生於土而別於土，乃自然之形也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":324,"lineType":1,"content":"水主於北，應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"冬。水之為言，潤也，陰氣濡潤，任養萬物也。水西而東，金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"所生也，水流曲折，順下而達，乃自然之性也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"土主於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505721040961555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"中央，兼位西南，應於長夏。土之為言吐也。含吐萬物，將","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"生者出，將死者歸，為萬物家，故長於夏末，火所生也。土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"或勝水，水乃反土，自然之義也。五行相尅，子皆能為母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"復讎也。木尅土，土之子金，反尅木。金尅木，木之子火，反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"尅金。火尅金，金之子水，反尅火。水尅火，火之子土，反尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"水。土尅水，水之子木，反尅土。互能相生，乃其始也；互能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"相尅，乃其終也。皆出乎天之性也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"素問","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_17","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂水生木，木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"復生火，是木受竊氣，故水怒而尅火。即子逢竊氣，母乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505678389329932"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"力爭，與母被鬼傷，子來力救，其義一也。强可攻弱，土得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"木而達；實可勝虛，水得土而絶。陰可消陽，火得水而滅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"烈可敵剛，金得火而缺。堅可制柔，木得金而伐。故五者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"流行而更轉，順則相生，逆則相尅。如是則各各為用，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"成其道而已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"344","lineNum":345,"lineType":8,"content":"論支干源流","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"345","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"夫干猶木之幹，强而為陽；支猶木之枝，弱而為陰。昔盤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"古氏明天地之道，達陰陽之變，為三才首君。以天地旣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505721040994323"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"分之後，先有天而後有地，由是氣化而人生焉。故天皇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"氏一姓十三人，繼盤古氏以治，是曰天靈，澹泊無為，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"俗自化。始制干支之名，以定歲之所在。其十干曰：閼逢、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"旃蒙、柔兆、彊圉、著雍、屠維、上章、重光、玄黓、昭陽；十二支","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：困敦、赤奮若、攝提格、單閼、執徐、大荒落、敦牂、協洽、涒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"灘、作噩、閹茂、大淵獻。蔡邕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"獨斷","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_18","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：干，幹也，其名有十，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"曰十母，即今甲、乙、丙、丁、戊、己、庚、辛、壬、癸是也。支，枝也，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"名十有二，亦曰十二子，即今子、丑、寅、卯、辰、巳、午、未、申、酉、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505662086103040"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":360,"lineType":1,"content":"戌、亥是也。謂之天皇氏者，取其天開於子之義也。謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"地皇氏者，取其地闢於丑之義也。謂之人皇氏者，取其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"人生於寅之義也。故干支之名，在天皇時始制，而地皇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"氏則爰定三辰，道分晝夜，以三十日為一月，而干支始","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"各有所配。人皇氏者，主不虛王，臣不虛貴，政教君臣所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"自起，飲食男女所自始，始得天地陰陽之氣，而有子母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"之分，於是干支始各有所屬焉。至於伏羲，仰觀象於天，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"俯觀法於地，中觀萬物與人，始畫八卦，以通神明之徳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505706637819931"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"以類萬物之情，以作甲厯，而文字生焉。逮及黃帝授","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"河","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_19","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"圖","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_19","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"，見日月星辰之象，於是始有星官之書。命大撓探五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"行之情，占斗綱所建，於是始作甲子，配五行納音之屬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"路史","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_20","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"云：伏羲命潛龍氏筮之，乃迎日推策剛柔，建造甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"子，以命歲時，配天為幹，配地為枝，枝幹配類，以綱維乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"四象，故情偽相感，而星辰以順則。至黃帝命大撓探五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"行之情，考天書三式，以十干十二支衍而成六十，取納","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"音聲而定之為納音，即甲子乙丑海中金之類是也。風","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505622781263898"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"后釋之，以致其用，而三命行矣。彼術家以黄帝定天干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"十字屬河之圖，地支十二屬洛之書，以鬼谷子算成納","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"音，東方朔解納音象，皆不得其源而妄云也。浚川王氏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：昔大撓作甲子，名數無有窮已，便於紀時，偶爾定之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"若推考其源，必日月初轉之日，而後為甲子可也。天之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"開，尚未有地，安能有人？尚未有人，孰從而傳以記之，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"為本於十二辰之常而知之耶？天地之運，如環無端，運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"周一元，磨磑之轉，獨不再始乎？日周十二時，天之運，獨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505721040977939"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"不再子乎？一元之上，安知其不有一元耶？况厯元之度，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"牛斗之變，歲差遠矣。後世之厯，各自為據，以求合時爾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"古厯之法，隨世亡矣，安能算而合之？今之言甲乙者，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"曰實有木氣主之，而今日木，明日火，後日土，不亦誣乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：大撓占斗柄而造甲子，必能遠遡天地之始，故以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"年甲子、月甲子、日甲子、時甲子為厯元。不思占斗柄止","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"可定十二月，天地初開闢，日月如合璧，五星如連珠，俱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"起於牽牛之初，而後可以定夜半之冬至，此乃死法，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505662086070272"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"孟子以為千歲之厯可坐而致。以今之厯考之，如所云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"云，則天地之開闢者亦數矣。是豈天地之始耶？日月初","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"轉之始耶？文字未興，天運無稽，又安能盡推之也耶？按：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"王説果為有見，然古今高人達士，稽考天數，推察陰陽，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"以太乙數而推天運吉凶，以六壬而推人事吉凶，以奇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"門而推地方吉凶，以年月日時而推人一生吉凶，如天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"罡、淳風、一行、虛中輩，無不奇中，抑又何耶？若如王氏所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"説，前皆不足信矣。其然，豈其然乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"408","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"天氣始於甲干，地氣始於子支者，乃聖人究乎陰陽重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"輕之用也。著名以彰其徳，立號以表其事，由是干甲相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"合，然後成紀。遠可步於歲而統六十年，近可推於日而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":414,"lineType":1,"content":"明十二時。歲運之盈虛，氣令之早晏，萬物生死，由今驗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"古，或得而知之。非特是也，將攷其細而知未萌之禍福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"究其用而察向往之死生，則精微之義，可謂大矣哉！是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"以東方甲乙，南方丙丁，西方庚辛，北方壬癸，中央戊己，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505682059116578"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之位也。蓋甲乙，其位木，得春之令，甲乃陽内而陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"尚包之，草木始甲而出也。乙者，陽過中，然未得正方，尚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"乙屈也。又云：乙，軋也，萬物皆解莩甲，自抽軋而出之。丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"丁，其位火，行夏之令，丙乃陽上而陰下，陰内而陽外，陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"丁其强，適能與陰氣相丁。又云：丙，炳也，萬物皆炳然著","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"見而强大。戊己，其位土，行周四季，戊，陽土也，萬物生而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"出之，萬物伐而入之。己，陰土也，無所為而得已者也。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"云：戊，茂也；己，起也。土行四季之末，萬物含秀者，抑屈而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505677676052531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"起也。庚辛，其位金，行秋之令，庚乃陰干陽，更而續者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"辛乃陽在下，陰在上，陰干陽極於此。庚更故也，而辛，新","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":432,"lineType":1,"content":"也。庚辛皆金，金味辛，物成而後有味。又云：萬物肅然更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"改，秀實新成。壬癸其位水行冬之令，壬之言任也，壬乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"陽生之位，壬而為胎，萬物懷妊於壬，與子同意。癸者，揆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"也。天令至此，萬物閉藏，懷妊於其下，揆然萌芽，此天之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"道也，以為日名焉。故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_21","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：天有十日，日六竟而周甲者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"此也。蓋天地之數，甲、丙、戊、庚、壬為陽，乙、丁、己、辛、癸為陰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505678615806015"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"五行各一陰一陽，故有十日也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"437","lineNum":441,"lineType":8,"content":"論十二支名字之義","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"438","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"夫清陽為天，五行彰而十干立；濁陰為地，八方定而十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"二支分。運移氣遷，歲歲而盈虛應紀；上升下降，物物而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"變化可期。所以支干配合，共臻玅用矣。子者，北方至陰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"寒水之位，而一陽肇生之始，故陰極則陽生，壬而為胎，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"子之為子，此十一月之辰也。至丑陰尚執而紐之。又丑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"陰也，助也，謂十二月終始之際，以結紐為名焉。寅，正月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505682059149346"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":450,"lineType":1,"content":"也，陽已在上，陰已在下，人始見之時，故律管飛灰以候","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"之，可以述事之始也。又，寅，演也，津也，謂物之津塗。卯，日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"升之時也。又，卯，茂也，言二月陽氣盛而孳茂。辰者，陽已","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"過半，三月之時，物盡震而長。又謂辰，言震也。巳者，四月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"正陽而無陰也。自子至巳，陽之位，陽於是盡。又，巳，起也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"物畢盡而起。午者，陽尚未屈，陰始生而為主。又云：午，長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"也，大也，物至五月，皆豐滿長大也。未，六月，木已種而成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。又云：未，味也，物成而有味，與辛同意。申者，七月之辰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505678389362700"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"申，陽所為而己，陰至於申，則上下通而人始見，白露葉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"落，乃其候也，可以述陰事以成之。又云：申，身也，言物體","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"皆成。酉者，日入之時，乃陽正中，八月也。又云：酉，緧也。萬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"物皆緧縮收斂。九月：戌，陽未旣也，然不能事，潛藏於戌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"戌中乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_22","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"位，戌為天門故也。又云：戌，滅也，萬物皆衰滅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。十月，亥，純陰也。又亥，劾也，言陰氣劾殺萬物，此地之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"道也，故以此名月焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"463","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"甲之干乃天之五行，以一陰一陽言之。子之支乃地之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505713642176546"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"五行，以地之方隅言之。故子、寅、午、申為陽，卯、巳、酉、亥為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"陰。土居四維，王在四季之末。土有四，辰戌為陽，丑未為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"陰，故其數不同也。合而言之，十配十二，共成六十日，復","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"六六而成歲。故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_23","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"曰天以六六之節，以成一歲，此之謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"也。陳摶曰：天干始於甲而終於癸，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"河圖","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_24","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"生成之數也。地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"支起於子而終於亥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"洛書","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_25","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"奇偶之數也。陽自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"復","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_26","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"始，六變","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_27","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"陽備；陰自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"姤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_28","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"始，六變而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_29","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"陰成。合二六之數而為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"十二辰也。夫甲、丙、戊、庚、壬，陽幹也；子、寅、辰、午、申、戌，陽枝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505678615855167"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"也。乙、丁、己、辛、癸，陰幹也；丑、卯、巳、未、酉、亥，陰枝也。法以陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"幹配陽枝，陰幹配陰枝，猶木之有幹而有枝。自甲子為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"首，以六甲五子次第推排，而盡於癸亥，仍以幹枝本數","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"而計其成數，總其成數幹枝若干，然後以五數除之，遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"其有剩者，約之以生五行之音，是為六甲納音。聖人推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"之以入用，以分金六十位，定布於二十四位，以正五行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":486,"lineType":1,"content":"為各宮之主。以六甲大五行為緯，察其分金胎養衰死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣，定其孤虛旺相之卦，内有戊己為龜甲空亡，甲乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505712220307471"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"為補接之空，以是消息陰陽。凡立葬乘氣定命納音皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"宗乎此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
