{"lines":[{"lineId":"500","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"嘗觀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"筆談","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_30","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"論六十甲子納音，本六十律旋相為宮法也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"一律含五音。凡氣始於東方而右行，音起於西方而左","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"行，陰陽相錯而生變化。所謂氣始於東方者，四時始於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"木，右行傳於火，火傳於土，土傳於金，金傳於水。所謂始","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"於西方者，五音始於金，左旋傳於火，火傳於木，木傳於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505664967393306"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"水，水傳於土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"納音與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_31","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"納甲同法，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_32","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"納甲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_33","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"納癸，始於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_34","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"而終於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_35","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"。納音始於金，金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_36","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"也，終於土，土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_37","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"也。五行之中，惟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":502,"lineType":2,"content":"有金鑄而為器，則音聲彰，納音所以先金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum" {"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":503,"lineType":1,"content":"納音之法，同類娶妻，隔八生子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":503,"lineType":2,"content":"此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":503,"lineType":2,"content":"漢志","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_39","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":503,"lineType":2,"content":"語也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":503,"lineType":1,"content":"律呂相生之法","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":504,"lineType":1,"content":"也。甲子金之仲，同位娶乙丑，隔八下生壬申，金之孟。壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"申同位娶癸酉，隔八上生庚辰，金之季。庚辰同位娶辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"巳，隔八下生戊子，火之仲；戊子娶己丑，生丙申，火之孟；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申娶丁酉，生甲辰，火之季；甲辰娶乙巳，生壬子，木之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505677676101683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"仲。如是左行，至於丁巳中呂之宮，五音一終，復自甲午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"金之仲娶乙未，隔八生壬寅，一如甲子之法，終於癸亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"自子至於巳為陽，故自黃鍾至於中呂皆下生。自午至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"於亥為陰，故自林鍾至於應鍾皆上生。夫上下生者，正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"謂天氣下降，地氣上升。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_40","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：天地交泰，義見於此。然所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"生止三者，亦三元之義。故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_41","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：三而成天，三而成地，三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"而成人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_42","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"爻之象取三。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"老子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_43","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：一生二，二生三，三生萬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"物。蓋有始有中有終畢矣。又觀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"路史","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_ cSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":522,"lineType":1,"content":"泰","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_49","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":522,"lineType":1,"content":"。徳為父，紅為母，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"徳紅合而為東。干為君，支為臣，干支合而納音生。是故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙為君，子丑為臣，子丑甲乙合而為金。蓋五行之在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"天下，各有氣性，有材位，或相濟，或相尅。若成器未成器，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"旺中受絶，絶中受氣，惟相配而取之為不同耳。此金數","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"之所以難同，而又有海中沙中之異。或曰：甲乙以相尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505677676085299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"取，甲嫁庚，乙嫁辛，甲乙遂有金氣，故凡木必受金胎。陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"生於子，水旺之地，故甲子、乙丑為海中之陽金。陰生於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"午，火旺之地，故甲午、乙未為沙中之陰金。子，陽之始；午，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"陰之始。以甲加子，乙加丑，數之至午得庚，至未得辛，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"陽索陰。以甲加午，乙加未，數至子丑，亦得庚辛，為陰匹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"陽。蓋亦旋宮之法，夫妻子母相濟相尅，相上相下，而吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"凶之兆著矣。草有莘與藟，獨食之殺人，合而食之有壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"金錫兩柔，合而煉之則剛，理固如是。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"觀六微旨論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_50","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505706637852699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"納音者，謂子午數至庚，丑未數至辛，寅申數至戊，卯酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"數至己，辰戌數至丙，巳亥數至丁。得七者，西方素皇之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，納音屬金也。得三者，南方丹天之氣，納音屬火也。得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"九者，東方陽九之氣，納音屬木也。得一者，中央總統之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，納音屬土也。得五者，北方玄極之氣，納音屬水也。假","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子、甲午，從甲至庚，乙丑、乙未，從乙至辛，其數皆七，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"所以納音屬金。丙寅、丙申，從丙至戊，丁卯、丁酉，從丁至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"己，其數皆三，所以納音屬火。戊辰、戊戌，從戊至丙，己己、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505717253472295"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥，從己至丁，其數皆九，所以納音屬木。庚子、庚午、辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"未、辛丑，其數皆一，所以納音屬土。丙子、丙午，從丙至庚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未、丁丑，從丁至辛，其數皆五，所以納音屬水。納，干數","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"也，所以只數其干，不數其支。如從丙至庚，即丙、丁、戊、己、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"庚，是其數五也。又如從甲至庚，即甲、乙、丙、丁、戊、己、庚，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"數七，即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"路史","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_51","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"之義。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"瑞桂堂暇錄","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_52","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"則云：六十甲子之納","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"音，此以金、木、水、火、土之音而明之也。一六為水，二七為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"火，三八為木，四九為金，五十為土。盖五行之中，惟金木","logicSentenceId":"0","margin [],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"生數也。生者左旋，故以中央之土而生西方之金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"西方之金而生北方之水，北方之水而生東方之木，東","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"方之木而生南方之火，南方之火而復生中央之土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"洛","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_55","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"書","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_55","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"尅數也。尅者右轉，故以中央之土而尅北與西北之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"水，北與西北之水而尅西與西南之火，西與西南之火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"而尅南與東南之金，南與東南之金而尅東與東北之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"木，東與東北之木而又尅中央之土，無微不通，此納音","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505677676118067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"之所為玅也。斷斷乎出自黃帝無疑矣。再考","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"太玄","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_56","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList {"lines":[{"lineId":"762","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"昔者黃帝將甲子分輕重而配成六十，號曰花甲子。其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"花字誠為奥妙，聖人借意而喻之，不可著意執泥。夫自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"子至亥十二宮，各有金木水火土之屬，始起於子為一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，終於亥為六陰。其五行所屬金木水火土，在天為五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505713642225698"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"星，於地為五岳，於徳為五常，於人為五臟。其於命也為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"五行。是故甲子之屬乃應之於命，命則一世之事。故甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"子納音象，聖人喩之，亦如人一世之事也。何言乎？子丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"二位陰陽始孕，人在胞胎，物藏荄根，未有涯際。寅卯二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":674,"lineType":1,"content":"位陰陽漸闢，人漸生長，物以拆甲，羣葩漸剖，如人將有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"立身也。辰巳二位，陰陽氣盛，物當華秀，如人三十四十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"而有立身之地，始有進取之象。午未二位，陰陽彰露，物","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"已成齊，人至五十六十，富貴貧賤可知，凡百興衰可見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505713642242067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"申酉二位，陰陽肅殺，物已收成，人已龜縮，各得其靜矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"戌亥二位，陰陽閉塞，物氣歸根，人當休息，各有歸著。詳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"此十有二位，先後六十甲子，可以次第而曉。甲子、乙丑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"何以取象為海中之金？蓋氣在包藏，有名無形，猶人之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"在母腹也。壬寅、癸卯，絶地存金，氣尚柔弱，薄若繒縞，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"曰金泊金。庚辰、辛巳，以金居火土之地，氣已發生，金尚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"在鑛，寄形生養之鄉，受西方之正色，乃曰白鑞金。甲午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未，則氣已成物，質自堅實，混於沙而別於沙，居於火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505712220438543"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"而煉於火，乃曰沙中金也。壬申、癸酉，氣盛物極，當施收","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"斂之功，穎脱鋒鋭之刃，蓋申酉，金之正位，干值壬癸，金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"水淬礪，故取象劒鋒，而金之功用極矣。至戌亥，則金氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"藏伏，形體已殘，煅煉首飾，已成其狀，藏之閨閣，無所施","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"為，而金之功用畢，故曰庚戌、辛亥釵釧金。壬子、癸丑，何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"以取象桑柘木？蓋氣居盤屈，形狀未伸，居於水地。蠶衰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":696,"lineType":1,"content":"之月，桑柘受氣，取其時之生也。庚寅、辛卯，則氣已乘陽，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"得栽培之勢力，其為狀也，奈居金下，凡金與霜素堅木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505706637885467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"居下得其旺，歲寒後凋，取其性之堅也，故曰松柏木。戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、己巳，則氣不成量，物已及時，枝葉茂盛，鬱然成林，取","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"其木之盛也，故曰大林木。壬午、癸未，木至午而死，至未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"而墓，故楊柳盛夏葉凋，枝幹微弱，取其性之柔也，故曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"楊柳木。庚申、辛酉，五行屬金，而納音屬木，以相尅取之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋木性辛者，唯石榴木。申酉氣歸靜肅，物漸成實，木居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"金地，其味成辛，故曰石榴木。觀他木至午而死，惟此木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"至午而旺，取其性之偏也。戊戌、己亥，氣歸藏伏，陰陽閉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505664967507994"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"塞，木氣歸根，伏乎土中，故曰平地木也。丙子、丁丑，何以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"取象澗下水？蓋氣未通濟，高段非水流之所，卑濕乃水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"就之鄉，由地中行，故曰澗下水。甲寅、乙卯，氣出陽明，水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"勢恃源，東流滔注，其勢浸大，故曰大溪水。壬辰、癸巳，勢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":714,"lineType":1,"content":"極東南，氣傍離宮，火明勢盛，水得歸庫，盈科後進，乃曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"長流水也。丙午、丁未，氣當升降，在高明火位，有水，沛然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"作霖，以濟火中之水，惟天上乃有，故曰天河水。甲申、乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"酉，氣息安靜，子母同位，出而不窮，汲而不竭，乃曰井泉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505712220454927"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":720,"lineType":1,"content":"水。壬戌、癸亥，天門之地，氣歸閉塞，水歷遍而不趨，勢歸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"乎寧謐之位，來之不窮，納之不溢，乃曰大海水也。戊子、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":722,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑，何以取象霹靂火？蓋氣在一陽，形居水位，水中之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"火，非神龍則無，故曰霹靂火。丙寅、丁卯，氣漸發輝，因薪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"而顯，陰陽為冶，天地為爐，乃曰爐中火也。甲辰、乙巳，氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"形盛地，勢定高岡，傳明繼晦，子母相承，乃曰覆燈火也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午、己未，氣過陽宮，重離相㑹，炳靈交光，發輝炎上，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"曰天上火也。丙申、丁酉，氣息形藏，勢力韜光，龜縮兌位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505713642242082"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":730,"lineType":1,"content":"力微體弱，明不及遠，乃曰山下火也。甲戌、乙亥謂之山","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"頭火者，山乃藏形，頭乃投光，内明外暗，隱而不顯，飛光","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"投乾，歸於休息之中，故曰山頭火也。庚子、辛丑，何以取","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"象？壁上土。氣居閉塞，物尚包藏，掩形遮體，内外不交，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":734,"lineType":1,"content":"曰壁上土。戊寅、己卯，氣能成物，功以育物，發乎根荄，壯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"乎萼蕊，乃曰城頭土也。丙辰、丁巳，氣以承陽，發生已過，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"成齊未來，乃曰沙中土也。庚午、辛未，氣當承形，物以路","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"彰，有形可質，有物可彰，乃曰路傍土也。戊申、己酉，氣以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505682059231266"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"歸息，物當收斂，龜縮退閑，美而無事，乃曰大驛土也。丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"戌、丁亥，氣成物府，事以美圓，陰陽歷遍，勢得其閒，乃曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"屋上土也。余見路傍之土，播殖百穀。午未之地，其盛夏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"長養之時乎。大驛之土，通達四方。申酉之地，其得朋利","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":744,"lineType":1,"content":"亨之理乎。城頭之土，取隄防之功，王公恃之，立國而衞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"民也。壁上之土，明粉飾之用，臣庶資之，爰居而爰處也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"沙中之土，土之最潤者也，土潤則生，故成齊未來而有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"用。屋上之土，土之成功者也，成功者靜，故止於一定而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505721041125395"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"不遷。蓋居五行之中，行負載之令，主養育之權，三才五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"行，皆不可失。處高下而得位，居四季而有功。金得之鋒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":752,"lineType":1,"content":"鋭雄剛，火得之光明照耀，木得之英華越秀，水得之濫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"波不泛，土得之稼穡愈豐。聚之不散，必能為山，山者，高","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":754,"lineType":1,"content":"也。散之不聚，必能為地，地者，原也。用之無窮，生之罔極，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"土之功用大矣哉。又聞日家云：甲子乙丑，子屬水，又為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":756,"lineType":1,"content":"湖，又為水旺之地，兼金死於子，墓於丑，水旺而金死墓，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰海中金。壬申、癸酉，申酉，金之正位，兼臨官申帝旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505721041109011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"酉金旣生旺，則誠剛矣，剛則無踰於劒鋒，故曰劒鋒金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰、辛巳，金養於辰，生於巳，形質初成，未能堅利，故曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":762,"lineType":1,"content":"白鑞金。甲午、乙未，午為火旺之地，火旺則金敗；未為火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"衰之地，火衰則金冠帶，敗而方冠帶，未能斫伐，故曰沙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":764,"lineType":1,"content":"中金。壬寅、癸卯，寅卯為木旺之地，木旺則金羸，又金絶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"於寅，胎於卯，金旣無力，故曰金泊金。庚戌、辛亥，金至戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"而衰，至亥而病，金旣衰病，則誠柔矣，故曰釵釧金。丙寅、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯，寅為三陽，卯為四陽，火旣得地，又得寅卯之木以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505682059247650"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":770,"lineType":1,"content":"生，此時天地開爐，萬物始生，故曰爐中火。甲戌、乙亥，戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"亥為天門，火照天門，其光至高，故曰山頭火。戊子、己丑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":772,"lineType":1,"content":"丑屬土，子屬水，水居正位，而納音乃火，非神龍則無，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":773,"lineType":1,"content":"曰霹靂火。丙申、丁酉，申為地戸，西為日入之門，日至此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":774,"lineType":1,"content":"而藏光，故曰山下火。甲辰、乙巳，辰為食時，巳為禺中，日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"之將中，艷陽之勢，光於天下，故曰覆燈火。戊午、己未，午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"為旺火之地，未中之木又復生之，火性炎上，及逢生地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰天上火。戊辰、己巳，辰為原野，巳為六陽，木至此則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505664967524378"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"枝榮葉茂，以茂盛之木而居原野之間，故曰大林木。壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"午、癸未，木死於午，墓於未，木旣死墓，雖得天干壬癸水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"生，終是柔弱，故曰楊柳木。庚寅、辛卯，木臨官寅帝旺，卯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"木旣生，旺則非柔弱之比，故曰松柏木。戊戌、己亥，戌為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"原野，亥為木生之地，木生原野，則非一根一株之比，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"曰平地木。壬子、癸丑，子屬水，丑屬金，水方生木，金則伐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"之，猶桑柘方生，人便以餧蠶，故曰桑柘木。庚申、辛酉，申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"為七月，酉為八月，此時木絶，惟石榴之木反結實，故曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505664967540762"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"石榴木。庚午、辛未，未中之木而生午位之旺火，火旺則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":791,"lineType":1,"content":"土於斯而受形，土之始生，未能育物，猶傍路若也。戊寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":792,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯，天干戊己屬土，寅為艮山，土積而為山，故曰城頭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"土。丙戌、丁亥，丙丁屬火，戌亥為天門，火旣炎上，則土非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":794,"lineType":1,"content":"在下而生，故曰屋上土。庚子、辛丑，丑雖土家正位，而子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"則水旺之地，土見水則為泥，故曰壁上土。戊申、己酉，申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_86","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"，為地，酉屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"兌","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_87","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"，為澤。戊己之土加於坤澤之上，非它","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"浮薄之土比，故曰大驛土。丙辰、丁巳，土庫辰絶巳，而天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505677676183603"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"干丙丁之火，至辰冠帶，巳臨官，土旣庫絶，旺火復與生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"之，故曰沙中土。丙子、丁丑，水旺於子，衰於丑，旺而反衰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"則不能為江河，故曰澗下水。甲申、乙酉，金臨官，申帝旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"酉，金旣生旺，則水由是以生，力量未洪，故曰井泉水。壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、癸巳，辰為水庫，巳為金長生之地，金生之，水旺巳存，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"以庫水而逢生金，則泉源不竭，故曰長流水。丙午、丁未，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁屬火，午為火旺之地，而納音乃水，水自火出，非銀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"漢不能有，故曰天河水。甲寅乙卯，寅為東北維，卯為正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505677676199987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":810,"lineType":1,"content":"東，水流正東，則其性順，而川澗池沼，俱合而歸，故曰大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"溪水。壬戌癸亥，水冠帶，戌臨官，亥則力厚，兼亥為江，非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"他水比，故曰大海水。其説雖鑿，與前互相發明，可以見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"古人取象之義也。嘗試論之，五行取象，皆以對待而分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":814,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽，即始終而明變化。如甲子乙丑，對甲午乙未，海中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"沙中，水土之辨，陰陽之分也。壬寅癸卯，對壬申癸酉，金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"泊劒鋒，金木之辨，剛柔之別也。庚辰辛巳、庚戌辛亥，白","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"鑞釵釧，乾巽異方，形色各盡也。壬子癸丑，對壬午癸未，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505682059313186"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"桑柘楊柳，一曲一柔，形質各別也。庚寅辛卯，對庚申辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"酉，松柏石榴，一堅一辛，性味迥異也。戊辰己巳，對戊戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥，大林平地，一盛一衰，巽乾殊方也。戊子己丑，對戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"午己未，霹靂天上，雷霆揮鞭，日月同照也。丙寅丁卯，對","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":824,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申丁酉，爐中山下，火盛木焚，金旺火滅也。甲辰乙巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"對甲戌乙亥，覆燈山頭，含光畏風，投光止艮也。庚子辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":826,"lineType":1,"content":"丑對庚午辛未，壁上路傍，形分聚散，類別死生也。戊寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":827,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯對戊申己酉，城頭大驛，東南西北，坤艮正位也。丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505721041141779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":830,"lineType":1,"content":"辰丁巳對丙戌丁亥，沙中屋上，乾濕互用，變化始終也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"圓看方看，不外旺相死休囚；近取遠取，莫逃金木水火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"土。以干支而分配五行，論陰陽而大明終始。天成人力","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"相兼，生旺死絶并類。嗚呼！六十甲子，聖人不過借其象","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":834,"lineType":1,"content":"以明其理，而五行性情材質形色功用，無不曲盡，而造","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"化無餘藴矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_88","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：立天之道，隂與陽。日，天道也，自甲至癸，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"十日迭運，而隂陽之義明。立池之道，柔與剛，辰，地道也，自子至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，十二辰更次，而剛柔之義顯。單出為聲而已，雜比然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505677676216371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":840,"lineType":1,"content":"後為音，故以日辰錯綜納甲，以成五音，以取六象，於是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"三才備而五行無餘蘊矣。以干為祿定貴賤，以支為命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"定脩短，以納音為身察盛衰。人得祿命，身俱旺相，三才","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"有氣，主快樂長壽。若值死絶休囚，三才無氣，必為塵埃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":844,"lineType":1,"content":"困窘之命無疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"931","lineNum":845,"lineType":8,"content":"釋六十甲子性質吉凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"932","lineNum":846,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":846,"lineType":2,"content":"為寶物，喜金木旺地，針、破字、進神，喜福星平頭懸針破字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":914,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":914,"lineType":2,"content":"日輪。夏則人畏，冬則人愛。忌戊子、己丑、甲寅、乙卯。伏神、羊刃、九醜。棒杖、懸針。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"己未火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":915,"lineType":2,"content":"日光，忌夜，亦畏四者。福星、華葢、羊刃、闕字、曲脚、破字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":916,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":916,"lineType":2,"content":"榴花，喜夏，不宜秋冬。建祿馬、八專、杖刑、破字、懸針。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":917,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":917,"lineType":2,"content":"榴子。喜秋及夏。建祿、交神、九醜、八專、懸針、聾啞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505682059362338"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":920,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":920,"lineType":2,"content":"海也，喜春夏及木。華葢、退神、平頭、聾啞、杖刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":921,"lineType":2,"content":"百川。喜金土火。伏馬、大敗、破字、截路。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":922,"lineType":1,"content":"右件六十甲子，盛大者，忌變為小弱；小弱者，欲變為盛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"大也耶。先貧賤而後富貴，則榮華；先富貴而後貧賤則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":924,"lineType":1,"content":"卑辱。不可以其先貧賤而不論其富貴，亦不可以其先","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴而不論其貧賤也。且生年屬木，假令是庚寅、辛卯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":926,"lineType":1,"content":"則木之盛大可知；若月日時胎不見他木，則以松柏論；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"萬一上見楊柳木或柘榴木，則捨大就小，不以松柏論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505754847019043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":930,"lineType":1,"content":"也。假令是壬午、癸未生人，則木之小弱可知。若月日時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"胎不見他木，則以楊柳論；萬一見松柏木或大林木，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":932,"lineType":1,"content":"棄小論大，不可以楊柳論也。以至天上火、劒鋒金、大海","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"水、大驛土生人，月日時胎別見他位，納音同而小弱者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":934,"lineType":1,"content":"又如覆燈火、金泊金、井泉水、沙中土生人，月日時胎別","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":935,"lineType":1,"content":"見他位，納音同而盛大者。或引凡而入聖，或先重而後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":936,"lineType":1,"content":"輕，皆當從其變者而論之，不可拘於一端。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":937,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子從革之金，其氣散，得戊申土、癸巳水相之則吉。戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505713642274850"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":940,"lineType":1,"content":"申乃金臨官之地，土者更旺於子，必能生成。癸巳係金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"生於巳，水旺於子，納音各有所歸，又為朝元祿，忌丁卯、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":942,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉、戊午之火。閻東叟云：甲子金為進神，禀沈潛虛中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"之徳，四時皆吉，入貴格，承旺氣，則術業精微，主奪魁之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":944,"lineType":1,"content":"榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑自庫之金，火不能尅，葢已藏之金，自無尅害衝破，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":946,"lineType":1,"content":"未有不顯榮者，獨忌己丑、己未之火。閻東叟云：乙丑為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"正印，具大福徳，秋冬富貴壽考，春夏吉中有凶，入格則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505713642389523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":950,"lineType":1,"content":"建功享福，帶煞類為凶會。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":950,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寶鑑","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_89","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":950,"lineType":1,"content":"云：甲子、乙丑未成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"器，金見火則成，多見則吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":952,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅赫曦之火，無水制之，則有燔灼炎烈之患，水不可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":953,"lineType":1,"content":"過，獨愛甲寅之水，就位濟之。又名朝元祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":953,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_90","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":953,"lineType":1,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":954,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅火含靈明冲粹之氣，四時生生之徳，入貴格則文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"彩發應，主魁甲之貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":956,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯伏明之火，氣弱，宜木生之，遇水則凶。乙卯、乙酉水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"最毒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_91","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"云：丁卯沐浴之火，含雷動風作之氣，水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505713642340371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":960,"lineType":1,"content":"濟則達，土載之則基厚，以木資之為文彩，以金槖之，更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"逢夏令則凶暴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼谷遺文","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_92","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅、丁卯，秋冬宜以保持。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":962,"lineType":1,"content":"註云：火無西旺，火至秋冬，勢恐不乆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰兩土下木，衆金不能尅，蓋土生金，有子母之道，得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":964,"lineType":1,"content":"水生之為佳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":964,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_93","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":964,"lineType":1,"content":"云：戊辰、庚寅、癸丑三辰，挺剛徳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"清健之數，生於春夏，能特立獨奮，隨變成功，更逢旺氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":966,"lineType":1,"content":"則有凌霄聳壑之志，惟忌秋生，雖懷志節，屈而不伸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳為近火之木，金自此生，於我無傷，忌見生旺之金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505706637983771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":970,"lineType":1,"content":"閻東叟云：己巳在巽，為風動之木，根危易拔，和之以金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":971,"lineType":1,"content":"土運歸東南，方成材用，雖外陽内陰，別無輔助，則其氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":972,"lineType":1,"content":"虛散，更為金鬼所尅，乃不材之木也。珞琭子云：己巳、戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，度乾宮而脱厄。註云：己巳、戊辰，舉木之類，西方金鬼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":974,"lineType":1,"content":"旺鄉納音之木，至此絶矣，斯謂厄會。若度乾亥之宮，木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"得水以長生，故脱厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":976,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午、辛未始生之土，木不能尅，惟忌水多，反傷其氣，木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"多却有歸，蓋木歸未也。閻東叟云：庚午、辛未、戊申、己酉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505754847068195"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":980,"lineType":1,"content":"皆厚徳之土，含容鎮靜，和氣融洽，福祿優裕。入格則多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"歷方岳之任，有普惠博愛之功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":982,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申臨官之金，利見水土，若丙申、丙寅、戊午之火，則為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"災害。閻東叟云：壬申金持天將之威，資臨官之氣，秋冬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":984,"lineType":1,"content":"掌生殺之權，春夏吉少凶多，入格以功名自奮，帶煞以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"刻剝為能。癸酉堅成之金，火死於酉，見火何傷，惟忌丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":986,"lineType":1,"content":"酉火就位尅之。閻東叟云：癸酉自旺之金，禀純粹之氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏為性英明，秋冬尤貴，入格則功業節槩，挺持出倫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505721041223699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":990,"lineType":1,"content":"帶煞則少年剛勁，四十之後，漸成純徳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":990,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寶鑑","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_94","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":990,"lineType":1,"content":"云：壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"申、癸酉，金旺之位，不可復旺，旺則傷物，不可見火，見火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":992,"lineType":1,"content":"則自傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":993,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌自庫之火，不嫌衆水，只忌壬戌，所謂墓中受尅，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":994,"lineType":1,"content":"患難逃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":994,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_95","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":994,"lineType":1,"content":"云：甲戌火為印為庫，含至陽藏伏之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，貴格逢之，富貴光大，惟忌夏生，防吉中有凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":996,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥伏明之火，其氣湮鬱而不發，藉己亥、辛卯、己巳、壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"午發未木生之，則精神旺相，癸亥、丙午水有之，則不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505750006792219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":1000,"lineType":1,"content":"閻東叟云：乙亥火自絶，含明敏貞靜之氣，葆光晦跡，寂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"然無形，稟之得數者，為玅道高人，吉徳君子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":1002,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子流衍之水，不忌衆土，惟嫌庚子，乃旺中逢鬼，不祥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"莫大焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_96","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"云：丙子自旺之水，陽上陰下，精神俱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":1004,"lineType":1,"content":"全，稟之者天資曠達，識量淵深，春夏為濟物之氣，多建","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"利澤之功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":1006,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑福聚之水，最愛金生，忌辛未、丙辰、丙戌相刑破也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":1007,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_97","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":1007,"lineType":1,"content":"云：丁丑、乙酉，在數為渙弱之水，陰盛陽弱，稟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505712220520463"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":1010,"lineType":1,"content":"之者器識清明，多慧少福，槖以水木旺氣，則陰陽均協，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"為貴達崇顯之士。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":1012,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅受傷之土，最為無力，要生旺火，以資其氣，忌己亥、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅、辛卯諸色木尅，主短折之凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_98","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"云：戊寅、丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":1014,"lineType":1,"content":"戌，此二位乘土徳厚氣，一含生火，一含宿火，是謂陽靈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"襲中，福慶之辰。貴格得之，道徳蓋世，貴極人臣，惟親王","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":1016,"lineType":1,"content":"貴公子，多於此日生。常格得之，亦主福壽遐遠，始終安","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"逸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505677676249139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":1020,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯自死之土，抑又甚焉，貴得丁卯、甲戌、乙亥、己未之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"火，由合而來，以致其福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_99","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"云：己卯自死，土建於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":1022,"lineType":1,"content":"震位，風行雷動，散為和氣，徳自冲虛，稟之者類有道行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":1023,"lineType":1,"content":"隨變而適，有養生自在之福壽，惟不利死絶，則為乆假","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":1024,"lineType":1,"content":"不歸之徒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":1024,"lineType":1,"content":"三命纂局","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_100","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":1024,"lineType":1,"content":"云：戊寅、己卯受傷之土，不可為木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":1025,"lineType":1,"content":"所損，其土無力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":1025,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寶鑑","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_101","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":1025,"lineType":1,"content":"云：戊寅、己卯土，不宜見水，見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":1026,"lineType":1,"content":"水不為財，不畏木，見木愈堅。戊寅承土徳旺氣，而含生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"火得之，主福壽綿遠。己卯不宜再見死絶，見則凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505754847084579"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":1030,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰氣聚之金，不用火制，其器自成，火盛反喪其器，病","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":1031,"lineType":1,"content":"絶火無害。若甲辰、乙巳火，惡不可言，亦不能尅衆木，蓋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":1032,"lineType":1,"content":"我氣亦聚耳。閻東叟云：庚辰之金，具剛健沈厚之徳，稟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":1033,"lineType":1,"content":"聰明疏通之性，春夏禍福倚伏，秋冬秀穎充實，入格則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":1034,"lineType":1,"content":"兼資文武，帶煞則好弄兵權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":1035,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳自生之金，精神具足，體氣完備，炎烈熾化而不亡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":1036,"lineType":1,"content":"忌丙辰乙巳戊午之火。蓋金生於巳而不能生，敗於午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"絶於寅而氣散，復見生旺之火，烏可當之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_102","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505717253570599"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":1040,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳金為自生學堂，具英明瑰奇之徳，秋冬得力十全，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":1041,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏七凶三吉，入貴格則主學行英偉，致身清貴，常懷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":1042,"lineType":1,"content":"濟物之心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":1042,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寶鑑","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_103","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":1042,"lineType":1,"content":"云：庚辰、辛己未成器金，宜見火。兼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":1043,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳是自生，巳為火，得之者光輝日新。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":1044,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午柔和之木，枝幹微弱，木能生火，却忌見火多，多則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":1045,"lineType":1,"content":"燼矣。雖生旺之金，亦不能傷，蓋金就我敗，得金反貴，水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":1046,"lineType":1,"content":"土盛者亦貴，惟忌甲午金傷之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":1046,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_104","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":1046,"lineType":1,"content":"云：壬午自死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":1047,"lineType":1,"content":"之木，木死絶則魂遊，而神氣靈秀，稟之者挺靜明之徳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505712220536847"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":1050,"lineType":1,"content":"抱仁者之勇，建立功行，可謂靜而有勇，延年益壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":1051,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未自庫之木，生旺則佳，雖乙丑金不能衝破，各歸其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":1052,"lineType":1,"content":"根而不相犯。忌庚戌、乙未金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":1052,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_105","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":1052,"lineType":1,"content":"云：癸未木為正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":1053,"lineType":1,"content":"印，挺文明吉會之徳，稟之者類抱間世之才，享清華之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":1054,"lineType":1,"content":"福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":1054,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寶鑑","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_106","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":1054,"lineType":1,"content":"云：壬午、癸未，謂之楊柳木者，蓋木至午而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"死，至未而墓，故盛夏葉稠，得其時則富壽，非其時則貧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":1056,"lineType":1,"content":"夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":1057,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申自生之水，其氣流衍，宜有所歸，亦藉金生，不忌衆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505713642405907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":1060,"lineType":1,"content":"土，特嫌戊申、庚子之土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":1060,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_107","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":1060,"lineType":1,"content":"云：甲申水自生，含天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":1061,"lineType":1,"content":"真，學堂得之，入局主智識聰慧，妙用無窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":1062,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉自敗之水，假衆金以相之，蓋我氣旣弱，藉母以育，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":1063,"lineType":1,"content":"忌己酉、己卯、戊申、庚子、辛丑之土，則夭折窮賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":1064,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌，福壯祿厚之土，木不能尅，忌見生旺之金，若遇火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":1065,"lineType":1,"content":"盛，則貴不可言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":1066,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥臨官之土，木不能尅，嫌金多，須得火生救之乃吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":1067,"lineType":1,"content":"忌己亥、辛卯之木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":1067,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_108","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":1067,"lineType":1,"content":"云：丁亥、庚子二土，中含金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505760752599059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":1070,"lineType":1,"content":"數，内剛外和，稟之者得有定力，土下濟之以水火旺氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":1071,"lineType":1,"content":"能建功立事，敢為威果之行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":1072,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子己丑，水中之火，又曰神龍之火，遇水方貴，為六氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":1073,"lineType":1,"content":"之君火也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":1073,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_109","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":1073,"lineType":1,"content":"云：戊子含精神輝光全實之氣，作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":1074,"lineType":1,"content":"四時保生之福，入貴格則為大人君子，器宇含弘，富貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"終吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":1076,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑為天將之火，又為天乙本家，含威福光厚之氣，發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":1077,"lineType":1,"content":"越峻猛，貴局乘之，為將徳，為魁名而建功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":1077,"lineType":1,"content":"燭神經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_110","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":1077,"lineType":1,"content":"云：丑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505760752615443"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":1080,"lineType":1,"content":"胎養之火，其氣漸隆，若遇丙寅、戊午之火助之，可成濟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":1081,"lineType":1,"content":"物之功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":1082,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅、辛卯，歲寒之木，雪霜無以改其操，况金能尅之乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"上有庚辛，不假制治，自然成材。閻東叟云：辛卯木自旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":1084,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏則氣節挺拔，建功立事；生於秋，則狂狷折剉，勁氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"不伸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":1086,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰自庫之水，若池沼水積之地，忌金來決破，若再見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":1087,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰，是謂自刑，別辰無咎，遇多水土皆喜，惟畏壬戌、癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505755790770186"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":1090,"lineType":1,"content":"亥、丙子之水，生旺太過，汗漫無歸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":1090,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_111","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":1090,"lineType":1,"content":"云：壬辰水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":1091,"lineType":1,"content":"為正印，含清明潤沃之徳，稟之者含容弘大，心識如鏡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":1092,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏得之，作大福慧，秋冬得之類姦詐無徳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳為自絶之水，名曰涸流，若丙戌、丁亥、庚子壯厚之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":1094,"lineType":1,"content":"土，其涸可待，若得三合生旺之金生之，則源泉混混，盈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"科而進也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_112","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"云：癸巳、乙卯自絶自死之水，乃至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":1096,"lineType":1,"content":"陰退藏，真精嗇養，凝成貴氣，貴局乘之類，是妙道君子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":1097,"lineType":1,"content":"夙體常徳，有功及物。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505754847117347"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":1100,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午自敗之金，亦曰强悍之金，遇火生旺，其器乃成。忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯、丁酉、戊子之火，凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_113","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"云：甲午金為進神魁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":1102,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，具剛明之徳，秋冬則吉，春夏或凶。入貴格，主科場，建","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"統衆之功，非時帶煞，則暴戾尅忍，寡恩少義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"燭神經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_114","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":1104,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午金傷强悍，或抑之乃沈潛。註云：沙石金剛礦喜殺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"抑之者，火革之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼谷遺文","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_115","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"云：甲午愛官鬼。李虛中云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":1106,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午金傷强悍，壬子木失之柔，或壬子得甲午，或甲午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":1107,"lineType":1,"content":"得壬子，陰陽專位，却有炳靈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505713642438675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":1110,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未偏庫之金，亦火制而土生之，則福壯氣聚。忌己未、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申、丁酉之火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_116","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1286","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"云：乙未金，在數為木庫，又為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":1112,"lineType":1,"content":"天將，具純仁厚義之徳，無往不吉。貴格得之，是不世之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":1113,"lineType":1,"content":"英傑，魁鎮士倫，常格得之，帶煞衝犯，亦作小人中之君","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":1114,"lineType":1,"content":"子，眉壽人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
