{"lines":[{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":1115,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申自病之火，丁酉自死之火，其氣極微，假木相助，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":1116,"lineType":1,"content":"氣方生。忌甲申、乙酉、甲寅、乙卯之水。閻東叟云：丙申病","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":1117,"lineType":1,"content":"火，以木為文明之徳，以水為曠達之性，以土為福慧之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505754847133731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":1120,"lineType":1,"content":"基，惟金為暴虐，縱有吉辰，革為不和之氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":1120,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_117","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":1120,"lineType":1,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉火自死，含韜晦寂靜之氣，外和内剛，貴格乘之，類","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":1122,"lineType":1,"content":"為有道君子自然之徳行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌土中之木，忌重見土，若納音土多，一生屯蹇，金不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":1124,"lineType":1,"content":"能尅。蓋金氣至戌而散，遇金乃能致福利，見水多木盛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"而為貴格。閻東叟云：戊戌之木，孤根獨立，和之以水火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":1126,"lineType":1,"content":"旺氣，則有英明秀實之徳，入格則文章進達，福祿始終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"然乘天將之氣，主備歷艱險，節操不移，方見晚福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505712220569615"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":1130,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥自生之木，根本繁盛，不忌衆金，惟嫌辛亥、辛巳、癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"酉之金，若見乙卯、丁未水，癸未木，未有不大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_118","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":1132,"lineType":1,"content":"論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_118","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":1132,"lineType":1,"content":"云：己亥木自生，挺英才秀拔之徳，得之於特達處，類","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":1133,"lineType":1,"content":"皆清貴少達。閻東叟云：己亥之木，得時則清貴，非時則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":1134,"lineType":1,"content":"辛苦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子厚徳之土，能尅衆水，不忌他木，蓋木至子無氣，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":1136,"lineType":1,"content":"遇壬申之金，謂之明位祿，其貴必矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":1137,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑福聚之土，衆木不能尅，蓋丑為金庫，丑中有金，見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505755790786570"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":1140,"lineType":1,"content":"木何傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":1140,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寶鑑","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_119","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":1140,"lineType":1,"content":"云：庚子辛丑土，愛木而惡水，見木為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":1141,"lineType":1,"content":"官，見水不相宜。閻東叟云：辛丑己酉之土，中含金數，厚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":1142,"lineType":1,"content":"徳性剛和，而不同上下，濟以水火旺氣，則威名功烈，見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":1143,"lineType":1,"content":"為果敢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":1144,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅自絶之金，癸卯氣散之金，若見衆火則喪氣，惟水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"土朝之則吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_120","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"云：壬寅癸卯為虛薄之金，具仁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":1146,"lineType":1,"content":"柔義剛之徳，秋冬剛健無凶，凶為吉兆，春夏則内凶外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，吉乃先凶。入貴格則志節英明，帶煞則凶暴不能終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505755790819338"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":1150,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":1150,"lineType":1,"content":"三命纂局","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_121","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":1150,"lineType":1,"content":"云：癸卯自胎之金，若逢丙寅、丁卯爐中之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":1151,"lineType":1,"content":"火不為鬼，以胎金爐中成器故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":1152,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰偏庫之火，多火助之吉，所謂同氣之求，以資其不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":1153,"lineType":1,"content":"足。若見戊辰、戊戌木生之為貴格，忌壬辰、壬戌、丙午、丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":1154,"lineType":1,"content":"未水最毒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":1154,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_122","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":1154,"lineType":1,"content":"云：甲辰為天將之火，含敏速峻烈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":1155,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣，入貴格則為特達，為文魁，利秋冬，不利於夏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":1156,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳臨官之火，水不能尅，葢水絶於巳，得水濟之，則為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":1157,"lineType":1,"content":"純粹，若得二三火助之亦佳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":1157,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_123","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":1157,"lineType":1,"content":"云：乙巳火含純","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505677676298291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":1160,"lineType":1,"content":"陽巽發之氣，光輝充實，春冬向吉，夏秋向凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":1161,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午、丁未，銀漢之水，土不能尅，天上之水，地金不能生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":1162,"lineType":1,"content":"也。生旺太過，反傷於萬物，死絶太多，又不能生萬物。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":1162,"lineType":1,"content":"五","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_124","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":1163,"lineType":1,"content":"行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_124","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":1163,"lineType":1,"content":"云：丙午至崇之水，體南方溫厚之氣，稟之者類","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":1164,"lineType":1,"content":"有道氣虛變穎異，有為魁衆出倫。丁未具足三才全數，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":1165,"lineType":1,"content":"得冲正之氣，稟之者主精神氣全，性根高玅，盡變之道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":1166,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申重阜之土，木絶於申，不能尅，若見金水多助，則富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":1167,"lineType":1,"content":"貴尊榮之格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505712220585999"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":1170,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉自敗之土，其氣不足，藉火以相助之，見丁卯、丁酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":1171,"lineType":1,"content":"火則吉，切忌死絶，畏辛卯、辛酉木，災蹇夭折。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":1172,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌、辛亥堅成之金，不可見火，恐有所傷，若得水土相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":1173,"lineType":1,"content":"之為貴。閻東叟云：庚戌火墓之金，有剛烈自恃之暴，秋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":1174,"lineType":1,"content":"冬庶幾沈厚，春夏動生悔吝，君子執兵刑之權，小人恣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":1175,"lineType":1,"content":"獷悍之性。辛亥金稟乾健純明中正之氣，春秋冬三時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":1176,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，夏七吉三凶，貴格乘之，體仁守義，若帶刑殺，肆暴貪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1362","lineNum":1177,"lineType":1,"content":"功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1363","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505760752680979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1364","lineNum":1180,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子專位之木，癸丑偏庫之木，遇死絶則富貴，生旺則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1365","lineNum":1181,"lineType":1,"content":"貧賤，水多則夭折，金多土盛為佳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1366","lineNum":1181,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_125","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1367","lineNum":1181,"lineType":1,"content":"云：壬子幽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1368","lineNum":1182,"lineType":1,"content":"陰之木，陽弱陰盛，柔而無立，類仁水徳用事，惟對以丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1369","lineNum":1183,"lineType":1,"content":"午水，則為水木冲粹之徳，類入神仙異士標格，非常流","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1370","lineNum":1184,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1371","lineNum":1184,"lineType":1,"content":"燭神經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_126","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1372","lineNum":1184,"lineType":1,"content":"云：壬子之木，失於優柔，其或揚之，仁而高明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1373","lineNum":1185,"lineType":1,"content":"註云：壬子木在水旺之鄉，假子中得微水滋潤而生，柔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1374","lineNum":1186,"lineType":1,"content":"脆易折，則自敗木也。揚之者，欲得火旺之氣，益之使敷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1375","lineNum":1187,"lineType":1,"content":"榮，則仁勇而高明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1376","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505717253619751"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1377","lineNum":1190,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅自病之水，乙卯自死之水，雖然死病，土不能尅，蓋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1378","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"支干二木，可以制土，若見壬寅、癸卯之金，則為優裕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1379","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"五","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_127","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1380","lineNum":1192,"lineType":1,"content":"行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_127","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1381","lineNum":1192,"lineType":1,"content":"云：甲寅、壬戌二水，為伏逆，陰勝於陽，主姦邪害","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1382","lineNum":1193,"lineType":1,"content":"物，惟濟之以火土損益，方成大器。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1383","lineNum":1194,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰自庫之土，厚且壯，喜甲辰火，惡戊辰木，此土凡木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1384","lineNum":1195,"lineType":1,"content":"不能傷，蓋丙火也，辰為火偏庫，土已成器，惟嫌戊戌、己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1385","lineNum":1196,"lineType":1,"content":"亥、辛卯、戊辰之木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":1196,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_128","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":1196,"lineType":1,"content":"云：丙辰土為正印，建五福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":1197,"lineType":1,"content":"吉會之徳，稟之者類皆亨，大有為，不貴即富，惟犯衝者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505760752713747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":1200,"lineType":1,"content":"多為僧道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1391","lineNum":1201,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳自絶之土，又不為絶，蓋一土居二火之下，在父母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1392","lineNum":1202,"lineType":1,"content":"之鄉，乘天屬之恩，故不為絶。木不能尅，火多益佳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1393","lineNum":1202,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_129","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1394","lineNum":1203,"lineType":1,"content":"寶鑑","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_129","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1395","lineNum":1203,"lineType":1,"content":"云：丁巳含東南火徳旺數，得之者含容福壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1396","lineNum":1204,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午自旺之火，己未偏庫之火，居離明之方，旺相之地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1397","lineNum":1205,"lineType":1,"content":"其氣極盛，他水無傷。忌丙午、丁未天上之水。閻東叟云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1398","lineNum":1206,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午自旺火，含離明炎上之氣，無情治物，動違於衆。秋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1399","lineNum":1207,"lineType":1,"content":"冬得之，濟以水土旺氣，則豁達高明，福力堅壯。春夏乘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1400","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505754847166499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1401","lineNum":1210,"lineType":1,"content":"之以金木，雖騰光迅速，命非乆常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1402","lineNum":1210,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_130","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1403","lineNum":1210,"lineType":1,"content":"云：己未衰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1404","lineNum":1211,"lineType":1,"content":"火，含餘藏寶之氣，春夏之月，運入沈潛之鄉，則明達峻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1405","lineNum":1212,"lineType":1,"content":"敏，福慶深遠。夏得之非和氣也，秋得之則先吉後凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1406","lineNum":1213,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申、辛酉二木，金居木上，因金以成器，忌再見金，致毁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1407","lineNum":1214,"lineType":1,"content":"其器。若見甲申、乙酉水，則入格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1408","lineNum":1214,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寶鑑","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_131","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1409","lineNum":1214,"lineType":1,"content":"云：庚申自絶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1410","lineNum":1215,"lineType":1,"content":"木為魂游神變，遇此日生者，類非凡器常格，主賦性穎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":1216,"lineType":1,"content":"異，家族不羈；入貴格，則是英傑之才，立不世之功。辛酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":1217,"lineType":1,"content":"失位之木，木困金鄉，乘之者涉世多艱。惟對癸卯金，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1413","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505750006841371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1414","lineNum":1220,"lineType":1,"content":"剛柔相濟，挺拔出羣，决取巍科。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1415","lineNum":1220,"lineType":1,"content":"燭神經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_132","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1416","lineNum":1220,"lineType":1,"content":"云：魂貴天遊，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1417","lineNum":1221,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申之木，不嫌於死絶，獨坐而守，庚申是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1418","lineNum":1221,"lineType":1,"content":"註","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_133","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1419","lineNum":1221,"lineType":1,"content":"云：庚申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":1222,"lineType":1,"content":"自絶木，木於五臟屬肝，肝藏魂，木休絶則魂遊於天，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":1223,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申之木，不嫌死絶，所以貴於天遊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":1223,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼谷遺文","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_134","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1423","lineNum":1223,"lineType":1,"content":"云：辛酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1424","lineNum":1224,"lineType":1,"content":"期生旺。註云：辛酉氣絶之木，欲生旺以為榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1425","lineNum":1225,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌偏庫之水，癸亥臨官之水，名曰大海水。蓋支干納","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1426","lineNum":1226,"lineType":1,"content":"音皆水，忌見衆水，雖壬辰水庫，亦不能當。不忌他土，死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1427","lineNum":1227,"lineType":1,"content":"絶則吉，生旺則汎濫而無所歸也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1428","lineNum":1227,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寶鑑","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_135","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1429","lineNum":1227,"lineType":1,"content":"云：亥子水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1430","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505750006857755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1431","lineNum":1230,"lineType":1,"content":"之正位，壬戌氣伏而不順，惟以火土損益之，乃成大器。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1432","lineNum":1231,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥具純陽之數，内體至仁，稟之者天資夷曠，志氣浩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1433","lineNum":1232,"lineType":1,"content":"然，發為功業利澤，日時帶煞，則凶狡之流。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1434","lineNum":1233,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：丙戌之土，為福隆厚，火鍾於此故也。己未、庚辰、戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1435","lineNum":1234,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、丁丑，與此同義。己未火也，未中有墓木；庚辰金也，辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1436","lineNum":1235,"lineType":1,"content":"中有墓土；戊辰木也，辰中有墓水；丁丑，水也，丑中有墓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1437","lineNum":1236,"lineType":1,"content":"金。皆父母之氣，各有所養。此五者，福壯厚。以上有鬼所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1438","lineNum":1237,"lineType":1,"content":"傷，不為害，氣成故也。李虛中云：丙戌尤異，以戌又為土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1439","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505677676331059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1440","lineNum":1240,"lineType":1,"content":"之本位，而尤旺盛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1441","lineNum":1241,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳、戊午，乃盛炎之火，秋冬作徳，吉，春夏作刑，凶。若仲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1442","lineNum":1242,"lineType":1,"content":"夏暴炎一發，旋即歸燥，竟焚和而為咎。乙巳，臨官之火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1443","lineNum":1243,"lineType":1,"content":"上有一木生之，其氣盛矣。戊午，自旺之火，若生秋冬，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1444","lineNum":1244,"lineType":1,"content":"溫燠之氣，為濟物之徳；若生春夏，旺火復得陽位，則作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1445","lineNum":1245,"lineType":1,"content":"凶；生仲夏，為暴戾刻忍，凶夭之流也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1446","lineNum":1246,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯、癸巳、丁酉、乙亥，水火雖死絶，却清明而妙佳。火死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1447","lineNum":1247,"lineType":1,"content":"絶而内明外晦，返照回光；水死絶而湛然清徹，可燭鬚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1448","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505767547453494"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1449","lineNum":1250,"lineType":1,"content":"眉，故却清明而妙佳。李虛中云：四位水火雖死絶，却清","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1450","lineNum":1251,"lineType":1,"content":"明而妙佳。觀天乙貴人，自可見矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1451","lineNum":1252,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅之金，事君不逆。庚申之木，為臣不强。五行屬五音，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1452","lineNum":1253,"lineType":1,"content":"宮土者，君也；商金者，臣也；角木者，民也。商太過則臣强，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1453","lineNum":1254,"lineType":1,"content":"角太過則君弱。故五音之中，常用四清宮以殺商角。庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1454","lineNum":1255,"lineType":1,"content":"申者，角木自絶也。壬寅者，商金自絶也。性情得忠順之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1455","lineNum":1256,"lineType":1,"content":"道，故事君不逆，為臣不强。所以自紫微鸞臺鳳閣以上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1456","lineNum":1257,"lineType":1,"content":"官，切忌金木生旺之命，如是必不為之，為之亦不能久。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1457","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505760752730131"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1458","lineNum":1260,"lineType":1,"content":"獨臺諫則可。若金木生旺而尅破，則不然。庚申木，乙巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1459","lineNum":1261,"lineType":1,"content":"火，土金生而還不生。丙午水，癸卯金，木水死而還不死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1460","lineNum":1262,"lineType":1,"content":"土生申而不生於庚申，水生申而不生於戊申，火生寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1461","lineNum":1263,"lineType":1,"content":"而不生於甲寅，金生巳而不生於乙巳，木生亥而不生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1462","lineNum":1264,"lineType":1,"content":"於辛亥。蓋生處而反受制故也。得之者夭壽。木死卯而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1463","lineNum":1265,"lineType":1,"content":"不死於癸卯，土死卯而不死於丁卯，木死午而不死於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1464","lineNum":1266,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午，金死子而不死於庚子，火死酉而不死於辛酉。蓋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1465","lineNum":1267,"lineType":1,"content":"死處得生也，若得之者長壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1466","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505760752697363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1467","lineNum":1270,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子支干旺於北方，乃水之位，納音屬火，乃水中之火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1468","lineNum":1271,"lineType":1,"content":"非神龍不能有之。丙午支干旺於南方，乃火之位，納音","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1469","lineNum":1272,"lineType":1,"content":"屬水，乃火中之水，非天河不能有之。戊子人得丙午，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1470","lineNum":1273,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午人得戊子，無不貴。蓋火中出水，水中藏火，水火旣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1471","lineNum":1274,"lineType":1,"content":"濟，精神運動，必靈異於人矣。李虛中云：丙午天上之水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1472","lineNum":1275,"lineType":1,"content":"銀漢有之，即十二辰之天后也。得之者高明豁達，穎異","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1473","lineNum":1276,"lineType":1,"content":"不凡。戊子水中之火，神龍有之，即六氣之君火也。得之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":1277,"lineType":1,"content":"者自神而明，沈幾先物，二氣兼得，尤妙絶。其餘辛氣凖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505713642324002"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":1280,"lineType":1,"content":"此詳之。辛丑之土不嫌於木，戊戌之木不怕於金。何以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1477","lineNum":1281,"lineType":1,"content":"辯之？丑中金庫，木不為鬼；戌中有火，金反受其殃。若戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1478","lineNum":1282,"lineType":1,"content":"戌之木，二土在上，一木在下，埋在二土之内，尚未萌芽，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1479","lineNum":1283,"lineType":1,"content":"不見其形，是土盛木弱。餘皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1480","lineNum":1284,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅木，丁巳土，不嫌金木之鬼。金至寅宮雖為鬼，而金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1481","lineNum":1285,"lineType":1,"content":"絶在寅，故不為鬼。木至巳宮而已有生，金尅木，故不為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":1286,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼。若庚寅木逢壬申金相衝受尅。餘皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":1287,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午之土，乘南方旺火以養其形。戊申之土自生，庚子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505754847199267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":1290,"lineType":1,"content":"之土自盈。不忌木鬼，蓋木至午死，申絶子敗。又自强之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":1291,"lineType":1,"content":"土何傷？餘皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":1292,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申、癸酉、庚戌、辛亥，四金氣壯，不嫌於鬼。戊子之火，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":1293,"lineType":1,"content":"畏其鬼。水中霹靂之火，神龍有之。蓋有水則雷方鳴，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":1294,"lineType":1,"content":"逢丙午、丁未天上水，則有所忌，有相戰之功。大凡本命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":1295,"lineType":1,"content":"支干受傷，則主六根不足，有始無終。如丁巳見癸亥，壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":1296,"lineType":1,"content":"子見戊午，餘皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":1297,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午、庚申，彼我得之超異。庚申，石榴木，夏旺，故喜戊午。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1493","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505713642487827"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1494","lineNum":1300,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋火官旺，而石榴木性得時，戊午乃旺極之火，喜於申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1495","lineNum":1301,"lineType":1,"content":"見天馬相資也。其神頭祿者，即十干專位祿，乃陰陽專","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1496","lineNum":1302,"lineType":1,"content":"位，天地神會也。列八卦之真源，演五行之成敗，剛柔相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1497","lineNum":1303,"lineType":1,"content":"推，有無合化。故壬子之水應北方之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1498","lineNum":1303,"lineType":1,"content":"坎","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_136","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1499","lineNum":1303,"lineType":1,"content":"，丙午之火，實南","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1500","lineNum":1304,"lineType":1,"content":"宮之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1501","lineNum":1304,"lineType":1,"content":"離","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_137","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1502","lineNum":1304,"lineType":1,"content":"。所以丙午得壬子不為破，丁巳得癸亥不為衝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1503","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"是水火相濟之源，有夫婦配合之理，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1504","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"坎","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_138","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1505","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"離","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_139","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1506","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"為男女精神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1507","lineNum":1306,"lineType":1,"content":"之用也。壬子得丙午，癸亥得丁巳，則先後火水有未濟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1508","lineNum":1307,"lineType":1,"content":"之象，不如丁巳見壬子，丙午得癸亥也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1509","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505755790884874"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1510","lineNum":1310,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申、辛酉之金，應西方之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":1310,"lineType":1,"content":"兌","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_140","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":1310,"lineType":1,"content":"；甲寅、乙卯之木，象東方之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":1311,"lineType":1,"content":"震","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_141","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":1311,"lineType":1,"content":"。所以甲寅得庚申不為刑，乙卯得辛酉不為鬼，是木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":1312,"lineType":1,"content":"女金夫之正體，明左右之神化也。木主魂，金主魄，二者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":1313,"lineType":1,"content":"左右相間不合，若能全合，則神之化生以無間也。若庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":1314,"lineType":1,"content":"申得乙卯，辛酉得甲寅，不為元辰，變通之用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":1315,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰、戊戌之土，為魁罡相㑹，乾坤厚徳，覆載含生，不得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":1316,"lineType":1,"content":"以為反吟。戊辰、戊戌不為衝，土得正位，干守元㑹也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":1317,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑、己未是貴神，守忠貞。此四真土，有萬物始終之道，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505764867227699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":1320,"lineType":1,"content":"非大人君子，孰能備此徳？况神頭祿各有神以主之，左","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":1321,"lineType":1,"content":"右運動於六合之中，盈縮於吉凶之變也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":1322,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑土為天乙貴人，己未土為太常福神，解百煞之凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":1323,"lineType":1,"content":"若得之，當用為橫財之喜。戊辰為勾陳，戊戌為天空，土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":1324,"lineType":1,"content":"之神多遷改，居帥外藩，出鎮邊防，有不常矣。丁巳為螣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":1325,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇之神。凶以凶用，吉以吉承，多熒惑之憂，有滑稽之性。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":1326,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午為朱雀之神。應陽明之體，文詞藻麗。甲寅為青龍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":1327,"lineType":1,"content":"之神。博施濟衆，得四方之利。乙卯為六合之神。主發生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505754847232035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":1330,"lineType":1,"content":"榮華，和弱順黨。壬子為天后之神。主陰騭天徳，容美多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":1331,"lineType":1,"content":"權。癸亥為玄武之神。乃陰陽終極，有潛伏之氣，從下如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":1332,"lineType":1,"content":"流，雖有大智，非軒昂超達之士。順則安平，逆則姦宄。庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":1333,"lineType":1,"content":"申為白虎之神。利於武而不利於文，有抱道孤騫之性，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":1334,"lineType":1,"content":"善中嚴外，色厲内荏，有仁義，好幽僻。辛酉為太陰之神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":1335,"lineType":1,"content":"懷肅殺之氣，有清白之風，為文章利口、不世之才。然更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":1336,"lineType":1,"content":"各以親疎休旺，定遇者之情性禍福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":1337,"lineType":8,"content":"甲子乙丑海中金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505717253636135"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":1340,"lineType":1,"content":"海中金者，寶藏龍宮，珠孕蛟室。出現雖假於空衝，成器","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":1341,"lineType":1,"content":"無藉乎火力。故東方朔以蛤蚌名之，良有理也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":1341,"lineType":1,"content":"妙選","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_142","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":1341,"lineType":1,"content":"有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":1342,"lineType":1,"content":"珠藏淵海格。以甲子見癸亥，是不用火逢空；有蚌珠照","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":1343,"lineType":1,"content":"月格。以甲子見己未，是欲合化互貴。蓋以海金無形，非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":1344,"lineType":1,"content":"空衝則不能出現，而乙丑金庫，非旺火則不能陶鑄故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":1345,"lineType":1,"content":"也。如甲子見戊寅、庚午，是土生金；乙丑見丙寅、丁卯，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":1346,"lineType":1,"content":"火制金。又天干逢三奇，此等格局，無有不貴。舊説甲子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":1347,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑，俱喜見爐中火，丙寅旺火，不喜木助，丁卯敗火，却","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505713642340386"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":1350,"lineType":1,"content":"宜木助。覆燈山下、山頭諸火性微，不能煉金，故宜木助。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":1351,"lineType":1,"content":"天上火不能尅金，須假凡火，再得水濟，無衝破為佳。霹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":1352,"lineType":1,"content":"火就位相尅，性主昏蒙，運如再犯大凶。見木則無造化，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":1353,"lineType":1,"content":"以此金未能成器，不能制物故也。若月日有火，而時遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":1354,"lineType":1,"content":"木，却以財論則吉。井泉、澗下、大溪、天河等水，無火俱不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":1355,"lineType":1,"content":"宜，見海水亦不宜，然以妙選論之，則為貴格。據理，甲子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":1356,"lineType":1,"content":"見癸亥，逢生趨乾，何不可之有？路傍、屋壁、城頭、大驛諸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":1357,"lineType":1,"content":"土，在日時柱中，天元支辰納音俱無火制，主賤，中年夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1559","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505765559271459"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1560","lineNum":1360,"lineType":1,"content":"余見亦未然，以庚午、辛未、戊寅己卯二土造化有情故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1561","lineNum":1361,"lineType":1,"content":"也。如甲子見庚午，坎離相濟，見辛未，官星帶貴，乙丑見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1562","lineNum":1362,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午，官貴互換，甲子見戊寅，絶地逢生，見己卯，天干合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":1363,"lineType":1,"content":"化，乙丑見戊寅，亦絶地逢生，見己卯，則歸祿帶財，餘土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":1364,"lineType":1,"content":"又當仍分年上祿馬貴人方准。沙土埋金，誠不宜見，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":1365,"lineType":1,"content":"火亦不吉。柱中逢金，砂鑞原未成器，海中又未成器，彼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":1366,"lineType":1,"content":"此無益，故無火不宜。劒釵已成器，金相見有助，玅選謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":1367,"lineType":1,"content":"之脱體化神，主貴，泊金亦好。如甲子見甲子，乙丑見乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505764867244083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":1370,"lineType":1,"content":"丑，同類相資。柱中喜見一寅，見戊寅謂之崑山片玉，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":1371,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子見乙丑，謂之干支連珠，非得火煉不可，即子平金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":1372,"lineType":1,"content":"神格之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":1373,"lineType":8,"content":"壬寅癸卯金泊金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":1374,"lineType":1,"content":"金泊金者，潤色盃盤，增光宮室，打薄須藉乎別金，描彩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":1375,"lineType":1,"content":"必假乎水力。此金甚微，非木則無所依，木以平地為上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":1376,"lineType":1,"content":"有此不宜見火，有火主夭，遇太陽為日間之顯，二火相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":1377,"lineType":1,"content":"反，不宜同見。山下山頭有清水助之，亦吉。惟忌爐火就","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505750006890523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":1380,"lineType":1,"content":"位相尅，此金體薄，不能反源。定夭，限運同論。井泉澗下，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":1381,"lineType":1,"content":"天河水清，日時喜見，須月令有木方吉。溪流大海水濁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":1382,"lineType":1,"content":"見溪流主漂蕩，見大海無木為基，主凶殘。金遇劒鋒釵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":1383,"lineType":1,"content":"釧，可以裝飾，有輔成造化之理，故喜見。砂海白鑞無益，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":1384,"lineType":1,"content":"有火濟之亦吉，無則終凶。城頭壁上二土有靠安身，城","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":1385,"lineType":1,"content":"頭多主寄人，壁上加木則貴。再遇燈火，輝光照耀，主權","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":1386,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。丙戌土中藏火，干支却不宜太炎，亦為貴格。考玅選","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":1387,"lineType":1,"content":"金命而遇戊寅，崑山片玉格也。癸卯而遇己卯，玉兔東","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505755790901258"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":1390,"lineType":1,"content":"升格也，與前海金同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":1391,"lineType":8,"content":"庚辰辛巳白鑞金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":1392,"lineType":1,"content":"白鑞金者，崑山片玉，洛浦遺珍，交棲日月之光，凝聚陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":1393,"lineType":1,"content":"陽之氣，形明體潔，乃金之正色也。此金惟喜火煉，須爐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":1394,"lineType":1,"content":"中炎火，然庚辰見之，若無水濟，主貧夭。辛巳却以貴論，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":1395,"lineType":1,"content":"緣己是金生之地，見丙寅化水逢貴故也。山下火生，早","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":1396,"lineType":1,"content":"主榮貴，亦須水助方得。井泉大溪，俱為貴格。庚官在丁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1594","lineNum":1397,"lineType":1,"content":"辛官在丙，故庚見丁丑，官貴俱全，辛見丙子，不如癸巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1595","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505767547404342"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1596","lineNum":1400,"lineType":1,"content":"更清，不貴即富。論中見木，逢多無益，以此金不能相尅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1597","lineNum":1401,"lineType":1,"content":"若柱遇無氣之火，却要木生，有祿馬貴人方吉。見土只","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1598","lineNum":1402,"lineType":1,"content":"宜磨砌，方成器物，則吉，別土無用。金忌海砂為汨沒，日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1599","lineNum":1403,"lineType":1,"content":"時逢火則榮，若見清金加水相助，火亦不愛，只怕衝刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1600","lineNum":1404,"lineType":1,"content":"玅選，有哨風猛虎格，以此金日時遇辛巳或乙巳是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1601","lineNum":1405,"lineType":8,"content":"甲午乙未砂中金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1602","lineNum":1406,"lineType":1,"content":"砂中金者，剛形布地，寶質藏砂，直敎淘洗為珍，必須因","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1603","lineNum":1407,"lineType":1,"content":"人始貴，此金非爐火則不能制。但甲午見丙寅，寅中火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1604","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505755790950410"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1605","lineNum":1410,"lineType":1,"content":"生，寅午合局，柱無長生之土則燥，更值木助，主疾夭。丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1606","lineNum":1411,"lineType":1,"content":"午納音雖水，而支干純火加逢尤凶。山頭山下、覆燈三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1607","lineNum":1412,"lineType":1,"content":"火，旣有木生尅制，此金，又須清水濟之，决主少年榮貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1608","lineNum":1413,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子、己丑，龍火相逢，子午有交媾之玅，甲己有合化之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1609","lineNum":1414,"lineType":1,"content":"理，主貴，雜以凡火，則不為奇。見水惟宜井泉澗下，天河","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1610","lineNum":1415,"lineType":1,"content":"清淨則吉。長溪大流，動而不靜，並見則金泛不安，海水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1611","lineNum":1416,"lineType":1,"content":"尤忌。見木有何關係，火衰却喜生扶，更有祿馬貴人互","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1612","lineNum":1417,"lineType":1,"content":"換，朝拱為上，如柱無火，逢一二木則危。若甲午見己巳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1613","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505755790917642"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1614","lineNum":1420,"lineType":1,"content":"是謂採精金於黃磧，乃貴格也。金生於砂，得造化則吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1615","lineNum":1421,"lineType":1,"content":"若更逢砂土，反有埋沒之憂，路傍大驛，亦在所忌，有火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1616","lineNum":1422,"lineType":1,"content":"庶幾城頭。戊寅乙未喜見，謂之採精金於青沙，乃貴格","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1617","lineNum":1423,"lineType":1,"content":"也。惟丙戌之土，中藏火庫，乃喜見之。金為同類，最喜清","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1618","lineNum":1424,"lineType":1,"content":"氣為上，海中白鑞有火制亦得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1619","lineNum":1425,"lineType":8,"content":"壬申癸酉劒鋒金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1620","lineNum":1426,"lineType":1,"content":"劒鋒金者，白帝司權，剛由百鍊，紅光射於斗牛，白刃凝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1621","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"於霜雪，此金造化，非水不能生。大溪海水，日時相逢，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1622","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505765559287843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1623","lineNum":1430,"lineType":1,"content":"上格。井泉澗下，有霹靂助，或得乙卯之雷方好，若無雷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1624","lineNum":1431,"lineType":1,"content":"霹，亦金白水清格也，秋生更吉。日時遇長流，在壬辰，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1625","lineNum":1432,"lineType":1,"content":"寶劒化為青龍。癸巳亦得此劒，不能通變，然癸丑為劒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1626","lineNum":1433,"lineType":1,"content":"氣衝斗，最吉，松柏楊柳亦吉，但多聚散大林平地，嫌有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1627","lineNum":1434,"lineType":1,"content":"土制，主勞苦。火見神龍，陰陽交遇，如壬申逢己丑，癸酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1628","lineNum":1435,"lineType":1,"content":"逢戊子，方為上格。遇天上爐中二火，無水救則夭。諸土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1629","lineNum":1436,"lineType":1,"content":"見皆不吉，以其埋沒，只壁上城頭，有磨鋒淬礪之，用此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1630","lineNum":1437,"lineType":1,"content":"二土則可。金喜同類，如壬申見壬申，癸酉見癸酉，有木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1631","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505754847281187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1632","lineNum":1440,"lineType":1,"content":"制之，是謂盤根錯節，所以別利器也。無木主帶疾。海砂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1633","lineNum":1441,"lineType":1,"content":"白鑞，此三金内，乙丑獨吉。釵釧成器，相見亦宜。若柱有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1634","lineNum":1442,"lineType":1,"content":"未成之金，無加於劒，故最忌之，見則性蒙猖狂。戌則金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1635","lineNum":1443,"lineType":1,"content":"混雜時中，却宜火勝。大抵劒鋒乃金之最利者，只宜水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1636","lineNum":1444,"lineType":1,"content":"潤，不宜火刑，如見寅巳三刑全者，大凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1637","lineNum":1445,"lineType":8,"content":"庚戌辛亥釵釧金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1638","lineNum":1446,"lineType":1,"content":"釵釧金者，美容首飾，增光膩肌，偎紅倚翠之珍，枕玉眠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1639","lineNum":1447,"lineType":1,"content":"香之寶。此金藏之閨閣，惟宜靜水，井澗溪流，見之皆吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1640","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505767547469878"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1641","lineNum":1450,"lineType":1,"content":"多見則泛，海水貧夭。天河辛亥見之無妨。丙午真火，庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1642","lineNum":1451,"lineType":1,"content":"戌所忌，以午戌凑成火局，有傷此金故也。太陽火，日生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1643","lineNum":1452,"lineType":1,"content":"顯耀，覆燈火，夜間顯耀，故皆宜見。但甲辰、乙巳與庚戌、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1644","lineNum":1453,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥相衝，陰陽交見為玅。戊子、己丑與丙午、丁未相持，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1645","lineNum":1454,"lineType":1,"content":"二火忌疊見之，非貧即夭。爐中火，庚戌最忌，辛亥見之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1646","lineNum":1455,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛化水稍吉。山下山頭，俱不宜見，若有水濟亦可。柱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1647","lineNum":1456,"lineType":1,"content":"中有水，此金入於匣中，有福貴方吉。土見砂中，相生相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1648","lineNum":1457,"lineType":1,"content":"養，更有澗下水助榮華富貴。金喜劒鋒，則成造化。泊金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1649","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505713642405922"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1650","lineNum":1460,"lineType":1,"content":"增光釵釧，須假微火濟之。除此二金，別金無用。若命中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1651","lineNum":1461,"lineType":1,"content":"只有金水，更無夾雜，為金白水清，在活法推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1652","lineNum":1462,"lineType":8,"content":"戊子己丑霹靂火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1653","lineNum":1463,"lineType":1,"content":"霹靂火者，一縷毫光，九天號令，電掣金蛇之勢，雲驅鐵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1654","lineNum":1464,"lineType":1,"content":"馬之奔。此火須資風水雷，方為變化，若五行得值一件，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1655","lineNum":1465,"lineType":1,"content":"皆主亨通。如日時見大海癸亥為引凡入聖，己丑為上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1656","lineNum":1466,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子次之。見大溪乙卯，為雷火變化，己丑為吉，戊子忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1657","lineNum":1467,"lineType":1,"content":"之。辰巳為風，運中遇之尤佳。天上水名為旣濟，主吉，遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1658","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505713642389538"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1659","lineNum":1470,"lineType":1,"content":"之者稟性含靈，聰明特異，長流無用，澗下雖就位相尅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1660","lineNum":1471,"lineType":1,"content":"此神火也，不忌有風亦顯。五行見木，辛卯有雷，大林有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1661","lineNum":1472,"lineType":1,"content":"風，平地有天門，與此火相資，餘木無用。土見路傍，加巽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1662","lineNum":1473,"lineType":1,"content":"則吉。砂中丁巳有風，己卯有雷，得泉助之，亦主貴顯。劒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1663","lineNum":1474,"lineType":1,"content":"金加水，海金遇風，鑞金逢澗，皆吉，餘金無用，見爐中丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1664","lineNum":1475,"lineType":1,"content":"卯為吉。戊子逢丙寅，太燥性凶，主夭。己丑見丙申，却得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1665","lineNum":1476,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子，忌之。燈火東南巽地有風最宜。戊午己未天上火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1666","lineNum":1477,"lineType":1,"content":"日時遇之，防刑尅，再考玅選。有烈風雷雨格，即霹靂見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1667","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505767547486262"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1668","lineNum":1480,"lineType":1,"content":"天河是也。有天地中分格，即戊子見戊午是也。有雷霆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1669","lineNum":1481,"lineType":1,"content":"得門格，即戊子己丑日時遇卯是也。三格純戊午，與前","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1670","lineNum":1482,"lineType":1,"content":"説不同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1671","lineNum":1483,"lineType":8,"content":"丙寅丁卯爐中火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1672","lineNum":1484,"lineType":1,"content":"爐中火者，天地為爐，陰陽為炭，騰光輝於宇宙，成陶冶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1673","lineNum":1485,"lineType":1,"content":"於乾坤。此火炎上，喜得木生，惟平地之木為上，以丙寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1674","lineNum":1486,"lineType":1,"content":"見己亥，謂之天乙貴，見戊戌謂之歸庫，故吉。丁卯次之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1675","lineNum":1487,"lineType":1,"content":"然丙寅火自生，無木庶幾。丁卯火自敗，若無木則凶。且","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1676","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505767547502646"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1677","lineNum":1490,"lineType":1,"content":"此火以金為用，更得金來，方應化機。但丁卯無木而更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1678","lineNum":1491,"lineType":1,"content":"遇金，主勞苦之命。夫寅見木多火炎，而無水制主夭，卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1679","lineNum":1492,"lineType":1,"content":"見三四木不妨。如庚寅辛卯就位相生，壬午癸未化為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1680","lineNum":1493,"lineType":1,"content":"真火，寅見之多主凶暴，或疾夭。若天地元有水制，亦主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1681","lineNum":1494,"lineType":1,"content":"中壽，丁卯無妨。此火雖喜得金，為財内劒金，寅見之稍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1682","lineNum":1495,"lineType":1,"content":"可。丁卯火旣自敗，又到申酉而死絶，如何能尅，非貧即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1683","lineNum":1496,"lineType":1,"content":"夭。海中砂鑞諸金，須資木生，方喜見之，釵泊無用。見土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1684","lineNum":1497,"lineType":1,"content":"須先有金與木，却喜土以宿之，不至太燥。如城頭屋壁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1685","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505767547519030"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1686","lineNum":1500,"lineType":1,"content":"皆成器之土方好。見水，命中先愛木，不然火多喜逢之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1687","lineNum":1501,"lineType":1,"content":"天上清水，寅命遇之為吉，卯中無木，則嫌大海。丙寅見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1688","lineNum":1502,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌為福庫，見癸亥為官星帶合，半凶半吉，井澗溪流","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1689","lineNum":1503,"lineType":1,"content":"皆凶，有木不在此論。火見同類，若日月上衰敗則吉。霹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1690","lineNum":1504,"lineType":1,"content":"靂火本自無益，若得木生，更日時有海水則宜，無木遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1691","lineNum":1505,"lineType":1,"content":"水凶。天上火須有屋土遮之，燈火巽風，又為鼓舞亡神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1692","lineNum":1506,"lineType":1,"content":"須兼造化斷。如丙寅、丁酉、己酉、丙寅，火為無氣，不失大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1693","lineNum":1507,"lineType":1,"content":"貴；如丙寅、甲午、己巳、丙寅，則漂泛不安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1694","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505760752779283"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1695","lineNum":1510,"lineType":8,"content":"甲辰乙巳覆燈火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1696","lineNum":1511,"lineType":1,"content":"覆燈火者，金盞啣光，玉臺吐艷，照日月不照之處，明天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1697","lineNum":1512,"lineType":1,"content":"地未明之時，此火乃人間夜明之火。以木為心，以水為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1698","lineNum":1513,"lineType":1,"content":"油，遇陰則吉，遇陽則不利。凡日時最忌再見辰巳，地支","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1699","lineNum":1514,"lineType":1,"content":"有衝，恐風吹燈滅，主夭。或以戌亥子丑為陰，或以自未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1700","lineNum":1515,"lineType":1,"content":"至亥為陰。五行見木為根本，凡木皆好，更得官星祿貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1701","lineNum":1516,"lineType":1,"content":"相扶，干頭化水尤吉。限運遇相助，主大貴。水以井泉澗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1702","lineNum":1517,"lineType":1,"content":"下為真油，長流假油。妙選有暗燈添油格，即此理也。大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1703","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505782831415336"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1704","lineNum":1520,"lineType":1,"content":"海河水則不可以為油，遇者主尋常。大凡此火見水須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1705","lineNum":1521,"lineType":1,"content":"資木，不喜長生旺氣，水太泛反凶。命值泊金照耀，最為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1706","lineNum":1522,"lineType":1,"content":"清貴，亦須水木相資，方能顯達。砂中釵釧二金皆吉，劒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1707","lineNum":1523,"lineType":1,"content":"鋒一金，謂之燈花拂劒，尤吉。鑞金不宜。五行見土，須防","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1708","lineNum":1524,"lineType":1,"content":"尅破，若壁土可以安身，屋土可以覆庇，日時並見，主福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1709","lineNum":1525,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。砂土有木，亦主衣食，餘土無用。火愛同類，却怕風吹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1710","lineNum":1526,"lineType":1,"content":"霹靂，為龍神變化之火，必帶風來，此火難存。天上爐中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1711","lineNum":1527,"lineType":1,"content":"二火相見，最凶。再考玅選，有魁星格、指南格，以甲辰生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1712","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505754847313955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1713","lineNum":1530,"lineType":1,"content":"人，日時遇午未為是。有火土入堂格，以此火怕風，日時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1714","lineNum":1531,"lineType":1,"content":"遇丙戌丁亥屋上土，則燈在屋中，更得添油尤貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1715","lineNum":1532,"lineType":8,"content":"戊午己未天上火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1716","lineNum":1533,"lineType":1,"content":"天上火者，溫暖山河，輝光宇宙，陽徳麗天之照，陰精離","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1717","lineNum":1534,"lineType":1,"content":"海之明。戊午為太陽，則剛，己未為太陰，則柔。或以為夏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1718","lineNum":1535,"lineType":1,"content":"日則剛，冬日則溫，誣也。俱要戌亥為天門，卯酉為出入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1719","lineNum":1536,"lineType":1,"content":"之門，東南為行陸之地，則吉。此火見木，謂之震折，要日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1720","lineNum":1537,"lineType":1,"content":"時有風與水方得。大林木有辰巳，松柏石榴有卯酉，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1721","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505784089968666"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1722","lineNum":1540,"lineType":1,"content":"惟此三木主貴。午見木多猶可，未三四木，勞苦之命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1723","lineNum":1541,"lineType":1,"content":"見金且能照耀，不能尅濟。釵金有戌亥，泊金有寅卯，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1724","lineNum":1542,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。劒金為耀日月之光，必主少年登第，餘金則殃。水宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1725","lineNum":1543,"lineType":1,"content":"澗下，須戊午見丁丑，己未見丙子，陰陽交互，方為福貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1726","lineNum":1544,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中更有木滋生，富貴雙全。大溪有乙卯，井泉有己酉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1727","lineNum":1545,"lineType":1,"content":"出入得門皆吉。天河雨露相濟，不以就位尅論。戊午見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1728","lineNum":1546,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未亦吉，丙午則不明。火愛燈頭，再有別火則燥。霹靂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1729","lineNum":1547,"lineType":1,"content":"帶雲雨，則日月無光，故主昏蒙。爐中午忌丙寅，以午為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1730","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505784090001434"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1731","lineNum":1550,"lineType":1,"content":"剛火，纔見丙寅，便為火生之地，若無清水解救，主犯刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1732","lineNum":1551,"lineType":1,"content":"凶死。丁卯稍可。土見砂中，有巽風相假，路傍城屋皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1733","lineNum":1552,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中更有金木資助，尤吉。考","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1734","lineNum":1552,"lineType":1,"content":"玅選","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_143","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1735","lineNum":1552,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午遇卯，己未遇酉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1736","lineNum":1553,"lineType":1,"content":"為日月分秀格，而卯以乙卯、辛卯為正，己卯、丁卯次之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1737","lineNum":1554,"lineType":1,"content":"酉以乙酉、癸酉為正，己酉、丁酉次之。有日出扶桑格，即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1738","lineNum":1555,"lineType":1,"content":"日分秀，再見巳午日。時有日輪當表格，以戊午生於午，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1739","lineNum":1556,"lineType":1,"content":"月逢巳午日，又以戊午見戊子，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1740","lineNum":1556,"lineType":1,"content":"坎","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_144","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1741","lineNum":1556,"lineType":1,"content":"離","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_145","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1742","lineNum":1556,"lineType":1,"content":"正位。有月生滄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1743","lineNum":1557,"lineType":1,"content":"海格，即月分秀，而酉得乙癸是也。有月照寒潭格，是取","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1744","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505782831431720"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1745","lineNum":1560,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸亥子納音，屬水為潭，然必秋生為貴。有月桂芬芳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1746","lineNum":1561,"lineType":1,"content":"格，是己未生人，柱有三四木拱集，與桂林一枝同。桂林","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1747","lineNum":1562,"lineType":1,"content":"以少為貴，芬芳以多為貴，義各有所取也。再考凶格中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1748","lineNum":1563,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽損明，戊午不禁於水溢，是嫌水盛；太陰薄食，己未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1749","lineNum":1564,"lineType":1,"content":"豈堪於土多，是嫌土重也。須如是並叅，方盡其理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1750","lineNum":1565,"lineType":8,"content":"丙申丁酉山下火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1751","lineNum":1566,"lineType":1,"content":"山下火者，草間熠燿，花裏熒煌，寒林綴葉之光，隔幔㸃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1752","lineNum":1567,"lineType":1,"content":"衣之彩，方朔以螢火名之，故玅選有螢火照水格，遇秋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1753","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505784090017818"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1754","lineNum":1570,"lineType":1,"content":"生則貴為卿監，是以此火喜水地，支逢亥子，或納音水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1755","lineNum":1571,"lineType":1,"content":"更遇申酉月是也。或以山下之火，最喜木與山，更得風","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1756","lineNum":1572,"lineType":1,"content":"來增輝為貴，又不以螢火論矣。大林木有辰巳為風，桑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1757","lineNum":1573,"lineType":1,"content":"柘木有癸丑為山，松柏平地最吉，更得風助主貴，若風","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1758","lineNum":1574,"lineType":1,"content":"多吹散，主夭。水愛井泉澗下，有木相資，主爵位崇顯。大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1759","lineNum":1575,"lineType":1,"content":"海水不宜，然有山亦應貴格。寅卯為東方，木旺火生之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1760","lineNum":1576,"lineType":1,"content":"地，只甲寅水吉。乙卯為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1761","lineNum":1576,"lineType":1,"content":"震","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_146","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1762","lineNum":1576,"lineType":1,"content":"，有風見之不佳，若無火無山，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1763","lineNum":1577,"lineType":1,"content":"更加霹火，主夭。天上水為驟雨，此火不宜相見，若先得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1764","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505750006923291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1765","lineNum":1580,"lineType":1,"content":"山水滋助，亦無大害。命裏有金，以清秀為吉，無木多逢，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1766","lineNum":1581,"lineType":1,"content":"以竊氣論之。乙丑為山，主貴，餘金若無尅破，遇貴人祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1767","lineNum":1582,"lineType":1,"content":"馬，只以財論。土見砂中，辰巳有風，若有木有山加助，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1768","lineNum":1583,"lineType":1,"content":"大貴，無則虛名。火忌太陽，霹靂燈頭是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1769","lineNum":1583,"lineType":1,"content":"巽","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_147","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1770","lineNum":1583,"lineType":1,"content":"，主光顯。大都","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1771","lineNum":1584,"lineType":1,"content":"五行有火，須資木則吉，限數喜忌，俱依此斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1772","lineNum":1585,"lineType":8,"content":"甲戌乙亥山頭火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1773","lineNum":1586,"lineType":1,"content":"山頭火者，野焚燎原，延燒極目，依稀天際斜輝，彷彿山","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1774","lineNum":1587,"lineType":1,"content":"頭落日，此乃九月燒荒，衰草盡爇之火也。大槩宜山木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1775","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505760752812051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1776","lineNum":1590,"lineType":1,"content":"與風，木喜大林松柏，以辰巳有風，寅卯歸祿，更得癸丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1777","lineNum":1591,"lineType":1,"content":"為山上木，主貴。無山則木無所依，火無所見，縱有風亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1778","lineNum":1592,"lineType":1,"content":"不光顯，餘木無用，只以祿馬看。水宜澗下，名為交泰，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1779","lineNum":1593,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。井泉清水，有木助之，亦吉。大溪甲戌見甲寅，乙亥見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1780","lineNum":1594,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯，却真祿俱吉。天上須有雨露，而火到午未得地，再","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1781","lineNum":1595,"lineType":1,"content":"得清水濟之，不至於燥，主福，不然則夭。大海就位，相尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1782","lineNum":1596,"lineType":1,"content":"最凶，有山逢之，稍得日時，見金為財，須有山木助之則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1783","lineNum":1597,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，無則凶。見土惟砂中有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1784","lineNum":1597,"lineType":1,"content":"巽","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_148","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1785","lineNum":1597,"lineType":1,"content":"，能揚此火，別土無益。大凡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1786","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505713642471458"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1787","lineNum":1600,"lineType":1,"content":"此火無木見土，多是下賤之命。見火爐中太炎，霹火凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1788","lineNum":1601,"lineType":1,"content":"害，太陽昏蒙，山下戰刑，皆所不宜。命帶二三火，如限數","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1789","lineNum":1602,"lineType":1,"content":"逢木，主禍生不測，或夭。大都此火大怕刑衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1790","lineNum":1603,"lineType":8,"content":"壬子癸丑桑柘木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1791","lineNum":1604,"lineType":1,"content":"桑柘木者，繒綵鎡基，綺羅根本，士民飄飄之袂，聖賢楚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1792","lineNum":1605,"lineType":1,"content":"楚之衣。此木供蠶為弧，其用甚大，最愛砂土，以為根基。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1793","lineNum":1606,"lineType":1,"content":"又以辰巳為蠶食之地，不宜刑衝互破，路傍大驛，二土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1794","lineNum":1607,"lineType":1,"content":"次吉，餘土無益。水喜天河，為雨露之滋，長流溪澗井泉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1795","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505764867293235"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1796","lineNum":1610,"lineType":1,"content":"諸水，皆可相依，亦須先得土為基，更加祿貴為妙。滄海","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1797","lineNum":1611,"lineType":1,"content":"水。漂泛無定，無土主夭。見火燈頭最吉，亦以辰巳之中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1798","lineNum":1612,"lineType":1,"content":"為蠶位故也。爐中位居寅卯，木之旺地，天上霹靂二火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1799","lineNum":1613,"lineType":1,"content":"與此木干支有合化之情，有坎離交媾之妙，俱吉。但諸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1800","lineNum":1614,"lineType":1,"content":"火不宜疊見，以金言之，砂中第一，劒鋒能修整，此木為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1801","lineNum":1615,"lineType":1,"content":"次。釵泊二金，須得土為基，如逢衝破又凶。木喜庚寅辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1802","lineNum":1616,"lineType":1,"content":"卯，為以弱就强，以小變大，作貴格論，縱無砂土亦吉。平","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1803","lineNum":1617,"lineType":1,"content":"地柏榴，無土則凶。大林乃東南蠶食之位，有土資生，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1804","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505713642455074"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1805","lineNum":1620,"lineType":1,"content":"大貴。遇楊柳為桑柳成林，亦是貴格，須生春夏方吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1806","lineNum":1621,"lineType":8,"content":"庚寅辛卯松柏木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
