{"lines":[{"lineId":"1807","lineNum":1622,"lineType":1,"content":"松柏木者，潑雪凑霜，參天覆地，風撼笙篁之奏，雨餘旌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1808","lineNum":1623,"lineType":1,"content":"斾之張。此木藏居金下，位列正東，乃為極旺。最喜山為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1809","lineNum":1624,"lineType":1,"content":"根基，水為滋潤，天河雨露之水，可以滋潤。澗下丁丑屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1810","lineNum":1625,"lineType":1,"content":"山，可為根基，丙子不如。大溪水有乙卯為雷，可以發榮，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1811","lineNum":1626,"lineType":1,"content":"却嫌風霹，有損折之凶。大海水有山則吉，癸亥清淨，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1812","lineNum":1627,"lineType":1,"content":"山亦吉，若柱有平地，得屋土，則為己成棟梁，無用山水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1813","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505782831480872"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1814","lineNum":1630,"lineType":1,"content":"無此二件，乃山間之茂木也。須要山水命中有火，最忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1815","lineNum":1631,"lineType":1,"content":"爐中就位相生，再加風木，灰飛煙滅。五行無水主夭折，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1816","lineNum":1632,"lineType":1,"content":"山頭山下，太陽覆燈，皆不可犯。寅人尤忌戊午丙寅，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1817","lineNum":1633,"lineType":1,"content":"木不南奔，寅午三合火局故也。辛卯無害，霹火雖可滋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1818","lineNum":1634,"lineType":1,"content":"生，運加凡火，主凶。土見路傍，似無足貴，若無死木，其福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1819","lineNum":1635,"lineType":1,"content":"還真。驛土無山貧夭，更加海水尤凶。金逢乙丑為印為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1820","lineNum":1636,"lineType":1,"content":"山，泊金就位自旺主吉。劒鋒能削能斲，更得壁土相成，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1821","lineNum":1637,"lineType":1,"content":"松柏相資，主貴。大林有風，楊柳㑹火，二木最忌，桑柘癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1822","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505717253718055"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1823","lineNum":1640,"lineType":1,"content":"丑為山，可以相助，石榴是辛酉金，反化死木，有造化却","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1824","lineNum":1641,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，玅選有蒼松冬秀格，是以此木生人月日時屬三冬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1825","lineNum":1642,"lineType":1,"content":"為貴。有日合辛卯，月值庚寅，二格雖取戊午己未，生居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1826","lineNum":1643,"lineType":1,"content":"夏秋，然專論此二木為貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1827","lineNum":1644,"lineType":8,"content":"戊辰己巳大林木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1828","lineNum":1645,"lineType":1,"content":"大林木者，枝幹撼風，柯條撐月，聳壑昂霄之徳，凌雲蔽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1829","lineNum":1646,"lineType":1,"content":"日之功。此木生居東南，春夏之交，長養成林，全假艮土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1830","lineNum":1647,"lineType":1,"content":"為源，癸丑為山，三命無破陷，最為福厚權貴。戊辰為上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1831","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505800577515547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1832","lineNum":1650,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳次之。土遇路傍為負載，戊辰見辛未為貴，己巳見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1833","lineNum":1651,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午為祿主福。壁屋二土，再得劒金，則大林之木，取為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1834","lineNum":1652,"lineType":1,"content":"棟梁成格最吉，無此乃山間茂林之木也。此木無論死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1835","lineNum":1653,"lineType":1,"content":"活，皆欲見土，如巳人見甲，雖云化土，然不如辰戌丑未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1836","lineNum":1654,"lineType":1,"content":"土局純全為玅。若此木已死在山之下，見甲戌乙亥燒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1837","lineNum":1655,"lineType":1,"content":"之，主凶夭。燈火就位相生，乙巳不如甲辰更吉。霹靂太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1838","lineNum":1656,"lineType":1,"content":"陽二火，皆能長育，運中遇之亦吉，然二火嫌並見持勝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1839","lineNum":1657,"lineType":1,"content":"須有土為根基方可。水見天河，戊辰見丁未為帶貴，雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1840","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505767547568182"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1841","lineNum":1660,"lineType":1,"content":"無土與山，亦主有衣食，即靈槎入天河格也，生秋冬死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1842","lineNum":1661,"lineType":1,"content":"絶方是。溪海二水重見，主貧夭。有山稍得玅選，有蒼龍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1843","lineNum":1662,"lineType":1,"content":"駕海格，是戊辰見癸亥為貴。澗下丁丑最吉，丙子不如，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1844","lineNum":1663,"lineType":1,"content":"諸金俱不宜見。海中有乙丑為山劒鋒，得屋壁為本，餘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1845","lineNum":1664,"lineType":1,"content":"金無用，逢之主夭賤。木喜桑柘，惟癸丑最妙。平地還須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1846","lineNum":1665,"lineType":1,"content":"得路傍土，謂之平林在野。松柏，東方生旺之地，柱有癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1847","lineNum":1666,"lineType":1,"content":"丑而得松柏為密蔭，最佳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1848","lineNum":1667,"lineType":8,"content":"壬午癸未楊柳木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1849","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505764867326003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1850","lineNum":1670,"lineType":1,"content":"楊柳木者，隋堤裊娜，漢苑輕盈，萬縷不蠶之絲，千條不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1851","lineNum":1671,"lineType":1,"content":"針之帶。午未木之死墓，壬癸木之滋潤，此木根基，惟喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1852","lineNum":1672,"lineType":1,"content":"砂土，見艮山則依倚搖金，遇寅卯則東方得地，辛丑有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1853","lineNum":1673,"lineType":1,"content":"山，庚子不如，戊寅雖吉，己卯尤勝。丙辰丁巳，却嫌戌亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1854","lineNum":1674,"lineType":1,"content":"對衝，若見大驛，有丑為山邊之驛，稍可，無丑獨見此土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1855","lineNum":1675,"lineType":1,"content":"主夭賤。路傍就位，復值死墓，日時遇之，主人卑弱。屋土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1856","lineNum":1676,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午見丁亥，丁壬合化則吉，丙戌不如。水見井泉長流","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1857","lineNum":1677,"lineType":1,"content":"大溪澗下皆吉，中間又分合化之位尤吉。丙午丁未，丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1858","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505782831513640"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1859","lineNum":1680,"lineType":1,"content":"丁真火，午未亦火，此木至午未死墓，壬午見之大凶，癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1860","lineNum":1681,"lineType":1,"content":"庶幾有别。水濟之，無害，此木午未已自有火，更見別火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1861","lineNum":1682,"lineType":1,"content":"恐引起傷壽。燈頭乙巳有風，木折主凶。爐中寅卯本位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1862","lineNum":1683,"lineType":1,"content":"木旺反吉。霹火如壬午見己丑，癸未見戊子，陰陽交遇，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1863","lineNum":1684,"lineType":1,"content":"更有砂土為基，主貴。若子午丑未對衝，則不為吉。金見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1864","lineNum":1685,"lineType":1,"content":"木無造化，釵釧金泊，却喜成功，海鑞劒砂，雖忌見之，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1865","lineNum":1686,"lineType":1,"content":"間輕重，當以祿貴徳煞參詳。見松柏木，為脱體化神之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1866","lineNum":1687,"lineType":1,"content":"格也，主貴。桑柘癸丑為山，作倚傍成林，主吉。庚申辛酉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1867","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505750006956059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1868","lineNum":1690,"lineType":1,"content":"木旣死絶，又逢金尅，以弱遇小，其人必賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1869","lineNum":1690,"lineType":1,"content":"玅選","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_149","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1870","lineNum":1690,"lineType":1,"content":"有花紅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1871","lineNum":1691,"lineType":1,"content":"柳綠格，是以此木遇石榴，生於春夏，不以賤論。有楊柳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1872","lineNum":1692,"lineType":1,"content":"拖金格，是以此木生於三春，而時得一金。辛亥、甲子、癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1873","lineNum":1693,"lineType":1,"content":"卯、辛巳最妙，乃壬癸祿貴之地故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1874","lineNum":1694,"lineType":8,"content":"庚申辛酉石榴木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1875","lineNum":1695,"lineType":1,"content":"石榴木者，性辛如薑，花紅似火，數顆枝頭，纍纍多子，房","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1876","lineNum":1696,"lineType":1,"content":"内瑩瑩，干支純金，而納音屬木，乃木之變者也。可以移","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1877","lineNum":1697,"lineType":1,"content":"盆内而糚做山，故喜成器之土，以為根基。城頭為上，屋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1878","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505717253734439"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1879","lineNum":1700,"lineType":1,"content":"上次之。然必陰陽交見，則丙辛丁庚互官，戊辛己寅互","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1880","lineNum":1701,"lineType":1,"content":"印，主吉。路壁、驛砂四土，有山助之亦吉。若無，何用見金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1881","lineNum":1702,"lineType":1,"content":"砂中最吉。泊金干支水木而納音金，榴木干支金而納","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1882","lineNum":1703,"lineType":1,"content":"音木，皆脱去本性，而互換歸旺，以木旺寅卯，金旺申酉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1883","lineNum":1704,"lineType":1,"content":"各得其位，謂之功侔造化，格主大貴。海中乙丑為山，更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1884","lineNum":1705,"lineType":1,"content":"逢水助則吉。或壁上城頭，亦得劒鋒就位，相尅最凶。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1885","lineNum":1706,"lineType":1,"content":"先有砂金，能制其毒，亦不為害。水見天河，雨露相滋，井","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1886","lineNum":1707,"lineType":1,"content":"泉溪澗，清水澆灌，大海大泛濫，非貧則夭。有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1887","lineNum":1707,"lineType":1,"content":"艮","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_150","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1888","lineNum":1707,"lineType":1,"content":"土，稍得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1889","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505782831530024"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1890","lineNum":1710,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽霹靂二火，雖喜不宜並見。爐中寅卯旺位本吉，再","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1891","lineNum":1711,"lineType":1,"content":"加別火則凶。若此木生於五月，日時止帶一火，謂之石","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1892","lineNum":1712,"lineType":1,"content":"榴噴火，主貴。桑柘、大林、楊柳三木皆喜見之。見桑柘癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1893","lineNum":1713,"lineType":1,"content":"丑為山，見大林，戊辰脱體，見楊柳，花紅柳綠，皆主功名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1894","lineNum":1714,"lineType":1,"content":"見松柏則强，見平地則大，若無別物夾雜，則綠遶紅圍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1895","lineNum":1715,"lineType":1,"content":"亦主富貴。如得城土為基，水運為助，享福優游，最為長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1896","lineNum":1716,"lineType":1,"content":"久。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1897","lineNum":1717,"lineType":8,"content":"戊戌己亥平地木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1898","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505760752828435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1899","lineNum":1720,"lineType":1,"content":"平地木者，初生萌蘖，始發枝條，惟資雨露之功，不喜雪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1900","lineNum":1721,"lineType":1,"content":"霜之積，此乃地上之茂材，人間之屋木。戊戌為棟，己亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1901","lineNum":1722,"lineType":1,"content":"為梁，最宜互換見之，須以土為基，土愛路傍為正格，更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1902","lineNum":1723,"lineType":1,"content":"逢子午尤貴，以子午為天地正柱故也。屋壁城頭三土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1903","lineNum":1724,"lineType":1,"content":"以此木相資，中間有升化尤吉。砂驛無用，日時見之，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1904","lineNum":1725,"lineType":1,"content":"災夭。火愛太陽霹靂，最為顯耀，爐中遇水則福，燈頭無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1905","lineNum":1726,"lineType":1,"content":"風則固，餘火無水則凶。此已成之木，不宜劒金，有木相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1906","lineNum":1727,"lineType":1,"content":"資，則可泊金，增飾光輝。又天干合地支旺，更有傍土為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1907","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505767547584566"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1908","lineNum":1730,"lineType":1,"content":"基，主大貴，餘金無用。水見天河為潤澤，主吉。溪海無山","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1909","lineNum":1731,"lineType":1,"content":"俱凶。井泉澗下雖吉，内甲申合丁丑為山，遇之尤吉。木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1910","lineNum":1732,"lineType":1,"content":"見大林，有風動搖，主壽促。桑柘癸丑最吉，壬子己亥人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1911","lineNum":1733,"lineType":1,"content":"見之為貴，戊戌人不堪。松柏木倚輔平地為棟梁，更有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1912","lineNum":1734,"lineType":1,"content":"土助，主貴。大抵此木惡金而喜水，土若生三冬時，得寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1913","lineNum":1735,"lineType":1,"content":"卯，為寒谷回春，亦貴論也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1914","lineNum":1736,"lineType":8,"content":"庚子辛丑壁上土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1915","lineNum":1737,"lineType":1,"content":"壁上土者，恃棟依梁，興門立戶，却暑禦寒之徳，遮霜護","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1916","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505764867342387"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1917","lineNum":1740,"lineType":1,"content":"雪之功，此乃人間壁土，非平地何以為靠。子午天地正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1918","lineNum":1741,"lineType":1,"content":"柱，逢之尤為吉慶。凡見木，皆可為主，庚寅辛卯，亦是棟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1919","lineNum":1742,"lineType":1,"content":"梁，只申酉衝破，子卯相刑，大林有風，若無承載之土加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1920","lineNum":1743,"lineType":1,"content":"凡火，主作事難成，貧賤而夭。土愛路傍，謂之負載，屋上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1921","lineNum":1744,"lineType":1,"content":"城頭，可以護身，皆吉。見火全無造化，太陽霹靂，雖云照","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1922","lineNum":1745,"lineType":1,"content":"耀，到底蹇危。若命先已見木，遇火助鬼焚尅，運再逢之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1923","lineNum":1746,"lineType":1,"content":"主禍患夭折。柱有水救濟稍得。水見甲申為最吉，乙酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1924","lineNum":1747,"lineType":1,"content":"次之，天上雨露亦吉。大海漂泛，此土何安，縱有根基，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1925","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505782831546408"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1926","lineNum":1750,"lineType":1,"content":"凶。諸金惟愛泊金命裏，先有木神則貴，以其成宮室而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1927","lineNum":1751,"lineType":1,"content":"金碧輝煌，非朝廷不敢用也。劒金傷害，餘金無用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1928","lineNum":1752,"lineType":8,"content":"戊寅己卯城頭土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1929","lineNum":1753,"lineType":1,"content":"城頭土者，天京玉壘，帝里金城，龍盤千里之形，虎踞四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1930","lineNum":1754,"lineType":1,"content":"維之勢。此土有成有未成，作兩般論。凡遇見路傍，為已","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1931","lineNum":1755,"lineType":1,"content":"成之土，不必用火。若無路傍，為未成之土，必須用火。大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1932","lineNum":1756,"lineType":1,"content":"都城土，皆須資木，楊柳癸未最佳，壬午則忌。桑柘，癸丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1933","lineNum":1757,"lineType":1,"content":"為上，壬子次之，庚寅辛卯就位相尅，則城崩不寧，何以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1934","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505800577597467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1935","lineNum":1760,"lineType":1,"content":"安人也耶。如見木無夾輔，只以貴人祿馬論之。見水有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1936","lineNum":1761,"lineType":1,"content":"山為顯貴，甲申丁丑俱吉，天河滋助亦吉，惟忌霹靂大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1937","lineNum":1762,"lineType":1,"content":"海，壬戌不忌，合化俱以吉推。土愛路傍，防見諸火，大驛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1938","lineNum":1763,"lineType":1,"content":"逢山，須作貴觀，若獨見無根本，貧夭孤寒。五行見金，只","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1939","lineNum":1764,"lineType":1,"content":"有白鑞怕巽，二者相妨，餘金無用，亦須以貴人祿馬看","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1940","lineNum":1765,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1942","lineNum":1767,"lineType":1,"content":"砂中土者，浪回所積，波渚而成，龍蛇盤隱之宮，陵谷變","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1943","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505717253783591"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1944","lineNum":1770,"lineType":1,"content":"遷之地。此土清秀，惟喜清金養之，更得清淨之土，主早","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1945","lineNum":1771,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。釵砂劒泊，此四金清秀相助，如丙人見辛亥為丙丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1946","lineNum":1772,"lineType":1,"content":"入於乾户，號曰駕海長虹，又有星拱北之論，皆貴格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1947","lineNum":1773,"lineType":1,"content":"更得水相涵，尤為上吉，若無水而時日得天上火照亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1948","lineNum":1774,"lineType":1,"content":"可。如丙辰、乙未、癸酉、戊午，此命有二金資養，却全無水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1949","lineNum":1775,"lineType":1,"content":"得太陽火照故貴。如丁巳、癸卯、己未、壬申，此命二金資","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1950","lineNum":1776,"lineType":1,"content":"養，得天上火照亦貴，然戊午太燥，己未稍緩，壽夭不同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1951","lineNum":1777,"lineType":1,"content":"水以井澗清潔為吉，若有金以養之，貴。如此土已得金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1952","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505800577613851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1953","lineNum":1780,"lineType":1,"content":"養，而日時有海水，便壞造化。癸亥輕清，丙人見之，限運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1954","lineNum":1781,"lineType":1,"content":"逢，亦主顯榮，餘水無用。火喜太陽在格，號為朱雀騰空，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1955","lineNum":1782,"lineType":1,"content":"主貴。山頭山下，爐中覆燈，諸火若無水濟，主壽夭。木愛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1956","lineNum":1783,"lineType":1,"content":"桑柘楊柳，以此土能栽二木故也，餘木却以祿馬貴人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1957","lineNum":1784,"lineType":1,"content":"叅之，如日中刑破衝尅之木，雖見有何造化，不如無為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1958","lineNum":1785,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。五行最忌土相刑，路傍安身，有金木資生，亦主福慶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1959","lineNum":1786,"lineType":1,"content":"大驛往來，最不宜見，縱有金水亦凶，餘土尤不為吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1960","lineNum":1787,"lineType":8,"content":"庚午辛未路傍土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1961","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505717253767207"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1962","lineNum":1790,"lineType":1,"content":"路傍土者，大地連途，平田萬頃，禾稼賴以資生，草木由","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1963","lineNum":1791,"lineType":1,"content":"之暢茂，此乃火煖土溫，長養萬物之土也。故須假水為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1964","lineNum":1792,"lineType":1,"content":"先，乃灌漑滋潤之論，次第尤宜水化為妙，更得金來相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1965","lineNum":1793,"lineType":1,"content":"助，則禾稼成實。如庚午見甲申，辛未見乙酉，為祿，若無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1966","lineNum":1794,"lineType":1,"content":"衝破，主早貴。天上水，雨露相滋，庚午喜見丁未，辛未喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1967","lineNum":1795,"lineType":1,"content":"見丙午，為官貴祿合之妙。澗下庚午見丁丑，貴祿交馳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1968","lineNum":1796,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未見丙子，化水逢生。大溪乙卯為雷，能發生此土，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1969","lineNum":1797,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚合化，故皆主吉。長流大海二水，以其不能澆灌此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1970","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505800577679387"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1971","lineNum":1800,"lineType":1,"content":"土，故最忌之，主凶夭。火逢霹靂，庚午見己丑，貴祿交穿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1972","lineNum":1801,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未見戊子，印貴朝陽，皆吉。天上火，就位相生，太燥則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1973","lineNum":1802,"lineType":1,"content":"土反不能生物，有水潤之始得，若獨見主夭。爐中火亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1974","lineNum":1803,"lineType":1,"content":"燥，亦主妨壽。燈頭有屋土，方應造化，名超凡入聖，不然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1975","lineNum":1804,"lineType":1,"content":"亦凶。見木可以發生，然有貴人祿馬則吉，刑煞衝破則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1976","lineNum":1805,"lineType":1,"content":"凶。只有庚寅木，此土逢之大好，大林不能勝載。如逢土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1977","lineNum":1806,"lineType":1,"content":"位，見丙辰丙戌辛丑辛未皆吉，若庚午見辛未，辛未見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1978","lineNum":1807,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午，為二儀貴偶，無有不貴。釵釧砂中二金，可以滋助","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1979","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505768780496950"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1980","lineNum":1810,"lineType":1,"content":"清水，金水並見，大吉。若命已見水無金，運遇此金亦福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1981","lineNum":1811,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑海金可為山論，若得天河清水助之，庚人大好。玅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1982","lineNum":1812,"lineType":1,"content":"選有金馬嘶風格，以庚午甲午生人，得辛巳時，有馬化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1983","lineNum":1813,"lineType":1,"content":"龍駒格。又以午生人，見辰時，有哨風猛虎格。以庚辛生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1984","lineNum":1814,"lineType":1,"content":"人，得辛巳乙巳，俱以貴論。而水火土金似不相拘，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1986","lineNum":1816,"lineType":1,"content":"大驛土者，堂堂大道，坦坦平途，九州無所不通，萬國無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1987","lineNum":1817,"lineType":1,"content":"行不至，此乃位屬坤方，徳乃厚載，輪天轉日，負海乘山","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1988","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505765559320611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1989","lineNum":1820,"lineType":1,"content":"之土也。發生萬物，以木為基，戊申長生之土，徳厚無疆，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1990","lineNum":1821,"lineType":1,"content":"見三四木皆能滋生。己酉自敗之土，木多則竊氣。大林","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1991","lineNum":1822,"lineType":1,"content":"合中逢衝主夭，别木則吉。更以祿貴叅之，井泉澗下二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1992","lineNum":1823,"lineType":1,"content":"水，清貴不燥，如戊申見丁丑或乙酉，己酉見丙子或甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1993","lineNum":1824,"lineType":1,"content":"申，謂之官貴主吉。天河丙午而己酉得之，丁未而戊申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1994","lineNum":1825,"lineType":1,"content":"得之，亦為貴祿，主福。長流戊申見癸巳，己酉見壬辰，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1995","lineNum":1826,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，多逢則不寧靜。大溪乙卯為東震發生之義，單見亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1996","lineNum":1827,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。海水對穿，土不能勝日時遇主夭，得山稍輕，内戊申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1997","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505764867391539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1998","lineNum":1830,"lineType":1,"content":"見癸亥，戊癸合，申亥為地天交泰，反吉。火見太陽霹靂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1999","lineNum":1831,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之聖火，最能發生，此土如逢水助，主顯達。其餘凡火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2000","lineNum":1832,"lineType":1,"content":"再逢木生之更燥，主凶夭。五行見土，惟路傍最宜，屋上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2001","lineNum":1833,"lineType":1,"content":"壁上砂中，縱先得木，亦為冺絶。城頭有水稍吉，命若有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2002","lineNum":1834,"lineType":1,"content":"金，清秀吉。釵釧得辛亥，金泊得壬寅，戊申遇之，柱中更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2003","lineNum":1835,"lineType":1,"content":"加水助，乃地天交泰，水遶山環，大格主貴。己酉見庚戌、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2004","lineNum":1836,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯稍次，砂金造化亦同，劒金須候木得用，不然無益。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2006","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505765190254644"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2007","lineNum":1840,"lineType":1,"content":"屋上土者，埏埴為林，水火旣濟，蓋蔽雪霜之積，震凌風","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2008","lineNum":1841,"lineType":1,"content":"雨之功，此土瓦也，非木無以架之，故以木為根基，平地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2009","lineNum":1842,"lineType":1,"content":"為上，大林次之，餘取天干化木亦吉，只怕衝破，此已成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2010","lineNum":1843,"lineType":1,"content":"之土，不宜見火。爐中丙寅最凶，丁卯稍可，太陽霹靂，可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2011","lineNum":1844,"lineType":1,"content":"取相資。山下山頭有木生之則禍。燈頭丙戌見乙巳為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2012","lineNum":1845,"lineType":1,"content":"上，丁卯見甲辰次之，謂之火土入堂格。若柱中木多，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2013","lineNum":1846,"lineType":1,"content":"不為吉。水宜天河、井泉澗下皆吉，如先得平地木成格，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2014","lineNum":1847,"lineType":1,"content":"大貴，溪流無木多夭。若丙戌而得癸巳，丁亥而得甲寅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2015","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505800577646619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2016","lineNum":1850,"lineType":1,"content":"則又別論。再看日時所成造化何如。大海無山，則不宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2017","lineNum":1851,"lineType":1,"content":"見土，土見路傍，如丙戌得辛未，丁亥得庚午，陰陽互見，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2018","lineNum":1852,"lineType":1,"content":"更假木為基，主貴，壁土亦宜，餘則汨沒。若缺木而三刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2019","lineNum":1853,"lineType":1,"content":"聚，縱是二土亦凶。砂土獨丁巳不妨，金惟劒鋒釵釧最","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2020","lineNum":1854,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。丁見壬申，天干化木，地支乾坤清夷。丙見辛亥，天干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2021","lineNum":1855,"lineType":1,"content":"化水，地支丙入乾戸，皆大貴格。若丁亥見庚戌，丙戌見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2022","lineNum":1856,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉，則不為吉。泊金有粉飾之用，亦吉，餘金無用，當以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2023","lineNum":1857,"lineType":1,"content":"貴祿叅詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2026","lineNum":1861,"lineType":1,"content":"澗下水者，山環細浪，雪湧飛湍，相連南北之流，對峙坎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2027","lineNum":1862,"lineType":1,"content":"離之脉，此水清澄，喜見金養，砂中、劒鋒二金，最宜釵釧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2028","lineNum":1863,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌丁丑不宜以丑戌相刑。辛亥見丙子，則丙辛化水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2029","lineNum":1864,"lineType":1,"content":"尤貴。餘金以祿貴叅之，取其資生，惡其衝破，見木一位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2030","lineNum":1865,"lineType":1,"content":"不妨，二三則主勞苦，亦以貴人祿馬叅之。命中見土，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2031","lineNum":1866,"lineType":1,"content":"人多濁，天元若木或化水，則主清吉。砂中屋上二土，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2032","lineNum":1867,"lineType":1,"content":"氣稍清，路傍大驛，則濁甚矣，主財散禍生。如辰戌丑未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2033","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505760752910355"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2034","lineNum":1870,"lineType":1,"content":"土局，其凶尤甚，以水濁土渾故也。火見太陽，雖炎中間","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2035","lineNum":1871,"lineType":1,"content":"有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2036","lineNum":1871,"lineType":1,"content":"旣濟","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_151","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2037","lineNum":1871,"lineType":1,"content":"未濟","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_152","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2038","lineNum":1871,"lineType":1,"content":"之論，霹靂就位相爭，最所不宜。若二火並","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2039","lineNum":1872,"lineType":1,"content":"臨，無金資助，主荒淫。有金別論，山下山頭亦吉。若並臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2040","lineNum":1873,"lineType":1,"content":"時日，則嫌命中遇水，反成漂蕩。見天河為引凡入聖，見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2041","lineNum":1874,"lineType":1,"content":"大海為福貴朝宗，皆吉。獨丁丑見壬戌，則丑戌相刑，丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2042","lineNum":1875,"lineType":1,"content":"壬淫合，主風聲不雅，大溪性急，長流不靜，皆不為吉。大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2043","lineNum":1876,"lineType":1,"content":"抵此水須以金為主，而無火土夾雜，再得甲寅乙卯之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2044","lineNum":1877,"lineType":1,"content":"水，則源遠流清，真君子人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2047","lineNum":1881,"lineType":1,"content":"大溪水者，驚濤薄岸，駭浪浮天，光涵萬里之寛，碧倒千","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2048","lineNum":1882,"lineType":1,"content":"山之影，最喜有歸有養，遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2049","lineNum":1882,"lineType":1,"content":"坎","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_153","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2050","lineNum":1882,"lineType":1,"content":"則為有歸，得金則為有養。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2051","lineNum":1883,"lineType":1,"content":"所嫌者，日月時中，有申酉衝動，或辰巳風吹，主飄流，井","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2052","lineNum":1884,"lineType":1,"content":"泉水淨而止，澗下有丑為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2053","lineNum":1884,"lineType":1,"content":"艮","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_154","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2054","lineNum":1884,"lineType":1,"content":"，天河沾潤，大海朝宗，此四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2055","lineNum":1885,"lineType":1,"content":"水皆吉。長流有風，獨不宜見。此水以清金為助養，惟釵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2056","lineNum":1886,"lineType":1,"content":"砂最宜，鑞金亦清，若有釵金對衝，則不宜。海中雖無造","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2057","lineNum":1887,"lineType":1,"content":"化，甲子屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2058","lineNum":1887,"lineType":1,"content":"坎","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_155","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2059","lineNum":1887,"lineType":1,"content":"，乙丑為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2060","lineNum":1887,"lineType":1,"content":"艮","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_156","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2061","lineNum":1887,"lineType":1,"content":"，乃歸源之地，亦吉。泊金最微，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2062","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505800577695771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2063","lineNum":1890,"lineType":1,"content":"能相生，豈有超顯之理。劒金雖化於大溪，却忌卯雷巽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2064","lineNum":1891,"lineType":1,"content":"風，主性不定，五行有土，皆為無益。屋上城頭，壅阻此水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2065","lineNum":1892,"lineType":1,"content":"路傍稍可，亦不為奇。壁上獨辛丑為山，大驛惟己酉有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2066","lineNum":1893,"lineType":1,"content":"合，戊申則衝，庚子則刑，皆不為吉。火見太陽，雖假照燿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2067","lineNum":1894,"lineType":1,"content":"霹靂，尤忌相逢。若二火互見，主貧。單見別論。木見此水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2068","lineNum":1895,"lineType":1,"content":"徒被漂蕩，惟桑柘木壬子有坎，癸丑為山，為水遶山環","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2069","lineNum":1896,"lineType":1,"content":"之貴。内甲寅人見壬子吉，乙卯人見癸丑吉，餘木以祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2070","lineNum":1897,"lineType":1,"content":"貴叅之，尤忌衝破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2071","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505765190221876"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2072","lineNum":1900,"lineType":8,"content":"壬辰癸巳長流水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2073","lineNum":1901,"lineType":1,"content":"長流水者，混混無窮，滔滔不竭，就下必納於東南，順流","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2074","lineNum":1902,"lineType":1,"content":"自歸於辰巳。此水喜金生養，金要白鑞釵釧，以天干有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2075","lineNum":1903,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛真金，地支辰巳就位相生，戌亥為歸源之地，劒鋒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2076","lineNum":1904,"lineType":1,"content":"純是金水，泊金水木居東，皆以吉論。海中砂中無取，嫌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2077","lineNum":1905,"lineType":1,"content":"土蹇涸，而土有隄防之用。六土之中，取庚辛丙丁為吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2078","lineNum":1906,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己無用，遇火則相刑，而有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2079","lineNum":1906,"lineType":1,"content":"旣濟","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_157","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2080","lineNum":1906,"lineType":1,"content":"之妙。内壬辰喜見丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2081","lineNum":1907,"lineType":1,"content":"卯丁酉，癸巳喜見戊子戊午，以天干合化故也。燈頭癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2082","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505765190287412"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2083","lineNum":1910,"lineType":1,"content":"巳尤喜見甲辰，山頭壬辰尤喜遇乙亥。化龍歸祿，取義","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2084","lineNum":1911,"lineType":1,"content":"更佳。逢木雖漂泛，而桑柘癸丑為山，楊柳癸未為園，年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2085","lineNum":1912,"lineType":1,"content":"時得此水圍之，為水遶花堤，大貴格也。松柏石榴，天干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2086","lineNum":1913,"lineType":1,"content":"有金相生，大林平地，雖嫌有土，而癸巳見戊辰，壬辰見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2087","lineNum":1914,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥，俱吉。水為同類，澗下則丁壬合化，天上則雨露相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2088","lineNum":1915,"lineType":1,"content":"資，井泉大溪無益，海乃衆流所歸，而壬辰之龍，得癸亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2089","lineNum":1916,"lineType":1,"content":"則龍躍天門，春夏秋生為吉，或龍潛大海，則冬生乃宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2090","lineNum":1917,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中須先得金為妙，又壬辰為自印之水，再見壬辰則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2091","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505782831595560"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2092","lineNum":1920,"lineType":1,"content":"刑，刑則自害，見戊戌則衝，衝則泛濫，主凶。癸巳自絶之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2093","lineNum":1921,"lineType":1,"content":"水，名為涸流，若遇丙戌、丁亥、庚子、辛丑之土，其涸可待。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2094","lineNum":1922,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中如得三合生旺之金生之，則吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"2095","lineNum":1923,"lineType":8,"content":"丙午丁未天河水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2096","lineNum":1924,"lineType":1,"content":"天河水者，亂灑六野，密沛千郊，淋淋瀉下銀河，細細飛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2097","lineNum":1925,"lineType":1,"content":"來碧落，此乃天上雨露，發生萬物，無不賴之。銀漢之水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2098","lineNum":1926,"lineType":1,"content":"土不能尅，故見土不忌，而且有滋潤之益。天上之水，地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2099","lineNum":1927,"lineType":1,"content":"金難生，故見金難益，而亦有涵秀之情。生旺太過，則為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2100","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505786677592076"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2101","lineNum":1930,"lineType":1,"content":"淫潦，反傷於物；死絶太多，則為旱乾，又不能生物。要生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2102","lineNum":1931,"lineType":1,"content":"三秋，得時為貴也。水喜長流大海内，丙午宜癸巳癸亥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2103","lineNum":1932,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未宜壬辰壬戌，陰陽互見尤吉。大溪乙卯為雷，井泉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2104","lineNum":1933,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉為貴，俱以吉論。火喜霹靂，為神龍之火，與此水相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2105","lineNum":1934,"lineType":1,"content":"濟，而倏忽變化，雲行雨施，豈有不貴。爐中火旺，大海水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2106","lineNum":1935,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，如柱中得二火二水，上下相濟，謂之精神俱足，大貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2107","lineNum":1936,"lineType":1,"content":"格也。燈頭有風，山頭有貴，皆以吉論，又須以別水濟之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2108","lineNum":1937,"lineType":1,"content":"方吉。天上就位，相尅則忌。見之木，石榴、楊柳俱吉。大林","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505800577712155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2110","lineNum":1940,"lineType":1,"content":"有巽，平地有亥，亦吉。松柏石榴，遇丙辛合化，亦以吉論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2111","lineNum":1941,"lineType":1,"content":"玅選有靈槎入天河格，是取死絶無根之木，柱無土培，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2112","lineNum":1942,"lineType":1,"content":"則漂流，天河是也。土雖不能尅，而柱逢庚午辛未，就位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2113","lineNum":1943,"lineType":1,"content":"相尅，土壅水滯，或水又冬生，則水結池塘，必主濁濫。餘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2114","lineNum":1944,"lineType":1,"content":"土如砂中屋上皆吉，城頭大驛無用，壁上地支對衝，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2115","lineNum":1945,"lineType":1,"content":"壞造化。水金雖不能生，獨辛亥釵金，却屬乾天水在天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2116","lineNum":1946,"lineType":1,"content":"上，只此最吉。餘金亦取天干有庚辛壬癸者為用，甲乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2117","lineNum":1947,"lineType":1,"content":"無益，再以祿馬貴人叅之，始得玅選。又以水生人，得庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505768780529718"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2119","lineNum":1950,"lineType":1,"content":"子壬子，為雲騰雨施，生春則旱，夏則潦，冬則寒，獨三秋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2120","lineNum":1951,"lineType":1,"content":"最吉。遇甲辰、乙巳、庚辰、辛巳柱中有壬為雲，有辰為龍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2121","lineNum":1952,"lineType":1,"content":"為風雨作霖。若生冬月，是為霜凝薄露日時，喜遇寅卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2122","lineNum":1953,"lineType":1,"content":"溫和之氣，可解斯凍，俱貴格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"2123","lineNum":1954,"lineType":8,"content":"甲申乙酉井泉水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2124","lineNum":1955,"lineType":1,"content":"井泉水者，寒泉清冽，取養不窮，八家鑿之以同飲，萬民","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2125","lineNum":1956,"lineType":1,"content":"資之以生活。此水生於金而出於木，故喜見金為福。砂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2126","lineNum":1957,"lineType":1,"content":"中有土，性與之最宜，釵釧清秀次之，鑞金與釵金相衝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505765190271028"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2128","lineNum":1960,"lineType":1,"content":"故不宜再見劒鋒。申酉太旺，恐有泛濫之災。海金無取，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2129","lineNum":1961,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2130","lineNum":1961,"lineType":1,"content":"艮","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_158","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2131","lineNum":1961,"lineType":1,"content":"，山下出泉亦吉，此非木不能出，譬之桶論，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2132","lineNum":1962,"lineType":1,"content":"見木皆吉。如見平地大林，須假劒金削之，方可。取用桑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2133","lineNum":1963,"lineType":1,"content":"柘楊柳，無用松柏，則互換歸祿，此其最吉。諸火陰陽互","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2134","lineNum":1964,"lineType":1,"content":"見則吉，霹靂名為入聖，太陽號為顯照，二火相見最吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2135","lineNum":1965,"lineType":1,"content":"但不宜並有則凶。諸土路傍，砂中最吉，屋上有天門，生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2136","lineNum":1966,"lineType":1,"content":"水之源，亦吉。城頭壁上，與此水則無干涉。大驛就位相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2137","lineNum":1967,"lineType":1,"content":"尅，水為土掩，則井渫不食，須有木去之方可。水喜大海","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2138","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505782831661096"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2139","lineNum":1970,"lineType":1,"content":"為引，凡入聖天上，澗下長流，亦不為災。大溪甲寅乙卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2140","lineNum":1971,"lineType":1,"content":"為吉，如甲申見乙酉，乙酉見甲申，官星互換最吉。如二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2141","lineNum":1972,"lineType":1,"content":"水在年時，二木在月日，謂之水遶花堤，乃貴格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2165","lineNum":1996,"lineType":1,"content":"六十甲子納音取象，其十干有可以為金，有不可以為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2166","lineNum":1997,"lineType":1,"content":"金者，雖因所值之數不同，而五行類化類從之妙，其理","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2167","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505750007070747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2168","lineNum":2000,"lineType":1,"content":"亦不可不知。如甲乙、庚辛、壬癸，此三行者可以為金，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2169","lineNum":2001,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁、戊己不與焉。庚辛元金，固為本家之物，壬癸非金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2170","lineNum":2002,"lineType":1,"content":"也，又胡為金？以金水相生之理，而水亦可以為金，故世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2171","lineNum":2003,"lineType":1,"content":"有水碧金明之物。甲乙之木其質堅强，世有木化為石","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2172","lineNum":2004,"lineType":1,"content":"者，可以例見。故此二者可以取象為金，與本家之物同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2173","lineNum":2005,"lineType":1,"content":"也。丙丁屬火，燥剛不同，戊己屬土，柔剛不同，與金相反，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2174","lineNum":2006,"lineType":1,"content":"自不可以金論。戊己、庚辛、壬癸，此六干者可以為木，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2175","lineNum":2007,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙丙丁不預焉。以丙丁元火所以焚木，自不可取，甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2176","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505767547666486"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2177","lineNum":2010,"lineType":1,"content":"乙原木，胡不取之？殊不知五行中金還金，水還水，火還","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2178","lineNum":2011,"lineType":1,"content":"火，土還土，獨木則變，以木資火，水土之性假合而生，脉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2179","lineNum":2012,"lineType":1,"content":"絶而枯槁，則還水也。灼之為火，則還火也。腐之為土，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2180","lineNum":2013,"lineType":1,"content":"還土也。故不用木，所以脱體而化神也。六甲輪環所值","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2181","lineNum":2014,"lineType":1,"content":"之數，五行錯綜所得之理，自可以黙識矣。凡木皆水所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2182","lineNum":2015,"lineType":1,"content":"生，其津液即水也，故壬癸可以為木。庚辛之質其堅與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2183","lineNum":2016,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙同，故甲乙可以為金，而庚辛可以為木，互換交通，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2184","lineNum":2017,"lineType":1,"content":"其理亦無二也。丙丁、甲乙、壬癸，取象為水，以壬癸原水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2185","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505764867424307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2186","lineNum":2020,"lineType":1,"content":"也，丙丁其化也，甲乙之津液即水也。戊己之土所以尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2187","lineNum":2021,"lineType":1,"content":"水，庚辛之金所以燥水，氣有異也，自不可以水論。甲乙、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2188","lineNum":2022,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁、戊己，取象為火，以丙丁原火也，戊己其化也，甲乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2189","lineNum":2023,"lineType":1,"content":"之生燃即火也。壬癸之水所以尅火，庚辛之金所以燥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2190","lineNum":2024,"lineType":1,"content":"火，類不同也，自不可以火論。丙丁、戊己、庚辛，納音屬土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2191","lineNum":2025,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己原土也。丙丁之火化而為灰，灰即土也。庚辛之金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2192","lineNum":2026,"lineType":1,"content":" marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2219","lineNum":2050,"lineType":1,"content":"，以其顛倒陰陽，反易水火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2220","lineNum":2051,"lineType":1,"content":"太和。周視作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2221","lineNum":2051,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽定論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_163","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2222","lineNum":2051,"lineType":1,"content":"，乃深闢之。西蜀羅青霄作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2223","lineNum":2051,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_164","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2224","lineNum":2052,"lineType":1,"content":"辨疑","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_164","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2225","lineNum":2052,"lineType":1,"content":"，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2226","lineNum":2052,"lineType":1,"content":"洪範","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_165","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2227","lineNum":2052,"lineType":1,"content":"五行出自八卦，斷不可不用，又闢周氏之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2228","lineNum":2053,"lineType":1,"content":"見為誣。噫！何前後無定説也耶？余見納音五行，即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2229","lineNum":2053,"lineType":1,"content":"洪範","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_166","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2230","lineNum":2054,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之義，不可
