ginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2244","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505786677624844"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2245","lineNum":2070,"lineType":1,"content":"重之為六十四，周公作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2246","lineNum":2070,"lineType":1,"content":"爻辭","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_168","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2247","lineNum":2070,"lineType":1,"content":"，孔子作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2248","lineNum":2070,"lineType":1,"content":"繫辭","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_169","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2249","lineNum":2070,"lineType":1,"content":"，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2250","lineNum":2070,"lineType":1,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_170","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2251","lineNum":2070,"lineType":1,"content":"更四聖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2252","lineNum":2071,"lineType":1,"content":"而後成，謂之經。目五行家為九流，其亦不思甚矣。豈以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2253","lineNum":2072,"lineType":1,"content":"五行家專論生旺而昧正理，委天命而棄人事，與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2254","lineNum":2072,"lineType":1,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_171","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2255","lineNum":2072,"lineType":1,"content":"道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2256","lineNum":2073,"lineType":1,"content":"不合耶？嗚呼！干支出自上古，甲子本之羲皇，音象傳自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2257","lineNum":2074,"lineType":1,"content":"黃帝，是數聖人也，豈在文王、周公、孔子後耶？若天地開","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2258","lineNum":2075,"lineType":1,"content":"闢，而干支之名不立，則不能錯綜為甲子。無六十甲子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2259","lineNum":2076,"lineType":1,"content":"則不能錯綜五行，何以紀厯成歲？而一年有三百六十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2260","lineNum":2077,"lineType":1,"content":"日，歲有十二月，月有三十日，日有十二時，孰從而明之？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2261","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505782831710248"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2262","lineNum":2080,"lineType":1,"content":"孰從而知之？而舉世渾渾沌沌，如在洪濛之中，何以立","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2263","lineNum":2081,"lineType":1,"content":"兩間，叅三才，而成世界也耶？所以百姓日用而不知，終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2264","lineNum":2082,"lineType":1,"content":"身由之而不察者是矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2265","lineNum":2082,"lineType":1,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_172","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2266","lineNum":2082,"lineType":1,"content":"道雖微，不過因天地定位，山","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2267","lineNum":2083,"lineType":1,"content":"澤通氣，雷風相薄，水火不相射，取象以畫八卦，其理自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2268","lineNum":2084,"lineType":1,"content":"不出干支甲子之外，而別有所創置也。嗚呼！干支錯綜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2269","lineNum":2085,"lineType":1,"content":"而為六十八卦，錯綜而為六十四甲子，以數納音，以理","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2270","lineNum":2086,"lineType":1,"content":"取象，乃五行之正也，而八卦之體已備。八卦仰觀俯察，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2271","lineNum":2087,"lineType":1,"content":"遠取諸物，近取諸身，為六十四卦，三百八十四爻，亦一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2272","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505794474803241"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2273","lineNum":2090,"lineType":1,"content":"年之數也，而干支之用以行。干支本天地以為經，八卦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2274","lineNum":2091,"lineType":1,"content":"道陰陽以為緯。經緯錯綜，往來變化，而天地之蘊奥，鬼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2275","lineNum":2092,"lineType":1,"content":"神之情狀，人事之吉凶，盡在其中，而其義微矣。世之儒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2276","lineNum":2093,"lineType":1,"content":"者，又烏可鄙五行為九流哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"2277","lineNum":2094,"lineType":8,"content":"論五行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2278","lineNum":2095,"lineType":1,"content":"五行者，往來乎天地之間而不窮者也，是故謂之行。北","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2279","lineNum":2096,"lineType":1,"content":"方陰極而生寒，寒生水。南方陽極而生熱，熱生火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2280","lineNum":2096,"lineType":1,"content":"東方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2281","lineNum":2097,"lineType":1,"content":"陽散以泄而生風，風生木。西方陰止以收而生燥，燥生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2282","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505794474819625"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2283","lineNum":2100,"lineType":1,"content":"金。中央陰陽交而生濕，濕生土。其相生也，所以相維；其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2284","lineNum":2101,"lineType":1,"content":"相尅也，所以相制。此之謂有倫。火為太陽，性炎上。水為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2285","lineNum":2102,"lineType":1,"content":"太陰，性潤下。木為少陽，性騰上而無所止。金為少陰，性","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2286","lineNum":2103,"lineType":1,"content":"沈下而有所止。土無常性，視四時所乘，欲使相濟得所，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2287","lineNum":2104,"lineType":1,"content":"勿令太過弗及。夫五行之性，各致其用。水者其性智，火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2288","lineNum":2105,"lineType":1,"content":"者其性禮，木者其性仁，金者其性義。惟土主信，重厚寛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2289","lineNum":2106,"lineType":1,"content":"博，無所不容。以之水，則水附之而行；以之木，則木托之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2290","lineNum":2107,"lineType":1,"content":"而生。金不得土，則無自出，火不得土，則無自歸。必損實","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505794474836009"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2292","lineNum":2110,"lineType":1,"content":"以為通，致虛以為明，故五行皆賴土也。推其形色，則水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2293","lineNum":2111,"lineType":1,"content":"黑、火赤、木青、金白、土黃，此正色也。及其變易則不然，常","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2294","lineNum":2112,"lineType":1,"content":"以生旺從正色，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2295","lineNum":2112,"lineType":2,"content":"當生旺則正氣全，可見正色。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2296","lineNum":2112,"lineType":1,"content":"死絶從母色，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2297","lineNum":2112,"lineType":2,"content":"水者，木之母，死絶則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2298","lineNum":2113,"lineType":2,"content":"黑。木者火之母，死絶則青。火者土之母，死絶則赤。土者金之母，死絕則黃。夫五行死絕，則氣歸根，見母之色。凡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2299","lineNum":2114,"lineType":2,"content":"人遇苦楚而呻吟母者，乃其義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2300","lineNum":2114,"lineType":1,"content":"成形冠帶從妻色，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2301","lineNum":2114,"lineType":2,"content":"少壯之年，及衰老之際，仰妻之時也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2302","lineNum":2115,"lineType":1,"content":"病敗從鬼色，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2303","lineNum":2115,"lineType":2,"content":"病敗之地，是鬼旺之鄉，受尅則氣歸鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2304","lineNum":2115,"lineType":1,"content":"旺墓從子色。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2305","lineNum":2115,"lineType":2,"content":"旺為傳，墓為斂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2306","lineNum":2116,"lineType":2,"content":"藏，故色在於子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2307","lineNum":2116,"lineType":1,"content":"其數則水一、火二、木三、金四、土五。生旺加倍，死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2308","lineNum":2117,"lineType":1,"content":"絶减半，以義推之。夫萬物負陰而抱陽，冲氣以為和，過","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2309","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505765190352948"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2310","lineNum":2120,"lineType":1,"content":"與不及，皆為乖道。故高者抑之使平，下者舉之使崇，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2311","lineNum":2121,"lineType":1,"content":"益其不及，或損其太過，所以貴在折衷，歸於中道，使無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2312","lineNum":2122,"lineType":1,"content":"有餘不足之累，即財官印食、貴人驛馬之微意也。行運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2313","lineNum":2123,"lineType":1,"content":"亦如之。識其微意，則於命之説，思過半矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2314","lineNum":2124,"lineType":1,"content":"金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2315","lineNum":2124,"lineType":2,"content":"喜木象，土生，空亡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2316","lineNum":2125,"lineType":2,"content":"煅煉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2317","lineNum":2126,"lineType":2,"content":"忌木旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2318","lineNum":2127,"lineType":2,"content":"火旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2319","lineNum":2128,"lineType":2,"content":"墓敗等火。水寒，金銷刑煞尅害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2320","lineNum":2129,"lineType":1,"content":"金以至陰為體，中含至陽之精，乃能堅剛，獨異衆物。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2321","lineNum":2130,"lineType":1,"content":"獨陰而不堅，冰雪是也，遇陽則消矣。故金不煉不成器，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2322","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505764867457075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2323","lineNum":2133,"lineType":1,"content":"聚金無火，難成脱朴之名。金重火輕，執事繁難。金輕火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2324","lineNum":2134,"lineType":1,"content":"重，煆煉消亡。金極火盛，為格最精。金火全名鑄印，犯丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2325","lineNum":2135,"lineType":1,"content":"字即為損模。金火多名乘軒，遇死衰反為不利。大火煉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2326","lineNum":2136,"lineType":1,"content":"金，幸功名而退速。純金凑水，遇富顯以贏餘。金能生水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2327","lineNum":2137,"lineType":1,"content":"水旺則金沈。土能生金，金貴則土賤。金無水乾枯，水重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2328","lineNum":2138,"lineType":1,"content":"則沈淪無用。金無土死絶，土重則埋沒不顯。兩金兩火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2329","lineNum":2139,"lineType":1,"content":"最上，兩金兩木財足。一金生三水，虛弱難勝；一金得三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2330","lineNum":2140,"lineType":1,"content":"木，頑鈍自損。金成則火滅，故金未成器，欲得見火；金已","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2331","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505794474868777"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2332","lineNum":2143,"lineType":1,"content":"成器，不欲見火。金到申酉巳丑，亦可謂之成也。運喜西","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2333","lineNum":2144,"lineType":1,"content":"北，不利南方，生於春月，餘寒未盡，貴乎火氣為榮。性柔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2334","lineNum":2145,"lineType":1,"content":"體弱，欲得厚土輔助。水盛增寒，難施鋒鋭之勢，木旺損","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2335","lineNum":2146,"lineType":1,"content":"力，反招剉鈍之危。金來比助，扶持最喜，比而無火，失類","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2336","lineNum":2147,"lineType":1,"content":"非良。夏月之金，性尚在柔，形未執方，尤嫌死絶。火多而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2337","lineNum":2148,"lineType":1,"content":"却為不厭，水盛而滋體呈祥，見木而助鬼傷身，遇金而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2338","lineNum":2149,"lineType":1,"content":"扶持精壯。土薄而最為有用，土厚而埋沒無光。秋月之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2339","lineNum":2150,"lineType":1,"content":"金，當權得令，火來煉煅，遂成鍾鼎之材，土多培養，反為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2340","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505802204938280"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2341","lineNum":2153,"lineType":1,"content":"頑濁之氣。見水則精神越秀，逢木則琢削施威。金助愈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2342","lineNum":2154,"lineType":1,"content":"剛，剛過必缺，氣重愈旺，旺極則害。冬月之金，形寒性冷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2343","lineNum":2155,"lineType":1,"content":"木多則難施琢削之功，水盛而未免沈潛之患。土能制","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2344","lineNum":2156,"lineType":1,"content":"水，金體不寒，火來取土，子母成功。喜比肩聚氣相扶，欲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2345","lineNum":2157,"lineType":1,"content":"官印溫養為利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2346","lineNum":2158,"lineType":1,"content":"木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2347","lineNum":2158,"lineType":2,"content":"喜琢削，生扶、助火、上培。生旺地靣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2348","lineNum":2159,"lineType":2,"content":"有黨成林。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2349","lineNum":2160,"lineType":2,"content":"忌空折、飄落、空亡、動搖、死絶、枯槁、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2350","lineNum":2161,"lineType":2,"content":"自焚、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2351","lineNum":2162,"lineType":2,"content":"耗泄、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2352","lineNum":2163,"lineType":2,"content":"濕爛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2353","lineNum":2164,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2354","lineNum":2165,"lineType":1,"content":"木性騰上而無所止。氣重則欲金任使。木有金，則有惟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2355","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505765559386147"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2356","lineNum":2168,"lineType":1,"content":"高惟斂之德，仍愛土重，則根蟠深固，土少則有枝茂根","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2357","lineNum":2169,"lineType":1,"content":"危之患。木賴水生，少則滋潤，多則漂流。甲戌乙亥木之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2358","lineNum":2170,"lineType":1,"content":"源，甲寅乙卯木之鄉。甲辰乙巳木之生，皆活木也。甲申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2359","lineNum":2171,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉木受尅，甲午乙未木自死，甲子乙丑金尅木，皆死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2360","lineNum":2172,"lineType":1,"content":"木也。生木欲火而秀，丙丁亦然；死木得金而造，庚辛必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2361","lineNum":2173,"lineType":1,"content":"利。生木見金自傷，死木得火自焚。無風即止，其勢亂也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2362","lineNum":2174,"lineType":1,"content":"遇水返化其源，其勢盡也。金木相等，格謂斲輪，若向秋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2363","lineNum":2175,"lineType":1,"content":"生，反為傷斧，是秋生忌金重也。陰木重火，舌辨能言，生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2364","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505781933834278"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2365","lineNum":2178,"lineType":1,"content":"於春月，餘寒猶有，喜火溫燠，別無盤屈之拘，藉水資扶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2366","lineNum":2179,"lineType":1,"content":"而有舒暢之美。春初不宜水盛，陰濃則根損枝枯；春末","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2367","lineNum":2180,"lineType":1,"content":"陽氣煩燥，無水則葉摘根乾。是以木火二物，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2368","lineNum":2180,"lineType":1,"content":"旣濟","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_173","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2369","lineNum":2180,"lineType":1,"content":"方佳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2370","lineNum":2181,"lineType":1,"content":"土多而損力，土薄則財豐，忌逢金重，傷殘尅伐，一生不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2371","lineNum":2182,"lineType":1,"content":"閑。設使木旺，得金為良，終身獲福。夏月之木，根乾葉燥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2372","lineNum":2183,"lineType":1,"content":"盤而且直，屈而已伸，欲其水盛，而成滋潤之力，誠不可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2373","lineNum":2184,"lineType":1,"content":"少；忌其火旺，而招焚化之憂，故獨為凶。喜土在薄，不宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2374","lineNum":2185,"lineType":1,"content":"重厚，厚則反為災咎；惡金在多，不可欠缺，缺則不能琢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2375","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505800577777691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2376","lineNum":2188,"lineType":1,"content":"削。重重見木，徒以成林；疊疊逢華，終無結果。秋月之木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2377","lineNum":2189,"lineType":1,"content":"氣漸凄凉，形漸凋敗。初秋之時，火氣未除，猶喜水土以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2378","lineNum":2190,"lineType":1,"content":"相滋；中秋之令，果已成實，欲得剛金而修削。霜降後不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2379","lineNum":2191,"lineType":1,"content":"宜水盛，水盛則木漂。寒露節又喜火炎，火炎則木實。木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2380","lineNum":2192,"lineType":1,"content":"多有多材之美，土厚無己任之才。冬月之木，盤屈在地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2381","lineNum":2193,"lineType":1,"content":"欲土多而培養，惡水盛而亡形，金縱多不能尅伐，火重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2382","lineNum":2194,"lineType":1,"content":"見溫燠成功，歸根復命之時，木病安能輔助。惟忌死絶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2383","lineNum":2195,"lineType":1,"content":"只宜生旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2384","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505802204954664"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2385","lineNum":2198,"lineType":1,"content":"水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2386","lineNum":2198,"lineType":2,"content":"喜清潔，寛遠，相生，火濟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2387","lineNum":2199,"lineType":2,"content":"，潤下，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2388","lineNum":2200,"lineType":2,"content":"西北。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2389","lineNum":2201,"lineType":2,"content":"忌空亡、泛濫、尅害、木多、氣寒、枯涸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2390","lineNum":2202,"lineType":2,"content":"、死絶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2391","lineNum":2203,"lineType":2,"content":"焦燥等土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2392","lineNum":2204,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2393","lineNum":2205,"lineType":1,"content":"天傾西北，亥為出水之方；地陷東南，辰為納水之府。逆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2394","lineNum":2206,"lineType":1,"content":"流到申而作聲，故水不西流。水之性潤下，順則有容，順","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2395","lineNum":2207,"lineType":1,"content":"行十二辰，順也，主有度量，有吉神扶助，乃貴格逆則有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2396","lineNum":2208,"lineType":1,"content":"聲，逆行十二辰，逆也，入格者主清貴有聲譽。忌刑衝則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2397","lineNum":2209,"lineType":1,"content":"橫流，愛自死自絶則吉。水不絶源，仗金生而流遠；水流","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2398","lineNum":2210,"lineType":1,"content":"泛濫，賴土尅以隄防。水火均則合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2399","lineNum":2210,"lineType":1,"content":"旣濟","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_174","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2400","lineNum":2210,"lineType":1,"content":"之美，水土混則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2401","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505768780578870"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2402","lineNum":2213,"lineType":1,"content":"有濁源之凶。四時皆忌火多則水受渴，忌見土重則水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2403","lineNum":2214,"lineType":1,"content":"不流；忌見金死，金死則水囚；忌見木旺，木旺則水死。沈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2404","lineNum":2215,"lineType":1,"content":"芝云：水命動搖，多主濁濫，陰人尤忌之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2405","lineNum":2215,"lineType":1,"content":"口訣","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_175","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2406","lineNum":2215,"lineType":1,"content":"云：陽水身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2407","lineNum":2216,"lineType":1,"content":"弱窮，陰水身弱貴。生於春月，性濫滔淫，再逢水助，必有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2408","lineNum":2217,"lineType":1,"content":"崩堤之勢，若加土盛，則無泛漲之憂。喜金生扶，不宜金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2409","lineNum":2218,"lineType":1,"content":"盛，欲火旣濟，不要火多，見木而可以施功，無土而仍愁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2410","lineNum":2219,"lineType":1,"content":"散漫。夏月之水，執性歸源，時當涸際，欲得比肩，喜金生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2411","lineNum":2220,"lineType":1,"content":"而助體，忌火旺而太炎，木盛則耗盜其氣，土旺則尅制","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2412","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505764867489843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2413","lineNum":2223,"lineType":1,"content":"其流。秋月之水，母旺水相，裏瑩表光，得金助則能清澄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2414","lineNum":2224,"lineType":1,"content":"逢土旺則嫌混濁。火多而財盛，太過不宜，木重而妻榮，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2415","lineNum":2225,"lineType":1,"content":"中和為利。重重見水，增其泛濫之憂；疊疊逢土，始得清","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2416","lineNum":2226,"lineType":1,"content":"平之意。冬月之水，司令專權。遇火則增煖除寒，見土則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2417","lineNum":2227,"lineType":1,"content":"形藏歸化。金多反曰無義，木盛是謂有情，土太過尅制。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2418","lineNum":2228,"lineType":1,"content":"水死，水泛漲，喜土為堤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2419","lineNum":2229,"lineType":1,"content":"火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2420","lineNum":2229,"lineType":2,"content":"喜和煖、生助、空亡、炎上、高遠、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2421","lineNum":2230,"lineType":2,"content":"土照、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2422","lineNum":2231,"lineType":2,"content":"水濟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2423","lineNum":2233,"lineType":2,"content":"忌局促、急燥、清冷、水重、木枯、雜黨、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2424","lineNum":2234,"lineType":2,"content":"木敗，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2425","lineNum":2235,"lineType":2,"content":"死水之木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2426","lineNum":2236,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2427","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505800577810459"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2428","lineNum":2239,"lineType":1,"content":"炎炎真火，位鎮南方，故火無不明之理。輝光不久，全要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2429","lineNum":2240,"lineType":1,"content":"伏藏，故明無不滅之象。火以木為體，無木則火不長焰；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2430","lineNum":2241,"lineType":1,"content":"火以水為用，無水則火太酷烈。故火多則不實，太烈則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2431","lineNum":2242,"lineType":1,"content":"傷物。木能藏火，到寅卯而方生；火不利西，遇申酉而必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2432","lineNum":2243,"lineType":1,"content":"死。生居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2433","lineNum":2243,"lineType":1,"content":"離","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_176","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2434","lineNum":2243,"lineType":1,"content":"位，果斷有為；若居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2435","lineNum":2243,"lineType":1,"content":"坎","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_177","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2436","lineNum":2243,"lineType":1,"content":"宮，謹畏守禮。金得火和，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2437","lineNum":2244,"lineType":1,"content":"則能鎔鑄。水得火和，則成旣濟。遇土不明，多主蹇塞。逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2438","lineNum":2245,"lineType":1,"content":"水旺處，决定為榮；木死火虛，難得永久。縱早功名，必不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2439","lineNum":2246,"lineType":1,"content":"久長。春忌見木，惡其焚也；夏忌見土，惡其暗也。秋忌見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2440","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505786677657612"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2441","lineNum":2249,"lineType":1,"content":"金，金旺難尅制。冬忌見水，水旺則滅形。故春火欲明不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2442","lineNum":2250,"lineType":1,"content":"欲炎，炎則不實。秋火欲藏不欲明，明則燥；冬火欲生不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2443","lineNum":2251,"lineType":1,"content":"欲殺，殺則暗。生於春月，母旺子相，勢力並行，喜木生扶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2444","lineNum":2252,"lineType":1,"content":"不宜過旺，旺則火炎。欲水旣濟，不愁興盛，盛則沾恩。土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2445","lineNum":2253,"lineType":1,"content":"多則蹇塞埋光，火盛則傷多爆燥。見金可以施功，縱重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2446","lineNum":2254,"lineType":1,"content":"疊妻財猶遂。夏月之火，勢力行權，逢水制，則免自焚之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2447","lineNum":2255,"lineType":1,"content":"咎；見木助必招夭折之患。遇金必作良工，得土遂成稼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2448","lineNum":2256,"lineType":1,"content":"穡。金土雖為美利，無水則金燥土焦，再加火助，太過傾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2449","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505800577794075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2450","lineNum":2259,"lineType":1,"content":"危。秋月之火，性息體休，得木生，則有復明之慶；遇水尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2451","lineNum":2260,"lineType":1,"content":"難逃隕滅之災。土重而掩息其光，金多而損傷其勢。火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2452","lineNum":2261,"lineType":1,"content":"見火以光輝，縱疊見而轉利。冬月之火，體絕形亡，喜木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2453","lineNum":2262,"lineType":1,"content":"生而有救，遇水尅以為殃。欲土制為榮，愛火比為利，見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2454","lineNum":2263,"lineType":1,"content":"金而難任為財，無金而不遭妻害。天地雖傾，水火難滅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2455","lineNum":2264,"lineType":1,"content":"土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2456","lineNum":2264,"lineType":2,"content":"喜生扶、堅厚、疏通、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2457","lineNum":2265,"lineType":2,"content":"生金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2458","lineNum":2266,"lineType":2,"content":"忌崩頽、木重、水多、空亡、氣寒、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2459","lineNum":2267,"lineType":2,"content":"金重、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2460","lineNum":2268,"lineType":2,"content":"虛淺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2461","lineNum":2269,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2462","lineNum":2270,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之土，散在四維，故金木水火，依而成象，是四時皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2463","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505765190369332"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2464","lineNum":2273,"lineType":1,"content":"有用，所忌者，火死酉也；水旺子也。蓋土賴火印，火死則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2465","lineNum":2274,"lineType":1,"content":"土囚；土喜水財，水旺則土虛。土得金火，方成大器；土高","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2466","lineNum":2275,"lineType":1,"content":"無貴，空惹灰塵，土聚則滯，土散則輕。辰戌丑未，土之正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2467","lineNum":2276,"lineType":1,"content":"位，分陰分陽，土則不同。辰有伏水，未有匿木，滋養萬物，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2468","lineNum":2277,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏為功。戌有藏火，丑有隱金，秋火冬金，肅殺萬物。故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2469","lineNum":2278,"lineType":1,"content":"土聚辰未為貴，聚戌丑不為貴，是土愛辰未而不愛丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2470","lineNum":2279,"lineType":1,"content":"戌也明矣。若更五行有氣，人命逢之，田產無比，晚年富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2471","lineNum":2280,"lineType":1,"content":"貴悠悠。若土太實，無水則不和柔，無木則不疏通，上見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2472","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505802204971048"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2473","lineNum":2283,"lineType":1,"content":"火則焦，女命多不生長。土旺四季，惟戌土困弱。戌多為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2474","lineNum":2284,"lineType":1,"content":"人好鬭，多瞌睡，辰未人好食，丑人清省。丑有艮土，有癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2475","lineNum":2285,"lineType":1,"content":"水，能潤而膏，人命遇此，主能卓立。生於春月，其勢虛弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2476","lineNum":2286,"lineType":1,"content":"喜火生扶，惡木太過，忌水泛濫，欲喜比助，得金而制木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2477","lineNum":2287,"lineType":1,"content":"為祥，金若多，仍盜土氣。夏月之土，其勢燥烈，得盛水滋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2478","lineNum":2288,"lineType":1,"content":"潤成功，忌旺火煅煉焦赤，木助火炎，生尅無良，金生水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2479","lineNum":2289,"lineType":1,"content":"泛，妻財有益，見比肩蹇滯不通。如太過，又喜木襲。秋月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2480","lineNum":2290,"lineType":1,"content":"之土，子旺母衰，金多而耗盜其氣，木盛而制伏純良，火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2481","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505768780595254"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2482","lineNum":2293,"lineType":1,"content":"重重而不厭，水泛泛而非祥，得比肩則能助力，至霜降","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2483","lineNum":2294,"lineType":1,"content":"不比無妨。冬月之土，外寒内溫，水旺財豐，金多子秀，火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2484","lineNum":2295,"lineType":1,"content":"盛有榮，木多無咎，再加土助尤佳，惟喜身强足壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2485","lineNum":2296,"lineType":1,"content":"徐大升曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2486","lineNum":2296,"lineType":1,"content":"金賴土生，土多金埋；土賴火生，火多土焦；火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2487","lineNum":2297,"lineType":1,"content":"賴木生，木多火熾；木賴水生，水多木漂；水賴金生，金多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2488","lineNum":2298,"lineType":1,"content":"水濁。金能生水，水多金沈；水能生木，木盛水縮；木能生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2489","lineNum":2299,"lineType":1,"content":"火，火多木焚；火能生土，土多火晦；土能生金，金多土變。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2490","lineNum":2300,"lineType":1,"content":"金能尅木，木堅金缺；木能尅土，土重木折；土能尅水，水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2491","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505794474885161"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2492","lineNum":2303,"lineType":1,"content":"多土流。水能尅火，火炎水熱。火能尅金，金多火熄。金衰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2493","lineNum":2304,"lineType":1,"content":"遇火，必見銷鎔；火弱逢水，必為熄滅。水弱逢土，必為淤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2494","lineNum":2305,"lineType":1,"content":"塞。土衰遇木，必遭傾陷。木弱逢金，必為砍折。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2495","lineNum":2305,"lineType":1,"content":"强金得水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2496","lineNum":2306,"lineType":1,"content":"方挫其鋒，强水得木，方泄其勢，强木得火，方化其頑。强","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2497","lineNum":2307,"lineType":1,"content":"火得土，方止其焰，强土得金，方制其害。斯言簡而盡也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2498","lineNum":2308,"lineType":1,"content":"三命通㑹","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00002_0_178","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2499","lineNum":2308,"lineType":1,"content":"卷一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"古者庖羲氏之王天下也，則河圖以作八卦，故序乾、坤、","logicSentenceId":"7634120659307937811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"坎、離、震、巽、艮、兊之名，設天、地、日、月、風、雷、山、澤之象。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659307937811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"繫辭","logicSentenceId":"7634120659307954195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：天地定位，山澤通氣，風雷相薄，水火不相射，八卦相","logicSentenceId":"7634120659307954195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"錯。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659307954195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦成列，而二十四位同行乎其中。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659307970579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"迨夫以陰陽消","logicSentenceId":"7634120659307986963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505794474999849"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"息驗之，八卦之變，甲本屬木，納卦於乾，乾與坤交，以坤","logicSentenceId":"7634120659307986963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"之上下二爻交換，乾之上下二爻化成坎象，甲隨坎化","logicSentenceId":"7634120659307986963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"故屬水也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659307986963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"乙夲屬木，納卦於坤，坤與乾對，以乾之中爻","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308003347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"交換，坤之中爻化成離象，乙受離化故屬火也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308003347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"丙夲屬","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308019731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"火，納卦於艮，艮與兊對，以兌之下爻交換，艮之下爻化","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308019731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"成離象，丙受離化故屬火也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308019731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"丁夲屬火，納卦於兌，兌與","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308036115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"艮對，以艮之上爻交換，兌之上爻化成乾象，丁受乾化","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308036115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"故屬金也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308036115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"庚夲屬金，納卦於震，震與巽對，以巽之下爻","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308052499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505786677755916"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"交換，震之下爻化成坤象，庚受坤化故屬土也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308052499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"辛夲屬","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308068883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"金，納卦於巽，巽與震對，以震之上爻交換，巽之上爻化","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308068883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"成坎象，辛受坎化故屬水也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308068883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"壬夲屬水，納卦於離，離與","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308085267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"坎對，以坎之中爻交換，離之中爻化成乾象，壬受乾化，","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308085267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"夲當屬金，納於離火，火㷔金銷，不能退立，而自附於離","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308085267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"火立焉，故屬火也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308085267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"癸本屬水，納卦於坎，坎與離對，以離","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308101651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"之中爻交換坎之中爻，化成坤象，癸受坤化，故屬土也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308101651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"此八干納卦之變，如乾坤上下二爻交者，取象於否泰","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308118035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505765190402100"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"之義，故曰天地定位。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308118035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"震艮以上爻交於巽兌，巽兌以下","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308134419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"爻交於震艮者，取象於咸恒損益之義，故曰雷風相薄，","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308134419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"山澤通氣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308134419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"離以中爻交於乾坤，乾坤以下爻交於坎離，","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308150803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"取象於旣濟未濟，故曰水火不相射是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308150803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦有變不","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308167187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"變，乾坤夲乎金土而不變者，乃陰陽之祖宗，衆卦之父","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308167187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"母也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308167187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"退身於休明之地，老亢而不變也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308183571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"故坎離震兌位","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308199955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"乎四正，金木水火而不變者，以子午卯酉四位各專四","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308199955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"旺之地，宣布四時之令，而氣化行焉，故不變也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308199955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"艮巽用","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308216339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505802205003816"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"變者，艮土易位於坎震東北之界，處身於衰丑病寅之","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308216339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"間，思於更相代立，自然成山而化木也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308216339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"巽夲易位於震","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308232723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"離東南之界，立身於衰辰病巳之間，不能自立，反歸於","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308232723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"水。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308232723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"辰為墓地，並與辰皆水也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308249107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"亥本屬水，因金以生，乘代金，","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308265491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"金立，故亥屬金也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308265491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"寅夲屬水，因水以生，乘代水立，故寅","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308281875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"屬水也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308281875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"巳夲屬火，因木以生，乘震之衰，代震之立，故已","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308298259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"屬木也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308298259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"申夲屬金，水生於申，金助水勢，故申屬水也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308314643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"辰","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308331027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"戌丑未，五方五土之神，分爲四季，作造化甄陶之主，爲","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308331027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505794475016233"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"厚載之質，夲不可變，因土以生。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308331027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"木附於土，奪土一半爲","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308347411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"水，水動土靜。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308347411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":93," {"lines":[{"lineId":"95","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"或問：十干有陰陽、剛柔、生死之分，其說然否？","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308544019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：十干","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308560403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"五陽五陰，陽者爲剛，陰者爲柔。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308560403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰分陰分陽，迭用柔","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308576787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"剛是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308576787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"其生死之分，如母生子，子成而母老死，理之自","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308593171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505781933899814"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"然。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308593171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"賦曰陽生陰死，陽死陰生，循環逆順，變化見矣是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308609555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"甲木乃十干之首，主宰四時，生育萬物，在天爲雷爲龍，","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308625939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"在地爲梁爲棟，謂之陽木。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308625939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"其禄到寅，寅爲離上之水，","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308642323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"其根巳斷，其枝已絶，謂之死木。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308642323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"死木者，剛木也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308658707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"湏仗","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308675091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"斧斤斵削，方成其噐，長生於亥，亥爲河潭池沼之水，","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308675091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"名曰死水。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308675091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"故死木放死水中，雖浸年久，不能朽壞。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308691475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"譬","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308707859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"如杪椿之木，在於水中，則能堅固。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308707859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"若離水至岸而遇","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308724243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"癸水，癸水者，活水也，爲天地間雨露，日晒雨淋，乾濕","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308724243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505791983386675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"不調，遂成枯朽，則能生火，火旺而木必焚矣，故有灰","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308724243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"飛烟滅之患。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308724243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"且午屬離火，火頼木生，木爲火母，火爲","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308740627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"木子，子旺母衰，焉有不終之理？","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308740627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"故甲木死於午。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308757011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"經云","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308773395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"木不南奔，正謂此也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308773395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：甲乃陽剛蠢木，原無根葉","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308789779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"枝荄，若成器得用，必藉乎金；宻藏不壞，必頼乎水。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308789779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"火","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308806163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"初得配，遂成文明之象。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308806163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"使火過多，𠔥遇南方，化成灰","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308822547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"炭，反致其害矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308822547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"葢甲木不以春秋而爲榮悴，觸物變","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308838931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"化，亦無定形，須看火金水何如，又看化合何如，不可","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308838931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505786677788684"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"執一論。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308838931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"135","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"乙木繼甲之後，發育萬物，生生不已，在天爲風，在地爲","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308855315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"樹，謂之陰木。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308855315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"其禄到邜，邜爲樹木，根深枝茂，謂之活","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308871699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"木。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308871699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"活木者，柔木也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308888083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"懼陽金斫伐爲患，畏秋至木落凋","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308904467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"零，欲潤土而培其根荄，利活水而滋其枝葉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308904467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"活水者，","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308920851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"癸水也，卽天之雨露，地之泉源。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308920851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"潤土者，巳土也，如耕","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308937235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"耨之土，成稼穡之功。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308937235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"已禄在午，午乃六陽消盡，一隂","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308953619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"復生，故稻花開於午時，乙木生於午地。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308953619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"十月建亥，亥","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308970003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505791983403059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"乃純陰司令，壬禄到亥當權，死水泛濫，土薄根虚，有","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308970003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"失培養，故乙木死於亥。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308970003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：水泛木浮，正此謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659308986387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309002771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：乙乃枝葉繁華之木，大喜陽和，煦則發榮，不利陰","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309002771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"冷，惨刻則耗枯。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309002771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"水多則傾頺其根荄，金旺則𢦤剥其","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309019155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"生意。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309019155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"如身衰火多，兼行南方，而禍尤深。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309035539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"葢活木連根","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309051923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"之本也，豈棟梁之比哉？","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309051923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"丙火麗乎中天，普照六合，在天為日為電，在地為爐為","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309068307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"冶，謂之陽火。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309068307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"其禄在已，已為爐冶之火，謂之死火。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309084691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"死","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309101075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505786677739532"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"火者，剛火也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309101075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"喜死木發生其熖，惡金土掩息其光。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309117459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"死","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309133843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"木者，甲木也，甲禄在寅，寅乃陽木之垣，木盛火生，隠","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309133843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"於木石之間，非人用之，不能生發。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309133843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"故五陽皆出乎自","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309150227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"然，而爲先天；五陰皆係乎人事，而爲後天。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309150227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"丙火生於","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309166611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，其理甚明。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309166611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"如太陽之火，自東而升，至西而没。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309182995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"且酉","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309199379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"屬兌，兌為澤，巳土生金，金氣盛，掩息丙火之光，不能","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309199379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"顯輝，豈無晦乎？","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309199379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"故丙火生於寅，而死於酉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659309215763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"經云火無","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425034303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"西向，正此謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425034303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：丙火太陽之象，上下化光，無所","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425050687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505786677772300"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"不照。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425050687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"然不以浮水之木為母，不能生有熖之火，不以","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425067071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"濕水之土為子，陽火所不産也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425067071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"縱遇江湖死水，不合","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425083455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"不衝，則波濤弗致衝激，焉能為尅火之害？","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425083455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"其所忌者，","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425099839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"乃繁華之木，浥水不能生火，而反能晦火之光，如五","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425099839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"星太陽，以木炁為難之義。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425099839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"192","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"丁火繼丙之後，為萬物之精，文明之象，在天為列星，在","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425116223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"地為燈火，謂之陰火。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425116223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"其禄到午，乃六陰之首，內有乙","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425132607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"木，能生丁火。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425132607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"乙為活木，丁為活火。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425148991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"活火者，柔火也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425165375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"丁","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425181759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505781933883430"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"喜乙木而生，乃陰生隂也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425181759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"如世人用菜油、蔴油為燈","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425198143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"燭之義，夫油乃乙木之脂膏也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425198143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"至於酉時，四陰司權，","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425214527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"燈火則能煇煌，列星則能燦爛，故丁生於酉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425214527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"至於寅","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425230911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"地，三陽當合，陽火而生，陰火而退，如日東升，列星隠","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425230911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"耀，燈雖有熖，不顯其光，故丁生於酉，而死於寅也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425230911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"經","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425247295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"有云火明則滅，正謂此也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425247295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：丁火陰柔，要得時遇","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425263679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"局，方能輝光燦爛。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425263679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"雖頑鈍之金，亦在其所煆煉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425280063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"若失","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425296447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"時䘮局，卽韜光晦跡，而烟無存，雖㣲眇之金，亦不能","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425296447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505794474983465"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"制。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425296447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"然木燥雖少，猶足以發火之機；木濕雖多，亦難以","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425312831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"致火之明。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425312831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{ {"lines":[{"lineId":"284","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"庚金掌天地肅殺之權，主人間兵革之變，在天為風霜，","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425935423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"在地為金鐵，謂之陽金。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425935423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"其禄到申，申乃剛金，喜戊土","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425951807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505786677821452"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"而生，畏癸水而溺，長生於已。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425951807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"巳中戊土能生庚金，乃","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425968191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"陽生陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425968191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"巳為爐冶之火，煆煉庚金，遂成鍾鼎之器，","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425984575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"叩之有聲。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659425984575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇水土沉埋，則無聲也，所謂金實無聲。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426000959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"至於子地水旺之鄉，金寒水冷，子旺母衰，亦遭沉溺","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426017343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"之患，豈能復生？","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426017343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"故庚金生於巳而死於子。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426033727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"conte
