{"lines":[{"lineId":"312","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金繼庚之後，為五金之首，八石之元。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426164799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"在天為日月，乃","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426181183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"太陰之精。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426181183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"在地為金，金乃山石之礦，謂之陰金。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426197567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"其禄","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426213951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"到酉，酉中巳土能生辛金，乃陰生陰也，謂之柔金，為","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426213951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"太陰之精。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426213951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"至於中秋，金水相停，會合含光，圓融皎潔。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426230335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505811415629865"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"邵子有云八月十五翫蟾光是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426246719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"長生於子，子乃坎","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426263103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"水之垣，坎中一陽屬金，外有二陰屬土，土能生金，子","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426263103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"隠母胎，未顯其體，得子水蕩漾，淘去浮砂，方能出色，","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426263103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃水濟金輝，色光明瑩。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426263103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"至於巳地，巳為爐冶之火，","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426279487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"将辛金煆成死器，亦被巳中戊土埋没其形，不能變","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426279487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"化，豈得復生？","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426279487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"故辛金生於子而死於已也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426295871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"經云土重","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426312255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"金埋，正謂此也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426312255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：辛金濕潤，非頑鈍堅剛之物，使","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426328639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"遇火炎煆煉，性質反傷，安能成其美用？","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426328639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"只宜水土資","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426345023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505768780759094"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"扶，優柔浹洽，以潤其體。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426345023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"原火太繁，喜行西北，使去火","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426361407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"而存金。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426361407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"如金太寒，亦要丙丁，使和金而去冷。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426377791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"若坐禄","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426394175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"通根郎身旺之地，縱加厚土，亦不能汨没，所以非陽","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426394175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"金比也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426394175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"343","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"壬水喜陽土而為堤岸之助，畏陰木而為盗氣之憂。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426410559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"在","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426426943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"天為雲，在地為澤，謂之陽水。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426426943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"其禄在亥，亥為池沼存","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426443327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"留之水，謂之死水。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426443327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"死水者，剛水也，頼庚金而生。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426459711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"庚禄","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426476095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"到申，能生壬水，乃五行轉養之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426476095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"至於卯地，卯乃花","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426492479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505794475098153"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"菓樹木，木旺於卯，則能尅土，土虚則崩，故堤岸崩頺，","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426492479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"而壬水走泄，散漫四野，流而不返，又被陰木盗氣，豈","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426492479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"得存活？","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426492479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"故壬水生於申而死於卯也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426508863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"經云死水横流，","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426525247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"正謂此也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426525247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：壬水浩蕩有源之水，併百川而漫天","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426541631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"下，藉土為之隄防，若干支無土，必至漂流四溢，身衰","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426541631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"多遇火土，反見耗源塞流之吝。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426541631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"且壬愛南行，以未午","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426558015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"為胎養之地，財禄和煖之鄉，長生歸禄莫過申亥。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426558015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"盖","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426574399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"統宗㑹元之府，而水得其所歸故也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426574399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"若財多身弱，值","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426590783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505781933932582"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"此必能集福；身旺財輕，遇此反受其災，縱強壮少年","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426590783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"亦不能勝此也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426590783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"癸水繼壬之後，乃天干一週陰陽之氣成於終而反於","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426607167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"始之漸，故其為水，清濁以分，散諸四方，有潤下助土","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426607167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"之功，滋生萬物之徳。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426607167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"在天為雨露，在地為泉脉，謂之","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426623551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"陰水，其禄在子，子乃陰極陽生之地，辛生庚死之垣，","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426623551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"癸為活水。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426623551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"活水者，柔水也，喜陰金而生，畏陽金而滯，","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426639935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"欲隂木行其根，則能疎通陰土，陰土旣通於地脉，則","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426639935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505765190451252"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"能流暢。","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426639935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"二月建邜為花果樹木，木旺土虚，癸水方得","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426656319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"通逹，至於申地，三陰用事，否卦司權，天地不交，萬物","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426656319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"不通，申中坤土庚金遂成圍堰，使癸水不能流暢，困","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426656319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"於池沼，無所施設，豈再生物？","logicSentenceId":"7634120659426656319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"故癸水生於邜，而死於","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792189503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"申。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792189503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"經云水不西流，正謂此也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792205887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：癸水雨露陰澤之","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792222271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"潤也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792222271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"若根通亥子，則盈科集流以成江河，柱無坎坤，","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792238655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"失其生旺之夲，終為身弱。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792238655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"局有財官，雖我所用之物，","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792255039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"不可遇之太過。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792255039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"如申子辰全，則水歸聚一家，暗衝寅","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792271423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505802205102120"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"午戌火為用，反為上格。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792271423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"若明用寅午戌火，湏表裏不","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792287807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"弱，得之乃佳。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792287807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"或生於深夏，得用財官，不失其𠋣之宫，","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792304191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"主大富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792304191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"運道再行西北，不為太過之嫌。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792320575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"401","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"論曰：五行長生之埋，與萬物亦同。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792336959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"且如日之初出時，光","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792353343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"明可觀，至午離宫，光明愈甚。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792353343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"月之初出，巧若蛾眉，至望","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792369727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"光明圓潔。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792369727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"若人之生也，自少至壮，自老至死，常理也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792386111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"人","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792402495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"之初生也，嬰孩啼笑而巳，至壮賢愚方辨，萬物皆一同。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792402495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":465,"lineType":2,"content":"甲木生亥，亥令屬水，甲木居焉。木旺於春，至寅臨官歸禄，甲木得垣，至午則死。丙火生寅，寅令屬木，丙火居焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505765190467636"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":469,"lineType":2,"content":"火旺於夏，至巳臨官歸禄，丙火得垣，至酉則死。庚金生巳，巳申戊土，庚金居焉。金旺於秋，至申臨官歸禄，庚金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":471,"lineType":2,"content":"得垣，至子則死。壬水生申，申令屬金，壬水居焉。水旺於冬，至亥臨官歸禄，壬水得垣，至邜則死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"戊土生","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792418879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"於寅，寅中有火，戊土生焉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792418879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"三陽之時，土膏以動，萬物發","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792435263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"生，是戊生於寅也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792435263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"土旺於四季，火土有如母子相生，所","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792451647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"以戊隨丙，臨官歸禄於巳，巳臨丁，臨官歸禄於午。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792451647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"戊土","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792468031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"生於寅，巳土生於酉，明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792468031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"若以戊生申，巳生邜，何不以","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792484415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戊歸禄於亥，癸已歸禄於子？","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792484415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"後人妄作擬土歌，有戊","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792500799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"巳當絶在巳懐之句，以戊生申，酉沐浴，戌冠帶，陰陽間","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792500799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505819837759500"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"隔，謬戾甚矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792500799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：五行長生，有母而後有子，歸母成孕","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792517183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"之説也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792517183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"獨土一行分體用，厚徳載物，居中不用者，土之","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792533567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"體也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792533567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"散於四維，各旺四季，土之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792549951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"體生於巳，乗父之","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792566335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"之禄；用生於申，維父母之位。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792566335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"故水土生申，陰陽家之説；","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792582719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"土生於巳，醫家之説。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792582719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"考五星書，申為陰陽宫，故水土俱","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792599103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"生。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792599103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"申，坤位，水土原不相離，而土隨水源之説，亦為有理。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792615487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"四行有一生，獨土長生於寅，又生於申，一物而有兩生，","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792631871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"以坤艮土之方位，坤屬西南，土至此而得朋，故曰利亨。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792631871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505794475114537"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子曰：坤之厚重，積土成功，上生於此者然也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792648255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"復言","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792664639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"戊土生寅，寄禄於巳者，隨母得家之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792664639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"是以土無正","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792681023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"位，生物多方，又何疑矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792681023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"再考周視作隂陽定論，有云：乙","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792697407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"木生於午，癸水生於卯，辛金生於子，丁火生於酉，以為","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792697407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"陽死隂生，不知冬至即子水旺時，春分即乙木旺時，夏","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792697407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"至即丁火旺時，秋分即辛金旺時，而坎離巽兊即子午","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792697407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"卯酉之正位。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792697407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"位者，時之定在；時者，位之妙用，曷嘗逢生","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792713791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"於死絶哉？","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792713791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：果如所謂，則乙木何由生耶？","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792730175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"假云在亥，","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792746559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505819837775884"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"亥中止有甲，甲木何由生耶？","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792746559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"假云在卯，卯中止有乙。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792762943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"試","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792779327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"辨以火土金水之例，曰：隂陽相為一體。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792779327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"孔子曰：太極生","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792795711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"兩儀。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792795711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"周子曰：陽變隂合而生水火木金土。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792812095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"朱子曰：萬物","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792828479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"各具一太極。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792828479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"此三言者，皆五行之樞紐。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792844863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"即萬物各具一","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792861247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"太極之説，則木之為物，亦具一太極者，可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792861247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"即太極","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792877631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"生兩儀之説，則分甲乙，而甲為陽之動於先，乙為隂之","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792877631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"静於後，可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792877631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"即陽變隂合之説，則甲之為一變，而乙","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792894015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"之為一合，然後能生木者，又可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792894015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"非謂甲是一木，而","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792910399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505810090213410"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"乙又别為一木也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792910399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"夫甲乙相須而為一木，則甲固不必","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792926783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"旺於卯，而卯自不能不為乙以旺於後；乙亦不必生於","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792926783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，而亥自不能不為甲以生乎其先。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792926783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"推而至於丙丁相","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792943167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"須為火，戊已相須為土，庚辛相須為金，壬癸相須為水，","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792943167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"豈不了了然哉？","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792943167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"朱子曰：隂氣流行則為陽，陽氣凝聚則","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792959551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"為隂，非真有二物相對也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792959551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"蔡氏曰：東方寅卯木，辰土生","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792975935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"於亥；南方已午火，未土生於寅；西方申酉金，戌土生於","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792975935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"已；北方亥子水，丑土生於申。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792975935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：金木水火土各有一","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792992319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505802754457638"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"隂一陽，如甲便是木之陽，乙便是木之隂。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727792992319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"乙以質言，甲","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793008703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"以氣言。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793008703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"隂主翕，凡聚斂成就者，乙為之也；陽主闢，凡發","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793025087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"暢揮散者，甲為之也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793025087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"觀此亦見甲不必主，乙不必生之","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793041471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"説矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793041471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"其言足以破前說之偏，而有合古人原論十千之","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793057855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"義也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793057855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"再考廣録，甲是木之幹，乙是木之根，丙火之宿，丁","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793074239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"火之光，戊土之剛，己土之柔，庚金之質，辛金之刄，壬水","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793074239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"之源，癸水之流，是甲乙一木而分隂陽，非死木活木岐","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793074239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"而二之也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793074239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"既一木皆同死同生，故古人只有四大長生","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793090623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505768780791862"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"之説，今分隂陽為二，所以有陽死隂生、陽生隂死之辨。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793090623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"考陳搏甲木乙草、丙火丁灰、戊土已砂、庚金辛石、壬水","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793107007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"癸泉之説，是亦分而為二也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793107007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"若不分，則官煞、食傷、印綬、","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793123391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"梟神、刼財、比肩，何以一物名而為二，而吉凶禍福逈不","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793123391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"同耶？","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793123391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"看命者當以前説為是。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793139775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"513","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"地支之用，不比天干，動静不同，圓方逈異。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793172543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"然五行所屬","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793188927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"則一，而所處之地不一。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793188927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"且如在年則有在年之論；在月","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793205311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505791983435827"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"則有在月之論；在日時則有日時之論。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793205311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"其隂陽輕重剛","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793221695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"柔，豈可泥於一體？","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793221695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"今當以月提為主，所藏所用要見何","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793238079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"神，所耗所嫌要係何物。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793238079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"凡四柱之神，較量深淺而用。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793254463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"子十二支之魁。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793270847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"溪澗江洋之水，乃戊土旺地，然必過大雪","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793287231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"之期，一陽來復之後，方能成旺。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793287231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金所生，亦必於陽","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793303615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"囘水煖而後能生也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793303615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"與午相衝，與卯相刑，與申辰三","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793319999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793319999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"若申子辰全㑹起水局，即成江海發波濤之聲也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793336383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"532","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"丑雖隆冬有氷霜之可怯，但天時已轉二陽，是以丑中","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793352767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505802205167656"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"已土之煖能生萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793352767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金養地，豈只深藏。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793369151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"見戌則刑，","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793385535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"見未則衝，庫地最宜刑衝，不為無用。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793385535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"見已酉三合㑹","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793401919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"起金局。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793401919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"若人命生於丑月，而日時多見水木，必側行","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793418303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"巽離之地，而土方不衰耳。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793418303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"542","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"寅建於春，氣聚三陽，有丙火生焉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793434687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"寅刑已，已合申，並旺","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793451071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"而為貴客。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793451071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"旺於卯，庫於未，同類則為一家。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793467455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"至午則火","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793483839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"光輝而有超凡入聖之美。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793483839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"見申則寅受衝而有破祿","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793500223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"傷提之憂。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793500223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱火多，則又不可入南方火地。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793516607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"語云","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793532991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505802205151272"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"木不南奔是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793532991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"554","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"卯木仲春，氣稟繁華，雖用金水，不可太過。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793549375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"若干頭庚辛","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793565759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"叠見，地支不可見申酉，恐有破伐之害。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793565759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"地支亥子重","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793582143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"逢，干頭不可見癸壬，主有漂流之傷。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793582143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"見酉則衝木必","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793598527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"落葉，見亥未則合木必成林。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793598527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"若時日歸於金重，大運","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793614911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"更向西行，患不禁也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793614911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"563","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"辰建季春，為水泥之濕，而萬物之根皆賴此培養。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793631295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"甲至","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793647679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"此雖裒而有乙之餘氣；壬至此雖墓，而有癸之還魂。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793647679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505786677854220"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"見戌為鑰，能開庫中之物；若三戌重衝，破門非吉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793664063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793680447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"時多見水木，其運更向西北，則辰土不能存矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793680447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"已當初夏，其火增光，是六陽之極也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793696831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"庚金寄生，困頓戊","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793713215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"母，戊土歸祿，乃隨火孃。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793713215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"見申則刑，刑中有合，翻為無","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793729599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"害；見亥則衝，衝而必破，便為有傷。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793729599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"若運再行東南生","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793745983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"發之地，便成燒天烈熖之勢矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793745983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"577","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"午月炎火正升入中氣，則一隂生也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793762367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"庚至此為無用，已","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793778751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"至此為歸垣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793778751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"見申子則必戰尅，見寅戌則越光明。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793795135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"運","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793811519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505811415597097"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"行東南，正是身強之地；若入西北，則休囚喪形矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120727793811519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"584","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"未當季夏，則隂深而火漸衰。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182259753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"未中有乙木，有丁火，是藏","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182276137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"官藏印不藏財也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182276137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"無亥卯以㑹之，則形難變，只作火","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182292521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"土論；無丑戌以刑衝之，則庫不開，難得官印力。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182292521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182308905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"無火，怕行金水之運；日時多寒，偏愛丙丁之鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182308905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"盖用","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182325289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"神之喜忌，最當分曉，不可毫髮誤也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182325289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"593","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"申宫水土長生之地，入已午則逢火煉，遂成劍戟；見子","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182341673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，則逢水淬，益得光鋒。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182341673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"使木多無火，金終能勝；若土","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182358057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505802754441254"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"重堆埋，金却有凶。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182358057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"盖申乃頑鈍之金，與温柔珠玉不","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182374441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"同故也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182374441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"600","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"酉建八月，金色白，水流清，若遇日時火多運，更愁東去；","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182390825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇日時水旺運，亦怕南行。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182390825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"柱見水泥，應為有用，運","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182407209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"行西北，豈是無情？","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182407209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"然逢已丑三合，亦能堅鋭，豈可以","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182423593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"隂金為温柔珠玉而泥論哉？","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182423593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"606","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"戌乃洪鑪之庫，鈍鐵頑金，賴以煉成。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182439977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"見辰龍，則衝出壬","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182456361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"水，而雨露生焉；見寅虎，則㑹起丙火，而文章出焉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182456361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"然","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182472745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505765559484451"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"火命逢之則為入墓，寧能免於不傷哉？","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182472745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"612","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"亥地六隂，雨雪載塗，土至此而不煖，金至此而生寒，其","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182489129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"象若五湖之歸聚，其用在三合之有心。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182489129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"是故欲識乾","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182505513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"坤和煖之處，即從艮震巽離之地而尋之也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182505513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"　大抵","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182521897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"五行用法總無真實，生死哀旺亦假名耳。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182521897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"直向源頭","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182538281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"明其出處，如五陽為剛，五隂為柔，若失令身衰，不遇","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182538281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"資扶而頻泄氣，則剛者失其為剛。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182538281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"若得令身强，用事","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182554665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"有助，則柔者不失之柔。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182554665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"中間又分木火為陽，金水為","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182571049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505765559500835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"conten {"lines":[{"lineId":"627","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"甲木為雷雷者，陽氣之嘘也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182603817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"甲木屬陽，故取象於雷焉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182620201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"稽諸月令，仲春之月，雷乃發聲，甲木旺，即其驗也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182636585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"况","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182652969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"雷奮於地，木生於地，其理又無不同者。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182652969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"邵子云：地逢","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182669353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"雷處見天根。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182669353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"陽木之生，孰非天根之動為之乎？","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182685737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"是甲","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182702121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"木至申而遂絶，以雷聲至申而漸收也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182702121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命屬甲日，","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182718505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"主喜值春天，或類象，或趨乾，或遥已，或拱貴，俱大吉","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182718505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505810090229794"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"運，不喜西方。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182718505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：木在春生，處世安然，必夀。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182734889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"642","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"乙木為風乙木長生在午，敗在巳。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182751273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"在午而生者，盖乙為","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182767657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"山林活木，至夏來而暢茂，詩所謂千章夏木青是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182767657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"其敗已云何？","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182784041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"巳","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182800425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"乃巽地，巽為風，木盛風生也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182800425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"風生於","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182816809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"木而反摧木，猶之火生於木而反焚木，其取敗也固","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182816809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"宜。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182816809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂乙木為風者，木其所自生云爾。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182833193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"如人乙日建","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182849577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"生者，在秋令大吉，秋令金旺，乙木能化能從，而盤根","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182849577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"錯節，非利器無所裁成，逢亥必死，其落葉歸根之時耶？","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182849577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505802754490406"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"丙為日，説卦傳曰：離為火，為日。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182865961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"日與火皆文明之象，是","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182882345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"以丙火為日之名不易焉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182882345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽朝出而夕入，陽火寅","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182898729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"生而酉死，而又何異乎？","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182898729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"萬騏真寳賦以丙日丑時為","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182915113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"日出地上之格，有㫖哉，有㫖哉！","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182915113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"凡六丙生，冬夏不如","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182931497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"春秋，春日有晅萬物之功，秋陽有燥萬物之用，冬則","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182931497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"隂晦，夏則炎蒸，宜細推之。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182931497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"666","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"丁火為星，丙火死而丁火遂從生焉，在天之日薄而星","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182947881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"迴也，𩔖如此。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182947881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"星象惟入夜故燦爛，隂火惟近晦故輝","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182964265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505802754474022"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"煌，丁不謂之星而何？","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182964265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"真寳賦云：隂火時亥，富貴悠悠，","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182980649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"解者以此為財、官、印之三竒亦可矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182980649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知亥在北方，","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182997033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"是為天門，又星拱北之説乎？","logicSentenceId":"7634120728182997033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"凡丁日生人喜遇夜，喜","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183013417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"遇秋，如星光之得時也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183013417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"又喜行身弱地，如石裏所藏","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183029801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"屬丁火，石雖在水，即時取撃，亦自有火。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183029801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"其丁已一日","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183046185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"多尅父兄妻子，盖財忌比刼，兄屈弟下。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183046185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"巳中有戊土","logicSentenceId":"7683559061753069609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官也。","logicSentenceId":"7683559061753069609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"683","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"戊土為霞。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183062569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"土無專氣，依火以生；霞無定體，借日以現。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183078953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"知","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183095337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505781933981734"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"丙火之為日，則知戊土之為霞矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183095337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"是霞者，日之餘也，","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183111721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"日盡而霞將滅没，火熄則土無生意，故謂之霞也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183111721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"大","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183128105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"撓氏演納音五行象，以戊午為天上火，意盖如此。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183128105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183144489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"戊土日主愛，四柱帶水，則為上格，霞水相映而成文彩","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183144489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183144489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"更喜年月干見癸，癸則為雨，雨後霞見而覩文明也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183160873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"已土為雲。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183177257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"已土生居酉，酉，兑方也，其象為澤。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183193641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"先正曰：天","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183210025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"降時雨，山川出雲。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183210025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"然則雲者，山澤之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183226409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"已雖屬土，","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183242793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"以此論之，則其謂之雲也亦宜。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183242793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"故甲己合而化土，其","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183259177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505811415711785"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"氣上升而雲施，雲雷交而作雨，其澤下究而土潤，此","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183259177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"造化之至妙至妙者與。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183259177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"凡身主屬己土，貴坐酉，貴春","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183275561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"生，貴見印。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183275561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"坐亥者不可見乙，木雲升天，遇風則狼藉","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183291945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"而不禁也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183291945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"711","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"庚金為月。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183308329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"庚乃酉方陽金，何以知其配月乎？","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183324713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：五行之","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183341097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"有庚，猶四時之有月也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183341097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"庚不待秋而長生，然必秋而","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183357481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"始盛；月不待秋而後有，然必秋而益明。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183357481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"以色言，月固","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183373865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"白也，其色同矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183373865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"以氣言，金生水也，潮應月也，其氣同","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183390249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505811415679017"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183390249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"古甲子以庚為上章，見其與日平明也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183406633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"經云金沉","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183423017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"在子，見其與月沉波也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183423017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"三日月見庚方，見月初生，與","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183439401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"庚同位也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183439401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰庚金為月。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183455785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"如人庚日生者，四柱有乙","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183472169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"已字出，謂之月白風清。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183472169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"秋為上，冬次之，春夏無取。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183488553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"731","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金為霜。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183504937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"八月辛金建祿之地。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183521321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"是月也，天氣肅，白露為","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183537705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"霜，草木黄落而變衰，故五行隂木絶在此地。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183537705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"若木經","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183554089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"斧斤之斬伐，未有能生焉者也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183554089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"斧斤以時入山林，嚴","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183570473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"霜以時殺草木，揆之天道，參之人事，信乎辛金之為","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183570473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505811415695401"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"霜矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183570473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：霜常避日，丙與辛合，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183586857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：此亦相尅之","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183603241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"理也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183603241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"火惟尅金，故相合而水斯化；霜惟避日，故相遇","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183619625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"而氷以消，亦為水也，是之取耳。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183619625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"如辛人坐卯未透乙，","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183636009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"大富；坐亥透丙，則貴愛。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183636009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"冬生","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183652393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"749","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"壬水為秋露。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183668777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"春亦有露，何獨擬之以秋？","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183685161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"盖春露，雨露既","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183701545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"濡之露；秋露，霜露既降之露也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183701545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"露一也，春主生，秋主","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183717929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"殺，功用不同有如此。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183717929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"然吾以壬為秋露也，盖露屬水，","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183734313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"而壬水生於申，水本能生木者，水既然在此而生，木","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183734313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505819837825036"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"何由於此而絶，故知壬之為露，秋露也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183734313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"如壬日生秋，","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183750697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"見丁火最顯，丁為星河，壬為秋露，一洗炎蒸，象緯昭","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183750697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"然矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183750697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"762","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"癸水為春霖。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183767081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"癸水生卯月，號曰春霖，葢隂木得雨而發","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183783465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"生也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183783465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"然至申則死，七八月多乾旱也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183799849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"且卯前一位是","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183816233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，辰龍宫也，卯近龍宫而水生，龍一奮遂化為雨焉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183816233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"卯為雷門，雷一震而龍必興焉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183832617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"觀此則癸水其春霖","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183849001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183849001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"如癸卯日透出已字者，有雲行雨施之象，其人必","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183865385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505781934063654"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"有經濟才也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183865385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏吉，秋冬不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728183881769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：癸日生逢已已","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979177515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"鄉，煞星須要木來降。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979177515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然名利升髙顯，争柰平生夀","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979193899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"不長。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979193899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
