{"lines":[{"lineId":"780","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"子為墨池。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979226667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"子在正北方，屬水，色象墨，故有墨池之象。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979243051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"凡","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979259435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"命逢子年生者，時喜見癸亥，謂之水歸大海，又謂之","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979259435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"雙魚逰墨，必為文章士矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979259435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"785","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"午為烽堠。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979275819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"午正位於南，屬火土，其色赤黄，名之曰烽堠","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979292203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505819837841420"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"者，此也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979292203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"又午為馬烽堠，乃戎馬兵火之處所也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979308587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"午生","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979324971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"人，時利見辰，真龍出，則凡馬空矣，謂之馬化龍駒。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979324971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"792","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"卯為瓊林。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979341355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"卯係乙木，居位正東，於時為仲春，萬物生焉，","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979357739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"色若琅玕之青，故曰瓊林。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979357739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"卯年遇已未時者，是為兔","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979374123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"入月宫之象，主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979374123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"797","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"酉為寺鐘。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979390507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"酉屬金位近戌亥。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979406891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"戌亥者，天門也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979423275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"鐘，金屬也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979439659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"寺鐘敲則聲徹天門。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979456043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"又酉居正西，寺則西方佛界也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979472427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"酉見寅吉，謂之鐘鳴谷應。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979488811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505781934030886"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"寅為廣谷。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979505195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"寅乃艮方，艮為山，戊土長生，於是而廣谷之","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979521579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"義著矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979521579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"然寅宫有虎，寅生人而時戊辰者，謂之虎嘯","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979537963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"而谷風生，威震萬里。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979537963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"810","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"申為名都。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979554347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"坤為地，其體無疆，非名都不足以喻之。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979570731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"申，坤","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979587115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979587115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"都者，帝王所居。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979603499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"申宫壬水生，又與艮山對，是水遶","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979619883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"山𤨔也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979619883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命愛申年亥時，乃地天交㤗。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979636267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"818","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"已為大驛。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979652651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"大驛者，人煙凑集，道路通達之地，已中有丙","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979669035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"火戊土，是其象也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979669035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"又已前有午馬，故曰大驛已生。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979685419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"喜","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979701803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505791983534131"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":937,"lineType":1,"content":"得辰時，蛇化青龍，於格為千里龍駒。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979701803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"825","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"亥為懸河。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979718187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"天河之水，奔𣴑不回，故曰懸河。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979734571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"亥即天門，又","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979750955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"屬水，非懸河之象乎？","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979750955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"亥年建生日，時見寅辰二字，是","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979767339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"乃水拱雷門。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979767339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"831","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"辰為草澤。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979783723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"左傳曰：深山大澤，龍蛇生焉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979800107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"夫澤，水所鍾也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979816491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"辰在東方之次，為水庫，故為草為澤。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979832875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"辰逢壬戌癸亥，","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979849259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"即龍歸大海格。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979849259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"837","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"戌為燒原。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979865643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"戌月在九秋，草木盡萎，田家焚燒而耕。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979882027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"又戌","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979898411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505791983501363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"屬土，是以稱名燒原。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979898411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"故戌與辰地，皆貴人所不臨也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979914795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"戌生逢卯，號曰春入燒痕。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979931179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"844","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"丑為栁岸，丑中有水有土有金。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979947563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"岸者，土也，所以止水也，","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979963947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"故謂栁岸。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979963947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰栁色黄金嫩是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979980331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"丑人時見已。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728979996715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"未，乃","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980013099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"月照栁梢，極為上格。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980013099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"851","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"未為花園，花園屬之未，不屬之卯，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980029483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"卯乃木旺，自成","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980045867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"林麓。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980045867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"未乃木庫，如人築墻垣以䕶百花也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980062251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"以百花言，","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980078635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":969,"lineType":1,"content":"未中有雜氣耳。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980078635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":969,"lineType":1,"content":"未年入雙飛格最妙。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980095019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":969,"lineType":1,"content":"如辛未見戊戌，","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980111403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505811415728169"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"兩干不雜是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980111403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"861","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"或問：十干之所取象，有自其配合言之，有自其生尅言","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980127787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"之，又有自其方位、自其時令、自其始終言之，不同何也？","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980127787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：予各舉其一隅而為言也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980144171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"善學者類而推之，則十干","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980160555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"各有消息盈虚之機，各有聲應氣求之妙矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980160555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"斯道也，造","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980176939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"化自然之道，豈予一人之私言哉？","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980176939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：十二支，辰戌丑","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980193323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"未居四隅，乃對待之體，所謂支屬地，地能静而不能動","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980193323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980193323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"戊已居中央，乃流行之用，所謂干屬天，天能動而不","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980209707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505791983566899"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"能静也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980209707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"故地支四土，非加益也，以其有專氣耳。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980226091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"天干二","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980242475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":993,"lineType":1,"content":"土，非加損也，以其無定位耳。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980242475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":993,"lineType":1,"content":"使干支無分數之差，何以","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980258859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"成變化而行鬼神乎？","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980258859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"夫天元之數有十，予既分配以天","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980275243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"文；而地元之數十有二，予又分配以地理。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980275243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"然則所謂牽","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980291627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"強與？","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980291627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"殆非也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980308011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"昔者聖人作易，於八卦之象，逺取諸物，近","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980324395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"取諸身，重復明之，而有所不置。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980324395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"干支之理，一易書之理","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980340779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980340779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"術家者流，語數而違理者多矣，予故表而出之。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980357163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"賦云：","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980373547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"論用神，論日主，各有所宜；取地脈，取天元，是或一道。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980373547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"盖","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980389931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505802205200424"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"必𠔥此妙焉，然後為至也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980389931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"不然，是亦一得之愚而已。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980406315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980422699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"天元之分配循其序，地支則舉其四生四敗四庫之位","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980422699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"而錯綜之者，亦有見也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980422699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"學者合前説而觀之，思過半矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980439083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"醉醒子曰：大哉干支，生物之始。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980455467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"本乎天地，萬物宗焉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980471851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"有","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980488235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽變化之機，時候淺深之用。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980488235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"故金木水火，土無主形，","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980504619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"生尅制化，理取不一。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980504619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"假如死木，偏宜活水長。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980521003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"濡譬若頑","logicSentenceId":"7683559061753085993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"金，最喜洪爐久煉。","logicSentenceId":"7683559061753085993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽火，忌林木為讐；梁棟材，求斧斤","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980537387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":1023,"lineType":1,"content":"為友。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980537387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":1023,"lineType":1,"content":"火隔水不能鎔金，金沉水豈能尅木？","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980553771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":1023,"lineType":1,"content":"活木忌埋根","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980570155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505765559549987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"之鐵，死金嫌盖頂之泥。","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980570155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙欲成一塊，須知穿鑿之功；","logicSentenceId":"7634120728980586539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"li {"lines":[{"lineId":"962","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"或問：地支有屬相，而天干則無者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734348842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：天干動而","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734365226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":1077,"lineType":1,"content":"無相，地支静而有相。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734365226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":1077,"lineType":1,"content":"盖輕清者天也；重濁者地也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734381610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":1077,"lineType":1,"content":"重濁","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734397994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505791983583283"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":1081,"lineType":1,"content":"之中，乃有物焉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734397994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":1081,"lineType":1,"content":"故子屬䑕，丑屬牛，寅屬虎，卯屬兔，辰屬","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734414378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"龍，已屬蛇，午屬馬，未屬羊，申屬猴，酉屬雞，戌屬犬，亥屬","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734414378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"猪。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734414378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"此十二屬相，亦有竒偶之分，盛衰之用。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734430762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"竒者，鼠、虎、龍、","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734447146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":1087,"lineType":1,"content":"馬、猴、犬，一則屬陽，六獸之足皆單；偶者，牛、兔、蛇、羊、雞、猪，","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734447146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"二則屬隂，六獸之足皆雙。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734447146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"惟蛇無足，又何取義？","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734463530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"盖已在","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734479914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":1091,"lineType":1,"content":"月，乃純陽之月；在時，乃純陽之時，數則偶而時則陽，故","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734479914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"用蛇以象之。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734479914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇乃隂物，不用其足而象巳著，疑亦諱言","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734496298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"乎隂之意爾。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734496298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"况亦有雙頭者可驗。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734512682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"十二相，即三十六禽","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734529066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505810090295330"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":1099,"lineType":1,"content":"中取其首者擬之，自有隂陽之别、單雙之分，此造化之","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734529066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"所以為妙也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734529066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"或問：十二屬相各有所缺者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734545450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：天","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734561834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"傾西北，地不滿東南，天地尚缺，獸體豈全？","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734561834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"故鼠少光夜","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734578218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"出，牛無牙唇吻，虎無項和身而轉，兔缺唇無雄，龍虧耳","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734578218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":1107,"lineType":1,"content":"角聴，蛇無足快行，馬怯膽常立不眠，羊無瞳死不閉目，","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734578218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"猴無脾，喜食果物，雞無腎，淫而無節，犬無胃，食穢善呼，","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734578218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"猪無觔，常眠少立。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734578218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"此係隂陽不僃之意，亦與造化相應。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734594602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":1113,"lineType":1,"content":"惟人獨㑹其全，此其所以貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734610986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":1113,"lineType":1,"content":"王充論衡曰：五行之氣","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734627370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505791983599667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":1117,"lineType":1,"content":"相賊害，含血之蟲相勝服。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734627370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":1117,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，木也，其禽虎。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734643754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":1117,"lineType":1,"content":"戌，土也，其禽","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734660138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"犬。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734660138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未亦土也，丑禽牛，未禽羊。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734676522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"木勝土，故犬與牛羊為","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734692906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"虎所服。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734692906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，水也，其禽豕。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734709290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"已，火也，其禽蛇。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734725674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"子亦水也，其禽","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734742058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"䑕。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734742058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"午亦火也，其禽馬。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734758442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"水勝火，故豕食蛇。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734774826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"火為水所害，故","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734791210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"馬食䑕屎而腹脹。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734791210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"然亦有不相勝者。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734807594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"午，馬也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734823978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"子，䑕也；酉，","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734840362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"雞也；卯，兔也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734840362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"水勝火，䑕何不逐馬？","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734856746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"金勝木，雞何不啄兔？","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734873130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，豕也；未，羊也；丑，牛也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734889514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"土勝水，牛羊何不殺豕？","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734905898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"已，蛇也；","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734922282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"申，猴也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734922282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"火勝金，蛇何不食獼猴？","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734938666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"獼猴畏䑕者也，囓獼猴","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734955050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505781934096422"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"者，犬也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734955050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"䑕水，獼猴金也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729734971434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content {"lines":[{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"夫一氣渾淪，形質未離，孰為隂陽？","logicSentenceId":"7634120729735086122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"太始既肇，裂一為三，","logicSentenceId":"7634120729735102506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"倐忽乃分。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729735102506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"天得之而輕清為陽，地得之而重濁為隂。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729735118890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"人","logicSentenceId":"7634120729735135274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":1149,"lineType":1,"content":"位乎天地之中，禀陽隂沖和之氣，故此輕清者為十干，","logicSentenceId":"7634120729735135274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505819837923340"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":1153,"lineType":1,"content":"主祿，謂之天元；重濁者為十二支，主身，謂之地元。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729735135274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":1153,"lineType":1,"content":"天地","logicSentenceId":"7634120729735151658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":1155,"lineType":1,"content":"各正其位，成才於兩間者，乃所謂人也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729735151658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":1155,"lineType":1,"content":"故支中所藏者","logicSentenceId":"7634120729735168042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":1157,"lineType":1,"content":"主命，謂之人元，名為司事之神。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729735168042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":1157,"lineType":1,"content":"以命術言之，為月令用","logicSentenceId":"7634120729735184426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":1159,"line {"lines":[{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":1227,"lineType":1,"content":"醉醒子曰：時行物生，天道之常。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910362131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":1227,"lineType":1,"content":"一歳之中，雖有進退，四","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910378515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":1229,"lineType":1,"content":"時之內，本無輕重。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910378515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":1229,"lineType":1,"content":"故以金、木、水、火分旺四時，各得七十","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910394899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":1231,"lineType":1,"content":"二日；土旺四季，各有十八日，共三百六十日乃成嵗焉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910394899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":1233,"lineType":1,"content":"立春之後，則用陽木三十六日，艮土分野，丙戊長生；驚","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910411283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":1235,"lineType":1,"content":"蟄後六日，則用隂木三十六日，癸水寄生；清明後十二","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910411283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":1237,"lineType":1,"content":"日，則用戊土十八日，陽水歸庫，隂水返魂。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910411283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":1237,"lineType":1,"content":"夏、秋、冬亦如","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910427667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":1239,"lineType":1,"content":"此。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910427667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":1239,"lineType":1,"content":"淵源淵海則以立春之後，已土餘氣幾日，艮土分野","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910444051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505822052384808"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":1243,"lineType":1,"content":"幾日，丙戊長生先後各得幾日；卯月癸水寄生幾日，辰","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910444051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":1245,"lineType":1,"content":"月陽水歸庫，隂水返魂亦各幾日。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910444051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":1245,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不思丑月之用既","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910460435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":1247,"lineType":1,"content":"足，春後又何餘哉？","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910460435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":1247,"lineType":1,"content":"分野者，聚一方之旺氣；長生者，歸母","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910476819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":1249,"lineType":1,"content":"成孕；先後者，盖有寅而後生丙，有丙而後戊生；寄生者，","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910476819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":1251,"lineType":1,"content":"徒有虚名，乃無實位；歸庫者，絶其生氣而收藏；返魂者，","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910476819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":1253,"lineType":1,"content":"續其死氣而變化。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910476819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":1253,"lineType":1,"content":"此五行生死進退之𤣥機，豈可以幾","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910493203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":1255,"lineType":1,"content":"日為限哉？","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910493203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":1255,"lineType":1,"content":"且春之用木，秋之用金，固一定之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910509587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":1255,"lineType":1,"content":"若雜","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910525971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":1257,"lineType":1,"content":"揉寓處之神，占用幾日，則本宫主氣之數，未嘗不缺而","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910525971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505810090328098"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":1261,"lineType":1,"content":"虧矣，則何以見春木夏火一氣流行，各旺七十二日之","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910525971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":1263,"lineType":1,"content":"數耶？","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910525971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":1263,"lineType":1,"content":"以四季配五行之用，乃主有納客之數，客無勝主之","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910542355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":1265,"lineType":1,"content":"理，但主氣之司權，自有初中末三氣之淺深，用之者特","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910542355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":1267,"lineType":1,"content":"宜較量輕重言耳，又豈可以三五七日為限哉？","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910542355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":1267,"lineType":1,"content":"其説足","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910558739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":1269,"lineType":1,"content":"以破淵源之誤。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910558739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":1269,"lineType":1,"content":"又支中所藏，止以月論年日時，不論人","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910575123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":1271,"lineType":1,"content":"命，重提綱，厥有㫖哉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910575123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":1275,"lineType":1,"content":"立節中氣，其春秋有分而不言至，夏冬有至而不言分。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910607891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505811415793705"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":1279,"lineType":1,"content":"及夫雨水、驚蟄以降，二十四氣分屬有名，亦必有所以","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910624275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":1281,"lineType":1,"content":"為名者。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910624275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":1281,"lineType":1,"content":"何言乎？","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910640659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":1281,"lineType":1,"content":"四立者，四時之節氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910657043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":1281,"lineType":1,"content":"丑之終，寅之始，","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910673427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":1283,"lineType":1,"content":"則為節；月之半，則為中。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910673427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":1283,"lineType":1,"content":"二分者，隂陽相半之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910689811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":1283,"lineType":1,"content":"二至","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910706195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":1285,"lineType":1,"content":"者，至有二義，子至已為六陽，午至亥為六隂。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910706195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":1285,"lineType":1,"content":"至者，介乎","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910722579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":1287,"lineType":1,"content":"已午亥子之間也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910722579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":1287,"lineType":1,"content":"冬至亥隂極，故曰子。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910738963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":1287,"lineType":1,"content":"子者，止也，陽於","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910755347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":1289,"lineType":1,"content":"此生，故亦曰至。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910755347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":1289,"lineType":1,"content":"夏至已陽極，故曰午。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910771731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":1289,"lineType":1,"content":"午者，忤也，隂於此","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910788115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":1291,"lineType":1,"content":"生，故亦曰至。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910788115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":1291,"lineType":1,"content":"自秋分水始涸，冬至水始氷，冬至水泉動，","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910804499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":1293,"lineType":1,"content":"大寒水澤腹堅，","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910804499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":1293,"lineType":1,"content":"為今之雨水者，先是為露，為霜，為雪，皆","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910804499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505819837939724"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":1297,"lineType":1,"content":"水氣凝結，以至於寒之極。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910804499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":1297,"lineType":1,"content":"春則暑氣順行，而又為暑之","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910837267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":1299,"lineType":1,"content":"始也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910837267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":1299,"lineType":1,"content":"況天一生水，人物之生，皆始於水。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910853651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":1299,"lineType":1,"content":"春屬木，木生於","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910870035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":1301,"lineType":1,"content":"水，立春後繼以雨水，宜也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910870035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":1301,"lineType":1,"content":"卦氣正月為㤗，天氣下降，當","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910886419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":1303,"lineType":1,"content":"為雨水。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910886419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":1303,"lineType":1,"content":"二月大壯，雷在天上，當為驚蟄。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910902803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":1303,"lineType":1,"content":"先雨水而後驚","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910919187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"蟄，亦宜也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910919187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"驚蟄者，萬物出乎震，震為雷也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910935571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"清明者，萬物","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910951955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":1307,"lineType":1,"content":"齊乎巽，巽為風也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910951955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":1307,"lineType":1,"content":"巽潔齊而曰清明，清明乃潔齊之義。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910968339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":1309,"lineType":1,"content":"榖雨，三月中。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729910984723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":1309,"lineType":1,"content":"自雨水後，土膏脉動，至此又雨，則土脈生","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911001107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":1311,"lineType":1,"content":"物，所以滋五穀之種也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911001107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":1311,"lineType":1,"content":"小滿，四月中。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911017491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":1311,"lineType":1,"content":"先儒云：小雪後，陽","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911033875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505819837956108"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":1315,"lineType":1,"content":"一日生一分，積三十日生三十分，而成一畫，為冬至。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911033875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":1315,"lineType":1,"content":"小","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911050259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":1317,"lineType":1,"content":"滿後，隂生亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911050259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":1317,"lineType":1,"content":"夫四月乾之終，謂之滿者，姤初六：羸豕","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911066643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":1319,"lineType":1,"content":"孚蹢躅。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911066643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":1319,"lineType":1,"content":"坤初六履霜堅氷至。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911083027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":1319,"lineType":1,"content":"羸豕喻其小，蹢躅喻其滿。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911099411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":1321,"lineType":1,"content":"履霜喻其小，堅氷喻其滿。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911115795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":1321,"lineType":1,"content":"易言於一隂既生之後，厯言","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911132179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":1323,"lineType":1,"content":"於一隂方萌之初，慮之深，防之預也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911132179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":1323,"lineType":1,"content":"小雪後有大雪，此","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911148563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":1325,"lineType":1,"content":"但有小滿，無大滿，意可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911148563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":1325,"lineType":1,"content":"至若三月中穀雨，五月中","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911164947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":1327,"lineType":1,"content":"芒種，此二氣獨指榖麥言穀必原其生之始，榖種於春，","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911164947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":1329,"lineType":1,"content":"得木之氣，殘於秋，金尅木也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911164947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":1329,"lineType":1,"content":"麥必要其成之終，麥種於","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911181331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505795766779919"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":1333,"lineType":1,"content":"秋，得金之氣，成於夏，火尅金也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911181331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":1333,"lineType":1,"content":"六月節小暑，六月中大","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911197715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":1335,"lineType":1,"content":"暑。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911197715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":1335,"lineType":1,"content":"夏至後暑已盛，不當又謂之小。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911214099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":1335,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知易曰：寒往則","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911230483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":1337,"lineType":1,"content":"暑來，暑往則寒來，寒暑相推而嵗成焉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911230483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":1337,"lineType":1,"content":"通上半年之半，","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911246867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":1339,"lineType":1,"content":"皆可謂暑；通下半年之半，皆可謂寒。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911246867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":1339,"lineType":1,"content":"正月，暑之始；十二","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911263251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":1341,"lineType":1,"content":"月，寒之終。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911263251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":1341,"lineType":1,"content":"而曰大暑、小暑者，不過上半年之辭耳。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911279635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":1341,"lineType":1,"content":"六月","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911296019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":1343,"lineType":1,"content":"中，暑之極，故謂大。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911296019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":1343,"lineType":1,"content":"然則未至於大，則猶為小也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911312403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":1343,"lineType":1,"content":"七月中","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911328787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":1345,"lineType":1,"content":"處暑。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911328787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":1345,"lineType":1,"content":"七月，暑之終，寒之始，大火西流，暑氣於是乎處矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911345171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":1347,"lineType":1,"content":"處者，隠也，藏伏之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911361555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":1347,"lineType":1,"content":"白露八月節，寒露九月節。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911377939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":1347,"lineType":1,"content":"秋本","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911394323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505802754523174"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":1351,"lineType":1,"content":"屬金，金色白，金氣寒。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911394323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":1351,"lineType":1,"content":"白者，露之色；寒者，露之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911410707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":1351,"lineType":1,"content":"先白而","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911427091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":1353,"lineType":1,"content":"氣始寒，固有漸也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911427091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":1353,"lineType":1,"content":"九月中霜降，露寒始結為霜也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911443475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":1353,"lineType":1,"content":"立冬","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911459859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":1355,"lineType":1,"content":"後曰小雪、大雪，寒氣始於露，中於霜，終於雪。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911459859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":1355,"lineType":1,"content":"霜之前為","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911476243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":1357,"lineType":1,"content":"露，露由白而始寒；霜之後為雪，雪由小而至大，皆有漸","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911476243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":1359,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911476243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":1359,"lineType":1,"content":"至小寒、大寒，豳風云：一之日觱發，二之日栗烈。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911492627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":1359,"lineType":1,"content":"觱發，","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911509011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":1361,"lineType":1,"content":"風寒，故十一月之餘為小寒；栗烈，氣寒，故十二月之終","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911509011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":1363,"lineType":1,"content":"為大寒也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911509011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":1363,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵合而言之，上半年主長生，曰雨、曰雷、曰","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911525395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":1365,"lineType":1,"content":"風，皆生之氣；下半年主生成，曰露、曰霜、曰雪，皆成之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911525395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505822052417576"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":1369,"lineType":1,"content":"下半年言天時，不言農時，農時莫急於春夏也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911541779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":1369,"lineType":1,"content":"先儒云：","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911558163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":1371,"lineType":1,"content":"變者化之漸；化者變之成。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911558163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":1371,"lineType":1,"content":"立春、雨水後，寒氣漸變，至立","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911574547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":1373,"lineType":1,"content":"夏則寒盡化為水矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911574547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":1373,"lineType":1,"content":"然曰小暑、大暑，其化固有漸也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911590931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":1373,"lineType":1,"content":"立","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911607315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":1375,"lineType":1,"content":"秋、處暑後，暑氣漸變，至立冬則暑氣盡化為寒矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911607315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":1375,"lineType":1,"content":"然曰","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911623699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":1377,"lineType":1,"content":"小寒、大寒，其化亦有漸也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911623699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":1377,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：日月運行而四時成，以","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911640083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":1379,"lineType":1,"content":"其有常也，故聖人立法以步之。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911640083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":1379,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽相錯而萬物生，以","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911656467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":1381,"lineType":1,"content":"其無窮也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911656467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":1381,"lineType":1,"content":"故聖人指物以候之，貫六氣終始早晏，五運","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911672851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":1383,"lineType":1,"content":"大小盈虚，原之以至理，考之以至數，而𡸁示萬古，無有","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911672851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1286","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505822052401192"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":1387,"lineType":1,"content":"差忒也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911672851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":1387,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：五日謂之候，三候謂之氣，六氣謂之時，四","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911689235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":1389,"lineType":1,"content":"時謂之嵗。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911689235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":1389,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：日為陽，月為隂，行有分紀，周有道理。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911705619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":1389,"lineType":1,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911722003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":1391,"lineType":1,"content":"行一度，月行十三度而有竒焉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911722003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":1391,"lineType":1,"content":"故大小月三百六十五","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911738387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":1393,"lineType":1,"content":"日而成嵗，積氣餘而盈閏矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911738387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":1393,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：日常於畫夜行天之","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911754771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":1395,"lineType":1,"content":"一度，則一日也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911754771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":1395,"lineType":1,"content":"共三百六十五日四分之一而周天度，","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911771155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":1397,"lineType":1,"content":"乃成一嵗。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911771155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":1397,"lineType":1,"content":"常五日一候應之，故三候成一氣，即十五日","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911787539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":1399,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911787539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":1399,"lineType":1,"content":"三氣成一節，節謂立春春分、立夏夏至、立秋秋分、立","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911803923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":1401,"lineType":1,"content":"冬冬至，此四節也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911803923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":1401,"lineType":1,"content":"三八二十四氣而分主四時，一嵗成","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911820307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505814511091751"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":1405,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911820307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":1405,"lineType":1,"content":"春秋言分者，以六氣言之，則二月半初氣終而交二","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911836691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":1407,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣，八月半四氣盡而交五之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911836691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":1407,"lineType":1,"content":"若以四時之分言之，","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911869459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":1409,"lineType":1,"content":"則隂陽寒暄之氣到此可分之時也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911869459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":1409,"lineType":1,"content":"晝夜分五十刻，亦","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911885843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":1411,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽之中分也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911885843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":1411,"lineType":1,"content":"故經曰分則氣異，此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911902227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":1411,"lineType":1,"content":"冬夏言至","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911918611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":1413,"lineType":1,"content":"者，以六氣言之，則五月半司天之氣至其所在，十一月","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911918611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":1415,"lineType":1,"content":"半在泉之氣至其所在。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911918611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":1415,"lineType":1,"content":"以四時之令言之，則隂陽至此","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911934995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":1417,"lineType":1,"content":"極至之時也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120729911934995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":1417,"lineType":1,"content":"夏至日長不過六十刻， "7634120730438877238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":1435,"lineType":1,"content":"十九日計行天三百八十七度有竒。","logicSentenceId":"7634120730438877238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":1435,"lineType":1,"content":"計月行疾之數，比","logicSentenceId":"7634120730438893622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":1437,"lineType":1,"content":"日行遲之數，則二十九日日方行天二十九度，月已先","logicSentenceId":"7634120730438893622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505810090377250"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":1441,"lineType":1,"content":"行一周天三百六十五度外，又行天之二十二度，反少","logicSentenceId":"7634120730438893622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":1443,"lineType":1,"content":"七度而不及日也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120730438893622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":1443,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽家説謂日月之行，自有前後遲","logicSentenceId":"7634120730438910006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":1445,"lineType":1,"content":"速不等，固無常凖，則有大小月盡之異也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120730438910006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":1445,"lineType":1,"content":"本三百六十","logicSentenceId":"7634120730438926390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":1447,"lineType":1,"content":"五日四分度之一，即二十五刻，當為一嵗，自除嵗外之","logicSentenceId":"7634120730438926390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":1449,"lineType":1,"content":"餘，則有三百六十日，又除小月所少之日六日，止有三","logicSentenceId":"7634120730438926390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":1451,"lineType":1,"content":"百五十四日，而成一歳，通少十一日二十五刻，乃盈閏","logicSentenceId":"7634120730438926390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":1453,"lineType":1,"content":"為十二月之制，則有立首之氣，氣乃三候之至，月半視","l {"lines":[{"lineId":"1369","lineNum":1479,"lineType":1,"content":"夫日一晝一夜十二時，當均分於一日。","logicSentenceId":"7634120730439155766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1370","lineNum":1479,"lineType":1,"content":"故上智設銅壺","logicSentenceId":"7634120730439172150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1371","lineNum":1481,"lineType":1,"content":"貯水，漏下壺箭，箭分百刻以度之，雖日月晦明，終不能","logicSentenceId":"7634120730439172150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1372","lineNum":1483,"lineType":1,"content":"逃。","logicSentenceId":"7634120730439172150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1373","lineNum":1483,"lineType":1,"content":"是一日之中有百刻之候也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120730439188534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1374","lineNum":1483,"lineType":1,"content":"夫六氣通主一歳，則一","logicSentenceId":"7634120730439204918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1375","lineNum":1485,"lineType":1,"content":"氣主六十日八十七刻半，乃知交氣之時有早晏也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120730439204918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1376","lineNum":1485,"lineType":1,"content":"冬","logicSentenceId":"7634120730439221302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1377","lineNum":1487,"lineType":1,"content":"夏日有長短之異，則晝夜互相推移，而日出入時刻不","logicSentenceId":"7634120730439221302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1378","lineNum":1489,"lineType":1,"content":"同，然終於百刻矣，其氣交之刻則不能移也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120730439221302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1379","lineNum":1489,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子之歳，","logicSentenceId":"7634120730439237686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1380","lineNum":1491,"lineType":1,"content":"初之氣始於漏水下一刻，終於八十七刻半，子正之中","logicSentenceId":"7634120730439237686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1381","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505802754572326"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1382","li enceId":"7634120731098562602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1629","lineNum":1753,"lineType":1,"content":"月，陽中之隂，后妃之𧰼也，其徳至柔，而其體至順，其行","logicSentenceId":"7634120731098578986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1630","lineNum":1755,"lineType":1,"content":"天所以佐理大陽，驗之夜景，以為消息。","logicSentenceId":"7634120731098578986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1631","lineNum":1755,"lineType":1,"content":"月本無光，麗日","logicSentenceId":"7634120731098595370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1632","lineNum":1757,"lineType":1,"content":"而有明，以不明之體言之，則純隂而𧰼坤，晦朔之時也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120731098595370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1633","lineNum":1759,"lineType":1,"content":"越三十日不及日三十七度强而哉生明，始資日之明","logicSentenceId":"7634120731098611754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1634","lineNum":1761,"lineType":1,"content":"而有光，因謂之朏，陽之初生也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120731098611754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1635","lineNum":1761,"lineType":1,"content":"昏見於庚，震三之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120731098628138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1636","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505811415859241"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1637","lineNum":1765,"lineType":1,"content":"越八日，不及日九十八度強，而資日之半明，因謂之弦，","logicSentenceId":"7634120731098644522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1638","lineNum":1767,"lineType":1,"content":"乃陽将半也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120731098644522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1639","lineNum":1767,"lineType":1,"content":"昏見於丁，兊三之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120731098660906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1640","lineNum":1767,"lineType":1,"content":"越十五日，不及日","logicSentenceId":"7634120731098677290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1641","lineNum":1769,"lineType":1,"content":"一百八十二度半强，與對望，資日之全明而大圓，因謂","logicSe ","lineNum":1901,"lineType":1,"content":"之法，則四行分配，而附麗於四正之宫。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163309574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1762","lineNum":1901,"lineType":1,"content":"坎以水體，申子","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163325958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1763","lineNum":1903,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，水之垣也，故納坎從水。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163325958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1764","lineNum":1903,"lineType":1,"content":"離以火體，寅午戍，火之垣也，","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163342342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1765","lineNum":1905,"lineType":1,"content":"故納離從火。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163342342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1766","lineNum":1905,"lineType":1,"content":"兊以金體，巳酉丑，金之垣也，故納兊從金。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163358726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1767","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505845225898011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1768","lineNum":1909,"lineType":1,"content":"震以木體，亥卯未，木之垣也，故納震從木。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163375110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1769","lineNum":1909,"lineType":1,"content":"此陽支從陽","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163391494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1770","lineNum":1911,"lineType":1,"content":"干，隂支從隂干也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163391494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1771","lineNum":1911,"lineType":1,"content":"於是五氣生成，八卦翕合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163407878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1772","lineNum":1911,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人者因","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163424262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1773","lineNum":1913,"lineType":1,"content":"其至理而消息之，以為妙用，使天陽地隂，一闢一闔，一","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163424262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1774","lineNum":1915,"lineType":1,"content":"造一化，生成無方，有㡬㣲矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163424262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1775","lineNum":1915,"lineType":1,"content":"丹經歴術納甲之説，無出","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163457030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1776","lineNum":1917,"lineType":1,"content":"老子載營魄抱一，能無離乎一章。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163457030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1777","lineNum":1917,"lineType":1,"content":"其以日月言者，謂日","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163473414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1778","lineNum":1919,"lineType":1,"content":"以其光加於月魄而為之明，如人登車而載於其上也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163473414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1779","lineNum":1921,"lineType":1,"content":"月未望而載魄於西，既望則終魄於東，其遡於日乎？","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163489798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1780","lineNum":1921,"lineType":1,"content":"言","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163506182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1781","lineNum":1923,"lineType":1,"content":"月之方生，則以日之光加被於魄之西，而漸滿其東，以","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163506182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1782","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505811415892009"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1783","lineNum":1927,"lineType":1,"content":"至於望而後圓。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163506182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1784","lineNum":1927,"lineType":1,"content":"及既望矣，則以日之光終守其魄之東，","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163522566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1785","lineNum":1929,"lineType":1,"content":"而漸虧其西，以至於晦而後盡。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163522566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1786","lineNum":1929,"lineType":1,"content":"葢月遡日以為明，未望","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163538950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1787","lineNum":1931,"lineType":1,"content":"則日在其右，既望則日在其左，故各自其所在而受光。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163538950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1788","lineNum":1933,"lineType":1,"content":"以卦納之，似非實論。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163555334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1790","lineNum":1937,"lineType":1,"content":"盛徳乘時曰旺。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163588102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1791","lineNum":1937,"lineType":1,"content":"如春木旺，旺則生火，火乃木之子，子乗","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163604486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1792","lineNum":1939,"lineType":1,"content":"父業，故火相。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163604486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1793","lineNum":1939,"lineType":1,"content":"木用水生，生我者父母，今子嗣得時，登髙","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163620870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1794","lineNum":1941,"lineType":1,"content":"明顯赫之地，而生我者當知退矣，故水休。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163620870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1795","lineNum":1941,"lineType":1,"content":"休者，羙之無","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163637254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1796","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505814511124519"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1797","lineNum":1945,"lineType":1,"content":"極，休然無事之義。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163637254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1798","lineNum":1945,"lineType":1,"content":"火能尅金，金乃木之鬼，被火尅制，不","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163653638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1799","lineNum":1947,"lineType":1,"content":"能施設，故金囚。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163653638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1800","lineNum":1947,"lineType":1,"content":"火能生土，土為木之財，財為隠藏之物，","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163670022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1801","lineNum":1949,"lineType":1,"content":"草木發生，土散氣塵。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163670022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1802","lineNum":1949,"lineType":1,"content":"所以春木尅土則死。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163686406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1803","lineNum":1949,"lineType":1,"content":"夏火旺，火生","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163702790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1804","lineNum":1951,"lineType":1,"content":"土則土相，木生火則木休，水尅火則水因，火尅金則金","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163702790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1805","lineNum":1953,"lineType":1,"content":"死。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163702790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1806","lineNum":1953,"lineType":1,"content":"六月土旺，土生金則金相，火生土則火休，木尅土則","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163719174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1807","lineNum":1955,"lineType":1,"content":"木囚，土尅水則水死。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163719174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1808","lineNum":1955,"lineType":1,"content":"秋金旺，金生水則水相，土生金則","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163735558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1809","lineNum":1957,"lineType":1,"content":"土休，火尅金則火囚，金尅木則木死。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163735558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1810","lineNum":1957,"lineType":1,"content":"冬水旺，水生木則","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163751942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1811","lineNum":1959,"lineType":1,"content":"木相，金生水則金休，土尅水則土囚，水尅火則火死。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163751942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1812","lineNum":1959,"lineType":1,"content":"觀","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163768326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1813","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505814511140903"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1814","lineNum":1963,"lineType":1,"content":"夏月大旱，金石流水，土焦；六月暑氣增，寒氣滅；秋月金","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163768326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1815","lineNum":1965,"lineType":1,"content":"勝，草木黄落；冬月大寒太冷，水給氷，火氣頓减。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163768326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1816","lineNum":1965,"lineType":1,"content":"其旺其","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163784710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1817","lineNum":1967,"lineType":1,"content":"死，槩可見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163784710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1818","lineNum":1967,"lineType":1,"content":"葢四時之序，節滿即謝；五行之性，功成必","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163801094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1819","lineNum":1969,"lineType":1,"content":"覆。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163801094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1820","lineNum":1969,"lineType":1,"content":"故陽極而降，隂極而升，日中則昃，月盈則虧，此天之","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163817478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1821","lineNum":1971,"lineType":1,"content":"常道也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163817478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1822","lineNum":1971,"lineType":1,"content":"人生天地，勢積必損，財聚必散，年少反衰，樂極","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163833862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1823","lineNum":1973,"lineType":1,"content":"反悲，此人之常情也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163833862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1824","lineNum":1973,"lineType":1,"content":"故一盛一衰，或得或失，榮枯進退，","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163850246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1825","lineNum":1975,"lineType":1,"content":"難逃此理。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163850246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1826","lineNum":1975,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：人雖靈於萬物，命莫逃乎五行。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163866630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1827","lineNum":1975,"lineType":1,"content":"斯言盡","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163883014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1828","lineNum":1977,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163883014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1829","lineNum":1977,"lineType":1,"content":"夫五行寄生十二官，長生、沐浴、冠帶、臨官、帝旺、衰、病、","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163899398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1830","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505795766910991"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1831","lineNum":1981,"lineType":1,"content":"死、墓、絶、胎、飬，循環無端，週而復始。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163899398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1832","lineNum":1981,"lineType":1,"content":"造物大體與人相似，","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163915782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1833","lineNum":1983,"lineType":1,"content":"循𤨔十二宫，亦若人世輪迴也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163915782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1834","lineNum":1983,"lineType":1,"content":"三命提要云：五行寄生","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163932166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1835","lineNum":1985,"lineType":1,"content":"十二宫，一曰受氣，又曰絶，曰胞，以萬物在地中，未有其","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163932166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1836","lineNum":1987,"lineType":1,"content":"象，如毋腹空，未有物也；二曰受胎，天地氣交，氤氲造物，","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163932166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1837","lineNum":1989,"lineType":1,"content":"其物在地中萌芽，始有其氣，如人受父母之氣也；三曰","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163932166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1838","lineNum":1991,"lineType":1,"content":"成形，萬物在地中成形，如人在母腹成形也；四曰長生，","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163932166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1839","lineNum":1993,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物發生向榮，如人始生而向長也；五曰沐浴，又曰敗，","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163932166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1840","lineNum":1995,"lineType":1,"content":"以萬物始生，形體柔脆，易為所損，如人生後三日，以沐","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163932166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1841","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505856013680674"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1842","lineNum":1999,"lineType":1,"content":"浴之，㡬至困絶也；六曰冠帶，萬物漸榮秀，如人具衣冠","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163932166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1843","lineNum":2001,"lineType":1,"content":"也；七曰臨官，萬物既秀實，如人之臨官也；八曰帝旺，萬","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163932166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1844","lineNum":2003,"lineType":1,"content":"物成熟，如人之興旺也；九曰衰，萬物形衰，如人之氣衰","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163932166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1845","lineNum":2005,"lineType":1,"content":"也；十曰病，萬物病，如人之病也；十一曰死，萬物死，如人","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163932166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1846","lineNum":2007,"lineType":1,"content":"之死也；十二曰墓，又曰庫，以萬物成功而藏之庫，如人","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163932166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1847","lineNum":2009,"lineType":1,"content":"之終而歸墓也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163932166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1848","lineNum":2009,"lineType":1,"content":"歸墓則又受氣胞胎而生。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163948550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1849","lineNum":2009,"lineType":1,"content":"凡推造化，見","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163964934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1850","lineNum":2011,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺者，未必便作吉論；見休、囚死絶，未必便作凶言。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163964934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1851","lineNum":2011,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163981318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1852","lineNum":2013,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺太過，宜乎制伏；死絶不及，宜乎生扶。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163981318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1853","lineNum":2013,"lineType":1,"content":"妙在識其通","logicSentenceId":"7634120732163997702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1854","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505820638969907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1855","lineNum":2017,"lineType":1,"content":"變。","logicSentence
