{"lines":[{"lineId":"1900","lineNum":2077,"lineType":1,"content":"凡論人命，年月日時，排成四柱，遁月從年，則以年為本；","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519317540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1901","lineNum":2079,"lineType":1,"content":"遁時從日，則以日為主。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519317540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1902","lineNum":2079,"lineType":1,"content":"古法以年看子平，以日看本。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519333924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1903","lineNum":2079,"lineType":1,"content":"此","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519350308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1904","lineNum":2081,"lineType":1,"content":"如人本木而得夘月以乗之，主金而得酉時以乗之，謂","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519350308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1905","lineNum":2083,"lineType":1,"content":"之本主乗旺氣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519350308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1906","lineNum":2083,"lineType":1,"content":"如本水而得甲申、丙子、壬戍、癸亥月，主","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519366692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1907","lineNum":2085,"lineType":1,"content":"火而得丙寅、戊午、甲辰、乙巳時，本木而得巳亥、辛卯、甲","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519366692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1908","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505856013713442"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1909","lineNum":2089,"lineType":1,"content":"寅、庚寅月，主金而得辛巳、癸酉、庚申、壬申時，謂之本主","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519366692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1910","lineNum":2091,"lineType":1,"content":"還家。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519366692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1911","lineNum":2091,"lineType":1,"content":"本木而得癸未月，主金而得乙丑時，本水而得壬","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519383076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1912","lineNum":2093,"lineType":1,"content":"辰月，主火而得甲戍時，謂之本主持印。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519383076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinY lineType":1,"content":"用。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519481380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1927","lineNum":2109,"lineType":1,"content":"况用神多取諸月，是月又可輕乎？","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519497764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1928","lineNum":2109,"lineType":1,"content":"唐李虚中獨以日","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519514148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1929","lineNum":2111,"lineType":1,"content":"干為主，却以年月時合㸔，生尅制化，旺相休囚，取立格","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519514148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1930","lineNum":2113,"lineType":1,"content":"局。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519514148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1931","lineNum":2113,"lineType":1,"content":"譬之衡焉，年如衡鈎，綰起其物；月如綱紐，提起其物；","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519530532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1932","lineNum":2115,"lineType":1,"content":"日如衡身，星兩不差，錘分輕重，分毫加减。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519530532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1933","lineNum":2115,"lineType":1,"content":"此發前賢所","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519546916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1934","lineNum":2117,"lineType":1,"content":"未發，故今術家宗之。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519546916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1935","lineNum":2117,"lineType":1,"content":"然古人論命，分三主，定三限，以年","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519563300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1936","lineNum":2119,"lineType":1,"content":"與月，管初主；月與日，管中主；日與時，管末主。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519563300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1937","lineNum":2119,"lineType":1,"content":"其法與星","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519579684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1938","lineNum":2121,"lineType":1,"content":"歴家分三主同。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732519579684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1939","lineNum":2121,"lineType":1,"content":"若初主星當生年，得力，則初主好，不得","logicSentenceI {"lines":[{"lineId":"2044","lineNum":2235,"lineType":1,"content":"夫胎者，受形之始，故易乾知太始，以形言也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520480804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2045","lineNum":2235,"lineType":1,"content":"月者，成氣","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520497188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2046","lineNum":2237,"lineType":1,"content":"之時，故傳曰積日為月，以氣言也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520497188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2047","lineNum":2237,"lineType":1,"content":"今談命或不以胎月","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520513572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2048","lineNum":2239,"lineType":1,"content":"為重，殊不思胎月是四柱之根苗，日時雖為𦂳，若不犯","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520513572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2049","lineNum":2241,"lineType":1,"content":"破胎月，或乘旺氣禄馬之處，則為福尤多。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520513572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2050","lineNum":2241,"lineType":1,"content":"或日時之吉，","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520529956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2051","lineNum":2243,"lineType":1,"content":"而為胎月所犯，則吉亦歸無用，是胎月最為樞要。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520529956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2052","lineNum":2243,"lineType":1,"content":"玉湖","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520546340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2053","lineNum":2245,"lineType":1,"content":"專論胎數，良有以也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520546340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2054","lineNum":2245,"lineType":1,"content":"今人多以法取胎元，未審精當。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520562724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2055","lineNum":2245,"lineType":1,"content":"且","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520579108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2056","lineNum":2247,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子生甲寅月，往往便以一巳為胎，葢言乙巳是生月","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520579108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2057","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505857192329270"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2058","lineNum":2251,"lineType":1,"content":"前十日，更不明其中有閏無閏。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520579108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2059","lineNum":2251,"lineType":1,"content":"或取日特以生日支干","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520595492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2060","lineNum":2253,"lineType":1,"content":"合者為受胎之時，中有不值干支合全者，亦取之無據。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520595492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2061","lineNum":2255,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有一法，以當生前三百日為十月之氣，乃是受胎之","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520611876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2062","lineNum":2257,"lineType":1,"content":"正。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520611876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2063","lineNum":2257,"lineType":1,"content":"譬甲子日生，便以甲子為受胎之日，葢五六計三百","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520628260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2064","lineNum":2259,"lineType":1,"content":"日，看其生日在何月中，有則閏在其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520628260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2065","lineNum":2259,"lineType":1,"content":"且如戊子生","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520644644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2066","lineNum":2261,"lineType":1,"content":"人，甲寅月乙丑日，湏於半月前十月或十一月內，尋當","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520644644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2067","lineNum":2263,"lineType":1,"content":"生乙丑日，乃是三百日之正。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520644644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2068","lineNum":2263,"lineType":1,"content":"胎經云：胎生元命，前人言","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520661028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2069","lineNum":2265,"lineType":1,"content":"如子生得子胎，丑生得丑胎，此説亦未善。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520661028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2070","lineNum":2265,"lineType":1,"content":"且如辛未生","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520677412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2071","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505861214584851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2072","lineNum":2269,"lineType":1,"content":"得壬辰月，以癸未為胎，辛未土受癸未木制為身鬼，又","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520677412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2073","lineNum":2271,"lineType":1,"content":"何以謂之胎生元命？","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520677412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2074","lineNum":2271,"lineType":1,"content":"五行相尅，𠔥胎處六害之地，縱使","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520693796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2075","lineNum":2273,"lineType":1,"content":"日時為福，亦主獨强自立者歟！","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520693796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2076","lineNum":2273,"lineType":1,"content":"蘭臺妙選有子歸母腹","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520710180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2077","lineNum":2275,"lineType":1,"content":"格，謂金年受胎，逢土年生者吉，火年生者凶。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520710180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2078","lineNum":2275,"lineType":1,"content":"月日時相","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520726564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2079","lineNum":2277,"lineType":1,"content":"生則吉，相尅則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520726564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2080","lineNum":2277,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：凡人胎數長，壽必長，胎數短，夀","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520742948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2081","lineNum":2279,"lineType":1,"content":"必短。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520742948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2082","lineNum":2279,"lineType":1,"content":"常以受胎隔零數為夀限，遇徳却於零數增之，遇","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520759332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2083","lineNum":2281,"lineType":1,"content":"煞於零數减之。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520759332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2084","lineNum":2281,"lineType":1,"content":"受胎不深者，不能耐乆，廢即易休，更看","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520775716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2085","lineNum":2283,"lineType":1,"content":"納音何如。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520775716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2086","lineNum":2283,"lineType":1,"content":"若胎時支干納音相生，不刑戰者，主夀。","logicSentenceId":"7634120732520792100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2087","lineNum":2283,"lineType":1,"content":"希尹","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563551750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2088","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505861214601235"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2089","lineNum":2287,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：胎月見貴，必受福蔭，刑衝破害，决主艱辛。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563551750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2090","lineNum":2287,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼谷子曰：","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563568134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2091","lineNum":2289,"lineType":1,"content":"胎中如有禄，生在貴豪家。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563568134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2092","lineNum":2289,"lineType":1,"content":"或值空亡中，貧窮起怨嗟。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563584518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2093","lineNum":2289,"lineType":1,"content":"古","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563600902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2094","lineNum":2291,"lineType":1,"content":"詩云：時為末主胎為夀，盡在末年五十後。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563600902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2095","lineNum":2291,"lineType":1,"content":"帝座朝胎生","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563617286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2096","lineNum":2293,"lineType":1,"content":"氣結，看取壽年多老耄。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563617286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2097","lineNum":2293,"lineType":1,"content":"意葢謂此。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563633670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2098","lineNum":2293,"lineType":1,"content":"據胎分經，人懐胎二","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563650054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2099","lineNum":2295,"lineType":1,"content":"百七十日而生，醫家以十月産者，計其血臟乾濕之一","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563650054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2100","lineNum":2297,"lineType":1,"content":"月也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563650054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2101","lineNum":2297,"lineType":1,"content":"况人有多月生者，少月生者，以何為准？","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563666438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2102","lineNum":2297,"lineType":1,"content":"多月生者，","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563682822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2103","lineNum":2299,"lineType":1,"content":"不但古今可考，就余所知者二三人，俱是貧家。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563682822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2104","lineNum":2299,"lineType":1,"content":"少月生","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563699206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2105","lineNum":2301,"lineType":1,"content":"如杜拯都憲，止七個月，余與同僚，親聞渠説。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563699206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2106","lineNum":2301,"lineType":1,"content":"又呉淵頴","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563715590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2107","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505845225996315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2108","lineNum":2305,"lineType":1,"content":"先生來、宋文憲公濓，俱姙七月而生。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563715590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2109","lineNum":2305,"lineType":1,"content":"然則貴人受胎，定","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563731974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2110","lineNum":2307,"lineType":1,"content":"在三百日，又豈可據乎？","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563731974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2112","lineNum":2311,"lineType":1,"content":"神無廟無所歸，人無室無所棲，命無宫無所主，故有命","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563764742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2113","lineNum":2313,"lineType":1,"content":"宫之説。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563764742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2114","lineNum":2313,"lineType":1,"content":"不然，流年星辰為凶為吉，以何憑據？","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563781126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2115","lineNum":2313,"lineType":1,"content":"此法看是","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563797510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2116","lineNum":2315,"lineType":1,"content":"何月生人，坐於何時，然後方定命坐何宫。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563797510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2117","lineNum":2315,"lineType":1,"content":"先将所生之","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563813894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2118","lineNum":2317,"lineType":1,"content":"月從子上起，正月亥上，二月戌，三酉，四申，五未，六午，七","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563813894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2119","lineNum":2319,"lineType":1,"content":"巳，八辰，九夘，十寅，十一丑，十二逆行十二位。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563813894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2120","lineNum":2319,"lineType":1,"content":"次将所生","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563830278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2121","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505822052483112"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2122","lineNum":2323,"lineType":1,"content":"之時加於所生之月，順行十二位，逢卯即安命宫。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563830278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2123","lineNum":2323,"lineType":1,"content":"經云","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563846662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2124","lineNum":2325,"lineType":1,"content":"天輪轉出地輪上，卯上分明是命宫是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563846662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2125","lineNum":2325,"lineType":1,"content":"假令甲子年","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563863046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2126","lineNum":2327,"lineType":1,"content":"三月生人，得戍時生，却将正月加子，二月在亥，三月在","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563863046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2127","lineNum":2329,"lineType":1,"content":"戍為止，又将戍時加在戍上，亥上亥，子上子，丑上丑，寅","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563863046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2128","lineNum":2331,"lineType":1,"content":"上寅，卯上卯，逢卯便是，即命坐卯宫是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563863046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2129","lineNum":2331,"lineType":1,"content":"仍隨甲子年","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563879430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2130","lineNum":2333,"lineType":1,"content":"起，亦如起月之法，甲已之年丙作首，乃丁夘宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563879430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2131","lineNum":2333,"lineType":1,"content":"次看","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563895814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2132","lineNum":2335,"lineType":1,"content":"三方并本命流干，犯何星凶吉，推之","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563895814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2134","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505856013762594"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2135","lineNum":2341,"lineType":1,"content":"夫運者，人生之傳舍。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563928582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2136","lineNum":2341,"lineType":1,"content":"探命之説，先以三元、四柱、五行生","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563944966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2137","lineNum":2343,"lineType":1,"content":"死格局致合以定根基，然後考覈運氣，協而從之，以定","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563944966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2138","lineNum":2345,"lineType":1,"content":"平生之吉凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563944966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2139","lineNum":2345,"lineType":1,"content":"且根基如木，運氣如春，春無木而不著，","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563961350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2140","lineNum":2347,"lineType":1,"content":"木無春而不榮。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563961350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2141","lineNum":2347,"lineType":1,"content":"賦以根基淺薄者，如蒿萊之㣲，春風潜","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563977734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2142","lineNum":2349,"lineType":1,"content":"發，亦能敷茂，豈能乆耶？","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563977734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2143","lineNum":2349,"lineType":1,"content":"根基厚壮者，如松柏之實，不為","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563994118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2144","lineNum":2351,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗寒所變。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733563994118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2145","lineNum":2351,"lineType":1,"content":"此所謂先論根基，後言運氣者歟？","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564010502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2146","lineNum":2351,"lineType":1,"content":"古人以大","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564026886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2147","lineNum":2353,"lineType":1,"content":"運則一辰十嵗，折除以三日為年者何？","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564026886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2148","lineNum":2353,"lineType":1,"content":"葢一月之終，晦","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564043270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2149","lineNum":2355,"lineType":1,"content":"朔周而有三十日；一日之終，晝夜周而有十二時。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564043270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2150","lineNum":2355,"lineType":1,"content":"總十","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564059654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2151","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505857192362038"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2152","lineNum":2359,"lineType":1,"content":"年之運氣，凡三日有三十六時，乃見三百六十日，為一","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564059654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2153","lineNum":2361,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗之數。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564059654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2154","lineNum":2361,"lineType":1,"content":"在一月之中有三百六十時，折除節氣算計三","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564076038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2155","lineNum":2363,"lineType":1,"content":"千六百日，為一辰之十嵗也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564076038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2156","lineNum":2363,"lineType":1,"content":"人生以百二十嵗為周天，","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564092422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2157","lineNum":2365,"lineType":1,"content":"論折除之法，必用生者日歴過日時數其節氣之數，陽","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564092422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2158","lineNum":2367,"lineType":1,"content":"男隂女，大運以生日後未來節氣日時為數，順而行之；","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564092422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2159","lineNum":2369,"lineType":1,"content":"隂男陽女，大運以生日前過去節氣日時為數，逆而行","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564092422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2160","lineNum":2371,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564092422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2161","lineNum":2371,"lineType":1,"content":"假如甲子陽男十二月二十四日巳時生，是月也，二","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564108806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2162","lineNum":2373,"lineType":1,"content":"十九日申時立春，陽男數以未來之日，自二十四日巳","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564108806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505820639100979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2164","lineNum":2377,"lineType":1,"content":"時至二十五日巳時，方是一日之實數，至二十九申時，","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564108806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2165","lineNum":2379,"lineType":1,"content":"正得五日三時之節氣，實歴過六十三日折除，過六十","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564108806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2166","lineNum":2381,"lineType":1,"content":"三時折除計六百三十日，乃一嵗竒九月之大運。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564108806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2167","lineNum":2381,"lineType":1,"content":"起於","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564125190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2168","lineNum":2383,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑，必自十二月生日後，實經厯過二十有一之日月，","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564125190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2169","lineNum":2385,"lineType":1,"content":"運方移宫，是越三嵗九月之內，方是甲子十二月生，行","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564125190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2170","lineNum":2387,"lineType":1,"content":"一嵗竒九月之大運也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564125190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2171","lineNum":2387,"lineType":1,"content":"今人行運多用約法，論以一嵗","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564141574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2172","lineNum":2389,"lineType":1,"content":"竒八月起運，便以二嵗，殊不明折除實厯之數也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564141574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2173","lineNum":239 {"lines":[{"lineId":"2198","lineNum":2421,"lineType":1,"content":"凡行運在干，𠔥用地支之神，在支則棄天干之物。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564338182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2199","lineNum":2421,"lineType":1,"content":"葢大","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564354566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2200","lineNum":2423,"lineType":1,"content":"運重地支，故有行南方、南方、西方、北方之辨。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564354566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2201","lineNum":2423,"lineType":1,"content":"損用神者，","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564370950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2202","lineNum":2425,"lineType":1,"content":"欲運制之。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564370950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2203","lineNum":2425,"lineType":1,"content":"益用神者，欲運生之。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564387334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2204","lineNum":2425,"lineType":1,"content":"身弱欲運引進旺鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564403718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2205","lineNum":2425,"lineType":1,"content":"官","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564420102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2206","lineNum":2427,"lineType":1,"content":"欲運生，不欲運傷。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564420102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2207","lineNum":2427,"lineType":1,"content":"煞欲運制，不欲運助。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564436486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2208","lineNum":2427,"lineType":1,"content":"財欲運扶，不欲","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564452870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2209","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505868776914959"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2210","lineNum":2431,"lineType":1,"content":"運刼。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564452870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2211","lineNum":2431,"lineType":1,"content":"印欲運旺，不欲運衰。","logicSentenc 1,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱得煞深，迎運便發；得氣淺，湏","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564616710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2226","lineNum":2443,"lineType":1,"content":"交過運始發。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564616710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2227","lineNum":2443,"lineType":1,"content":"得其中氣，運至中則發。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564633094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2228","lineNum":2443,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭子云：其為氣","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564649478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2229","lineNum":2445,"lineType":1,"content":"也，将來者進，成功者退。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564649478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2230","lineNum":2445,"lineType":1,"content":"瑩和尚云：迎之以臨官帝旺，将","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564665862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2231","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505822052532264"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2232","lineNum":2449,"lineType":1,"content":"來者進。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564665862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2233","lineNum":2449,"lineType":1,"content":"背之以休廢死絶，成功者退。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564682246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2234","lineNum":2449,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：生逢休敗之","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564698630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2235","lineNum":2451,"lineType":1,"content":"地，早嵗孤貧。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564698630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2236","lineNum":2451,"lineType":1,"content":"老邁徤旺之鄉，臨年偃蹇。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564715014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2237","lineNum":2451,"lineType":1,"content":"瑩和尚云：身須","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564731398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2238","lineNum":2453,"lineType":1,"content":"逐運，必假運而資身；勢須及時，亦假時而成勢。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564731398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2239","lineNum":2453,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：生","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564747782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2240","lineNum":2455,"lineType":1,"content":"逢旺嵗，運湏處於旺鄉；晚遇衰年，運恰宜於困地。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564747782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2241","lineNum":2455,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564764166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2242","lineNum":2457,"lineType":1,"content":"子曰：老幼慎勿坐强，壮實惟宜趨旺。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564764166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2243","lineNum":2457,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺雖吉，而未必","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564780550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2244","lineNum":2459,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，衰滅雖凶，而未必凶。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564780550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2245","lineNum":2459,"lineType":1,"content":"達此者，始可論運。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564796934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2246","lineNum":2459,"lineType":1,"content":"葢人自生至","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564813318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2247","lineNum":2461,"lineType":1,"content":"老，必從㣲以至少壮。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564813318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2248","lineNum":2461,"lineType":1,"content":"十嵗之時，方當少年，惟可行胎、養","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564829702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2249","lineNum":2463,"lineType":1,"content":"生、沐浴、冠帯處。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564829702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2250","lineNum":2463,"lineType":1,"content":"三十、四十，當陽强齒壮之時，可行旺處。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564846086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2251","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505868776931343"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2252","lineNum":2467,"lineType":1,"content":"五十、六十，天癸枯竭，只可行衰敗、死絶。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564862470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2253","lineNum":2467,"lineType":1,"content":"反此者，謂之一","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564878854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2254","lineNum":2469,"lineType":1,"content":"生運背，三限驅馳，直饒晚入旺鄉，巳非符叶。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564878854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2255","lineNum":2469,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：命中","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564895238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2256","lineNum":2471,"lineType":1,"content":"五行衰者，運宜盛；五行盛者，運宜衰。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564895238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2257","lineNum":2471,"lineType":1,"content":"衰者復行衰運，是","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564911622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2258","lineNum":2473,"lineType":1,"content":"謂不及，不及則迍蹇沉滯。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564911622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2259","lineNum":2473,"lineType":1,"content":"盛者復行盛運，是謂太過，過","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564928006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2260","lineNum":2475,"lineType":1,"content":"則擊作成敗要歸於中而巳。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564928006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2261","lineNum":2475,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭子云：年雖逢於冠帶，","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564944390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2262","lineNum":2477,"lineType":1,"content":"尚有餘災；運初入於衰鄉，猶披尠福。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564944390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2263","lineNum":2477,"lineType":1,"content":"王氏註云：年運或","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564960774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2264","lineNum":2479,"lineType":1,"content":"初離沐浴、暴敗之地，順行至冠帯，未可便以為福，尚有","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564960774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2265","lineNum":2481,"lineType":1,"content":"衰敗之餘災也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564960774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2266","lineNum":2481,"lineType":1,"content":"或自旺地而行，初入衰鄉，亦不可便以","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564977158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2267","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505802754670630"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2268","lineNum":2485,"lineType":1,"content":"為福，猶披旺鄉之尠福也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564977158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2269","lineNum":2485,"lineType":1,"content":"行運所以有前後五年之説。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733564993542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2270","lineNum":2487,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子曰：将徹不徹，寕有久否之殃；欲交不交，尚有㡬","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565009926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2271","lineNum":2489,"lineType":1,"content":"殘之禍。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565009926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2272","lineNum":2489,"lineType":1,"content":"葢言運行在衰絶之處，将入吉慶之地，必於臨","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565026310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2273","lineNum":2491,"lineType":1,"content":"離之時，更有重撓。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565026310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2274","lineNum":2491,"lineType":1,"content":"運在吉慶之地，将入衰絶之處，必於","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565042694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2275","lineNum":2493,"lineType":1,"content":"初入之時，更有重福。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565042694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2276","lineNum":2493,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：吉運未到先作福，㐫運過去","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565059078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2277","lineNum":2495,"lineType":1,"content":"始為殃。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565059078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2278","lineNum":2495,"lineType":1,"content":"乃火未熖而先烟，水既徃而猶濕之理，當更詳","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565075462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2279","lineNum":2497,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565075462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2280","lineNum":2497,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：隂男陽女，時觀出入之年；隂女陽男，更看元辰","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565091846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2281","lineNum":2499,"lineType":1,"content":"之嵗。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565091846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2282","lineNum":2499,"lineType":1,"content":"葢言隂男陽女，禀氣不順，故大運時，觀出運入運","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565108230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2283","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505845226045467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2284","lineNum":2503,"lineType":1,"content":"之年，而有吉凶之𠮓。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565108230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2285","lineNum":2503,"lineType":1,"content":"陽男隂女，禀氣雖順，不以出入之","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565124614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2286","lineNum":2505,"lineType":1,"content":"年為應，亦不可遇元辰之厄㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565124614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2287","lineNum":2505,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子云：元辰犯運，仲","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565140998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2288","lineNum":2507,"lineType":1,"content":"尼困陳蔡之饑是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565140998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2289","lineNum":2509,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：凡大運行有益處，為吉泰之運，亦不能常為福，須","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565157382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2290","lineNum":2511,"lineType":1,"content":"候太嵗行年，更於生旺和合，方可發福。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565157382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2291","lineNum":2511,"lineType":1,"content":"若大運至吉鄉，","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565173766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2292","lineNum":2513,"lineType":1,"content":"却遇逐年太嵗，小運到刑害之鄉，亦主細累浮灾，但不","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565173766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2293","lineNum":2515,"lineType":1,"content":"為重害也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120733565173766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2294","lineNum":2515,"lineType":1,"content":"若大運行迍蹇凶禍之地，逐年太嵗又見刑","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008148031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2295","lineNum":2517,"lineType":1,"content":"衝，小運不和，衝擊死絶，方主發禍。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008148031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2296","lineNum":2517,"lineType":1,"content":"若小運與太嵗到生","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008164415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2297","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505850795917350"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2298","lineNum":2521,"lineType":1,"content":"旺禄馬貴人，一切吉神，其年却有小慶，過去則否。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008164415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2299","lineNum":2521,"lineType":1,"content":"燭神","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008180799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2300","lineNum":2523,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：凡推命之禍福，須先度量基地厚薄，然後定灾福。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008180799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2301","lineNum":2525,"lineType":1,"content":"如命有十分福氣，行三四分惡運，都不覺凶，福力厚故","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008197183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2302","lineNum":2527,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008197183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2303","lineNum":2527,"lineType":1,"content":"若五六分惡運，只浮災細累而巳。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008213567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2304","lineNum":2527,"lineType":1,"content":"至七八分惡運，方","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008229951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2305","lineNum":2529,"lineType":1,"content":"有重灾。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008229951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2306","lineNum":2529,"lineType":1,"content":"如命有五分福氣，行三四分惡運，為甚凶。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008246335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2307","lineNum":2529,"lineType":1,"content":"若四","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008262719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2308","lineNum":2531,"lineType":1,"content":"五分惡運，則須死，葢基地不牢故也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008262719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2309","lineNum":2531,"lineType":1,"content":"若大運曾歴過本","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008279103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2310","lineNum":2533,"lineType":1,"content":"命長生處者，謂之氣盛之運，雖嵗運來衝尅者，為禍不","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008279103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2311","lineNum":2535,"lineType":1,"content":"重，運氣强故也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008279103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2312","lineNum":2535,"lineType":1,"content":"未經長生而嵗運刑衝尅破，則便為灾，","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008295487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2313","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505861214666771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2314","lineNum":2539,"lineType":1,"content":"葢氣未偹，運弱故也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008295487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2315","lineNum":2539,"lineType":1,"content":"若曽過旺相而逢死絶，如命不吉，","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008311871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2316","lineNum":2541,"lineType":1,"content":"為災亦輕，隂陽五行代謝之順道也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008311871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2317","lineNum":2541,"lineType":1,"content":"縱死於此，亦須令","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008328255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2318","lineNum":2543,"lineType":1,"content":"疾而終。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008328255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2319","lineNum":2543,"lineType":1,"content":"若方經長生，厯於敗地，其中有刑尅惡煞與命","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008344639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2320","lineNum":2545,"lineType":1,"content":"相符而見者，則五行之氣反戰，故有㐫惡而終。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008344639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2321","lineNum":2547,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：凡行運長生，主有創建作新之事。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008361023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2322","lineNum":2547,"lineType":1,"content":"到臨官帝旺，主","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008377407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2323","lineNum":2549,"lineType":1,"content":"興盛快樂，發福進財，生子骨肉之慶。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008377407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2324","lineNum":2549,"lineType":1,"content":"到衰病之鄉，多退","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008393791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2325","lineNum":2551,"lineType":1,"content":"敗破財，疾病等事。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008393791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2326","lineNum":2551,"lineType":1,"content":"到死絶鄉，主骨肉死䘮，自身衰禍鈍","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008410175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2327","lineNum":2553,"lineType":1,"content":"悶，百事蹇塞。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008410175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2328","lineNum":2553,"lineType":1,"content":"到敗運，主落魄懶惰，酒色昏迷。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008426559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2329","lineNum":2553,"lineType":1,"content":"到胎庫，成","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008442943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2330","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505856013811746"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2331","lineNum":2557,"lineType":1,"content":"形冠帶之鄉，百事得中，安康平易。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008442943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2332","lineNum":2557,"lineType":1,"content":"凡行運至夾貴華葢","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008459327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2333","lineNum":2559,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人六合上，及乗生旺氣者，皆主善慶。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008459327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2334","lineNum":2559,"lineType":1,"content":"仍湏察當生根","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008475711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2335","lineNum":2561,"lineType":1,"content":"基，十分則應五分，生時五分則應十分，福與災同。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008475711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2336","lineNum":2561,"lineType":1,"content":"凡行","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008492095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2337","lineNum":2563,"lineType":1,"content":"運至臨官帝旺上，太嵗持之，官員主薦章改秩之喜，官","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008492095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2338","lineNum":2565,"lineType":1,"content":"印食神亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008492095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2339","lineNum":2565,"lineType":1,"content":"馬旺貴人之地，必入叅侍之列，葢貴為君","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008508479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2340","lineNum":2567,"lineType":1,"content":"道，馬主遷動故也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008508479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2341","lineNum":2569,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：凡子、丑、寅、卯、辰、巳四柱陽多人，行運至午、未、申、酉、","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008524863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2342","lineNum":2571,"lineType":1,"content":"戍、亥上，乗隂氣而發。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008524863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2343","lineNum":2571,"lineType":1,"content":"午、未、申、酉、戍、亥四柱隂多人，行子、","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008541247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2344","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505861214683155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2345","lineNum":2575,"lineType":1,"content":"丑、寅、卯、辰、巳運，乘陽氣而發。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008541247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2346","lineNum":2575,"lineType":1,"content":"二者隂陽均恊，然隂人陽","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008557631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2347","lineNum":2577,"lineType":1,"content":"發者快，陽人隂發者遲。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008557631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2348","lineNum":2579,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：凡水命四柱有土，至火運，本是財運，却反為鬼者，","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008574015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2349","lineNum":2581,"lineType":1,"content":"以火生土，土尅水，是財化為鬼，轉福成禍。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008574015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2350","lineNum":2581,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱有金，至","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008590399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2351","lineNum":2583,"lineType":1,"content":"土運是鬼運，却反為吉者，以土生金，金生水，是化鬼為","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008590399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2352","lineNum":2585,"lineType":1,"content":"助氣，反禍為福。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008590399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2353","lineNum":2585,"lineType":1,"content":"又如水命人柱有寅午戍，或納音火，更","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008606783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2354","lineNum":2587,"lineType":1,"content":"行寅午戍，皆為好運。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008606783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2355","lineNum":2587,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱有金有火，固是為，若行水","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008623167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2356","lineNum":2589,"lineType":1,"content":"運，則分擘其福，即為不好運。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008623167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2357","lineNum":2589,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱多土，却行木運，名曰","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008639551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2358","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505822052548648"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2359","lineNum":2593,"lineType":1,"content":"損氣，主駁雜，雖有救，亦多辛苦歇滅，餘倣此推。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008639551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2360","lineNum":2595,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：丁丑人行丁未運，名曰将凡入聖，以假為真，不以","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008655935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2361","lineNum":2597,"lineType":1,"content":"退人論。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008655935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2362","lineNum":2597,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱有丁丑、丁未者，不在此限。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008672319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2363","lineNum":2597,"lineType":1,"content":"若戊寅人行丁","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008688703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2364","lineNum":2599,"lineType":1,"content":"丑運，雖是退神，却有濟化為福。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008688703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2365","lineNum":2599,"lineType":1,"content":"若庚辰生人，或庚辰月","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008705087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2366","lineNum":2601,"lineType":1,"content":"行乙酉運，乙酉生人或乙酉月行庚辰運，名曰鴛鴦兩，","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008705087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2367","lineNum":2603,"lineType":1,"content":"兩主發跡，但重叠者不佳。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008705087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2368","lineNum":2603,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚人酉年月日時者，大凶。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008721471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2369","lineNum":2605,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申人行丙寅運，名曰力停相衝，主破財爭競，屈伸不","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008737855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2370","lineNum":2607,"lineType":1,"content":"辨。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008737855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2371","lineNum":2607,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戍人行辛夘運，主鈍滯，只宜武人。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008754239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2372","lineNum":2607,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子人行壬寅","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008770623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2373","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505814511222823"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2374","lineNum":2611,"lineType":1,"content":"運，壬入丙家，破財不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008770623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2375","lineNum":2611,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此推。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008787007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2376","lineNum":2613,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：凡命有氣象，常取生時干神為氣，四柱干神為象。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008803391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2377","lineNum":2615,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲時、巳時則有土氣，乙庚金氣，丙辛水氣之類為化","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008819775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2378","lineNum":2617,"lineType":1,"content":"象，甲、乙、丙丁為本𧰼。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008819775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2379","lineNum":2617,"lineType":1,"content":"行運至氣象得地處吉，不得地處","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008836159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2380","lineNum":2619,"lineType":1,"content":"凶。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008836159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2381","lineNum":2619,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛、壬癸、乙庚、丙辛為金，水象，運至申、酉、丑上得地。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008852543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2382","lineNum":2621,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛、戊巳、甲巳、乙庚，為金，土象，運至申、酉、辰上得地。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008868927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2383","lineNum":2621,"lineType":1,"content":"庚","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008885311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2384","lineNum":2623,"lineType":1,"content":"辛、丙丁、乙庚、戊癸，為金，火象，運至巳、午、戊上得地。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008885311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2385","lineNum":2623,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛、","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008901695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2386","lineNum":2625,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙、乙庚、丁壬，為金，木象，運至丑、寅、卯土得地。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008901695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2387","lineNum":2625,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙、壬","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008918079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2388","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505845226061851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2389","lineNum":2629,"lineType":1,"content":"癸、丁壬、丙辛，為水，木象，運至亥、子、辰上得地。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008918079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2390","lineNum":2629,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁、甲乙、","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008934463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2391","lineNum":2631,"lineType":1,"content":"戊癸、丁壬，為火，木象，運至寅、卯、未上得地。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008934463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2392","lineNum":2631,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳、壬癸、甲","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008950847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2393","lineNum":2633,"lineType":1,"content":"已、丙辛，為水，土象，運至辰上得地。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008950847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2394","lineNum":2633,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳、丙丁、戊癸、甲巳，","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008967231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2395","lineNum":2635,"lineType":1,"content":"為火，土象，運至戍上得地。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008967231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2396","lineNum":2635,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳、甲乙、甲巳、丁壬，為土，木","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008983615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2397","lineNum":2637,"lineType":1,"content":"象，運至未上得地。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008983615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2398","lineNum":2637,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳、庚辛、乙庚、甲巳，為金土象。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734008999999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2399","lineNum":2637,"lineType":1,"content":"運至","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009016383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2400","lineNum":2639,"lineType":1,"content":"丑上得地，看四柱干神得何象。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009016383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2401","lineNum":2639,"lineType":1,"content":"如鈍金、木、水、火、土亦為","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009032767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2402","lineNum":2641,"lineType":1,"content":"五象。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009032767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2403","lineNum":2641,"lineType":1,"content":"若雜而不入象者不發，發亦不乆。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009049151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2404","lineNum":2641,"lineType":1,"content":"如五鈍象，亦有","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009065535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2405","lineNum":2643,"lineType":1,"content":"太過之象，仍詳當生月令得地。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009065535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2406","lineNum":2643,"lineType":1,"content":"然得看行運得地不得","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009081919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2407","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505861214715923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2408","lineNum":2647,"lineType":1,"content":"地而言，不可以遇禄馬貴人為得運，遇空亡陽刄、刼煞","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009081919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2409","lineNum":2649,"lineType":1,"content":"為失運也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009081919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2410","lineNum":2651,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：凡行運看納音，年庚金木水火、土是何命人，如土","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009098303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2411","lineNum":2653,"lineType":1,"content":"命而行西南方，為西南得朋之慶。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009098303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2412","lineNum":2653,"lineType":1,"content":"木命而行東方，火命","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009114687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2413","lineNum":2655,"lineType":1,"content":"而行南方，金命而行西方，水命而行北方，皆為得地。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009114687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2414","lineNum":2655,"lineType":1,"content":"更","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009131071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2415","lineNum":2657,"lineType":1,"content":"看所行之運，納音與命相孚同類，最為上吉，財官次之。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009131071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2416","lineNum":2659,"lineType":1,"content":"若泄氣或受尅重則不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009147455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2417","lineNum":2661,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：古人以甲子丑丑名支干，六十甲子用花字，是皆","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009163839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2418","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505856013828130"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2419","lineNum":2665,"lineType":1,"content":"以木喻義。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009163839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2420","lineNum":2665,"lineType":1,"content":"若天干地支得時，自然開花結子茂盛。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009180223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2421","lineNum":2665,"lineType":1,"content":"月令","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009196607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2422","lineNum":2667,"lineType":1,"content":"者，天元也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009196607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2423","lineNum":2667,"lineType":1,"content":"命運就月上起，譬之樹苗，樹之見苗則知其","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009212991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2424","lineNum":2669,"lineType":1,"content":"名，月之用神，則知其格，故謂交運如同换木命，有根苗","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009212991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2425","lineNum":2671,"lineType":1,"content":"花實，正此意也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009212991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2426","lineNum":2671,"lineType":1,"content":"若出癸入甲，譬反汗之人，多主不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009229375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2427","lineNum":2671,"lineType":1,"content":"古","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009245759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2428","lineNum":2673,"lineType":1,"content":"語云：傷寒换陽，行運换甲，换過是人，換不過是鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009245759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2429","lineNum":2673,"lineType":1,"content":"假如","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009262143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2430","lineNum":2675,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戍接癸亥，是火土接水，丑交寅，辰交巳，未交申，戍交","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009262143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2431","lineNum":2677,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，東西南北，四方轉角，謂移根接木。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009262143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2432","lineNum":2677,"lineType":1,"content":"更遇換甲格，凶者","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009278527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2433","lineNum":2679,"lineType":1,"content":"多死，善者亦災，老人大忌，後生差慢。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009278527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2434","lineNum":2679,"lineType":1,"content":"若寅卯辰巳午未","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009294911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2435","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505857192427574"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2436","lineNum":2683,"lineType":1,"content":"申酉、戍亥子丑，一氣相連，皆非接木之説，總遇接甲，亦","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009294911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2437","lineNum":2685,"lineType":1,"content":"無大禍。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009294911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2438","lineNum":2685,"lineType":1,"content":"假如甲乙傳寅夘運，名曰刼財敗財，主尅父母，","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009311295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2439","lineNum":2687,"lineType":1,"content":"及尅財敗財爭闘之事。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009311295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2440","lineNum":2687,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁巳午運，名傷官運，主尅子","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009327679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2441","lineNum":2689,"lineType":1,"content":"女，訟事囚繫。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009327679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2442","lineNum":2689,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛申酉運，七煞官鄉，主得名，發越太過，","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009344063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2443","lineNum":2691,"lineType":1,"content":"則災病惡疾。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009344063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2444","lineNum":2691,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸亥子生氣印綬運，主吉慶增産。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009360447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2445","lineNum":2691,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戍","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009376831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2446","lineNum":2693,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未戊巳財運，主名利皆通。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009376831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2447","lineNum":2693,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃死發，須隨格局喜忌","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009393215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2448","lineNum":2695,"lineType":1,"content":"推之干旺宜衰運，正所謂干弱則求氣旺之藉，有餘則","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009393215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2449","lineNum":2697,"lineType":1,"content":"欲不足之營，須要通𠮓，更𠔥流年諸神煞推之，其驗如","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009393215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2450","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505868776996879"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2451","lineNum":2701,"lineType":1,"content":"神。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009393215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2453","lineNum":2705,"lineType":1,"content":"夫大運司十年之休咎，小運掌一嵗之灾祥，是小運者，","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009425983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2454","lineNum":2707,"lineType":1,"content":"補大運之不足而立名也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009425983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2455","lineNum":2707,"lineType":1,"content":"古人以男起丙寅，女起丙申","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009442367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2456","lineNum":2709,"lineType":1,"content":"者何？","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009442367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2457","lineNum":2709,"lineType":1,"content":"葢元氣之所孕，始於子，立於巳。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009458751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2458","lineNum":2709,"lineType":1,"content":"子者氣之始，巳者","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009475135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2459","lineNum":2711,"lineType":1,"content":"包之始。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009475135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2460","lineNum":2711,"lineType":1,"content":"自子推之，男左行三十而立於巳，女右行積二","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009491519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2461","lineNum":2713,"lineType":1,"content":"十而合之巳。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009491519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2462","lineNum":2713,"lineType":1,"content":"巳，正陽也，隂實從焉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009507903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2463","lineNum":2713,"lineType":1,"content":"是故聖人因是而制","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009524287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2464","lineNum":2715,"lineType":1,"content":"禮，参天兩地，自然之數配也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009524287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2465","lineNum":2715,"lineType":1,"content":"自巳而壬之，男十月毓於","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009540671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2466","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505868777013263"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2467","lineNum":2719,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，女十月毓於申，申為三隂，寅為三陽，故年運起焉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009540671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2468","lineNum":2719,"lineType":1,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009557055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2469","lineNum":2721,"lineType":1,"content":"生於甲，月生於庚，日月東西，夫婦之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009557055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2470","lineNum":2721,"lineType":1,"content":"甲統於寅，庚","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009573439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2471","lineNum":2723,"lineType":1,"content":"通於申，是故隂陽之合以正，將以順性命之理耳。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009573439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2472","lineNum":2723,"lineType":1,"content":"此小","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009589823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2473","lineNum":2725,"lineType":1,"content":"運所以男起丙寅順行，女起壬申逆行，一定而不可易","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009589823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2474","lineNum":2727,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009589823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2475","lineNum":2727,"lineType":1,"content":"觧者謂男子陽火元氣起戊子，三十丁巳，十月至丙","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009606207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2476","lineNum":2729,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，此木生火；女之隂水元氣起庚子，二十辛巳，十月至","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009606207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2477","lineNum":2731,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申，為金生水，此其數也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009606207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2478","lineNum":2731,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎通謂男三十筋骨堅强，","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009622591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2479","lineNum":2733,"lineType":1,"content":"任為人父；女二十肌膚𠑽盛，任為人母，合為五十，應大","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009622591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2480","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505857192460342"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2481","lineNum":2737,"lineType":1,"content":"衍之數，以生萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009622591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2482","lineNum":2737,"lineType":1,"content":"陽竒而舒，故三終；隂偶而促，故再終。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009638975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2483","lineNum":2739,"lineType":1,"content":"参天兩地之道，此其理也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009655359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2484","lineNum":2739,"lineType":1,"content":"或者以甲子旬如上起、甲申","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009671743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2485","lineNum":2741,"lineType":1,"content":"旬男起丙戍，女起壬辰；甲午旬男起丙申，女起壬寅；甲","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009671743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2486","lineNum":2743,"lineType":1,"content":"辰旬男起丙午，女起壬子；甲寅旬男起丙辰，女起壬戍，","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009671743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2487","lineNum":2745,"lineType":1,"content":"則非聖人原立起年運之義矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009671743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2488","lineNum":2745,"lineType":1,"content":"今之談命者，只以大運","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009688127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2489","lineNum":2747,"lineType":1,"content":"為用，殊不知小運亦有緊關，大運雖吉，其小運不通，未","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009688127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2490","lineNum":2749,"lineType":1,"content":"可便言吉利。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009688127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2491","lineNum":2749,"lineType":1,"content":"如大運雖㐫，其小運却吉，未可便作凶推。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009704511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2492","lineNum":2751,"lineType":1,"content":"此小運又名行年，不可不究。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009720895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2493","lineNum":2751,"lineType":1,"content":"醉醒子以為男女小運皆","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009737279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2494","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505820639166515"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2495","lineNum":2755,"lineType":1,"content":"由時生，而行之逆順亦以年定。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009737279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2496","lineNum":2755,"lineType":1,"content":"如陽命陽年甲子時生，","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009753663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2497","lineNum":2757,"lineType":1,"content":"堕地即行，乙丑，二嵗丙寅，一位一年，週而復始。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009753663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2498","lineNum":2757,"lineType":1,"content":"隂命陽","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009770047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2499","lineNum":2759,"lineType":1,"content":"年逆行亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734009770047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2500","lineNum":2759,"lineType":1,"content":"嘗試用之，屢驗。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461132836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2501","lineNum":2759,"lineType":1,"content":"亦要與大運及柱中用神","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461149220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2502","lineNum":2761,"lineType":1,"content":"日主較量吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461149220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2503","lineNum":2761,"lineType":1,"content":"童限未交大運，專用此法，行死絶煞旺","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461165604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2504","lineNum":2763,"lineType":1,"content":"之宫，必有危難。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461165604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2505","lineNum":2763,"lineType":1,"content":"先詳八字衰旺喜忌，然後以此叅之，蔑","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461181988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2506","lineNum":2765,"lineType":1,"content":"不中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461181988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2508","lineNum":2769,"lineType":1,"content":"夫太嵗者，乃一嵗之主宰，諸神之領袖。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461214756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2509","lineNum":2769,"lineType":1,"content":"其説有二：如四","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461231140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2510","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505881221398554"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2511","lineNum":2773,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中生年，曰當生太嵗；如逐年輪轉，曰逰行大嵗。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461231140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2512","lineNum":2773,"lineType":1,"content":"當生","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461247524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2513","lineNum":2775,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗，乃終身之主，其理巳論於前。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461247524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2514","lineNum":2775,"lineType":1,"content":"其逐年太嵗，逰行十","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461263908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2515","lineNum":2777,"lineType":1,"content":"二宫，定一年之禍福，為四時之吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461263908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2516","lineNum":2777,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：太嵗乃衆煞","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461280292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2517","lineNum":2779,"lineType":1,"content":"之主，入命未必為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461280292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2518","lineNum":2779,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢戰闘之鄉，必主刑於本命。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461296676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2519","lineNum":2779,"lineType":1,"content":"葢","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461313060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2520","lineNum":2781,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗如君也，大運如臣也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461313060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2521","lineNum":2781,"lineType":1,"con oteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2535","lineNum":2793,"lineType":1,"content":"下凌其上，逆","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461460516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2536","lineNum":2795,"lineType":1,"content":"也，其凶决不能免。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461460516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2537","lineNum":2795,"lineType":1,"content":"若五行有救，四柱有情，如甲日尅戊","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461476900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2538","lineNum":2797,"lineType":1,"content":"年，四柱元有庚申金，或大運中亦有将甲木制伏純粹，","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461476900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2539","lineNum":2799,"lineType":1,"content":"不能尅戊土，為有救。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461476900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2540","lineNum":2799,"lineType":1,"content":"經云戊巳愁逢甲乙，干頭湏要庚","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461493284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2541","lineNum":2801,"lineType":1,"content":"辛是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461493284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2542","lineNum":2801,"lineType":1,"content":"如大運并四柱中有一癸字與戊相合為有情。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461509668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2543","lineNum":2803,"lineType":1,"content":"經云壬以癸妹配戊，凶為吉兆是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461526052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2544","lineNum":2803,"lineType":1,"content":"若二字俱全，其年","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461542436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2545","lineNum":2805,"lineType":1,"content":"凶反為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461542436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2546","lineNum":2805,"lineType":1,"content":"有一字者㐫半，二字俱無，㐫莫能觧。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461558820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2547","lineNum":2805,"lineType":1,"content":"經云五","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461575204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2548","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505857192493110"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2549","lineNum":2809,"lineType":1,"content":"行有救，其年反必為財；四柱無情，故論名為尅嵗是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461575204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2550","lineNum":2811,"lineType":1,"content":"又有真太嵗、征太嵗之説。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461591588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2551","lineNum":2811,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：生時相逢真太嵗。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461607972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2552","lineNum":2811,"lineType":1,"content":"假如","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461624356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2553","lineNum":2813,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子生人，又見甲子年，謂之真太嵗，又名轉趾煞。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461624356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2554","lineNum":2813,"lineType":1,"content":"要大","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461640740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2555","lineNum":2815,"lineType":1,"content":"運日主與太嵗相和相順，其年則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461640740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2556","lineNum":2815,"lineType":1,"content":"若值刑衝破害，與","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461657124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2557","lineNum":2817,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗互相戰尅則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461657124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2558","lineNum":2817,"lineType":1,"content":"如癸巳日逢丁亥流年，日干支衝","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461673508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2559","lineNum":2819,"lineType":1,"content":"尅太嵗曰征，運干支傷衝太嵗亦曰征，太嵗干支衝日","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461673508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2560","lineNum":2821,"lineType":1,"content":"干支亦曰征，其年則凶，災禍未免。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461673508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2561","lineNum":2821,"lineType":1,"content":"又如甲子流年，又是","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461689892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2562","lineNum":2823,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子運，謂之嵗運并臨，獨羊刄、七煞為凶，財、官、印、綬亦","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461689892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2563","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505868777029647"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2564","lineNum":2827,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461689892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2565","lineNum":2827,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：嵗運并臨，災殃立至。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461706276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2566","lineNum":2827,"lineType":1,"content":"此指羊刄言也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461722660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2567","lineNum":2827,"lineType":1,"content":"又如甲子","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461739044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2568","lineNum":2829,"lineType":1,"content":"日見甲子太嵗，謂之日年相併，如君子得之，謂之君臣","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461739044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2569","lineNum":2831,"lineType":1,"content":"慶會，具年利奏對，有靣君之喜。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461739044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2570","lineNum":2831,"lineType":1,"content":"若當省士人得之，有登","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461755428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2571","lineNum":2833,"lineType":1,"content":"薦仕進之象。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461755428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2572","lineNum":2833,"lineType":1,"content":"又要與嵗君帝座和恊，方為竒特。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461771812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2573","lineNum":2833,"lineType":1,"content":"若是常","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461788196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2574","lineNum":2835,"lineType":1,"content":"俗小人遇之，最為不善。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461788196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2575","lineNum":2835,"lineType":1,"content":"若生時相和，為災稍輕。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461804580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2576","lineNum":2835,"lineType":1,"content":"故經云：","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461820964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2577","lineNum":2837,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗當頭立，諸神不敢當。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461820964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2578","lineNum":2837,"lineType":1,"content":"若無官事擾，定主見重䘮，此","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461837348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2579","lineNum":2839,"lineType":1,"content":"之謂歟。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461837348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2580","lineNum":2839,"lineType":1,"content":"更加以勾林元亡、咸池孤害、宅墓病死、官符、喪","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461853732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2581","lineNum":2841,"lineType":1,"content":"吊、白虎、羊刄、暴敗、天厄諸凶煞併臨，禍患百出，甚者死。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461853732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2582","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505857192509494"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2583","lineNum":2845,"lineType":1,"content":"假如甲日見戊年太嵗，甲又生寅卯亥未，年月日時，又","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461870116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2584","lineNum":2847,"lineType":1,"content":"重見甲乙字，併尅戊年，柱中無庚辛巳酉丑金局制木，","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461870116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2585","lineNum":2849,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁火局焚木者，太凶。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461870116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2586","lineNum":2849,"lineType":1,"content":"如一命戊辰、戊午、戊戍、甲寅，羊","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461886500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2587","lineNum":2851,"lineType":1,"content":"刄倒戈，遇壬申年四月，項生惡瘡，頭将墮，死。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734461886500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pin
