{"lines":[{"lineId":"2604","lineNum":2873,"lineType":1,"content":"夫太嵗者，年中天子，一嵗諸神煞之尊，綂正方位，逥送","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462017572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2605","lineNum":2875,"lineType":1,"content":"六氣，遷運四時，以成嵗功，至尊無上。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462017572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2606","lineNum":2875,"lineType":1,"content":"若人遇尅衝壓伏，","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462033956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2607","lineNum":2877,"lineType":1,"content":"皆為不祥之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462033956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2608","lineNum":2877,"lineType":1,"content":"運者，恊和二十四氣，般運一生休咎，扶","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462050340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2609","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505850795966502"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2610","lineNum":2881,"lineType":1,"content":"持四柱，輔弼三元，運與流年二者相為表裏，乃人命禍","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462050340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2611","lineNum":2883,"lineType":1,"content":"福死生所係。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462050340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2612","lineNum":2883,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗用天元，運用地支。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462066724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2613","lineNum":2883,"lineType":1,"content":"凡行好運，而日干傷","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462083108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2614","lineNum":2885,"lineType":1,"content":"流年天元，為禍輕。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462083108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2615","lineNum":2885,"lineType":1,"content":"若行不好運，及脱財官運，而日干傷","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462099492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2616","lineNum":2887,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗干，為禍重。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462099492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2617","lineNum":2887,"lineType":1,"content":"若是巳發之命，禍患立至。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462115876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2618","lineNum":2887,"lineType":1,"content":"凡行不好運，未","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462132260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2619","lineNum":2889,"lineType":1,"content":"可便言衰絶，大要知已發未發，其氣數已過未過言之。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462132260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2620","lineNum":2891,"lineType":1,"content":"行運以生月為運元，最怕行運與太嵗衝尅，若嵗運衝","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462148644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2621","lineNum":2893,"lineType":1,"content":"月，必禍。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462148644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2622","lineNum":2893,"lineType":1,"content":"若嵗運與日相對，謂之返吟。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462165028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2623","lineNum":2893,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗運壓日，謂之伏","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462181412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2624","lineNum":2895,"lineType":1,"content":"吟。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462181412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2625","lineNum":2895,"lineType":1,"content":"二者不利六親，非横破財，不為吉兆。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462197796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2626","lineNum":2895,"lineType":1,"content":"凡嵗運吉凶，當","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462214180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2627","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505856013877282"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2628","lineNum":2899,"lineType":1,"content":"生天元，或支中原無官星，天元有正官，或原有偏官，制","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462214180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2629","lineNum":2901,"lineType":1,"content":"伏太過，運遇天元官星，亦可發福。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462214180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2630","lineNum":2901,"lineType":1,"content":"運支無財，而運干是" {"lines":[{"lineId":"2633","lineNum":2905,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：晦氣者，乃不明之象，昏昧之道也，即甲巳乙庚之","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462263332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2634","lineNum":2907,"lineType":1,"content":"例，以合則晦也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462263332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2635","lineNum":2907,"lineType":1,"content":"日干與時干不宜與太嵗天元合，合則","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462279716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2636","lineNum":2909,"lineType":1,"content":"名為晦氣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462279716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2637","lineNum":2909,"lineType":1,"content":"又要分日干合太嵗，如甲日巳年之例。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462296100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2638","lineNum":2909,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462312484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2639","lineNum":2911,"lineType":1,"content":"合日干，如巳日甲年之例。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462312484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2640","lineNum":2911,"lineType":1,"content":"甲合巳災重，已合甲災輕。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462328868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2641","lineNum":2911,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462345252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2642","lineNum":2913,"lineType":1,"content":"位近者災重，逺者災輕。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462345252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2643","lineNum":2913,"lineType":1,"content":"如嵗在日前五辰而遇合，謂之","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462361636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2644","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505857192525878"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2645","lineNum":2917,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗入宅。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462361636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2646","lineNum":2917,"lineType":1,"content":"晦氣臨門，主災厄。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462378020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2647","lineNum":2917,"lineType":1,"content":"神白經日論晦氣，日轉時","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462394404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2648","lineNum":2919,"lineType":1,"content":"重，更看人元旺，則主眷屬。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462394404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2649","lineNum":2919,"lineType":1,"content":"眷屬之災，死絶併衝，主身災。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462410788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2650","lineNum":2921,"lineType":1,"content":"若在地支，六合相合，謂之鴛鴦合，有用主好事。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462427172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2651","lineNum":2921,"lineType":1,"content":"相近若","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462443556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2652","lineNum":2923,"lineType":1,"content":"干支俱合，主添進人口，得吉神。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462443556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2653","lineNum":2923,"lineType":1,"content":"同位士人，宜見官奏薦，","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462459940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2654","lineNum":2925,"lineType":1,"content":"文書之喜。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462459940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2655","lineNum":2925,"lineType":1,"content":"若相憎，則有離别之苦。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462476324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2656","lineNum":2925,"lineType":1,"content":"若有相刑之位，更處","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462492708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2657","lineNum":2927,"lineType":1,"content":"休咎，主本人災禍。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462492708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2658","lineNum":2927,"lineType":1,"content":"若在六害之位，主小口有疾，或奴婢","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462509092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2659","lineNum":2929,"lineType":1,"content":"走失之恼。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462509092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pi {"lines":[{"lineId":"2678","lineNum":2949,"lineType":1,"content":"東叟云：以十干為四候，十五日為一候，十二日為進","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462722084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2679","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505861214765075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2680","lineNum":2953,"lineType":1,"content":"神候，外三日為交退伏神候。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462722084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2681","lineNum":2953,"lineType":1,"content":"故甲子為第一進神，則丙","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462738468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2682","lineNum":2955,"lineType":1,"content":"子、丁丑、戊寅為交退伏神。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462738468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2683","lineNum":2955,"lineType":1,"content":"巳卯為第二進神，則辛卯、壬","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462754852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2684","lineNum":2957,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、癸巳為交退伏神。","logicSentenceId":"7634120734462754852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2685","lineNum":2957,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午為第三進神，則丙午、丁未、戊","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115444287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2686","lineNum":2959,"lineType":1,"content":"申為交退伏神。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115444287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2687","lineNum":2959,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉為第四進神，則辛酉、壬戍、癸亥為","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115460671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2688","lineNum":2961,"lineType":1,"content":"交退伏神。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115460671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2689","lineNum":2961,"lineType":1,"content":"值進神，則發跡亨快；值交神，則庶事不諧；值","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115477055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2690","lineNum":2963,"lineType":1,"content":"退神，則官資降黜；值伏神，則所作留滯。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115477055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2691", {"lines":[{"lineId":"2707","lineNum":2981,"lineType":1,"content":"夫合者，乃和諧之義。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115657279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2708","lineNum":2981,"lineType":1,"content":"如陽見陽，二陽相競，則為尅。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115673663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2709","lineNum":2981,"lineType":1,"content":"隂見","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115690047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2710","lineNum":2983,"lineType":1,"content":"隂，二隂不足，則為尅。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115690047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2711","lineNum":2983,"lineType":1,"content":"惟隂見陽，陽見隂為合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115706431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2712","lineNum":2983,"lineType":1,"content":"亦如男女","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115722815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2713","lineNum":2985,"lineType":1,"content":"相合，而成夫婦之道。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115722815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2714","lineNum":2985,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰一隂一陽之謂道，偏隂偏陽","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115739199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2715","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505857192542262"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2716","lineNum":2989,"lineType":1,"content":"之謂疾是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115739199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2717","lineNum":2991,"lineType":1,"content":"東方甲乙木，畏西方庚辛金尅。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115755583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2718","lineNum":2991,"lineType":1,"content":"甲屬陽為兄，乙屬隂為","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115771967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2719","lineNum":2993,"lineType":1,"content":"妹。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115771967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2720","lineNum":2993,"lineType":1,"content":"甲兄遂將乙妹嫁金家，與庚為妻，所以乙與庚合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115788351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2721","lineNum":2993,"lineType":1,"content":"乙","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115804735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2722","lineNum":2995,"lineType":1,"content":"雖嫁與庚為妻，春來木旺金囚，不畏金尅乙，遂歸本","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115804735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2723","lineNum":2997,"lineType":1,"content":"家就甲，然不免在金家懐胎，歸木家産。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115804735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2724","lineNum":2997,"lineType":1,"content":"木色青，金色","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115821119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2725","lineNum":2999,"lineType":1,"content":"白，是以春來園林木青，葉開白花。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115821119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2726","lineNum":3001,"lineType":1,"content":"南方丙丁火，畏北方壬癸水尅。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115837503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2727","lineNum":3001,"lineType":1,"content":"丙屬陽為兄，丁屬隂為","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115853887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2728","lineNum":3003,"lineType":1,"content":"妹，丙兄遂将丁妹嫁水家，與壬為妻，所以丁與壬合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115853887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2729","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505850795982886"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2730","lineNum":3007,"lineType":1,"content":"丁雖嫁與壬為妻，夏來火旺水囚，不畏水尅丁，遂歸","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115870271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2731","lineNum":3009,"lineType":1,"content":"火家就丙，然不免在水家懐胎，歸火家産。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115870271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2732","lineNum":3009,"lineType":1,"content":"水色黑，火","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115886655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2733","lineNum":3011,"lineType":1,"content":"色赤，小滿後桑椹熟，當有赤。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115886655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2734","lineNum":3013,"lineType":1,"content":"中央戊巳土，畏東方甲乙木尅。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115903039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2735","lineNum":3013,"lineType":1,"content":"戊屬陽為兄，已屬隂為","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115919423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2736","lineNum":3015,"lineType":1,"content":"妹，戊兄遂将巳妹嫁木家，與甲為妻，所以甲與巳合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115919423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2737","lineNum":3017,"lineType":1,"content":"已雖嫁與甲為妻，六月木江木囚，不畏木尅巳，遂歸","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115935807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2738","lineNum":3019,"lineType":1,"content":"土家就戊，然不免在甲家懐胎，歸戊家産。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115935807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2739","lineNum":3019,"lineType":1,"content":"土色黄，木","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115952191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2740","lineNum":3021,"lineType":1,"content":"色青，所以六月甜𤓰雖熟，肉黄皮青。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115952191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2741","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505881221447706"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2742","lineNum":3025,"lineType":1,"content":"西方庚辛金，畏南方丙丁火尅。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115968575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2743","lineNum":3025,"lineType":1,"content":"庚屬陽為兄，辛屬隂為","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115984959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2744","lineNum":3027,"lineType":1,"content":"妹。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735115984959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2745","lineNum":3027,"lineType":1,"content":"庚兄乃将辛妹嫁火家，與丙為妻，所以丙與辛合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116001343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2746","lineNum":3029,"lineType":1,"content":"辛雖嫁與丙為妻，秋來金旺火囚，不畏火尅辛，乃歸","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116017727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2747","lineNum":3031,"lineType":1,"content":"金家就庚，然不免在火家懐胎，歸金家産。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116017727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2748","lineNum":3031,"lineType":1,"content":"火赤金白，","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116034111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2749","lineNum":3033,"lineType":1,"content":"秋中棗熟，有半赤半白之狀。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116034111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2750","lineNum":3033,"lineType":1,"content":"楓葉丹。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116050495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2751","lineNum":3035,"lineType":1,"content":"北方壬癸水，畏中央戊巳土尅。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116066879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2752","lineNum":3035,"lineType":1,"content":"壬屬陽為兄，癸屬隂為","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116083263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2753","lineNum":3037,"lineType":1,"content":"妹。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116083263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2754","lineNum":3037,"lineType":1,"content":"壬兄乃將癸妹嫁土家，與戊為妻，所以戊與癸合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116099647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2755","lineNum":3039,"lineType":1,"content":"癸雖嫁與戊為妻，冬來水旺土囚，不畏土尅癸，遂歸","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116116031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2756","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505856013942818"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2757","lineNum":3043,"lineType":1,"content":"水家就壬，然不免在戊家懐胎歸壬家産。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116116031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2758","lineNum":3043,"lineType":1,"content":"水黑土黄，","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116132415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2759","lineNum":3045,"lineType":1,"content":"嚴冬霜雪，草木死而黄出。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116132415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2760","lineNum":3047,"lineType":1,"content":"甲與巳，何名為中正之合？","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116148799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2761","lineNum":3047,"lineType":1,"content":"甲，陽木也，其性仁，位處十干","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116165183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2762","lineNum":3049,"lineType":1,"content":"之首。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116165183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2763","lineNum":3049,"lineType":1,"content":"已，隂土也，鎮靜淳篤，有生物之徳。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116181567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2764","lineNum":3049,"lineType":1,"content":"故甲巳為中","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116197951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2765","lineNum":3051,"lineType":1,"content":"正之合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116197951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2766","lineNum":3051,"lineType":1,"content":"帶。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116214335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2767","lineNum":3051,"lineType":1,"content":"此合主人尊崇重大，寛厚平直。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116230719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2768","lineNum":3051,"lineType":1,"content":"如帶煞而","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116247103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2769","lineNum":3053,"lineType":1,"content":"五行無氣，則多嗔好怒，性梗不可屈。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116247103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2770","lineNum":3055,"lineType":1,"content":"乙與庚，何名為仁義之合？","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116263487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2771","lineNum":3055,"lineType":1,"content":"乙隂木也，其性仁而太柔。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116279871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2772","lineNum":3055,"lineType":1,"content":"庚","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116296255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2773","lineNum":3057,"lineType":1,"content":"陽金也，堅强不屈，則剛柔相濟，仁義𠔥資。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116296255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2774","lineNum":3057,"lineType":1,"content":"故主人果","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116312639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2775","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505881221464090"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2776","lineNum":3061,"lineType":1,"content":"敢有守，不惑柔侫，周旋惟仁，進退惟義。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116312639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2777","lineNum":3061,"lineType":1,"content":"五行生旺，則","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116329023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2778","lineNum":3063,"lineType":1,"content":"骨秀形清。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116329023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2779","lineNum":3063,"lineType":1,"content":"若死絶帶煞，則使氣好勇，體貌不揚，自是","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116345407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2780","lineNum":3065,"lineType":1,"content":"非人。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116345407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2781","lineNum":3065,"lineType":1,"content":"甲巳乙庚之合，婦人不忌。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116361791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2782","lineNum":3067,"lineType":1,"content":"丙與辛，何名為威制之合？","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116378175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2783","lineNum":3067,"lineType":1,"content":"丙，陽火也，煇赫自盛。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116394559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2784","lineNum":3067,"lineType":1,"content":"辛，隂金","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116410943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2785","lineNum":3069,"lineType":1,"content":"也，尅刃喜煞。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116410943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2786","lineNum":3069,"lineType":1,"content":"故丙辛為威制之合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116427327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2787","lineNum":3069,"lineType":1,"content":"主人儀表威肅，人","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116443711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2788","lineNum":3071,"lineType":1,"content":"多畏懼酷毒，好賄喜淫。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116443711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2789","lineNum":3071,"lineType":1,"content":"若帶煞或五行死絶，則寡恩","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116460095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2790","lineNum":3073,"lineType":1,"content":"少義，無情之人，婦人得之，與天中大耗、咸池相併者，","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116460095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2791","lineNum":3075,"lineType":1,"content":"貌羙聲卑，三合夭冶而淫。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116460095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2792","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505814511271975"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2793","lineNum":3079,"lineType":1,"content":"丁與壬，何名為淫慝之合？","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116476479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2794","lineNum":3079,"lineType":1,"content":"壬者，純隂之水，三光不照。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116492863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2795","lineNum":3079,"lineType":1,"content":"丁","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116509247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2796","lineNum":3081,"lineType":1,"content":"者，藏隂之火，自昧不明。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116509247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2797","lineNum":3081,"lineType":1,"content":"故丁壬為淫慝之合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116525631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2798","lineNum":3081,"lineType":1,"content":"主人眼","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116542015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2799","lineNum":3083,"lineType":1,"content":"明神嬌，多情易動，不事髙潔，習下無志，躭歡嫟色，於","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116542015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2800","lineNum":3085,"lineType":1,"content":"我則吝，於彼則貪。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116542015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2801","lineNum":3085,"lineType":1,"content":"若五行死絶，或帶煞，見咸池大耗、","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116558399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2802","lineNum":3087,"lineType":1,"content":"天中自敗，有淫汚家風之醜，親厚小人，侮慢君子，貪","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116558399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2803","lineNum":3089,"lineType":1,"content":"婪妄作，必勝而後巳。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116558399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2804","lineNum":3089,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人淫邪奸慝，易挑易誘，多招","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116574783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2805","lineNum":3091,"lineType":1,"content":"玷辱。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116574783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2806","lineNum":3091,"lineType":1,"content":"或年髙而嫁少婚，或年幼而配老夫，或先賤而","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116591167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2807","lineNum":3093,"lineType":1,"content":"後良，或先良而後賤。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116591167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2808","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505822052630568"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2809","lineNum":3097,"lineType":1,"content":"戊與癸，何名為無情之合？","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116607551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2810","lineNum":3097,"lineType":1,"content":"戊，陽土也，是老醜之夫；癸，隂","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116623935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2811","lineNum":3099,"lineType":1,"content":"水也，是婆娑之婦。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116623935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2812","lineNum":3099,"lineType":1,"content":"老陽而少隂，雖合而無情，主人或","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116640319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2813","lineNum":3101,"lineType":1,"content":"好或醜。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116640319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2814","lineNum":3101,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊得癸，則嬌媚有神，姿羙得所，男子娶少","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116656703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2815","lineNum":3103,"lineType":1,"content":"婦，婦人嫁羙夫。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116656703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2816","lineNum":3103,"lineType":1,"content":"若癸得戊，則形容古樸，老相俗塵，男","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116673087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2817","lineNum":3105,"lineType":1,"content":"子娶老妻，婦人嫁老夫。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116673087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2818","lineNum":3105,"lineType":1,"content":"經取戊得癸，合少長無情是","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116689471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2819","lineNum":3107,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116689471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2820","lineNum":3109,"lineType":1,"content":"或問：十干必隔六位一合何也？","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116705855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2821","lineNum":3109,"lineType":1,"content":"余答曰：天地之數，各不","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116722239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2822","lineNum":3111,"lineType":1,"content":"過五。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116722239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2823","lineNum":3111,"lineType":1,"content":"上五位為生數，下五位為成數。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116738623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2824","lineNum":3111,"lineType":1,"content":"生數與成數相遇，","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116755007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2825","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505887319932980"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2826","lineNum":3115,"lineType":1,"content":"然後合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116755007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2827","lineNum":3115,"lineType":1,"content":"天一生壬。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116771391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2828","lineNum":3115,"lineType":1,"content":"地二生丁。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116787775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2829","lineNum":3115,"lineType":1,"content":"天三生甲。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116804159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2830","lineNum":3115,"lineType":1,"content":"地四生辛。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116820543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2831","lineNum":3115,"lineType":1,"content":"天五","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116836927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2832","lineNum":3117,"lineType":1,"content":"生戊。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116836927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2833","lineNum":3117,"lineType":1,"content":"地六成癸。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116853311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2834","lineNum":3117,"lineType":1,"content":"天七成丙。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116869695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2835","lineNum":3117,"lineType":1,"content":"地八成乙。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116886079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2836","lineNum":3117,"lineType":1,"content":"天九成庚。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116902463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2837","lineNum":3117,"lineType":1,"content":"地十成","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116918847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2838","lineNum":3119,"lineType":1,"content":"巳。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116918847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2839","lineNum":3119,"lineType":1,"content":"天一數見地二數，然後合，所以必隔六也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116935231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2840","lineNum":3119,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰夭數","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116951615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2841","lineNum":3121,"lineType":1,"content":"五，地數五，五位相得，而各有合是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116951615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2842","lineNum":3121,"lineType":1,"content":"五行要論云：天一","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116967999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2843","lineNum":3123,"lineType":1,"content":"生水，其於物，為精，精者，一之所生也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116967999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2844","lineNum":3123,"lineType":1,"content":"地二，生火，其於物","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116984383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2845","lineNum":3125,"lineType":1,"content":"為神，神者，二之所生也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735116984383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2846","lineNum":3125,"lineType":1,"content":"天三生木，其於物為魂，魂，從神","logicSentenceId":"7634120735117000767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2847","lineNum":3127,"lineType":1,"content":"者也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735117000767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2848","lineNum":3127,"lineType":1,"content":"地四生金，其於物為魄，魄，從精者也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735117017151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2849","lineNum":3127,"lineType":1,"content":"天五生土，其","logicSentenceId":"7634120735117033535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2850","lineNum":3129,"lineType":1,"content":"於物為體，體者，精神、魂魄具而後有者也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735117033535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2851","lineNum":3129,"lineType":1,"content":"自天一至天","logicSentenceId":"7634120735117049919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2852","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505845226176539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2853","lineNum":3133,"lineType":1,"content":"五，五行之生數；自地六至地十，五行之成數。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735117049919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2854","lineNum":3133,"lineType":1,"content":"以竒生者，","logicSentenceId":"7634120735117066303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2855","lineNum":3135,"lineType":1,"content":"成而偶；以偶生者，成而竒。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735117066303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2856","lineNum":3135,"lineType":1,"content":"其成之者皆五。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388073990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2857","lineNum":3135,"lineType":1,"content":"五，天數之中，","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388090374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2858","lineNum":3137,"lineType":1,"content":"所以成於物也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388090374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2859","lineNum":3137,"lineType":1,"content":"道立於一，成於三，變於五，而天地之數","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388106758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2860","lineNum":3139,"lineType":1,"content":"具矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388106758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2861","lineNum":3139,"lineType":1,"content":"其十也，偶之而巳。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388123142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2862","lineNum":3139,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：一六同宗，二七同道，三八","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388139526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2863","lineNum":3141,"lineType":1,"content":"為朋，四九為友，五十同途。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388139526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2864","lineNum":3141,"lineType":1,"content":"闔闢竒偶是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388155910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2865","lineNum":3143,"lineType":1,"content":"合者，貴平得中而不偏。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388172294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2866","lineNum":3143,"lineType":1,"content":"如一甲得一巳，各乗生旺，是謂","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388188678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2867","lineNum":3145,"lineType":1,"content":"得中而不偏。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388188678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2868","lineNum":3145,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲太旺，巳太柔，兩不相稱，是謂太過不","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388221446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2869","lineNum":3147,"lineType":1,"content":"及。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388221446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2870","lineNum":3147,"lineType":1,"content":"若一已合兩甲，兩甲合一巳，是謂隂陽偏枯。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388237830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2871","lineNum":3147,"lineType":1,"content":"如婦多","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388254214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2872","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505822052663336"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2873","lineNum":3151,"lineType":1,"content":"夫少，夫多婦少，相爭相妬，皆亂之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388254214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2874","lineNum":3151,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰偏則亂。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388270598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2875","lineNum":3151,"lineType":1,"content":"壺","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388286982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2876","lineNum":3153,"lineType":1,"content":"中子云一氣偏枯，老為俗物是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388286982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2877","lineNum":3153,"lineType":1,"content":"天元𠮓化書云：天干","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388303366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2878","lineNum":3155,"lineType":1,"content":"合，陽得隂合福慢；隂得陽合福𦂳。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388303366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2879","lineNum":3155,"lineType":1,"content":"故甲得巳合為財，巳","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388319750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2880","lineNum":3157,"lineType":1,"content":"得甲合為官。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388319750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2881","lineNum":3157,"lineType":1,"content":"陽干遇隂干合，止得干合之福；隂干遇陽","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388336134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2882","lineNum":3159,"lineType":1,"content":"干合，又得正官合輔為而里福，故𦂳慢不同。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388336134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2883","lineNum":3159,"lineType":1,"content":"餘干例推。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388352518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2884","lineNum":3161,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：干合更得支合，在一旬內，如甲戍見巳卯，甲辰見","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388368902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2885","lineNum":3163,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉之類，謂之君臣慶㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388368902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2886","lineNum":3163,"lineType":1,"content":"在兩旬內，如甲子見巳丑，甲","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388385286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2887","lineNum":3165,"lineType":1,"content":"午見巳未之類，謂之夫妻聚㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388385286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2888","lineNum":3165,"lineType":1,"content":"葢世事有本國之君，未","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388401670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2889","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505884308406281"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2890","lineNum":3169,"lineType":1,"content":"嘗有異國之臣，所以在一旬內見，方曰君臣慶㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388401670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2891","lineNum":3169,"lineType":1,"content":"仍要","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388418054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2892","lineNum":3171,"lineType":1,"content":"别其陽為君，隂為臣，君位致上，臣位致下方是，反此則","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388418054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2893","lineNum":3173,"lineType":1,"content":"悖。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388418054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2894","lineNum":3173,"lineType":1,"content":"世事有本郡之夫，却有他郡之妻，所以各旬互見，謂","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388434438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2895","lineNum":3175,"lineType":1,"content":"之夫妻會聚，又名天地得合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388434438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2896","lineNum":3175,"lineType":1,"content":"若見是合，又須要和氣貴","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388450822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2897","lineNum":3177,"lineType":1,"content":"神相助，方為有用。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388450822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2898","lineNum":3177,"lineType":1,"content":"內有衝破受傷，合中有刑煞，皆為不","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388467206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2899","lineNum":3179,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388467206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2900","lineNum":3179,"lineType":1,"content":"御製言談云：合中帶禄，定是公侯；合處相傷，反為無","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388483590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2901","lineNum":3181,"lineType":1,"content":"補，是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388483590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2948","lineNum":3247,"lineType":1,"content":"三車，以甲巳年遁起，丙寅至戊辰三數，數至三則變化，","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388860422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2949","lineNum":3249,"lineType":1,"content":"辰為龍，亦能變化，故甲已、乙庚、丙辛、丁壬、戊癸，隨其所","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388860422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2950","lineNum":3251,"lineType":1,"content":"屬天干而得其氣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388860422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2951","lineNum":3251,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：甲巳丙作首，丙屬火，火生土，故","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388876806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2952","lineNum":3253,"lineType":1,"content":"化土。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388876806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2953","lineNum":3253,"lineType":1,"content":"餘例推其説，不外前理。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388893190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2954","lineNum":3255,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：甲巳化土，有二則化，一不能化，仍還本位之性。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388909574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2955","lineNum":3255,"lineType":1,"content":"所","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388925958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2956","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505822052646952"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2957","lineNum":3259,"lineType":1,"content":"謂一不能生，生物必兩，此天干一隂一陽，如夫婦配合","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388925958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2958","lineNum":3261,"lineType":1,"content":"成偶，方能變化成刑，隂陽不合，安得化機之宣哉？","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388925958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2959","lineNum":3261,"lineType":1,"content":"是以","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388942342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2960","lineNum":3263,"lineType":1,"content":"有妬化之説。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388942342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2961","lineNum":3263,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲巳見乙，乙庚見辛，丁壬見丙，戍癸見","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388958726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2962","lineNum":3265,"lineType":1,"content":"壬，丙辛見丁，所謂妬花，自戀其生，遂成一家之好，愛戀","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388958726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2963","lineNum":3267,"lineType":1,"content":"親情，何能從化？","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388958726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2964","lineNum":3267,"lineType":1,"content":"故化象須歸一方穏。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388975110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2965","lineNum":3267,"lineType":1,"content":"如丁壬化木，柱中","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388991494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2966","lineNum":3269,"lineType":1,"content":"見癸並子，雖强成木，不成眞物，是化而不化也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120735388991494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0," {"lines":[{"lineId":"3184","lineNum":3489,"lineType":1,"content":"夫合者，和也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418543145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3185","lineNum":3489,"lineType":1,"content":"乃隂陽相和，其氣自合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418559529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3186","lineNum":3489,"lineType":1,"content":"子、寅、辰、午、申、戍，六","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418575913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3187","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505884308488201"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3188","lineNum":3493,"lineType":1,"content":"者為陽。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418575913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3189","lineNum":3493,"lineType":1,"content":"丑、卯、巳、未、酉、亥，六者為隂。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418592297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3190","lineNum":3493,"lineType":1,"content":"是以一隂一陽，和而","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418608681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3191","lineNum":3495,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418608681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3192","lineNum":3495,"lineType":1,"content":"子合丑，寅合亥，却不子合亥，寅合丑。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418625065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3193","lineNum":3495,"lineType":1,"content":"夫何故？","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418641449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3194","lineNum":3495,"lineType":1,"content":"造","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418657833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3195","lineNum":3497,"lineType":1,"content":"物中雖是隂陽為合，氣數中要占陽氣為尊。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418657833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3196","lineNum":3497,"lineType":1,"content":"子為一陽，","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418674217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3197","lineNum":3499,"lineType":1,"content":"丑為二陽，一二成三數，寅為三陽，亥是六隂，二六成九","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418674217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3198","lineNum":3501,"lineType":1,"content":"數。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418674217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3199","lineNum":3501,"lineType":1,"content":"卯為四陽，戍是五隂，四五得九數；辰為五陽，酉為四","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418690601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3200","lineNum":3503,"lineType":1,"content":"隂，五四得九數；已為六陽，申為二隂，六三得九數；午為","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418690601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3201","lineNum":3505,"lineType":1,"content":"一隂，未為二陽，一二得三數。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418690601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3202","lineNum":3505,"lineType":1,"content":"子、丑、午、未各得三者，三生","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418706985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3203","lineNum":3507,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物，餘皆得九者，乃陽數極也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418706985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3204","lineNum":3507,"lineType":1,"content":"當聞論甲乙者，如何子","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418723369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3205","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505884308520969"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3206","lineNum":3511,"lineType":1,"content":"與丑合，皆莫知其故。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418723369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3207","lineNum":3511,"lineType":1,"content":"因偏覽羣書，以觀大運，乃知壬亥","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418739753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3208","lineNum":3513,"lineType":1,"content":"之間，日月十二辰交會之所。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418739753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3209","lineNum":3513,"lineType":1,"content":"凡月之會，朔日之璧於此位，","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418756137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3210","lineNum":3515,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之㑹，劣謂之集。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418756137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3211","lineNum":3515,"lineType":1,"content":"十二月之辰，如玄枵星紀之類，與之同在","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418772521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3212","lineNum":3517,"lineType":1,"content":"焉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418772521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3213","lineNum":3517,"lineType":1,"content":"一嵗十二㑹，太隂太陽隔液坎離之妙，此生萬轉圖","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418788905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3214","lineNum":3519,"lineType":1,"content":"而放會合得可見也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418788905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3215","lineNum":3519,"lineType":1,"content":"十二月建丑，是時玄枵同在壬亥","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418805289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3216","lineNum":3521,"lineType":1,"content":"之間，以玄枵在子之辰，此其所以為子丑之合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418805289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3217","lineNum":3521,"lineType":1,"content":"正月建","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418821673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3218","lineNum":3523,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，是時娵訾在壬亥之間，以娵訾在亥之辰，此其所以","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418821673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3219","lineNum":3525,"lineType":1,"content":"為寅亥之合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418821673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3220","lineNum":3525,"lineType":1,"content":"二月建卯，此時降婁在壬亥之間，降婁戍，","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418838057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3221","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505879384326155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3222","lineNum":3529,"lineType":1,"content":"故卯與戍合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418838057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3223","lineNum":3529,"lineType":1,"content":"三月建辰，此時大梁在壬亥之間，大梁酉，","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418854441","marginNoteIdLi eType":1,"content":"十月建亥，是時析木在壬、亥之間，析","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418969129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3238","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505884308537353"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3239","lineNum":3547,"lineType":1,"content":"木寅，故寅與亥合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418969129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3240","lineNum":3547,"lineType":1,"content":"十一月建子，是時星紀在壬、亥之間，","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418985513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3241","lineNum":3549,"lineType":1,"content":"星紀丑，故子與丑合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737418985513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3242","lineNum":3549,"lineType":1,"content":"得日月會同之數，則其相合之用，","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419001897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3243","lineNum":3551,"lineType":1,"content":"如日月彌漫六合矣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419001897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3244","lineNum":3551,"lineType":1,"content":"人命逢六合，造化豈不羙哉！","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419018281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3245","lineNum":3551,"lineType":1,"content":"觀周","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419034665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3246","lineNum":3553,"lineType":1,"content":"禮春官之屬曰太師樂，其所掌之職，乃奏黄鍾、歌大吕、","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419034665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3247","lineNum":3555,"lineType":1,"content":"舞雲門以祭天神；黄鍾子，大吕丑，取其子丑之合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419034665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3248","lineNum":3555,"lineType":1,"content":"以召","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419051049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3249","lineNum":3557,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之和氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419051049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3250","lineNum":3557,"lineType":1,"content":"奏太簇、歌應鍾、舞咸池，以祀地祇；太簇","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419067433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3251","lineNum":3559,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，應鍾亥，取其寅亥之合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419067433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3252","lineNum":3559,"lineType":1,"content":"奏無射、歌夾鍾、舞大武，以享","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419083817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3253","lineNum":3561,"lineType":1,"content":"祖先；無射戍，夾鍾卯，取其卯戍之合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419083817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3254","lineNum":3561,"lineType":1,"content":"奏姑洗、歌南吕、舞","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419100201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3255","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505892474748982"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3256","lineNum":3565,"lineType":1,"content":"大罄，以祀四望；姑洗辰，南吕酉，取其酉辰之合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419100201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3257","lineNum":3565,"lineType":1,"content":"奏夷則、","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419116585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3258","lineNum":3567,"lineType":1,"content":"歌仲吕、舞大濩，以享先妣；夷則申，仲吕巳，葢巳與申合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419116585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3259","lineNum":3569,"lineType":1,"content":"奏蕤賔、歌林鍾、舞大夏，以祀山川；蕤賔午，林鍾未，葢午","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419132969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3260","lineNum":3571,"lineType":1,"content":"與未合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419132969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3261","lineNum":3571,"lineType":1,"content":"成王、周公之制作也，因取乎律吕相合，然後可","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419149353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3262","lineNum":3573,"lineType":1,"content":"格三才之體，其理㣲哉！","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419149353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3263","lineNum":3573,"lineType":1,"content":"廣録云：寅午往來，有甲巳土氣；","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419165737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3264","lineNum":3575,"lineType":1,"content":"子巳往來，有戊癸火氣；巳酉往來，有丙辛水氣；卯申往","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419165737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3265","lineNum":3577,"lineType":1,"content":"來，有乙庚金氣；亥午往來，有丁壬木氣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419165737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3266","lineNum":3577,"lineType":1,"content":"皆在禄上。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419182121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3267","lineNum":3577,"lineType":1,"content":"子巳、","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419198505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3268","lineNum":3579,"lineType":1,"content":"午亥，亦謂之隔六合，葢一陽至六陽，一隂至六隂，更得","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419198505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3269","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505887320064052"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3270","lineNum":3583,"lineType":1,"content":"天干納音，有交涉，尢吉。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419198505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3271","lineNum":3583,"lineType":1,"content":"夫合有合禄、合馬、合貴之説，珞","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419214889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3272","lineNum":3585,"lineType":1,"content":"琭子云：是從無而立有，謂見不見之形也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419214889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3273","lineNum":3585,"lineType":1,"content":"從無立有，喻","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419231273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3274","lineNum":3587,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲生人以寅為禄，不見寅而見亥，謂之合禄；寅生人","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419231273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3275","lineNum":3589,"lineType":1,"content":"以申為馬，不見申而見巳，謂之合馬。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419231273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3276","lineNum":3589,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戍庚人，以丑未","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419247657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3277","lineNum":3591,"lineType":1,"content":"為貴，不見丑未而見子午，謂之合貴。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419247657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3278","lineNum":3591,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：明合不如暗","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419264041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3279","lineNum":3593,"lineType":1,"content":"合，拱實不如拱虚，此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419264041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3280","lineNum":3593,"lineType":1,"content":"天元變化書云：子合丑，福","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419280425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3281","lineNum":3595,"lineType":1,"content":"輕。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419280425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3282","lineNum":3595,"lineType":1,"content":"丑合子，福盛。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419296809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3283","lineNum":3595,"lineType":1,"content":"寅合亥，福清。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419313193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3284","lineNum":3595,"lineType":1,"content":"亥合寅，福慢。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419329577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3285","lineNum":3595,"lineType":1,"content":"戍合夘，福虚。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419345961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3286","lineNum":3597,"lineType":1,"content":"卯合戍，福厚。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419362345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3287","lineNum":3597,"lineType":1,"content":"辰合酉，福弱。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419378729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3288","lineNum":3597,"lineType":1,"content":"酉合辰，大利。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419395113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3289","lineNum":3597,"lineType":1,"content":"午合未，福慢。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419411497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3290","lineNum":3597,"lineType":1,"content":"未","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419427881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505850796032038"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3292","lineNum":3601,"lineType":1,"content":"合午，大利。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419427881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3293","lineNum":3601,"lineType":1,"content":"已合申，福慢。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419444265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3294","lineNum":3601,"lineType":1,"content":"申合巳，官氣盛。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419460649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3295","lineNum":3601,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲午辛未，只","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419477033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3296","lineNum":3603,"lineType":1,"content":"是身旺，却命禄弱。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419477033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3297","lineNum":3603,"lineType":1,"content":"如乙未壬午，雖禄弱，粗得。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419493417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3298","lineNum":3603,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：男子","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419509801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3299","lineNum":3605,"lineType":1,"content":"忌合絶，女人忌合貴。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419509801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3301","lineNum":3609,"lineType":1,"content":"考厯家，申子辰初之氣，俱起於下漏一刻。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419542569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3302","lineNum":3609,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉丑初之","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419558953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3303","lineNum":3611,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，俱起於二十六刻；寅午戊初之氣，俱起於五十一刻；","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419558953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3304","lineNum":3613,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未初之氣，俱起於七十六刻。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419558953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3305","lineNum":3613,"lineType":1,"content":"氣皆起於同刻，是天","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419575337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3306","lineNum":3615,"lineType":1,"content":"地自然之理也，故謂之三合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419575337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3307","lineNum":3615,"lineType":1,"content":"或以三合者，如人一身之","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419591721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3308","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505892474765366"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3309","lineNum":3619,"lineType":1,"content":"運用也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419591721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3310","lineNum":3619,"lineType":1,"content":"精乃天之元，氣乃神之本，是以精為氣之母，神","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419608105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3311","lineNum":3621,"lineType":1,"content":"為氣之子，子母互相生，精氣神全而不散之為合。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419608105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3312","lineNum":3621,"lineType":1,"content":"葢謂","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419624489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3313","lineNum":3623,"lineType":1,"content":"支屬人元，故以此論之。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419624489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3314","lineNum":3623,"lineType":1,"content":"如申子辰，申乃子之母，辰乃子","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419640873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3315","lineNum":3625,"lineType":1,"content":"之子。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419640873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3316","lineNum":3625,"lineType":1,"content":"申乃水生，子乃水旺，辰乃水氣。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419657257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3317","lineNum":3625,"lineType":1,"content":"生即産，旺即成，庫","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419673641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3318","lineNum":3627,"lineType":1,"content":"即收。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419673641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3319","lineNum":3627,"lineType":1,"content":"有生有成有收，萬物得始得終，乃自然之理。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419690025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3320","lineNum":3627,"lineType":1,"content":"故申","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419706409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3321","lineNum":3629,"lineType":1,"content":"子申為水局。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419706409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3322","lineNum":3629,"lineType":1,"content":"若三字缺其一，則化不成局，不可以三合","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419722793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3323","lineNum":3631,"lineType":1,"content":"化局論。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419722793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3324","lineNum":3631,"lineType":1,"content":"葢天地間道理，兩則化，一隂一陽之謂也；三則","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419739177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3325","lineNum":3633,"lineType":1,"content":"化，三生萬物之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737419739177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3326","lineNum":3633,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉丑寅午、戍、亥卯未皆然。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737497808959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3327","lineNum":3633,"lineType":1,"content":"五行","logicSentenceId":"7634120737497825343","marginNo content":"奔。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498153023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3372","lineNum":3683,"lineType":1,"content":"中有貴格者，自賤而貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498169407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3373","lineNum":3683,"lineType":1,"content":"大率合吉神則吉，合㐫神","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498185791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3374","lineNum":3685,"lineType":1,"content":"則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498185791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3375","lineNum":3685,"lineType":1,"content":"玉井云：合者，非只泥三合、六合，如酉字有力，或多","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498202175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3376","lineNum":3687,"lineType":1,"content":"見能用，寅字亦切，又㸔巳宫，却被壊了。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498202175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3377","lineNum":3687,"lineType":1,"content":"酉中辛，寅中丙","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498218559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3378","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505892474781750"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3379","lineNum":3691,"lineType":1,"content":"方取。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498218559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3380","lineNum":3691,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡亦㸔暗干與明干合氣相干取用，名為勾引","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498234943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3381","lineNum":3693,"lineType":1,"content":"恩讐，又為牽綰得失，又為顧盼人我，又為呼應前後，又","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498234943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3382","lineNum":3695,"lineType":1,"content":"為夫婦有情，又為行藏同道。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498234943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3385","lineNum":3699,"lineType":1,"content":"将星者，如将劄中軍也，故以三合中位，謂之将星。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498267711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3386","lineNum":3699,"lineType":1,"content":"華葢","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498284095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3387","lineNum":3701,"lineType":1,"content":"者，喻如寳葢，天有此星，其形如葢，常覆乎大帝之座，故","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498284095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3388","lineNum":3703,"lineType":1,"content":"以三合底處得庫，謂之華葢。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498284095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3389","lineNum":3703,"lineType":1,"content":"洞玄經云将星處乎中軍，","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498300479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3390","lineNum":3705,"lineType":1,"content":"華葢張乎庫土是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498300479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3391","lineNum":3705,"lineType":1,"content":"凡将星，常欲吉星相扶，貴煞加臨，","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498316863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3392","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505883046035510"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3393","lineNum":3709,"lineType":1,"content":"乃為吉慶。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498316863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3394","lineNum":3709,"lineType":1,"content":"理愚歌云：將星若用亡神臨，為國棟梁臣，言","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498333247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3395","lineNum":3711,"lineType":1,"content":"吉助之為貴。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498333247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3396","lineNum":3711,"lineType":1,"content":"更夾貴庫墓，純粹而不雜者，出将入相之","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498349631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3397","lineNum":3713,"lineType":1,"content":"格也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737498349631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3398","lineNum":3713,"l {"lines":[{"lineId":"3561","lineNum":3909,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：三刑之法，以數起之。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737892352036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3562","lineNum":3909,"lineType":1,"content":"皇極中天，十為煞數，積數至","logicSentenceId":"7634120737892368420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3563","lineNum":3911,"lineType":1,"content":"十，則悉空其數。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737892368420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3564","lineNum":3911,"lineType":1,"content":"天道惡盈，滿則覆，故數自卯順至子，子","logicSentenceId":"7634120737892384804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3565","lineNum":3913,"lineType":1,"content":"逆至卯，極十數而為無禮之刑。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737892384804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3566","lineNum":3913,"lineType":1,"content":"寅逆至已，巳逆至申，極","logicSentenceId":"7634120737892401188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3567","lineNum":3915,"lineType":1,"content":"十數而為無恩之刑。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737892401188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3568","lineNum":3915,"lineType":1,"content":"丑順至戍，戍順至未，極十數而為","logicSentenceId":"7634120737892417572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3569","lineNum":3917,"lineType":1,"content":"恃勢之刑。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737892417572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3570","lineNum":3917,"lineType":1,"content":"七則衝，十則刑，六則合一理之自然也。","logicSentenceId":"7634120737892433956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3571","lineNum":3917,"lineType":1,"content":"然寅","logicSentenceId":"7634120737892450340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3572","lineNum":3919,"lineType":1,"content":"巳申何以謂之無恩？","logicSentenceId":"7634120737892450340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3573","lineNum":3919,"lineType":1,"content":"葢寅中有甲木，刑巳中戊土，戊以","logicSentenceId":"7634120737892466724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3574","lineNum":3921,"lineType":1,"content":"癸水相 {"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":5,"lineType":7,"content":"明","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":6,"lineType":7,"content":"萬民英","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":7,"lineType":7,"content":"撰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":8,"lineType":8,"content":"論十干祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":8,"lineType":2,"content":"祿前二辰為金轝，喻人得祿須坐車也，故附於後。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"9","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"祿，爵祿也。當得勢而享，乃謂之祿。自始分十干十二支","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"時，便以甲乙配同寅、卯，居東；丙丁配同巳、午，居南；庚辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"配同申、酉，居西；壬癸配同亥、子，居北。十干就支神為祿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"謂祿隨旺行，所以甲祿寅，乙祿卯，庚祿申，辛祿酉，壬祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505913584680995"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，癸祿子，丙祿巳，丁祿午。戊寄己，巳寄午。謂巳午乃火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"旺之鄉，子隨母得祿之義。内有辰、戌、丑、未，辰、戌為魁罡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"名曰邊鄙惡地，祿元不寄。丑未乃天乙貴人出入之門，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"祿元避之。所以四宫無祿。又曰：四季有雜氣，為祿不專，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"故不取。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"19","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"甲祿寅。如甲見丙寅，甲土尅丙水，為財，為福星祿。戊寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"火土相生，為伏馬祿，俱吉。庚寅謂之破祿，半吉半㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅謂之正祿，帶截路空亡，必為僧道。甲寅謂之長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505900968230921"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"生祿，大吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"24","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"乙祿卯。見乙卯謂之喜神旺祿，主吉。丁卯為截路空亡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"主㐫。己卯進神祿，辛卯破祿，又為交神，半吉半㐫。癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"卯帶太乙死祿，雖貴終貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"丙祿巳見，己巳九天庫祿，主吉，辛巳截路空亡，癸巳伏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"貴神祿，半吉半㐫，乙巳旺馬祿，丁巳庫祿，俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"29","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"丁祿午見，庚午截路空亡㐫，壬午為徳合祿，甲午為進","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"神祿，俱吉。丙午喜神祿，交羊刃半吉。戊午伏羊刃祿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505879384457227"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"多㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":36,"lineType":1,"content":"戊祿己見，己巳九天庫祿，主吉。辛巳截路空亡。癸巳貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"神祿，戊癸化合，有官位重。乙巳驛馬同鄉祿，丁巳旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"庫祿，俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"36","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"己祿午見，庚午截路空亡，壬午死鬼祿，俱㐫。甲午進神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"合祿，顯達之象。丙午喜神祿，戊午伏神羊刃祿㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"38","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"庚祿申見，壬申為大敗祿，甲申截路空亡祿，俱㐫。丙申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"大敗祿，多成敗。戊申伏馬祿，多滯，若値福星，貴吉。庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505913584664611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"申長生祿，大吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"42","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"辛祿酉見，癸酉伏神祿，水火相犯㐫，乙酉破祿，成敗。丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"酉空亡貴神祿，丁木受氣，辛水沐浴，主姦淫事，値喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"神吉。己酉進神祿，辛酉正祿，俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"壬祿亥。見丁亥貴神合祿，乙亥天徳祿，己亥旺祿，辛亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"同馬鄉祿，俱大吉，獨癸亥大敗祿，貧薄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"47","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"癸祿子。見甲子進神祿，主登科進達，丙子交羊刃祿，帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"福星貴有權，戊子伏羊刃，合貴祿半吉。庚子印祿吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505892474863670"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子正羊刃祿㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"51","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"有生成祿，甲乙人得甲寅乙卯之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"52","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"有名位祿，甲人見丙寅之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"53","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"有眞祿，甲人見丙或己，乙人見己或午之類。皆為貴格，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"有進退。眞祿，戊辰見丁巳，戊午見丁巳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰見癸巳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午見癸巳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥見甲子，癸丑見甲子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥，壬子見癸亥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"進則平易，退則艱難，更帶福神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"可作貴命，怕重見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505869565542434"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"有祿値㑹合，甲祿寅而得庚戌之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"64","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"有食神帶祿，壬食甲而得甲寅，癸食乙而得乙卯，戊食","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"庚而得庚申，己食辛而得辛酉。主吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"66","lineNum":72,"lineType":1,"content":"有食神合祿，甲食丙，得丙申丙寅。乙食丁，得丁未丁卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"庚食壬，得壬辰、壬子。辛食癸，得癸巳、癸丑。八位俱主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"69","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"有祿頭財，為絪縟煞，甲人見戊寅，乙人見己卯之類，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"人富，有聲望。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505879384440843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"有祿頭鬼，為赤口煞。甲人見庚寅，乙人見辛卯之類，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"口舌刑責。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"74","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"有旬中祿，甲申見庚寅，戊午見丁巳之類，主清華要職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"有天祿貴神。如丁人祿在午，遁至午上，得丙字，而丙貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"在酉，亥得辛酉、辛亥，則辛貴復見於午之類，入格極","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"品。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"78","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"有干支合祿，如甲祿寅，得甲寅、己亥。乙祿卯，得乙卯、庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"戌之類，主官職崇重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505900968214537"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"有互換貴祿，庚寅見甲申日時之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"82","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"有朝元祿，如寅人見甲日時之類，或朝於胎中，尤貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"有朝元夾合，如癸巳見戊辰、戊午，兩戊與癸合夾己，戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"祿巳之類，主封爵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
