{"lines":[{"lineId":"85","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"有祿入祿堂理。愚歌云：祿入祿堂須大拜。李虛中以甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"人得甲戌，以甲為歲干，則甲之本位遁至戌，謂之祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"堂。辛壬有二位，辛有辛卯、辛丑，壬有壬寅、壬子。五行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"無尅，諸位相助，發福必大。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505897403187240"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"古人云：祿前二辰為背，祿後二辰為向。沈芝取建向近","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"合四字為貴，建不如向，近不如合，四字中得兩字者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。如甲祿寅，以寅為建，丑為向，卯為近，亥為合，餘准","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"此，餘皆一位。忌三合六合上見刑見鬼。以甲戌言，鬼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"在丑上則可畏，以丑刑戌。在未則不忌，以戌刑未。以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉言，鬼在巳上為害，以三合相㑹。在辰則減福，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"六合相親。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"97","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"夫建祿者，主人肌厚氣實，體格不清，一生安逸，足財利，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505900968247305"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺自然死。絶則氣濁神慢，孳孳為生，吝嗇猥鄙。與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"元辰併，因摴蒱得財，復因此敗。與官符併，因官門得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"財，或多爭訟。與刼煞併，好賤技小商，不義横財。與天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"中併，多遺失破財。與祿鬼倒食併。多因賖貸牙儈得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"財，至死不通。惟財是念之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"104","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：庫者，祿之聚，如甲乙在未，丙丁在戌，戊己壬癸在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，庚辛在丑，如甲乙亥多而得未，乃祿厚豐足之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"合者，祿之横。如甲祿寅而得亥，謂之明合，無寅得亥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505897403203624"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之暗合。雖非見祿，亦曰見祿多，主儻來之福。拱者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"祿之尊。如甲祿居寅，不見寅而見丑，卯在兩傍拱之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之虛拱。如甲人見寅，又見丑，卯在兩傍，謂之實拱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"然拱實不若拱虛，主大富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"112","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人命帶祿，或吉或㐫，或貴或賤，未可全靠便為吉論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙妙㫖","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_1","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"云：君不見祿馬貴人無准托，考究五行之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"善惡。天元羸弱未為災，地氣堅牢足懽樂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"源髓歌","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_2","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"祿馬更有多般說，自衰自死兼敗絶。若無吉煞加助","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505892474880054"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"時，定知破祖多浮劣。可見先論五行，後看祿馬。五行要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺，祿馬怕衰絶。司馬季主云：祿多馬少，使主神勞。祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"少馬多，能操善負。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"123","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"洞玄經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_3","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：位生火以圓融之，然後隂中陽動而生。亥卯未，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"木屬也，金藏其中矣。遇巳位生金以槖籥之，然後動者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"靜而斂者散。巳酉丑，金屬也，水藏其中矣。遇亥位生木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"以敷榮之，然後斂者散而屈者伸。由是水火木金，錯綜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"往來，因時動靜，内外相感，互為利用，進則與時偕行，退","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505869565526050"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"則與時偕極。然則古之强名驛馬者，皆此例也。是特舉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"其一隅而已。苟以三隅反，則理歸一揆，不必執寅午戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"申、申子辰寅，然後為馬。凡水中火騰，火中水降，隂陽交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"泰，剛柔變通，皆為馬類。希尹曰：古人謂當行更易變動，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"奔衝往來之際，惟驛馬為然。火局在申，水局在寅，金局在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":144,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，木局在巳。葢五行之氣，當其相反處，乃始衝激，故火馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"必在水長生處，水馬必在火長生處，木金亦然，此其義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"徐子平以財為馬，亦是因古人之義，取尅處而名之耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505892474847286"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"燭神經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_4","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"云：驛馬生旺，主人氣韻凝峻，通變趨時，平生多聲望，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"死絶則為性，有頭無尾，或是或非，一生少成，漂泊不定。與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"祿同鄉，則福力優游。與煞相衝併，或孤神弔客喪門併者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"離鄉背井之人，或為僧道，或為商賈。帶倒食禄鬼者，一生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"慳吝，機倖過賤，市㕓態。與食神衝併者，聲譽人也。行年遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"馬，與病符同，主病驚，與甲以寅祿庚壬，本非駕禄可以興","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"馬，有時乎無用。可見命之見禄，要簡不要繁，要禄干不返","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"傷本主，不犯梟神為佳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505892474945590"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：凡命帶祿，最怕犯衝，謂之破祿。如甲以寅祿見申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"乙以卯祿見酉，則氣散不聚，貴人停職剥官，衆人衣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"祿不足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"源髓歌","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_5","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"云：破印破財併破禄，破馬少曽為我","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":162,"lineType":1,"content":"福。是嫌衝也。最怕落空，謂之閒祿，如甲辰旬空寅卯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"却得寅為甲之祿。古人云：資財聚散祿居空，胎裏生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"時怕遇逢，貧賤為奴多乞食，飄飄身自從西東。沈芝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"云：禄入空亡何所知，虛名虚譽足堪嗤。是嫌亡也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"158","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵命入格合造化，亦不専在祿上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505869565607970"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":169,"lineType":8,"content":"論金轝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"轝者車也。金者貴之之義。譬之君子居官得祿，須坐車","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"以載之，故金轝常居祿前二辰，如甲子人祿在寅，辰為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"金轝是也。此煞乃祿命之旌旗，三才之節鉞，主人性柔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"貌愿，舉止溫克。婦人逢之，不富即貴；男子得之，多妻妾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"陰福相扶持，生日生時遇之為佳，骨肉平生安泰，得賢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"妻妾，子孫茂盛。如皇族多帶此煞。常格得之，身在無氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"中，生主作贅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"紫虛局","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_6","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"云：祿前二辰號金轝，遇此之人福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505869565624354"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"最殊，偏主聰明多富貴，一生清泰亦無虞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"八字金書","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_7","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":180,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬前辰居二位，此名金轝在其中。生於此處併行運，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"到老為官轉自通。是又以馬前二辰為金轝。若人命官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，夾擁金轝引從，主大貴。若金轝見福，貴併將星者妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"177","lineNum":183,"lineType":8,"content":"論驛馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":183,"lineType":2,"content":"後一辰為攀鞍，喻人乘馬須加鞍也，故論馬要攀鞍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂驛馬者，乃先天三合數也。先天寅七午九戌五，合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"數二十有一，故自子順至申，凡二十有一，而為火局之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬。亥卯未之數四，六與八合，為十八，故自子順至巳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505892474929206"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"凡十八而為木局之驛馬。木火陽局也，從子一陽順行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"金水，陰局也，從午一陰逆行。申子辰之數七，九與五合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"為二十有一，故自午逆至寅，凡二十有一，而為水局之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬。巳酉丑之數四，六與八合，為十八，故自午逆至亥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"凡十有八，而為金局之驛馬。此法之所由立也。或以馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"有傳受之氣，有代勞之功，如人病不能赴，待子來接，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"病處見子為驛馬。又曰：驛馬者，五行有為待用之氣，强","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"名也。陰陽倚伏，氣令循環，猶今之置郵傳命，迎來送往，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505913584713763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"氣藏如驛，氣動如馬。寅午戌，火屬也，水藏其中矣。遇申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"位生水，以發越之，然後陽中陰動而化。申子辰，水屬也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"火藏其中矣。遇寅官符同主官事驚恐，入宅舍，主口舌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"驚恐。但以歲中吉㐫言之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌生人馬在申，而五陽干乘之，見甲申截路空日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"馬，丙申大敗馬，戊申福星伏馬，庚申逢天關馬，壬申大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"敗馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":205,"lineType":2,"content":"又名劣馬。主平生奔走，財帛歇滅。如壬申、甲申、丙申、戊申四馬多疾，再沈再起，招是招非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"以上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉丑申年月日時發應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505897403236392"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰人馬在寅，而五陽干乘之，見甲寅正祿文星馬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅福星馬，戊寅伏馬，庚寅破祿馬，壬寅截路馬。以上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未寅年月日時發應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉丑人馬在亥，而五陰干乘之，見乙亥天徳馬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":212,"lineType":2,"content":"又名劣馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"以馬中支生干，主汨沒無成，徒自聰明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":213,"lineType":2,"content":"又名絶馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥天乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"馬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":214,"lineType":2,"content":"是馬臨官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"巳亥旺祿馬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":214,"lineType":2,"content":"是長生馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥正祿馬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":214,"lineType":2,"content":"又病馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥大敗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":215,"lineType":2,"content":"又臨官馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"以上申子辰亥年月日時發應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"221","lineNum":216,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未人馬在巳，而五陰干乘之，見乙巳正祿馬，丁巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505879384539147"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"旺氣馬，己巳九天祿庫馬，辛巳截路馬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":219,"lineType":2,"content":"一云値貴人半吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙伏馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":220,"lineType":2,"content":"一云，値貴人吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"以上寅午戌巳年月日時發應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"凡柱中帶馬，若不値空亡、破敗、交退，伏神須榮貴互祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"共天乙貴神同其馬位，更得諸煞相併，官秉大權，貴居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"廊廟，時為上貴，日為中貴，月為常庶。庫馬主少年之喜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"旺馬資壯歲之榮，生馬老方得遂，而官卑任遠矣。如木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"生亥，旺卯庫未，餘倣此。珞琭子云：生馬未必有馬，背祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"未必無祿。看其旺庫，不問背生，妙在消息盈虛也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505883046182966"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：驛馬者，三命中發用，喜慶之神。若人遇之，君子常","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"居榮位，小人主豐贍。大小運行年至此，主得官及遷改","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"之喜。小運及行年合驛馬，並主遷官得祿。如甲子人驛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"馬在寅，小運及太歲至亥，亥與寅合之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"240","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"又馬有十二。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":234,"lineType":1,"content":"一曰欵段。謂己酉丑人得壬亥，亥卯未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"人得丙巳，申子辰人得甲寅，寅午戌人得戊申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"二曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"蹶蹄。謂四柱雖帶驛馬，而生日値空亡之神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"三曰折","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"足。謂胎月帶驛馬，而日時帶沐浴者是。申子辰全見寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505914566164507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"為馬，是三人騎一馬，謂之折足。若亥卯未全見馬，總有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"官貴，終成下賤。若一辰坐者，少年雖泰後還窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"四曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"無糧。謂生日値馬，馬食太歲。如甲子人得壬寅日，而時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"更落在空亡者是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"五曰不出㕔廐。謂胎月帶馬，不見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，及不見祿堂，及入空亡者是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"六曰嘶風，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":249,"lineType":2,"content":"缺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"七曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"趨途。謂驛馬雖有祿，在空亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":252,"lineType":1,"content":"八曰䭾屍。十二驛馬，惟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"䭾屍最㓙，見祿即屍。甲子旬中，巳酉丑生人，馬在亥。乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"丑人丁亥；己巳人乙亥；癸酉人癸亥。乙丑人得亥馬，忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505879384522763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"寅月日時；己巳人得亥馬，忌申月日時；癸酉人得亥馬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"亦忌寅月日時。有一在此，名曰䭾屍，亦如亥卯未是。甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"午旬中，乙未人辛巳、己亥人己巳、癸卯人丁巳。乙未人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"得巳馬，忌寅月日時；己亥人得巳馬，忌申月日時；癸卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"人得巳馬，亦忌寅月日時，皆䭾屍也。餘旬凖此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"九曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"食蒭。謂驛馬尅其時。假令驛馬屬金，生時得木，此類謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"之食蒭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"十曰乘軒。謂胎月生日帶祿馬。假令甲申人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"得庚寅、甲寅時及庚寅胎月是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"十一曰乘軺。謂有天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505883046199350"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"地得合，見太歲生月日時，見貴人驛馬。假令丁亥生人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"四月壬寅日、己酉時，月坐馬，酉係貴人是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"十二曰無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"轡，謂貴神空亡，祿在絶鄉者是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"279","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"以上十二驛馬，當以意消息，灾福自見。欵段則平生坎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"坷，止作選人。無糧不食天俸，不出廐則不歴任所，折足","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"則永失，蹶蹄則復起，無轡則一生孤寒，食蒭則官可六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"品，嘶風徒有虛聲，趨途謾勞求祿，乘軺則帶職，乘軒則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"三公，䭾屍則得官即亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505908551532554"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"有干支合馬，如申子辰馬在寅，甲寅見己亥合，丙寅見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥合，主官職崇重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"287","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"有馬頭帶劒，謂驛馬上見庚辛，或納音見金，主名振邊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"疆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"有馬驟天庭，謂木人得亥而見辛亥。又馬上干逢得祿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"如六壬人生居寅午戌之位，於甲上遁得戊干，戊之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"祿在己巳，係天庭，復見巳得酉合之為是，主官居極","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"品。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505914566148123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"有馬，後二辰為九地馬，主職近王廷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"295","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"有天馬貴神，乃歲中不見驛，五虎遁至馬上，看得何干，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"其干見天乙，而天乙所坐之干，却復見貴於馬上是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"也。貴不下三品。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"有一木繫雙馬，寅午戌多見丙申，申子辰多見庚寅，巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"酉丑多見己亥，亥卯未多見癸巳。馬上干尅支，主多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"驚險。若遇四馬聚於時或年上，主封爵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"301","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"又驛馬下生人月日時支干得御䇿全併尅身者，定貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505908551548938"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"馬前一辰為御，後一辰為䇿。假令甲子金命，正月辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"丑日卯時生，以子人馬在寅逢祿，又本命子與生日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"丑在馬後為䇿，卯時在馬前為御。又馬是丙寅火，能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"尅甲子金，故主貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"307","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"有有驛有馬者，主位至公侯。干為馬，支為驛。如戊戌人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"馬在申，而得庚申支干俱屬金，到申臨官；戊戌支干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"俱屬土，到申長生，本命及驛馬支干背馬有氣，是有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"驛有馬。又如壬午人驛馬在戊申，戊土臨申長生，本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505879384588299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"命壬水到申亦長生，午火到申為衰鄉，本命干旺支","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"衰，是有馬無驛。又如丁丑人驛馬在辛亥，金臨亥為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"病鄉，本命丁火到亥為絶，以丑土到亥為臨官，本命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"干衰支旺，驛馬干亦衰，是有驛無馬。或以寅午戌見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"庚無申，見申無庚之類，為有馬無驛。有驛無馬亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"317","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"有馬尅身者，取驛馬之辰能制生月。如寅午戌人馬在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"申，申屬金，能制寅卯月木。假令甲子人在辰戌丑未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"月生是也。主官祿易求，仕宦無滯，少年亨快，為官清","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505916365471763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"顯，常人遇之小富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"322","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"有馬財庫，取驛馬所尅之辰入墓，如馬在申，申屬金，金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"尅木，木至未為庫之例。主平生遊歴四方，廣得資財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"324","lineNum":324,"lineType":1,"content":"有英靈貫馬，乃五行眞氣之長生，下遇驛馬，主持節按","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"部之使。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"有南方離明馬，謂未馬己，丑馬亥，辰馬寅，戌馬申。辰戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未係土之位，以生處為馬故辰戌丑未人飛在午，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"為南方離門之馬，遇此者愛子午相衝，為飛馬，見鞭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505913584795683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"䇿入格，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"331","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"有驛馬清濁，甲子得丙寅祿馬同鄉，又丙為食神，乘長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"生馬，丁丑得丁亥為天乙天官乘臨官馬。若乘長生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"臨官馬，或帶食祿貴氣，則遇一當百。若乘病絶空亡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"馬，更値破敗交退伏神，則遇而不遇，縱為官，粗濁卑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"賤，非清要之職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"336","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：凡看驛馬，有四專名位、生旺、病絶、駞寶、啣花及倒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"食，互換不同，中間好惡榮辱，須於歲運鞭䇿細詳之。四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505916365488147"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"專者，如申子辰馬在寅，寅逢甲寅、申遇庚申、己逢丁巳、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"亥遇癸亥是也。名位者，乃馬中逢食神，如甲見丙、乙見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"丁之類，馬上得食是也。四生者，辛巳、甲申、己亥、丙寅，納","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"音自生是也。四病乃自死自絶，如年納音屬金，金絶在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"寅是也。駞寶者，乃甲子見戊寅，馬頭帶天財，或納音尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"馬為財，如食神之類，如甲寅人見丙申，甲申見丙寅日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"時是也。啣花者，乃納音臨官遇馬，如庚申、壬子、戊辰，納","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"音皆木遇寅馬臨官之地是也。又生成馬、名位馬，與前","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505911848206377"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"論祿同，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"349","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人遇馬，喜專旺而嫌空亡駁雜為不達，惡死絶而喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"逢食見財為有益。商賈多愛駞寶，婦女最怕啣花，駞寶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"則富，啣花則淫，啣花更忌木。人値庚寅，乙亥見乙巳，丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"卯見丁巳，己未見己巳，尤重，男多淫蕩，女多私情。運中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"遇者同前斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"354","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰驛馬最怕干神倒食，如乙酉見癸亥為驛馬，却被","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"反食於我，所謂乙癸不同科是也。鞭策發時看互換，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505908551614474"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"辰人馬在寅，或太歲在申，衝動寅即太歲。為鞭䇿，小運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"在申，即小運為鞭䇿，多主動。更看申與寅互換如何，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申遇甲寅，庚申屬木，寅則臨官，甲寅屬水，申則長生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"之類，相和則吉，相尅則滯。如兩互換，無氣則空動或失","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"意，有氣即主財。四馬朝元，好則榮貴，惡則破家失業，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"為僧道，好遊脚小兒，老人不利見馬，小兒十二歲以前，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"三歲以上，或馬遇小運太歲衝，或臨官馬遇，多主驚病","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"顚撲之厄。老人五十以上，或運與太歲乘之，主氣虛、腰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505913584779299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"痛、脚痛之患。亦如老人祿遇病多吐食之類，少者見之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"多發病。蓋老少並不堪乘馬，以馬在五行中為動躍之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"神故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"369","lineNum":374,"lineType":8,"content":"總論祿馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"祿為養命之源，馬是扶身之本，二者最喜相見。且如寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"午戌馬在申，甲祿在寅，甲干寅上遁見丙，申上遁見壬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"則以丙為天祿，壬為天馬，在日時上交互見之，謂之天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":378,"lineType":1,"content":"祿天馬。又甲人遁至戌，見甲戌，謂之活祿；甲子人遁見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505913584812067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅，謂之活馬。又如寅午戌在申，而時干得庚，亥卯未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"在巳，而時干得丙，申子辰在寅，而時干得甲，巳酉丑在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，而時干得壬。以日支求時干，以時干求日支，互換得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"之，謂之祿馬交馳。又如甲祿在寅，申子辰馬亦在寅，却","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"是甲子甲申甲辰生，而時得丙寅，帝座上會祿馬，謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"祿馬同鄉。又如祿前馬後，如辛巳人得戌日時，乙亥人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"得辰日時，辛祿在酉馬在亥，乙祿在卯馬在巳。不見祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"馬，而祿馬藏於其中，謂之夾祿夾馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼谷遺文","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_8","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：時居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505908551598090"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"日祿，當得路於青雲；五馬交馳，可致身於黄閣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_9","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"389","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"背祿逐馬，守窮途而恓惶；祿馬同鄉，不三台而八座。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"韓□","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"命書","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_10","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"有孤孀祿馬之說。如甲子見丙寅，庚午見壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"申，此雖祿馬同鄉，殊不知甲子乃一陽，乙丑二陽，丙寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"三陽，純陽無陰也。庚午乃一陰，辛未二陰，壬申三陰，純","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"陰無陽也。此二者謂之孤孀祿馬，雖同鄉亦不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"理愚","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_11","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"歌","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_11","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：祿馬飛天無刑尅，旺相中生須至貴。林開曰：馬在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"長生須富學，祿逢帝旺足錢財。若還刺死兼流役，是帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505911848222761"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"懸針刼煞來。又曰：祿若臨時馬不來，此人只是有錢財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"一生耻話招賢士，死絶關門誓不開。詳諸說，見祿馬兼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"有，又乘生旺為妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"404","lineNum":404,"lineType":8,"content":"論天乙貴人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"405","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙者，乃天上之神，在紫微垣閶闔門外，與太乙並列，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"事天皇大帝，下遊三辰，家在己丑斗牛之次，出乎己未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"井鬼之舍，執玉衡較量天人之事，名曰天乙也。其神最","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"尊貴，所至之處，一切㓙煞，隱然而避。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"通玄經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_12","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"云：先天坤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505916365504531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"在北方子位，陽貴起。先天之坤，乃從子上起甲干，甲徳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"在子，甲與己合。不取甲徳，而取合氣，故己為貴人。陽貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"順行，則乙徳在丑，乙與庚合，庚以牛。為陽貴。丙徳在寅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":414,"lineType":1,"content":"丙與辛合，辛以虎。丁徳在卯，丁與壬合，壬以兔。辰乃天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"羅，貴人不臨，故戊跳辰徳在己，戊與癸合，癸以巳。午與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"子對衝，名為天空，貴人有獨無對，故己徳跳午在未，己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"與甲合，甲以羊。庚徳在申，庚與乙合，乙以猴。辛徳在酉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"辛與丙合，丙以雞。戌乃地網，貴人不臨，故壬跳戌徳在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505900968312841"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，壬與丁合，丁以猪。子乃先天起貴之所，貴人不再臨，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"故癸跳子徳在丑，癸與戊合，戊以牛。如此則甲戊庚牛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"羊，六辛逢馬虎明矣。後天坤在西南申位，陰貴起後天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"之坤，乃從申上起甲干。甲徳在申，甲與己合，己以猴。陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"貴逆行，則乙徳在未，乙與庚合，庚以羊。丙徳在午，丙與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"辛合，辛以馬。丁徳在巳，丁與壬合，壬以蛇。辰乃天羅，貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"人不臨，故戊跳辰，徳在卯，戊與癸合，癸以兔。寅與甲對","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"衝，名曰天空，貴人有獨無對，故己徳跳寅居丑，己與甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505900968345609"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"合，甲以牛。庚徳在子，庚與乙合，乙以鼠。辛徳在亥，辛與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":432,"lineType":1,"content":"丙合，丙以猪。戌乃地網，貴人不臨，故壬跳戌，徳在酉，壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"與丁合，丁以雞。申乃後天起貴之處，貴人不再臨，故癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"跳申，徳在未，癸與戊合，戊以羊。以此推之，則甲戊庚貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"人之居丑未，而於先後起陰陽者，亦明矣。然必皆起","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_13","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"者，貴人家在己丑，出乎己未，先後俱屬土，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_14","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"卦二五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"黄中之合氣。干之配支，徳氣相合，出於自然如此。其曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"陽貴陰貴，乃冬至用陽，夏至用陰，非晝夜之說。據此說，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505897403269160"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙是十干之秀氣，非天上之星也。余聞一術者云：日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"出於寅，衆星皆落；日沉於申，衆星皆出。故晝貴起於寅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"夜貴起於申。數至丑未，是天乙之家舍十干見天乙為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。如甲祿寅，以寅加寅，順數至丑，即為本家。故甲貴在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"丑。乙祿卯，以卯加寅，數至子，見丑。故乙貴在子。丙祿己，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"以己加寅，數至戌，見丑。戌為惡弱之地，天乙不臨，則進","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"一位，故丙貴在亥。丁祿午，以午加寅，數至酉，見丑。故丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"貴在酉。戊寄位於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"艮","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_15","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"，故戊亦以寅起，與甲同。己寄位於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505914566213659"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_16","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"，以未加寅，數至申，見丑。故己貴在申。庚祿申，以申加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，數至未，見丑。故庚貴在未。辛祿酉，以酉加寅，數至午，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"見丑。故辛貴在午。壬祿亥，以亥加寅，數至辰，見丑。辰為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"惡弱之地，天乙不臨，則進一位。故壬貴在巳。癸祿子，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"子加寅，數至卯，見丑。故癸貴在卯。夜貴以申起，一如寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"法。見未與見丑，同是貴分有定位，而甲戊庚牛羊之歌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"則泥而不通矣。此說就以天星論，尤為有理。今","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_17","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"選","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"擇諸術，或分隂陽，或分晝夜，盖本此二説。壺中子云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505900968378377"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人分治晝夜，各自專權，以晝生遇晝貴，夜生遇夜貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"為得力。或以子後為晝，午後為夜；或以日出為晝，日入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"為夜，皆是臆說。不若只以寅申分陰陽，冬至後用陽貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"夏至後用陰貴。人命一陽生後遇陽貴為得力，一陰生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"後遇陰貴為得力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"三車一覽","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_18","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"，則以甲陽木乘少陽之氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"生乎東方，至巳而用事畢矣，故退藏於未而為貴。庚陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"金乘少陰之氣而生乎西，至亥而用事畢矣，故退藏於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":468,"lineType":1,"content":"丑而為貴。戊陽土沖和中央，播於四時，甲因之萬物生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505900968411145"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"庚因之萬物成，則生成之理畢矣。乙乃陰木，巳乃陰土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"二位無氣失類而無所居，必待申子生旺，水土滋養充","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"實，補助不足，此二者，喜見申子而為貴。丙丁之火當盛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"夏，至酷而害萬物，性熄於酉，藏於亥，以西北成齊之氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"而和。此二者，以酉亥陰氣和而為貴。壬癸之水至窮冬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"則其性嚴而殺萬物，惟嗇於卯，潛於巳，以東南溫燠之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"氣而和。此二者，以己卯陽氣和而為貴。辛乃陰金，執方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"不能自化，須假寅午生旺之火，剉剛革而成形為貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"廣","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_19","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505892474994742"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"錄","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_19","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"云：甲陽木，戌陽土，庚陽金，皆喜土位。未者，土之正位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"丑者，土安靜之地，所以牛羊為貴。細分之，甲尤喜未，庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"尤喜丑，各歸其庫也。戊子、戊寅、戊午，喜丑，丑者，火人胎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"養之鄉。戊辰、戊申、戊戌，喜未，未者，木人之庫，土人生旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"之位也。乙者陰木，己者陰土。陰土喜生旺，陰木愛陽水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":486,"lineType":1,"content":"所以鼠猴為貴。然乙尤喜子，子者，水之旺鄉。己尤喜申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"申者，坤之正位。丙丁屬火，火墓在戌。壬癸屬水，水墓在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"辰。辰戌魁罡之地，貴人不臨，故尋寄火貴於酉亥，寄水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505911848255529"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"貴於卯巳，皆歸根復命之鄉。六辛陰金，喜陽火生旺之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"地，故以馬虎為貴。更宜以納音互換推尋，須比和，則其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"貴為福。若丙火得酉火至此死，焉足貴哉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"499","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"閻東叟云：論天乙貴，須就五行喜忌。如甲人有戊有庚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"得癸未、乙丑，遇二吉而帶印為上遁，見丁丑、辛未者次","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"之，乃三陽喜在印庫。乙人得戊申、庚子生旺之土，己人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"得甲申、丙子生旺之水，此陰木陰土，喜於財旺。丙丁得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉、乙亥，壬癸得乙卯、癸巳，此水火不嫌死絶。六辛得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505900968394761"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅、丙午，此陰金不嫌鬼勝。得二為上，得一次之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"紫虛","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_20","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"局","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_20","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"以此為貴人入廟，遇者主金紫貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寶鑑","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_21","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"又以五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":503,"lineType":1,"content":"虎元遁至貴人本位上，見所遁之干為入廟，不犯空亡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":504,"lineType":1,"content":"駁雜，主清貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"513","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"八字金書","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_22","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"論貴神又分優劣，即前六十甲子吉㓙其歸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"要與祿馬同窠，不犯交退伏神。支干相合為吉，𦂳要在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"月日時支干相合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"517","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"林開論天乙相合，如甲子見己未，無死絶衝破空亡，更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505914566230043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"有福神助，至貴；如犯上忌減力，又多難無福。戊子見己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"丑，不犯上忌，更有福助，此為次格。有死絶減力，有衝破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡，風塵吏也。辛未見庚寅，不犯上忌，有福助，為第三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"等。死絶減力衝破空亡，平生多難，卑冗官耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"523","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"閻東叟論貴合貴食，如甲得己丑、己未，戊得癸丑、癸未，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"庚得乙丑、乙未，乙得庚子、庚申，己得甲子、甲申，丙得辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"酉、辛亥，丁得壬寅、壬辰，如此類，謂之貴合。甲食丙，乙食","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"丁，丙丁貴在酉亥，甲得丙寅、丙辰，乙得丁酉、丁亥；庚食","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505892475027510"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":521,"lineType":1,"content":"壬，辛食癸，壬癸貴在卯巳，庚得壬申、壬戌，辛得癸卯、癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":522,"lineType":1,"content":"巳，如此類，謂之貴食。有貴合，則官多榮顯，有貴食，則祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"多稱意，三者兼之，官高祿重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"531","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"三命提要","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_23","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"以天乙在貴神六合上，如甲戊庚在子午，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"子合丑，午合未；乙己在丑巳，丙丁在寅辰，壬癸在申戌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"辛在未亥，皆主大福。遇兩合以上尤貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"535","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"寶鑑","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_24","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"有天乙扶身，取貴人夾擁太歲，如壬寅人得甲寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"日時，壬貴在卯，甲癸在丑，夾擁乎寅。丙申人得戊申，准","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505926826065935"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"此。入貴格，别無刑衝，主一生少病，早年享福。常格得之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"終身無刑獄之災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"541","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"有干夾貴神，如甲戊庚人得丑未日時上却帶甲戊庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"一字，主顯異。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"543","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"指南","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_25","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"有夾貴逢六合，如壬癸人見辰而得癸酉合，丙丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"人見戌而得丁卯合，取前後各有天乙貴，更祿馬臨身，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"主大富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"547","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"紫虛局","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_26","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"有活祿貴人，乃貴人干上轉干支，再就生時胎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505869565689890"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"月，如甲逢寅午，乙辛丑未，丙酉亥，丁申子，戊癸猴鼠，庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"壬兔蛇，己卯巳日時兼全坐之，主大貴。如一命戊戌甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"子、辛巳丙申是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"553","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"有福星貴人，如一命壬子癸卯，庚戌庚辰，壬騎龍背，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"貴在卯，己得辰，是福星扶貴人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"555","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"有貴人擁馬而前，視刃，主權貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"556","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"陳希烈曰：干為天乙之將，支為貴人之帥。假如丑未生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"人，月日時得甲戊庚，是遇正天乙；甲子人十二月生，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505926826082319"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"遇貴神；己巳日、乙亥時，是遇兩天乙。合貴人之命觀之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"若在太歲本干，四貴華蓋上遇天乙者，宰輔之命也。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"在四平位，遇兩天乙，亦為侍從清華之命。若四忌上遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"兩天乙，常調之官也。凡貴人命，若丑未人，甲戊庚中惟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"得兩字。子申人得乙己全，酉亥人得丙丁全之類。更得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲干祿為正官正印者，其福加倍。沈芝云：凡生月日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"時，遇天乙貴人相間四字全者，為極貴，如酉亥有丙丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":558,"lineType":1,"content":"之類。說者舉魯公命己亥、丙寅、乙酉、丁丑，是相間四字","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505926826115087"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"全。予謂時不値忌神，所以至宰相。若酉月生己祿到酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"為敗忌，雖四字全，必不至大貴。古人皆以貴人主福，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"言福力厚薄，今各隨位約而分之。如甲人遇丑，庚人遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"未，各在祿庫。戊人遇丑，未是土支，己人遇申，是與生旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"同位。以上四神，生日生時遇之，帶正官正印，上下合正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙本家，天乙貴神合者，福力加倍。乙人遇申絶忌，却","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"有暗合，遇子敗忌，丙丁遇亥絶忌，丁有暗合，遇酉死忌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸遇巳絶忌，癸有暗合，遇卯死忌，辛人遇午敗忌，遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505926826098703"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"寅絶忌。以上六貴神，皆與忌神同位，生月日時遇之，可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"得二三分福力。若與驛馬同位，及帶正天乙本家祿正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"官正印干合有輔助者加倍。據此分，是貴人忌死絶，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"不思丙丁壬癸，正以死絶為貴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"581","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"燭神經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_27","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：天乙貴遇生旺，則形貌軒昻，性靈頴悟，理義","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"分明，不喜雜術，純粹大器，身蘊道徳，衆人欽愛；死絶則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"執抝自是，喜遊近貴。與刼煞併，則貌厚有威，多謀足計；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"與官符併，則文翰飄逸，高談雄辯；與建祿併，則文翰純","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505908551663626"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"實，濟惠廣遊，君子人也。若落天中，或與天中合，或與天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"中連珠，當有伶倫之態，好謳吟伎藝人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"589","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：天乙貴，三命中最吉之神，若人遇之則榮，功名早","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"達，官祿亦易進。如三命皆乘旺氣，終登將相公侯之位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"大小運行年至此，亦主遷官進財。一切加臨至此，皆為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"吉兆。凡貴人所臨之處，大槩喜生旺，無衝破，道理順，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"落空亡，天干納音偕和，更得祿馬，而晝夜不背。或年時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"互換貴，如甲午人見辛丑時，丙申見己亥之類。或四干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505869565706274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"併在一支上見貴，如丑未生而得甲戊庚之類。或四位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"天干通聚貴，地支為五行聚貴，更遇天月二徳為佳理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"愚歌","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_28","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"云：貴人或落空亡裏，祿馬背違如不値。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"寶鑑","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_29","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"云：貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":594,"lineType":1,"content":"人無氣，雖有如無。林開云：貴人死絶，為鄙吝煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":594,"lineType":1,"content":"洞玄經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_30","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"云：貴人嗔，則㐫來可見。命中有貴，不可就為吉論，要當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"細詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"606","lineNum":597,"lineType":8,"content":"論三奇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"607","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭子曰：奇為貴也。奇者，異也。謂物以貴為奇也。乙丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505869565722658"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"丁出於貴人，干徳配支之妙。陽貴甲徳起子，則乙徳在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"丑，丙徳在寅，丁徳在卯，三干相連而無間。陰貴甲徳起","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"申，乙在未，丙在午，丁在巳，三間相聯而無間。以其隨貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"人在天，故曰天上三奇。十干惟此為異，餘則或間羅網，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"或間天空，或不重臨，又不相聯，不可以為奇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寶鑑","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_31","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"謂：古人以正月為歲之始，日出於乙，故以乙為日奇。老","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"人星見為瑞，見於丁位，故以丁為星奇。月照夜到丙位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"而天下明，故以丙為月奇。若甲戊庚亦以為天上三奇，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505908551680010"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"以甲戊庚俱臨丑未，乃貴人家在斗牛之次，出乎井鬼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":612,"lineTyp
