e":1,"content":"之舍。先後天起貴，而三干適臨之，與别干不同，其理亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"三車一覽","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_32","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"以甲為陽木之魁，戊為陽土之君，庚為陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"金之精，地有此三物為奇，謂之地三奇，其說則鑿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"太乙","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_33","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_33","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"以辛壬癸為水奇，謂之人間三奇，其說無據。但辛壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"癸天干連珠，謂之三台，亦為難得。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"紫虛局","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_34","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"又有四奇之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"說。夫奇，奇數也，四則偶矣，謂之奇可乎？三奇要順布，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"欲倒亂。如乙丙丁、甲戊庚，天干年月日時，順布為吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"廣","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_35","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505920505282571"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"錄","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_35","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"又以乙人丙月丁時，是乙生丙丁，秀氣下降，主平常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"若乙時丙日丁年，是秀氣上達，反為貴。似又不論順逆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戊庚却以順者為貴，逆者福，慢亂者不壽。氣清則貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"氣濁則富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_36","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：五行各有奇儀，須分逆順。若日月倒亂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"得順三奇，亦不謂倒。命有三奇，要得體、得地，不欲失時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"如乙丙丁夜生，甲戊庚晝生。得體。乙丙丁柱有亥，則三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"光有所依附。甲戊庚柱有申，則三物有所憑藉。或乙丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"丁得丑寅卯未午己，甲戊庚得丑未全，皆為得地。三奇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505911848304681"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"再遇三合。如乙丙丁得金木局，甲戊庚得水火局。又遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"六儀，甲子旬戊，甲戌旬己，甲申旬庚，甲午旬辛，甲辰旬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"壬，甲寅旬癸，俱吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_37","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"云：重犯奇儀蘊藉，抱出羣之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"器。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"遁甲","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_38","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：順布三奇逆六儀。如命出甲子甲申二旬，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"遇甲戊庚，是重犯奇儀也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"656","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命遇三奇，主人精神異常，襟懷卓越，好奇尚大，博學","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"多能。帶天乙貴者，勲業超羣；帶天月二徳者，㓙災不犯；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"帶六儀者，才智出類；帶三合入局者，國家柱石；帶官符","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505914566311963"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞者，器識宏遠；帶空亡生旺者，脫塵離俗，富貴不淫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"威武不屈；値元辰咸池衝破天羅地網者，為無用。論三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"奇，太歲不帶而月日時帶者，孤獨。詩曰：順十干神乙丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"丁，神童及第播聲名，日時祿馬公卿煞，換武除文佐聖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"明。又曰：順十干神甲戊庚，兼得長生兩府名，若然無祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"兼無馬，只是財中蓄積人。又曰：三奇須是重逢貴，方是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"榮華福壽人，只有空奇無貴地，貧窮下賤被欺陵。又曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丙丁，甲戊庚，上局相生生復生，不是蓬萊三島客，也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505900968460297"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"應金殿玉階行。又曰：欲識嵓廊官赫奕，名仙多誕癸壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"辛。三奇玉籍傳消息，輕薄時師莫與評。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"合諸詩觀三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"奇，喜忌見矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"674","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"夫徳者，利物濟人，掩㓙作善之謂也。天徳者，謂周天有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"三百六十五度二十五分半，除十二宫分野，每宫各占","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"三十度。共計三百六十度外，有五度二十五分半，散在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"十二佐宫，甲庚丙壬，乙辛丁癸，乾坤艮巽，謂之神藏煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505900968476681"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":662,"lineType":1,"content":"沒，每宫各得四十四分。所以子午卯酉中，有甲庚丙壬；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":663,"lineType":2,"content":"子中有壬。卯中有甲。午中有丙。酉中有庚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未中，有乙辛丁癸；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":663,"lineType":2,"content":"丑中有癸。辰中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":664,"lineType":2,"content":"有乙未中有丁戌中有辛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申巳亥中，有乾坤艮巽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":664,"lineType":2,"content":"寅中有艮巳中有巽申中有坤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":665,"lineType":2,"content":"亥中有乾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"此十二位宫，能回㓙作善，乃曰天徳也。月徳者，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"三合所照之方，日月會合之辰。申子辰會酉，出庚入垣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"於壬。亥卯未會午，出丙入垣於甲；寅午戌會卯，出甲入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"垣於丙；巳酉丑會子，出壬入垣於庚。故壬甲丙庚，謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"月徳。而辰未戌丑，四月天徳，亦同屬焉。蓋日月照臨之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505918110302223"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，凡天曜地煞，盡可制服，故可回㓙作吉。壺中子云：天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"徳，陽之徳。正月起自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_39","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之前一辰亥上順行乃正月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":674,"lineType":1,"content":"亥、二月子、三月丑、四月寅、五月卯、六月辰、七月巳、八月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"午、九月未、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"699","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"十月申、十一月酉、十二月戌。月徳，陰之徳。正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"月起自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_40","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之後一辰未上順行乃正月未、二月申、三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"月酉、四月戌、五月亥、六月子、七月丑、八月寅、九月卯、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"704","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"月辰、十一月巳、十二月午。五星論天月徳本後說，而以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"前為天月徳，貴人干支之分也。閻東叟云：貴神在位，諸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505916365586451"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"煞伏藏。二徳扶持，衆㓙解散。凡命中帶㓙煞，得此二徳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"扶化，㓙不為甚，須要日上見時上，不犯尅、衝、刑、破方吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人得之，一生安逸，不犯刑，不逢盜，縱遇㓙禍，自然消","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"散。與三奇天乙貴同併，尤為吉慶。或財官印綬，食神變","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"徳，各隨所變，更加一倍之福。入貴格，主登科甲，得君寵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"任，或承祖蔭，亦得顯達。入賤格，一生溫飽，福壽兩全，縱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"有蹇滯，亦能守分固窮，不失為君子。女命得之，多為貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"人之妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"三命鈴","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_41","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"云：天徳者，五行福徳之辰，若人遇之，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505916365570067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"登台輔之位。更有月徳併者尤好，縱有㓙煞，亦主清顯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"子平賦云：印綬得同天徳，官刑不犯，至老無殃。是天徳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"勝月徳也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"722","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"考","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"大統厯","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_42","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"，有天月徳合，乃五行相契之辰。月徳合：如正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":696,"lineType":1,"content":"月丙與辛合，二月甲與己合，三月壬與丁合，四月庚與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"乙合，餘照此。天徳合：如正月丁與壬合，二月坤與巽合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":698,"lineType":1,"content":"三月壬與丁合，四月辛與丙合，餘照此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"728","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"有月空：如寅、午、戌月壬，亥、卯、未月庚，申、子、辰月丙，巳、酉、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505920505298955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"丑月甲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"731","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"有月厭：正月戌，二月酉，三月申，四月未，五月午，六月巳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"七月辰，八月卯，九月寅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"734","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"有月煞：寅、午、戌月丑，亥、卯、未月戌，申、子、辰月未，巳、酉、丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"月辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"738","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"有天赦日。春戊寅，夏甲午，秋戊申，冬甲子，乃天四時専","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505911848337449"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，生育萬物，宥罪赦過。如人命聚一月，徳秀合空，及","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"四大吉時生，更遇天赦日尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"742","lineNum":714,"lineType":1,"content":"此外又有天喜神，春戌、夏丑、秋辰，冬未，遇者主歡欣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"有旌徳煞。如寅午戌丙日時，亥卯未甲日時，申子辰壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"日時，己酉丑庚日時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"745","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"有旌鉞煞。如寅午戌寅時，亥卯未亥時，申子辰申時，己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"酉丑巳時。又寅午戌見辛，亥卯未見巳，申子辰見丁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉丑見乙，亦謂之旌徳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_43","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"云：一神主旌徳，五世不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505920505315339"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":722,"lineType":1,"content":"貧窮。内有旌鉞煞將相及三公，徳鉞相會，不貴即富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"752","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"又有一種旌鉞煞。寅卯辰人見癸酉，己午未人見癸卯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"申酉戌人見戊子，亥子丑人見戊午，乃四時專主誅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"戮之神，庶人主徒配，尅本命，主惡死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"755","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"又有一種三公煞。寅午戌人壬子，己酉丑人丙午，申子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"辰人乙卯，亥卯未人辛酉，乃坐四方專氣，來尅生年，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":728,"lineType":1,"content":"為五行毒氣，庶人犯之，主非横惡，死若旌鉞。更與三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"公煞㑹同一位，主殊貴。今之談命者，論月徳而諸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505914566361115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"煞不論，自是偏見，因並及之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"763","lineNum":734,"lineType":1,"content":"太極者，太初也，始也，物造於初為太極。成也，収也，物有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"所歸曰極。造化始終相保，乃曰太極貴也。甲乙木先造","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"乎子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"坎","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_44","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"水助而生，後終乎午，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"離","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_45","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"火焚而死。丙丁火先喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"出乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"震","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_46","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"，卯也。後喜藏乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"兌","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_47","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"，酉也。庚辛金得寅，乃金生乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":738,"lineType":1,"content":"艮","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_48","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":738,"lineType":1,"content":"，見亥，乃金廟乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":738,"lineType":1,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_49","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":738,"lineType":1,"content":"。壬癸水先得申而生，後得巳而納。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_50","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：地陷東南，四瀆俱流","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"巽","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_51","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"位。皆有始有終之意。戊己，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505916365602835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"土也，喜生乎申，得辰戌丑未為正庫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"理愚歌","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_52","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"云：四庫全","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"時為至貴，位班 {"lines":[{"lineId":"789","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"有文昌貴：甲人蛇口乙猪頭，丙狗丁龍戊向猴。巳午庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"寅辛未貴，六壬卯位癸逢牛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"791","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"有文譽貴如甲子，人見壬戌丙寅。祿前祿後一般神，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":748,"lineType":1,"content":"作公卿冠世人。立性天聰名譽播，富貴榮華事業新。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"793","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"有文星貴：甲馬乙蛇丙戊猴，酉臺丁巳亥辛求。庚逢戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505908551712778"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":752,"lineType":1,"content":"狗壬逢虎，十位文星癸兔遊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"796","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"有天印貴：甲子在寅中，乙逢亥亦同。丁酉戊申位，丙戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":754,"lineType":1,"content":"己羊宫。庚辛馬蛇足，癸卯與壬龍。此號天印貴，榮達","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"受皇封。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
