{"lines":[{"lineId":"800","lineNum":756,"lineType":2,"content":"魁星科名","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_53","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":756,"lineType":2,"content":"附。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"802","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"夫學堂者，如人讀書之在學堂。詞館者，如今官翰林，謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"之詞館，取其學業精專，文章出類。長生乃學堂之正位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"如金命見辛巳，金長生在己，辛巳納音又屬金，是也。臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505914566328347"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":762,"lineType":1,"content":"官乃詞館正位，如金命見壬申，金臨官在申，壬申納音","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"又屬金，是也。餘以類推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_54","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"云：文星入命，笑班馬之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":764,"lineType":1,"content":"無才。註云：乙亥丁巳為文星，是取木火長生臨官之義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"重木火者，發焰紅綠，文章之象也。或以納音論，火包而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"不包，惟乙亥得之。土包而不包，惟丁巳得之。恐未然。閻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"東叟謂：年月日時，有甲乙丙丁，分處四位，相連不斷，青","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":768,"lineType":1,"content":"赤為文章，如甲寅、乙亥、丁酉、丙申、甲子、丙寅、甲寅、丙寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"之類，主文彩異衆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寶鑑","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_55","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"則以木金火全，赤白成章，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505914566393883"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":772,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙寅見己亥、辛巳，取丙寅火，己亥木，辛巳金，皆坐長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":773,"lineType":1,"content":"生之地，主詞翰秀頴。又以申子辰全見丙，如丙子人、丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":774,"lineType":1,"content":"寅月、丙辰日，丙申時，丙為眞水，申子辰水之正位，干支","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"全見之，有金則貴，無金亦主學海波深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼谷要訣","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_56","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己重重兩位，帶旺兼元祿，如戊子人，見戊午、戊戌、己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"未、己酉，主文章燦爛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"827","lineNum":778,"lineType":1,"content":"諸家說有學堂會祿，如金長生，巳，臨官申，甲乙人得之；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"水土長生，申，臨官亥，丙丁壬癸人得之；木長生，亥，臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505913584844835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"官寅，戊己人得之；火長生，寅，臨官巳，庚辛人得之。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"名官貴學堂，以官貴長生之位為學堂，官貴臨官之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"位為詞館也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"833","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"有學堂會食，如甲食丙得丙寅，乙食丁得丁巳，丙食戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"得戊申之類。兼官印驛馬，其福厚；遇祿貴奇徳，其氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"清；値刑尅衝破，其氣濁。清則科名巍峩，厚則官尊榮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"顯，濁則福祿微薄，官職卑賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"837","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"有生處見尅，如甲乙人辛亥，丁丙人壬寅，戊己人甲申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505911848452137"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":792,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛人丁己，謂之官星學堂，主登科甲，入侍從。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"840","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"有納音見帝旺之位，而逢天乙貴處其上，如己酉人得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":794,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子、庚子日時，壬午人得辛卯日時之類，謂之學堂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"會貴，主清貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"843","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"凡學堂、詞館，切不要犯空亡及衝破，支干納音不要見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"尅，方為得用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"祝勝經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_57","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"云：甲辰丙寅，學堂不眞。或止富蔭，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"官職卑貧，讀書修學，空有虛名。此言學堂怕落空也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"三","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_58","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"車","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_58","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"云：學堂無氣，惟利師儒。此言學堂要乘旺也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"理愚歌","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_59","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505918110367759"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"云：學堂如更朝驛馬，位極勲高壓天下。此言學堂要有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"馬也。又云：生來祿馬眞學堂，若同詞館主文章。遇中不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"遇人誰會，不遇衝尅福祿昌。又云：文星聚處人中瑞，聲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"華獨冠英雄輩，降生不遇眞學堂，才學豈能為拔萃。此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"言學堂怕衝破受尅也，况人命入格合造化，又不在學","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"堂詞館而得。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"859","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"子平云：學堂者，天地陰陽清秀之氣，五行長生之神，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"甲見亥，乙見午等例，或月時一位見者即是，不必兼全，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505946619019314"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"更帶天乙貴，如丁日酉時，或酉月之類，讀書人遇之，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"聰明智巧，高科文翰，更引用得地，無尅壓之神，及逢徳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":814,"lineType":1,"content":"秀，冠世儒業，與命中財帛印食，相為表裏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":814,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_60","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":814,"lineType":1,"content":"云生氣學","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"堂冠世，文章富貴。又云：學堂不必專論官星，文章不必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"專論印綬。古人以長生學堂，取生氣就學之義，不必專","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"論日干，但柱中帶寅申巳亥，便為有學。此四宮聚天地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"間至清之氣，其中有四驛馬、四刼煞，皆是生發之意。子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"午卯酉為四敗，其氣濁；辰戌丑未為四庫，其氣雜。且如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505914566426651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"月候到寅申巳亥，便不寒不熱，風氣自然清雅溫和。凡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"占年月者最有力，日干自得長生，却不喜在月令，如月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":824,"lineType":1,"content":"令見之運順行便交沐浴。如八字不帶學堂，到五七歲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"却交日干長生運，亦有文學，雖非通儒，却未至全不識","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":826,"lineType":1,"content":"字。若八字不見，最忌五七歲交敗死二運，縱有嚴師，也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":827,"lineType":1,"content":"難訓化。命帶二様學堂，俱怕自刑尅壞，但有刑衝破損，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":828,"lineType":1,"content":"讀書便不成，重見雖不妨，一衝終不純粹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"880","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：人命不喜十分財盛，財是厚濁之物，一見便要貪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505946619052082"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"好，喪人心志。柱中若先有官星，以抑禀氣之偏，亦性情","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"執古，不能通變。若財盛而無官星，便渾濁不清，縱富貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":834,"lineType":1,"content":"亦愚。古歌云：五行生處為學堂，陰陽順逆要推詳，引旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"有倚文學貴，如逢尅壓不為良。註云：學堂上帶鬼為尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"壓。凡有科名命，自是五行清粹。學堂驛馬，生旺於金水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"之上，三奇華蓋，類萃於日時之中。或刑衝生旺，水火相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":838,"lineType":1,"content":"生，福神聚時，天元不戰，皆主清譽巍科。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"889","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：甲辰一旬十二位，謂之魁星。一旬中又取出甲辰、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505918110433295"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未、庚戌、癸丑四位，以甲木旺於東方，丁火旺於南方，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"庚金旺於西方，癸水旺於北方，取逐方旺氣，加於辰戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":844,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未之上，以為眞魁星。凡人命甲辰至癸丑一旬，俱在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":845,"lineType":1,"content":"日時上，無不及第，兩三位者，必中前名。又云：丁亥、辛卯、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":846,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌為魁星，日時遇者，多占解省殿魁。又，四柱内兩見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"干合，謂之歲首星。子生人在子，以命建之月，謂之歲窠，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"主詞學豐贍，科名顯赫。又，寅申巳亥四位，大愛本年遁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"起四位為魁星。如癸巳人從寅上遁起，甲寅、丁巳、庚申、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505914566410267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥。又如丁卯人從寅上遁起，壬寅、乙巳、戊申、辛亥是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"也。餘准此例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"902","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命，金土乘秀氣，金木乘秀氣，火木乘秀氣，水木乘秀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，皆主科名。秀氣者，月令中秀氣也。大凡支干有氣，乘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":856,"lineType":1,"content":"月令秀氣，皆主及第之命。古歌曰：日旺提綱，火明木秀，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"金白水清重叠。土金既濟，水火遞互，丙丁根苗，天乙相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"涵，金水是也。又，木春生，逢食傷財印兩輕，官煞重，煞重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"身輕，逢印綬魁星，官煞分明奇，亦登科之命，及第之年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505918110400527"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_61","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"云：馬兼財合，秦廷獻一鶚之書。官共祿迎，禹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":863,"lineType":1,"content":"門透三級之浪。註云：行年驛馬與見生驛馬衝而不合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":864,"lineType":1,"content":"又見天財文星之類，其人必發，合則必不發也。遇官與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"祿則須成，不遇官與祿，止發而已。又云：凡舉人了，當年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":866,"lineType":1,"content":"大要太歲與月建，相和作福，其餘甲戊、庚乙丙丁之類，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"皆不定，只以行年太歲，與本生月建，參而推之。又云：須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":868,"lineType":1,"content":"是大運在官位。又，太歲帶正印，或正天乙，或本家祿，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"及第之年也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505926826164239"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":872,"lineType":8,"content":"論正印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"921","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"正印者，乃五行之正庫。金命見乙丑木，癸未火，甲戌水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"土，壬辰丙辰是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"言談","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_62","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"云：生逢正印，必拜玉堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"妙選","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_63","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"五行入垣，官居五府。可見得本家正印為貴，本主同徳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"為上，帝座為中，胎月為下，主人重厚魁梧，功名昭著。本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"家印又得貴格扶之，更妙。若木得水印，火得木印，多兼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"他權外財。若身尅印，或印尅身，廢而復興。若水人得火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"印，火人帶水印，次於本家印，然須本主有旺氣方吉。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505916365651987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":882,"lineType":1,"content":"尅破，别無福救助，或空亡，只作清閒僧道，無成舉人。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"五行有清氣，則絶世高人；有煞則貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"935","lineNum":884,"lineType":1,"content":"有貴人夾印，如丙丁火命，以甲戌為正印，却得酉亥夾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"之，酉亥乃丙丁貴人。壬癸水命，以壬辰為正印，却得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"卯巳夾之，卯巳乃壬癸貴人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"938","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"有華蓋印，如亥卯未得癸未之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"939","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"有文章印，如戊寅見癸未，辛巳見甲戌，庚申見乙丑，癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"亥見丙辰，乙亥見壬辰，乃納音尅身，干神復制。戊午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505913584877603"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":892,"lineType":1,"content":"得癸未，庚子得乙丑，丁酉得壬辰，己卯得甲戌，辛酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"得丙辰。干神制，支神合之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"944","lineNum":894,"lineType":1,"content":"諸印要逢庫墓，若生旺扶助，互換祿馬貴人併相合者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"至貴之命。最忌刑衝破害，三合六合上見鬼。如甲戌日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":896,"lineType":1,"content":"得癸酉時，則減力。水命人得本家印無益，得木印損氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"得土印，支干有交涉者，名官印，無交涉者名鬼印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":898,"lineType":1,"content":"有年時見印，名鳯凰啣印，如虞尚書癸未甲寅戊午丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":899,"lineType":1,"content":"辰是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505908551745546"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":902,"lineType":1,"content":"又有福聚印。如年月日時胎五位俱無氣衰敗，得正印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"偏印，俱在此印上，或庫或旺，雖有煞神，至是受制，此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"之謂福聚印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"954","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"有禍聚印。如癸巳人帶壬辰印，柱多逢水，俱墓於辰，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳受煞，以巳為命，巳火遇多，則本命病，此之謂禍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"聚印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"957","lineNum":908,"lineType":1,"content":"有破福成禍印。如水人得水印，或月日時胎多帶土來，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"本家印見鬼盛，是謂破福成禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505918110449679"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":912,"lineType":1,"content":"有帶煞印。印中見貴煞。如壬子見壬辰、丙辰，子至辰謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"之華蓋，壬人見辰為貴，若印中反尅本命，無福神往","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":914,"lineType":1,"content":"還，名帶煞主，㓙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"963","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"有臨空印，乃印落空亡。支無六合，見官貴至賤而無成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":916,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"965","lineNum":917,"lineType":1,"content":"有自刑印。如庚戌人帶乙丑金人，見金印固好。丑戌相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":918,"lineType":1,"content":"刑，以金刑金，此類不如無，雖有少福，亦終賤。餘准此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505946619068466"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":922,"lineType":1,"content":"凡論印，更得眞五行，與納音同氣，尤妙。但主少安逸，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"利六親，難為子息。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"971","lineNum":924,"lineType":8,"content":"論徳秀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"972","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"夫徳者，本月生旺之徳；秀者，合天地中和之氣，五行變","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":926,"lineType":1,"content":"化而成者也。又曰：徳者，陰陽解㐫之神；秀者，天地清秀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣，四時當旺之神。故寅、午、戌月，丙丁為徳，戊癸為秀；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":928,"lineType":1,"content":"申子、辰月，壬癸戊己為徳，丙辛、甲己為秀。巳、酉、丑月，庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"辛為徳，乙庚為秀。亥、卯、未月，甲乙為徳，丁壬為秀。凡人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505916365701139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":932,"lineType":1,"content":"命中得此徳秀，無破衝尅壓者，賦性聰明，溫厚和氣。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"遇學堂，更帶財官，主貴，衝尅減力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"980","lineNum":934,"lineType":8,"content":"論刼煞亡神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"981","lineNum":935,"lineType":1,"content":"刼者，奪也，自外奪之之謂刼。亡者，失也，自内失之之謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":936,"lineType":1,"content":"亡。刼在五行絶處：亡在五行臨官，俱屬寅申巳亥。水絶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":937,"lineType":1,"content":"在巳、申、子、辰，以巳為刼煞，巳中戊土，刼水也。火絶在亥、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":938,"lineType":1,"content":"寅、午、戌，以亥為刼煞，亥中壬水刼火也。金絶在寅巳酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"丑，以寅為刼煞，寅中丙火刼金也。木絶在申亥卯未，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505926826197007"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":942,"lineType":1,"content":"申為刼煞，申中庚金刼木也。古歌云：刼煞為灾不可當，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"徒然奔走利名塲，須防祖業消亡盡，妻子如何得久長？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":944,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：四位逢生刼又來，當朝振業逞儒魁，若兼官貴在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"時上，鯁直名標御史臺。又云：刼神包裏遇官星，主執兵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":946,"lineType":1,"content":"權助聖明。不怒而威人仰慕，須令華夏悉安榮。又云：刼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"煞原來是煞魁，身宮命主不須來。若為魁局應當死，煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":948,"lineType":1,"content":"曜臨之不必猜。若是無星居此位，更於三合細推排。天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"盤加得㐫星到，命似風燈不久摧。水生木，申子辰，以亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505946619084850"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":952,"lineType":1,"content":"為亡神，亥中甲木，洩水也。火生土，寅午戌，以巳為亡神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":953,"lineType":1,"content":"巳中戊土，洩火也。金生水，巳酉丑，以申為亡神，申中壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":954,"lineType":1,"content":"水，洩金也。木生火，亥卯未，以寅為亡神，寅中丙火，洩木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"也。古歌云：亡神七煞禍非輕，用盡機關一不成，尅子刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":956,"lineType":1,"content":"妻無祖業，仕人猶恐有虛名。又云：命宫若也値亡神，須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"是長生遇貴人，時日更兼天地合，匪躬蹇蹇作王臣。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":958,"lineType":1,"content":"云：皆言七煞是亡神，莫道亡神禍患輕，身命若還居此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"地，貧窮蹇滯過平生。㓙星惡曜如臨到，大限渾如履薄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505918110498831"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":962,"lineType":1,"content":"冰，三合更須明審察，煞來夾拱必難行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":963,"lineType":9,"content":"刼煞一十六般","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":963,"lineType":2,"content":"一名大煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":964,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，則聰慧敏給，才智過人，事不留行，胸羅萬象，高明爽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"迅，武徳横財，即生旺與貴煞建禄併也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":966,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫則昏濁邪侈，毒害性重，宿疾刑徒，兵刀折傷，執抝内","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"狠，貪奪無情，即死絶與惡煞併也。若元辰空亡，為盜金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":968,"lineType":1,"content":"神，庚辛併，好刓刻雕鏃，空亡金火併，為打鐵屠儈捕獵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":969,"lineType":1,"content":"籠養之人。若刼煞尅身，更帶金神，羊刃同尅，主車馬顚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505926826213391"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":972,"lineType":1,"content":"覆之灾，生時得之，子孫愚薄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞聚寶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":973,"lineType":2,"content":"我尅他也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"一名瓊珠刼煞。歲尅刼有力與日主和","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":974,"lineType":1,"content":"諧者，主富裕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞宜權，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":975,"lineType":2,"content":"臨官空亡，空亡准十日夜推，臨官准十日辰折。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"一名冠裳刼煞，為人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":976,"lineType":1,"content":"衣冠齊楚，光顯貴人，况生旺日辰乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞嘉謨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":977,"lineType":2,"content":"身不尅於煞，煞却不得其位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"一名紀綱刼煞。主强煞弱日，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":978,"lineType":1,"content":"有他位之貴者，動容不妄，中禮安常，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞奏號。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":979,"lineType":2,"content":"貴人同到。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"一名旌旗刼煞。刼坐貴人貢，助日主者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505935646720038"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":982,"lineType":1,"content":"凡事變難成易，人自欽仰，福氣異常，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞呈瑞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":983,"lineType":2,"content":"眞長生位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"一名冕旒刼煞。刼煞在長生位，有日主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":984,"lineType":1,"content":"之財官等祿主貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞為霖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":985,"lineType":2,"content":"羅文貴人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"一名鹽梅刼煞。時帶此刼煞，與歲君干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":986,"lineType":1,"content":"支互換見貴，更日辰有情，名利顯赫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞生上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":987,"lineType":2,"content":"下生其上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"一名庫堂刼煞。時帶此煞，自家生旺助","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":988,"lineType":1,"content":"年者，一重最吉，仍喜兩頭衝破，年時干合，支下帶煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":989,"lineType":1,"content":"主破家蕩業，更與日家不情宜然，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505958711164939"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":992,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞類爭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":992,"lineType":2,"content":"火人火類煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":992,"lineType":1,"content":"一名鬭爭刼煞。無制無馭則為屠沽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":993,"lineType":1,"content":"巫醫，有制有馭則為福壽貴格。又看日辰吉㓙何如，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":994,"lineType":1,"content":"増減斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞造意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":995,"lineType":2,"content":"我去生他。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"一名提孩刼煞。歲去生煞，猶母生子，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":996,"lineType":1,"content":"孤刑來併，主喪家尅子，或被兒女耗財，兼尅竊日主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"無疑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":998,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞非良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":998,"lineType":2,"content":"煞來尅我。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":998,"lineType":1,"content":"一名貪玩刼煞。主非義取財，因財害己，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"或貪悋遭禍等事。為日辰㐫煞者必然，為貴氣者庶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505918110547983"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":1002,"lineType":1,"content":"幾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞毁焚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":1003,"lineType":2,"content":"破宅煞尅歲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"一名醫桑刼煞。此兼領破宅之神來","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":1004,"lineType":1,"content":"尅歲，不獨無屋可居，貧當甑釜生塵，更兼亡神尅竊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"者無救。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":1006,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞酣慾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":1006,"lineType":2,"content":"合起，我弱他强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":1006,"lineType":1,"content":"一名風流刼煞。日時犯有合，單合、雙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":1007,"lineType":1,"content":"合，不降不尅日辰，竟無好意思相援者，主酒色破家，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":1008,"lineType":1,"content":"不知廉耻，生平酣飲嗜音。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞輕盈，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":1009,"lineType":2,"content":"煞逢死絶，我去生他，又合起。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"一名管絃刼煞。主嬌態美姿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505918110531599"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":1012,"lineType":1,"content":"春風花柳，日為活計，以日辰不絶，福神無援故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞黨衆，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":1013,"lineType":2,"content":"煞雙來尅歲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"一名天牢刼煞。縱貴亦夭，或軍旅亡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":1014,"lineType":1,"content":"於他鄉，否則為盜干音。或又尅竊日辰，更入空絶者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"無疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":1016,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞暴厲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":1016,"lineType":2,"content":"亡刼雙全，又尅羊刃，重重來合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":1016,"lineType":1,"content":"一名刀鎗刼煞。主㓙暴惡死，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"干音。尅竊日主決難免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":1018,"lineType":1,"content":"刼煞空閒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":1018,"lineType":2,"content":"孤寡同到。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":1018,"lineType":1,"content":"一名烟霞刼煞。此煞與孤寡、刑隔四位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"内犯二者兼死絶之氣，尅竊日主，非僧則道。以水火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505916365717523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":1022,"lineType":1,"content":"象分之，水多為道，火多為僧。若是俗人，孤寒之甚，貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":1023,"lineType":1,"content":"氣交加者庶幾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":1024,"lineType":9,"content":"亡神十六般","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":1024,"lineType":2,"content":"一名官符，一名七煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":1025,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，則峻厲有威，謀畧算計，見事如神，事不露機，兵行詭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":1026,"lineType":1,"content":"計，始終爭勝，言事析辯，壯年進用，即生旺與貴煞併也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"㓙則褊躁性窄，顚詐狂妄，浮蕩是非，酒色風流，官府獄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":1028,"lineType":1,"content":"訟疽㾿氣，血氣不謙下，失勢失下，兵刑責難，即死絶與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":1029,"lineType":1,"content":"惡煞併也。若貴人建祿併專弄筆硯，撰飾文詞，因公起","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505913584910371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":1032,"lineType":1,"content":"家，干渉官利，或為胥徒併。火尅身，則語吃無氣，多腰足","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":1033,"lineType":1,"content":"疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":1034,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神富藏，一名亡神貴驛。此乃歲去尅煞，亡神受歲之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":1035,"lineType":1,"content":"尅，我勝於彼，方是受降。或為日主財官貴氣，或來生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":1036,"lineType":1,"content":"助日主，主大富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神長生，一名珪玉，亡神。亡神在長生位，兼帶日辰别","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":1038,"lineType":1,"content":"位，貴祿飛騰早發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":1039,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神臨官，一名軒冕，亡神。亡神入臨官位，却落空亡反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505946619150386"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":1042,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。干音又能生日，雖主乘軒戴冕之貴，亦有二三分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":1043,"lineType":1,"content":"酒色。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":1044,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神鑾輿，一名鼎鼐。亡神臨時座，却見年時互換，貴人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":1045,"lineType":1,"content":"來往，干神助日主者貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":1046,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神自如，一名規矩亡神。煞居弱地，歲入強宫，雖不尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":1047,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，煞却不得其位，其煞來降。另有日辰貴氣者，主賢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":1048,"lineType":1,"content":"能謙謹，中正公勤，食祿之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":1049,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神生本，一名父母亡神。亡神生歲兼生旺，只宜一重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505935646736422"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":1052,"lineType":1,"content":"若有財官等貴，係屬日辰者，主精神富聚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":1053,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神義門，一名羅綺亡神。貴人同到日時，見此煞干支","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":1054,"lineType":1,"content":"不壞，日者有福榮華。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神錦里，一名兒女亡神。歲去生他，遇孤隔刼煞則㓙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":1056,"lineType":1,"content":"帶祿，貴則吉，一重為妙。又與日辰相統，兼推吉㓙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":1057,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神未降，一名停力亡神。此乃歲與煞同氣，如木人見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":1058,"lineType":1,"content":"木煞，竟無相尅相降，日無統攝，若欠貴氣，只是屠行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":1059,"lineType":1,"content":"牙儈巫醫丹青之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505916365733907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":1062,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神妄作，一名擄掠亡神。此煞下反尅歲，竊日之氣，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":1063,"lineType":1,"content":"非理取財，語言狂妄，乃巫醫藝術，談天說地之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":1064,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神嘯宅，一名溝壑亡神。亡神若為破宅，煞兼尅竊歲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":1065,"lineType":1,"content":"與日無情，主謀拙計窮，生為乞丐，死無棺槨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":1066,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神舞羣。一名鼓樂亡神。其煞不降不尅，却有合起之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":1067,"lineType":1,"content":"神，主閙羣叢裏，花酒立身。若無日家貴氣，准上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":1068,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神薄惡，一名噴血亡神。亡刼俱全，年時干合，音尅其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":1069,"lineType":1,"content":"歲，必主遭刑，不然惡病。尅竊日辰無貴氣者，定驗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505911848517673"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":1072,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神迷溺。一名花柳亡神。此神單來，合煞之氣剛，我身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":1073,"lineType":1,"content":"柔弱，定主歌謳，花酒度日。更引日家㓙煞，衣食艱難，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":1074,"lineType":1,"content":"亡於癆夭，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神乖張。一名枷鎻亡神。亡神日時有兩重，又帶合，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":1076,"lineType":1,"content":"是刺面彫青，徒配胥吏，尅竊日主者愈重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":1077,"lineType":1,"content":"有眞亡刼，寅午戌人見癸巳癸亥；己酉丑人見丙申丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":1078,"lineType":1,"content":"寅；申子辰人見丁亥丁巳；亥卯未人見壬寅壬申。獨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":1079,"lineType":1,"content":"者主㓙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505946619166770"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":1082,"lineType":1,"content":"有刼頭見財，如寅午戌人，甲干己亥之例；己酉丑人，乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"干戊寅之例，是刼煞上見干財，主蓄積大富，吞併不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":1084,"lineType":1,"content":"顧，慘毒害物。遇兩重者，反主貧寒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"有刼頭見鬼，如申子辰人，甲干辛巳之例；亥卯未人，乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":1086,"lineType":1,"content":"干庚申之例是。刼煞見官鬼，主無官，縱有，須因事罷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":1087,"lineType":1,"content":"難得入侍從，庶人多被刼。平生聚散。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":1088,"lineType":1,"content":"有刼煞相合，如甲寅値己亥，丙寅値辛亥，戊寅値癸亥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅値乙亥，壬寅値丁亥，甲申値己巳，丙申値辛巳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505918110564367"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":1092,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申値癸巳，庚申値乙巳，壬申値丁巳。十位在日上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之旌旗煞，在時上謂之英雄煞，主武。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":1094,"lineType":1,"content":"有分刼、聚刼。分刼如甲子人得己巳月己巳時，是子，一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"刼寄於兩巳，而兩己分受，為灾，反輕。聚刼如甲子人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":1096,"lineType":1,"content":"得丙子月己巳時，是子，兩重會刼一巳，而一己獨受","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":1097,"lineType":1,"content":"致害，反重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":1098,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰，刼煞主煞，生氣主生，若有生氣兩重而刼煞一重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":1099,"lineType":1,"content":"則是生氣強於刼，刼煞兩重而生氣一重，則是刼強於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505946619215922"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":1102,"lineType":1,"content":"生。生氣多者從生氣言，刼煞多者從刼煞言，不可槩論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱逢生，交互見之，主作臺諫將帥之職，亡神准推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":1104,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵二煞全要以身尅煞，不要以煞尅身。日煞尅妻，婦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"尅夫時煞尅子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":1106,"lineType":1,"content":"此外有天煞、地煞、歲煞、刑煞。天煞在刼煞前二辰，地煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":1107,"lineType":1,"content":"在刼煞前五辰，是辰戌丑未也。歲煞在刼煞前三辰，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":1108,"lineType":1,"content":"是寅申巳亥也。刑煞在刼煞前七辰，與將星同位，是子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"午卯酉也。以上四煞，俱主有權。不尅身，不為灾。尅身則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505920505364491"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":1112,"lineType":1,"content":"為灾重，與亡刼同。帶金土為武臣，水木為文臣。文臣帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":1113,"lineType":1,"content":"土金為煞者，亦主兵權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":1114,"lineType":9,"content":"論羊刃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":1114,"lineType":2,"content":"對宫曰飛刃，又曰唐符。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":1115,"lineType":1,"content":"三車","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_64","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":1115,"lineType":1,"content":"云：羊，言剛也。刃者，取宰割之義。祿過則刃生，功成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":1116,"lineType":1,"content":"當退。不退則過越其分，如羊之在刃，言有傷也。故羊刃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":1117,"lineType":1,"content":"常居祿前一辰。希尹曰：陰陽萬物之理，皆惡極盛。當其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":1118,"lineType":1,"content":"極處，火則焦滅，水則湧竭，金則折缺，土則崩裂，木則摧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"折。故既成而未極，則為福；已極則將反而為㓙。極盛之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505958711214091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":1122,"lineType":1,"content":"地，十干中正處是也。卯者，甲之正位，為陽木之極辰者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"乙之正位，為陰木之極；午者，丙之正位，為陽火之極未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":1124,"lineType":1,"content":"者，丁之正位，為陰火之極；酉者，庚之正位，為陽金之極；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"戌者，辛之正位，為陰金之極；子者，壬之正位，為陽水之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":1126,"lineType":1,"content":"極；丑者，癸之正位，為陰水之極。當其極處，其氣剛烈，暴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"戾不和，所以祿前一辰為羊刃，對衝為飛刃，既盛而未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":1128,"lineType":1,"content":"極，則溫柔和暢，故刃後一辰為祿也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":1128,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_65","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":1128,"lineType":1,"content":"云：凡人有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"祿，必賜刃以衛之。此其義也。一行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"命書","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_66","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"云：羊刃重重又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505908551778314"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":1132,"lineType":1,"content":"見祿，富貴饒金玉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":1132,"lineType":1,"content":"洞玄經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_67","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":1132,"lineType":1,"content":"云：官印相助福相資。是羊刃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":1133,"lineType":1,"content":"帶祿。更有官印相資，尤作吉論。如專羊刃，主眼露性急，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":1134,"lineType":1,"content":"㓙暴害物，親近惡黨，生旺稍可，死絶尤甚。在五行敗者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"逢之多患瘰癧，或瘴癘、金刃之災，不論貴賤，多冗雜勞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":1136,"lineType":1,"content":"廹，少得安逸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":1136,"lineType":1,"content":"太乙經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_68","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":1136,"lineType":1,"content":"云：六甲生人，逢乙卯、丁卯為眞羊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":1137,"lineType":1,"content":"刃。若重犯，主殘疾，官祿失退，敗散在晚年。餘卯為偏刃，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":1138,"lineType":1,"content":"則輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":1139,"lineType":1,"content":"有刃頭財。如甲人見己卯之類，謂之銷鎔煞主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505958711230475"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":1142,"lineType":1,"content":"財帛歇滅。常人以屠沽、刀鋸等事為業，或因被盜而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":1143,"lineType":1,"content":"致命者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":1144,"lineType":1,"content":"有刃頭鬼。如甲人見辛卯之類，謂之持刃煞，主人不令","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"終，雖入貴格，亦不可測。甲乙人見之尤𦂳，多腦疽發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":1146,"lineType":1,"content":"背而終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"金書命訣","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_70","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"有羊刃相蝕，如甲寅虎兔，甲戌狗兔之類。見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":1148,"lineType":1,"content":"所蝕年月稍可，日時至危。若見兩重，更値空亡，設非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":1149,"lineType":1,"content":"相蝕，亦犯流配，至老主不善終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505959424213055"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":1152,"lineType":1,"content":"沈芝源髓有朝元羊刃。如卯年日時有甲字之類，主㓙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":1153,"lineType":1,"content":"若日干在時上作刃，主痕疾。不然，即子息帶，亦主子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":1154,"lineType":1,"content":"少。時干就日支作刃，主妻惡死，禀性不良。不然是軍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":1155,"lineType":1,"content":"人，或帶痕疾。年干臨時支作刃，多主父母惡死。更天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":1156,"lineType":1,"content":"煞在上，決定無疑。若胎中羊刃，更帶刑年，主出不善，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":1157,"lineType":1,"content":"或父母惡死，及賊陰人。年干就日支作刃，主父母惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":1158,"lineType":1,"content":"死。餘照年月日時分位推之。古詩云：或時藏刃入於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":1159,"lineType":1,"content":"胎，日刃或朝時上來。更若支干相刑尅，妻身姙產定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505946619232306"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":1162,"lineType":1,"content":"應災。婦人之命若如此敢斷，須憂生産厄。是相刑羊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":1163,"lineType":1,"content":"刃，為禍最重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":1164,"lineType":1,"content":"又連珠刃，如庚戌、辛酉、戊午、己未、丙午、丁未、甲辰、乙卯、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":1165,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子、癸丑，皆㓙象也。金𦂳木慢，女命犯之，定尅夫害","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":1166,"lineType":1,"content":"子，不貞潔理。愚歌云：倒懸羊刃又同行，形骸不免塡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":1167,"lineType":1,"content":"溝壑。又云：飛刃倒戈終見乖，小人得此便為災。空亡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":1168,"lineType":1,"content":"截路同相見，此身安得出塵埃。又云：羊刃更兼倒戈，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":1169,"lineType":1,"content":"必作無頭之鬼。是羊刃帶諸惡煞尤㓙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505959424245823"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":1172,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人行運，最怕羊刃，主作事稽遲，無士農工商皆厭之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":1173,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_71","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":1173,"lineType":1,"content":"云：運行羊刃，財物耗散。此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":1174,"lineType":1,"content":"玉霄寶鑑","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_72","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":1174,"lineType":1,"content":"有攬轡澄清格，謂貴人乘馬而前視羊刃，猶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":1175,"lineType":1,"content":"馬頭帶劒之義。假令庚午人得乙酉或己酉日，時帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":1176,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申為入格，午馬在申，庚祿在申，乙巳貴在申，庚羊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":1177,"lineType":1,"content":"刃在酉，却乙巳貴人乘甲申為驛馬，而前視羊刃，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":1178,"lineType":1,"content":"曰攬轡澄清。此格多為清嚴之官，若更有吉類，多為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":1179,"lineType":1,"content":"酷吏，能制奸宄。子平以甲、丙、戊、庚、壬五陽干有刃，乙、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505926826278927"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":1182,"lineType":1,"content":"丁、己、辛、癸五陰干無刃，惟見傷官，與羊刃同禍。是指","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":1183,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽之陽，非牛羊之羊，其義見後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":1183,"lineType":1,"content":"論陽刃格","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_73","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":1183,"lineType":1,"content":"中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
