{"lines":[{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":1185,"lineType":1,"content":"空對實，亡對有言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":1185,"lineType":1,"content":"神白經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_74","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":1185,"lineType":1,"content":"云：空亡空亡幾多般，十干不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":1186,"lineType":1,"content":"到作空看。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":1186,"lineType":1,"content":"洞玄經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_75","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":1186,"lineType":1,"content":"云：遁窮而亡生，故以甲旬盡處曰空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":1187,"lineType":1,"content":"亡。蓋有是位而無祿曰空，有支而無干曰亡。如甲子旬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":1188,"lineType":1,"content":"遁至酉而十干足，所以無戌亥。餘五干例見，是為空亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":1189,"lineType":1,"content":"然空而有實，亡而有存，所以未可便為脉論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":1189,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_76","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":1189,"lineType":1,"content":"論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505946619248690"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":1192,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡云：五陽令用一陽，五陰令用一陰。假如甲子、丙寅、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":1193,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰、庚午、壬申，則用戌不用亥；乙丑、丁卯、己巳、辛未、癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":1194,"lineType":1,"content":"酉，則用亥不用戌。陽分陽年，陰分陰年。又說：甲子至戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":1195,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，以戌為空亡；己巳至癸酉，以亥為空亡。分上下五年，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":1196,"lineType":1,"content":"中間又分甲子至戊辰，見壬戌為重，見戊戌之類為輕；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":1197,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳至癸酉，見癸亥為重，見乙亥之類為輕。如甲子生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":1198,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌時，此時上正見差輕。如己巳生癸亥時，亦時上内","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":1199,"lineType":1,"content":"犯最重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":1199,"lineType":1,"content":"指迷賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_77","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":1199,"lineType":1,"content":"云：祿入空亡，必分前後之辰，所以表陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505926826328079"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":1202,"lineType":1,"content":"陽之分，明輕重之等也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":1202,"lineType":1,"content":"八字金書","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_78","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":1202,"lineType":1,"content":"云：甲寅旬壬癸落空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":1203,"lineType":1,"content":"亡，甲辰旬甲乙，甲申旬丙丁，甲戌旬庚辛。以地支二位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":1204,"lineType":1,"content":"而論天干，或謂十惡大敗，犯此日生者，主貧賤。然人命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":1205,"lineType":1,"content":"見空亡而合格者多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1286","lineNum":1205,"lineType":1,"content":"洞玄經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_79","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":1205,"lineType":1,"content":"云：淵淨而倥侗無氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":1205,"lineType":2,"content":"空亡多謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":1206,"lineType":2,"content":"淵淨。格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":1206,"lineType":1,"content":"圓機而自立一家，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":1206,"lineType":2,"content":"祿馬貴官上見空亡，為九流格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":1206,"lineType":1,"content":"辭有章而賁名，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":1207,"lineType":2,"content":"學堂見空亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":1207,"lineType":1,"content":"性無為而湛如，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":1207,"lineType":2,"content":"自死自絶見空亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":1207,"lineType":1,"content":"美質可愛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":1207,"lineType":2,"content":"貴人多，見空亡則可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":1208,"lineType":2,"content":"愛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":1208,"lineType":1,"content":"功名可珍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":1208,"lineType":2,"content":"華蓋多，見空亡則可珍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":1208,"lineType":1,"content":"優游恬淡無累，雕鏤華藻有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":1209,"lineType":1,"content":"功，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":1209,"lineType":2,"content":"休囚旺相有吉神而見空亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":1209,"lineType":1,"content":"抱越人之才，挾敢斷之果。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":1209,"lineType":2,"content":"神煞暗指空亡，雖超","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505959424229439"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":1212,"lineType":2,"content":"人無福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":1212,"lineType":1,"content":"詳此亦有吉處。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":1213,"lineType":1,"content":"凡帶此煞，生旺則氣度寛大，動招虛名，長大肥滿，多意","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":1214,"lineType":1,"content":"外無心之福；死絶則一生成敗飄泊，但在我有氣之地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":1215,"lineType":1,"content":"則不能為禍。大忌支干與天中相合，是謂小人得位，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":1216,"lineType":1,"content":"奸詐譎詭，靡所不為。若為我所尅，是謂天中受殃，反為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":1217,"lineType":1,"content":"特達之福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":1217,"lineType":2,"content":"如戊午火人見甲子金之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":1217,"lineType":1,"content":"其神性無常，與官符併，則佞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":1218,"lineType":1,"content":"媚多文；與刼煞併，則狡勇；與亡神併，則飄蓬；與大耗併，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":1219,"lineType":1,"content":"顚倒鶻突；與建祿併，一生破散；與咸池六害併，多㐫暴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505926826311695"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":1222,"lineType":1,"content":"卒。惟夾貴華蓋、三竒學堂併者，大聰明脫俗之士。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":1223,"lineType":1,"content":"夫空亡不言太歲，見生日旬中空亡極𦂳。若太歲與日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":1224,"lineType":1,"content":"互換空亡，更不佳。以實為空，則實可映空；以空為空，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":1225,"lineType":1,"content":"所映實。故帶互換空亡者災深。假令甲子年壬戌日，甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":1226,"lineType":1,"content":"子之正空亡在壬戌，其壬戌乃甲寅旬，甲寅旬中空復","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":1227,"lineType":1,"content":"在子，主一生財物耗散，大破家宅。餘倣此。若日時互換，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":1228,"lineType":1,"content":"時𦂳日慢。若日犯而時却刑害衝破，時犯而日却刑害","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":1229,"lineType":1,"content":"衝破，亦主有福，未免坎坷。又云：天中一煞，不可全以㓙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505958711246859"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":1232,"lineType":1,"content":"言。如柱有惡神惡煞，禍聚之地，全要空亡解之。有空亡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":1233,"lineType":1,"content":"不宜見合，合則不能空矣。若祿馬財官福聚之氣，全怕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":1234,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡散之。有空亡却喜見合，合則不能空矣。若無衝無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":1235,"lineType":1,"content":"合無刑，謂眞空亡。四孟太毒，只作小伎巧術人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":1236,"lineType":1,"content":"又甲子旬水土，甲戌旬金，甲申旬火土，甲午旬火土，甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":1237,"lineType":1,"content":"辰旬木，甲寅旬水土，為眞空亡。乂云：響之有聲，莫非虛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":1238,"lineType":1,"content":"中也。是以大人之命，要有虛中之徳。空亡自旺有用，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":1239,"lineType":1,"content":"大聲大應之器。月日時三位俱空亡者，不害為大貴人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505959424262207"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":1242,"lineType":1,"content":"若値兩位，雖有官不大。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":1243,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：凡命値空亡，時上見，多拗性，為事高而虛。更遇華","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":1244,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋決，主少子。日上見，多庶出，或妻妾間離。遇偶合則多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":1245,"lineType":1,"content":"淫蕩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":1246,"lineType":1,"content":"古歌云：胎裏生逢怕遇空，遇空時節自昏蒙。饒君十步","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":1247,"lineType":1,"content":"有九計，不免飄飄西復東。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":1247,"lineType":2,"content":"是胎中忌見空也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":1248,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：建祿臨空虛有名，平生向學老無成。若逢馬貴來","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":1249,"lineType":1,"content":"相救，縱得官時又復停。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":1249,"lineType":2,"content":"是建祿忌見空也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505926826360847"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":1252,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：甲寅戊午及庚申，丑上天中最不仁。本分生來當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":1253,"lineType":1,"content":"受祿，因逢五鬼遂衰貧。以甲寅水見辛丑土，為鬼來尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":1254,"lineType":1,"content":"命。戊午見丁丑，庚申見乙丑，同是空亡，忌尅命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":1255,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：六旬後兩號天中見合長生旺不㓙，加臨衝尅兼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":1256,"lineType":1,"content":"刑祿，官職陞騰位更隆。如己酉丑人，丁丑月，癸未日，戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":1257,"lineType":1,"content":"午時，午未空亡，而戊癸之火旺在午，反為貴格，是火虛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":1258,"lineType":1,"content":"有焰也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":1259,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：印綬之星中見空，順臨墓庫福重重，若還夾貴歸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505920505397259"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":1262,"lineType":1,"content":"元位，帶煞須為給事中。如甲午、癸酉、丙子、壬辰，時雖空，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":1263,"lineType":1,"content":"却與癸酉作六合，又庫墓夾貴，所以入格，是水空則流","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":1264,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":1265,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_80","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":1265,"lineType":1,"content":"云：金空則響，火空則明，水空則清，木空則折，土空則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1362","lineNum":1266,"lineType":1,"content":"崩。此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1363","lineNum":1267,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：人命空亡本不好，若運衝刑，反為虛煞，士人遇之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1364","lineNum":1268,"lineType":1,"content":"飛聲走譽。如甲申、丁丑、乙亥、甲申，行壬午運，作當路。乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1365","lineNum":1269,"lineType":1,"content":"未、乙酉、乙丑、丁亥，行辛巳運，作監司，大振聲望。若壬寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1366","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505971377963042"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1367","lineNum":1272,"lineType":1,"content":"為空亡，壬申同類衝之，則不動，此為最毒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1368","lineNum":1273,"lineType":1,"content":"有截路空亡，正如人在途遇水，不能前進，不可以濟，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1369","lineNum":1274,"lineType":1,"content":"曰截路。只以日取時見之，如甲己日遁十二時中，申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1370","lineNum":1275,"lineType":1,"content":"酉上見壬癸，故甲己見申酉，乙庚見午未，丙辛見辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1371","lineNum":1276,"lineType":1,"content":"巳，丁壬見寅卯，戊癸見戌亥。此二時上俱遇壬癸，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1372","lineNum":1277,"lineType":1,"content":"水故也。此空亡非但命見不吉，凡出入求財、交易、上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1373","lineNum":1278,"lineType":1,"content":"官嫁娶，百事皆忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1374","lineNum":1279,"lineType":1,"content":"有四大空亡：六甲中，甲辰、甲戌二旬，金木水火土全，内","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1375","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505946619297842"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1376","lineNum":1282,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子、甲午旬獨無水，甲寅、甲申旬獨無金。此四旬者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1377","lineNum":1283,"lineType":1,"content":"五行不全。如甲子、甲午旬生人見水，甲寅、甲申旬生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1378","lineNum":1284,"lineType":1,"content":"人見金，謂之正犯。如當生年中不犯，行運至水金處，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1379","lineNum":1285,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之犯。若帶得，主一生蹇滯，不問貧賤富貴，皆夭折。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1380","lineNum":1286,"lineType":1,"content":"三處重遇，瞬息為期。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1381","lineNum":1286,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_81","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1382","lineNum":1286,"lineType":1,"content":"云：顏回夭折，只因四大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1383","lineNum":1287,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡。正謂此也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1384","lineNum":1288,"lineType":1,"content":"洞微經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_82","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1385","lineNum":1288,"lineType":1,"content":"有五鬼空亡。甲己人見巳午，乙庚寅卯，丙辛子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":1289,"lineType":1,"content":"丑，丁壬戌亥，戊癸申酉，限至斯鄉，主貧，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505935646785574"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":1292,"lineType":1,"content":"有尅害。空亡。甲乙人見午，丙丁申。戊己巳、庚辛寅、壬癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":1293,"lineType":1,"content":"酉丑，主尅害妻子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":1294,"lineType":1,"content":"有破祖。空亡。甲乙丙丁同上。戊己人見戌，庚辛子、壬癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1391","lineNum":1295,"lineType":1,"content":"寅遇者，主破祖業。須併論之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1392","lineNum":1296,"lineType":9,"content":"論元辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1393","lineNum":1296,"lineType":2,"content":"屬毛頭星，一名大耗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1394","lineNum":1297,"lineType":1,"content":"元辰者，别而不合之名。陽前陰後，則有所屈，屈則於事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1395","lineNum":1298,"lineType":1,"content":"無所伸；陰前陽後，則直而不遂，於事暴而不治，難與同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1396","lineNum":1299,"lineType":1,"content":"事，故謂之元辰。是以陽男陰女，在衝前一位支辰，陰男","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1397","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505918110613519"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1398","lineNum":1302,"lineType":1,"content":"陽女在衝後一位支辰。假如甲子生男，與甲午對衝，即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1399","lineNum":1303,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未為正；乙丑生男，與乙未對衝，即甲午為正。餘干午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1400","lineNum":1304,"lineType":1,"content":"未半之。所以為㐫者，當氣衝之地，左鼓則風煞在右，右","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1401","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"鼓則風煞在左，故陰陽男女，取衝前衝後不同。若歲運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1402","lineNum":1306,"lineType":1,"content":"臨之，如物當風，動摇顚倒，不得寧息，不有内疾，必有外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1403","lineNum":1307,"lineType":1,"content":"難。雖富貴崇高，勢位炎盛，大運逢之，十年可畏，立朝定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1404","lineNum":1308,"lineType":1,"content":"當竄逐，居家必罹㓙咎。縱有吉神扶持，不免禍福倚伏，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1405","lineNum":1309,"lineType":1,"content":"尤忌先吉後㓙。臨旺之後，欲出未出之際，㓙禍尤的，生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1406","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505947281719336"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1407","lineNum":1312,"lineType":1,"content":"命逢之。主形骸陋朴，面有顴骨，鼻低口大，眼生威角，腦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1408","lineNum":1313,"lineType":1,"content":"凸臋高，手脚強硬，聲音沉濁。生旺則落魄大度，不别是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1409","lineNum":1314,"lineType":1,"content":"非，不分良善，顚倒鶻突。死絶則寒酸薄劣，形貌猥下，語","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1410","lineNum":1315,"lineType":1,"content":"言渾濁，不識羞辱，破敗坎坷，貪飲好情，甘習下流，與官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":1316,"lineType":1,"content":"符併，多招無辜之撓。帶刼煞則不循細行，動招危辱，窮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":1317,"lineType":1,"content":"賤無耻，婦人得之，聲雄性濁，奸滛私通奴賤，鬼魅為憑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1413","lineNum":1318,"lineType":1,"content":"不遵禮法，一生多災，雖生子，抝而不孝。常術鼠忌羊頭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1414","lineNum":1319,"lineType":1,"content":"歌，未分男女，不足憑也。珞琭子以宣父畏其元辰，林開","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1415","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505920505430027"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1416","lineNum":1322,"lineType":1,"content":"以元辰惡煞為災甚重，有互換遇者，尤為不吉。忽然遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1417","lineNum":1323,"lineType":1,"content":"合，又以吉論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1418","lineNum":1323,"lineType":1,"content":"洞玄經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_83","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1419","lineNum":1323,"lineType":1,"content":"云元辰遇合而大亨是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":1323,"lineType":1,"content":"廣信集","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_84","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":1324,"lineType":1,"content":"取巫伋參政己卯甲申己巳甲戌，滕康樞密乙丑壬午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":1325,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑壬午二命，豈不犯元辰？李吉甫曰：大凡貴命，須逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1423","lineNum":1326,"lineType":1,"content":"煞即得君王横升拔林開一偏之見也。徐子平云：元辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1424","lineNum":1327,"lineType":1,"content":"者，命中元有所害之辰，如甲見申庚，乙見酉辛之類。人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1425","lineNum":1328,"lineType":1,"content":"生歲月日時，原有七煞，巳為所害之辰，歲運復遇，謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1426","lineNum":1329,"lineType":1,"content":"犯元辰，為害尤重，元無則輕。然元辰一煞，與亡刼、羊刃、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1427","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505947281686568"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1428","lineNum":1332,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡同類，觀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1429","lineNum":1332,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭子消息賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_85","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1430","lineNum":1332,"lineType":1,"content":"自見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1431","lineNum":1332,"lineType":1,"content":"雪心賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_86","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1432","lineNum":1332,"lineType":1,"content":"云：元辰水去，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1433","lineNum":1333,"lineType":1,"content":"亦指神煞之名，是古人之說是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1434","lineNum":1334,"lineType":9,"content":"論暗金的煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1435","lineNum":1334,"lineType":2,"content":"今選擇家以月取，謂之紅煞日。凡百皆㐫，出行尤忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1436","lineNum":1335,"lineType":1,"content":"此三煞乃先天數之四衝也。夫子午之數各九，卯酉各","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1437","lineNum":1336,"lineType":1,"content":"六，總為三十。自子順行，極三十而見巳，是為四仲之正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1438","lineNum":1337,"lineType":1,"content":"煞。寅申各七，巳亥各四，總二十有二。自子順行，極二十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1439","lineNum":1338,"lineType":1,"content":"二而見酉，是為四孟之正煞。辰戌各五，丑未各八，總二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1440","lineNum":1339,"lineType":1,"content":"十有六。自子順行，極二十六數而見丑，是為四季之正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1441","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505966319632424"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1442","lineNum":1342,"lineType":1,"content":"煞。是起於數者然也。凡神煞皆起於數，與祿馬同類。此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1443","lineNum":1343,"lineType":1,"content":"一煞而有三名：一曰吟呻，二曰破碎，三曰白衣。子午卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1444","lineNum":1344,"lineType":1,"content":"酉在巳，寅申巳亥在酉，辰戌丑未在丑。巳者，金生之地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1445","lineNum":1345,"lineType":1,"content":"巳中臨官之火，金氣臨尅，主杖楚刑獄呻吟之災，故曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1446","lineNum":1346,"lineType":1,"content":"吟呻。酉者，金旺之地，煞物當時，又有辛金相助，萬物當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1447","lineNum":1347,"lineType":1,"content":"之，無不破碎，主支離流血之災，故曰破碎。丑乃金之庫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1448","lineNum":1348,"lineType":1,"content":"墓，居四季而臨鬼門，主妨害喪服哭泣之事，故曰白衣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1449","lineNum":1349,"lineType":1,"content":"五行中惟金能煞物，故總名曰暗金的煞也。其神生旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1450","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505947281735720"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1451","lineNum":1352,"lineType":1,"content":"主人寛量大器，決斷有為，形容清峻。若不夭喪刑傷，須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1452","lineNum":1353,"lineType":1,"content":"有癩病、癱瘓死絶，則慘害尅毒，形容紅白，巧言令色，笑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1453","lineNum":1354,"lineType":1,"content":"裏藏刀。與官符併則横來官災；與刼煞併則横來死喪；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1454","lineNum":1355,"lineType":1,"content":"與白虎羊刃併則流血傷殘；與貴人建祿併則稍慢。五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1455","lineNum":1356,"lineType":1,"content":"行旺相，吉神相救，入貴格則無害，入賤格再値一切㓙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1456","lineNum":1357,"lineType":1,"content":"神則愈㓙。又曰：金生處，主大風癱瘓之疾；金旺處，主水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1457","lineNum":1358,"lineType":1,"content":"蠱毒藥之病；金墓處，主尅子惡死之憂。若帶三刑徳貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1458","lineNum":1359,"lineType":1,"content":"主有高官，持兵權。大抵此煞不吉，人命逢之，固所不宜；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1459","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505975836524582"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1460","lineNum":1362,"lineType":1,"content":"歲逢之，亦主孝服哭聲、盜賊侵擾、口舌破耗。小兒犯此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1461","lineNum":1363,"lineType":1,"content":"湯火之厄，不然，身有痕疤破綻之象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1462","lineNum":1363,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_87","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1463","lineNum":1363,"lineType":1,"content":"云：謬戾無過於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1464","lineNum":1364,"lineType":1,"content":"刑害，有時而吉；乖違莫甚於衝破。未必皆㓙，此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1465","lineNum":1365,"lineType":9,"content":"論災煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1466","lineNum":1365,"lineType":2,"content":"一名白虎煞。余見申子辰全遇午，方是白虎，與災煞微不同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1467","lineNum":1366,"lineType":1,"content":"災煞者，其性勇猛，常居刼煞之前，衝破將星，謂之災煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1468","lineNum":1367,"lineType":1,"content":"如申子辰，將星在子，午却去衝子；寅午戌在午，子却去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1469","lineNum":1368,"lineType":1,"content":"衝；巳酉丑在酉，卯却去衝；亥卯未在卯，酉却去衝。是災","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1470","lineNum":1369,"lineType":1,"content":"煞也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1471","lineNum":1369,"lineType":1,"content":"神白經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_88","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1472","lineNum":1369,"lineType":1,"content":"云：類水逢星照，虛空怕日煙。庚辛夏蠋戰，木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1473","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505920505462795"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":1372,"lineType":1,"content":"不引雞眠。四柱交加見，福少禍連綿。此煞主血光横死，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":1373,"lineType":1,"content":"在水火防焚溺，金木杖刃，土墜落，瘟疫尅身。大㓙若有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":1374,"lineType":1,"content":"福神相助，多是武權。亦如刼煞之類，要見官星印綬，生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1477","lineNum":1375,"lineType":1,"content":"旺處為佳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1478","lineNum":1375,"lineType":1,"content":"神白經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_89","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1479","lineNum":1375,"lineType":1,"content":"云：災煞畏乎尅，生處却為祥。正謂此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1480","lineNum":1376,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1481","lineNum":1377,"lineType":8,"content":"論六厄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":1378,"lineType":1,"content":"厄者，遭乎難者也。常居馬前一辰，刼後二辰，死而不生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":1379,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之厄。申子辰，水局，水死在卯；寅午戌，火局，火死在酉；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505935646801958"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":1382,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未，木局，木死在午；巳酉丑，金局，金死在子。所以為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":1383,"lineType":1,"content":"厄。若有救䕶，有扶持，逢生旺，兼貴氣相助則吉，究竟一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":1384,"lineType":1,"content":"生蹇滯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":1384,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_90","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":1384,"lineType":1,"content":"云：六厄為剝官之煞。李廣不封侯是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":1385,"lineType":9,"content":"論勾絞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":1385,"lineType":2,"content":"一名爪牙煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":1386,"lineType":1,"content":"勾者，牽連之義；絞者，覊絆之名。二煞嘗相對衝，亦猶亡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1493","lineNum":1387,"lineType":1,"content":"刼。陽男陰女，命前三辰為勾，命後三辰為絞；陰男陽女，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1494","lineNum":1388,"lineType":1,"content":"命前三辰為絞，命後三辰為勾。假令甲子陽命人，卯為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1495","lineNum":1389,"lineType":1,"content":"勾，酉為絞；乙丑陰命人，辰為絞，戌為勾之例。古歌云：爪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1496","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505966319697960"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1497","lineNum":1392,"lineType":1,"content":"牙煞去命三辰，大忌金神羊刃臨。夾煞尅身無福救，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1498","lineNum":1393,"lineType":1,"content":"遭蛇虎傷其身。此煞大忌金神白虎併，則㓙牛馬犬畜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1499","lineNum":1394,"lineType":1,"content":"等傷亦是，不獨虎狼也。不尅身與福同宫者不用。大抵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1500","lineNum":1395,"lineType":1,"content":"此煞，凡命遇之，身若尅煞，多心路計巧，主掌刑法之任，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1501","lineNum":1396,"lineType":1,"content":"或為將帥，專行誅戮。煞若尅身，主非命而終。小人逢之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1502","lineNum":1397,"lineType":1,"content":"非横災禍，行年至此，亦主口舌、刑獄等事。又云：値兩位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1503","lineNum":1398,"lineType":1,"content":"全者災重，一位者輕。又云：有鬼則災重，無鬼則災輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1504","lineNum":1399,"lineType":9,"content":"論孤辰寡宿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1505","lineNum":1399,"lineType":2,"content":"及隔角煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1506","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505975836540966"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1507","lineNum":1402,"lineType":1,"content":"先賢有云：老而無夫曰寡，㓜而無父曰孤。此其義也。辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1508","lineNum":1403,"lineType":1,"content":"謂星辰，宿謂星宿，指其神也。人命犯此星辰，則孤寡如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1509","lineNum":1404,"lineType":1,"content":"是。如亥子丑逐方三位，進前一辰見寅為孤；退後一辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1510","lineNum":1405,"lineType":1,"content":"見戌，為寡。又過角為孤，退角為寡。其餘三方，皆依此推，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":1406,"lineType":1,"content":"乃陰陽惆悵之義。且夫寅為春始，辰為春末；巳為夏始，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":1407,"lineType":1,"content":"未為夏末；申為秋始，戌為秋末；亥為冬始，丑為冬末，皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":1408,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽支離之神，四時代謝之方。三車云：造物中以生我","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":1409,"lineType":1,"content":"者為母，尅我者為夫，我尅者為妻。亥子丑，屬北方水位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505966319681576"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":1412,"lineType":1,"content":"水用金為母，金絶於寅，是母絶也；用火為妻，火墓在戌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":1413,"lineType":1,"content":"是妻墓也。申酉戌，屬西方金位，金用火為夫，火絶在亥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":1414,"lineType":1,"content":"用木為妻，木墓在未。巳午未，南方火位，火用木為母，木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":1415,"lineType":1,"content":"絶在申；用水為夫，水墓在辰。寅卯辰屬東方木位，木用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":1416,"lineType":1,"content":"水為母，水絶在巳；用金為夫，金墓在丑。是取母絶為孤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":1417,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，夫墓、妻墓為寡宿，其義尤切。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":1417,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_91","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":1417,"lineType":1,"content":"云：骨肉中道分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":1418,"lineType":1,"content":"離，孤寡猶嫌於隔角。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":1418,"lineType":1,"content":"玉門集","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_92","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":1418,"lineType":1,"content":"云：寅申巳亥為角，辰戌丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":1419,"lineType":1,"content":"未為隔。進者為陽，不利父；退者為陰，不利母。又云：在陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505947281752104"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":1422,"lineType":1,"content":"宫妨父，在陰宫妨母。如寅卯辰人，巳為孤，丑為寡，寅辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":1423,"lineType":1,"content":"為陽之位，丑巳為陰之位。男女生命見之，雖親生兒女，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":1424,"lineType":1,"content":"多不和順。王氏云：男命生於妻絶之中，而逢孤辰，平生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":1425,"lineType":1,"content":"難於婚偶；女命生於夫絶之位，而遇寡宿，屢嫁不能偕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":1426,"lineType":1,"content":"老。如辛丑人得庚寅，寅為丑孤辰，丑為寅寡宿，寅丑互","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"為孤寡。隔角，言丑寅中有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"艮","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_93","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"卦，隔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_94","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_95","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"艮","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_96","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"巽","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_97","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"四，猶之角","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":1428,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":1429,"lineType":1,"content":"燭神經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_98","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":1429,"lineType":1,"content":"云：凡人命犯孤寡，主形孤骨露，面無和氣，不利","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505958711296011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":1432,"lineType":1,"content":"六親。生旺稍可，死絶尤甚。驛馬併放蕩他鄉，空亡併㓜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":1433,"lineType":1,"content":"少無倚，喪弔併父母相繼而亡，一生多逢重喪疉禍，骨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":1434,"lineType":1,"content":"肉伶仃，單寒不利。入貴格，贅壻婦家；入賤格，移流未免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":1435,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼谷遺文","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_99","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":1435,"lineType":1,"content":"云：連屬不言孤寡，如亥得寅戌，寅得丑巳，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":1436,"lineType":1,"content":"支干朝會，包裹貴人，雖犯孤寡，不以孤寡論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":1436,"lineType":1,"content":"廣錄","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_100","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":1436,"lineType":1,"content":"云：井","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":1437,"lineType":1,"content":"欄斜衝，是孤辰寡宿，更天干帶倒食，謂之井欄倒食。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":1438,"lineType":1,"content":"巳午未人，再生夏三月，是帶兩重孤寡，主尅妻害子，少","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1559","lineNum":1439,"lineType":1,"content":"六親，不聚財，多生女，更帶諸㓙煞，主不令終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1560","lineNum":1439,"lineType":1,"content":"珞琭子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_101","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1561","lineNum":1439,"lineType":1,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1562","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505944744214565"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":1442,"lineType":1,"content":"憑陰察其陽禍，歲星莫犯於孤辰；恃陽鑑以陰災，天年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":1443,"lineType":1,"content":"忌逢於寡宿。蓋言小運，太歲不可犯之，陽以孤辰為重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":1444,"lineType":1,"content":"陰以寡宿為重。瑩和尚云：子午、卯酉有死氣，辰戌、丑未，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":1445,"lineType":1,"content":"四墓之鄉，人或値之，孤中孤也。常以寅卯辰居午，巳、午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":1446,"lineType":1,"content":"未在酉，申酉戌逢子，亥子丑臨卯，此是孤辰隔角。辰戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":1447,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未亦然。以寅、申、巳、亥為天地之角，今隔此四位，故曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":1448,"lineType":1,"content":"孤辰。或以寅日丑時，巳日辰時，申日未時，亥日戌時，名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":1449,"lineType":1,"content":"惆悵煞，主咨嗟不足，雖富貴亦然。君子玷責，庶人刑徒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505944744181797"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":1452,"lineType":1,"content":"不獨孤寡巳也。若戌日子時，丑日卯時，辰日午時，未日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":1453,"lineType":1,"content":"酉時，互換看之，君子主癰疽致命，庶人血光致死。日時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":1454,"lineType":1,"content":"損尅妻子，胎年損尅父母，名血光煞。沈芝又以子人見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":1455,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，亥人見子，丑人見戌，戌人見丑，寅人見酉，酉人見寅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":1456,"lineType":1,"content":"卯人見申，申人見卯，辰人見未，未人見辰，巳人見午，午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":1457,"lineType":1,"content":"人見巳，各兩位，依次數之，日時遇着，定主孤寡，少失六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":1458,"lineType":1,"content":"親。年時犯，若不過房，必尅父母。此又一說。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":1459,"lineType":8,"content":"論天羅地網","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505944744198181"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":1462,"lineType":1,"content":"羅網之說，其義甚明，然何以戌亥為天羅，辰巳為地網？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":1463,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋天傾西北，戌亥者，六陰之終也；地陷東南，辰巳者，六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":1464,"lineType":1,"content":"陽之終也。陰陽終極，則暗昧不明，如人之在羅網，此其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":1465,"lineType":1,"content":"義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":1465,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_102","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":1465,"lineType":1,"content":"云：龍蛇混雜，偏不利於辰生；猪犬侵凌，但","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":1466,"lineType":1,"content":"獨嫌於亥字。龍為辰，蛇為巳，辰人得巳，巳人得辰，皆曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":1467,"lineType":1,"content":"龍蛇混雜。男命則不妨，惟女命破婚害子，薄命抱疾。辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":1468,"lineType":1,"content":"人得巳重，巳人得辰輕，謂龍生蛇穴者退，蛇生龍穴者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":1469,"lineType":1,"content":"進。猪為亥，犬為戌，戌人得亥，亥人得戌，皆曰猪犬侵凌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505920505495563"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":1472,"lineType":1,"content":"女命則不妨，惟男命則迍滯齟齬，妨祖尅妻。戌人得亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":1473,"lineType":1,"content":"輕，亥人得戌重，謂犬入猪羣則進，猪入犬羣則傷。諸書","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1594","lineNum":1474,"lineType":1,"content":"亦云：龍蛇混雜，常防婦女憂危；猪犬侵凌，每慮丈夫厄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1595","lineNum":1475,"lineType":1,"content":"難。是男怕天羅，女怕地網，中間又分火命人有天羅，水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1596","lineNum":1476,"lineType":1,"content":"土命人有地網，餘金木二命無之。人命帶此，多主蹇滯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1597","lineNum":1477,"lineType":1,"content":"更加惡煞相併，五行無氣，必主惡死。行運至此，亦如之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1598","lineNum":1478,"lineType":1,"content":"假如戌年戌月初一日生者，犯一年天羅；十五日生者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1599","lineNum":1479,"lineType":1,"content":"犯十五年天羅。若更生時是戌，增成三十年天羅。或戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1600","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505944744230949"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1601","lineNum":1482,"lineType":1,"content":"年亥月，或亥時戌日，交互見之，謂之重犯，則災不能歇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1602","lineNum":1483,"lineType":1,"content":"地網如上說，若天羅地網重併，為害尤重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1603","lineNum":1483,"lineType":1,"content":"理愚歌","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_103","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1604","lineNum":1483,"lineType":1,"content":"云：生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1605","lineNum":1484,"lineType":1,"content":"時地結與天盤，爭使親闈得久安。如甲辰命見甲戌，甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1606","lineNum":1485,"lineType":1,"content":"戌命見甲辰，只此二辰生人，是就羅網中言之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1607","lineNum":1486,"lineType":8,"content":"論十惡大敗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1608","lineNum":1487,"lineType":1,"content":"十惡者，譬律法中人犯十惡重罪，在所不赦。大敗者，譬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1609","lineNum":1488,"lineType":1,"content":"兵法中與敵交戰大敗，無一生還，喻極㐫也。六甲旬中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1610","lineNum":1489,"lineType":1,"content":"十個日値祿入空亡，如甲辰、乙巳，甲以寅為祿，乙以卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1611","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505959424327743"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1612","lineNum":1492,"lineType":1,"content":"為祿，甲辰旬以寅、卯為空亡。壬申者，壬以亥為祿，甲子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1613","lineNum":1493,"lineType":1,"content":"旬以亥為空亡。餘如丙申、丁亥、庚辰、戊戌、癸亥、辛巳、乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1614","lineNum":1494,"lineType":1,"content":"丑等日，皆倣此。命中犯者，當以日上見之為是，其餘不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1615","lineNum":1495,"lineType":1,"content":"論。况犯者未必皆㐫，若内有吉神相扶，貴氣相輔，當為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1616","lineNum":1496,"lineType":1,"content":"吉論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1617","lineNum":1497,"lineType":1,"content":"元白經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_104","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1618","lineNum":1497,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：十惡都來十個辰，逐年有煞用區分。如庚戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1619","lineNum":1498,"lineType":1,"content":"年見甲辰日，辛亥年見乙巳日，壬寅年見丙申日，癸巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1620","lineNum":1499,"lineType":1,"content":"年見丁亥日，甲辰年見戊戌日，乙未年見己丑日，甲戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1621","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505975836590118"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1622","lineNum":1502,"lineType":1,"content":"年見庚辰日，乙亥年見辛巳日，丙寅年見壬申日，丁巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1623","lineNum":1503,"lineType":1,"content":"年見癸亥日。蓋以年支干衝日支干，無祿為忌，餘悉無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1624","lineNum":1504,"lineType":1,"content":"妨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1625","lineNum":1505,"lineType":1,"content":"釋敎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1626","lineNum":1505,"lineType":1,"content":"玄黄經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_105","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1627","lineNum":1505,"lineType":1,"content":"又以甲己年戊辰月、戊戌日、壬申月、癸亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1628","lineNum":1506,"lineType":1,"content":"日、乙亥月、丙申日、丙子月、丁亥日；乙庚年辛巳月、壬申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1629","lineNum":1507,"lineType":1,"content":"日、甲戌月、乙巳日；丙辛年壬辰月、辛巳日、戊戌月、庚辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1630","lineNum":1508,"lineType":1,"content":"日、己亥月甲辰日；戊癸年己未月、己丑日。丁壬年無如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1631","lineNum":1509,"lineType":1,"content":"人命甲己年三月、七月、十月、十一月生，恰遇此四日，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1632","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505966319730728"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1633","lineNum":1512,"lineType":1,"content":"分别甲子旬生，恰遇壬申；甲辰旬生，恰遇乙巳，在日上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1634","lineNum":1513,"lineType":1,"content":"見方是。其說尤的","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1635","lineNum":1514,"lineType":1,"content":"有四廢日。春庚申，夏壬子，秋甲寅，冬丙午，三厯會同，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1636","lineNum":1515,"lineType":1,"content":"添辛酉、癸亥、乙卯、丁未。廢者，囚死無用之謂也。凡命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1637","lineNum":1516,"lineType":1,"content":"帶此作事不成，有始無終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1638","lineNum":1517,"lineType":1,"content":"有天地轉日，春乙卯、辛卯，夏丙午、戊午，秋辛酉、癸酉，冬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1639","lineNum":1518,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子、丙子，乃干支納音俱專，旺於四時之謂也。凡命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1640","lineNum":1519,"lineType":1,"content":"値此日，生於四季，更本命又到此旺，成功不退。物過","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1641","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505959424344127"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1642","lineNum":1522,"lineType":1,"content":"則損主夭折。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1643","lineNum":1522,"lineType":1,"content":"玄微賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_106","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1644","lineNum":1522,"lineType":1,"content":"云韓信被誅，只傷天地轉煞是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1645","lineNum":1523,"lineType":1,"content":"也。如顏子己丑、辛未、丙午、戊子夏生，見丙午，加以本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1646","lineNum":1524,"lineType":1,"content":"命，又到此旺，雖亞聖造化太極，至庚申年壽止。又一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1647","lineNum":1525,"lineType":1,"content":"命丙戌、丁酉、辛酉、己未秋生，而遇辛酉，雖本命是土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1648","lineNum":1526,"lineType":1,"content":"丑甲年庚戌月壽止。大抵造化最喜中和，太過、不及","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1649","lineNum":1527,"lineType":1,"content":"皆不為吉。上四日乃過，遇死囚謂之不及。天地轉日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1650","lineNum":1528,"lineType":1,"content":"乃過，遇健旺謂之太過，非中和也。若柱中不及，有生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1651","lineNum":1529,"lineType":1,"content":"扶太過有制，抑不在此論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1654","lineNum":1533,"lineType":1,"content":"古人製字，各有取義。神字之訓，為木自斃，水土絶於己，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1655","lineNum":1534,"lineType":1,"content":"故汜字之訓，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1656","lineNum":1534,"lineType":1,"content":"說文","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_107","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1657","lineNum":1534,"lineType":1,"content":"以為窮瀆。圯字之訓，為岸圯及覆。火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1658","lineNum":1535,"lineType":1,"content":"衰於戌，故烕為滅。金衰於丑，故鈕為鍵閉。草核為亥，木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1659","lineNum":1536,"lineType":1,"content":"根於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1660","lineNum":1536,"lineType":1,"content":"艮","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_108","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1661","lineNum":1536,"lineType":1,"content":"。金遇十為針，白遇十為皁，水遇十為汁之類，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1662","lineNum":1537,"lineType":1,"content":"可以不論乎？故甲乙十干，子丑十二支，古人製字，必有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1663","lineNum":1538,"lineType":1,"content":"深義，試以字形言之。甲丙丁壬辰字，謂之平頭煞，若見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1664","lineNum":1539,"lineType":1,"content":"三四帶空亡者，定為僧道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1665","lineNum":1539,"lineType":1,"content":"命書","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_109","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1666","lineNum":1539,"lineType":1,"content":"云：人命犯甲乙丙丁，一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1667","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505920505511947"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1668","lineNum":1542,"lineType":1,"content":"路無間，主陷害，男尅妻，女尅夫。甲癸未申酉，屬破字，甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1669","lineNum":1543,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉必損眼，未申患心腹疾，更看時入害鄉，干神受制","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1670","lineNum":1544,"lineType":1,"content":"者不虛。甲辛卯午申屬懸針，五行元無氣，不値徳神，定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1671","lineNum":1545,"lineType":1,"content":"是軍人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1672","lineNum":1545,"lineType":1,"content":"三命纂局","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_110","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1673","lineNum":1545,"lineType":1,"content":"云：甲辛三四號懸針，眼疾還多嶮厄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1674","lineNum":1546,"lineType":1,"content":"臨，被刑帶煞須徒配，多是為軍刺面人。戌庚戌屬杖刑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1675","lineNum":1547,"lineType":1,"content":"鋒刃倒戈。若帶羊刃蝕神，定犯徒流惡死。乙己丑己，屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1676","lineNum":1548,"lineType":1,"content":"闕字曲脚煞，犯多者，必有闕脣穿耳，支體不全。若無徳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1677","lineNum":1549,"lineType":1,"content":"合，五行無氣，穀帛不充，寄食他門。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1678","lineNum":1549,"lineType":1,"content":"命書","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_111","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1679","lineNum":1549,"lineType":1,"content":"云：己巳、乙巳、丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1680","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505958711361547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1681","lineNum":1552,"lineType":1,"content":"己，人命日遇，主尅頭妻。李九萬云：凡己、酉、丑三合全，天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1682","lineNum":1553,"lineType":1,"content":"干帶己字者，主脣齒不全之疾，一生招人脣吻。四柱有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1683","lineNum":1554,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳者，名曲脚煞。帶多，主養他人為子，不然，養於他人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1684","lineNum":1555,"lineType":1,"content":"為子。丙壬寅酉為聾啞字，若犯多者，及胎中受害，時蝕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1685","lineNum":1556,"lineType":1,"content":"於日，必患聾啞。又酉日戌時生，亦主此患，及頭面惡瘡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1686","lineNum":1557,"lineType":1,"content":"此是時破日也。歌曰：平頭必是為僧道，破字終須失眼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1687","lineNum":1558,"lineType":1,"content":"明。帶煞懸針須刺面，徒流多是杖刑併。飢貧不幸逢空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1688","lineNum":1559,"lineType":1,"content":"缺，相貌兼知不十成。惟是相遭聾啞子，空亡無氣定來","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1689","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505935646867494"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1690","lineNum":1562,"lineType":1,"content":"精。若還曲脚多多帶，父子須敎兩姓生。又壬癸人得酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1691","lineNum":1563,"lineType":1,"content":"字，或酉人得壬癸字，水從酉為酒，遇吉因酒成家，㓙則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1692","lineNum":1564,"lineType":1,"content":"破家或醉死。乙字為披頭，若重見者，或師巫，或倡優，併","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1693","lineNum":1565,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙天徳為高官。丙戊二干若在寅卯上，名仇讐晦氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1694","lineNum":1566,"lineType":1,"content":"主招謗怨，多與人競。乙己癸三干全非四肢眼目破傷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1695","lineNum":1567,"lineType":1,"content":"則中年後犯刑。甲乙庚三干全，主失明，或少年班瘡損","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1696","lineNum":1568,"lineType":1,"content":"眼。乙癸二干不可同見丑字，主富貴少壽。丁辛二干不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1697","lineNum":1569,"lineType":1,"content":"可同見巳字，主傷父母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1698","lineNum":1569,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_112","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1699","lineNum":1569,"lineType":1,"content":"云：乙癸同牛，寸陰難保。丁辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1700","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505958711345163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1701","lineNum":1572,"lineType":1,"content":"二干，父母多傷。丙辛二干不可見巳。丁壬二干不可見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1702","lineNum":1573,"lineType":1,"content":"午申，名曰類應，主平生歇滅。乙辛二干不可同未。庚壬二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1703","lineNum":1574,"lineType":1,"content":"干不可同戌，名曰反傷，主富貴中夭夀，小人刑戮之災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1704","lineNum":1574,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_113","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1705","lineNum":1575,"lineType":1,"content":"云：乙辛逢未是天牢，四位同宮禍患遭。庚壬遇戌須徒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1706","lineNum":1576,"lineType":1,"content":"配，災咎來時不可逃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1708","lineNum":1578,"lineType":1,"content":"神煞古有百二十名，其說穿鑿支離，造化恐不如是。除","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1709","lineNum":1579,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃空亡、刼煞、災煞、大煞、元辰勾絞、咸池破碎、羅網衝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1710","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505959424360511"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1711","lineNum":1582,"lineType":1,"content":"擊、天空懸針、平頭倒戈等煞，命中切要者，已備論於前","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1712","lineNum":1583,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。兹以諸星家考驗有理，復備叙於左。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1713","lineNum":1584,"lineType":1,"content":"自縊煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1714","lineNum":1585,"lineType":1,"content":"此煞取五行反繫處，如戌人巳，巳人戌，辰人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1715","lineNum":1586,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，亥人辰，寅人未，未人寅，卯人申，申人卯，午人丑，丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1716","lineNum":1587,"lineType":1,"content":"人午，子人酉，酉人子是也。大忌相尅，天元是墓，更有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1717","lineNum":1588,"lineType":1,"content":"天中、官符、大耗者，定㓙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1718","lineNum":1589,"lineType":1,"content":"水溺煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1719","lineNum":1590,"lineType":1,"content":"此煞取丙子、癸未、癸丑，上帶咸池、金刃、羊刃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1720","lineNum":1591,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋丙子納音水，又子為水旺之地，未為井宿之居，丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1721","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505966319747112"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1722","lineNum":1594,"lineType":1,"content":"為三河之分，更納音尅身，決不可免。古歌云：刼煞尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1723","lineNum":1595,"lineType":1,"content":"身名顚墜，金神羊刃防同位。要知自縊最㓙神，戌、巳、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1724","lineNum":1596,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、亥併寅、未、子、酉，一例為㓙煞。卯、申、丑、未依前是，大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1725","lineNum":1597,"lineType":1,"content":"忌空亡兼墓鬼，官符、大耗仍須避。丙子、癸未併癸丑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1726","lineNum":1598,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池、金煞、羊刃畏五行。更若來尅身，一死懸梁，一溺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1727","lineNum":1599,"lineType":1,"content":"水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1728","lineNum":1600,"lineType":1,"content":"掛劒煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1729","lineNum":1601,"lineType":1,"content":"此煞取巳酉、丑、申四柱純全者是。或重帶巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1730","lineNum":1602,"lineType":1,"content":"酉、丑，亦是。更犯官符、元辰、白虎、金神等類。五行刑尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1731","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505975836606502"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1732","lineNum":1605,"lineType":1,"content":"本命者，主㓙暴殺人，或反為人所殺。詩曰：巳酉丑申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1733","lineNum":1606,"lineType":1,"content":"金氣全，從革局多名掛劒，元亡金虎併尅身，縱不殺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1734","lineNum":1607,"lineType":1,"content":"人身，豈免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1735","lineNum":1608,"lineType":1,"content":"天火煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1736","lineNum":1609,"lineType":1,"content":"此煞取寅午戌全，而天干有丙丁，五位中全","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1737","lineNum":1610,"lineType":1,"content":"不見水者，是，有水則非。若年運至火氣生旺處，當防","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1738","lineNum":1611,"lineType":1,"content":"火災。詩曰：寅午戌全號天火，不見丙丁猶自可，五位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1739","lineNum":1612,"lineType":1,"content":"都無一水神，生旺臨年災厄火。余命寅午戊全，月干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1740","lineNum":1613,"lineType":1,"content":"有癸，行戊午運，戊癸化火，甲戌年、甲戌月，遂遭火災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1741","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505935646900262"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1742","lineNum":1616,"lineType":2,"content":"育吾自記。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1743","lineNum":1617,"lineType":1,"content":"天屠煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1744","lineNum":1618,"lineType":1,"content":"此煞除子日、午時、午日、子時外，自餘丑日、亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1745","lineNum":1619,"lineType":1,"content":"時、亥日、丑時、寅日、戌時、戌日、寅時、卯日、酉時、酉日、卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1746","lineNum":1620,"lineType":1,"content":"時、辰日、申時、申日、辰時、巳日、未時、未日、巳時，依次逐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1747","lineNum":1621,"lineType":1,"content":"兩位數之。君子犯者，主異疾、腸風、脚氣；小人折損肢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1748","lineNum":1622,"lineType":1,"content":"體。重犯者，主徒配。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1749","lineNum":1623,"lineType":1,"content":"天刑煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1750","lineNum":1624,"lineType":1,"content":"此煞取子丑人，乙時、寅人，庚時；卯辰人，辛時、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1751","lineNum":1625,"lineType":1,"content":"巳人，壬時；午未人，癸時、申人，丙時；酉戌人，丁時、亥人、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1752","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505971377995810"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1753","lineNum":1628,"lineType":1,"content":"戊時。取時刑尅本命，犯者遭刑有疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1754","lineNum":1629,"lineType":1,"content":"雷霆煞：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1755","lineNum":1630,"lineType":1,"content":"正七二八子寅方，三九四十辰午當，五十一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1756","lineNum":1631,"lineType":1,"content":"申六二戌，必主雷轟虎咬亡。又云：正七下加子，二八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1757","lineNum":1632,"lineType":1,"content":"在寅方，三九居辰上，四十午位傷，五十一申位，六十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1758","lineNum":1633,"lineType":1,"content":"二戌方。正月起子，順行六陽位，此煞人命遇之，如逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1759","lineNum":1634,"lineType":1,"content":"祿貴吉星臨壓，則吉。好行陰隲，為法官，掌雷霆、行符","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1760","lineNum":1635,"lineType":1,"content":"勅水之人，或成佛作祖之輩。如遇羊刃、的煞、飛廉等","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1761","lineNum":1636,"lineType":1,"content":"會命限，必㓙主墮於天眞，雷傷虎啗，天譴瘟疾，或溺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1762","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505958711394315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1763","lineNum":1639,"lineType":1,"content":"水囹圄死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1764","lineNum":1640,"lineType":1,"content":"吞陷煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1765","lineNum":1641,"lineType":1,"content":"猪犬羊逢虎必傷，猴蛇相會樹頭亡。犬逢雞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1766","lineNum":1642,"lineType":1,"content":"子遭徒配，兔趕蛇歌走遠鄉。鼠見犬來須惡死，馬牛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1767","lineNum":1643,"lineType":1,"content":"遇虎定相戕。兔猴逢犬難廻避，龍來龍上水中殃。凡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1768","lineNum":1644,"lineType":1,"content":"人若値臨時日，三合為災仔，細詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1769","lineNum":1644,"lineType":2,"content":"以年支為主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
