{"lines":[{"lineId":"1784","lineNum":1657,"lineType":1,"content":"喪吊煞","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_117","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1785","lineNum":1657,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1786","lineNum":1658,"lineType":1,"content":"一名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1787","lineNum":1658,"lineType":1,"content":"横關煞","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_118","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1788","lineNum":1658,"lineType":1,"content":"，取命前二辰為喪門，命後二辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1789","lineNum":1659,"lineType":1,"content":"為弔客，其或太歲㐫煞併臨大小運限，必主禍。古詩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1790","lineNum":1660,"lineType":1,"content":"云：五官六死十二病，三喪十一弔來臨。可見此十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1791","lineNum":1661,"lineType":1,"content":"宫一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1792","lineNum":1661,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲歌","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_119","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1793","lineNum":1661,"lineType":1,"content":"，不惟命犯不吉，流年尤㓙，若月有羊刃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1794","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505981427630117"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1795","lineNum":1664,"lineType":1,"content":"來佐，㐫煞臨時，則横關也。古歌云：横關惡煞少人知，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1796","lineNum":1665,"lineType":1,"content":"月祿㓙神又及時，縱有吉星重疉至，不遭刑戮也傾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1797","lineNum":1666,"lineType":1,"content":"危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1798","lineNum":1666,"lineType":2,"content":"喪門即地雌，弔客即天狗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1799","lineNum":1667,"lineType":1,"content":"宅墓煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1800","lineNum":1668,"lineType":1,"content":"命前五辰為宅，命後五辰為墓，怕宅墓受歲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1801","lineNum":1669,"lineType":1,"content":"刼等煞，來破本命之宅，主呻吟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1802","lineNum":1670,"lineType":1,"content":"日刑煞","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_120","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1803","lineNum":1670,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1804","lineNum":1671,"lineType":1,"content":"以本生日上數甲子本日干住，陽干順數，陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1805","lineNum":1672,"lineType":1,"content":"干逆數。若在命官，主極刑三合，主徒配對宮，主外死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1806","lineNum":1673,"lineType":1,"content":"流血煞","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_121","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1807","lineNum":1673,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1808","lineNum":1674,"lineType":1,"content":"以本生月起子，順數至本年住。若在命宮三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1809","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505959424426047"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1810","lineNum":1677,"lineType":1,"content":"合對宫，主癰疽、庶人徒配、婦人産厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1820","lineNum":1685,"lineType":1,"content":"十月壬，十一月癸，十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1821","lineNum":1686,"lineType":1,"content":"月己，逐月旺干加臨日時，帶兩重者，㓙更與懸針相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1822","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505959424442431"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1823","lineNum":1689,"lineType":1,"content":"見，主決配傷殘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1824","lineNum":1690,"lineType":1,"content":"浮沉煞","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_124","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1825","lineNum":1690,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1826","lineNum":1690,"lineType":2,"content":"血刃","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_125","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1827","lineNum":1690,"lineType":2,"content":"同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1828","lineNum":1690,"lineType":1,"content":"從戌上起子，逆行至本生年住，却從年宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1829","lineNum":1691,"lineType":1,"content":"數，看在何宫。只在財帛宫，名串錢，主富蓄，餘皆㓙。甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1830","lineNum":1692,"lineType":1,"content":"乙己庚壬人犯之稍輕，丙丁戊辛癸人犯之重。在寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1831","lineNum":1693,"lineType":1,"content":"午戌申未年中，此煞多主水厄。仍各隨宫分論災。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1832","lineNum":1694,"lineType":1,"content":"在田宅，則主破祖。餘宫類推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1833","lineNum":1695,"lineType":1,"content":"破煞","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_126","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1834","lineNum":1696,"lineType":1,"content":"此煞卯與午，丑與辰，子與酉，未與戌，皆相破。惟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1835","lineNum":1697,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申巳亥原破，却三合，故不取。犯者主少年災滯，財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1836","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505947281866792"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1837","lineNum":1700,"lineType":1,"content":"產耗散，兼身有折傷之災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1838","lineNum":1701,"lineType":1,"content":"返本煞","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_127","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1839","lineNum":1701,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1840","lineNum":1702,"lineType":1,"content":"五行無貴氣，下尅上為返。歌曰：五行死絶併","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1841","lineNum":1703,"lineType":1,"content":"來時，有格如閒福不隨。更忌日時尅年主，定無官貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1842","lineNum":1704,"lineType":1,"content":"切須知。如甲子金命，得戊午日，又胎月日時，多帶寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1843","lineNum":1705,"lineType":1,"content":"巳，犯者定主孤立，或富或貴，一旺便尅，傷父母尊長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1844","lineNum":1706,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽煞：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1845","lineNum":1707,"lineType":1,"content":"女屬陰而喜陽命，得戊午旺火為正陽；男屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1846","lineNum":1708,"lineType":1,"content":"陽而喜陰命，得丙子旺水為正陰。是陰陽和暢。故男","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1847","lineNum":1709,"lineType":1,"content":"得丙子，平生多得美婦人；女得戊午，平生多逢美男","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1848","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505958711410699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1849","lineNum":1712,"lineType":1,"content":"子。日上遇之，男得美妻，女得美夫。大忌元辰，咸池同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1850","lineNum":1713,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，不論男女皆淫。如男得戊午，多婦人相愛；女得丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1851","lineNum":1714,"lineType":1,"content":"子，多男子挑誘。更看有無貴賤消息。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1852","lineNum":1715,"lineType":1,"content":"淫慾妨害煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1853","lineNum":1716,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_128","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1854","lineNum":1716,"lineType":1,"content":"云：老醉秦樓十二，直緣重犯八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1855","lineNum":1717,"lineType":1,"content":"專；少亡楚甸八千，應是疉逢九醜。蓋言八專為淫慾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1856","lineNum":1718,"lineType":1,"content":"之煞，九醜為妨害之辰。八專乃甲寅、乙卯、己未、丁未、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1857","lineNum":1719,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申、辛酉、戊戌、癸丑是也。日上有不正之妻，時上有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1858","lineNum":1720,"lineType":1,"content":"不正之子，女人犯者，不擇親疎，犯多者尤𦂳。九醜乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1859","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505947281850408"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1860","lineNum":1723,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子、壬午、戊子、戊午、己酉、己卯、乙酉、乙卯、辛酉、辛卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1861","lineNum":1724,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。婦人犯者主產厄。男犯多醜，不令終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1862","lineNum":1725,"lineType":1,"content":"孤鸞寡鵠煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1863","lineNum":1726,"lineType":1,"content":"古歌曰：木火逢蛇大不祥，金猪何必強","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1864","lineNum":1727,"lineType":1,"content":"猖狂，土猴木虎夫何在，時對孤鸞舞一塲。乃乙巳、丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1865","lineNum":1728,"lineType":1,"content":"巳、辛亥、戊申、甲寅，又丙午、戊午、壬子等日，男尅妻，女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1866","lineNum":1729,"lineType":1,"content":"尅夫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1867","lineNum":1730,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽差錯煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1868","lineNum":1731,"lineType":1,"content":"乃丙子、丁丑、戊寅、辛卯、壬辰、癸巳、丙午、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1869","lineNum":1732,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未、戊申、辛酉、壬戌、癸亥十二日也。女子逢之，公姑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1870","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505920505544715"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1871","lineNum":1735,"lineType":1,"content":"寡合；妯娌不足，夫家冷退。男子逢之，主退外家，亦與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1872","lineNum":1736,"lineType":1,"content":"妻家是非寡合。其煞，不論男女月、日、時兩重或三重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1873","lineNum":1737,"lineType":1,"content":"犯之極重，只日家犯之尤重。主不得外家力，縱有妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1874","lineNum":1738,"lineType":1,"content":"財，亦成虛花，久後仍與妻家為仇，不相往來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1875","lineNum":1739,"lineType":1,"content":"臨官遇刼，名桃花煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1876","lineNum":1740,"lineType":1,"content":"主好酒色。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1877","lineNum":1741,"lineType":1,"content":"返吟遇梟，名短壽煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1878","lineNum":1742,"lineType":1,"content":"主傷妻子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1879","lineNum":1743,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花紅艶煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1880","lineNum":1744,"lineType":1,"content":"亥、卯、未在子，巳酉、丑在午，寅、午、戌在卯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1881","lineNum":1745,"lineType":1,"content":"申子、辰在酉，為桃花煞。甲、乙逢午，丙寅、丁未、戊子、己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1882","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505944744296485"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1883","lineNum":1748,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、庚戌、辛酉、壬巳、癸申，為紅艶煞。女命最忌之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1884","lineNum":1749,"lineType":1,"content":"以上諸煞。凡言尅身，謂㓙煞下納音尅生年。太歲納音","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1885","lineNum":1750,"lineType":1,"content":"臨身，謂㓙煞帶太歲納音於本位也。太歲納音為身，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1886","lineNum":1751,"lineType":1,"content":"身被尅、被臨於死、敗、絶位，便遭不測之災。若但在身有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1887","lineNum":1752,"lineType":1,"content":"氣處被尅，災重；被臨則輕。惟太歲納音尅煞則吉。如人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1888","lineNum":1753,"lineType":1,"content":"命已入貴格，𦂳要處帶煞，有福神助之，則名為權柄；無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1889","lineNum":1754,"lineType":1,"content":"福神助之，又煞氣乘旺，遞互往還，或刑尅本主，下賤惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1890","lineNum":1755,"lineType":1,"content":"死。又云：一切福神所居之位，則欲生旺，生旺則榮貴。一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1891","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505975836639270"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1892","lineNum":1758,"lineType":1,"content":"切煞神所居之位，則欲死絶，死絶則善終。又云：凡福神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1893","lineNum":1759,"lineType":1,"content":"欲令得旺氣，忌有敗之者。凡㓙神欲令得衰氣，忌有助","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1894","lineNum":1760,"lineType":1,"content":"之者。又云：相衝、相破、三合、六合，命中有之，即求五行相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1895","lineNum":1761,"lineType":1,"content":"得何如？或禍中生福，福中生禍。如死絶復生，空亡受破，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1896","lineNum":1762,"lineType":1,"content":"相尅相成，則禍中生福。反此，則福中生禍。命書云：道途","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1897","lineNum":1763,"lineType":1,"content":"賤吏，豈無驛馬攀鞍；市井博徒，亦有三奇夾貴。子平云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1898","lineNum":1764,"lineType":1,"content":"君子格中，也犯七煞陽刃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1899","lineNum":1764,"lineType":1,"content":"小人命内，亦有正印官星。由","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1900","lineNum":1765,"lineType":1,"content":"是觀之，吉㓙神煞，不可拘定，輕重較量，要在通變。大抵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1901","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505971378044962"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1902","lineNum":1768,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫煞所居，于神不宜帶真鬼尅傷本身，雖見官星，尚變","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1903","lineNum":1769,"lineType":1,"content":"為鬼，况是真鬼，其為災禍明矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1904","lineNum":1770,"lineType":8,"content":"寅申巳亥四宫互換神煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1905","lineNum":1771,"lineType":1,"content":"當年同榜拜丹墀，文業雖齊祿不齊。生死榮枯千百樣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1906","lineNum":1772,"lineType":1,"content":"為緣煞局有高低。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1907","lineNum":1773,"lineType":2,"content":"煞局十二宫中皆有之，寅申巳亥為最，以亡神刼煞、貴人長生、祿馬同位故也。人命逢吉神多則吉，㐫煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1908","lineNum":1774,"lineType":2,"content":"多則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1909","lineNum":1775,"lineType":1,"content":"煞中包煞方為貴，不在年干在日時。帶貴自生方是吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1910","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505959424458815"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1911","lineNum":1778,"lineType":1,"content":"力停爭戰又非宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1912","lineNum":1779,"lineType":2,"content":"煞中包煞是長生帶貴，則變煞為生，無吉則煞無變，非一煞占二官也。不在生年干頭及生年納音，全在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1913","lineNum":1780,"lineType":2,"content":"日時見煞，煞自長生，方可作吉。如一命庚子、壬午、辛巳、辛卯、癸酉胎，子午、卯酉，蛇頭開口四位全破碎在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1914","lineNum":1781,"lineType":2,"content":"己子，人刼煞在己，是四位煞聚於辛巳，金自長生。又一命乙巳、乙酉、己未、壬申，是壬申為亡神聚貴，又自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1915","lineNum":1782,"lineType":2,"content":"旺為權，故皆大貴。力停如戊午、丙子之類，兩邊皆旺，各自為主，相對相尅謂之戰，不勝者爭。故林開曰：力","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1916","lineNum":1783,"lineType":2,"content":"停爭戰，寡不敵衆，受降者得福，此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1917","lineNum":1784,"lineType":1,"content":"自生自旺自臨官，分散英靈氣不完。四弱一強方是福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1918","lineNum":1785,"lineType":1,"content":"迭為賓主便分權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1919","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505944744312869"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1920","lineNum":1788,"lineType":2,"content":"四柱中只要一位長生專旺，方可聚斂精神。若年月生旺，日時又生旺，謂之分散英靈，反主不貴。如癸亥、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1921","lineNum":1789,"lineType":2,"content":"戊午、丙子、己亥四位，各自生旺，迭為賓主，心性雖巧，只一術士。如一命壬寅、壬寅、庚辰、辛巳，納音三位金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1922","lineNum":1790,"lineType":2,"content":"同長生於時，是聚斂精神，故貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1923","lineNum":1791,"lineType":1,"content":"談命先須挑煞局，星辰要看主宫星。兩般強弱能分别，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1924","lineNum":1792,"lineType":1,"content":"禍福何愁斷不靈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1925","lineNum":1793,"lineType":1,"content":"煞局不多元百個，亡神刼煞皆為禍。若逢祿貴及長生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1926","lineNum":1794,"lineType":1,"content":"反煞為權聲譽播。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1927","lineNum":1795,"lineType":1,"content":"如無祿貴是奸頑，不忙不急足機關。更帶三刑作僧道，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1928","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505966319796264"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1929","lineNum":1798,"lineType":1,"content":"難和骨肉必傷殘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1930","lineNum":1799,"lineType":1,"content":"長生甲申並己亥，辛巳宜堪見丙寅。沙漠揚威奸膽破，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1931","lineNum":1800,"lineType":1,"content":"調羮鼎鼐廟堂人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1932","lineNum":1801,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申己亥喜長生，胎元凑足最為榮。四方四馬人聲價，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1933","lineNum":1802,"lineType":1,"content":"紆紫拖朱居帝京。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1934","lineNum":1803,"lineType":2,"content":"甲申、己亥、辛巳、丙寅四位，為眞長生，如是亡刼，更帶祿馬貴人同到，必主揚威沙漠。如一命乙酉、乙酉、乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1935","lineNum":1804,"lineType":2,"content":"酉、甲申，四水皆生於申，三貴又聚於申，自得長生，又在旬内，故大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1936","lineNum":1805,"lineType":1,"content":"煞神和主兩長生，富貴榮華莫與京。若有貴人兼帶合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1937","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505947281883176"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1938","lineNum":1808,"lineType":1,"content":"定知金殿玉階行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1939","lineNum":1809,"lineType":2,"content":"神煞自得長生。年頭納音，又隨神煞同長生，在於日時，謂之眞長生，又謂之生處逢生。如壬寅見辛巳，乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1940","lineNum":1810,"lineType":2,"content":"酉見甲申之類，主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1941","lineNum":1811,"lineType":1,"content":"凡是有權須帶煞，權星須用煞相扶。五行俱善無權煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1942","lineNum":1812,"lineType":1,"content":"即得權星命又孤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1943","lineNum":1813,"lineType":2,"content":"造物不能兩全，所以神煞無權，又不免刑尅多孤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1944","lineNum":1814,"lineType":1,"content":"一座亡神性機密，兩座亡神須決脊。三座亡神生不生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1945","lineNum":1815,"lineType":1,"content":"狴犴不亡終惡疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1946","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505971378077730"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1947","lineNum":1818,"lineType":2,"content":"亡神重於刼煞，以太過也。如壬子、丁未、辛亥、己亥，兩重亡神，決配貧薄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1948","lineNum":1819,"lineType":1,"content":"一重刼煞福胚胎，兩重刑法盜資財。三重㓙狠人頑惡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1949","lineNum":1820,"lineType":1,"content":"生不生兮命惡推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1950","lineNum":1821,"lineType":2,"content":"刼一重若帶貴，或自生旺，主發達，縱尅我，亦無害。若三重死絶無氣，必是賊徒，主惡死，如辛丑、丁酉、乙未、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1951","lineNum":1822,"lineType":2,"content":"戊寅，犯官司，後大發，如辛丑、戊戌、丁亥、壬寅，讀書及第，改官就祿。丁亥合起貴人故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1952","lineNum":1823,"lineType":1,"content":"有煞方能始煞財，我尅他時是福媒。煞自受降財自至，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1953","lineNum":1824,"lineType":1,"content":"不須祿馬貴人來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1954","lineNum":1825,"lineType":2,"content":"人命有亡刼二煞，始能煞財。大要我去尅煞為吉，煞來尅我為禍。若甲子見己巳福，見乙巳貧之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1955","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505944744362021"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1956","lineNum":1828,"lineType":1,"content":"盡說貴人能壓煞，亡刼多時依舊貧。自衰竊氣難憑貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1957","lineNum":1829,"lineType":1,"content":"煞㓙貴善又無功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1958","lineNum":1830,"lineType":2,"content":"如辛亥、庚寅、甲申、丙寅，緣亥寅六合合起，吞啖亡刼為㓙，故一生修讀，竟中風不第。若無貴人，決然惡死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1959","lineNum":1831,"lineType":2,"content":"又己巳、壬申、甲寅、壬申，刺配吏也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1960","lineNum":1832,"lineType":1,"content":"五行不用多神煞，刼煞臨官須早發。煞自為權三兩重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1961","lineNum":1833,"lineType":1,"content":"癆瘵身亡兼骨熱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1962","lineNum":1834,"lineType":1,"content":"重逢帝旺亦如然，七傷五癆下九泉。生刼重重人早死，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1963","lineNum":1835,"lineType":1,"content":"臨官帝旺尚遲延。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1964","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505975836704806"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1965","lineNum":1838,"lineType":2,"content":"如辛未、辛丑、壬申、戊申，早發而嘔血癆病。甲戌、庚午、戊辰、戊午，亦病纒身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1966","lineNum":1839,"lineType":1,"content":"日月逢徳禍必輕，煞來尅我也無迍。日時亡刼貪杯酌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1967","lineNum":1840,"lineType":1,"content":"只喜長生及貴人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1968","lineNum":1841,"lineType":2,"content":"日時帶亡刼全者，主貪酒色成疾，只宜藝術九流月日逢天，月徳縱有禍亦輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1969","lineNum":1842,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申己亥若逢全，長生不遇命難延。謀高膽大終遭辱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1970","lineNum":1843,"lineType":1,"content":"結果應無莫怨天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1971","lineNum":1844,"lineType":2,"content":"如韓平原壬申、辛亥、己巳、丙寅，如此大貴，不免斬首，常人必無結果。又禇冲夷翰林命：甲申、丙寅、壬午、辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1972","lineNum":1845,"lineType":2,"content":"亥、丁巳胎，辛巳年被禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1973","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505981427695653"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1974","lineNum":1848,"lineType":1,"content":"刼孤二煞怕同辰，隔角雙來便見迍。丑合見寅辰見己，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1975","lineNum":1849,"lineType":1,"content":"戌人逢亥，未逢申。初年必主家豪富，中主賣田刑及身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1976","lineNum":1850,"lineType":1,"content":"喪子喪妻還尅父，日時鬭凑不由人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1977","lineNum":1851,"lineType":2,"content":"丑見寅為例，謂之刼帶孤辰，主刑尅孤貧僧道，九流人庶幾。一命癸未、庚申、丙申、己亥，中年退散，喪身遠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1978","lineNum":1852,"lineType":2,"content":"配；一命己未、壬申，又見申時，却有貴人，不妨，但刑尅父母，無子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1979","lineNum":1853,"lineType":1,"content":"刼孤帶貴長生兼，便主威權福壽全。若不長生逢貴氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1980","lineNum":1854,"lineType":1,"content":"也應白手置莊田。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1981","lineNum":1855,"lineType":2,"content":"如辛丑見丁亥、壬寅者為官，見戊寅，先犯官司，後富。緣丁亥是臨官，又合貴力重故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1982","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505971378094114"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1983","lineNum":1858,"lineType":1,"content":"古老三命分強弱，刼煞亡神最㓙惡，聚衆攻身大不祥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1984","lineNum":1859,"lineType":1,"content":"不貧即夭塡溝壑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1985","lineNum":1860,"lineType":2,"content":"聚衆乃亡刼同八寡、隔角、破田、破宅、大耗、懸針等類。如己卯見庚申，癸卯見丙申尤甚，緣尅主也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1986","lineNum":1861,"lineType":1,"content":"亡神刼煞不宜全，莫教得黨尅生年。羅紋不戰也。㓙惡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1987","lineNum":1862,"lineType":1,"content":"生死榮枯在目前。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1988","lineNum":1863,"lineType":2,"content":"如癸酉、辛酉、壬寅、壬寅被牛觸出骨，病五日而後死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1989","lineNum":1864,"lineType":1,"content":"凡是㓙神莫尅年，尅年便主禍連綿。煞神各自分輕重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1990","lineNum":1865,"lineType":1,"content":"我尅他兮煞變權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1991","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505959424491583"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1992","lineNum":1868,"lineType":2,"content":"㓙神惡煞宜尅出吉神，貴人宜尅八。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1993","lineNum":1869,"lineType":1,"content":"大富大貴憑煞權，煞宜居後主宜先。單逢亡刼天元秀，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1994","lineNum":1870,"lineType":1,"content":"定亂安邦作大賢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1995","lineNum":1871,"lineType":2,"content":"如一命癸酉、庚申、丙子、丙申，酉為主在前；申為煞在後。庚申煞受制，丙申鬼病金旺，所以大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1996","lineNum":1872,"lineType":1,"content":"最㓙卯酉見寅申，卯見申兮煞帶針。破宅破田併大耗，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1997","lineNum":1873,"lineType":1,"content":"離居離祖更孤貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1998","lineNum":1874,"lineType":1,"content":"全見寅申必破家，平生造屋愛奢華。設居富貴應無久，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1999","lineNum":1875,"lineType":1,"content":"祖業非官火炬花。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2000","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505966319812648"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2001","lineNum":1878,"lineType":2,"content":"命宅祿宅不宜同亡刼，卯酉生人不宜見寅申，謂之破宅煞。若亡刼懸針，大耗隔寡在其上。見全寅申者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2002","lineNum":1879,"lineType":2,"content":"愛造屋費，若非官司抄没，必主燒毁。先富後貧，如乙酉、癸未、庚寅、甲申，女命纔嫁夫火燒其屋，因訟賣盡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2003","lineNum":1880,"lineType":2,"content":"田園而離祖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2004","lineNum":1881,"lineType":1,"content":"子午生人一例推，己亥那堪在日時。尅主更嫌他有黨，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2005","lineNum":1882,"lineType":1,"content":"耗財破產決無疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2006","lineNum":1883,"lineType":2,"content":"如戊午、癸亥、癸巳、甲寅。又甲寅胎是煞得黨，三次投軍，後作丐者。戊午、癸亥、癸巳、丁巳，一土制，二水火。復","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2007","lineNum":1884,"lineType":2,"content":"臨官，富足而孤離祖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2008","lineNum":1885,"lineType":1,"content":"上宫亡刼主刑妻，破碎臨官一例推。尅後依前婚室女，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2009","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505981427712037"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2010","lineNum":1888,"lineType":1,"content":"干生音助歲必低。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2011","lineNum":1889,"lineType":2,"content":"日為上宫，時為帝座，如見亡刼大敗，臨官帝旺，皆主尅妻。天干助生，納音又生，主再婚室女不然，或以妾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2012","lineNum":1890,"lineType":2,"content":"為妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2013","lineNum":1891,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人祿馬上宫加，妻必賢能内克家。更有食神兼帶合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2014","lineNum":1892,"lineType":1,"content":"腰如楊柳面如花。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2015","lineNum":1893,"lineType":2,"content":"上宫見祿馬，或貴人食神，必主妻賢内助。更兼六合合起，主得貌美成家之妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2016","lineNum":1894,"lineType":1,"content":"亡刼孤寡凑同辰，六親尅害必然眞。日上逢之妻愚樸，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2017","lineNum":1895,"lineType":1,"content":"時上逢之子未眞。更與三刑同位到，若非僧道主孤貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2018","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505944744394789"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2019","lineNum":1898,"lineType":2,"content":"亡刼，本孤，更値孤寡，三刑同位，決然難為六親。日上尅妻，時上尅子，必然妻愚子抝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2020","lineNum":1899,"lineType":1,"content":"凡處公門休帶煞，若逢亡刼便遭刑。計孛火羅臨四正，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2021","lineNum":1900,"lineType":1,"content":"千里徒流枉喪身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2022","lineNum":1901,"lineType":2,"content":"凡處公門，不宜見亡刼，日時全見，必主配死。如隔見有合，亦主徒流。更火羅、計孛守四正者，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2023","lineNum":1902,"lineType":1,"content":"祿馬嫌衝宜六合，煞神忌合喜刑衝。煞神遇合為㓙煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2024","lineNum":1903,"lineType":1,"content":"祿馬刑衝吉反㓙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2025","lineNum":1904,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲子、乙亥、己亥、己巳是合煞，被人殺死，如己亥、丙寅、甲寅、庚午。甲寅與己亥為雙合，若更尅身則早死，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2026","lineNum":1905,"lineType":2,"content":"今却不尅，五十二歲坐獄而死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2027","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505944744411173"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2028","lineNum":1908,"lineType":1,"content":"單逢刼煞或亡神，間有咸池及貴神。醫卜巫師或牙儈，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2029","lineNum":1909,"lineType":1,"content":"隨緣度日免孤刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2030","lineNum":1910,"lineType":2,"content":"日時單見一位亡刼，無貴人生旺而逢死絶之地，主貪杯好色，術藝人方可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2031","lineNum":1911,"lineType":1,"content":"回頭破碎煞非佳，煞反朝元禍不賖。酉丑兩宫攢煞轉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2032","lineNum":1912,"lineType":1,"content":"孤尅重重壽不遐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2033","lineNum":1913,"lineType":2,"content":"酉命人見寅申巳亥日時，丑命人見辰戌丑未日時，謂之回頭破碎。主狹猾命夭，受尅者不滿三十。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2034","lineNum":1914,"lineType":1,"content":"子午卯酉若逢蛇，受氣長生必拜麻。煞神死絶相攢聚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2035","lineNum":1915,"lineType":1,"content":"宜作屠行賣肉家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2036","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505947281932328"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2037","lineNum":1918,"lineType":2,"content":"如一命庚子、壬午、辛巳、辛卯，自中庭拜麻，而又出之，緣煞氣太重。如己卯、丁卯、乙卯、辛巳，殺猪屠户。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2038","lineNum":1919,"lineType":1,"content":"雙魚雙女主雙生，命入寅申孛計侵。男女兩途逢朔望，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2039","lineNum":1920,"lineType":1,"content":"望過一子一為陰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2040","lineNum":1921,"lineType":1,"content":"三刑隔角更空亡，華蓋重併主過房。必是雙生或庶出，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2041","lineNum":1922,"lineType":1,"content":"不然重拜兩爺娘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2042","lineNum":1923,"lineType":2,"content":"巳為雙女，亥為雙魚，以蛇有兩頭，魚有比目，故名。命帶己亥寅申戌立命，及火羅、計孛坐命，華蓋併於空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2043","lineNum":1924,"lineType":2,"content":"亡，三刑孤隔，多是雙生，不然庶出過房，或尅害父母兄弟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2044","lineNum":1925,"lineType":1,"content":"雙辰一煞最刑傷，干帶同干支帶雙。六害併逢亡刼煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2045","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505981427728421"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2046","lineNum":1928,"lineType":1,"content":"叢林之内禮空王。重拜偏生併寄養，男當鰥寡女居孀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2047","lineNum":1929,"lineType":1,"content":"只為重犯雙辰煞，更有平頭一例詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2048","lineNum":1930,"lineType":2,"content":"雙辰者，干支兩位是也，多主孤尅，如癸亥、癸亥、丙申、丙申，謂之亡刼。雙辰煞是一長老，如乙亥、丁亥、己卯、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2049","lineNum":1931,"lineType":2,"content":"丁卯，是一奴婢，如己亥、乙亥、丁酉、己酉，是一過房。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2050","lineNum":1932,"lineType":1,"content":"寡宿孤辰不可當，犯全送老沒兒郎。共活却宜三兩姓，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2051","lineNum":1933,"lineType":1,"content":"好為僧道守空房。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2052","lineNum":1934,"lineType":1,"content":"合空合刃合咸池，空主聰明刃狠愚。合刃羅紋身惡死，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2053","lineNum":1935,"lineType":1,"content":"官刑苟免主顚痴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2054","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505944744443941"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2055","lineNum":1938,"lineType":2,"content":"有大六合、小六合、大三合、小三合、華蓋雙合、單合、内合、外合、順合、反合。合空亡，主人奸巧。合羊刃更羅紋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2056","lineNum":1939,"lineType":2,"content":"重疉互換，主惡死，如乙酉、庚辰、庚辰、乙酉，非犯法，徒刑必破相。有疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2057","lineNum":1940,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池不合也風流，合起奸淫老不羞。有合更兼來尅我，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2058","lineNum":1941,"lineType":1,"content":"腸風消渴病為仇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2059","lineNum":1942,"lineType":2,"content":"咸池主腸風，干尅及納音尅，主消渴，如庚辰、己丑、辛巳、丁酉，一生最淫。以己、酉、丑三合合起桃花也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2060","lineNum":1943,"lineType":1,"content":"干頭帶合力還輕，三合應須辨淺深。順合也還觀反合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2061","lineNum":1944,"lineType":1,"content":"吉㓙禍福要詳明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2062","lineNum":1945,"lineType":2,"content":"如天干合，地支不合，為單合。戌命人時，日見寅午，為反合。禍福一般。斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2063","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505958711459851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2064","lineNum":1948,"lineType":1,"content":"亡刼不宜眞六合，有合還宜有貴人。不遇貴人兼尅主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2065","lineNum":1949,"lineType":1,"content":"他不殺人人殺身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2066","lineNum":1950,"lineType":2,"content":"亡。刼切不宜合，亦不宜尅主。如壬戌、癸卯、己亥、己巳，雖不合，却有己之陰土，尅壬之陽水。地支逢衝，故主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2067","lineNum":1951,"lineType":2,"content":"大㓙。又丁巳、壬申，天干地支，六合合起。巳刑申，酒色破家。一女命壬申年見巳巳日為娼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2068","lineNum":1952,"lineType":1,"content":"合貴之中更帶官，少年平步上雲端。合祿干頭兼得祿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2069","lineNum":1953,"lineType":1,"content":"三宫釣起福人看。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2070","lineNum":1954,"lineType":2,"content":"如辛未、己亥、丙午、戊戌，謂之合貴，又謂合官。少年請舉如辛未、辛丑、甲午、丙寅，早年入仕，緣為丙寅勝也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2071","lineNum":1955,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人尅入最為佳，祿馬如斯皆可誇。微尅更兼逢六合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2072","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505975836770342"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2073","lineNum":1958,"lineType":1,"content":"管敎富貴享榮華。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2074","lineNum":1959,"lineType":2,"content":"凡貴人祿馬宜尅我，謂之尅入。有尅而又帶合，斯至妙矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"2075","lineNum":1960,"lineType":8,"content":"子午卯酉四宫互換神煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2076","lineNum":1961,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池四位五行中，徧野桃花鬭嫩紅。男女遇之皆酒色，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2077","lineNum":1962,"lineType":1,"content":"為其嬌艶弄春風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2078","lineNum":1963,"lineType":1,"content":"子午卯酉占中天，咸池羊刃煞相連。甲庚壬丙人相遇，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2079","lineNum":1964,"lineType":1,"content":"慷慨風流醉管絃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2080","lineNum":1965,"lineType":1,"content":"凡是咸池多性巧，更主風流貌比華。性急又兼多業藝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2081","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505975836721190"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2082","lineNum":1968,"lineType":1,"content":"是非林裏反成家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2083","lineNum":1969,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池一煞號廉貞，逢水妖嬈主亂淫。沐浴進神仍見貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2084","lineNum":1970,"lineType":1,"content":"必敎傾國與傾城。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2085","lineNum":1971,"lineType":2,"content":"咸池煞，乃天之廉貞星也。凡命遇之，最不宜見水，主好淫，如更在沐浴之鄉，逢進神，傾國傾城貌也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2086","lineNum":1972,"lineType":1,"content":"倒插桃花色更鮮，日時月裏反朝年。風流倜儻人奸妒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2087","lineNum":1973,"lineType":1,"content":"性巧聰明賢不賢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2088","lineNum":1974,"lineType":2,"content":"如卯人見寅午戌月日時，酉人見申子辰月日時，反朝於年，謂之倒插桃花。主人性巧、聰明、性急，不能容","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2089","lineNum":1975,"lineType":2,"content":"事，多賢淑而有不賢處也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2090","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505947281965096"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2091","lineNum":1978,"lineType":1,"content":"錯亂咸池藝術人，休囚帶鬼最為眞。空亡生旺心偏巧，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2092","lineNum":1979,"lineType":1,"content":"能武能文罵鬼神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2093","lineNum":1980,"lineType":2,"content":"咸池主藝術，如在旺宫，必術藝精奇，高秀之士；如空亡帶鬼，無氣死絶，必村巫或粗工。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2094","lineNum":1981,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃咸池在日時，心靈性巧事多知。旺宫性急敗宫緩，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2095","lineNum":1982,"lineType":1,"content":"宿疾風流兼有之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2096","lineNum":1983,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲戌人見卯，謂之咸池羊刃，又庚申見酉，庚辰見酉之類，主人多學多能，未免帶疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2097","lineNum":1984,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池為性本邪淫，申子辰逢癸酉金。亥子水人情色重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2098","lineNum":1985,"lineType":1,"content":"恐躭花酒病傷心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2099","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505970627198988"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2100","lineNum":1988,"lineType":1,"content":"時日咸池一兩重，名為歲煞反招㐫。暴亡水火離鄉死，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2101","lineNum":1989,"lineType":1,"content":"咀咒瘟黄不善終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2102","lineNum":1990,"lineType":2,"content":"歲煞者即咸池，在日時主父惡死，屬火主火死，屬水主水死，屬土主瘟死，屬木主打死，屬金主刃死，各以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2103","lineNum":1991,"lineType":2,"content":"五行推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2104","lineNum":1992,"lineType":1,"content":"日上咸池帶旺神，陰錯陽差華蓋并。妻家惹禍兼裝醜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2105","lineNum":1993,"lineType":1,"content":"若不刑離誘外人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2106","lineNum":1994,"lineType":2,"content":"凡日上咸池，更有陰錯陽差，華葢破碎在其上，皆主妻不良，因妻裝醜受辱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2107","lineNum":1995,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人天上號文星，互換年時福氣深。四柱羅紋重疉見，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2108","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505971378143266"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2109","lineNum":1998,"lineType":1,"content":"重逢生旺侍楓宸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2110","lineNum":1999,"lineType":2,"content":"天乙貴乃天上至尊星也。若年與時上互換，見之則吉，更得生旺有氣為上。如丙申、己亥、辛未、己亥、辛巳、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2111","lineNum":2000,"lineType":2,"content":"丙申、壬午、壬寅，俱互換見貴，前命有氣為宰相，後命無氣為太守。又蘓東坡學士丙子、辛丑、癸亥、己卯，水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2112","lineNum":2001,"lineType":2,"content":"臨官於亥。太抵五行第一貴者，福氣為官，併根互換貴人；第二貴者，權煞為官，不可拜相；第三貴者，秀氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2113","lineNum":2002,"lineType":2,"content":"而已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2114","lineNum":2003,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人六合有陰陽，陰貴逢陽喜異常。若見羅紋兼有氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2115","lineNum":2004,"lineType":1,"content":"少年天府姓名香。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2116","lineNum":2005,"lineType":2,"content":"羅紋貴人，年時互換是也。甲見丑為陽貴，未為陰貴，如甲寅、辛未、癸未、戊午，合起陰貴，得女人財力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2117","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505999853109258"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2118","lineNum":2008,"lineType":1,"content":"進神白虎兼羊刃，歲煞懸針破碎同。誰識陰陽眞造化，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2119","lineNum":2009,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤感應自相通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2120","lineNum":2010,"lineType":2,"content":"子午卯酉有四個進神，四個羊刃，四個白虎，歲煞、咸池將星，兩個懸針破碎。乾坤造化，各主禍福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2121","lineNum":2011,"lineType":1,"content":"進神不可例言奇，中間妙理有誰知。進祿貴官方是吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2122","lineNum":2012,"lineType":1,"content":"敗家時日進咸池。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2123","lineNum":2013,"lineType":2,"content":"如辛未見甲子是進咸池，主孤貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2124","lineNum":2014,"lineType":1,"content":"進針進耗皆無益，羊刃咸池尤不吉。設逢天乙貴人臨，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2125","lineNum":2015,"lineType":1,"content":"起倒無成貪酒色。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2126","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505989254086692"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2127","lineNum":2018,"lineType":2,"content":"如辛未見甲午是貴而帶懸針。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2128","lineNum":2019,"lineType":1,"content":"進神入命本無益，翻作耗神尤不吉。若逢暴敗與咸池，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2129","lineNum":2020,"lineType":1,"content":"賣盡田園躭酒色。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2130","lineNum":2021,"lineType":2,"content":"進神懸針羊刃在日上，主生離死别，三妻之命在時無子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2131","lineNum":2022,"lineType":1,"content":"進神羊刃必遭官，日上屢敎歌鼓盆。時上號為埋子煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2132","lineNum":2023,"lineType":1,"content":"三刑同到入軍門。不入軍門身惡殞，遲早須當運限論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2133","lineNum":2024,"lineType":2,"content":"進神羊刃更帶懸針，暴敗三刑，必主因公得罪，入於軍門，不然惡死。如甲子、庚午、庚午、己卯，四十四歲㐫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2134","lineNum":2025,"lineType":2,"content":"死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2135","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505990881476619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2136","lineNum":2028,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎胎神氣象豪，木人癸酉便聲高。更逢羊刃兼飛刃，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2137","lineNum":2029,"lineType":1,"content":"罵殺時人口似刀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2138","lineNum":2030,"lineType":1,"content":"尅本如逢在日時，娶妻糊塗又刑妻。焦牙爆齒仍多口，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2139","lineNum":2031,"lineType":1,"content":"方許和鳴福壽齊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2140","lineNum":2032,"lineType":2,"content":"白虎煞即五行胎神是也，如庚申、庚寅之木，見癸酉日時之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2141","lineNum":2033,"lineType":1,"content":"陰錯陽差因孝娶，外祖兩重或入贅。不然決要尅其妻，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2142","lineNum":2034,"lineType":1,"content":"或者殘房來作壻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2143","lineNum":2035,"lineType":1,"content":"陽差陰錯不風流，花燭迎郎不自由。不是寒房因孝娶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2144","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505999853125642"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2145","lineNum":2038,"lineType":1,"content":"殘房入舍兩家仇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2146","lineNum":2039,"lineType":1,"content":"女人逢者亦依然，眞假公姑或續絃。否則有刑多寡合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2147","lineNum":2040,"lineType":1,"content":"外家零落是前緣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2148","lineNum":2041,"lineType":1,"content":"陰錯陽差煞最㓙，日時年月莫相逢。孛星若也臨高位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2149","lineNum":2042,"lineType":1,"content":"自作媒人兩三重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2150","lineNum":2043,"lineType":2,"content":"如丁亥、丁未、壬戌、癸卯，頭妻偏生女，半年而死，復娶一妻，如丙子、庚寅、丁丑、丙午，亦娶三妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2151","lineNum":2044,"lineType":1,"content":"陰錯陽差理更微，桃花帝旺莫相隨。惹起官司因婦女，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2152","lineNum":2045,"lineType":1,"content":"不因外祖便因妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2153","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505947281981480"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2154","lineNum":2048,"lineType":2,"content":"凡錯差會桃花煞在帝旺之位，准上文如庚子、己丑、辛卯、戊子三次招女人官司，如辛亥、壬辰、辛酉、壬辰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2155","lineNum":2049,"lineType":2,"content":"因女人官司破家，如癸亥、戊午、丙子、己亥，因女人起事，其驗如此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2156","lineNum":2050,"lineType":1,"content":"日時羊刃貼身隨，必主生離死别妻。互換懸針攢一處，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2157","lineNum":2051,"lineType":1,"content":"駝腰狗背免流笞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2158","lineNum":2052,"lineType":1,"content":"女子逢之必夭傷，投河自縊樹頭亡。如逢天月徳來救，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2159","lineNum":2053,"lineType":1,"content":"免得凌尸死血光。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2160","lineNum":2054,"lineType":2,"content":"日時羊刃主尅妻，若來尅身，主生離一妻死二妻，如丙午生見甲午之類，為貼身年月日之刃聚於時，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2161","lineNum":2055,"lineType":2,"content":"三處刃聚於日，准上文，如丙寅、丙申、壬午、戊申，十八割頸。又女命丙寅、甲午、丁亥、庚午，為有日煞，雖免自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2162","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505997944684571"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2163","lineNum":2058,"lineType":2,"content":"縊凌尸，却早生產死，終見血光。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2164","lineNum":2059,"lineType":1,"content":"古言羊刃只宜男，不怒而威性不忙。寛慓剛廉人梗槩，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2165","lineNum":2060,"lineType":1,"content":"管敎富貴享安康。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2166","lineNum":2061,"lineType":2,"content":"如一命庚戌、乙酉、乙酉、乙酉，帶三重旺氣，羊刃不併華蓋、咸池、懸針之類，主有權，作從化得局看，所以大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2167","lineNum":2062,"lineType":2,"content":"貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2168","lineNum":2063,"lineType":1,"content":"狼飡鯨飲是如何，羊刃重重亡刼多。計孛火羅臨四正，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2169","lineNum":2064,"lineType":1,"content":"只圖醉飽任風波。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2170","lineNum":2065,"lineType":2,"content":"四正，子午卯酉是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2171","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505989254103076"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2172","lineNum":2068,"lineType":1,"content":"神煞無多不易論，看他攢聚看他分。分開禍福皆分散，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2173","lineNum":2069,"lineType":1,"content":"聚煞攢㓙命不存。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2174","lineNum":2070,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲戌、丁卯、癸卯、丁巳，一生富足無子，謂之分散，不合太多，壽不滿五十，如丙寅、壬辰、丙子、甲午，謂之攢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2175","lineNum":2071,"lineType":2,"content":"㓙聚煞，貧賤早夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2176","lineNum":2072,"lineType":1,"content":"日中羊刃兼華蓋，只利妻先嫁一人。卒急寒房方免禍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2177","lineNum":2073,"lineType":1,"content":"貌如太美便風聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2178","lineNum":2074,"lineType":2,"content":"六巳生人見未日，若己亥、己卯、己未人得之，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2179","lineNum":2075,"lineType":1,"content":"煞神最喜落空亡，㓙煞空亡大吉昌。祿馬貴人還減福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2180","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505981427777573"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2181","lineNum":2078,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇相衝另一詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2182","lineNum":2079,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡生旺必聰明，死絶嘍囉語不眞。犯盡空亡空裏發，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2183","lineNum":2080,"lineType":1,"content":"空門藝術九流人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2184","lineNum":2081,"lineType":2,"content":"空亡遇相衝則不空，宜生旺，忌死絶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2185","lineNum":2082,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人祿馬事非虛，神煞權高首位居。祿馬煞神如得貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2186","lineNum":2083,"lineType":1,"content":"禹門級浪化龍魚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2187","lineNum":2084,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人祿馬在身宫，不帶空亡不帶衝。遇旺逢生多發福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2188","lineNum":2085,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花浪裏變魚龍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2189","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505966319845416"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2190","lineNum":2088,"lineType":1,"content":"休囚死絶均無益，衝擊空亡皆減力。任是侯門將相兒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2191","lineNum":2089,"lineType":1,"content":"只可隨緣度終日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2192","lineNum":2090,"lineType":2,"content":"如丙申、己亥、辛未、己亥是貴人，上帶長生，又煞在旬内，所以大貴，如己亥、庚午、庚午、壬午，祿太多而逢死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2193","lineNum":2091,"lineType":2,"content":"絶，所以為道。人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2194","lineNum":2092,"lineType":1,"content":"年月日時共一旬，還同兄弟一家人。若兼祿馬同旬内，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2195","lineNum":2093,"lineType":1,"content":"金榜揚名顯二親。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2196","lineNum":2094,"lineType":2,"content":"五行四柱皆在本旬，遇祿馬官貴則吉，遇羊刃破碎，則㐫秀而不實。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2197","lineNum":2095,"lineType":1,"content":"為人性快是如何，生旺臨官馬更多。待物接人多慷慨，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2198","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505970627248140"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2199","lineNum":2098,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池疎爽更嘍囉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2200","lineNum":2099,"lineType":1,"content":"勾絞三刑亡刼併，為人狡猾更沉吟。日時年月如重見，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2201","lineNum":2100,"lineType":1,"content":"内蘊機關似海深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2202","lineNum":2101,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲申生見乙亥、辛巳之類，主人奸巧，作事多詐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2203","lineNum":2102,"lineType":1,"content":"平頭一路占天干，羊刃懸針煞鬭攢。相尅相衝無旺氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2204","lineNum":2103,"lineType":1,"content":"披毛帶角畜生看。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2205","lineNum":2104,"lineType":2,"content":"天干一路是平頭煞，如丙午、丁未之類。地支重疉帶羊刃，懸針聚一位，傷主命必傷殘，不然畜生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2206","lineNum":2105,"lineType":1,"content":"戊庚多者定披毛，重疉元辰命不牢。計孛火羅如守照，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2207","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505997944717339"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2208","lineNum":2108,"lineType":1,"content":"馬羊猪犬數難逃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2209","lineNum":2109,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱刑胎父必傷，當於母腹便身亡。戊庚隔角平頭煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2210","lineNum":2110,"lineType":1,"content":"背指青天壽不長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2211","lineNum":2111,"lineType":2,"content":"凡四柱刑胎，有早尅父，不吉。凡有隔角平頭，三刑空亡，五行無氣，多是畜生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"2212","lineNum":2112,"lineType":8,"content":"辰戌丑未四宫互換神煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2213","lineNum":2113,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未為四印，戊己得之偏主信。甲乙若逢鄙且貪，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2214","lineNum":2114,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁或遇多貧病。庚辛格號母生兒，聚煞丑宫多短命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2215","lineNum":2115,"lineType":2,"content":"戊己屬土，遇四印為本宫，主信。甲乙逢之為財，財己入庫，主人貪鄙。丙丁得之竊氣，不貧則夭。庚辛為子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2216","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505971378176034"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2217","lineNum":2118,"lineType":2,"content":"歸母腹，或四位不全，在死絶之地，主人勾絞使術數，或聚煞丑宫多夭折。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2218","lineNum":2119,"lineType":1,"content":"天罡大煞占辰宫，大吉原來在丑中。小吉煞常居未上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2219","lineNum":2120,"lineType":1,"content":"河魁在戌定其踪。不知四柱四般煞，難定浮生吉與㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2220","lineNum":2121,"lineType":2,"content":"人命辰戌丑未全，更有别煞主孤尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2221","lineNum":2122,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱四衝皆有刃，三刑華蓋一般同。若逢丑未干頭貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2222","lineNum":2123,"lineType":1,"content":"金谷園中富貴翁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2223","lineNum":2124,"lineType":2,"content":"辰戌丑未四位，華蓋、羊刃、飛刃、墓庫、三刑若全帶，如甲辰、甲戌、辛未、己丑之類，未有不享福者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2224","lineNum":2125,"lineType":1,"content":"戌重見戌未見未，丑重見丑辰見辰。時上疉逢華蓋煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2225","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505997944733723"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2226","lineNum":2128,"lineType":1,"content":"男女空亡寂寞春。更有羅火孛與氣，若臨身命一般論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2227","lineNum":2129,"lineType":1,"content":"華蓋清閒藝術人，休囚生旺兩般論。文章醫卜兼師術，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2228","lineNum":2130,"lineType":1,"content":"九流僧道日時眞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2229","lineNum":2131,"lineType":2,"content":"華蓋喜於自墓及相生，乃可享清閒之福。否則僧道九流，如庚辰之類，不能自墓，只可村巫粗藝人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2230","lineNum":2132,"lineType":1,"content":"華蓋咸池兼帶鬼，不為巧匠便為師。鬼少五行兼有氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2231","lineNum":2133,"lineType":1,"content":"不頂黄冠便着緇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2232","lineNum":2134,"lineType":1,"content":"墓庫逢華福壽基，六親孤尅似華夷。日妻時子分輕重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2233","lineNum":2135,"lineType":1,"content":"官不封侯定可知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2234","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505981427826725"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2235","lineNum":2138,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲戌、甲戌、己未、甲戌是墓庫，逢華蓋，主享福眉壽。未免尅父母、刑妻子，尅我者重，合我者輕，爲官不至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2236","lineNum":2139,"lineType":2,"content":"封侯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2237","lineNum":2140,"lineType":1,"content":"前言丑位怕逢寅，戌人嫌亥未嫌申。辰人嫌巳為孤刼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2238","lineNum":2141,"lineType":1,"content":"祿貴臨兹是福神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2239","lineNum":2142,"lineType":2,"content":"刼孤二煞更帶長生逢貴祿尤好。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2240","lineNum":2143,"lineType":1,"content":"土旺辰戌并丑未，凡命逢之多性執。飛刃三刑同位見，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2241","lineNum":2144,"lineType":1,"content":"性惡性剛兼性急。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2242","lineNum":2145,"lineType":1,"content":"觀之外貌似溫和，怒髪衝冠奈觸何。若不刑妻併尅子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2243","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505970627264524"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2244","lineNum":2148,"lineType":1,"content":"因親氣血不調和。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2245","lineNum":2149,"lineType":2,"content":"辰戌、丑未屬土，所以性執不拘。單逢雙逢但有羊刃、飛刃准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2246","lineNum":2150,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃四宫三兩重，盲聾瘖瘂或腸風。三刑同位來傷主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2247","lineNum":2151,"lineType":1,"content":"不配應當不善終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2248","lineNum":2152,"lineType":2,"content":"既多羊刃，又有三刑，同來傷主，不但刑妻子，且不善終也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2249","lineNum":2153,"lineType":1,"content":"飛刃比和便主權，為人公議寡於言。剛方正大多欽仰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2250","lineNum":2154,"lineType":1,"content":"聲勢肥家遠近傳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2251","lineNum":2155,"lineType":2,"content":"如帶羊刃，不要尅我，仍不要他旺在強地。他弱則降我為福，他強我弱則禍。如甲寅水見辛卯木之類是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2252","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505970627280908"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2253","lineNum":2158,"lineType":2,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2254","lineNum":2159,"lineType":1,"content":"帶來飛刃并三刑，㓙狠強梁不可親。好殺好欺仍好武，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2255","lineNum":2160,"lineType":1,"content":"只宜他敗我生成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2256","lineNum":2161,"lineType":1,"content":"刑尅重重好過房，古言辰戌是魁罡。破祖離家方吉利，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2257","lineNum":2162,"lineType":1,"content":"只宜藝術與牙郎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2258","lineNum":2163,"lineType":2,"content":"辰為天罡，又為地網；戌為天魁，又為天羅。辰戌日時，未有不孤者也。中末年，只宜守己；如相尅，只宜藝術","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2259","lineNum":2164,"lineType":2,"content":"空門人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2260","lineNum":2165,"lineType":1,"content":"辰能合酉酉衝卯，辰卯之中六害生。未來合午午衝子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2261","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505996866797602"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2262","lineNum":2168,"lineType":1,"content":"子未之中一般情。不是過房隨母嫁，或為僧道或孤貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2263","lineNum":2169,"lineType":2,"content":"以上名暗六害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2264","lineNum":2170,"lineType":1,"content":"五行鬼煞看輸嬴，鬭戰伏降分重輕。他弱我強還得福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2265","lineNum":2171,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼強我弱便為㓙。鬼多只利術醫卜，空裏營謀事事成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2266","lineNum":2172,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼占強宫居旺地，洛陽花發又殘春。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2267","lineNum":2173,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼煞皆不尅身，及占強宫，要分戰鬭伏降。如鬼多，只宜九流敗宫。鬼多身居強位，纔發又不如意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2268","lineNum":2174,"lineType":1,"content":"無鬼不能成造化，無煞安能身有權。只怕鬼多兼煞衆，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2269","lineNum":2175,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫多吉少便為愆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2270","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505997944750107"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2271","lineNum":2178,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼強不可例言㓙，鬼伏他家受制功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2272","lineNum":2178,"lineType":1,"content":"格","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_129","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2273","lineNum":2178,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：伏降神内保","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2274","lineNum":2179,"lineType":1,"content":"恭謙，富貴福興隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2275","lineNum":2180,"lineType":2,"content":"貴人祿馬主溫和，神煞主猛烈。命中無鬼，不成造化，無煞不成權柄。但恐多則分秀氣，不為吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2276","lineNum":2181,"lineType":1,"content":"他來尅我我居強，我占強宫又不妨。鬼敗本強身富貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2277","lineNum":2182,"lineType":1,"content":"名高仍且壽延長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2278","lineNum":2183,"lineType":1,"content":"母生子廣母當虛，母占強宫又不虞。母旺子衰分四季，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2279","lineNum":2184,"lineType":1,"content":"九重城裏任安居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2280","lineNum":2185,"lineType":2,"content":"如金人見土為母，見水為子，如庚戌、乙酉、乙酉、乙酉、丙子胎，是金生四水，母生子廣，却喜子衰母旺而不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2281","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505981427810341"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2282","lineNum":2188,"lineType":2,"content":"為害。况金生八月，是得令之秋，煞不得地而身得地，子不能竊母之氣，故貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2283","lineNum":2189,"lineType":1,"content":"母分四季產嬰孩，子旺強宫母却衰。夏月木人逢火旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2284","lineNum":2190,"lineType":1,"content":"家徒四壁免㓙災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2285","lineNum":2191,"lineType":2,"content":"凡上生於下，乃脫氣不吉，如木命逢戊午之類。况是夏月，火復得時，乃子旺母衰，不貧則夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2286","lineNum":2192,"lineType":1,"content":"隔角三刑尅害多，直須離祖號行窠。自為自立方奇特，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2287","lineNum":2193,"lineType":1,"content":"骨肉仍敎内不和。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2288","lineNum":2194,"lineType":1,"content":"身體髪膚因父母，賢哲保身無毁傷。進退存亡能覺悟，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2289","lineNum":2195,"lineType":1,"content":"吉人㐫變作禎祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2290","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505996866830370"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2291","lineNum":2198,"lineType":2,"content":"右十二宫神煞，古人所重，然必以主本旺相休囚，五行生尅制化，本之以財官印食，參之以貴人祿馬，然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2292","lineNum":2199,"lineType":2,"content":"後看神煞輕重較量可也。若專論神煞，則誣矣。故取","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2293","lineNum":2199,"lineType":2,"content":"應天歌","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_130","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2294","lineNum":2199,"lineType":2,"content":"，以為三命之一助云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"2295","lineNum":2200,"lineType":8,"content":"戰鬭伏降刑衝破合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2296","lineNum":2201,"lineType":1,"content":"戰鬭為祥力兩停，兩邊相制始為榮。夫妻相稱仍和順，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2297","lineNum":2202,"lineType":1,"content":"平步青雲萬里程。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2298","lineNum":2203,"lineType":1,"content":"要知戰鬭福千鈞，四柱相停力不分。沙漠宣威聲萬里，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2299","lineNum":2204,"lineType":1,"content":"詞塲筆陣掃千軍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2300","lineNum":2205,"lineType":2,"content":"此戰鬭為福格也。凡五行不戰，則體常為主，遇戰鬭則迭為賓主。己巳癸酉。庚寅、辛巳，大林木懼。癸酉劒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2301","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505971378208802"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2302","lineNum":2208,"lineType":2,"content":"金日為主，主乃庚寅旺木，己巳林木，依附庚寅，自立為主，癸酉勢孤，不能敵也。又有辛巳金為之輔主，自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2303","lineNum":2209,"lineType":2,"content":"立為主，己巳主弱而疾寅強，癸酉金剛，辛巳又弱，強弱相等，兩邊力停，我尅者為夫，受尅者為妻，夫妻剛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2304","lineNum":2210,"lineType":2,"content":"柔相濟，所以戰鬭之中，反得福也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
