{"lines":[{"lineId":"2305","lineNum":2211,"lineType":1,"content":"五行遇戰主多更，相對相衝便鬭爭。鬭若不嬴翻作禍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2306","lineNum":2212,"lineType":1,"content":"力停須看兩相登。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2307","lineNum":2213,"lineType":1,"content":"刑衝戰鬭論輸嬴，四柱偏頗力不停。魚腹有災防溺水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2308","lineNum":2214,"lineType":1,"content":"鼠牙莫近恐遭刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2309","lineNum":2215,"lineType":2,"content":"此戰鬭為禍格也。一命壬午、己酉、己巳、壬申，楊木生秋月，白帝司權，金得勝之時，木極衰弱，己、申酉皆金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2310","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505989254168612"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2311","lineNum":2218,"lineType":2,"content":"局，况壬申金得土以滋其勢，己巳又合起壬申，為禍傷身，故三十八歲溺水而死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2312","lineNum":2219,"lineType":1,"content":"上宫刑月月刑年，鬼在休囚勢自偏。帝座若還仍尅日，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2313","lineNum":2220,"lineType":1,"content":"遞相關鎻福滔天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2314","lineNum":2221,"lineType":2,"content":"此伏降為福格也。如乙巳、甲申、乙酉、己卯、乙酉敗水生於甲申，而尅乙巳之火，火却不得其位，而水反勝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2315","lineNum":2222,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼得其黨，謂之鬼嘯。却喜己卯土，先破乙酉水，復制甲申，互換相制，不能為禍，反為吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2316","lineNum":2223,"lineType":1,"content":"伏降為福下刑年，帝座居強獨主權。心廣體胖膺百福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2317","lineNum":2224,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫榮貴慶雙全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2318","lineNum":2225,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲子、丙寅、甲申、辛未，是土制水，水制火，火制金，皆反為福，必主簪纓累代，福壽人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2319","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505996866863138"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2320","lineNum":2228,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼來攻我鬼居強，我弱之時，執力莫當。鬼煞兩般俱有氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2321","lineNum":2229,"lineType":1,"content":"不空有合最為殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2322","lineNum":2230,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼逢專旺擅強梁，身弱名為我反降。若遇空亡應免禍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2323","lineNum":2231,"lineType":1,"content":"如無援救命難長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2324","lineNum":2232,"lineType":2,"content":"此伏降為福格也。如一命辛未、辛卯、辛卯、己亥，鬼在強宫，却喜甲申旬金空亡，故雖不能富貴，亦無災禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2325","lineNum":2233,"lineType":2,"content":"未滿五十而死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2326","lineNum":2234,"lineType":1,"content":"母被鬼傷子來救，子報母寃排左右，破其鬼賊衝其刑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2327","lineNum":2235,"lineType":1,"content":"破鬼衝刑為福壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2328","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505989254184996"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2329","lineNum":2238,"lineType":2,"content":"此衝破為福格也。如戊午、癸亥、癸巳、丁巳、癸巳之絶水，歸於癸亥，冬月水勝之時，而尅戊午無氣之火，况","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2330","lineNum":2239,"lineType":2,"content":"巳為破祿，亥為破宅，合主貧賤。今喜丁巳土就身，尅退癸巳，衝破癸亥，乃子來救母，一生富足人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2331","lineNum":2240,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼煞來刑要帶衝，交相衝破却為功。文章獨步誇王粲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2332","lineNum":2241,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴雙全比石崇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2333","lineNum":2242,"lineType":2,"content":"如乙亥、乙酉、癸巳、癸亥，衝破其鬼，反為福，一生富而好禮，名冠鄉閭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2334","lineNum":2243,"lineType":1,"content":"破其祿馬破其庫，破了吉神無救助。神煞相殘破宅同，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2335","lineNum":2244,"lineType":1,"content":"作丐人間無限數。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2336","lineNum":2245,"lineType":1,"content":"墓庫中為祿馬殘，更衝命宅一般般。如無吉曜居強正，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2337","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505996866846754"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2338","lineNum":2248,"lineType":1,"content":"活計猶如一范丹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2339","lineNum":2249,"lineType":2,"content":"此衝破為禍格也。如鬼尅我，謂之傷殘吉神格，無救助。如戊午、癸亥、癸巳、甲寅，又甲寅胎三水歸依癸亥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2340","lineNum":2250,"lineType":2,"content":"而尅戊午之火，破了祿宅、命宅，乃溝壑亡神，醫桑刼煞，三次投軍，後作丐餓而死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2341","lineNum":2251,"lineType":1,"content":"刑煞落空兼有制，刑不入身為福會。同宫相制主得援，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2342","lineNum":2252,"lineType":1,"content":"得援附主為祥瑞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2343","lineNum":2253,"lineType":2,"content":"此制刑為福格也。如甲子、甲戌、甲寅、丁卯、甲戌，鬼落空亡，吞啖寡宿。空亡甲寅水尅退丁卯之火，不敢傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2344","lineNum":2254,"lineType":2,"content":"甲子之金，乃主得其援，反為福也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2345","lineNum":2255,"lineType":1,"content":"制刑得援要空亡，不尅身兮福祿昌。金玉滿堂人富貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2346","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505999853158410"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2347","lineNum":2258,"lineType":1,"content":"少年高折桂枝香。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2348","lineNum":2259,"lineType":2,"content":"如庚寅、癸未、壬戌、乙巳、甲戌胎、甲戌、壬戌同宫，水火相争，又喜甲戌歸於乙巳，不能刑於癸未，壬戌勢孤，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2349","lineNum":2260,"lineType":2,"content":"刑而不入，故主富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2350","lineNum":2261,"lineType":1,"content":"戰鬭刑衝為大敵，敵得勝時方是吉。投身如在鬼賊中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2351","lineNum":2262,"lineType":1,"content":"横死家亡刑憲及。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2352","lineNum":2263,"lineType":2,"content":"此，惹刑為禍格也。如辛酉、辛丑、癸酉、壬子、癸酉、辛酉，同宫戰鬭，刑於本身，就家降鬼，為鬼所制，被人殺死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2353","lineNum":2264,"lineType":1,"content":"惹刑為禍最非良，停力同宫盡鬭傷。身若就降降鬼賊，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2354","lineNum":2265,"lineType":1,"content":"難逃家破更身亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2355","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505989254201380"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2356","lineNum":2268,"lineType":2,"content":"力停者，一位不能刑，二三位刑一位，乃眞刑也。如辛酉、辛丑、己丑、乙丑，得己丑之火以救其禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2357","lineNum":2269,"lineType":1,"content":"十般六合少人知，自古神仙不泄機。祿馬貴人旬内合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2358","lineNum":2270,"lineType":1,"content":"合中添福福無涯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2359","lineNum":2271,"lineType":2,"content":"此六合為福格也。十般六合已解前，如甲寅、辛未、癸未、戊午，此為小六合，合起貴人，而得陰人之助，致富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2360","lineNum":2272,"lineType":2,"content":"貴福壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2361","lineNum":2273,"lineType":1,"content":"六合為祥一例推，合中增損為咸池。功名擬向為霖用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2362","lineNum":2274,"lineType":1,"content":"不謂雲行雨不施。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2363","lineNum":2275,"lineType":2,"content":"如眞得秀，戊戌、壬戌、壬申、癸卯，金不能勝，而木反勝。合中不喜咸池增損，又且尅身。咸池雖人聰明，畢竟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2364","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505996866879522"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2365","lineNum":2278,"lineType":2,"content":"是減福。又壬申傷木柱，無土救，是為合中減福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2366","lineNum":2279,"lineType":1,"content":"合來神煞便為㓙，神煞如何一様同。各煞各宫專禍福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2367","lineNum":2280,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼神催使不由人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2368","lineNum":2281,"lineType":2,"content":"此六合為禍格也。如己亥、丙寅、甲寅、辛未，甲與己合，寅與亥合，合起亡神，吞啖孤辰，故主枉死於獄，平日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2369","lineNum":2282,"lineType":2,"content":"喜訟之過也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2370","lineNum":2283,"lineType":1,"content":"六合為災不可當，官符亡刼一般詳。迷花戀酒并籠養，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2371","lineNum":2284,"lineType":1,"content":"好訟終身桎梏亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2372","lineNum":2285,"lineType":2,"content":"如庚子、丙戌、乙酉、丁亥，合咸池羊刃，平日不如人，而好武，好籠養，歌舞酒色。三十一，坐獄死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2373","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505971378241570"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2374","lineNum":2288,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺旺中生福慧，旺裏反宜鬼相制得制方為福壽人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2375","lineNum":2289,"lineType":1,"content":"一重方可為祥瑞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2376","lineNum":2290,"lineType":2,"content":"此生旺為福格也。如甲寅、癸酉、壬戌、庚子，其父為太平宰相，可謂腹中藏貴煞，胎裏叫官人，是生旺中得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2377","lineNum":2291,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼制是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2378","lineNum":2292,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺為祥在日時，鬼來制御却相宜。桃花直透三層浪，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2379","lineNum":2293,"lineType":1,"content":"桂子高攀第一枝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2380","lineNum":2294,"lineType":2,"content":"如乙酉乙酉、壬辰庚子，然庚子土自旺，又帶鬼尅身相制，是生旺鬼制之福，故主早年登第。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2381","lineNum":2295,"lineType":1,"content":"五行生旺不宜多，三兩重逢禍必過。旺裏若還無制御，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2382","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505990881542155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2383","lineNum":2298,"lineType":1,"content":"傅尸癆瘵面閻羅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2384","lineNum":2299,"lineType":2,"content":"此生旺為禍格也。如丁亥辛亥、己亥甲子，同官戰鬭，非惟貧賤，又且癆瘵，十六歲死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2385","lineNum":2300,"lineType":1,"content":"長生帝旺見重重，變福為災反不中。得鬼制他方減禍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2386","lineNum":2301,"lineType":1,"content":"縱饒富貴也招㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2387","lineNum":2302,"lineType":2,"content":"如己未辛亥、甲午辛未，少年廸功郎，出身未敗死亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2388","lineNum":2303,"lineType":1,"content":"死中得母絶逢生，富貴榮華别様新。廉簡直溫無燥暴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2389","lineNum":2304,"lineType":1,"content":"朱衣元是黑頭人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2390","lineNum":2305,"lineType":2,"content":"此死絶為福格也。如金人見戊寅為絶處逢生，見庚子為死中得母，見庚午為敗中有救，皆為福矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2391","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505971378257954"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2392","lineNum":2308,"lineType":1,"content":"人言死絶最為㐫，起死為生福反崇。深畧沉機人謹重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2393","lineNum":2309,"lineType":1,"content":"康寧福壽足盈豐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2394","lineNum":2310,"lineType":2,"content":"凡命死中得母，絶處逢生，敗中有救，主人沉機謹厚而享大福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2395","lineNum":2311,"lineType":1,"content":"死絶那堪鬼更傷，鬼居強位豈能當。若還祿宅皆衝破，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2396","lineNum":2312,"lineType":1,"content":"失業亡家死異鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2397","lineNum":2313,"lineType":2,"content":"此死絶為禍格也。如己亥、庚午、庚午、壬午，非惟木死於午，而祿死於午，賣盡田園，死於道路。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2398","lineNum":2314,"lineType":1,"content":"死絶重重鬼更逢，祿宫命宅併刑衝。若還四正無吉曜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2399","lineNum":2315,"lineType":1,"content":"定主伶仃别祖宗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2400","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505990881525771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2401","lineNum":2318,"lineType":2,"content":"如戊午、壬戌、癸亥、癸亥，非惟火絶在亥，而且破命宅祿宅，定是離祖人也。凡干支戰鬭，降伏刑衝破合，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2402","lineNum":2319,"lineType":2,"content":"神煞中之最要者，故併及之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2403","lineNum":2320,"lineType":1,"content":"三命通㑹","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00004_0_131","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2404","lineNum":2320,"lineType":1,"content":"卷三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505989254397988"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":3,"lineType":1,"content":"欽定四庫全書","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":5,"lineType":1,"content":"明","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":6,"lineType":1,"content":"萬民英","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":7,"lineType":1,"content":"撰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":8,"lineType":8,"content":"論十干坐支兼得月時及行運吉㓙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"9","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"甲木屬陽，乃棟梁之材，喜生秋冬，遇申子月為吉。柱見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛，譬斧鑿之論，主名利。運行申酉、辰戌丑未鄉，大能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"發越，見辛官尤妙。忌寅午戌合局，及透丁火傷官，乃辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506021021745206"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"苦勞力，作事無成之命，運逢亦不順。若合局丁透，柱有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未干，上露戊己，再行財運，傷官生財，却發大福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"乙木屬陰，為生氣之木，遇春生而花葉茂盛，亦喜生於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"小春之令。逢亥卯未、申子辰二局，更行北運，雖透丙丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛，亦不妨。所忌寅午戌火、巳酉丑金，多傷殘，再行南","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"運，主夭無疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506021021777974"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙日生人，身坐巳酉丑申戌金鄉，運行宜土金分野。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"若生寅卯辰，不結木局，宜時引歸土金分野，大貴。行運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"亦然，則官長遠。若生巳酉丑申月時，引歸亥卯未寅，取","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"貴非此時者，乃過與不及，却要運行水木局分野，否則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"貧儒。柱中原有財星，怕比刼分奪，原無財星不畏。如木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"得金而成器，仁者有勇，金得木而成材，勇者必仁，是乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"剛柔相濟，陰陽相停，運行却喜財官。若有木無金，則庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"辛虧而義寡，有金無火，卽勇而無禮則亂，金太盛而無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506021021761590"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"水則枯，木太多而無金則繁，是金木各不一也。偏陰偏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，難名之命，縱遇財官，亦不發達。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":39,"lineType":2,"content":"六甲日詩曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"建禄於寅是旺鄉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":39,"lineType":2,"content":"寅上甲木坐禄，金絶土死，財官兩背。見辛未時取貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"秋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"臨傳送鬼刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":40,"lineType":2,"content":"謂申中甲絶庚為煞，秋生鬼旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"戌中坐禄心懷善，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":40,"lineType":2,"content":"戌中辛有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":41,"lineType":2,"content":"餘氣，戊土正位，身坐財官，身被火焚，心多懐善。見丙寅時貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"辰位藏財性亦良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":41,"lineType":2,"content":"辰中戊己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":42,"lineType":2,"content":"入墓，身坐財庫，水氣發生，性多善良。見丙寅時貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"午喜己財天有赦，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":42,"lineType":2,"content":"午中己土建旺，丁火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":43,"lineType":2,"content":"傷官，有財無官，夏生為天赦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"子雖沐浴日無妨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":43,"lineType":2,"content":"甲木子上雖沐浴，子中癸禄旺坐生氣，印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":44,"lineType":2,"content":"綬冬生為天赦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"有吉為㐫㐫為吉，更㸔天時仔。細詳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505966319910952"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"六甲日用，辛為正官，庚為偏官，戊己為財，如年月時中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"透出戊己辛字，生三秋四季及金土局，財官有用。如不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"透出三字，只生三秋四季及金土局，亦作財官論，見甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"乙奪財，丙丁傷官，名利艱難。若生春夏及火木局，財官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"無氣，雖得滋助，名利亦輕，喜行西方四季金土分野，向","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"官臨財之運，不喜東南木火傷官敗財之地。若四柱庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"辛俱見，謂之官煞混雜，無去留制伏，反主貧賤。如只有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":54,"lineType":1,"content":"庚不見制伏，當作鬼論，分身鬼强弱，定其吉㐫壽夭，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506021021794358"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"制伏得中，作偏官論，太過反不為福。更㸔日干於所生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"月内有力無力，有助無助，分節氣淺深輕重言之。喜行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺鬼衰運，忌身衰鬼旺運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":60,"lineType":2,"content":"六乙日詩曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"卯宫得地禄榮昌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":60,"lineType":2,"content":"卯上金絶土死，乙木坐禄，財官無氣，庚辰時主貴，或類作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":61,"lineType":2,"content":"木局，主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"未上逢財是正鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":61,"lineType":2,"content":"未上乙木，本局有己土為財，丁火傷官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"亥内壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"居不失局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":62,"lineType":2,"content":"亥上乙木死，喜壬旺為生氣，印綬不失。木局見丙子、壬午、甲申時貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"丑臨官庫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"從夫吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":63,"lineType":2,"content":"丑金局，從夫化金為福，身坐財官偏印，為丑中有己土辛金癸水餘氣故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"已上金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"宫有化良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":64,"lineType":2,"content":"己為金局，須化金為福，但身坐正財，男主尅妻，女主妨夫，見壬水者輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"更㸔天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506000041885730"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"時併合局，吉㐫禍福細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"85","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"六乙日用，戊為正財，己偏財，庚為正官，辛偏官。若年月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"時上透出戊己庚字，生三秋四季及金土局，財官有用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"如不透此三字，生三秋四季及金土局，亦作財官論。見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙奪財，丙傷官，名利艱難。若生春夏及火木局，縱有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":72,"lineType":1,"content":"財官無氣，雖得滋助亦輕。喜行西方四季，金土分野，向","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"官臨財，忌行火木之地，傷官敗財。怕官煞混雜，有煞無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"制鬼，論制太過不及，皆不為福。更詳日干於所生月内，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505970627330060"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"有無力助，分輕重言之。運喜忌同上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

"content":"亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"中坐貴向官榮，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":124,"lineType":2,"content":"亥上日貴，中有壬旺，身坐官鄉，見壬寅時貴。己己為金神化氣，貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"太衝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"無氣財官背，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":125,"lineType":2,"content":"卯上。水死金絶，財官俱背無氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"小吉迎祥印綬生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":125,"lineType":2,"content":"未中有木餘氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":126,"lineType":2,"content":"財官雖背印綬，生身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"已近火宫身旺相，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":126,"lineType":2,"content":"南方火旺之地。財官受制，謂己中丙火奪財，戊土奪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506000041869346"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":129,"lineType":2,"content":"官故也。男妨妻，女妨夫。有戊者重，甲寅者輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"丑中金庫禄榮豐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":129,"lineType":2,"content":"丑中庚辛入墓，有癸水餘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":130,"lineType":2,"content":"氣，身坐財官見辛亥時貴。","logicSentenceId":" ":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"酉中坐禄最為强，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":255,"lineType":2,"content":"酉中木絶火死，財官兩背然。辛建禄最强，見戊子丙申時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":256,"lineType":2,"content":"貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"亥上身臨沐浴鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":256,"lineType":2,"content":"辛金生子，亥上沐浴，財生官絶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"未位暗丁身尅剥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":257,"lineType":2,"content":"未中木為財，丁為煞，巳為倒食，尅剥傷身，喜身旺化鬼為官。見丙申時貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"丑中藏癸食榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":258,"lineType":2,"content":"丑中有癸為食，無火木，財官雖背亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"卯臨財地衰無懼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":258,"lineType":2,"content":"卯上身坐財官，謂木旺生火，見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":259,"lineType":2,"content":"戊子時貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"巳坐金局死不妨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":259,"lineType":2,"content":"巳上身坐官印，謂丙戌建禄在己。辛雖死地有倚，見戊子時貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相死囚分月氣，更㸔有用細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505996866994210"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛日用甲乙為財，丙正官，丁偏官，柱中年月時透甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"乙，丙字生春夏及火木局中，財官有用。如不透此三字，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"生春夏及火木局，亦作財官論，見庚辛為奪財，壬傷官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"名利艱難，若生秋冬及金水局，財官無氣，雖得滋助亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"輕。運喜東南火木分野，向官臨財，不喜西北金水分野，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官敗財之運，怕官煞混雜，有煞無制鬼，論制太過不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"福。更詳日干於所生月内，有無力助，分輕重言之。運喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"忌同上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505997944881179"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"344","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"壬水屬陽，乃甘澤長流之水，能滋生草木，長養萬物，獨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"喜春夏生人，秋冬値令，則無生意。若見寅午戌官星，得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"生助之氣，名譽自彰。金局生八月，名利兩遂。水局生三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"月，為天德主貴，地支亥卯未，行南方運，發財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"348","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"癸水屬隂，乃大海無涯之水，不能生長萬物。一云雨露","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"潤澤之水，滋助萬物。喜春秋間，運行巳午戌地，發福非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"常。大忌辰戌丑未運，成敗地支亥卯未合傷旺，益財，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505997944930331"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"寅甲亦發名利。如見巳土丑未月，更帶三刑，平常衣禄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"初中未濟，終末榮發。若五行有救，身旺，運喜財官，亦主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"359","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸日生，坐下辰戌丑未，巳午為玄武當權，運行宜火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"土分野，過與不及，偏陰偏陽，則貴而不實。若生四季巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"午月，引亥子時，或冬生，引辰戌丑未巳午時，俱貴，非此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506012272541746"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"時虚名虚利。運喜金水分野，生助為榮，無金則水絶，忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"比肩刼財。冬十一月，三合結局，水漲横泛而土崩，故水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"無土則濫，土無水則乾，土得水而受潤通氣，水得土而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"成隄為河，二者不可偏倚，若更氣運得宜，無不貴顯，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"刑合拱合等格，不在此論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":300,"lineType":2,"content":"六壬日詩曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"寅宫旣濟最為竒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":300,"lineType":2,"content":"寅上水火旣濟。身坐財食生旺。見壬寅時貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"子位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"衝刑反是宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":301,"lineType":2,"content":"壬子日刃飛天禄馬，喜刑衝破害，子中已絶丙胎，財官無氣，取 ","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"卯為日貴坐學堂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":322,"lineType":2,"content":"癸卯為日貴，坐長生學堂。食神建旺，雖財官無氣亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505997944963099"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"己建財官最吉祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":325,"lineType":2,"content":"癸巳為日貴，身坐財官印生旺，謂己中丙戊建禄，庚金長生。得丁巳時貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"未上鬼傷因質朴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":326,"lineType":2,"content":"未上身坐偏官，偏財喜身旺化鬼為官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"亥中官背却榮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":327,"lineType":2,"content":"亥中丙戊俱絶，財官俱背却喜亥多衝。己中丙戊飛來就，癸，為財官禄馬之貴。若得癸亥時並衝方合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"酉宫得救方無咎，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":328,"lineType":2,"content":"酉中癸水衰敗，財官無氣。要通身旺月為貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"丑位雖衝不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"作殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":329,"lineType":2,"content":"丑中羊刃，有官無財，己土專位，七煞喜衝破刃神，不為灾咎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"憂不憂兮喜不喜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"月間休旺要參詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"421","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸日用丙丁為財，戊正官，己偏官，若四柱透丙丁，戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"字，生九夏四季火土局，財官有用，若無此三字，生九夏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505997944979483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"四季火土局中，亦作財官論。見壬癸奪財，甲傷官不利，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"若生春冬水木局中，財官無氣，喜行南方四季財官之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"運，怕煞官混雜，有煞無制鬼，論制太過㓙更詳。日干於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"月令内有無力助，輕重言之，運喜忌同上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"428","lineNum":339,"lineType":8,"content":"論十二月支得日干吉㐫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"429","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"子月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"430","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙日，得子月為印綬，喜見官露印，忌坐天財傷印。歲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"運喜忌同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506025329311759"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁日為官貴，隂陽和合，喜露財官見三合六合，官印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"合，須考月令中氣。身旺喜財官，身弱喜印旺，忌七煞傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"官。歲運傷為福之地，丁得之。偏官兩陰相攻，喜身旺有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"合制，忌身弱無合，露正官，及四柱帶多無制伏運，喜身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"旺合偏官，忌身弱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"438","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己日為財，喜露財，身旺，忌坐刃透比，不遇亥子日生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"難為財運，喜身旺與財，身弱喜旺，忌刼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"440","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛日為長生財，喜坐露財，身旺，忌無財身弱，如四柱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506021021892662"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"全無財星，便不是長生財，只是傷官背禄。月令須時帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"偏官，庚日丙時己時，辛日丁時午時，便為有制，吉。次宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"日，時帶諸不見之形，貴。如年日時三宫皆不遇，其命可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"知。行運身旺喜財，身弱喜旺通，忌比刼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"446","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸日壬為旺，癸為建禄，只是身强，奈名利二者却被","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":360,"lineType":1,"content":"月令銷鎔盡了，頗宜時帶偏官，貴，如壬日戊己時，癸日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"己午時是也。次宜日時帶諸不見之形，貴如年日時三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"宫皆不遇，其命可知。運喜行偏官，忌正官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506025329295375"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"丑月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":365,"lineType":2,"content":"交丑未，是丑，丑初只是癸，須是坐了丑，丑中方有己辛。小寒上旬上七日，癸水餘氣旺，或丑日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":366,"lineType":2,"content":"丑時，冬春生作水用，下八日作辛金用。大寒節皆是已上正位，或夏月四季月作土用，秋生作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":367,"lineType":2,"content":"金用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙日，得丑月為雜氣，官貴，喜官星透干，不透要衝，旣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"透怕衝運喜行財，忌官藏，無衝，官煞混及傷官，官愛多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"合。身旺喜財官運，身弱喜行旺地，忌煞傷。歲同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"458","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁日，為雜氣，財，喜財透干，忌羊刃比肩運，身旺喜財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"身弱喜旺通，忌刼財，若不遇申酉丑日生，難為財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506023907442725"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己日為餘氣財，月初小寒後七日半生有癸水餘氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"無比肩敗財，羊刃亦能發財，貴，如過期生丑中，無利無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"害，平平。日時二宫，能帶諸貴格，亦可發有餘氣。財貴者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":378,"lineType":1,"content":"喜財露身旺，忌財衰身弱。運喜忌同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"465","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛日為自庫之月，只得身强，少病多安，壽考。月令中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"更無物可採，頗宜時偏官貴，及帶日時諸不見之形，依","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"然發福。時偏官，庚日丙時己時辛日丁時午時，運喜行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"合偏官，忌正官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505999182020642"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸日為雜氣，印貴，喜透印見官，及刑衝，忌印伏運，宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"行官印之地，忌財傷印，餘同前論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"472","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"寅月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":387,"lineType":2,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00005_0_2","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":387,"lineType":2,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00005_0_3","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":387,"lineType":2,"content":"艮","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00005_0_4","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":387,"lineType":2,"content":"巽","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00005_0_5","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":387,"lineType":2,"content":"，四維在地，月令在天，不管四維，纔立春便有寅有甲，不必拘泥於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":387,"lineType":2,"content":"艮","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00005_0_6","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":387,"lineType":2,"content":"時辰，論分野則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":388,"lineType":2,"content":"有之，餘巳申亥同此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"481","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"甲日得寅建禄，乙日旺相，月令中無格可取，只利得身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"旺年久，頗宜帶時偏官，及日時諸不見之形貴。時偏官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"者，甲日庚時申時，乙日辛時酉時，如年日時三宫無格","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"可取，終身可知。有偏官者，喜行合偏官運，忌正官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505997944995867"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁日為印貴，喜坐官露官，再露印星，忌露財，宜行官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"印運，忌財傷印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"488","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"戊日為偏官貴，兩陽相攻，喜身旺，忌身弱偏官，有合莫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"制，無合要制運，喜身旺，合制忌身弱正官及再行煞鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"己日為正官貴，陰陽和合，喜坐露財，再露官星，三合六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"合，身旺，忌七煞傷官，官愛明合，身旺，喜行財官，身弱喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，忌七煞偏官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"516","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸日為長生財。喜坐露財，如柱無財，便不是長生財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"只是傷官背禄。月令頗宜帶時上偏官，如壬日戊時己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"時，癸日己時午時，須是帶諸不見之形貴運，身旺喜財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"身弱喜旺，帶偏官者，喜合偏官，忌刼財正官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"520","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"辰月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":431,"lineType":2,"content":"交辰末，是辰，辰初只是乙，須是坐了辰，方有壬癸水。清明上旬七日半，乙木餘氣旺，或辰日辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":432,"lineType":2,"content":"時作乙木論，下八日作癸水論，穀雨節皆是戊上正位。若秋生，辰日辰時作水論，四季作土用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506012272590898"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙日生，辰月為雜氣印。喜見官星及印露不露要衝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"旣露怕衝，忌見財，多傷印運。喜忌同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"526","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁日，為雜氣官。喜官透不透要衝見財，身强發福，忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"官伏無衝及煞傷運，身强喜財，官弱喜旺，忌煞傷。同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己日為雜氣財。喜財露旺，不露要衝，忌財伏無衝，坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"刃比肩，不坐亥子辰日，難為財運，身旺喜財弱喜旺，忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"刼。同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"531","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛日為餘氣財貴，清明後七日半，有乙木餘氣，方可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505999853256714"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"發。如月初生，無比刃奪財，皆可發，過期則辰中無利無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"害，平平。如日時帶諸貴格，亦發運有餘氣財，身旺喜財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"地，忌身弱刼地，財衰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"536","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸日為自庫，只是身强少疾，月令無貴可取，頗宜時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"上偏官，及日時諸不見之形貴，依然發福，勿拘月令運，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":450,"lineType":1,"content":"如時偏官者，喜行合制，忌行正官傷官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"巳月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"540","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙日，得巳月為財貴，不生於巳午日，難為財，亦名長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506021021925430"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"生財貴。戊土露則財星愈光，丙火露則傷神益壯，喜身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"旺財露，忌坐刃露比運，身旺喜財，身弱喜旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"544","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"丙日建禄丁旺相，丙子生，巳月無可取用為福，只是身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"旺年長，頗宜時帶偏官，及日時之貴格。又丙丁己月亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"是長生財貴，要財露，如不露，只是傷官背禄。月令是長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"生財，喜行財運，帶偏官，喜合運，忌刼財正官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"548","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己日為印，亦是建禄，何以别之？只年月時露，丙火為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"印，丙不露，更有壬癸字者，只是建禄印綬貴，喜露官星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505999182053410"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"及行官印之地，忌傷官印。如建禄時宜帶偏官，喜自身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"强旺，運宜合偏官，忌正官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"553","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日為偏官，貴印與同宫，喜身旺合制，有合莫制，忌身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":468,"lineType":1,"content":"弱無合，正官運亦同論，忌再見偏官，全無制多夭，獨庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"申日則不然，何者？己中有土能生金，金旣長生，又自坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"禄，何夭之有？更㸔壬露無丙，癸露無丁，甲露戊衰，乙露","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"己病之機，何如？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"620","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日為建禄，辛為旺相月令，别無可取為福，只是身强","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"年長，頗宜時帶偏官，有合莫制，有制莫合，運忌正官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"622","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸日為印，喜露官透印，忌財，運亦如之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505990881738763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"酉月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"625","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"甲日，酉月為正官，喜身旺，露官見財，三合六合，忌七煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官，官愛多合。運，身旺喜財，官弱喜旺，忌七煞傷官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"乙日得酉月為偏官，喜身旺，有合莫制，有制莫合，忌身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"弱正官，運亦如之，再忌見七煞運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"629","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁日為財，喜身旺，露財，官，三合六合，忌刑衝破害比","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"肩刼財。運，身旺喜財，身弱喜旺，忌刼奪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"631","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己日為長生財，如柱中不帶財露，便不是，只是傷官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506019390160907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"月令頗宜時帶偏官及諸貴格。偏官格喜合制運，身旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"喜財，身弱喜旺，忌刼財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"635","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日為旺相，辛日為建禄。月中無物可取，只是身旺年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":558,"lineType":1,"content":"長，頗宜時帶偏官及日時諸貴格，有偏官喜合或制，忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"正官，運亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"638","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸日為印，喜露官透印，忌財，運亦如之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"639","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"戌月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":561,"lineType":2,"content":"寒露上旬，上七日辛金餘氣旺，或春生戌日戌時作火論，下八日生作丁火，用霜降節，皆是戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":562,"lineType":2,"content":"上正位，或夏生四季生作土用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506000042016802"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙日，戌月為雜氣財，喜生旺，財透不透要衝，忌財伏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"無衝，比肩羊刃運亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"645","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁日為自庫月，亦主身旺年長，戌中無物可取為福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"只宜時帶諸貴格為妙，運亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"647","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己日為雜氣印，喜正官，印透，不透要衝，忌印伏無衝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"有財傷印運忌傷官傷印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"649","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛日為雜氣官，貴，要身旺印全，如官透衝，則用官貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"印透衝則用印貴，不透要衝，忌官伏無衝，官愛多合運，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506019390259211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺喜財官，身弱喜旺，忌七煞傷官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"653","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸日為雜氣財，要身旺，財官雙全為貴。財透衝則用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"財，官透衝則用官。不透要衝，忌財伏無衝運，身旺喜財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"身弱喜旺，忌刼奪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"亥月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"657","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙日，得亥月為印，喜露官透印為福，忌財，運亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"丙日為偏官，有合莫制，有制莫合，喜身旺，忌身弱。正官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"歲運同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506025329393679"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"丁日為正官，喜透財露官，身旺，忌七煞傷官，多合運亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"663","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己日為財，要財露身旺，忌羊刃比肩，身弱，運亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛日為長生之財，如柱中全無財露，只是傷官背禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"月令頗宜時帶偏官，日時諸貴格，喜財露自旺，忌無財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"身弱運亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"667","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸日，壬為建禄，癸為旺相，福無可取，只是身旺年久，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"頗宜時帶偏官，及日時諸貴格。如得時偏官，運喜行合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505990881787915"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"偏官，忌正官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"671","lineNum":596,"lineType":8,"content":"論五行時地分野吉㓙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"672","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"按王氏所謂二氣者，陰陽也；五行者，金、木、水、火、土也；時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"者，春、夏、秋、冬也；地者，冀、青、兖、徐、揚、荆、梁、雍、豫也。蓋天有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽，行於四時，地有五行，具於九州。正朱子所謂五行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"質具於地，氣行於天，故天有春、夏、秋、冬，地有金、木、水、火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"皆以時地相為用也。今之談命者，但知論陰陽五行，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"不知兼論方隅，與晝夜陰晴所以有年日月時同，而貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505990881771531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"賤壽夭逈異，便謂五行無據，啟世人不信命之疑，亦誣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。嗟夫！人生天地，莫迯五行，九州分疆，風氣異宜，陰晴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"寒暖，理難一律。人禀天地靈氣以生，一時得氣，各自不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"同，所以貴賤壽夭，難以八字拘也。且以甲乙寅卯屬木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"生於兖青為得地，春令為得時。丙丁巳午屬火，生於徐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"揚為得地，夏令為得時。戊己辰戌丑未屬土，生於豫州","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"為得地，四季月為得時。庚辛申酉屬金，生於荆梁為得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":612,"lineType":1,"content":"地，秋冬為得時。壬癸亥子屬水，生於冀雍為得地，冬令","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506019390193675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"為得時。况晝夜陰晴之間，有寒有暖，陰陽造化之内，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"喜有忌。生尅制化，抑揚輕重，妙在識其通變，不可執一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"論也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"691","lineNum":618,"lineType":8,"content":"論木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"692","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"正春木，令木也，晴則花葉敷榮，雨則寒其萌蘖。正月生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"者，雖三陽交泰，寒氣未除，見火則生意藹然，富貴無敵，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"火多泄其元氣。徐、揚人晝生者疾，火土同躔，富而且貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"有土無火，僅足衣資而已，逢金折傷之患，得火制之為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506012272640050"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"福，見水不為子母相生，蓋初春之木，纔有生意，見水則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"寒，反不為吉。冀、雍生者貧寒，男濫而女滛也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"699","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"二月之木，生意暢茂，遇土培植為佳，火土同行，富貴而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"壽，火盛亦泄其氣，蓋花木始含英，而眞陽發散故也。兖、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"青人富貴無虞，徐、揚人美中不足，干支有壬癸亥子者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":630,"lineType":1,"content":"咎也。見水生之太過，情性流蕩，離祖遷居，土金水㑹，夭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"折無疑，賤貧而壽，逢金伐之，旺處遭傷，斨其生意，豈天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"地生物之至仁耶？先正有云，春木雖旺，不宜逢金者，此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506021021974582"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"707","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"三月之木，正條達長茂之時，春陽和照，萬紫千紅，雨水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"浸滛，根株摇動。見土，則根深蒂固，福壽綿延；見火，則木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"通火明，文章秀發。逢金伐木，荆梁生者㐫。徐揚之人，富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"貴喜火土，忌金、水，運喜東南西北，不利夏木病已死午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"墓未者，蓋南方火盛，泄其眞氣故也。陰雨則吉，亢晴則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"713","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"四月木未甚衰，火未甚旺，見㣲火，則枝葉茂繁，蔭庇發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506019771842571"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"福；値盛水，則水神飄蕩，男女滛奔；見土，利就名成。火土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"同躔，干支有壬癸亥子者，富貴，逢金尅之，灾訟不免，徐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"揚人反吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"718","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"五六月之木，喜雨水，夜生尤竒，値此者，富貴而壽，火盛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"無水者，貧夭。夏令炎威火盛，爍石流金，木有枯槁之患。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚人干火多者，有瘋癆熒燎之㓙，或水制，或夜生，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"陰雨，天化㓙而為吉矣。得土以培其根，得水以達其枝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"若水土同行，非惟富貴，且壽考康寧矣。見金不能尅木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505999853305866"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"火旺金柔，有子復仇故也。若小暑以後，土多亦忌，蓋衰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"木不能尅旺土也。兖、青生者為財。大抵夏木喜水，與他","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"時不類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"727","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"秋三月之木，惟欲晴雨得宜，亢旱則物皆枯槁，滛雨則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"物不収成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"729","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content":"初秋之時，炎威未退，不宜與火同行。陰雨生者最妙。見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"金雖有剥刻之嫌，然火氣尚炎，金氣未盛，不為害也。處","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":662,"lineType":1,"content":"暑以後，荆、梁生者忌之。金水同行，化㓙為吉，逢土培植，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506019771858955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"利就名成。水盛無土，冀、雍飄蕩無居，徐、揚人反㓙成吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"八、九月之木，正凋零之時，畫火同躔者貧夭，蓋秋陽燥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"烈，木皆枯落故也。或夜生，或隂雨，或水觧之方吉。兖、青","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"人文章富貴，見水有漂流之患，蓋秋水非滋木之時也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"冀、雍人尤忌。得土栽培，根基穏厚。見金反吉，蓋金司令","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"則萬物摧落，旣無長養以遂其生，又未歸根以復其命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"所可借者在一金耳。苟無金制以成其器，則為天地間","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"一朽木。此所以仗斧斤之力，斵削成器，而為棟梁之用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506019390242827"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"正所謂斧斤以時入山林，材木不可勝用也。氣運宜徃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"東方，南方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"744","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"冬木正肅殺之時，復命歸根，㣲有小春生意，以見造化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"無終窮之理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00005_0_7","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"曰碩果不食者，此也。生於晴明者最佳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"値陰雨則凝氷積雪也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"749","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"十月之木遇火貴而有壽，蓋氷寒土凍，仗火以温暖其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"根故也。火土輔運，富貴雙全，見金雖無害其根本，未免","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"骨肉参商，得水則有滋助之意。徐、揚人利就名成，冀、雍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505999853338634"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"人貧寒孤尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"754","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"若子丑月之木，喜火融之，與土同躔，位登台鼎，見水㐫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"尅。蓋冬水令也，木寒木也，冬木遇水而寒，無火温之，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"氷凝凍合，而生意摧折矣。貧賤者壽，富貴者夭，見金雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"傷不害。蓋木任冬令，歸根者斧斤無所施，凋零者斵削","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"可成器，所以見金而無咎也。徐、揚、兖、青生者有隕自夭，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"荆、梁、豫人雖忌，亦不過枝葉之傷耳，其本根則自若也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"干支得丁丙相制者，却能富貴，豈獨免禍而已。氣運宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506023907541029"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"徃南方，冬木喜南奔也，東方次之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"763","lineNum":696,"lineType":8,"content":"論火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"764","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"三春之火，其氣温然而始著也，晴則借木而明，雨則濕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":698,"lineType":1,"content":"木而晦。正月㣲陽之火隠於木中，雖有可親可愛之意，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"但氷霜之氣未消，遇木生之，則陽氣發揮矣。逢金為財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚人富而好禮，金木同行，官居鼎鼐，逢金値水，夭折","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"無疑，荆梁冀雍之人尤甚。見土，盗泄㣲陽，浮薄卑賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"二月見木，敗處逢生，木秀火明，文章富貴人也。但不宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506023907573797"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"有水，蓋濕木不生，無燄火也。穀雨之後生者，㣲水無㐫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋土司時，木主令，化㓙而為吉也。兖青徐揚生者，富貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"何疑。土與金，正月同論，但辰月土差旺耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
