{"lines":[{"lineId":"774","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"夏令之火，陽氣之極，草木為之焦枯，江河為之枯涸，晴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"則流金爍石，眞陽盡泄，雨則水濟其威，方得中和反應，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"蔭庇發福。四月火勢漸盛，逢日争光，未能全其忠愛，雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴亦主夭亡，貧寒者壽而多子，孤獨艱辛。見金名成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"利就，逢土有權有謀，遇木富而好禮，㣲水濟木，其貴不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506000042049570"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"可言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"781","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"五六月生者，火炎之極，得水制之，則都將相。惟冀、雍生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"人，水不宜盛，蓋旺火投於盛水，不能不傷故也。得土制","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"木觧，則富貴過人矣。見土畧洩其盛，而有權衡之貴，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"好施惠及人，但施恩而反怨耳。蓋火能生土，亦能燥土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":720,"lineType":1,"content":"故也。見木生過反傷。青、兖、徐、揚人，根基雖富，難免夭亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"冀、雍、荆、梁人，富而益富，遇金為財，火爍金流，反有破財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":722,"lineType":1,"content":"蕩家之患。水土同行，名成利就，日戰月刑，忠孝有虧，㐫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506019390275595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"禍孤尅夜生减輕氣運，宜徃西北南東，大忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"790","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"秋初之火，炎威未退。土傳生氣，水不能尅，反主貴榮，見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"木助之。徐、揚、兖、青人，干支火多者，雖富貴而壽不永。見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":728,"lineType":1,"content":"金為財，富貴豪侈，逢土則息，顯達非常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"793","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"八九月失時之火見木，生生之意無窮，富貴無敵。金木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":730,"lineType":1,"content":"同躔，官居宰輔，有金無木，主弱敵强，不免有争攘之事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"冀、雍、荆、梁人，因財致禍，與土同躔，泄其眞元，孤刑冷退，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"得木助之，斯為美矣。見水㐫夭，運喜東南西北忌之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506019771908107"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"冬月之火，人多親之，晴霽則明，陰雨則㓕，故見水為㐫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"木生為貴。有水無木，輕者疾，重者夭，雖生富厚之家，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"免冷退。徐、揚、兖、青人，得水制之無咎，逢土泄之，弱中又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":738,"lineType":1,"content":"弱，蹇滯終身。小寒之後，旺土晦其光明，定主昏愚瞽目。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"見金為財，青、兖、徐、揚人主富，荆、梁、冀、雍人助難為㓙，謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"金之子水也。克其母子，則乘勢報仇。無木觧之，有刀兵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"獄訟之厄，腫痢没溺之㓙。干支木盛者减輕。大抵冬火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"喜木忌水，運宜東南西北，大忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506012272672818"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":745,"lineType":8,"content":"論土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"808","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"土値春時，土膏脉起，萬物含生，木氣發泄。前哲所謂病","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"寅死卯墓辰者，良有以也。雨則陰凝，土濕而萌甲不舒；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":748,"lineType":1,"content":"晴則凍釋，陽和而生意發越。故春令之土，一接陽氣，就","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"能發育萬物。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"812","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"正月之土，尚有霜寒，遇雨則凍，遇水則氷，値木則病，惟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"得火以温之，則榮華莫比。逢金制木，亦名利兩成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":752,"lineType":1,"content":"二月之土，正木盛土崩之時。遇木同躔，有脾胃、腸風、痔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506023907557413"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"漏之灾，輕者疾，重者夭。徐揚人干支有火，而値晝晴者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":756,"lineType":1,"content":"無咎。見火同躔，位登台鼎；見水則脉，冀、雍、青、兖人土渾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"水濁，終有水湧土潰之危，蓋水生旺木而傷土也。値此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"者，貧寒疾夭。徐揚、豫人干支火者反吉。見金以泄土氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"難免灾㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"821","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"三月之土，漸有生意，蓋土旺季月故也。有火温燠，則陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"氣發舒，而生物茂矣。見木，非疾則夭，徐揚豫人無害。水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":762,"lineType":1,"content":"木同度，貧薄無聊，冀、雍、兖、青人尤甚。見金制木，反㐫成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506019771924491"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"吉運。喜南方、西方次之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"826","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"土旺長夏，火盛土生之故也。陰雨則濕養萬物，故見水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"為吉；亢旱則田疇龜坼，故遇火為㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"828","lineNum":768,"lineType":1,"content":"孟夏之土，炎氣未盛，終喜火以助之，逢木則疾夭無疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"見水為財，徐、揚人富足，見金遇木則貴，逢水則貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":770,"lineType":1,"content":"五六月之土，見火則燥，而萬物焦枯，徐、揚人干支火盛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"者，有火焚風血之災，輕者危，重者死，或陰雨，或夜生，雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":772,"lineType":1,"content":"災不甚。冀、雍人干支有壬癸亥子者，富貴非凢。見水滋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506023907606565"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"養萬物，主富貴文章，見木疏通，其性多聰明特達。遇金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"無用，蓋火盛金衰，不能制木，所以金無用也。氣運宜行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"西北，最忌南方，蓋夏土逢火太燥故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"837","lineNum":778,"lineType":1,"content":"土逢秋令，金氣盛旺，泄土而氣薄矣。晴雨須要得宜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"七月之土，火氣未除，土性尚燥，喜水滋之，則萬物實矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"若火太盛，亦有燥土之嫌，得水濟之為妙。逢木為灾，徐、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"揚、荆、梁人無忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"841","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"八九月之土，見木則不能尅，此萬物凋零之時，金氣生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506023907590181"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，子復母仇，荆、梁、徐、揚人富貴而壽。見金泄氣太甚，西","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"北人不免有冷退怯弱之患。見火助之，文武名高，君子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"小人皆吉。見水為財，徐揚、豫人富而無敵，冀、雍、荆、梁人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"水過盛者，反主貧薄。戌月僅可運喜火土之鄉，水木金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"方有忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"848","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"土於冬也，正天地肅殺之時，寒亦至矣。雖一陽下生，土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":791,"lineType":1,"content":"脉未温，値水雪則氷寒土凍，見火日則寒谷回春。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":792,"lineType":1,"content":"十月之土，惟喜火以温之，則土脉陽和，而萬物歸根矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506000042098722"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"見木則㐫，逢金則滯，遇水則主孤寒。徐揚人干支火多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"者可富，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"854","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"子丑之月，寒氣之極，火日融和，功名成就，見木最忌，見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"火觧之為吉，見水則陰氣愈甚，水寒地凍，輕者疾，重者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"夭，見金亦主貧薄。歲運南方最佳，北方大忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"857","lineNum":800,"lineType":8,"content":"論金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"858","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"春日之金，木旺火相，非金得氣時也。絶寅胎養於卯辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"者，蓋造化無終極之理也。是以春令之金晴明吉，陰雨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505999182135330"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"則滯，正宜遇土以生之，謂其將絶而有生意耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"862","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"正月之金，見木為財，木神太旺，僅足衣資，土氣尚寒，未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"能生助，藝術顯名而已。火若同躔，男女重婚重嫁，見火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"遇土，富貴非常，逢水泄之，孤寒懦弱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"865","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"二三月之金，見土則生生之意無窮，主人富貴而壽，逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":810,"lineType":1,"content":"水泄其元氣，亦主貧薄無情，見火則囚金遇鬼，貧夭無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"疑。土生水制為吉，見木而有困滯之灾，蓋春木盛旺，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"㣲弱之金而欲制之，是猶以嬰兒而禦强敵，其不格也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506025329426447"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"明矣。犯此者，必有求榮反辱之虞，官訟争攘之事，謂其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"仁義相刑故也。荆梁豫人逢之主富。徐揚人干支土多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"者貴顯，氣運土鄉最吉，金鄉次之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"873","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"夏月火盛，金至柔也，晴則日爍金流，雨則水滋金潤，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"夏令之金，俱宜見土，主人有出將入相之權，金馬玉堂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"之貴，見火則火炎金爍，貧夭居多，雖富而夭滛賤。見木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"為財，荆梁豫人多主富貴，遇水孤寒，蓋弱金不能生水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"故也。若與火土同行，則富貴康寧。運喜土金，木火最忌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505999853355018"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"秋金肅殺，萬物凋零，苟縱而不抑，則生生之意絶矣。晴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":826,"lineType":1,"content":"則火煆金堅，雨則水潤金明故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"881","lineNum":827,"lineType":1,"content":"七八月之金得令，其性剛强，仗火以制其威，則有玉帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":828,"lineType":1,"content":"金魚之貴，蓋頑金無火，不能成器故也。見水泄其旺氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"金白水清，多主詞林清貴，水火俱無，則主夭折。見木為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":830,"lineType":1,"content":"財，徐、揚人富而且貴，遇土則隐彩埋光，雖有財而不發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"孤者多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00005_0_8","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"云：秋金埋土而反旺也。逢木而貴，徐、揚、兖、青","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"人見之尤佳。九月生者，金氣稍退，遇火夜生為竒，晝生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505999182184482"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"少利，逢木則尅，反應骨肉参商。見水濟之，冀、雍人不免","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"冷退，徐、揚又何忌焉。逢土亦晦，兖、青人富貴居多，豫人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"困滯。運喜東南，西北忌之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"893","lineNum":838,"lineType":1,"content":"冬月天氣嚴肅，金伏藏之時也。蓋金之生也，胎於春，生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"於夏，旺於秋，至冬而死者，謂其畏寒無生意也。晴明則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":840,"lineType":1,"content":"金清水秀，雨雪則水冷金寒，所以冬月之金，得火融之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"然後可以奪其寒氣，則富貴非常矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"897","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"初冬之金，見火則為傷殘，徐、揚人干支無土，日生者貧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506023907655717"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":845,"lineType":1,"content":"夭，夜生者孤寒，遇土則衣禄豐足，見水木俱不利矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":846,"lineType":1,"content":"子丑月生者，亦喜火以温之，徐、揚人無火亦喜，遇土得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"火為貴。冀、雍人有土無火者孤貧，蓋寒土非生金之資","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"也，見水則寒。西北人賤貧疾夭，徐、揚人干支有火土者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"福壽康寧也，遇木為財主富，享閒中之福，兖、青人則有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"妻孥犯分之事，蓋衰金不能制木故也。荆、梁、豫人則吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"運喜東南，西北最忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"906","lineNum":852,"lineType":8,"content":"論水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506019390324747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"春月之水，孰不謂其病寅死卯墓辰為至弱矣。殊不知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":856,"lineType":1,"content":"水為陰氣，生申旺子，秋冬之時，其氣翕聚未散，故水常","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"涸。春至陽氣上蒸，陰氣下降，故雨露旣濡，而水生發，此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"水勢之常耳。星家以活水生於卯者，良有以也。晴則春","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"水溶溶，雨則汪洋泛溢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"913","lineNum":860,"lineType":1,"content":"正月生者，水有寒氣，見火則氷融凍釋，富貴雍容，得金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"相助，徐、揚生者最佳。逢木無火，則水冷木寒，未有生意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"遇土尅水，亦主貧寒，土制金生，衣資豐贍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506019772121099"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"二三月之水，浩無邊際，見土則有隄防，晝則富貴，夜則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":866,"lineType":1,"content":"流移。生於穀雨後者，或主滛邪痺憊之疾，蓋土渾水濁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"故也。見火則水火相刑，灾訟不免，遇金生水，泛溢無情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":868,"lineType":1,"content":"徐揚人干支得土者無咎，見木泄之，能施惠及人。兖青","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"人生於二月中旬者，木氣正旺，盗其元神，則生風怯之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"疾，得金助之無患。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"923","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"夏水失令，逢火則乾涸矣，所以忌晴而喜雨也。初夏之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"時，水猶泛濫，得土止而不流，則福氣深厚，但不宜與火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506019772137483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"同行，蓋火盛則土燥而水涸。徐揚人干支無金水者，疾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"夭也。逢水利就名成，金若生之，反主孤尅，蓋夏令金衰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"母弱，不能生子，而反傷於母也。荆梁豫人値之則吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"五六月之水，正能滋助萬物，喜土同行，生時更値陰雨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"者，主富貴文章，見火則有涸水之嫌，輕者疾，重者夭，得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":880,"lineType":1,"content":"水濟之，㓙中反吉。見木，亦主富貴豪雄，兖青人泄其眞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":881,"lineType":1,"content":"氣非佳，逢金，氣弱無力，生水不可。例以母曜論之，反主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":882,"lineType":1,"content":"孤尅。干支有金水者吉，運喜金水，火鄉最忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506000042131490"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"水生。秋令，正水清秀之時也，晴則清澈無瑕，雨則潦水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"渾濁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"937","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"七月之水，正能滋實萬物，不宜與火同行，徐揚火多者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"貧夭無依。金為母曜，適當其時，子母相生，文章清貴，土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"来同處，化禍為祥，木若聮行，亦當貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"940","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"八九月之水，遇令星則福壽難量，金火同躔，則功名炬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"赫。見木，終被疏泄，不免先成後敗。火若同垣，恩金失力，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":892,"lineType":1,"content":"雖有治民服衆之徳，未免痰疾刑傷。見土，雖㓙不㓙，蓋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505999182233634"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"秋令金，最能化難為福，徐揚豫人，干支土多者，亦困滯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":896,"lineType":1,"content":"終身，運利西北，東南失宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"946","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"冬月司令之水，寒氣嚴凝之時也，雨則氷凝，晴則凍釋，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":898,"lineType":1,"content":"故冬三月俱喜火以温之，則富貴無虞矣。見金，子母相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":899,"lineType":1,"content":"生，徐揚人，金紫玉堂之貴。冀雍人，水冷金寒，雖相生而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":900,"lineType":1,"content":"反貧薄，得火同行為吉。逢土金，骨肉参商，冀雍人頼以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"隄防，而無泛溢之患也。遇木，水寒木凍，俱無生意，貧夭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":902,"lineType":1,"content":"無疑。徐揚人，干支火多者富壽，木土同垣，制煞反吉。丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506000042147874"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"月生者貴顯，運喜南方，東方次之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"954","lineNum":906,"lineType":8,"content":"論甲乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"955","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙春生寅卯月，喜逢金火是榮名。莫將水土推為用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":908,"lineType":1,"content":"曲直類趨另一評。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":909,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙生正二月，其木專旺，遇金用金，是木要成材，定見金也；遇火用火，是木火通明之象也。水土此二月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":910,"lineType":2,"content":"休死，難為用神，若成趨乾、曲直、類象等格，雖無金火，亦可功名。用金不宜見火，用火不宜見金。水用金者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":911,"lineType":2,"content":"尚宜水印，用火最嫌水金相戰。且如甲木遇申庚柱，有己酉丑辛字扶其金旺，皆吉。如金旣輕，遇火而行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":912,"lineType":2,"content":"火地，難以金為用。若辛字虚立干支，别無金位，只是常人。  甲日丙透，不遇梟煞，更得寅辰二字多，兼以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505999182200866"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":915,"lineType":2,"content":"身旺行火地，皆主富貴。柱不忌丁，惟怕丙，如有去配之神，亦不執定。  四柱無官，專用食傷，身旺行火地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":916,"lineType":2,"content":"亦主利名。如水火金互相攻戰，更無去配，乃下命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":916,"lineType":2,"content":"獨歩","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00005_0_9","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":916,"lineType":2,"content":"云甲乙生春月，庚辛干上逢，離宫推富貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":916,"lineType":2,"content":"坎","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00005_0_10","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":916,"lineType":2,"content":"地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":917,"lineType":2,"content":"却為㐫是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"969","lineNum":918,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙夏生四五月，庚辛帶水却為宜。土神未月連金用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"不透傷官貴可知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":920,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙夏生乃食傷，與財為用，如火土不露，只是金水運行，金水得宜。如甲用庚壬有根，行東則吉。若丙丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":921,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辛互露，行西不吉，專用丙丁，不遇金水。柱有比肩，行東大發。如戊己透干，更無水佐，行西雖云向禄，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":922,"lineType":2,"content":"不吉論。乙見壬庚，兩露干頭，行西富背若是火，透行東發，遇火無水，反焚其主。故甲乙二日，在夏宜用比","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506012272705586"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":925,"lineType":2,"content":"肩，用火土不宜見金水，用金水不宜見火土。命如庚申、壬午、乙卯、戊寅、  庚辰、壬午，乙未、壬午，二  用金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":926,"lineType":2,"content":"水。甲丙辰、乙未、甲申、己巳，皆丙寅、乙未、  申乙丑，二命用火土，  吉命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"977","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙秋生兩様言，乙多金貴甲单尊。兩干飛臨無射月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":928,"lineType":2,"content":"戌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":928,"lineType":1,"content":"内有財官要印存。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":929,"lineType":2,"content":"甲木秋生，不宜金多，見印則吉，不宜水多，多則流。乙不忌金多，得印則貴，俱忌火土，傷官壊印。如甲生八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":930,"lineType":2,"content":"月，正官忌丁卯，火局運順行，不妨貴。柱有壬癸子辰之水，雖有火行南，亦吉。如用土兼官入墓，名利難進。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":931,"lineType":2,"content":"入甲生九月，宜比肩及亥卯未佐之，或得一金一火  格，無破，皆為吉論。若亥申庚己酉丑類，不遇丙丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":932,"lineType":2,"content":"戊己，别是一用，或趨乾胞胎煞印，皆可言吉。柱戊己透，要身旺行旺方可，不宜再露火金，用金不宜見火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505999853404170"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":935,"lineType":2,"content":"土，用火土，不宜見金。如只用金辛虚露，别無地支之金，只是平常。  乙日九月戌中原有戊辛丁得遇己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":936,"lineType":2,"content":"酉丑庚辛申辰，須見壬癸亥子之印方妙。丁火配制無妨，如專用戊，内無破，只以富㫁。若金火互相攻戰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":937,"lineType":2,"content":"及兩干只是火局，又行火地，乃驅馳不足之命天，如丙申戊戌甲午乙亥，狀元尚書，是甲趨乾，又地  交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":938,"lineType":2,"content":"㤗，未己亥甲，戊乙亥癸，  官給事，己運死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"989","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙冬生木本枯，若逢金土反宜乎。金多成格為官印，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":940,"lineType":1,"content":"用火尤嫌水土敷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":941,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙冬生，本印無金火土，則不足持印之美。柱多申酉庚辛己丑，乃擬煞印官印格，作上命論。如甲只一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":942,"lineType":2,"content":"辛，乙只一庚，干支别無金透藏，又不行金地，官露無根，虚名虚利。如得丙丁戊己食傷兩旺，行東南運發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506023907672101"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":945,"lineType":2,"content":"達，若壬丙相見，丁癸相持，皆不吉。用壬癸印，行丙丁己午方梟，遇食刑戰不吉。用申酉官煞，若水太盛，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":946,"lineType":2,"content":"不作吉，當細詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"996","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"甲生春季夏間來，丙火干頭作壽胎。戊本是財壬是印，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":948,"lineType":1,"content":"運臨酉地雨風摧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":949,"lineType":2,"content":"甲生三月與夏間，以丙戊壬為用神，行酉地，向禄本吉，豈知是壬丙戊敗死之地，有此為用，運行其中，皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":950,"lineType":2,"content":"不作吉論，如辛亥、丁酉、甲辰、丙寅，是貴命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"甲生秋月主逢財，印綬官星併帶來。運轉南方名利顯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":952,"lineType":1,"content":"傷多只恐子星乖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506019390341131"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":955,"lineType":2,"content":"甲日生七八月，官煞印綬多，又見戊己土財運行南傷煞之地，官貴太過，宜行剥削之方，乃得中和，主進","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":956,"lineType":2,"content":"爵加禄。但火金交戰，頼財生貴，子終有損。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":956,"lineType":2,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00005_0_11","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":956,"lineType":2,"content":"云：木嗣併絶於南，子息則損，縱有别生，如癸酉辛酉、甲申戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":957,"lineType":2,"content":"辰，俱己未癸酉、甲寅、己巳，二命  行南運，雖進職無子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":958,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申酉月煞官俱，莫要猜疑作混㸔。干上再逢庚字透，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"地支煞黨總一般。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":960,"lineType":2,"content":"甲申日生八月，莫言官煞混，柱中辛庚多，總作煞論，遇印扶身及制煞皆吉，若火多無水盗氣，不吉。如遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":961,"lineType":2,"content":"己酉丑時，亦非金神，皆以煞論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":962,"lineType":1,"content":"甲生八月禄當時，最怕卯丁来破之。誰信北行終富貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506020501651506"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"運南有水亦能支。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":966,"lineType":2,"content":"甲生八月，辛官得，時柱遇卯丁，火局本畏，如順行運經北地，其火遇制，不能害金，不可言卯丁玷之，不貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":967,"lineType":2,"content":"若原無水破，帶病行東南，則眞不吉。如柱有壬癸子辰亥水，干不遇土行南，亦能發達。若此月柱無火土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":968,"lineType":2,"content":"用印再行水地，盗盡金氣，亦不為吉，勿執官印之名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":969,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅庚透夏春生，煞淺身强最有情。羊刃如逢時月下，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":970,"lineType":1,"content":"却將高貴反常評。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":971,"lineType":2,"content":"甲寅日生春夏，柱遇庚金，煞淺身强本吉，緣。春夏庚金力輕，遇乙刃與煞暗合，自旺無倚，不作吉論。若庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":972,"lineType":2,"content":"金有根，或别有庚字，不在此論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506075912601663"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申春月喜重庚，壬乙相逢入帝庭。無乙只宜名利淺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":976,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁玷破作常評。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":977,"lineType":2,"content":"甲日春生庚金多，遇有乙壬亥丑取貴，無乙則减，若遇丙丁重戰，金力輕，不勝火尅，乃不足之命，須有印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":978,"lineType":2,"content":"去配方可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌干支三兩重，火金却喜格中逢。如無金火復行水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":980,"lineType":1,"content":"此命終須主困窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":981,"lineType":2,"content":"甲生九月，若有兩三重甲戌，干頭宜一丙，或一庚一戊，得地支申辰，可言成人，如干支無金火，又行水地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":982,"lineType":2,"content":"則無用。倘運得火郷，可獲其福，若身弱上火多，亦不足之論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506021022023734"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"甲日如逢乙亥時，庚金透出喜乙妻。丙丁若也無相混，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":986,"lineType":1,"content":"歲運申庚名利齊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":987,"lineType":2,"content":"甲日逢乙亥時趨乾格，喜柱有庚合乙，故忌見丙丁害庚，及泄主之氣。歲運遇申庚，主功名，忌行主死，用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":988,"lineType":2,"content":"敗火焚之地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":989,"lineType":1,"content":"甲生季月乙巳時，壬癸推他作印竒。火土相逢名利遂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":990,"lineType":1,"content":"水金運底更多非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":991,"lineType":2,"content":"甲生季月，有財官等物，時遇乙丑己巳，宜見壬癸印助，非金神忌水之論，逢土火則發財，金水之方不利","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":992,"lineType":2,"content":"别月，及癸酉時，忌見壬癸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505999182250018"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"甲日無他丑巳時，金神格也定非疑。赤黄運遇成名利，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":996,"lineType":1,"content":"水木之方又不宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":997,"lineType":2,"content":"甲日他處别無取用，遇乙丑己巳，乃金神格，宜行火土運，忌入金水方，衝拆作不吉論，主稱意中亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":998,"lineType":1,"content":"甲生冬月亥午多，以亥破午反中和。局中更得申庚用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"定主功名掇顯科。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":1000,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午冬生遇子時，格全印綬喜同支。莫言死敗為無用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"柱有酉辛貴莫疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":1002,"lineType":2,"content":"甲生冬月，亥午字多，謂之兩門遇貴。甲木死午，庚金敗午，本塞否之象，遇亥子共支，甲木生亥，乾天庚方，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506023907721253"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":1005,"lineType":2,"content":"否而反秦。如甲午日生子時，莫言金逢死敗，得酉金助之，皆富貴之命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":1006,"lineType":1,"content":"甲日冬生水盛期，髙明不遇嘆支離。歲時如得辛庚見，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":1007,"lineType":1,"content":"運入東南夢叶羆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":1008,"lineType":2,"content":"甲木冬生本印遇金土則有用，若柱得辛庚己酉丑，有一字，或得行西方，發達名利，如火土多互見，則兩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":1009,"lineType":2,"content":"用不專，顧此失彼，亦不稱情。若只見丙丁火，戊己土輕㣲，得遇東南之地，忽然發蹟，忌見金水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":1010,"lineType":1,"content":"甲在春生乙在秋，煞官重叠福優游。甲秋春乙如多遇，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"有印須知亦貴儔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":1012,"lineType":2,"content":"甲木春生官煞多，要印助之則吉。乙木秋生官煞多，遇印亦富貴。若甲生秋，乙生春，官煞少富貴多則不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506021022040118"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":1015,"lineType":2,"content":"貴，無印尤不利。如庚申、甲申、甲申、庚午，煞重木死，無印困窮。  庚寅、庚辰、甲申、壬申，甲日春生煞多有印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":1016,"lineType":2,"content":"富。如如丁酉、癸卯、甲申、壬申，甲木春生煞純，有印貴。    乙酉、乙酉、乙酉、壬午，乙木秋生純煞，有印貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙春逢金火期，分行南北利名宜。火宜南地金宜北，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":1018,"lineType":1,"content":"反此而行兩不時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":1019,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙生正二月，金為用神，無火戰，宜行北地，主名利。火為用神，無水金重戰，宜行南地，則可名利。如原火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":1020,"lineType":2,"content":"局行南方，木被火焚，故用金見火入火方，用火見水入水地，乃平常之命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙生炎火土敷，西行營利貴難圖。行東遇刼成家業，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":1022,"lineType":1,"content":"値水西通甲怕枯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506029800472613"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":1025,"lineType":2,"content":"甲木夏生遇火土露，本為用神，行西見金，乃捨去火土用金，金遇原火交戰，亦不能為用，乃來而不來，去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":1026,"lineType":2,"content":"而不去，只是營利之軰，莫言見貴禄，便擬富貴，若行東則吉，原有壬癸水生，不足破用，如甲日遇火土，重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":1027,"lineType":2,"content":"遇水生，行南與西，俱不為吉。乙日遇官印，虚露西地吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":1028,"lineType":1,"content":"乙生春月見金强，酉丑亥逢大吉昌。錯節盤根喜琢削，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":1029,"lineType":1,"content":"如行南地反為殃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":1030,"lineType":2,"content":"乙木春正旺，錯節盤根，非金强不成器，故宜琢削。如柱有庚辛巳酉丑為官煞混，宜丁火制煞，歲運見丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":1031,"lineType":2,"content":"酉亥為吉，如生巳月，逆行辰卯寅亦吉，若行火木旺地，傷去其官，不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":1032,"lineType":1,"content":"乙生卯月見金功，運行水金去火通。申子酉中應許貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506023907737637"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":1035,"lineType":1,"content":"火臨相聚格還空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":1036,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰辛巳時中遇，乙巳逢牛總一同。水金運底成功業，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"木火相逢反落空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":1038,"lineType":2,"content":"乙生卯月，用金不宜見丙火在干，引領支中之火，及木相㑹，皆壊格局，宜行金水之地，去火木則吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":1039,"lineType":1,"content":"乙日春冬時遇辰，再逢辛巳一般論。如行印地分榮貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":1040,"lineType":1,"content":"只怕丙丁損用神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":1041,"lineType":2,"content":"乙日春冬遇庚辰辛巳時，只是一用，遇壬癸子辰之印，可言富貴，混則富，若見火，多損用，乃小人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":1042,"lineType":1,"content":"乙日春生用丙丁，水金不遇妙南行。不宜西北兼歸墓，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506025329491983"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":1045,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺無梟水地平。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":1046,"lineType":2,"content":"乙木春生身旺，以丙丁為用，柱無金水行南地發福，怕逢水金及㑹木入墓。若身用旺，行北，不妨透土不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":1047,"lineType":2,"content":"忌水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":1048,"lineType":1,"content":"乙逢辰巳午未時，就裏藏眞未易知。若得土金皆有用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":1049,"lineType":1,"content":"只恐旺處更無依。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":1050,"lineType":2,"content":"乙木不拘提綱，得辰巳午未時行入金地，或入火土，便為有用。若入亥卯未地柱原有一二字，㑹成木局","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":1051,"lineType":2,"content":"全不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":1052,"lineType":1,"content":"夏生乙木遇壬庚，運向西方禄自榮。乙丙若無局内見，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506075912618047"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"讀書應許有功名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":1056,"lineType":2,"content":"乙生夏月遇庚壬，二字行西方，擬貴，若見丙丁主平常。如庚壬有根行旺金歲運，是讀書秀才必中。如坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":1057,"lineType":2,"content":"己丑日，得壬癸印，亦吉，酉日不堪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":1058,"lineType":1,"content":"乙日秋生官最强，喜逢辛煞反榮昌。蛇牛宜見嫌南火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":1059,"lineType":1,"content":"㣲水扶持入廟廊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":1060,"lineType":2,"content":"乙日秋官本庚，宜見煞則利，無煞雖功名未若煞而易成，若官煞互見，遇印綬則無嫌孤庚無煞，則名利","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":1061,"lineType":2,"content":"進退，或白身異路之擬。今世達官多用煞，故煞勝官。若遇丙火及土，無印入南，不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":1062,"lineType":1,"content":"乙日如逢辛煞多，見丁相擊無奈却。旺金去火翻為吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506048637075490"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":1065,"lineType":1,"content":"青赤交持名利薄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":1066,"lineType":2,"content":"乙日金多，見丁火相戰，不吉。丁丑時不忌，原有丁火，再行見丁，制伏太過，運行去火旺金之方，又吉。若入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":1067,"lineType":2,"content":"火木㑹旺之地，用神雖倚，乃虚名虚利，柱中見丙，皆不利也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":1068,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯坐禄見財官，庚辛帶水利名㸔。不論何月時辰巳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":1069,"lineType":1,"content":"丑午相逢亦類觀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":1070,"lineType":2,"content":"乙日逢丑辰巳午時，俱財官煞印食神之竒，四時皆作一用，但金水互見，乃功名之象，若庚被丙傷，辛被","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":1071,"lineType":2,"content":"丙合，無實用，不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":1072,"lineType":1,"content":"乙生己酉丑月中，最喜時支一様逢。印綬再來年月助，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506048637059106"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"千紅萬紫感春風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":1076,"lineType":2,"content":"乙日生己酉丑月，更逢己酉丑，時柱中若得印佐，或行印地，皆主富貴。古歌云：六乙生逢己酉丑，局中切","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":1077,"lineType":2,"content":"忌財星守，若還行運到南方，管取其人夀不久。又云：乙木生居酉，切勿逢己丑，富貴坎離宫，貧窮申酉守。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":1078,"lineType":2,"content":"如癸卯辛酉、乙酉丁丑，此命平常七十三，入卯地，死二子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":1079,"lineType":1,"content":"乙生亥月時遇丙，年月逢丁作三竒。坐丑兼戌引從貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":1080,"lineType":1,"content":"如專己酉另詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":1081,"lineType":2,"content":"乙生亥月印綬，如乙丑日丙戌時，天干三竒，地支丑引戌從作大貴㸔，若乙酉則無前引，乙巳則衝亥，大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":1082,"lineType":2,"content":"减分數，此煞印格，亦有輕重叅詳。水多則喜土制，如孟重侍郎，乙亥丁亥，乙丑丙戌，崔棟御史，日干乙酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506025329508367"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":1085,"lineType":2,"content":"不同，然官止七品，又無子，可例見也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":1086,"lineType":1,"content":"木生春旺弟嫌兄，誰道無情反有情。或火或金成一用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":1087,"lineType":1,"content":"不逢金火格多評。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":1088,"lineType":2,"content":"木春本旺，財官俱絶，更遇比刼無情，如遇一金或一火為用，反頼比肩之功，可以論福，無金火平常，如甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":1089,"lineType":2,"content":"得庚辛申巳酉丑亥，一用宜水，又如丙丁火無金水破比肩旺食反吉，趨乾格亦宜比肩，又是一用。如生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":1090,"lineType":2,"content":"三月，别有取用，亦頼比肩。又乙日遇金，局無丙透，又是一用。遇丙丁身旺無水，又是一用。類象一格，亦宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":1091,"lineType":2,"content":"比肩，兄弟成則貴，衝拆不論。此格木生三月，亦有金土之用，其甲乙得庚辛官，虚露比刼，分奪合，又無别","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":1092,"lineType":2,"content":"金，亦無别情，不吉。古歌云：陰木生逢己酉丑，生於子月貴難成，再行金水傷殘害，運轉南方還福清。  如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506019390406667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":1095,"lineType":2,"content":"丙午癸巳、乙亥丙子是丐者，辛辛巳庚子、乙丑丁卯是平人。丁酉運跌死  壬戌  亥，乙亥丙子嫌辛字，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":1096,"lineType":2,"content":"卯運不如甲寅，丙合辛貴，由貢而擢御史，無子。古歌曰：乙木逢陽遇子多，名為聚貴福重峩，局中最怕南","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":1097,"lineType":2,"content":"離地，官煞來衝無奈何。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":1098,"lineType":1,"content":"木生夏月節枝横，此地財傷要刼生。暢茂繁華根未盛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":1099,"lineType":1,"content":"刼多用重兩宜情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":1100,"lineType":2,"content":"木在夏生火土之時，若干頭再見火土，最要刼多生火，火生土為財。以此比肩多能任，莫言比肩多，反分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":1101,"lineType":2,"content":"其財也。古歌云：木逢壬癸水漂流，日主無根枉度秋，歲運若行財旺地，反㐫為吉佐王侯。  如甲寅庚午、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":1102,"lineType":2,"content":"乙卯戊寅，比乙未壬午、甲子丙寅，二命  肩所以皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506020501684274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":1105,"lineType":8,"content":"論丙丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":1106,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁正二印當春，壬癸多逢格最嗔。不忌浮財宜見化，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":1107,"lineType":1,"content":"遇辰月愛子連申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":1108,"lineType":2,"content":"丙丁春月，以木為印綬，水為官煞，丁壬合化最宜。若見官只用官，見煞只用煞，不宜混雜，怕水多不能生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":1109,"lineType":2,"content":"火，徒有印名。或一壬二壬，一癸二癸，得去配亦不為害，不忌干頭虚金，行南俱吉，柱原金水多又行北地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":1110,"lineType":2,"content":"更無去配，皆不足之論，行南稍吉，如官煞原淺，行北亦吉。若原金遇衝擊提綱伐木壤印，則㓙生三月，本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":1111,"lineType":2,"content":"是傷官，又宜金水之用，如㑹申子，全主發達。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":1112,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁夏月本炎蒸，富貴須憑别象稱。金水相逢渾有頼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506029800456229"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":1115,"lineType":1,"content":"用傷格破作髙僧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":1116,"lineType":2,"content":"丙丁夏生，丙有炎上、倒衝類象等格，丁有飛晶拱禄等格，如合不破，皆主富貴不成。前格或見一壬亥癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":1117,"lineType":2,"content":"及申子辰，全運行西方，以富貴論。有戊己為用，梟煞相征，行西亦發。丁忌行寅戌，丙亦嫌墓卯酉亥運吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":1118,"lineType":2,"content":"亦傷尅不成之困。如非格局，又無用神，及有用破壞，皆主不吉，多辟穀休糧之軰也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁秋月總為財，丁可通融丙忌哉。甲日怕逢兼怕刃，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":1120,"lineType":1,"content":"運行南地細推排。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":1121,"lineType":2,"content":"丙丁秋生，金得時令，俱作財論，若金水太盛，獨丁火能任丙火。怕逢煞，官多弱甚，無制則傷。如丙生七月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":1122,"lineType":2,"content":"遇煞地，或透煞官，宜見戊己為夀星，再行官貴發達。怕逢子辰卯地，八月丙死，若財多，則秀而不實，如壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506025329524751"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":1125,"lineType":2,"content":"水得制，或卯辰時從化得陽字，多行旺地亦可，但不宜甲木併比肩相見。九月近冬時，一貴不多，或辰巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":1126,"lineType":2,"content":"時，是一貴格，亦不要官煞多，若類炎上格亦貴。若遇庚辛為用四桂，不宜見官煞，戊己為用，不宜見甲乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":1127,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸，如用壬亥，别是一格，其中更怕官煞，及木土相戰。丁生七月，遇官煞及財重，宜行南則吉，不用木印，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":1128,"lineType":2,"content":"若生新秋，遇刼重，逆行南不吉，順則可，若無官煞，遇戊土或支遇子辰㑹水，行南北皆吉，惟忌子午寅運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":1129,"lineType":2,"content":"未有咎。遇壬寅時，雖作化木論，以金地無木情不能化故也。八月棄命就財，宜財格，巳酉丑全為美，丁酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":1130,"lineType":2,"content":"為主，不利官星，比肩印綬無忌，行南亦吉，忌寅午子。歲運九月遇煞官，或近冬界從化，但忌土木，如用庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":1131,"lineType":2,"content":"辛行木地，富貴，亦忌子運午運。用戊己，宜行弱地，若水木在内，亦為不足。大抵丙丁二火，丙怕弱，丁怕旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":1132,"lineType":2,"content":"宜細詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506019390423051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁冬月用當垣，從化都宜不帶根。官煞當時嫌日旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":1136,"lineType":1,"content":"無生清用便為恩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":1137,"lineType":2,"content":"丙丁冬月水，當時官煞旺，若從化作上命㸔，如丙生此際，遇壬癸干透相連，或申子辰㑹柱，有辛則化，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":1138,"lineType":2,"content":"戊己則制，皆主功名。遇丁傷辛，有壬透不妨，遇甲是梟，有庚制方去。丙生子月，財官柱無壬亥及坐申，皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":1139,"lineType":2,"content":"以財官論。怕刑衝破壞，及分官日弱，乃秀而不實，其煞格忌日主休囚死敗之地，及煞旺去食拆合拆化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":1140,"lineType":2,"content":"之方。丙生丑月，有戊己為用，宜身旺，怕木壞之，丑為財庫，如透辛庚，不宜見官煞，要日主健旺則吉，破用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":1141,"lineType":2,"content":"主弱則㓙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":1142,"lineType":1,"content":"丙日秋生官煞多，無生得化致中和。有生無制皆言弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506048637206562"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"兩地財名坦復波。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":1146,"lineType":2,"content":"丙生八月官煞多，宜食制合化俱吉，怕入子辰卯鄉，如無制合遇梟食，縱行旺地不吉。如九月近冬，遇時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":1147,"lineType":2,"content":"上一位貴格，逢梟偏印，月有戊食，運入身旺，寅辰方吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":1148,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申四月戊飛來，萬頃田園主富哉。最怕梟神同透干，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":1149,"lineType":1,"content":"平生辛苦命安排。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":1150,"lineType":2,"content":"丙申日生，四月得透土，食神坐禄主富。若遇壬煞甲，食如用壬見戊，莫言食神制煞，四月水涸，遇旺戊去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":1151,"lineType":2,"content":"之，不吉。柱得水局，或壬亥一二字方可，忌行日弱，及壬丙敗死休囚之地，若壬多，雖是辰時主旺用旺，皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":1152,"lineType":2,"content":"不作上命㸔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506075912667199"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":1155,"lineType":1,"content":"丙臨申位遇時辰，春夏生人煞最循。金水運逢雖阜澤，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":1156,"lineType":1,"content":"辰壬酉亥子申分。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":1157,"lineType":2,"content":"丙申日遇壬辰時，申辰㑹煞。春夏火旺相，不以㐫論，秋冬水旺相，火受水制，全頼食神制煞，主險中求名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":1158,"lineType":2,"content":"發達，險中全仗主强。辰壬酉亥子申卯，皆主休敗之地，吉㓙宜細詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":1159,"lineType":1,"content":"丙生冬月喜逢辛，格内土來作吉論。時上不妨壬字見，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":1160,"lineType":1,"content":"有丁合化俱無嗔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":1161,"lineType":2,"content":"丙生冬月喜見辛，化宜土制為食乃吉，時月煞不以為害，若見丁尅辛，時遇壬合，則丁不暇害辛，各全其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":1162,"lineType":2,"content":"化。歲運逢丁尅傷妻子，輕者稍可，重者尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506029800488997"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":1165,"lineType":1,"content":"丙坐三支寅午戌，月逢火局總皆同。格成炎上多名利，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":1166,"lineType":1,"content":"土富嫌臨水戰功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":1167,"lineType":2,"content":"丙坐寅午戌日及生月，又得局，全不遇水破，即炎上倒飛類象，從旺見土亦吉，忌見水類飛，失局失垣則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":1168,"lineType":2,"content":"㐫。戊如丙寅、甲午、丙戌、乙未，富。庚寅、  寅丙戌、甲午，二命合格，  貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":1169,"lineType":1,"content":"丙己相逢本是傷，官星就見又何妨。火時土旺宜金水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":1170,"lineType":1,"content":"時夏惟寅宜另詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":1171,"lineType":2,"content":"丙生季月，内有戊己，或透或不透，不透從土，無中生有得，寅午戌時俱入格，土透亦吉。不忌官星，如遇刃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":1172,"lineType":2,"content":"及照象，虎入中堂等格，非傷妻則少子，官煞重遇則禍，如遇煞，以煞論。此格最喜比肩，如六月丙寅，宜另","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506019390439435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":1175,"lineType":2,"content":"詳之。不宜卯未隨乙，而反傷正用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":1176,"lineType":1,"content":"丁生十月得寅時，化象成都富貴推。若再丁來曁辰戌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":1177,"lineType":1,"content":"戊分官貴庻人期。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":1178,"lineType":2,"content":"丁生亥月，遇寅時，成正化格，富貴。若再見丁則分官，見辰則官入墓，見戌字戊癸，乃拆合傷官，遇申酉，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":1179,"lineType":2,"content":"破木之用，此等皆壞格，不吉。如無此玷，乃大富貴。行午巳申酉地，吉，中主㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":1180,"lineType":1,"content":"丁壬化木卯羊寅，無破提綱利禄新。官旺且宜身旺地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":1181,"lineType":1,"content":"兔逢兊變虎愁坤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":1182,"lineType":2,"content":"丁壬十月，官印俱時，乃正化，其寅卯未偏垣，寅忌行申，卯忌行酉，未忌行寅，餘亦忌戌子午巳運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506020501717042"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":1185,"lineType":1,"content":"丁日秋生格最佳，無根有煞兩榮華。有根無煞行南域，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":1186,"lineType":1,"content":"好似良瓊玷缺瑕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":1187,"lineType":2,"content":"丁日陰柔宜弱柱，官輕行南不吉，若遇上官，煞輕行北，大發。柱無比印，行兩地皆吉。若七八月寅時不作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":1188,"lineType":2,"content":"化㸔，九月化煞化木，宜近冬界，及行木地吉。忌午申寅巳。秋月柱中用煞透戊己，忌行寅午子運。九月用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":1189,"lineType":2,"content":"戊己，忌見甲乙。若六月界作七月推，更無金水，逆行不吉，順行則可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":1190,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯秋冬煞疊昌，休來印綬助身强。美乎亥子嫌重火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"火木如來反主傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":1192,"lineType":2,"content":"丁卯一日乃煞印之源，能任官煞之多，柱多亥子，及運遇之，皆吉。若比肩印生，反不為利，行金水大發，行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506048637157410"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":1195,"lineType":2,"content":"比刼及原有土神，子申運㓙亥，如髙文薦都憲。丁亥癸卯丁卯庚子，柱多  子煞印為貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":1196,"lineType":1,"content":"丁生最怕午離間，金水無逢名利難。運徃兊西成利禄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":1197,"lineType":1,"content":"如行東地半愁顔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":1198,"lineType":2,"content":"丁生五月，日元自旺，若遇金水，不成飛晶拱禄。戊己不透，只支土為用，行西則土生財官，亦堪利禄，行東","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":1199,"lineType":2,"content":"原無格局，而用土，土受木尅，竟無倚頼，其主自旺，只宜入静及營托可也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":1200,"lineType":1,"content":"丁根石竹水源胎，金水鄉來道利開寅午戌方行補弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":1201,"lineType":1,"content":"官傷職掌庻生灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":1202,"lineType":2,"content":"丁火，房日之源，太陰之餘也，逢酉則明，遇寅則滅，行弱陰則明，行旺陽則昧。今人取火，截竹擊石得之，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506029800521765"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":1205,"lineType":2,"content":"行弱地，反見麗明，行旺地不吉。惟化格則是木，用木忌行金地，如生秋冬，忌行午及元地，命有土木，忌行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":1206,"lineType":2,"content":"申子，非化木，亦忌寅申夏生，忌寅戌春生，木用雖午晦昧，原有煞官，又為吉。論木印忌西，所忌之方，輕則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":1207,"lineType":2,"content":"非，重則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":1208,"lineType":1,"content":"丁日蛇提酉丑逢，水金運底利名通。柱中原有尤為上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":1209,"lineType":1,"content":"寅戌行來起戰鋒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":1210,"lineType":2,"content":"丁生四月，或丑酉日，或得金局，行西富貴，遇金水土亦吉，兩行俱是有情之地，惟寅午戌及子中有戰，倘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":1211,"lineType":2,"content":"傷枝葉，或非咎也，過此又吉。申如甲子、己巳、丁酉、庚戌、  癸未、丁巳、丁巳、戊，  俱行戊子運㓙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":1212,"lineType":1,"content":"丁生卯月卯寅提，雖化壬兮本木枝。木火却當官煞旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506054712033334"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":1215,"lineType":1,"content":"酉申運底動離悲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":1216,"lineType":2,"content":"丁生寅卯，遇官化及，煞乃印之本行，北方官煞，當其旺地，主功名發財，若行申酉，雖是財官，反傷木印，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":1217,"lineType":2,"content":"吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":1218,"lineType":1,"content":"丁日逢辰時戊申，傷官時内有生壬。煞星若出干頭上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":1219,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹水相征禍始侵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":1220,"lineType":2,"content":"丁生三月，傷官，如干上見煞，地支已有水局，若透戊字及水局，全發達，行子申酉地，傷官見官，水土相戰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":1221,"lineType":2,"content":"輕則非灾，重則破滅，稱意中亡。戊如癸未、丙辰、丁卯、戊申、  戊子、丙辰、丁卯、  申合此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":1222,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳居蛇弟襲兄，寅申月令喜壬庚。兩行運用尊榮貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506075912683583"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":1225,"lineType":1,"content":"相擊提綱禍始成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":1226,"lineType":2,"content":"丁巳、己巳二日，丁日申月，己日寅月，得壬水透干，原本有刑，未全得用神倚頼，則成富貴。再見此運三刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":1227,"lineType":2,"content":"全，輕則杖配晦駁，重則危滅，原有煞刃者尤㐫。如順行不遇財官，乃屠宰奔趨，亦無大咎，如享富貴，中有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":1228,"lineType":2,"content":"大險。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":1229,"lineType":1,"content":"丁戊傷官要見財，原無偏喜運重來。若逢寅戌雖為咎，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":1230,"lineType":1,"content":"誰信子申更主灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":1231,"lineType":2,"content":"丁日遇戊傷官，喜見庚辛申己酉丑為財柱，無宜行財地。丁生夏月，用戊宜行，金火方利，名至寅戌主旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":1232,"lineType":2,"content":"一停或尅戰晦滯，行子申一戰。丁生七月用戊，金水伏中行午戌寅停節，子寅運防禍。九月不遇甲寅，得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064990666778"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":1235,"lineType":2,"content":"戊透清者貴，互用者富。丑壬中行大吉，運遇甲乙，亦可言富貴。忌寅午。如流年㑹煞，㑹傷基之地，禍福響","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":1236,"lineType":2,"content":"應，運長者發久，短者易聚散。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":1237,"lineType":8,"content":"論戊己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":1238,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己當春官煞强，火金相見主榮昌。干支財透無臨刼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":1239,"lineType":1,"content":"運向財鄉田舎郎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":1240,"lineType":2,"content":"戊生正月，透官煞，只以煞論。柱得水行南則吉，火雖印亦不宜多，多則燥土，行火地，遇午刃旺甲死，是木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":1241,"lineType":2,"content":"遇火盛用亦被焚，土燥木虚，官煞有名無實，若金水多，行此地則吉，若金水多無印，行北方亦㓙生二月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":1242,"lineType":2,"content":"正官，要日干有財，行南可功名禄利，遇甲則從煞。論柱有財不忌，印旺行南吉，若偏正印多無財，行北亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506048637173794"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":1245,"lineType":2,"content":"吉。若財遇印多，行午地引領原火，火土燥水，不能制盗木之氣，羊刃無情，雖得富貴，未免災咎，重則危甚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":1246,"lineType":2,"content":"俱忌刑衝。運己生正月，乃官再透丙火，官印兩行俱吉，忌午戌  及衝提之方。遇子丑亥戌時合化，遇乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":1247,"lineType":2,"content":"是煞，遇印無水，行北亦吉，若水金多見，再行金水不吉，行南發達，生二月是煞，最宜透出官煞為美，有財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":1248,"lineType":2,"content":"無印，順行功名，逆行北不吉，若印多原無水，行北亦吉。大抵宜行木火，忌行金水，行午戌酉運亦宜，有灾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":1249,"lineType":2,"content":"傷福。戊生三月，遇有壬癸申子柱，無煞刼，行金水方發，  如遇刼財便發，亦尅妻損子。反覆見甲寅時是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":1250,"lineType":2,"content":"一格，可云富貴，却忌壬癸，喜見庚金，如遇財局，兼遇庚金，不見梟大發，見煞遇梟不吉。  己生三月，最宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":1251,"lineType":2,"content":"財官，全乎一格，或是傷官生財，及丑亥俱擬富貴，用財亦吉。若遇庚辛己酉丑金，不見火木，行金水方，皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":1252,"lineType":2,"content":"利禄，如時上一位貴，格局清者，可發科目柱。又云戊己正月，干見金局，及透金，最不宜見木，在  遺患後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506048637190178"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":1255,"lineType":2,"content":"行，患旺地壞用，用煞不忌見金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":1256,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己當時夏日期，土焦宜水乃相滋。木金得格成其器，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":1257,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬輕時怕水瀰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":1258,"lineType":2,"content":"戊己夏生，當垣印又生，扶土過，宜㣲水滋澤其間，俱要金水作用，若用印怕財，行財鄉不吉。且如戊日午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":1259,"lineType":2,"content":"月、戊寅日、甲寅時、戊午時，乃木用，富貴可言。六月木庫用甲乙，須透天干，甲寅時功名，餘甲則否，遇乙亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":1260,"lineType":2,"content":"不宜混煞，清者取貴，濁者不利，俱宜㣲水，不為壞印。如用金，四月遇庚辛己酉丑亥，多則可用，見壬水，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":1261,"lineType":2,"content":"水局破月，丙火行金水地，利禄人也，若無水，更遇甲丙，皆不吉。五六月金氣輕伏，無可言用，須多方取。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":1262,"lineType":2,"content":"六月用在七月，近秋作六月推者，遇金多順行，亦可言用，行遇金水方發財，戊生夏，若遇偏財時上及金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506029800554533"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":1265,"lineType":2,"content":"助之，行西方，發財，若露丁火，無財，印綬論，遇壬癸乙字及化格，富貴，怕衝提，再入財方己日。四月得庚辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":1266,"lineType":2,"content":"酉丑申全日支，又居酉丑，不見甲乙卯未丁字，行西北大發，忌入戌寅二運。若戌子丑亥時，以官印煞印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1286","lineNum":1267,"lineType":2,"content":"論，行官煞方皆吉。五月生遇木，行東方，可言名利，用金絶木宜水，如絶木得金局，行入北方，亦吉。六月遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":1268,"lineType":2,"content":"官煞，行東方，可擬富貴，西行次之，亦怕入旺。用金水，近秋則可，運宜順行，反則不吉。大抵戊己二干，用金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":1269,"lineType":2,"content":"水不宜露見火木，用火木不宜露見金水，中間又有拱禄拱貴格，宜細詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
