{"lines":[{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":1270,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己秋生本泄氣，少宜壬癸怕多逢。如專金用來青赤，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":1271,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有財名亦酌中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":1272,"lineType":2,"content":"戊己秋生，本用金水，遇火則害用，遇木則害身，如此日生，遇庚辛壬癸身旺，兩行功名人也。若遇癸化合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506029800570917"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":1275,"lineType":2,"content":"不利水地火地則吉，丁乙不忌，若全金用，惟怕丙甲不吉。如遇丙辰時，宜壬透制，及有寅字，或支隠甲，丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":1276,"lineType":2,"content":"遇庚壬在干屏之，行北，發達一度，入寅午運，二仇旺起，不吉。若歳月丙居申子辰上，雖無壬透，子丑辰巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":1277,"lineType":2,"content":"運干得壬癸庚辛去玷㑹，用為財名，如無此，西行亦頗可遂意。若丙有庚及申露，或隠寅無制，蹭蹬人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":1278,"lineType":2,"content":"運入午寅，重則危，輕則病，非尅傷。若丙年丁月連見，及丙甲俱見，小人，如無所忌，兩行發達，亦忌丙甲歲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":1279,"lineType":2,"content":"運大利辰巳子丑運，若歲時遇丁作印綬，逢癸丑正化傷丁，則貴。如兩癸争合，宜行戊地，兩戊争合，宜行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":1280,"lineType":2,"content":"癸地，若辛露怕見乙，俱忌財多有官，亦嫌丁辛在内，雖不為害，迤逓害地，不吉。若印旺，俱入怯瘋之病，尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":1281,"lineType":2,"content":"妻害子。若生九月，遇甲寅時，則是一格，宜臨冬首，如庚申時近冬無玷破，及火木亦福，亦有化印格之擬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":1282,"lineType":2,"content":"已上七月見卯未日，又見甲戌，甲子乙丑乙亥時，互見官煞，富貴，不宜透庚，如庚居寅午戌上，亦無害，此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506070451617811"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":1285,"lineType":2,"content":"非正氣官煞，惟忌財多。若用金水，不宜見木，生八月，遇丑亥時，叠見乙多，皆富貴。甲戌甲子時，亦要煞混","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":1286,"lineType":2,"content":"方吉，以虚官無實用也。若壬申癸酉時，則是一用，不宜見木，九月生亥卯未，遇巳時，亦可言吉，清者貴。遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":1287,"lineType":2,"content":"合不宜露煞，從合亦貴，坐煞亦妙，惟混不吉。若庚申辛酉等金為用，宜見官印，亦主利禄，受木破者不吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":1288,"lineType":2,"content":"忌行火木及午寅運，如用官煞，行戌午運，及木用入墓，用金敗印者，忌行午寅木火歲運，如得時上一煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":1289,"lineType":2,"content":"身弱不戰，尅者許登黄甲，戰争者稱意中亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":1290,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己冬生財利濵，柱中金水喜相親。水金得局空梟煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":1291,"lineType":1,"content":"貴比班超富季倫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":1292,"lineType":2,"content":"戊己冬生遇化，則是一格，不忌官星，更怕梟煞，若棄命就財，又是一格。戊日庚申時，無火木，遇申子辰無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506025329590287"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":1295,"lineType":2,"content":"火木，主大富貴。若戊申日遇金水，或壬癸時，亦是化格，不忌乙木，如此者大貴。畏行衝提折刃，若遇甲寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":1296,"lineType":2,"content":"時作煞論，可許功名，年月見甲，及金相攻，不吉。遇庚辛金為用，原有丙辰之玷，行壬癸子丑辰巳，及遇申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":1297,"lineType":2,"content":"酉方，亦當稱意。一度行寅午戌丙甲，重則危，輕則費患尅傷。己日遇子戌丑亥時，又一用見卯未，忌透金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":1298,"lineType":2,"content":"水，若申酉時為用，亦可言貴。不忌甲忌乙，亦忌火木中行，如戊日合得水局，棄命就財，合禄化火，四格無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":1299,"lineType":2,"content":"煞破，皆富貴，己日從木亦吉。辰巳日丑月透金，傷官及用財二格，行金水，申酉己  方吉，用時上一貴，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":1300,"lineType":2,"content":"可言功名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":1301,"lineType":1,"content":"戊日申時金水生，更兼水局禄財成。如無梟煞來侵格，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":1302,"lineType":1,"content":"職位崇髙莫與京。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064483123234"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":1305,"lineType":2,"content":"戊日秋冬金水旺局，遇庚申時合禄格，不遇梟煞之玷，及戊申日，主大富貴，夏生有水，木金制合，亦主大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":1306,"lineType":2,"content":"富貴享用。春生難言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":1307,"lineType":1,"content":"戊干合化在秋冬，遇癸逢壬化始通。火地財名功業就，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":1308,"lineType":1,"content":"最嫌梟煞兩相逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":1309,"lineType":2,"content":"合化格，見壬癸為然，行火地吉，見兩戊亦不妨。怕丙甲己，其丁乙輕無害，如丙辰時，水多壬觧，不甚為忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":1310,"lineType":1,"content":"戊日如逢甲寅時，却從煞格莫拘疑。運宜木火通名利，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":1311,"lineType":1,"content":"金水屏干入是非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":1312,"lineType":2,"content":"戊日寅時生春夏宜制則貴，生秋最怕庚露木衰，乃秀而不實，冬陽近木進氣，制稍無忌，亦不宜多行火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064990683162"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":1315,"lineType":2,"content":"木運，功名如傷官合財格，此寅時為戰，不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":1316,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申辰子日時同，金用壬連水有功。辰巳丑申為美運，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":1317,"lineType":1,"content":"午寅丙甲主貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":1318,"lineType":2,"content":"戊日生，如坐申子辰，及時亦遇天干庚辛透出，富貴，運行庚申辛酉、子辰丑己之地，可云遂意。若行寅午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":1319,"lineType":2,"content":"戌丙甲不吉，甚則死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":1320,"lineType":1,"content":"戊日秋冬兩様之，偏財時見最為竒。傷官歲月嫌梟煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":1321,"lineType":1,"content":"丑亥不如子戌時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":1322,"lineType":2,"content":"戊日秋冬，宜見偏財為美，丑亥二時，天財入化格，貴有玷折，不及子戌二時偏財為吉，忌煞官，多與前同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424505999182299170"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":1325,"lineType":2,"content":"戊己秋冬，遇庚辛透為用，行金水方發財，支宜申酉巳丑，壬癸申子辰俱吉，遇丙時有水制，亦吉，行金水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":1326,"lineType":2,"content":"地不妨，忌梟。丙申有根，行入子丑辰巳申酉運，俱稱意。丙甲午寅運不吉。戊己日如用次，則從木，論官煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":1327,"lineType":2,"content":"清行吉，乃富貴，用金水忌甲丙寅午戊，歲運輕則耗非，重則危殆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":1328,"lineType":1,"content":"巳臨卯位透官星，木火重逢事業成。順得南方人富貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":1329,"lineType":1,"content":"水多金重更無情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":1330,"lineType":2,"content":"己卯日生卯，或寅亥未月遇甲透從火木旺，乃白手成家，如遇金水重重渗洋日，主金重破木怕。行午戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":1331,"lineType":2,"content":"子運，及流年時主之地，不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":1332,"lineType":1,"content":"巳生季月旺身時，不遇官煞旺何為。命有財官如被刼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506025329573903"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":1335,"lineType":1,"content":"運行金水木鄉竒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":1336,"lineType":2,"content":"巳生辰戌丑未月，不遇官煞，空旺不吉，若遇財官之奪，秀而不實，行木金水地，倚運亦發，過此仍旧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":1337,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥日逢乙亥時，豈宜丁火柱中期。運行木火尤堪美，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":1338,"lineType":1,"content":"金水重逢不是竒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":1339,"lineType":2,"content":"巳見重亥，丁為巳梟，亥中壬水，渗洋不利，宜入火木則吉，若行金水運，争戰不條不化，如在秋冬入東南，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":1340,"lineType":2,"content":"則發，午中一咎，辰丑戌宫一礙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":1341,"lineType":1,"content":"巳生辰戌旺根荄，木破重重芽未衰。制運更愁驅煞起，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":1342,"lineType":1,"content":"煞鄉無謂就降猜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064990699546"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":1345,"lineType":2,"content":"巳生三九遇財官，本是一吉，若見煞多安身，身宫不弱，煞與身和，可言富貴，清者堪登科甲。若行制鄉，擊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":1346,"lineType":2,"content":"驅其煞，不吉，行入煞旺方，亦莫以旺煞論，若支遇卯木，更入火木，則吉，行金水不宜，忌煞入墓，及午戌辰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":1347,"lineType":2,"content":"土燥焚木，歲運如逢，輕則傷尅，重則危殆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":1348,"lineType":1,"content":"巳生夏月用辛庚，遇水西行事業成。酉丑喜連申子吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":1349,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢木火病非生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":1350,"lineType":2,"content":"巳生夏月，火藏木泄，若得庚辛透壬癸，及有申子酉丑運，入金水地發財，但見木一位便破格，忌午寅戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1362","lineNum":1351,"lineType":2,"content":"運，此乃無中生有之竒，行金水吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1363","lineNum":1352,"lineType":1,"content":"巳日如逢戌子時，節當官旺煞何疑。丙丁火印來相援，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1364","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506070451634195"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1365","lineNum":1355,"lineType":1,"content":"木進何愁金坐支。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1366","lineNum":1356,"lineType":2,"content":"巳日遇甲子甲戌時合化，宜卯未日支，不謂官煞混。若官旺，或兩甲兩巳，俱是富貴。若被拆合，分金無配，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1367","lineNum":1357,"lineType":2,"content":"及庚申金有根，皆不吉。若金坐寅午戌，局中有木不忌，亦宜丙丁火印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1368","lineNum":1358,"lineType":1,"content":"己坐卯：未逢卯月，天干透乙身更衰。棄命相從翻富貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1369","lineNum":1359,"lineType":1,"content":"如行旺制便生灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1370","lineNum":1360,"lineType":2,"content":"巳卯己未日，更坐卯月，又透一煞，乃棄命格，不宜丁巳重見。若遇制地旺地，是非競起，不遇所忌，發達功","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1371","lineNum":1361,"lineType":2,"content":"名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1372","lineNum":1362,"lineType":1,"content":"巳日如逢丑寅時，身衰宜印貴無疑。行來木火愁金水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1373","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506054712115254"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1374","lineNum":1365,"lineType":1,"content":"四季生人各另推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1375","lineNum":1366,"lineType":2,"content":"巳日用時煞春不須印，亦同棄論。若非春月，純陰俱偏，亦不忌梟。秋生遇乙多最宜，亦要正印，冬怕水多，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1376","lineNum":1367,"lineType":2,"content":"行入火木俱吉。如遇丑辰午戌運，專㸔歲㑹碍，此運有咎，非尅傷為忌，身弱煞旺吉。若財多，更透金水，及","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1377","lineNum":1368,"lineType":2,"content":"用入墓，稱意中亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1378","lineNum":1369,"lineType":1,"content":"巳日如逢戌子時，財官叠見最相宜。若生季月多財禄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1379","lineNum":1370,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺用衰作别推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1380","lineNum":1371,"lineType":2,"content":"巳生辰戌丑未，月日本旺，若叠見甲，或財利禄之人，如化土生正月，坐卯未更吉。怕制合及寅破，忌行午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1381","lineNum":1372,"lineType":2,"content":"戌辰丑鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1382","lineNum":1373,"lineType":1,"content":"如己丑甲戌、巳丑甲子，二品武職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1383","lineNum":1374,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1384","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064483172386"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1385","lineNum":1377,"lineType":1,"content":"戌、己巳甲戌，富貴清髙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":1378,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午甲戌、己巳甲子，巨富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":1379,"lineType":1,"content":"納貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":1380,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳、壬辰、己巳甲戌，富貴輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":1381,"lineType":1,"content":"巳日秋生本用金，干頭却喜木森森。乙連三四皆為吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":1382,"lineType":1,"content":"遇甲相成入翰林。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1391","lineNum":1383,"lineType":2,"content":"巳生秋月本金時，若不露庚辛為用，見一二乙字乃煞，食前煞後，遇丙亦吉，行火木地，富貴。若座下未卯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1392","lineNum":1384,"lineType":2,"content":"更遇兩甲，亦主功名。若庚辛已露，甲乙再見，互相攻擊，反害。忌行木火，稍遂金水，宜詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1393","lineNum":1385,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳得位號髙强，木火雖宜忌火昌。四柱若無金作梗，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1394","lineNum":1386,"lineType":1,"content":"一生名利入嵓廊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1395","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506075912732735"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1396","lineNum":1389,"lineType":2,"content":"勾陳為土得位，乃逢木之謂，如戊寅、己卯、己未、己亥日，更坐亥卯未寅月，方是柱。有火不怕庚辛，遇木火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1397","lineNum":1390,"lineType":2,"content":"運主功名，若火太旺，焦土焚木，不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1398","lineNum":1391,"lineType":8,"content":"論庚辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1399","lineNum":1392,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛春月正逢財，最忌干頭比刼來。官煞要分嫌混雜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1400","lineNum":1393,"lineType":1,"content":"身强用吉乃康哉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1401","lineNum":1394,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辛生正二月，本財遇官煞，只宜獨見，不宜混雜，要身强用吉為貴。  庚生正月，財旺煞生透煞，只宜煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1402","lineNum":1395,"lineType":2,"content":"不宜再見官星。無壬癸、戊己並見日主旺，運行吉地，可言功名。若身坐子午，遇丙透，又逢丁位，無戊己壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1403","lineNum":1396,"lineType":2,"content":"癸，運行子戌午，方為咎。若多遇合衝刼，財多身弱，秀而不實，又怕寅午戌，及梟食歲運，殃禍速至。如庚坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1404","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506020501766194"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1405","lineNum":1399,"lineType":2,"content":"辰，遇丙或丁，不㑹火木及刼，則吉。二月同論，二月庚辰日，連庚辰時，或庚辰月，及間寅字，乃是大格，否則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1406","lineNum":1400,"lineType":2,"content":"乂宜丙丁，為官煞遇印之論，此日亦有用傷官者，須細詳之。若庚生春遇乙，乙庚合化，另是一論，大怕身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1407","lineNum":1401,"lineType":2,"content":"輕財多身弱，遇刼及水局，水多盗氣，火局銷鎔，驅馳病弱之軰。  辛生正二月，或透一丙，不宜壬戌癸亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1408","lineNum":1402,"lineType":2,"content":"壬子壬申，歲運及柱中傍位，再見有丁，却不忌，壬運兩行俱吉。若官煞互見，無去配，作混雜論。如遇地衝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1409","lineNum":1403,"lineType":2,"content":"刼財太重，行火地亦可，水地不吉，兩月不遇火，亦是營利之徒，清者㣲名，難作貴論。若寅午戌時，成一妙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1410","lineNum":1404,"lineType":2,"content":"也。若水多，原本是財，生煞見水，屏火不生，皆不為貴，中亦有沽名釣譽者，太泄困乏。若刼財多入南，頗可，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":1405,"lineType":2,"content":"帶火則發，若無水刼，經行亥戌，稍可，酉申不遂。若丙合辛，只一不遇破，富貴，壬辰時亦有一用，其餘被刼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":1406,"lineType":2,"content":"官煞，及金破水泛，俱作下論。運行火木之鄉，頗宜，再入金水無望。  辛生三月，是印格，喜木火，亦有傷官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1413","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506054712131638"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1414","lineNum":1409,"lineType":2,"content":"格論，稍不忌水，餘忌如之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1415","lineNum":1410,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛夏月兩分評，遇煞逢官各有情。庚遇亥壬煞喜制，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1416","lineNum":1411,"lineType":1,"content":"辛逢丙合利名成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1417","lineNum":1412,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辛夏月，兩干不一，庚生四月本煞，五六月或遇己丙，及寅午戌皆煞，得壬亥癸水制之，無官混格局，清","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1418","lineNum":1413,"lineType":2,"content":"者貴，次者富，混壞减論，無制平平。五月午多見己亦煞，皆要亥子。壬癸制伏，戊己佐助，皆擬富貴，無則患","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1419","lineNum":1414,"lineType":2,"content":"難困乏。六月同論。論辛生四月，乃正官格，遇丙合官，遇丁為煞，俱作貴  行，西北得時，用官，忌壬亥再行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":1415,"lineType":2,"content":"見攻衝，必禍，用煞不忌，得巳午未時為妙。歲運同午，五月煞印在支，亦不宜透，透則宜制，如辛亥日己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":1416,"lineType":2,"content":"未時亦吉，遇壬無害，旋入金水之地，欠佳，原無水行，水亦無害，如辛未、辛卯、辛巳等日，遇巳午未時，行入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506029800620069"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1423","lineNum":1419,"lineType":2,"content":"財官，方堪甲第魁選，有玷减論。水六月宜火木，宜向火木運行，忌壬水旺地，不妨癸，  若不遇火木，遇水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1424","lineNum":1420,"lineType":2,"content":"土刼自旺，更行金水，官煞混雜，太過無制，俱不吉，運忌丑酉亥，乃官煞投墓，輕者非破尅傷，重者尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1425","lineNum":1421,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛秋月太身强，卯未逢支乃吉昌。庚遇午寅宜見水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1426","lineNum":1422,"lineType":1,"content":"辛遭丙衆喜非常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1427","lineNum":1423,"lineType":2,"content":"庚金七八月遇煞最吉，坐寅午戌，見官煞，宜逢壬癸及印，行南運吉，無行南太過不宜。九月遇官煞，清者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1428","lineNum":1424,"lineType":2,"content":"富貴，亦宜壬癸水。若火局火盛無救，行水遂意，行午寅運，則災生，秋絶，無火木氣，不吉。若用壬癸為引領，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1429","lineNum":1425,"lineType":2,"content":"無戊己破，行水地亦擬財，名一辛金，七八月遇丙，二三則吉，行水地發財，若孤立  丙，乃小人也。如無丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1430","lineNum":1426,"lineType":2,"content":"遇丁，則不宜，重以煞多則咎。如無火氣，坐亥卯未，得甲乙木局，行南大發，午未時可擬貴，九月遇丙合不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1431","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064483221538"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1432","lineNum":1429,"lineType":2,"content":"遇丁，乃是一格，可云富貴，亦忌壬亥，如有戊己救，亦吉。若用煞，只宜煞，怕官混，行火旺運生禍，有官㑹木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1433","lineNum":1430,"lineType":2,"content":"成局，行火木運發達。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1434","lineNum":1431,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛冬月作傷官，丁丙無逢金水寒。甲乙相連分上下，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1435","lineNum":1432,"lineType":1,"content":"稱心更要識悲歡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1436","lineNum":1433,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辛生冬月，遇官煞皆擬富貴，如庚生亥子，遇兩官兩煞，一官一煞，俱主利禄，飛禄夾丘亦吉。如無官煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1437","lineNum":1434,"lineType":2,"content":"宜見財星，原無行財官煞運，亦美。若金水自持，更無格局用神，及無木者貧寒，辛金一煞清者富貴。若丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1438","lineNum":1435,"lineType":2,"content":"亥時乃飛禄，如遇丙亦吉，若虚露丙，亦不濟事。如辛卯辛未日得木局，及寅午戌時引火，縱無干火，行火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1439","lineNum":1436,"lineType":2,"content":"木地亦發，若梟多無火木隐露，行火木不吉。丑月乃印也，遇一煞則吉。官輕者，宜行官旺方，若木局行木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1440","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064483188770"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1441","lineNum":1439,"lineType":2,"content":"火，亦主白手成家，土重則埋，水多則沉，宜細詳之。兩干無火木，更無格用，則不成器，其夾丘飛禄，怕行官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1442","lineNum":1440,"lineType":2,"content":"煞方，若己酉丑局無格，遇辰巳時，行水地金地，亦作上命論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1443","lineNum":1441,"lineType":1,"content":"庚生四月己多逢，壬癸透干作制功。南北兩行皆富貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1444","lineNum":1442,"lineType":1,"content":"却嫌戊甲在其中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1445","lineNum":1443,"lineType":2,"content":"庚生四月，遇己午，多宜見壬亥，如遇丁混有癸，皆主功名。如透丙，或見戊甲，及官混，無癸破之，又無壬亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1446","lineNum":1444,"lineType":2,"content":"減論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1447","lineNum":1445,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛七八比肩來，格局無成又没財。水用北行為利禄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1448","lineNum":1446,"lineType":1,"content":"逢財争競一時災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1449","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506054712148022"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1450","lineNum":1449,"lineType":2,"content":"此乃用水。庚日壬午癸未時，辛日壬辰、癸巳時，外己丑己亥時，皆比肩，更無火木，以自旺日為用，乃逢戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1451","lineNum":1450,"lineType":2,"content":"己行水地，發達，若行木，及見甲乙柱，原比肩多，庚辛無財，遇財争奪，不可以見財為吉論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1452","lineNum":1451,"lineType":1,"content":"庚金坐午又為提，丁巳齊明両可宜。干支無丙來雜混，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1453","lineNum":1452,"lineType":1,"content":"水絶肩多作富推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1454","lineNum":1453,"lineType":2,"content":"庚午日生，五月透丁巳，官印俱明，發達利名，若午多壬午時，亦吉，如遇丙煞不利，若從煞格，宜水制之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1455","lineNum":1454,"lineType":1,"content":"如己丑、庚午庚午、丁丑巨富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1456","lineNum":1455,"lineType":1,"content":"庚居子午月逢寅，官煞相淆干上評。子午運中愁咎起，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1457","lineNum":1456,"lineType":1,"content":"戊壬若遇暗回明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1458","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506054712164406"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1459","lineNum":1459,"lineType":2,"content":"庚子庚午生寅午戌月遇煞，在柱混淆，更見財多，無水土扶濟，乃弱論，再行子午則灾，若遇壬癸戊己，反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1460","lineNum":1460,"lineType":2,"content":"為吉論。困，如辛丑、庚寅、庚子、丙戌身弱，行子亥運顛。    癸卯、甲寅、庚戌、丙戌，此亦不足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1461","lineNum":1461,"lineType":1,"content":"庚金冬月本元疲，壬癸多逢盗日脂。丙丁若來庚更暖，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1462","lineNum":1462,"lineType":1,"content":"逢温都作利名推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1463","lineNum":1463,"lineType":2,"content":"庚生冬月，本弱，又遇水多盗氣，須得丙丁火照，乃可謂吉，如無火見財亦可。此言金水傷官，宜見官煞，可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1464","lineNum":1464,"lineType":2,"content":"以成就功名，終不大就，以本原疲也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1465","lineNum":1465,"lineType":1,"content":"庚生寒月丙雙存，便是功名利禄人。行運柱中攻戰闘，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1466","lineNum":1466,"lineType":1,"content":"却愁稱意没荆榛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1467","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506048637255714"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1468","lineNum":1469,"lineType":2,"content":"庚生秋冬，逢両丙為夾煞，其勢急矣。名彰乃煞之用，吉者甚吉，㐫者甚㓙，若運行擊觸煞起，及㑹衝刑之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1469","lineNum":1470,"lineType":2,"content":"地，其㓙不可當，多不善終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1470","lineNum":1471,"lineType":1,"content":"庚逢寅午巳提綱，遇亥同壬利禄昌。丙火透干無水制，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1471","lineNum":1472,"lineType":1,"content":"不堪回首嘆凄凉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1472","lineNum":1473,"lineType":2,"content":"庚生寅午戌巳月遇壬，亥字功名發財，若丙透無水制，及無印支，離惆悵之人，如坐寅午戌，忌丙丁、丙寅、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1473","lineNum":1474,"lineType":2,"content":"丙午、丙戌，歲運輕者悲傷訟耗，重則患難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":1475,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子秋冬水局全，井欄义格理誠淵。柱中無火方成貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":1476,"lineType":1,"content":"青赤交持未是便。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506029800652837"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1477","lineNum":1479,"lineType":2,"content":"庚子日乃中堂㑹申辰衝寅午戌中財，官干是庚用地支，水局及比肩多方是。若格不全，金水多則是傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1478","lineNum":1480,"lineType":2,"content":"官，如逢丙火煞，論母執此格言。遇丙破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1479","lineNum":1481,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日都宜丑亥時，癸壬相見亦相宜。丙逢亦許居名利，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1480","lineNum":1482,"lineType":1,"content":"土重財多反壞之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1481","lineNum":1483,"lineType":2,"content":"庚秋冬遇丑亥時，乃一用，如遇壬癸透亦吉，本是水用，以火為副用，且不嫌相見，若土重木多，不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":1484,"lineType":1,"content":"庚逢壬癸在秋冬，有子生財各利名。時歲木星相合見，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":1485,"lineType":1,"content":"金方發達見梟平。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":1486,"lineType":2,"content":"庚日秋冬無火，用水為導引，兼癸水，乃傷官生財，亦有夾丘之格。壬午、丁亥、癸未時，或庚寅日、庚辰時、庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506075912765503"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":1489,"lineType":2,"content":"申日、壬午時，怕行午運，此是寅辰日，俱忌辰時。戊土入庫，及戊歲運不吉，動傷枝葉，是非顚倒，咎禍不測，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":1490,"lineType":2,"content":"有子傷子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":1491,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未辛卯坐支財，最宜丁丙向干来。月生寅卯甲乙透，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":1492,"lineType":1,"content":"富比陶朱不用猜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":1493,"lineType":2,"content":"辛未、辛卯坐財，喜透丁乙為吉，宜寅卯午未亥月，如用丙，忌丁壬亥，宜火木旺地，不宜水金旺鄉，秋冬煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":1494,"lineType":2,"content":"旺根，不宜入南寅午戌妙，亥日亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":1495,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日提綱戌巳寅，貴乎丙火擢元神。再財庶利官加爵，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1493","lineNum":1496,"lineType":1,"content":"最怕相逢見亥壬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1494","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506070451699731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1495","lineNum":1499,"lineType":2,"content":"辛日生人，巳戌月透丙，是一貴格，主功名富貴。若遇亥壬壞格，雖得己戊破之，格亦不清。如逢寅午戌時，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1496","lineNum":1500,"lineType":2,"content":"又云一吉怕丁混。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1497","lineNum":1501,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金寒月兔猪羊，局㑹財成富貴詳。無火莫言金水冷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1498","lineNum":1502,"lineType":1,"content":"全陰福禄怕梟傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1499","lineNum":1503,"lineType":2,"content":"辛生秋冬，以卯為尊，若局全亥未，主發財吉。飛禄又是他格柱，丑亥多衝，己為禄馬，如全陰化，柱中無火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1500","lineNum":1504,"lineType":2,"content":"不可以金寒水冷言之，但忌無格梟煞。此以辛癸潤澤隂木，遇土則黨，須行木地則吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1501","lineNum":1505,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金最喜赤青逢，丁乙相逢名利通。青赤不加名利改，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1502","lineNum":1506,"lineType":1,"content":"水金相見落殘紅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1503","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506020501798962"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1504","lineNum":1509,"lineType":2,"content":"辛日宜弱，喜火木，忌金水。春夏遇火木，兩行皆吉，惟酉地則否。若原刼多行財，則㓙原財遇比行亥戌運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1505","lineNum":1510,"lineType":2,"content":"可入酉，亦㓙用丙忌壬，亥怕癸，屏之，成則富貴，破則困滯。秋冬原有火木，重者入南不吉，破丁乙又不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1506","lineNum":1511,"lineType":2,"content":"五隂之干顛倒而人不知，不宜身旺須中和則可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1507","lineNum":1512,"lineType":1,"content":"辛衰春夏行西可，官煞秋冬南地㓙。木火畏逢金水破，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1508","lineNum":1513,"lineType":1,"content":"秋冬要火木重鎔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1509","lineNum":1514,"lineType":2,"content":"辛日春夏衰甚，火木週遭原無水刼，行西亦吉。若辛不弱，帶刼水，行金亦不吉。秋冬有火木，亦宜入南。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1510","lineNum":1515,"lineType":2,"content":"以火木為用，怕金水破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":1516,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日如逢丙甲壬，相生相益又相征。東南運底宜名利，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064483254306"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":1519,"lineType":1,"content":"西北無成向酉傾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":1520,"lineType":2,"content":"辛日見丙、甲、壬三物，乃壬生甲，甲生丙，又壬尅丙，為征行西北，乃歸致之鄉，用此如㫁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":1521,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日東南丁酉時，火方名利却相宜。金强水旺虧財禄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":1522,"lineType":1,"content":"西北風寒葉自飛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":1523,"lineType":2,"content":"辛生春夏丁酉時，則是一格，行火木方，功名發達，柱原刼水，又行金水，乃虧財禄，所謂火木盛早成，入西","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":1524,"lineType":2,"content":"北惆悵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":1525,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日秋生怕煞肥，冬生水火喜東離。赤青月令嫌行水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":1526,"lineType":1,"content":"無火傷官恨酉西。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506070451732499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":1529,"lineType":2,"content":"金水傷官，宜見官也。夏無傷官之名，乃官印遇水，反破正官，春亦忌之，水無益用木生官水則盗氣，濕木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":1530,"lineType":2,"content":"則火難明，官不能生。惟秋冬金水之時，乃云金水傷官，喜見官煞亦同，論財亦可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":1531,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日如逢寅午時，戌亥卯未亦如之。火明木秀財名就，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":1532,"lineType":1,"content":"事不偕兮金水依。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":1533,"lineType":2,"content":"辛日，若得寅午戌亥卯未時，俱是一吉，宜木秀火明俱吉。若金水行入丑辰運，銷金絶墓，及申酉亥之方，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":1534,"lineType":2,"content":"擬其非耗病傷丁，煞重則死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":1535,"lineType":8,"content":"論壬癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":1536,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸春生喜㑹財，干支得土亦竒哉。無財營獲難成利，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506029800669221"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":1539,"lineType":1,"content":"木遇金多成㫁荄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":1540,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸生正二月，用木喜見比肩及食傷，透干不畏官煞，最妙見財，切忌金重，反壞木用，如浮金無害。  壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":1541,"lineType":2,"content":"生正二月，遇寅辰午戌，干透一甲二甲，得全陽，寅辰多清者貴，有寅風無雲者富，火局亦富。南行不忌戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":1542,"lineType":2,"content":"兼庚透丙甲，亦宜得丑亥時為妙。若金重，忌財輕木少，行西北不吉。  二月寅午戌辰日，遇戊己庚辛己，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":1543,"lineType":2,"content":"是一貴格，行南北俱吉，透甲為用，忌見梟，遇丙屏之，亦吉。  三月有煞印之名，官印一格成則富貴。若寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":1544,"lineType":2,"content":"辰午戌日，干遇一甲兩甲，乃富，風雲騎龍虎，則貴，但怕申酉衝刑，運若刼旺，無火土，隂陽交混，旺金尅木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":1545,"lineType":2,"content":"又無火屏，驅馳命也。又癸日生正月，寅時刑合格，忌庚申已，得亥丑辰時，  是一格，比肩行南北俱吉，忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":1546,"lineType":2,"content":"官煞財印透行南不吉。如秉中和入格，両行富貴，切忌金多，又遇財官煞印，不吉。  二月寅時擬貴格，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506070451716115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":1549,"lineType":2,"content":"忌浮土浮金，亦不忌庚申，或近三月，庚字全隂，亦可擬貴。若辰巳卯時行吉亦發，不甚忌土。若金局再入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":1550,"lineType":2,"content":"水金之地，不吉。亦三月有官煞為用，遇辰巳午未時是一格，申酉時  是一格，俱忌甲木，若無根上多亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":1551,"lineType":2,"content":"不為害，透木亦嫌甲寅時。比肩不忌原有官煞，忌行官煞方，  此春月，俱宜比肩，及見火土，皆主富貴。忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":1552,"lineType":2,"content":"庚申辛酉㑹金折木，若浮金不忌辰月，不忌見金，正二月原無比肩，有財官多，忌行財官運，謂之太過，傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":1553,"lineType":2,"content":"妻尅子，一度重則變，俱忌申子行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":1554,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸生炎論旺賒，若逢梟印盛無涯。有根壬子方成美，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":1555,"lineType":1,"content":"癸水無根作大家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":1556,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸生夏，以火土為用，不宜比刼，夏月水衰官煞旺，但得印綬，則成士夫君子。食傷為財官之忌，惟刑合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506048637288482"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":1559,"lineType":2,"content":"從彼論，不忌寅上之甲，若得巳配則吉，可壬子、壬寅、壬午、壬戌日生，四五月遇戊庚辛一透  擬貴，偏官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":1560,"lineType":2,"content":"偏印，貴髙財足，正官印次之，刼刃財名反覆。若甲丙透不足，得巳配頗遂，怕丙丁，丁從化亦吉。  五月忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":1561,"lineType":2,"content":"衝官，庚戊透從煞不忌，惟壬申日不喜財官，丙甲透成煞印可也。  六月傷官一格，㑹全者貴富，亦宜正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":1562,"lineType":2,"content":"印。壬寅、壬午、壬辰、壬戌日，遇官印煞印一格，清者貴，淆者次。壬子㑹傷為合，亦可擬貴。  癸日四五月，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":1563,"lineType":2,"content":"就財富貴，遇申酉辰巳午未丑卯時，皆作吉論，刼多不吉，全陰大吉，化火大富貴，煞印亦然。  六月有煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":1564,"lineType":2,"content":"印一格，貴，如丙辰丁巳時，又辛巳二時，俱主功名。甲寅時刑合格，怕庚申重刑，宜亥卯未，全富貴，忌戊己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":1565,"lineType":2,"content":"戌，用食傷比肩多，行東方，大發財，木用怕金，土用宜金。又壬日六月得寅辰午戌日，支干透戊己，富貴可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":1566,"lineType":2,"content":"擬，趨艮亦吉。遇丁多反覆，㑹甲宜木火，忌徃金行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506075912814655"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":1569,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸生臨旺九秋，功名火土遂情求。如無火土猶行北，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1559","lineNum":1570,"lineType":1,"content":"幾度歡娛幾度愁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1560","lineNum":1571,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸生，秋乃印，其作用要火土，火土秋月不時，雖多無害，如無火土，行北，旣在中秋，逢生太過，乃不足之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1561","lineNum":1572,"lineType":2,"content":"流。論壬生七月，歲月俱寅，又得辰戌，時得戌申，以煞印  順行富貴，子位欠吉，行南破印，若止一丙，孤棲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1562","lineNum":1573,"lineType":2,"content":"申子辰上，行南無害，順行怕寅火。八月遇戊字及戊申時，順則貴，逆則富，亦有原無，  遇刼行火亦貴，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":1574,"lineType":2,"content":"忌。丙陽九月，煞印官印，又是一格，其地自有煞印，若得全  及遇庚，富貴。若近冬生，更坐辰午寅戌干遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":1575,"lineType":2,"content":"甲木，主大富，清者貴。若丑亥寅辰時，干支遇煞則吉，若遇重木，金木交争，及刑衝者㓙。  癸日七八月遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":1576,"lineType":2,"content":"庚申時，合禄，七月遇火，火土行北亦吉，忌寅丙衝提，㑹火之地，見火返南則破。若辰巳時土多，両行皆吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064990765082"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":1579,"lineType":2,"content":"返八月遇戊己丙丁，及地支火土，行北富貴，但子少，  南有子，又怕傷印衝提。若癸巳日或亥巳日時比","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":1580,"lineType":2,"content":"肩，多得申酉印，行北功名，但財不聚，怕遇衝提刑地。七八月原無戊土，如逢甲，及原有甲申，行戌寅，乃傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":1581,"lineType":2,"content":"官，見官亦言稱意。中有純陰成格亦吉。若水不相持，陰陽混雜，則录此両干。七八月最宜土火為妙，  癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":1582,"lineType":2,"content":"日九月不妨比肩忌亥日，時乃隐甲害戊，若土多則富。申庚辛時，巳辰午未卯，但得一格俱吉，若通寅申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":1583,"lineType":2,"content":"縱有利名，立見反覆。此月入冬令，甲寅時得干從刑合格論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":1584,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸時垣比刼逢，運歸旺地反成功。如逢火土從他格，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":1585,"lineType":1,"content":"食木飛刑又不同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":1586,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸生冬令，再行旺地，飛天禄馬，禄從旺則吉，怕逢火土，如壬生十月、十一月，遇比刼，多是飛禄格，忌官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506075912831039"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":1589,"lineType":2,"content":"塡實。若水局從旺，如全陽得甲丙行東南，大發富貴，見丁合化亦吉。如遇戊乃煞，宜庚辛為印，不宜見甲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":1590,"lineType":2,"content":"如用地支，宜寅午戌辰，俱有火土，主功名輕重言之，如己辰丑亥時，一用俱喜行東南方，清者貴，混者次，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":1591,"lineType":2,"content":"此身旺宜任也。寅丑月官煞多，或遇丙丁，宜行酉地吉，偏官偏印，及  午戌辰日時食傷之類，皆可論吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":1592,"lineType":2,"content":"東癸水十月全隂，乃飛禄，亦有乙卯時食傷為用，行  南發福，己未時乃煞，庚申辛酉時乃合禄，飛禄遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":1593,"lineType":2,"content":"印，亦可名利見。戊官印己煞印忌。行丙丁官煞多貴小富，宜行土金旺地，但子少。  十一月亦有飛禄食","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":1594,"lineType":2,"content":"木之用，乃刑合夾丘等格，遇申酉時亦宜己煞清者貴，次者富。壬癸混刼主用乏，如癸巳、癸丑、癸亥、癸酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":1595,"lineType":2,"content":"多互，卽財官煞印，不忌飛玷，亦有土多卽煞印，非邀己格，両月同論，  十二月全陰，卽煞非飛禄也。先正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":1596,"lineType":2,"content":"所謂無煞方重用，有煞用難重，如遇官則化，見己従煞，亦宜印透為吉，怕壬陽混刼，金水交争。其癸干冬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506020501815346"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":1599,"lineType":2,"content":"月甲寅時無印，土金透刼亦竒，運宜東南方，乙卯時宜火土全隂，行東南發達，忌庚申辛酉在干。丑月無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":1600,"lineType":2,"content":"合禄格，申時酉時乃煞印忌財，方有刼小畏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":1601,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸秋生比刼多，無財財地奈貧何。干支有土兼逢火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":1602,"lineType":1,"content":"雨後桃夭春已過。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":1603,"lineType":2,"content":"此比肩多，原無財，行財地比肩争財不吉，若干支有火土，雖少比刼，頼刼蔽印，初行貧乏，行財地發財，但","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":1604,"lineType":2,"content":"不久耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":1605,"lineType":1,"content":"壬生己月戊丙該，煞印相逢大用材。癸日臨期應擬富，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":1606,"lineType":1,"content":"只愁原帶食傷來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506075912863807"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1594","lineNum":1609,"lineType":2,"content":"壬寅壬戌日生於己月，己中有丙戊庚三偏竒為用，癸日遇此乃三正竒，皆富貴之擬，忌比刼及甲字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1595","lineNum":1610,"lineType":2,"content":"癸日遇乙卯時乃破土，甲寅時乃壞土，不吉，土多亦不妨，大抵吉中生㐫甚則危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1596","lineNum":1611,"lineType":1,"content":"壬生七月印屬申，火木相逢便是春。無刼有官多吉慶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1597","lineNum":1612,"lineType":1,"content":"刼來相伴主薄貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1598","lineNum":1613,"lineType":2,"content":"金為水母，秋金太旺，無土則流，故宜見財官為美。運宜順行，柱無火土及梟食相持，遇南行運則吉，行北","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1599","lineNum":1614,"lineType":2,"content":"不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1600","lineNum":1615,"lineType":1,"content":"壬坐申辰子亥中，比全水局甲無功。東南北地皆名利，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1601","lineNum":1616,"lineType":1,"content":"金再相逢又是空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1602","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064483303458"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1603","lineNum":1619,"lineType":2,"content":"壬日坐冬，申子辰全，日干本旺，若得辰時，或干支别透，寅甲食神，財行東南大發，見庚戊争征不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1604","lineNum":1620,"lineType":1,"content":"壬日蛇提六獸支，内中壬午别為宜。餘逢陽土多尊貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1605","lineNum":1621,"lineType":1,"content":"甲木飛來便可疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1606","lineNum":1622,"lineType":2,"content":"壬日坐申辰子寅生四月乃富貴，得庚辛透更吉，若帶刃逢煞，主權要顯職，其中有混比，財印相持，主才","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1607","lineNum":1623,"lineType":2,"content":"髙不第，或異路功名，妾多無子。壬午一日乃支官也，清者貴，俱忌甲木遇甲，得己合庚透不妨，若丙甲丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1608","lineNum":1624,"lineType":2,"content":"俱露，不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1609","lineNum":1625,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌壬寅散月生，干頭喜透戊和庚。煞多尤利風雲㑹，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1610","lineNum":1626,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴愁逢丙甲申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1611","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064990781466"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1612","lineNum":1629,"lineType":2,"content":"此二日散生柱，宜見庚戊，透辛亦吉，若干支煞多尤吉，怕逢丙與甲，黨煞壞印及官星混，夏月尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1613","lineNum":1630,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申夏月赤黄時，干遇財官不是奇。庚戌若來成一妙，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1614","lineNum":1631,"lineType":1,"content":"豈期丙甲両相依。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1615","lineNum":1632,"lineType":2,"content":"此日夏月不喜財，官多原有根也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1616","lineNum":1633,"lineType":1,"content":"壬騎龍背喜風雲，財局之中亦自欣。遇甲全陽名利客，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1617","lineNum":1634,"lineType":1,"content":"戊庚一見要詳分。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1618","lineNum":1635,"lineType":2,"content":"壬騎龍背，以辰寅為風雲，多者主富貴，若寅午戌，財局亦吉。柱透甲最妙。如遇庚戊乃壞格，若戊申時，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1619","lineNum":1636,"lineType":2,"content":"煞論，當細詳之。年如己丑、戊辰、壬辰、庚子，甲子年中舉，卽尅父，戊辰  煞重二月死，是見庚戊壞格。  如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1620","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064990814234"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1621","lineNum":1639,"lineType":2,"content":"壬辰、甲辰、壬寅、庚子大貴，是透甲全寅辰妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1622","lineNum":1640,"lineType":1,"content":"壬臨午位禄馬同，疊見財官富貴翁。春喜見金不怕木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1623","lineNum":1641,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢子月土成功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1624","lineNum":1642,"lineType":2,"content":"壬午日，丁己為用，春生本忌木害官，若遇庚辛己酉、丑，則不忌。子月得土多，則能制癸子，雖衝午丁，自若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1625","lineNum":1643,"lineType":2,"content":"也。若生夏月，財官多者皆貴。庚、癸己、己未、壬午、己酉貴。  癸巳、己未、壬午  子，丙辰狀元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1626","lineNum":1644,"lineType":1,"content":"癸居金局己辰時，月値卯寅水木滋。最喜煞官來入格，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1627","lineNum":1645,"lineType":1,"content":"平生名利自相宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1628","lineNum":1646,"lineType":2,"content":"癸日逢己酉丑，梟印也，生春月，以木為用，亦不相害，遇官煞則為吉。辰、巳二時，乃財官也，格中忌破。丙丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1629","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506029800701989"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1630","lineNum":1649,"lineType":2,"content":"二引用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1631","lineNum":1650,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日如逢己酉丑，時利庚申南地走。木火功名比刼嫌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1632","lineNum":1651,"lineType":1,"content":"財官入格命少有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1633","lineNum":1652,"lineType":2,"content":"癸酉、癸丑、癸巳，此三日生，遇庚申時，宜火木方行吉，怕比肩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1634","lineNum":1653,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日多財春夏間，若成棄命福難攀。干頭官煞來相混，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1635","lineNum":1654,"lineType":1,"content":"猶事驅馳不解閒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1636","lineNum":1655,"lineType":2,"content":"癸日生，春夏遇財多，乃棄命就財，若遇庚辛戊己，又從煞印之論。四者怕相混，以財印有相征之忌。若戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1637","lineNum":1656,"lineType":2,"content":"己為用，又是他格，庚戊又是一用，辛己又是一用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1638","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064483287074"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1639","lineNum":1659,"lineType":1,"content":"癸生春夏食傷提，比刼重逢尅子妻。如得干支存火土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1640","lineNum":1660,"lineType":1,"content":"更行南地禄財齊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1641","lineNum":1661,"lineType":2,"content":"癸生春，以木為用，比刼多，更無火土藏透，乃尅妻子不堪之命，行北尤為不吉。若得火土為佐，及陽干多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1642","lineNum":1662,"lineType":2,"content":"甲透，并行南地，其子更多，此乃無中生有，而人難知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1643","lineNum":1663,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日如逢己未時，煞星更怕戊來持。如或制盡行財地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1644","lineNum":1664,"lineType":1,"content":"不是人間富貴兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1645","lineNum":1665,"lineType":2,"content":"癸日未時乃煞見戊要從化，又嫌己妬，所以不宜。戊己俱透，須宜制，又怕太過，秀而不實。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1646","lineNum":1666,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥多肩九月生，金水運底最無成。若行南地無寅甲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1647","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506048637321250"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1648","lineNum":1669,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴功名㫁可成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1649","lineNum":1670,"lineType":2,"content":"癸亥日生，九月見比肩多，行金水地不吉，行南方及火土皆吉，惟怕寅甲戊申，戊土忌寅申，如得南行不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1650","lineNum":1671,"lineType":2,"content":"忌，再行水地不吉，若非亥日遇寅甲，有比肩亦吉。如甲寅時近十月，作戌月推，乃作水論，如遇庚申字火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1651","lineNum":1672,"lineType":2,"content":"土多，不忌亥寅，甲行火土旺，亦可名利。如己未時煞不畏寅甲亥戊午時，畏甲不畏亥寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1652","lineNum":1673,"lineType":1,"content":"癸生秋月水金明，火土相逢便有情。比刼可圖南地禄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1653","lineNum":1674,"lineType":1,"content":"赤黄順北有功名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1654","lineNum":1675,"lineType":2,"content":"秋生比刼多，火土少，行南有禄，雖有財，名不實，原見火土多，行北不吉。  癸亥庚申、癸亥乙卯，南貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1655","lineNum":1676,"lineType":1,"content":"癸生秋月印生身，丙火相逢亦不嗔。有土許成名利客，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1656","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064579624995"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1657","lineNum":1679,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢寅甲䘮青春。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1658","lineNum":1680,"lineType":2,"content":"癸遇丙不嫌破印，有土乃吉，見巳午及戊己，辰戌丑未俱吉，若干支有寅甲遺患，雖印格成，亦無功名。行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1659","lineNum":1681,"lineType":2,"content":"運再遇寅甲，衝印銷印，變改忽然，其㓙不測。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1660","lineNum":1682,"lineType":1,"content":"癸居羊兔甲寅時，刑合格中最是竒。行運只嫌申午地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1661","lineNum":1683,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹青枝上利名期。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1662","lineNum":1684,"lineType":2,"content":"癸日寅時，乃刑合傷官，宜春亥、卯、未月，要木局全則貴。行木局及歲運，木秀利名可期。午、戌亦富貴。忌戊、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1663","lineNum":1685,"lineType":2,"content":"庚、申及戌、戊，重運不吉。卯甲子、丙寅、癸丑、甲寅，行申中休致。  丙子、辛、  癸亥、甲寅，行申休官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1664","lineNum":1686,"lineType":1,"content":"甲坤黄數五。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1665","lineNum":1686,"lineType":2,"content":"火生土旺，納音取用，以下專重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1666","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064579641379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1667","lineNum":1689,"lineType":1,"content":"甲人戊癸本非殊，或加從革應相呼。四位土支逢一二，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1668","lineNum":1690,"lineType":1,"content":"禄厚權清出帝都。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1669","lineNum":1691,"lineType":2,"content":"用眞火生眞土。有戊無癸，以子代之；有癸無戊，以己代之。子巳乃土成實之地，己酉丑，福元旺，水生焉。辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1670","lineNum":1692,"lineType":2,"content":"戌、丑、未四土，若逢一二位，為成實之格。子己代戊癸，甲人有戊癸，合戊子、癸巳，辰戌丑未最貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1671","lineNum":1693,"lineType":1,"content":"雲漢秀氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1672","lineNum":1693,"lineType":2,"content":"火中見水，暗金官神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1673","lineNum":1694,"lineType":1,"content":"甲人見火為孤獨，水若相逢却至清。若見丙來加子午，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1674","lineNum":1695,"lineType":1,"content":"定向初年達縉紳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1675","lineNum":1696,"lineType":2,"content":"木見火傷，金得水制也。丙子、丙午，乃水中有火，火中有水，木人得之，乃五行至清之氣。木得火多，則馳騁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1676","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506075912880191"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1677","lineNum":1699,"lineType":2,"content":"聰明，好學勤禮，立身孤獨。如得旺水，主財薄清貴。論曰：甲人以金為福，火盛則傷金，見水則火殆，五行要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1678","lineNum":1700,"lineType":2,"content":"有制抑，則轉禍為福。又甲㑹丙子，丙午旺水中合起辛未，辛丑，本家眞官，天乙貴人，無中設象，乃五行清","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1679","lineNum":1701,"lineType":2,"content":"華之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1680","lineNum":1702,"lineType":1,"content":"福禄歸根。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1681","lineNum":1702,"lineType":2,"content":"火土生官，忌木反元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1682","lineNum":1703,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙相逢土最精，不逢木辱足珠珍。辰戌両位如逢火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1683","lineNum":1704,"lineType":1,"content":"少歩青雲日益新。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1684","lineNum":1705,"lineType":2,"content":"土能生金，為木之官，無木傷土，福禄自然渾厚。辰戌之位，卽其中逢火，能生無窮之土。土旣渾厚，金自然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1685","lineNum":1706,"lineType":2,"content":"壯，乃無中之有也。論曰：辰戌乃魁罡之地，土旣鍾毓，更得干音。火神滋養，則氣數明爽，子子孫孫，相為羽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1686","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064990830618"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1687","lineNum":1709,"lineType":2,"content":"翼，福禄厚矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1688","lineNum":1710,"lineType":1,"content":"蔭助清竒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1689","lineNum":1710,"lineType":2,"content":"敗金逢旺土，官神益壮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1690","lineNum":1711,"lineType":1,"content":"丁蛇己酉金偏慕，縱逢火盛不為㓙。若見甲來加子午，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1691","lineNum":1712,"lineType":1,"content":"雲路峥嶸。早歲通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1692","lineNum":1713,"lineType":2,"content":"金生在巳，却逢丁巳；金旺在酉，却逢己酉。正胎中逢父母，轉見生旺，雖有火藏，未能奈何，蓋本源深厚也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1693","lineNum":1714,"lineType":2,"content":"以丁巳、己酉二位土神，能化其毒，不傷於金。然甲子、甲午二金，帶一路死敗之氣，旣有丁巳、己酉壮其本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1694","lineNum":1715,"lineType":2,"content":"源，故陰陽得中，金神之德，挺持可知，又何敗之有？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1695","lineNum":1716,"lineType":1,"content":"天地有餘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1696","lineNum":1716,"lineType":2,"content":"木加火盛，官神銷鑠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1697","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064579739683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1698","lineNum":1719,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰甲戌皆炎火，木作干神本自生。重遇木神駢輔翼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1699","lineNum":1720,"lineType":1,"content":"虛名雖有不遷升。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1700","lineNum":1721,"lineType":2,"content":"甲屬木，加辰戌土，納音火，是干分，帶木卽本位，自能發揚天地有餘之氣，不得外加木。若木多則又傷辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1701","lineNum":1722,"lineType":2,"content":"戌之土，不能為福。五行中如此理，尤用消詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1702","lineNum":1723,"lineType":1,"content":"破散離業。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1703","lineNum":1723,"lineType":2,"content":"木生火旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1704","lineNum":1724,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌本是火潜藏，木發其神轉更忙。又値木臨寅午戌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1705","lineNum":1725,"lineType":1,"content":"蕩除家業遠離鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1706","lineNum":1726,"lineType":2,"content":"甲戌本是伏藏火要安静，却以木發起，何益五行當生卽生，當伏卽伏，反此為禍。况火到戌亥，以四時推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1707","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506020501897266"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1708","lineNum":1729,"lineType":2,"content":"之，自不可發露，所以破財論曰：甲戌本木中宿火，見木則火熾。若更臨寅午戌宫，木得火局，則焚傷飛馳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1709","lineNum":1730,"lineType":2,"content":"不得歸元，所以流移鄉井，事多歇㓕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1710","lineNum":1731,"lineType":1,"content":"夭横無依。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1711","lineNum":1731,"lineType":2,"content":"禄位逢火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1712","lineNum":1732,"lineType":1,"content":"甲人寅重莫逢火，見火平生多坎坷，不然禄馬不陞遷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1713","lineNum":1733,"lineType":1,"content":"又恐天年多□□。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1714","lineNum":1734,"lineType":2,"content":"寅為火生之地，寅旣重，若又見火，火更有氣，庚辛受制，所以觸事迍邅。人皆言甲禄在寅，不知一火便能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1715","lineNum":1735,"lineType":2,"content":"為害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1716","lineNum":1736,"lineType":8,"content":"乙四眞金太陰化氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1717","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064579706915"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1718","lineNum":1739,"lineType":1,"content":"六乙之人遇丙辛，從魁大吉要傳名，傳送更加逢太乙，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1719","lineNum":1740,"lineType":1,"content":"便是中書燮理人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1720","lineNum":1741,"lineType":2,"content":"乙陰金，故生其水，母生子為親，若遇己酉丑生其子有丙無辛，以酉代之，有辛無丙，以巳代之，為秀實之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1721","lineNum":1742,"lineType":2,"content":"氣，故貴。論曰：三位子母俱旺，福㑹之慶。己酉以攝丙辛，乙遇丙辛，合丙辛己酉丑為貴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1722","lineNum":1743,"lineType":8,"content":"滋蔭返元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1723","lineNum":1744,"lineType":1,"content":"六乙生人正月内，蛇窠逢土少年榮。若見剛金臨煞位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1724","lineNum":1745,"lineType":1,"content":"必主兵權定塞塵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1725","lineNum":1746,"lineType":2,"content":"乙人正月以戊寅髙阜之土，乙庚之氣絶處逢父母，故喜見之。丁己乃蛇窠之土，金神生處逢父母。又乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1726","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506020501946418"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1727","lineNum":1749,"lineType":2,"content":"人見庚辰，乃羊刃煞，然而五行壮旺，更加此煞，須領兵刑之任。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1728","lineNum":1750,"lineType":8,"content":"鬼作截福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1729","lineNum":1751,"lineType":1,"content":"六乙怕逢丙丁盛，如無救助定成㐫。若値五行多水數，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1730","lineNum":1752,"lineType":1,"content":"陽土相臨主大隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1731","lineNum":1753,"lineType":2,"content":"丙丁若盛，金神不能發生，乙人所以不喜見之。若四柱中見水，可以制火，要得一位陽神之土扶持，如戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1732","lineNum":1754,"lineType":2,"content":"寅、戊申之類，五行又却還元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1733","lineNum":1754,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00005_0_12","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1734","lineNum":1754,"lineType":2,"content":"云：當憂不憂，頼五行之救助。良有以也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1735","lineNum":1755,"lineType":8,"content":"丙水乾龍之數一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1736","lineNum":1756,"lineType":1,"content":"六丙生人不見丙，己來同甲格最清。大吉若加并太乙，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1737","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087904116776"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1738","lineNum":1759,"lineType":1,"content":"名標金榜世傳名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1739","lineNum":1760,"lineType":2,"content":"水之類，火之屬，得木而生焉。甲己土合壮其丙火，土旺金生，有甲無己，以未代之，有己無甲，以寅代之，此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1740","lineNum":1761,"lineType":2,"content":"為反陰滋陽之理。水加木而清，丑為大吉，巳為太乙，丑乃金神墓地，故生丙水為秀實也。寅未代甲己，丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1741","lineNum":1762,"lineType":2,"content":"人有甲己未、寅卯巳丑貴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1742","lineNum":1763,"lineType":8,"content":"福禄還藏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1743","lineNum":1764,"lineType":1,"content":"丙人從革火為良，又乘巳位旺青揚。更得炎宫干木火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1744","lineNum":1765,"lineType":1,"content":"定知早達佐朝堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1745","lineNum":1766,"lineType":2,"content":"丙人喜見巳酉丑金位，如無巳酉丑日，時中有金神亦得用，得巳乃為眞官之貴。巳午二位干逢木，乃為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1746","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506020501930034"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1747","lineNum":1769,"lineType":2,"content":"丙人之福。火人得從革局，乃為尅財生官之象。若得巳巳之類，則火人禄氣純全。更寅午戌三位干頭，得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1748","lineNum":1770,"lineType":2,"content":"丙甲二字，其氣愈見强壮。陰陽書所謂火人得地無水，而仕路優游，抑有自也。有水則損。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1749","lineNum":1771,"lineType":8,"content":"禄旺興元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1750","lineNum":1772,"lineType":1,"content":"六丙生人火數多，更加一木最相和。剛明清健多榮禄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1751","lineNum":1773,"lineType":1,"content":"金神更壮早巍峩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1752","lineNum":1774,"lineType":2,"content":"丙本自旺盛，一木足矣多為過，雖是一木，若得地，尤竒絶。所以五行之神，貴在顯煥清越，不可過也。丙人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1753","lineNum":1775,"lineType":2,"content":"得木助，其銳可知，須要一位金來助其氣，則生火人官禄基如此，豈不早年享福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1754","lineNum":1776,"lineType":1,"content":"中央奪福：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1755","lineNum":1776,"lineType":2,"content":"亥子見水，被土所破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1756","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087904149544"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1757","lineNum":1779,"lineType":1,"content":"丙人見子休逢土，福破中央奪將去。又加火向辰戌中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1758","lineNum":1780,"lineType":1,"content":"决定傷殘終敗露。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1759","lineNum":1781,"lineType":2,"content":"見子則官神得位，逢土則水不能勝，終被所奪也。論曰：魁罡之地，土在鍾毓，更若火盛，如甲辰、甲戌之類，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1760","lineNum":1782,"lineType":2,"content":"土氣强旺，水氣消渴，為害甚矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1761","lineNum":1783,"lineType":1,"content":"截根無蔭：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1762","lineNum":1783,"lineType":2,"content":"生處逢鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1763","lineNum":1784,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅為禄火長生，甲寅相遇不光榮。憂妻害子無兄弟，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1764","lineNum":1785,"lineType":1,"content":"到老孤貧謾逞能。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1765","lineNum":1786,"lineType":2,"content":"逢鬼於受氣處被抑塞，終為害也。此為生地見鬼，鬼卽强壮，丙火不能舒爽。五行獨立，宜於順生，最嫌逆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1766","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064579723299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1767","lineNum":1789,"lineType":2,"content":"制，終孤竭矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1768","lineNum":1790,"lineType":1,"content":"煙㓕灰飛：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1769","lineNum":1790,"lineType":2,"content":"火木臨，巳午無水救助。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1770","lineNum":1791,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁巳午皆逢木，炎上威風勢猛强。更若五行無水制，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1771","lineNum":1792,"lineType":1,"content":"纔逢稱意必傾亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1772","lineNum":1793,"lineType":2,"content":"丙丁巳午，皆火之地，若逢木則益炎盛，須得水制，旣相比和，又有官神，方是有應。若一味炎盛，豈能長久。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1773","lineNum":1794,"lineType":1,"content":"食神為鬼：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1774","lineNum":1794,"lineType":2,"content":"干音火土多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1775","lineNum":1795,"lineType":1,"content":"丙人見戊加申子，時人皆謂食神重。若見火神有生位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1776","lineNum":1796,"lineType":1,"content":"一生孤蹇禄難逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1777","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506054712197174"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1778","lineNum":1799,"lineType":2,"content":"丙人見戊，又逢火旺土壮，尅丙人之官，所以無官。土主於中，旺於子午，頭帶戊丙人㑹，以為食神名譽之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1779","lineNum":1800,"lineType":2,"content":"兆。土旣成實，不必更見火，大旺則土强，丙人之官蔑然，雖少年見禄，終不為久長計。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1780","lineNum":1801,"lineType":8,"content":"丁火父木成數三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1781","lineNum":1802,"lineType":1,"content":"六丁戊癸本來髙，如加己亥勢雄豪。申子辰宫金水壮，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1782","lineNum":1803,"lineType":1,"content":"位到公侯佩玉袍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1783","lineNum":1804,"lineType":2,"content":"丁生戊癸為子如萌芽，有癸無戊以己代之，有戊無癸以子代之，皆為秀實之氣，造化之功可貴。為己乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1784","lineNum":1805,"lineType":2,"content":"戊癸之源，亥乃成實之地，為貴子巳代戊癸丁生人有戊癸戊子癸巳申子辰金水清貴，逢火土猶為禍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1785","lineNum":1806,"lineType":2,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1786","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506070451798035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1787","lineNum":1809,"lineType":1,"content":"飛活清秀：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1788","lineNum":1809,"lineType":2,"content":"水盛忌土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1789","lineNum":1810,"lineType":1,"content":"丁人愛遇北方水，忽見食神再續來。局内不逢於土數，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1790","lineNum":1811,"lineType":1,"content":"木神加䕶至三台。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1791","lineNum":1812,"lineType":2,"content":"丁人見水，官神得地，又遇金來生官，自然顯赫。北方乃亥子正位，壬癸旺鄉，更逢金生育不絶，甲子辛亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1792","lineNum":1813,"lineType":2,"content":"之類是也。若無土損其氣清，又得木神䕶禄，所以基本牢壮，此是財官印之說。見水是官宫，宜居北方旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1793","lineNum":1814,"lineType":2,"content":"地，又得金財以生之，木印以䕶之，所以基本牢壮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1794","lineNum":1815,"lineType":1,"content":"禄基成實：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1795","lineNum":1815,"lineType":2,"content":"子午逢金怕土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
