{"lines":[{"lineId":"1796","lineNum":1816,"lineType":1,"content":"金加子午多㐫暴，若是丁人又喜逢。更㸔五行無土數，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1797","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506070451781651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1798","lineNum":1819,"lineType":1,"content":"定扶聖主掌陶鎔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1799","lineNum":1820,"lineType":2,"content":"金加子午帶死敗，故罚甲子、甲午之類是也。然丁人午上見金，則是為財，子上見金則生官。若無土犯分，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1800","lineNum":1821,"lineType":2,"content":"則氣清禄厚。又云，在午見金則禄旺，在子見金又生出丁，官見土則傷水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1801","lineNum":1822,"lineType":1,"content":"禄氣差遲：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1802","lineNum":1822,"lineType":2,"content":"壬多不如亥子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1803","lineNum":1823,"lineType":1,"content":"丁見壬亥未是竒，亥子相逢正得時。忽被土來争旺位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1804","lineNum":1824,"lineType":1,"content":"謾有聲華亦差遲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1805","lineNum":1825,"lineType":2,"content":"壬不得地，遇而不遇，雖無壬而得水正位，官神旺處，自然壮也。水土混雜，終是土勝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1806","lineNum":1826,"lineType":8,"content":"破相孤獨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1807","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087904133160"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1808","lineNum":1829,"lineType":1,"content":"六丁忌見土長生，損妻害子强争能，縱有虚名難了達，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1809","lineNum":1830,"lineType":1,"content":"亦憂田宅乏興營。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1810","lineNum":1831,"lineType":2,"content":"六丁人以水為福，官也。土長生傷官，大旺則奪却水之位，有呼無應，其格卑下。若見尅傷，則觸事虧損。六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1811","lineNum":1832,"lineType":2,"content":"丁人以水土為官鬼，水土皆生於申，就位為土所損，壬癸無依，金生元被害，可貧賤矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1812","lineNum":1833,"lineType":8,"content":"戊火數二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1813","lineNum":1834,"lineType":1,"content":"六戊生人逢曲直，丁壬相合主清才。從革位中兼一二，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1814","lineNum":1835,"lineType":1,"content":"决須名譽少年魁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1815","lineNum":1836,"lineType":2,"content":"眞火要亥卯未旺，有丁無壬以亥代，有壬無丁以未代。本元壯則為福逺，戊癸丁壬合貴也。眞火愛寅午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1816","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506020501913650"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1817","lineNum":1839,"lineType":2,"content":"戌，土壮火炎官有力，天數乘三，子生其父己酉丑多逢則貴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1818","lineNum":1840,"lineType":1,"content":"淵源滋養。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1819","lineNum":1840,"lineType":2,"content":"金生水，神滋木之官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1820","lineNum":1841,"lineType":1,"content":"六戊生人見水深，更逢申子旺生金，須知名譽當騰達，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1821","lineNum":1842,"lineType":1,"content":"少主清華入禁林。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1822","lineNum":1843,"lineType":2,"content":"命已有水主官，更得金在申子水之鄉，則金又生水，甲乙自然有氣。五行要不㫁，若有金無水，又能害木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1823","lineNum":1844,"lineType":2,"content":"水深則木强，故貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1824","lineNum":1845,"lineType":1,"content":"相為慶㑹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1825","lineNum":1845,"lineType":2,"content":"土壮合水生木，官顯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1826","lineNum":1846,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申本是戊人强，癸亥當頭貴顯揚，但得五行金不入，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1827","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064990863386"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1828","lineNum":1849,"lineType":1,"content":"名清望重佐朝堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1829","lineNum":1850,"lineType":2,"content":"戊寅火生處逢土，戊申土生，故强。癸亥水生出甲乙，故竒。有金則傷矣。寅申土成體地，本源旣壮，又須借","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1830","lineNum":1851,"lineType":2,"content":"木神踈爽之，更得癸亥就位，滋養其神明之德，清健非常。若無金神返制，五行决恬然無害為福厚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1831","lineNum":1852,"lineType":8,"content":"金火相持","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1832","lineNum":1853,"lineType":1,"content":"戊人不貴南方火，見火須還帶旺金。有金無火終成咎，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1833","lineNum":1854,"lineType":1,"content":"有火無金亦不新。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1834","lineNum":1855,"lineType":2,"content":"戊人不貴南方火者，戒其太過盛。若無火，則金得勢來侵木，無金有火，亦無用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1835","lineNum":1856,"lineType":1,"content":"干鬼為映。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1836","lineNum":1856,"lineType":2,"content":"甲傷戊，元有金可救。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1837","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064483336226"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1838","lineNum":1859,"lineType":1,"content":"戊人有甲終無益，帶水拖泥不似初。若得庚金并水局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1839","lineNum":1860,"lineType":1,"content":"縱能財禄亦㣲餘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1840","lineNum":1861,"lineType":2,"content":"逢甲不如見乙，為陰陽和順，甲能傷戊，若加水，甲益壮，終有害也。若庚金制之，猶庻幾。甲，陽火之神，戊人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1841","lineNum":1862,"lineType":2,"content":"得之，陰錯陽差。若得庚金，又復制甲，旣又得水，則為戊人財廪之神，五行互有得失故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1842","lineNum":1863,"lineType":8,"content":"己五數眞土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1843","lineNum":1864,"lineType":1,"content":"六己相逢己用功，乙庚相㑹禄髙封，炎上火神加一二，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1844","lineNum":1865,"lineType":1,"content":"符壓兵權静塞衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1845","lineNum":1866,"lineType":2,"content":"己乃火生旺之地，己人遇寅午戌，為造化之功。一庚為土之子，生於己為實。有乙無庚，以申代之，有庚無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1846","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064579756067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1847","lineNum":1869,"lineType":2,"content":"乙，以卯代之，得此方為貴格。如寅午戌三宫，一位二位為貴。申卯代乙庚，庚卯乙申，用己炎上火而清貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1848","lineNum":1870,"lineType":2,"content":"顯達也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1849","lineNum":1871,"lineType":1,"content":"包成合禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1850","lineNum":1871,"lineType":2,"content":"寅午戌，懼旺水損元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1851","lineNum":1872,"lineType":1,"content":"己人正月正為魁，更於寅午戌相陪，局内不逢眞火數，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1852","lineNum":1873,"lineType":1,"content":"定知文武佐功來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1853","lineNum":1874,"lineType":2,"content":"丙辛為眞火數，己人見丙寅為食神之魁。蓋火生土，又得寅午戌炎上之火氣接濟，若無水損禄，天元有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1854","lineNum":1875,"lineType":2,"content":"滋養，榮名厚利，何患無矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1855","lineNum":1876,"lineType":1,"content":"秀特逢生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1856","lineNum":1876,"lineType":2,"content":"金生水，旺滋木旺金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1857","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087602176019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1858","lineNum":1879,"lineType":1,"content":"六己相加己是功。申子辰位甲須豐。更得金神同水化，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1859","lineNum":1880,"lineType":1,"content":"定知名譽至三公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1860","lineNum":1881,"lineType":2,"content":"申子辰，水之位，就中見甲，則木乘水旺氣，為福基甚厚。金同水地，則水益壮旺，甲自然發生。此五行陰陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1861","lineNum":1882,"lineType":2,"content":"消息，不必見其形，而黙㑹之可也。若只見金而無水，金無所歸，便傷甲乙之木。惟有水地，則自生出水，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1862","lineNum":1883,"lineType":2,"content":"必見水，深且詳之。論曰：若見水加亥卯未上，禄元有所養，為福無窮矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1863","lineNum":1884,"lineType":1,"content":"庚四金陽之數。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1864","lineNum":1884,"lineType":2,"content":"戊癸丑未，火土為貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1865","lineNum":1885,"lineType":1,"content":"六庚眞數少人知，戊癸相逢遇者稀。大小吉神逢一二，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1866","lineNum":1886,"lineType":1,"content":"名播中華福禄輝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1867","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506054712229942"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1868","lineNum":1889,"lineType":2,"content":"夫眞白虎數用，有子生焉。戊癸乃火之眞數，為庚金之眞官，有戊無癸，以子代之，有癸無戊，以己代之，方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1869","lineNum":1890,"lineType":2,"content":"為秀實之氣。戊癸化火，能生二吉，丑未為大小吉，二吉旣旺，能助庚金，乃為至貴。子己代戊癸，庚金生己，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1870","lineNum":1891,"lineType":2,"content":"戊癸之火發用丑未，貴矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1871","lineNum":1892,"lineType":8,"content":"聲譽逺馳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1872","lineNum":1893,"lineType":1,"content":"庚人巳午逢剛木，學問過人世所稀。但無金神并水屬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1873","lineNum":1894,"lineType":1,"content":"少馳聲譽掌樞機。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1874","lineNum":1895,"lineType":2,"content":"火正南方，官神得地，更逢剛木，滋養無窮，所謂本源深而氣壮。若見金神并見水，水又生起，便制其火，雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1875","lineNum":1896,"lineType":2,"content":"得正位，終被消爍，此有木無金水，然後為貴。論曰：火加己午，官星得地，若使納音帶得木來，火聚南方，髙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1876","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087602225171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1877","lineNum":1899,"lineType":2,"content":"明豁達，所憚者水耳。稍無犯分，則挺特出羣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1878","lineNum":1900,"lineType":1,"content":"相叅成慶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1879","lineNum":1900,"lineType":2,"content":"見土木火，禄元有助。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1880","lineNum":1901,"lineType":1,"content":"庚人愛得土來親，火數相乘位顯倫。春夏季中生月屬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1881","lineNum":1902,"lineType":1,"content":"又加木屬主光榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1882","lineNum":1903,"lineType":2,"content":"金得土扶，禄元有藉，更加火臨辰未，兩月中其福愈壮。蓋火生三月，木墓六月，所謂源逺相叅，發福有自。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1883","lineNum":1904,"lineType":2,"content":"其為氣也，妙在適其用耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1884","lineNum":1905,"lineType":8,"content":"禄鬼孤害","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1885","lineNum":1906,"lineType":1,"content":"六庚火禄向甲申，水數才多不可逢。更値金神重叠見，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1886","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087602208787"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1887","lineNum":1909,"lineType":1,"content":"到頭辛苦禄難崇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1888","lineNum":1910,"lineType":2,"content":"庚人以火為福，却遇甲申，更有别位見金神，則生出水，水有汗漫不絶之状，丙丁如此，無以發生，又何禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1889","lineNum":1911,"lineType":2,"content":"之有，終難顯達。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1890","lineNum":1911,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00005_0_13","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1891","lineNum":1911,"lineType":2,"content":"云：遇而不遇，禄馬之說，要在窮䆒，曲盡其理，方知禄馬歸着。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1892","lineNum":1912,"lineType":8,"content":"六辛天之水數","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1893","lineNum":1913,"lineType":1,"content":"天數當先號六辛，喜逢親子係丁壬。天魁合㑹功曹盛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1894","lineNum":1914,"lineType":1,"content":"名達朝堂職位清。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1895","lineNum":1915,"lineType":2,"content":"辛數，乾天之子，天乙生水，木數合之，乃陰從母生。其子有丁無壬，以亥代之，有壬無丁，以未代之，故為秀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1896","lineNum":1916,"lineType":2,"content":"實之氣。天魁戌，功曹寅也。亥未代丁壬，有丁壬亥未，用寅午戌之勢，為貴盛也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1897","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087052689434"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1898","lineNum":1919,"lineType":8,"content":"威髙志遠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1899","lineNum":1920,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛要得火相親，帶水須憑見木神。文中却作武中虎，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1900","lineNum":1921,"lineType":1,"content":"武禄還須静塞塵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1901","lineNum":1922,"lineType":2,"content":"水能生木，木生火，展轉相生，無有窮盡。辛金得火，六氣相親，若見水，則有損五行，若又見木，水却隨木化，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1902","lineNum":1923,"lineType":2,"content":"不傷於火。辛人如此，豈不快哉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1903","lineNum":1924,"lineType":8,"content":"先㐫後吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1904","lineNum":1925,"lineType":1,"content":"辛人卯酉値非善，又逢水屬主遲矇。若見火神當勝位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1905","lineNum":1926,"lineType":1,"content":"定知烜赫衆難同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1906","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087052705818"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1907","lineNum":1929,"lineType":2,"content":"辛以丙為官，以火為福，卯酉乃火死敗之地，更加水損，何由得福。五行若得火神位，寅午戌卽還元，如此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1908","lineNum":1930,"lineType":2,"content":"則轉禍為福也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1909","lineNum":1931,"lineType":8,"content":"禄氣退休","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1910","lineNum":1932,"lineType":1,"content":"辛人火居西北地，無木相扶仕禄艱。縱得少年膺爵命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1911","lineNum":1933,"lineType":1,"content":"亦須衰蹇見休官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1912","lineNum":1934,"lineType":2,"content":"火居西北無氣之郷，又無木來助，豈免迍剥。火在水鄉，終難顯達，得木衛䕶，猶且庻㡬，稍若闕此，終當偃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1913","lineNum":1935,"lineType":2,"content":"蹇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1914","lineNum":1936,"lineType":8,"content":"壬為眞木數三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1915","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087602192403"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1916","lineNum":1939,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬逢火自然光，丙辛交㑹勢堂堂。太衝還共登明㑹，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1917","lineNum":1940,"lineType":1,"content":"必是金門紫綬章。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1918","lineNum":1941,"lineType":2,"content":"壬為陽木數當三，用周天火數，當其二數，二三合五，乃受己之數，為壬之官。水數生木，乃母生其子，有丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1919","lineNum":1942,"lineType":2,"content":"無辛，以酉代之，有辛無丙，以己代之，為秀實之氣。太衝為卯，登明為亥，乃木乘旺之氣，為醖籍。己酉代丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1920","lineNum":1943,"lineType":2,"content":"辛，壬人有丙辛、丙酉、辛巳，以火用於木氣，為眞數，入格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1921","lineNum":1944,"lineType":8,"content":"相呼集福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1922","lineNum":1945,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬己亥不為官，忽逢水數禄須還。更値五行多火局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1923","lineNum":1946,"lineType":1,"content":"定期髙宦達金鑾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1924","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506070451912723"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1925","lineNum":1949,"lineType":2,"content":"巳亥為生成之木，下殘切土，干頭己土，所以不為壬人之官。若五行帶得火數多，己亥之木又隨火化，藏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1926","lineNum":1950,"lineType":2,"content":"己官之土，却得還元，不必更見水。蓋水能生木，木能尅土，卽為壞官故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1927","lineNum":1951,"lineType":8,"content":"火竒續貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1928","lineNum":1952,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬丑未兼申子，四位如逢火數奇。更値五行多土局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1929","lineNum":1953,"lineType":1,"content":"少年名位擁旌旗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1930","lineNum":1954,"lineType":2,"content":"丑未土成實之地，申子乃土旺之鄉，干音帶得火來，五行中更加土多，壬人䄂禄，自然顯著，豈不早年享","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1931","lineNum":1955,"lineType":2,"content":"快。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1932","lineNum":1956,"lineType":8,"content":"反㐫成慶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1933","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506070451896339"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1934","lineNum":1959,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬若逢繁剛木，須得干音帶火來。若是寅宫并午位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1935","lineNum":1960,"lineType":1,"content":"必作朝中將相才。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1936","lineNum":1961,"lineType":2,"content":"甲辰、甲戌，皆干音火木，更又庚寅、壬午俱來資助，火旺則土盛，氣數純全，福基自壮矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1937","lineNum":1962,"lineType":8,"content":"天鬼相交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1938","lineNum":1963,"lineType":1,"content":"六壬最怕干頭戊，或加辰戌主傷殘。不見甲來為救應，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1939","lineNum":1964,"lineType":1,"content":"定主身中帶不安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1940","lineNum":1965,"lineType":2,"content":"壬人見戊為干鬼，若加魁罡之地，則禍患之端。五行若有甲干陽木，又能尅戊土，卽有所救，不然鬼氣太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1941","lineNum":1966,"lineType":2,"content":"重，壬人所懼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1942","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064579788835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1943","lineNum":1969,"lineType":8,"content":"癸為眞火數二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1944","lineNum":1970,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸生逢曲直加，如臨甲己最為佳。更加傳送還為貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1945","lineNum":1971,"lineType":1,"content":"禄仕千鍾福夀遐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1946","lineNum":1972,"lineType":2,"content":"曲直，亥卯未之氣也。癸陰火，須逢木而生。甲己者，土合火之子數，陰從母生，其子為成，有甲無己，以未代","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1947","lineNum":1973,"lineType":2,"content":"之，有己無甲，以寅代之，乃為貴氣。傳送者，乃甲己生處，甲己未寅，為秀實之氣。癸人有甲己，旺中帶木氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1948","lineNum":1974,"lineType":2,"content":"為清竒之格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1949","lineNum":1975,"lineType":8,"content":"互相福應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1950","lineNum":1976,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸人生多亥子，不逢土數自光榮。若得土加寅已上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1951","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506029800734757"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1952","lineNum":1979,"lineType":1,"content":"不須亥子卽為清。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1953","lineNum":1980,"lineType":2,"content":"亥子乃水㑹之地，癸人得之，聚成一氣，不必見土，見土則水争强，反為不好。若寅已上却見土神，癸人之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1954","lineNum":1981,"lineType":2,"content":"官，又不必見亥子，見之則土争雄，反為交雜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1956","lineNum":1983,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸人逢己是殃，不逢甲數盡乖張。莫教丑未乘於火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1957","lineNum":1984,"lineType":1,"content":"定知貧賤永無糧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1958","lineNum":1985,"lineType":2,"content":"癸人以戊為官，見己為陰陽失序，反為鬼。五行中若得甲木之氣觧救，尚可免迍駁。若見己丑己未之類","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1959","lineNum":1986,"lineType":2,"content":"夾攻之，癸人福氣藐然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1960","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506070451879955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1961","lineNum":1989,"lineType":8,"content":"滋蔭福元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1962","lineNum":1990,"lineType":1,"content":"木逢癸亥正長生，蔭益根元必大亨。更有金臨西北位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1963","lineNum":1991,"lineType":1,"content":"定主清華禄自存。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1964","lineNum":1992,"lineType":2,"content":"木生在亥，就其位得癸亥之水滋養，生中逢生，最為喜㑹。更得西北帶金生，出水來木轉壯健，源深達遠，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1965","lineNum":1993,"lineType":2,"content":"禄福崇峻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1966","lineNum":1994,"lineType":8,"content":"變鬼為官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1967","lineNum":1995,"lineType":1,"content":"木人最怕逢壬申，若逢癸酉禍增新。但得水臨西北地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1968","lineNum":1996,"lineType":1,"content":"返作清達顯赫人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1969","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506070451929107"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1970","lineNum":1999,"lineType":2,"content":"壬申癸酉乃劒鋒，金乘臨官，旺地尅木，甲乙最怕之。忽若亥子上見水神，化藏金毒，金雖承天將之利，終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1971","lineNum":2000,"lineType":2,"content":"不能害木。大抵福欲乘之，鬼欲制之，然後可觀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1972","lineNum":2001,"lineType":8,"content":"破禍成福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1973","lineNum":2002,"lineType":1,"content":"木逢辛亥不長生，不逢火制禄難存。火神與木俱繁盛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1974","lineNum":2003,"lineType":1,"content":"何慮功名事不成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1975","lineNum":2004,"lineType":2,"content":"木生在亥，却於生處逢金，謂之生地見鬼，得火救之，金不敢用事，木乃出焉。此謂通變，自有輕重，五行須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1976","lineNum":2005,"lineType":2,"content":"明勝負，不可一途取軌。火木繁盛，金自銷爍，雖是辛亥作禍，得火與木繁盛，始免金生煞。若非辛亥見火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1977","lineNum":2006,"lineType":2,"content":"木繁多俱旺，又不便也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1978","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064990896154"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1979","lineNum":2009,"lineType":8,"content":"鬼氣臨官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1980","lineNum":2010,"lineType":1,"content":"木人怕見火神興，無水相臨主禍迎。更被金來加局内，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1981","lineNum":2011,"lineType":1,"content":"一生險難不安寧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1982","lineNum":2012,"lineType":2,"content":"木人火盛，則灰飛烟㓕，得氷可制，火局不見水。又如從革金局，其神銳利，甲乙之木，窘氣可知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1983","lineNum":2013,"lineType":8,"content":"根源渾厚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1984","lineNum":2014,"lineType":1,"content":"火人日月時遭水，須逢曲直乙為干。若得炎宫金納地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1985","lineNum":2015,"lineType":1,"content":"定知食禄是清官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1986","lineNum":2016,"lineType":2,"content":"火人日月時帶水神，則火無發露。若亥卯未上，干頭帶陰木，水却又來生木，木又生火，火生不絶，火神得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1987","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087602241555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1988","lineNum":2019,"lineType":2,"content":"地。更若寅午戌上，納音見金，又却來尅木，木神受制，生出火官，五行脫體還元，乃為髙上之福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1989","lineNum":2020,"lineType":8,"content":"兌宫生鬼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1990","lineNum":2021,"lineType":1,"content":"火神敗地莫逢金，見水加來愈不禁。不見傷殘併夭折，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1991","lineNum":2022,"lineType":1,"content":"定須受病肺連心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1992","lineNum":2023,"lineType":2,"content":"火敗地，本自衰㣲，逢水則金不能為財，而與水為鬼。論曰：火至敗地，見金則生出水來，力旣不能勝，安得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1993","lineNum":2024,"lineType":2,"content":"不傷殘也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1994","lineNum":2025,"lineType":8,"content":"迍蹇多災","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1995","lineNum":2026,"lineType":1,"content":"衆火須防水在寅，平生迍坎謾勞神。資財必竟難充溢，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1996","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064990945306"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1997","lineNum":2029,"lineType":1,"content":"到老身孤背六親。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1998","lineNum":2030,"lineType":2,"content":"火神稍衆，於生地却見水，如甲寅之類，何以堪然火神旣多，須得少木資之，則有不窮之象，稍多於此，終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1999","lineNum":2031,"lineType":2,"content":"為害也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"2000","lineNum":2032,"lineType":8,"content":"氣數淳厚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2001","lineNum":2033,"lineType":1,"content":"土人土重火炎揚，職位清華禄益强。火加巳午逢諸土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2002","lineNum":2034,"lineType":1,"content":"盛德髙風處處彰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2003","lineNum":2035,"lineType":2,"content":"土數旣重，必藉火扶持，為生生不窮之意。若更見火加巳午，火旺之地，土又强壮，設或見水，終不能勝火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2004","lineNum":2036,"lineType":2,"content":"土，得為財廪之氣矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2005","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506089808347186"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2006","lineNum":2039,"lineType":8,"content":"五木成煙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2007","lineNum":2040,"lineType":1,"content":"土人藉木為文曲，四位之中帶火來。重見木神臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2008","lineNum":2040,"lineType":1,"content":"巽","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00005_0_14","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2009","lineNum":2040,"lineType":1,"content":"地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2010","lineNum":2041,"lineType":1,"content":"髙甲陞名福慶開。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2011","lineNum":2042,"lineType":2,"content":"土無火不能通爽其氣，木無土，不能安植其根。二者相須，皆不可闕。五行中若帶火來，又於巳土見木，展","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2012","lineNum":2043,"lineType":2,"content":"轉生育，聚成一體，氣數北實，火神有所倚藉矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"2013","lineNum":2044,"lineType":8,"content":"救助减福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2014","lineNum":2045,"lineType":1,"content":"土人强位逢諸火，更加火旺生災禍。就中若見水神波，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2015","lineNum":2046,"lineType":1,"content":"縱免灾殃還坎坷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2016","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087904182312"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2017","lineNum":2049,"lineType":2,"content":"火數旣旺且多，併來生一土，其氣大段燥，忽見水返來制火，五行雖有救觧，終不為吉兆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"2018","lineNum":2050,"lineType":8,"content":"基本衰弱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2019","lineNum":2051,"lineType":1,"content":"土人若重嫌巳酉，區區終是謾勞生。水近土傍猶見禍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2020","lineNum":2052,"lineType":1,"content":"賣盡田園無地耕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2021","lineNum":2053,"lineType":2,"content":"巳酉乃土水敗地，重重見之則困，若相陵，終不為福，蓋水能勝於火矣。司馬季主曰：水逢沐浴如逢土，土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2022","lineNum":2054,"lineType":2,"content":"到衰鄉水不如。土到酉宫眞敗地，却逢癸酉禄盈餘。二氣各有勝負，爾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2024","lineNum":2056,"lineType":1,"content":"金多逢土不為灾，切忌金神帶水來。木逐火神生旺土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2025","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064579821603"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2026","lineNum":2059,"lineType":1,"content":"發榮名位足資財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2027","lineNum":2060,"lineType":2,"content":"只怕生旺被鬼所制，金多又自帶旺火不為害，自己寡弱，則尅我者始得志也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2029","lineNum":2062,"lineType":1,"content":"金遭乙巳大乖張，木數來逢主夭亡。便使水多難抑制，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2030","lineNum":2063,"lineType":1,"content":"定殘骨肉逺離鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2031","lineNum":2064,"lineType":2,"content":"金生處見乙巳火，被火截住，加以木來扶火之勢益壮，金自銷爍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2033","lineNum":2066,"lineType":1,"content":"水人見木為本利，得火相逢㐫害至。更無火木見金神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2034","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506094145241097"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2035","lineNum":2069,"lineType":1,"content":"决主少年登顯第。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2036","lineNum":2070,"lineType":2,"content":"金為水本源，木得水滋深為利用，見火却生火，則反傷於金。五行中若無水火，但得金氣發露，則生出水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2037","lineNum":2071,"lineType":2,"content":"禄，自然清徹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"2038","lineNum":2072,"lineType":8,"content":"無救成㐫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2039","lineNum":2073,"lineType":1,"content":"水人切忌戊申寅，截㫁根源主禍頻。局内不逢金發露，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2040","lineNum":2074,"lineType":1,"content":"半生波却受艱辛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2041","lineNum":2075,"lineType":2,"content":"戊申、戊寅乃土成實之地，水人生處受制，病處見鬼，故曰截㫁根源。五行中若見魁罡，則鬼氣無以化藏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2042","lineNum":2076,"lineType":2,"content":"水神如此，可謂困矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2045","lineNum":2080,"lineType":1,"content":"水人大怕火炎揚，寅午相逢轉更忙。若見丙加辰戌位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2046","lineNum":2081,"lineType":1,"content":"定知夭折見悲傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2047","lineNum":2082,"lineType":2,"content":"寅午乃火生旺之地，炎熾可知。水神如此，則竭矣。五行若見魁罡，如丙辰、丙戌之類，轉衰䘮矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2048","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506054712262710"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2049","lineNum":2085,"lineType":1,"content":"三命通㑹","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00005_0_15","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2050","lineNum":2085,"lineType":1,"content":"卷四。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"8","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"徐子平論格局，獨以印、食、官、財四者為綱。其立名之義云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"何？葢造化流行天地間，不過隂陽五行而已。隂陽五行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"交相為用，不過生尅制化而已。今指甲乙為例，以日干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"論，甲乙在五行屬木，甲陽而乙隂也。如人命得甲乙生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506089808412722"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之日主屬我。生我者壬癸水，我生者丙丁火，尅我者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛金，我尅者戊己土，而十干盡之矣。生我者，有父母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"之義，故立名印綬。印，䕃也；綬，受也。譬父母有恩徳，䕃庇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫，子孫得受其福。朝廷設官分職，畀以印綬，使之掌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"管。官而無印，何所慿據？人無父母，何所怙恃？其理通一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"無二，故曰印綬。我生者，有子孫之義，故立名食神。食者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"如虫之食物，盖傷之也。虫得食物則飽，人得食則益，被","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"食則損。造化以子成而致養，即人子致養父母之道也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506098595446823"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰食神。尅我者，我受制於人之義，故立名。官煞，官者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"官也。煞者，害也。朝廷以官與人，此身屬之公家，任其驅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"使，赴湯蹈火，不敢有違，至於葢棺而後已，是官害之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人夢棺則得官，亦是此義，故曰官煞。我尅者，是人受","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"制於我之義，故立名。妻財，如人成家立産，須得妻室内","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"助，故曰妻財。是四者，術家立名之大義。然生近乎身，尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"隔乎位，造化喜生惡煞，乃自然之理也。中間隂陽從類，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽配合，各有至理存焉。生我，我生，如壬生甲，癸生乙，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087602421779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"甲食丙，乙食丁，是隂生隂，陽生陽，隂食隂，陽食陽，為隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":36,"lineType":1,"content":"陽各從其類。故甲喜壬生死木滋死水中，則多年不壊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"不喜癸生死木被雨水淋漓，不踰年則朽。甲喜食丙，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"丙能制庚煞，而甲始得安其身。不喜食丁，以丁能傷官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"而甲不得成其材，此其義也。尅我，我尅，如辛尅甲，庚尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"乙，甲尅己，乙尅戊，是隂尅陽，陽尅隂，隂匹陽，陽匹隂，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽配合之理。故甲見辛為正官，見庚為偏官。官喜正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"不喜偏。掌印佐貳，職有不同。甲見己為正妻，見戊為偏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506119277559862"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"妻。妻貴正不貴偏，敵體侍立，分則有别，此其理也。至若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"官怕傷，被傷則禍；財怕刼，被刼則分；印怕財，貪財則壊；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"食怕梟，逢梟則奪。其理與人事無二。學者明於人事，斯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"可以言造化矣。夫五行展轉生尅，皆子為父母復讐之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"義。故甲乙生丙丁為子，甲乙畏庚辛，頼丙丁尅制之；丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"丁生戊己為子，丙丁畏壬癸，頼戊己尅制之；戊己生庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"辛為子，戊己畏甲乙，頼庚辛尅制之；庚辛生壬癸為子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛畏丙丁，頼壬癸尅制之；壬癸生甲乙為子，壬癸畏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087602389011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己，頼甲乙尅制之。地支十二，其理亦同。雖動静不同，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"方圓有異，而生尅一也。試言之：北方亥子水，生東方寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"卯木；東方寅卯木，生南方巳午火，土寄旺於火，生西方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"申酉金，西方申酉金生北方亥子水。然亥子間丑一位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"而後接寅卯；寅卯間辰一位，而後接巳午；巳午間未一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"位，而後接申酉；申酉間戌一位，而後接亥子。土立四維，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"五行均頼，故巳酉合丑為金局，申子合辰為水局，亥卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"合未為木局，寅午合戌為火局。金生水，水生木，木生火，火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506054712295478"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"生土，土生金，相生而無間也。丑為金庫，生亥子而克寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"卯；辰為水庫，生寅卯而克巳午；未為木庫，生巳午而受","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"金克；戌為火庫，克申酉而受水制。東南主生，西北主殺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"此天地之大機也。且辰戌丑未奠安四維，金木水火咸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"頼之以生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"藏易","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_2","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：成言乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"艮","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_3","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"，終言乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_4","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"。此土之功用，在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"五行為尤大也。合干支而總言之，甲生亥死午，乙生午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"死亥，就禄於寅卯，是甲乙寅卯同也。丙生寅死酉，丁生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":72,"lineType":1,"content":"酉死寅，就禄於巳午，是丙丁巳午同也。庚生己死子，辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064579854371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"生子死巳，就禄於申酉，是庚辛申酉同也。壬生申死卯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"癸生卯死申，就禄於亥子，是壬癸亥子同也。戊生寅死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"酉，己生酉死寅，就禄於巳午，與火同位，子随母旺之義，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"而辰戌丑未，乃其正位也。由是天干地支，相合配偶，生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"克制化，旺相休囚，其名為印、為梟、為食、為傷、為官、為煞、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"為財、為刼、刑衝破害，虚邀暗合，而變化無窮矣。徐子平","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"識破此理，故只論財官印食，分為六格，而人命之富貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"貧賤、夀夭窮通，舉不外是，其餘格局，不過自此而推之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087904247848"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"論正官：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":86,"lineType":2,"content":"喜身旺㸔印綬，  逢官  財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":87,"lineType":2,"content":"食神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":88,"lineType":2,"content":"以財為引，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":89,"lineType":2,"content":"忌身弱  泄氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":90,"lineType":2,"content":"偏官貪合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":91,"lineType":2,"content":"傷官入墓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":92,"lineType":2,"content":"刑衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":93,"lineType":2,"content":"一曰正官，二曰禄神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"92","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"正官者，乃甲見辛、乙見庚之例，隂陽配合，相制有用，成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"其道也。故正官為六格之首，止許一位，多則不宜。正官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"先㸔月令，然後方㸔其餘。以五行之氣，惟月令當時為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"最，况四柱各管年限，年管十五，失之太早，時管五十後，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087602438163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"失之太遲，故只此月令為正，餘格例此。甲日生酉月，乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"生申、己，丙生子，丁生亥，戊生卯，己生寅，庚生午，辛生寅、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"巳，壬生午、未、丑，癸生辰、巳。戌月皆為正氣官星，更天干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"透出，如甲見辛酉，乙見庚申之例，謂之支藏干透，餘位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"不宜再見。又須日主徤旺，得財印兩扶，柱中不見傷煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"行運引至官鄉，大富大貴命也。大忌刑衝破害傷官，七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"煞貪合㤀官，刼財分福，為破格。如甲生酉月，見卯為衝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"酉為刑，午為破，戌為害，丙為合，乙為刼，丁為傷克，庚為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087052738586"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"混雜。須是官星純一，五行和粹，方以正官論。若見前忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中，雖有物去之，亦不純粹。若官星結局，又有財資扶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"非行身旺地不發，官止一二，無財有印，身弱無妨。若四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"柱皆歸背禄，宜推嵗運向背，財官旺地何如？若財官滿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"目，日主衰弱，不能負荷，徒勞無用，運至財煞旺鄉，多染","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"癆瘵，但有七煞行運復遇，便是徒流之命。又曰：甲生酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"月，辛金正禄，若見丁傷，支中無局，時引歸衰敗死絶之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"地，或有制合去之，衰絶之火，豈能傷其旺禄？若時引官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087904280616"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"星臨衰敗死絶之位，反引丁火歸生旺之鄉，或臨煞地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"降官失職，禍生無疑。時為歸息之地，吉㐫全在時消息。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"日主用神太盛，宜時以節制之。日主用神漸衰，宜時以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"補助之。柱中雖有㐫神，時能節制，亦不能為禍，此㸔命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"之要法也。又曰：甲生丑月，内有辛金，又值酉時，已是重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"犯。若天干復透辛多，更行西方，力不勝任，變官為鬼，旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"處必傾，多致災夭，須有合制方吉。若自身乘旺，如甲寅、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯等日，更有印生助，官星雖多，亦不為害。甲生戌月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087602405395"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"雖坐火庫，若不成局，無黨，不能為害。以辛刃在戌，戌中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"有旺。戊生辛，如透庚混雜，戌月無氣，畧有制合，亦不為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"慮。又云：凡用官，日干自坐財印終顯，如甲子、甲辰之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"自坐傷煞，終有節病，如甲午、甲戌、甲申之類，須斟酌。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：取官星，不必專泥月令支辰，或月干，或年日時支干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"只一處有，不曽損傷，皆可取用。故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_5","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"云：明干有氣明干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"取，明干無氣暗中取。若明干無氣，引歸地支，或有助托，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"運行得地，亦不减月内官星之福。又曰：凡論官星，畧見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506119277510710"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"一位食神坐實，便能損局。惟月令隠禄見食，却為三竒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"之貴。大要㸔官食虚實何如，若官星坐實，合神畧虚，随","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"官助貴。合神坐實，官星漸弱，官随合神，謂之貪合㤀官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：正官格要行印鄉，即是逢官㸔印，柱中原有印，随","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":144,"lineType":1,"content":"官印輕重，日干強弱，以觀所行之運。身弱印輕，要補其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"印。身旺官輕，要補其官。行傷官運，即是背禄。行身旺運，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"即是逐馬。珞琭云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"背禄逐馬，守窮途而恓惶。行煞運，即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"是煞来混官。行墓運，即是官星入墓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_6","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"云：煞官混雜，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087904264232"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"貧則夭。旺煞投墓，住夀難延。所以正官格，只喜向禄臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"財，如此消詳，萬無一失。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"三命鈴","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_7","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"云：凡禄命身三等官，各","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"禀五行，率以其性推之。如以金為官，主職位清峻，多掌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"刑獄錢糓之任，决斷明敏。遇行年太嵗在丑為官庫，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"喜，亦取旺相休囚有氣無氣言之。若以木為官，主品秩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"清髙，和俗守慎。遇行年太歲在未為官庫，以火為官，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"官序炎赫，為性猛烈，用刑慘酷，亦主發歇不常。遇行年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗在戌為官庫，以水為官，主職卑位下，級陞序進，謙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506119277592630"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"和得衆，矜恤孤寡，亦有道性。遇行年太嵗在辰為官庫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"以土為官，主官序穏當，難侵犯，厚重質直，法令分明。遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":162,"lineType":1,"content":"行年太嵗在辰為官庫，凡五行之官，各随其性則吉，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"失其性，則主為官不久。假令癸丑木命人，以土為禄官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"木為命官，金為身官，皆以三命尊卑，五行休旺言之。禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"命身三等官庫，如甲子金，甲為禄屬木，木被金克，故為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"禄官，金墓丑，是為禄官庫也。命與身官庫倣此。西蜀知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"命者云：凡人年月日時，四干迭相，官印足者主貴。厯觀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064483434530"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"大命，遇兩印者頗多。如吕吉甫學士壬申、己酉、丁己、庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"子。壬與己，庚與丁，為官；壬與庚，己與丁，為印。章子厚相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"公，丁亥、戊子、丁未、壬寅、己卯胎，戊與乙，壬與己，丁與壬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"為官；乙與壬，戊與丁，為印。少遇兩官者，又須四貴華葢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"上遇正官者大貴，此亦一偏之見也。又云：㸔官星有天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"官鄉，取月干制嵗干。如六甲年，正月建丙寅，五月庚午，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"六月辛未，庚辛金能制甲木，戊癸即相帶而行，甲癸人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"在午未，乙丙人在辰己，丁戊人在寅卯，己庚人在戌亥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506100554154018"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":180,"lineType":1,"content":"辛壬人在申酉。若人遇之，當食天禄，貴處朝倫。有地官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"鄉，取月建制歲干。如歲干是甲乙，屬木，七八月見申，屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"金，金能制木。甲乙人在申酉，丙丁人在亥子，戊己人在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯，庚辛人在巳午，壬癸人在辰戌丑未，若人遇之，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"早承休䕃，官序易陞。有真官鄉，取命前三辰，月干與命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"干合。如丙子人二月生，為命前三辰是辛卯，丙與辛合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"故丙子二月生人，為真官中生之類。君子遇之，職居近","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"侍；小人遇之，亦主富豪。如劉行素御史丙子辛卯，丙子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087904313384"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯，正合此説。又云：術者以甲見辛為官，不知真五行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"克納音為真官，此最𦂳。福神干頭自見官而得合者為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"上，有諸神来朝者最佳。如甲寅生納音水，得己亥、甲己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"為真土，是納音見真五行克也。若不見太嵗本干克，但","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"於日月時上見乙庚，亦是。若止見庚，謂之偏官，比之全","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"者减力。又不見乙庚，止見乙巳、乙丑、乙酉，餘位中多見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"申不見申，止得三五分力。餘倣此。又如己酉、己卯見丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"壬，壬子、壬午見乙庚，雖納音見真五行克為官，柰本干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506119277576246"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"同受克，故不作真官，而作真鬼斷之。大小運流年逢之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"災尤重，此亦㸔官星者所當知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_8","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"云：五行正官，忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"衝刑克破之官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"繼善篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_9","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"官貴太盛，纔臨旺處","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"必傾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"三命","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_12","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"云：根元淺薄，遇官貴而不榮。身弱喜印綬生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506064483418146"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"身，比肩陽刃扶身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"定真","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_13","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"云：最貴者，官星為命，日時得偏，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"正財為福。又云：官星如遇刼財，雖官非貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"秘訣","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_14","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"云：罷職","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"休官，只為官逢運合。又云：官星重見，只作煞推，再至官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"鄉，災非難免，若是太多，制之為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"指迷賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_15","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"云：日遇真官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"貴則時加禄命。時日生遇官印，須慿有氣之鄉，若遇衝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"破空亡，此等遇而不遇。官印遇鬼，官印如無，鬼旺鬼衰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":216,"lineType":1,"content":"詳其勝負。官刑命喜，莫教命反刑官，官印受刑，不戎即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"吏。官印明無暗有，比如玉帶重重，時日相逢，福徳勝坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087052820506"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"十倍。有官無印，難求清顯之名；有印無官，發不在迅速","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"之内。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"淵源賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_16","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"云：正官乃忠信尊重之名，治國齊家之號。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱得天時地利，早登科甲，而封妻䕃子；歲運行官印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"之鄉，萬鼎千鍾，䨇旌五馬，若是庸流，常招官事之擾。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"或女命，當膺邑號之封。女命如平，賤中却貴；男命不遇，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"靠貴而發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"相心賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_17","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"云：官星愷悌，貴氣軒昂，抱優渥而仁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"慈寛大，懐豁達而聲韻和揚，丰姿美而秀麗，性格敏而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"聰明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"要訣","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_18","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"云：正官為人慳吝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"萬褀賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_19","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"云：官星者，榮身之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506094145306633"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"主，掌禄之源，逢財則從容顯達，遇刃則偃蹇伶仃，喜印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"綬以為順意，忌偏黨以為傷神。所以功名特達者，身強","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"官旺；利禄虧盈者，身弱官衰。身旺官㣲，財名寡合。傷官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"若重，再喜印滋，身輕忌曜如強，偏愛印綬生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"制古歌","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_20","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":234,"lineType":1,"content":"正氣官星用月支，喜逢財印到年時。破害衝空俱不犯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴䨇全報爾知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":235,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"官星不可被刑衝，官煞同来吉變","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"㓙。化煞為官方是吉，化官為煞禍重重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":236,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"官星大抵要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"身強，身弱須求氣旺方。印綬兼行財旺地，無衝傷破是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506100554137634"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"榮昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":240,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"生月官星坐禄鄉，日辰生旺福無疆。有財有印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"無傷破，年少成名坐玉堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":241,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"月逢正禄號真官，不犯刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"傷禄最寛。日主興隆名利顯，運逢財印步金鑾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":242,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"印多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"官多為貴命，官旺身衰反為病。官多身旺化為財，財旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"身衰貧病併。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":244,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"正官大抵要純和，四柱無傷掇顯科。時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"上喜逢財徤旺，柱中欣見印生多。提綱獨遇為真貴，年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"位重逢乃太多。别處若有煞来混，反為辛苦受奔波。合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"諸説觀，正官喜忌見矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"290","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"謂官星所居之地，出本旬遁見，如甲人以辛為官星，本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087052836890"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"旬遁得辛未，乙人遁得庚辰，丙人遁得癸巳之例。十干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"官星坐天乙貴人，如甲人見辛未，丙見癸巳，謂之貴人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"頭上戴官星，更得印綬，禄貴全見，天元清秀，不反傷納","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"音尤吉。有反傷衝克，不順無氣，則天官惡而吉去矣。一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"名官貴堂格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_21","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"云：金若遇火，有重權，防禦刺史臣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":266,"lineType":2,"content":"如庚午、庚寅、庚戌、辛巳、辛未等日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"水若遇土，入官局，可沾侍郎禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":267,"lineType":2,"content":"如壬午、壬戌、癸巳、癸丑、癸未等日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"木若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506054712344630"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"遇金，主傷衰化煞，為權勢若雷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":270,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲申、甲戌、乙巳、乙酉、乙丑等日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
