{"lines":[{"lineId":"310","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"土若遇木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"為正禄，八座三台福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":272,"lineType":2,"content":"如戊寅、戊辰、己卯、己未、己亥等日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"此即白虎持世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"等格，要日主與官貴相停，偏枯則不成造化，大忌刑衝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"破害，傷損貴氣，不成格矣。如庚午日坐丁官，喜見甲乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"財生官，戊己印生身，忌丙煞雜官，癸水傷官，子衝破午，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"餘干例推。又曰：日主自坐官星，不大忌衝，譬執物在手，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"無可奪之理，主為人伶俐好色，機變有謀。若只日下一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087052853274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"位行財，官運方發，若生月帶禄，支坐財官，生時得地，方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"為真貴。壬午日是禄馬同鄉，更逢庚戌時為妙。壬自坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"禄，有庚辛制甲乙，使壬得己土為官貴。如戊辰日，辰中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"乙木為戊之官，春生貴重，秋生虚譽無禄。古歌曰：座下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"官星最是竒，多因祖䕃見根基。若還行徃印鄉去，脱却","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"青衣換紫衣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":286,"lineType":8,"content":"嵗徳正官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"327","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"取年上干支官為嵗徳，喜忌與月令正官同論，遇此必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506087052869658"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"生宦族，或䕃襲祖父之職。若月居財官分野，運向財官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"旺地，日主徤旺，貴無疑矣。凡年干遇官，福氣最重，發達","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"必早。如癸酉、庚申、丙子、丙申，年上官星柱中㑹官局歸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"禄，日下丙克申酉金為財官䨇美，二丙身旺，十七八運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"行戊午，雖午衝子，申子㑹局，衝不能動，日主併旺，及第","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"早發。古歌云：年中正禄是根芽，必主生身富貴家，運氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"喜逢身旺地，財生印助福無涯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":296,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"年上官星為嵗徳，喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"逄財印旺身宫，不逢七煞偏官位，富貴榮華莫與京。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"341","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲日酉辛時，乙日申庚時例。時上官星與月亦同，但","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"力輕㣲，發福多在晚年，或生賢子，要有印助月令，通生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"旺官氣，及見財生，或行財官印生旺運，方可發福，破傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"不中。如辛未、辛卯、庚戌、壬午，時上正官，午戌㑹官局，卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"未㑹木局，運至丁亥，財局三合全生，起丁官，貴為學士。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌運官旺，禄位光華，雖見丙煞，有壬制辛合，不損貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"氣。古歌云：正官有用不須多，多則傷身少則和，日旺再","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506094145421321"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"逄生印綬，定須平步擢髙科。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"404","lineNum":362,"lineType":8,"content":"五官㑹聚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"405","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲乙人，遇庚辛申酉戌、己丑純官，四柱原有丙丁火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"制伏，則吉；或日主自旺，比刼相助，亦吉。如無制伏，再行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"金地，禍患不可勝言。一名聚鬼，又名夭折煞。遇鬼有氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"之月，君子主貴顯，常人夭横；無氣，君子反夭折，常人作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"胥吏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506089808478258"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":370,"lineType":8,"content":"五行不雜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"417","lineNum":375,"lineType":8,"content":"金木間隔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_31","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"云：木若逢金，間隔作兩府之官，木無金，終不成器。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"楊博尚書，己巳、庚午、乙卯、庚辰，乙坐卯，自旺生於午，得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506094145404937"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"兩庚間隔成器，故貴極品。又庚申、戊子、乙酉、甲申，乙為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"日主無氣，取庚為官，旺於酉，乙庚化金，妻從夫化成貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"月令子癸為印，申子合局生木，運行東南，身旺之地，制","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"煞之鄉，故貴。又云：木官不重，以木須要金，而木適中，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"兩木兩金，氣相停不偏，尤貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"461","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲人見辛月丙日癸時之類，主官職崇髙，名位清峻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":422,"lineType":2,"content":"官下食合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲人見辛為官，辛食癸，丙與辛合在月、日時之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"類，主為官有貼職，常人有兼藝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

6","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"若一位七煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"却有兩三重制伏，縱文過李杜，終難顯達。經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

ineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"生逢七煞在時中，定作邉臣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"立大功。制禦帶合無忌破，兵權赫奕鎮威風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":597,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"元無制","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"伏運須見，不怕刑衝多煞攅。若是身衰惟煞旺，定知此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"命是貧寒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":599,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"時逢七煞本無兒，此理人間仔細推。底月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"時中如有制，定知有子貴而遲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"757","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_69","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"云：年逢貴氣，不用制伏，喜日主徤旺，羊刃相合，柱中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506109938548736"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"帶財，更行財運，發福清秀，最忌身衰。葢七煞乃小人之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"象，既居祖宗之位，如朝廷老臣，祖父老僕，日主徤旺，老","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"僕則盡力以事㓜主。日主衰弱，不能與小人為主，何肯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"盡力事之，反成害己之物。年干見此，必主出身寒㣲。四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"柱行運有情，主寒門生貴子。若煞旺身衰，衝刑太過，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"主貧窮，至重者帶孝遭刑。又曰：嵗煞一位不宜制，四柱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"重見却宜制。日主生旺，制伏畧多，喜行煞旺地，制伏太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":612,"lineType":1,"content":"過，或煞旺身衰，官煞混雜，嵗運如之，碌碌之軰。若制伏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506119373996059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"不及，運至身衰煞旺鄉，必生禍患。一命戊戌庚申，壬午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯，戊與癸合，卯與戌合，壬坐午支，財官俱備為貴。古","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"歌云：嵗徳壬来見戌年，財旺身強禄自然。更得運行財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"旺地，為人聰慧又忠賢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":618,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"年干七煞莫言㓙，制合為權","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"最有功。若得身強無忌破，此身多入禁庭中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":619,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗傷日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"干不和同，須要干支制伏重。煞旺喜行身旺地，初年難","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"免一塲㓙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"812","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲生己酉，丑月，天干透；庚生申月，嵗時辛金坐實多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"透。二者不拘藏見，但無氣的便不用。如用官不宜行煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"運，用煞不宜行官鄉，要身旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_74","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"云：煞藏官顯，身弱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"豈得成名。煞顯官藏，有制自能顯達，災福與官煞格同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"古歌云：露煞藏官只論煞，露官藏煞只論官。身強遇此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506089808560178"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"多為貴，身弱逢之禍百端。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"822","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"人命官煞俱有，謂之混雜，只取財印為用。柱元有財，運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"行財發，大要身強勝任其財方可，身弱官煞混，多夭貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺有制亦好，無制成印局，化煞亦可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"詩","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_75","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：官煞交加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content":"用命推，箇中消息要詳之。得時身旺分輕重，貴賤分明","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"辨别知。如壬辰、丙午、丙辰、癸巳，身煞俱旺，官從戊化，徳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":662,"lineType":1,"content":"秀兼備。丁亥、壬子、丁未、癸卯，丁從壬化亥卯未㑹局，水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506109938565120"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"木清竒。甲午、己巳、辛酉、甲午辛日，己丙為官，二午丁為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，喜旺專禄，己酉㑹局勝煞，雖無制伏，初行西方，身益","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，故貴。觀三命，不可以混雜為賤。論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"834","lineNum":668,"lineType":8,"content":"㑹煞化印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"835","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"乃支辰㑹合煞局，如甲日見申子辰之類，最喜柱有印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"綬，隠顯無傷為妙。大運最怕與流年相㑹，旺財傷印，㓙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"危。如柱中元有克印之神，嵗運更逢財星併克，必遭㓙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"暴死。如甲辰日生子月見申時，㑹起庚煞化印，貴至一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506093424033833"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"品。運行丁未，嵗在庚戌，衝起日下辰土，聚財壊，印煞無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"化，戌年為事，辛亥年受刑。詩曰：㑹煞為權福最多，支辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"合印致中和，若逢克印臨年運，刑戮傷身可奈何。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"843","lineNum":678,"lineType":8,"content":"專煞無制","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"844","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_76","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"云：身強煞淺，假煞為權，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"846","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"煞重身輕，終身有損。煞旺相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"柱無制伏，日主坐旺引身，旺鄉為專，七煞當權，必當驟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"發。倘身旺運過嵗運，遇刑衝制伏之位，平安忌見煞。旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"運專煞，最怕見刃，柱元帶刃，嵗運再遇，苟非惡疾，必主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506119277822006"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"横死。詩曰：煞旺無制引身旺，為煞專權富貴全身旺運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"過煞若旺，刑冲破害也平安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"853","lineNum":687,"lineType":8,"content":"專禄要制","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"854","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"此格。六庚日見巳時，庚金長生之地，内有丙戊二禄，戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"生庚，丙為庚煞，柱要壬癸制丙，當為武帥持權，若逢煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"運不吉。詩曰：專禄庚来就己位，也須制伏始為竒。武職","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"當權為帥座，忽逢七煞禍来時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"858","lineNum":692,"lineType":8,"content":"官煞去㽞並官鬼互變雜論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506089808609330"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_77","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"云：煞官混雜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"862","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"類有去官留煞，亦有去煞留官。葢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":696,"lineType":1,"content":"言柱中官星，七煞交差，月上見官，時上見煞；或月上見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，時上見官；或四柱叠見。有物去官留煞者，即以偏官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":698,"lineType":1,"content":"論，有物去煞留官者，即以正官論。凡㸔去留，要詳柱中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"官煞孰重孰輕，天干透者易去，月支所藏者難去。須傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"官，食神去官，煞之物衆而有力，方纔去得。五陽日，食神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"能去煞，又能㽞官。五陽日傷官，但能去官，不能留煞，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"須得羊刃合，方成去官㽞煞。假如甲日生人，甲以辛為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506089808592946"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"官，庚為煞，若官重煞輕，得丙食一位，克去庚金，與辛相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"合，此謂去煞留官，有情而貴；若煞重官輕，得丁火傷官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"克去辛金，再得乙木羊刃與庚相合，此謂去官留煞，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"情而貴。五隂日，食神能去煞，却不能留官，日主自能留","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"之。五隂日傷官，能去官又能留煞。假如乙日生人，以庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"為官，辛為煞，若官重煞輕，得丁食一位，克去辛煞，則乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"與庚合，此謂去煞留官，有情而貴。若煞重官輕，得丙火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官，克去庚金，来合辛金，此謂去官留煞，有情而貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"元","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_78","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506098595512359"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"理賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_78","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"云去煞留官當論貴，去官留煞主威權。又曰官星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"七煞交差，却有合煞為貴，此之謂也。合煞有二義，有合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"去合来，合来是去官留煞，合去是去煞留官。假令六甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"生人，透辛正官，又透庚七煞，是官煞交差，柱中却有乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"木合庚七煞，有丁火克辛官星，此是去官留煞。假令六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":720,"lineType":1,"content":"己生人，透出甲正官，又透乙七煞，是官煞交差，柱中却","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"有庚克甲正官，来合乙七煞，是去官留煞，上是羊刃合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":722,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，此是傷官合煞。又如甲以辛酉為官，庚申為煞，若甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506123702517787"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"申日以申為煞，又有酉為官，縁申乃水長生之地，煞化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"印生助甲木，柱中雖有酉金，却有午丁字傷克，去官留","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"煞。值此，主生平心志巧妙，不受福徳，不信任他人，常勞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":728,"lineType":1,"content":"役自己。又如六庚生人，柱透丙煞，又透丁官，是官煞交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"差。若柱有壬克丙，又来合丁，是去煞留官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_79","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"云：合官星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":730,"lineType":1,"content":"不為貴，合七煞不為㓙。葢言合官是柱中閒神合去官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"星，所以不為貴；合煞是柱中閒神與七煞合，所以合官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"忘貴，合煞忘賤。若日主干支與官煞合，則為合官為貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506093424001065"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"合煞為賤。書云明煞合去，五行和氣春風；暗煞合来，四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"柱刑傷害己是也。若不分别日主與閒神，何以有合來","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"合去之辨？葢合去之法，如年月相合，去之不論；月時相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":738,"lineType":1,"content":"合，亦去；日與年合，不可去，以日與年為要。餘作閒神論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_80","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"909","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"官煞兩停，喜者存之，憎者去之。葢言柱中正官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"七煞，兩均相停。有物生扶㑹和者，其力專，宜存而留之；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"有物破損傷害者，其力散，宜棄而去之。官星有尘扶，煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"星有破害，則去煞留官，反是則去官留煞。若兩停俱無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506089808642098"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"扶合，而有破害，當斟酌柱中有力一字為用神，若是吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"神，則以吉論。若兩停俱有扶合而無破害，即是官煞混","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"雜，反為貧賤。又曰：年月日時，㦯有四位官，四位煞，當以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":748,"lineType":1,"content":"明者用之，藏者捨之。明見官則存其官，明見煞則存其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，宜仔細分别。若兩停無輕重，察其生助向時者用之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"背時無助者棄之，去留不清，乃為混雜。如甲生七月上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"旬，為煞得令，縱有丙火亦不能去。又曰：去留二格，最宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":752,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺，若身果旺，雖無物去煞，亦能化煞為官。如甲見庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506100554399778"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"為煞，甲坐寅禄旺，甲木自抱火氣制煞，不須再見丙丁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":756,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲生秋令，却要丙丁制之，柱原無制，運到制地方發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"又如丙日畏壬，丙坐己午，或丙下抱上，則壬不能為害，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"丙化煞為官，須行身旺運可。又曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"927","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"地支天干合多，亦云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"貪合忘官。葢言日主天元，地支人元，與當生嵗月時中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"支干明暗重重相合。有情貪戀合神，雖有官星，則財来","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"盗氣，官来尅身，反為不利，官將不成，財將不遂，故曰貪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":762,"lineType":1,"content":"合忘官。大抵㓙神有物，合去則反㓙為吉；吉神有物，合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506100554367010"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"去則反吉為㓙。吉㓙神煞㸔局中喜忌何神，不可執一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"論奥㫖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_81","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"云：陽日食神，暗合官星；隂日食神，竊侵印綬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"觀此，則知四柱無官印則喜食神，有官印則忌食神。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":768,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：貪合忘煞忘官，如六癸生人，干頭透出己字為煞，再","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"透甲字，是己家合神，合去己字，不為煞矣。此謂貪合忘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":770,"lineType":1,"content":"煞。如庚申、甲申、甲子、乙亥，年上庚字傷甲，得亥上乙字","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"合庚去煞，奈月令又有申不清，二申煞重，不能盡合，所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":772,"lineType":1,"content":"以只為吏命。又如：六壬生人，干頭透己字為官，再見甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506115582378024"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"透，是己家合神，合去己字，不為官星。此謂貪合忘官。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑、丙申、甲戌、己巳，甲日透出辛字，正是官星，奈因丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"火合去，所以發貴不清。訣云：壬水相逢陽土時，心懐忿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":778,"lineType":1,"content":"怒起争非，忽然癸水来相助，合住㓙頑不見威。此貪合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"忘煞例。又云：壬逢己土欲為官，驀被青陽起訟端，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":779,"lineType":2,"content":"青陽甲木。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"引誘合將真貴去，致令受挫萬千般。此貪合忘官例。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：貪合不但忘官煞，忘印忘食亦可憐，格中惟有忘煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，官煞俱去不成權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":782,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"去煞留官仔細詳，食神厨位要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506123702534171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"髙強。不逢偏印来傷用，財旺生官大吉昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":785,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"去煞留官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"造化竒，個中消息有誰知。有情克合多榮貴，月桂髙攀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"第一枝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":787,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"官煞相連只是煞，官煞各分為混雜。食神重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"犯作傷官，叠見官星又論煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":788,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"局中官煞兩頭窺，羊刃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"重重或助之。八字純陽偏印重，位髙身顯佐明時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"精紀","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_82","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"云：凡命鬼多，而主本却在有氣之地，其鬼化官，若主本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":791,"lineType":1,"content":"無氣，官有氣，即官化鬼。季主云：旺迅逢鬼，鬼化官。衰迅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":792,"lineType":1,"content":"逄官，官化鬼。如丁於真五行屬木，凡丁人見乙與庚為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506100554383394"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼，若丁亥、丁卯、丁未人見之，不為鬼。若亥卯未全見三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"丁足者，尤好。葢亥卯未，木之正位，而又得三丁，木盛氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，全要庚金尅制之。又如丁巳、丁酉、丁丑人，生居金之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"正位，木弱金強，更見乙庚真金，即以鬼論。又如六丁皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"真木，而見乙酉、乙亥。乙，真金也，却不為鬼，而反為官，縁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"丁貴在酉亥故也。壬寅、壬申見乙庚多，皆不為鬼，取其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"與納音皆比和故也。辛酉、辛丑見甲己、己巳、己亥見丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"壬，乙巳、乙亥見戊癸，皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"推天元變化書","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_83","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"有反鬼作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506115582361640"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"官，如丁未、甲辰、癸丑、癸亥，兩鬼反為生氣滋助甲木，既","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"甲木旺，則丁亦旺。又納音從下生至火，既火旺水，人得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"財盛，上下皆有用矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"尺壁","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_84","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"云：凡尅干者不得地，干却得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"地者，多鬼化為官，變官為鬼。如甲戌納音火見丙辛水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"為真官。若得丙申、辛西，或辛未、辛丑，皆好。若得辛卯，係","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":810,"lineType":1,"content":"甲羊刃，變官為鬼。若别有福神救助，則為右職無氣，胥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"吏之輩。如壬申人納音是成器之金，見火則壊，故壬申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"人見戊癸者，乃變官為鬼。又壬屬木，木至申為絶鄉，木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506119374094363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"絶得火，則灰飛烟㓕，此為尤㓙。若癸酉雖是成噐之金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"然本干自帶癸之官，故不為鬼，見戊尤好。當消息之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"論正財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":817,"lineType":2,"content":"喜身旺，㸔印綬，以食神引， {"lines":[{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"大段天元羸弱，官吉不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"及以為榮，縱鄧通鑄錢，終身不富而餓死是也。若月令","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":834,"lineType":1,"content":"得財局身衰，逢印資助，當作富論。如先見印，却怕見財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"獨步","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_88","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"云先財後印，反成其福，先印後財，反成其辱是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"用財不宜明露，柱見比刼，則宜透出，使人共見，則不能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506144678248511"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"奪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_89","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"云財宜藏，藏則豐厚，露則浮蕩是也。凡財格，喜見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":840,"lineType":1,"content":"官星顯露，别無傷損，或更食生印助，日主徤旺，富貴雙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"全。如干支見煞，亦能享用，即逢財㸔煞之義大，怕梟奪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"則不能生，刃刼則不能享，庫逢空則不能聚。如甲生午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"li {"lines":[{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"富而且貴，定因財旺生官。蓋財有生官之理，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":942,"lineType":1,"content":"既取財為用，不要見官，若見官，則為財官格矣。柱有傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"食，雖財厚亦不能生官。如戊己以亥子壬癸為財，以寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":944,"lineType":1,"content":"卯甲乙為官，若生壬子、癸亥月，四柱不見寅卯甲乙，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"為財旺生官。如此，元命因富致貴，或納粟及儀賔之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":946,"lineType":1,"content":"若月令財無損尅，亦主登科。透庚辛則不能生，不以此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506123702583323"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"格論。又云：辛見甲為正財，四柱干支太旺，似為有火。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":950,"lineType":1,"content":"見壬寅，别位帶子辰亥，即濕木不能生丙火，則辛無官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。又如庚合乙木為財，生丁火為官，柱見癸卯，或年月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":952,"lineType":1,"content":"日時上有水，亦是濕木有財無官。陶朱云：庚尅乙，辛尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":953,"lineType":1,"content":"甲，而遭刑尅，為壬癸水傷官故也。十干例推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":972,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚辰、辛卯日，春生甲乙木為財，喜戊己印生身，壬癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"食生財，忌庚辛金刼奪。切不可嵗逢官煞，即春月金弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":974,"lineType":1,"content":"不能勝任，反不為福。甲午、乙未日，夏生己土為財；甲辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"日，夏生戊土為財；丙戌、丁丑日，秋生辛金為財。喜忌俱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":976,"lineType":1,"content":"與前同，惟壬午、癸巳二日，禄馬同鄉，不専以財論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":980,"lineType":1,"content":"何謂偏財？乃甲見戊，乙見己之例，非妻所帶，乃衆人之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"財也。切忌有姊妹兄弟分奪。柱無官星，禍患百出。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_106","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":982,"lineType":1,"content":"偏財好出，亦不懼藏，唯怕分奪及落空亡。有一於此，官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"將不成，財將不住。如財弱，必待厯旺鄉而榮，財盛無往","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":984,"lineType":1,"content":"不利，但恐身勢無力，不能勝任。偏財格。主人慷慨，不甚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"吝財，與人有情而多詐。若是得地，不止財豐，亦能旺官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":986,"lineType":1,"content":"以財盛自生官，運行旺相，福禄俱臻，一遇官鄉，便可發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506144678395967"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":989,"lineType":1,"content":"福。如柱中原帶官星，便作好命看。若兄弟輩出，縱入官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":990,"lineType":1,"content":"鄉，發福必渺。偏財月令所帶最重，不宜柱中，多逢年上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"偏財生旺月令柱中通氣，主受伯叔祖考産䕃豐隆，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":992,"lineType":1,"content":"外祖產業恩養。大要日主興隆，財星生旺，運向財旺之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":993,"lineType":1,"content":"鄉發福。若見刑衝破害，比刼分奪，或財星太衰，日主太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":994,"lineType":1,"content":"弱，或財多生煞，皆破祖勞碌之命。凡月令有財，主少年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴，若生時不得地，或有刼敗，更運臨㓙地，晚年祖財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":996,"lineType":1,"content":"破盡，終身困窮，先富後貧。若年月本無，日時帶財，别無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506098595594279"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"刼敗衝尅，則主自家成立，中晚之年大發。若柱中財多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":1000,"lineType":1,"content":"身弱，少年又經休敗之地，多事頻併，百不如意，中末年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"後，忽臨父母之地，或三合可以助我，則勃然而興。若少","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":1002,"lineType":1,"content":"年乗旺，老來脫局，不唯守窮途而恓惶，抑且是非蜂起，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"以財能利己，亦能招謗故也。若四柱相生，别帶貴格，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":1004,"lineType":1,"content":"值空亡，又行旺運，三合財星，皆是貴命，其福禄淺深，隨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"格輕重言之。又曰：凡人命有兩位財，身弱不妨，元用正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":1006,"lineType":1,"content":"財，身旺發財，元用偏財，身旺脫財。又云，偏正二財，喜忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506119374143515"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"大同，唯有喜官星，不喜官星小異，有正財不若有偏財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":1010,"lineType":1,"content":"偏財重實，其福則厚，最怕刼敗。比肩在年最重，在月稍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"次，一名孤辰，一名逐馬，主尅妻害子，破財貧薄，又防陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":1012,"lineType":1,"content":"賊小人，同類相傷。柱中元犯此忌，運行財旺之地，亦可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"發福。再行比刼，退敗而身死者有之，遭官破敗者有之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":1014,"lineType":1,"content":"通明賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_107","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":1014,"lineType":1,"content":"云：月上偏財，無刼無敗，富甲人間。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":1014,"lineType":1,"content":"相心賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_108","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":1014,"lineType":1,"content":"云：偏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"財透露，輕財好義，愛人趨奉，好說是非，嗜酒貪花，亦係","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":1016,"lineType":1,"content":"如此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":1016,"lineType":1,"content":"驚神賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_109","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":1016,"lineType":1,"content":"云：偏財身旺，趂求商賈之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":1016,"lineType":1,"content":"奥㫖","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_110","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":1016,"lineType":1,"content":"云：偏財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506150667747380"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"能益，算延年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"千里馬","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_111","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"云：出現偏財，少愛正妻多愛妾。古","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":1020,"lineType":1,"content":"歌云：偏財格遇最難眀，日旺却從髙路行。一世因財人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"謗訕，財多身弱惹災生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":1021,"lineType":2,"content":"乂","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_112","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":1021,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"偏財非是自己財，最怕比肩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":1022,"lineType":1,"content":"同位來。刼敗不逢日主健，家資當發孟嘗財。","logicSentence {"lines":[{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"乃丙日見丙申時，甲日見己巳時。丙之禄在巳，丙既坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":1056,"lineType":1,"content":"申，引巳刑出庚金，丙日尅之為財，巳與申合，兩干皆丙，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506150667763764"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":1059,"lineType":1,"content":"是為専財。運行官旺，財神不背，大發財官。忌行傷官刼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":1060,"lineType":1,"content":"財、衝刑破禄之運。甲日己巳時，要身財俱旺，生木旺月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":1061,"lineType":1,"content":"喜土多，生土旺月喜木多。丙日亦然，如甲辰、戊辰、丙申、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":1062,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申，癸酉、庚申、丙子、丙申，二命専財格也。古詩云：専財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":1063,"lineType":1,"content":"丙日見申時，運至官鄉福更竒。須登象簡金魚貴，福夀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":1064,"lineType":1,"content":"䨇全事事宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":1065,"lineType":8,"content":"棄命從財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":1066,"lineType":1,"content":"獨步","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_116","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":1066,"lineType":1,"content":"云：棄命從財，須要㑹財，若逢根氣，命損無猜。假如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506094145552393"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":1069,"lineType":1,"content":"丁生酉，月柱多庚辛，日干無氣，只得棄命相從，運入北","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":1070,"lineType":1,"content":"方，財官旺地，乃為入格南行災。古歌云：曰干無氣滿盤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":1071,"lineType":1,"content":"財，棄命相從是福胎。運旺財官皆富貴，如逢根助反為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":1072,"lineType":1,"content":"災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":1073,"lineType":8,"content":"日坐天財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":1074,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊己土尅水為財，水墓辰是也。古歌云：年干尅下，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"天財尅墓之鄉。正庫開財入庫時多糓帛家豪金物積","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":1076,"lineType":1,"content":"成堆。如畢狀元己巳、癸酉、庚辰、甲申是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506094145536009"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":1079,"lineType":8,"content":"偏正財合論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":1080,"lineType":1,"content":"精紀有生成財，如甲乙見戊己土為財，申子辰上坐生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":1081,"lineType":1,"content":"旺庫，戊申、戊辰、戊子支干成合是也。凡命入貴格，除","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":1082,"lineType":1,"content":"貴外，須主大富，仍多厯錢糓之任。若不入貴格，又無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"福神助，亦是富豪百姓。若自生自旺，甲人見戊午、己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":1084,"lineType":1,"content":"亥之例，主富，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"有生合財，如甲人見戊，癸己人見癸，戊庚人見甲己等","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":1086,"lineType":1,"content":"類，主成立富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506098595643431"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"有子母財。如木命人見火月土日時之類，主平生多見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":1090,"lineType":1,"content":"喜事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":1091,"lineType":1,"content":"有類財煞。寅午戌人見乙庚，己酉丑人見丁壬，申子辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":1092,"lineType":1,"content":"人見戊癸，亥卯未人見甲己。一名幽微煞，主名利並","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":1094,"lineType":1,"content":"有財會煞。寅午戌人見辛丑，己酉丑人見乙未，申子辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"人見丙戌，亥卯未人見戊辰。此妻財聚㑹之神，遇者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":1096,"lineType":1,"content":"主富足，及有美妻。横財却妨妻。人毒藥害命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506144678428735"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":1099,"lineType":1,"content":"有名位財乃食神中見庫，如戊子火人見庚戌。戊食庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1362","lineNum":1100,"lineType":1,"content":"火，庫在戌，尅金為財，逢此者一生受禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1363","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"有長生財。如甲用戊己為財，見戊申；癸用丙丁為財，見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1364","lineNum":1102,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅之例，此類多得外財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1365","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰，術者多以甲見戊、乙見己類為財，不知甲己見丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1366","lineNum":1104,"lineType":1,"content":"辛，丙辛見戊癸等類為真財。生居有氣旺相之位，主富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1367","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"盛。又納音本干自見真五行，如乙亥人月日時中見庚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1368","lineNum":1106,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥納音火，乙庚真金，干頭自是財也。此名天財，主富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1369","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506123702632475"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1370","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"足優逸。若納音反制尅干頭，如丁卯火却能制乙庚金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1371","lineNum":1110,"lineType":1,"content":"此名鬼財，主一生得世財，或為豪猾胥吏起家，戊寅、戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1372","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"申得丙辛，乙酉、乙卯得戊癸，准此。更帶辰戌丑未，主為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1373","lineNum":1112,"lineType":1,"content":"藝術，大獲世財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1374","lineNum":1113,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰禄、命、身三等財庫。如甲子金，甲為禄，屬木，木尅土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1375","lineNum":1114,"lineType":1,"content":"故土為禄財，土墓在辰，是為禄財庫也。子為命，屬水，水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1376","lineNum":1115,"lineType":1,"content":"尅火，故火為命財，火墓在戌，是為命財庫也。金為身，金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1377","lineNum":1116,"lineType":1,"content":"尅木，故木為身財，木墓在未，是為身財庫也。主財產豐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1378","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506119374192667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1379","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"盈，少年辛苦，漸老成遂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1380","lineNum":1120,"lineType":1,"content":"有嵗制月建，如甲乙人在辰戌丑未，丙丁人在申酉等","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1381","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"類。若人遇之，主職位崇髙，印綬顯赫。若身衰不能尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1382","lineNum":1122,"lineType":1,"content":"財，如壬寅金，見戊辰木、丁卯火、癸酉金之類，不能尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1383","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"制，翻成損氣。餘倣此。推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1384","lineNum":1124,"lineType":1,"content":"論印綬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1385","lineNum":1124,"lineType":2,"content":"喜食神，看天月、徳官、七煞。  逢印  煞  以  為引，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":1125,"lineType":2,"content":"忌刑衝，印傷官。  辰戌  怕木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":1126,"lineType":2,"content":"死墓，印不怕木。丑未，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":1127,"lineType":2,"content":"一曰正印星，二曰魁星，三曰孤極。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506123702648859"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":1130,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬者，乃五行生我之名，如甲乙在亥子月，丙丁在寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1391","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月之類，乃我氣之源，為生氣，為父母，能䕶我官星，使","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1392","lineNum":1132,"lineType":1,"content":"無傷尅。譬人生得物，相助相養，受現成之福，豈不為妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1393","lineNum":1133,"lineType":1,"content":"此格主聰明，多智慧，性慈恵，語善良遲訥，體貌豐厚，能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1394","lineNum":1134,"lineType":1,"content":"飲食，平生少病，不逢凶横，但吝財耳。為官多為正官，受","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1395","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"宣勅，不拘文武，皆掌印信。喜官星，以官能生印，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1396","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_117","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1397","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"云印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1398","lineNum":1136,"lineType":1,"content":"賴官生，又云有官無印，即非真官，有印有官，方成厚福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1399","lineNum":1137,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。忌財星，以財能破印，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1400","lineNum":1137,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_118","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1401","lineNum":1137,"lineType":1,"content":"云月生日干無天財，乃印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1402","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506109938712576"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1403","lineNum":1140,"lineType":1,"content":"綬之名。乂云印綬被傷，倘若榮華不久。又云印綬生月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1404","lineNum":1141,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗時忌見財星，運入財鄉，却宜退身避位，是也。嵗運同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1405","lineNum":1142,"lineType":1,"content":"論，印綬不逢損傷，多受父母倚䕃，資財見成，安享富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1406","lineNum":1143,"lineType":1,"content":"諸命相比，當以印綬多者為上，月最要，日時次之。年干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1407","lineNum":1144,"lineType":1,"content":"雖重，須歸禄月日時，方可取用。若年露印，月日時無，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1408","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"不濟事。四柱元有官星為妙，若印綬少，官鬼多，或入他","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1409","lineNum":1146,"lineType":1,"content":"格，又不可専言印綬。若印綬復遇拱禄、専禄、歸禄、䑕貴、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1410","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"夾貴、時貴等格，尤為竒特，但主少子或無子。印綬多者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506144678461503"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":1150,"lineType":1,"content":"清孤，舊集云印多則清孤不免是也。凡印綬喜七煞，但","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1413","lineNum":1151,"lineType":1,"content":"煞不可太多，多則傷身。原無七煞，行運遇之則發，原有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1414","lineNum":1152,"lineType":1,"content":"七煞，行財運，或印綬死絶，或臨墓地，皆㓙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1415","lineNum":1152,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_119","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1416","lineNum":1152,"lineType":1,"content":"云煞能生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1417","lineNum":1153,"lineType":1,"content":"印，畏行財鄉，破印助鬼，决主不祥，又云印墓則夀夭難","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1418","lineNum":1154,"lineType":1,"content":"逃，是也。凡格喜身旺，惟印綬喜身弱，若元局帶財傷印，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1419","lineNum":1155,"lineType":1,"content":"運行比刼，身旺亦能發福，無則不宜。如無官煞財神，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":1156,"lineType":1,"content":"行身旺，主平常淵源。論印綬，如甲日遇子月為正印，亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":1157,"lineType":1,"content":"月為偏印，最喜逢天月徳。子天徳在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":1157,"lineType":1,"content":"巽","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_120","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1423","lineNum":1157,"lineType":1,"content":"，月徳在壬，亥天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1424","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506127028600858"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1425","lineNum":1160,"lineType":1,"content":"徳在乙，月徳在甲，時要見酉辛正官為妙。或申庚七煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1426","lineNum":1161,"lineType":1,"content":"却要見比刼助身，合煞為貴。畏戊己財星損印，忌丙丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1427","lineNum":1162,"lineType":1,"content":"食傷，生財破印。乙逢亥子月，喜忌與甲同。丙日逢卯月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1428","lineNum":1163,"lineType":1,"content":"正印天徳在坤，月徳在甲，寅月，偏印天徳在丁，月徳在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1429","lineNum":1164,"lineType":1,"content":"丙，喜見子癸正官，或壬亥七煞，却要比刼助身合煞。畏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1430","lineNum":1165,"lineType":1,"content":"申庚酉辛財星損印。忌戊己食傷，生財破印。丁逢寅卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1431","lineNum":1166,"lineType":1,"content":"月，喜忌與丙同。戊日逢午月，正印天徳在亥月徳在丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1432","lineNum":1167,"lineType":1,"content":"巳月，偏印天徳在辛月徳在庚。喜逢卯乙正官，寅甲七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1433","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506119374209051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1434","lineNum":1170,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，見煞却宜比刼助身合煞。忌見壬癸丁財壊，申庚辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1435","lineNum":1171,"lineType":1,"content":"食傷，生財破印。己生巳午月，最忌與戊同。庚日生午月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1436","lineNum":1172,"lineType":1,"content":"正印天徳在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1437","lineNum":1172,"lineType":1,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_121","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1438","lineNum":1172,"lineType":1,"content":"、月徳在丙己月，偏印天徳在辛月徳在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1439","lineNum":1173,"lineType":1,"content":"庚。喜見午丁官星，己丙七煞，見煞却宜比刼助身合煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1440","lineNum":1174,"lineType":1,"content":"忌甲乙寅卯旺財壊印，壬癸傷食，午財破印。辛生巳午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1441","lineNum":1175,"lineType":1,"content":"月，喜忌與庚同。壬日生酉月，正印天徳在寅、月徳在庚、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1442","l {"lines":[{"lineId":"1448","lineNum":1180,"lineType":1,"content":"官刑不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1449","lineNum":1181,"lineType":1,"content":"犯，印綬與天徳同宫。又曰：素食慈心，印綬喜逢於天徳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1450","lineNum":1182,"lineType":1,"content":"如孟重都憲，乙亥、丁亥、乙丑、丙戌，是印綬與天徳同宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1451","lineNum":1183,"lineType":1,"content":"一命甲寅、丙寅、丙寅、丁酉，是天徳在丁，月徳在丙，印綬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1452","lineNum":1184,"lineType":1,"content":"在寅；一命庚申、庚辰、庚子、壬午，是天徳月德俱在壬，印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1453","lineNum":1185,"lineType":1,"content":"綬在辰是也。此格大要生旺，最忌死絶，如甲乙見亥子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1454","lineNum":1186,"lineType":1,"content":"為印見金，成其仁義生養，印元見土，則混雜其格。運行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1455","lineNum":1187,"lineType":1,"content":"西北，官印為福，若時引歸卯辰巳地，或運行此地，財印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1456","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506127028650010"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1457","lineNum":1190,"lineType":1,"content":"歸死絶流年，再遇財尅印，决入黄泉無疑。印綬合格，行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1458","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"大運最忌印綬變合，遇地支三合，或變為傷局，或變成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1459","lineNum":1192,"lineType":1,"content":"財局，或變成煞局，最為不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1460","lineNum":1192,"lineType":1,"content":"賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_123","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1461","lineNum":1192,"lineType":1,"conten {"lines":[{"lineId":"1462","lineNum":1192,"lineType":1,"content":"金賴土生，土厚而金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1463","lineNum":1193,"lineType":1,"content":"遭埋沒；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1464","lineNum":1193,"lineType":1,"content":"木從水養，水盛而木必漂流。火炎土燥，則不能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1465","lineNum":1194,"lineType":1,"content":"生物，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1466","lineNum":1194,"lineType":2,"content":"如己日得午之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1467","lineNum":1194,"lineType":1,"content":"剛金不能生水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1468","lineNum":1194,"lineType":2,"content":"如庚日得戌之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1469","lineNum":1194,"lineType":1,"content":"旺土見旺火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1470","lineNum":1195,"lineType":1,"content":"逢此，必主眼疾、癰疽熱病。糞土不能生金，燥金不能生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1471","lineNum":1196,"lineType":1,"content":"水，絶水不能生木，遇此宜詳看，不可一概印綬論。若水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1472","lineNum":1197,"lineType":1,"content":"得金生而逢秋，乃水清金白，秀麗堪誇，一水三金，號曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1473","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506098595708967"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":1200,"lineType":1,"content":"體全之象。火得木生，而值春，為木秀火明，發焰紅緑，見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":1201,"lineType":1,"content":"金則傷其木，滅火之焰。是金木二印多者，俱作吉論。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":1202,"lineType":1,"content":"火印多者，火燥土烈；水印多者，水泛木浮；土印多者，土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1477","lineNum":1203,"lineType":1,"content":"重金埋，皆不為吉。又云：甲日子月，忌己巳，時怕午衝。乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1478","lineNum":1204,"lineType":1,"conten
