{"lines":[{"lineId":"1692","lineNum":1333,"lineType":8,"content":"時逢生印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1693","lineNum":1334,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲日子時，取子中癸水為印，資助日主，其人足智多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1694","lineNum":1335,"lineType":1,"content":"謀，安享食禄。年月上要見辛官生印，運行西北，官印乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1695","lineNum":1336,"lineType":1,"content":"為貴命。若柱逢戊己土重，更有午字衝破，運厯東南，官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1696","lineNum":1337,"lineType":1,"content":"印衰絶，百事無成，公吏肆市人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1697","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506115582607400"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1698","lineNum":1340,"lineType":8,"content":"胞胎逢印綬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1699","lineNum":1341,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_152","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1700","lineNum":1341,"lineType":1,"content":"云：胞胎逢印綬，禄享千鍾。如庚寅、辛卯、丙申、乙酉等","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1701","lineNum":1342,"lineType":1,"content":"日時月令，逢印綬之地，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1702","lineNum":1342,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_153","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1703","lineNum":1342,"lineType":1,"content":"云：時日胞胎格，月通印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1704","lineNum":1343,"lineType":1,"content":"綬，逢煞官印運助職，位列三公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1705","lineNum":1344,"lineType":8,"content":"棄印就財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1706","lineNum":1345,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_154","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1707","lineNum":1345,"lineType":1,"content":"云：棄印就財，明偏正。印綬忌財，此理甚明。正印居月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1708","lineNum":1346,"lineType":1,"content":"令者，决不可見財。若居年時月令，見財只用財格，喜印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1709","lineNum":1347,"lineType":1,"content":"生身，敵財為福。若偏印月令，年時見財，無妨為棄印就","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1710","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506115582558248"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1711","lineNum":1350,"lineType":1,"content":"財，捨輕用重。如壬生申月，丙生寅月，坐長生之地，年時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1712","lineNum":1351,"lineType":1,"content":"得財，即身旺喜見財地，如此造化，必主棄祖基而自創","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1713","lineNum":1352,"lineType":1,"content":"别業。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1714","lineNum":1352,"lineType":1,"content":"立身","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_155","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1715","lineNum":1353,"lineType":1,"content":"論","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_155","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1716","lineNum":1353,"lineType":1,"content":"倒食，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1717","lineNum":1353,"lineType":2,"content":"一名吞啗煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1718","lineNum":1354,"lineType":2,"content":"一名退神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1719","lineNum":1355,"lineType":1,"content":"倒食即偏印之謂，一名吞啖煞，食神最忌見之。如甲生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1720","lineNum":1356,"lineType":1,"content":"丙火為食，火能生土，為甲之財，財旺生金，為甲之官，食","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1721","lineNum":1357,"lineType":1,"content":"神生旺，財官備矣。今甲見壬為倒食者，壬旺則尅了丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1722","lineNum":1358,"lineType":1,"content":"火，丙被尅去，不能生土，甲無財矣。壬合起丁，傷甲之辛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1723","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506125103448127"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1724","lineNum":1361,"lineType":1,"content":"甲無官矣。壬尅去丙庚，煞得安來，傷甲木，甲生災矣。所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1725","lineNum":1362,"lineType":1,"content":"謂用食忌見者，此也。凡命帶倒食，福薄夀夭。若有制合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1726","lineNum":1363,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲日見壬辰、壬戌，辰戌中有土制丁合。乙日見癸未、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1727","lineNum":1364,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑，丑未中有己制癸。丙日見甲申，丁日見乙巳、乙酉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1728","lineNum":1365,"lineType":1,"content":"戊日見丙子、丙申、丙辰，己日見丁亥，庚日見戊寅、戊辰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1729","lineNum":1366,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日見己卯、己亥，壬日見庚午、庚戌，癸日見辛巳、辛未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1730","lineNum":1367,"lineType":1,"content":"此等偏印，不能為食害，有尅制故也。柱中身旺，財官俱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1731","lineNum":1368,"lineType":1,"content":"生，可取為福助身。陽日逢之，能暗合傷官生財；隂日逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1732","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506125103464511"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1733","lineNum":1371,"lineType":1,"content":"之，能暗合財星。柱中無食，只以偏印論。又曰：凡命有食","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1734","lineNum":1372,"lineType":1,"content":"遇梟，猶尊長之制我，不得自由，作事進退悔懶，有始無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1735","lineNum":1373,"lineType":1,"content":"終。財源屢成屢敗，容貌欹斜，身品瑣小，膽怯心虗，凡事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1736","lineNum":1374,"lineType":1,"content":"無成，尅害六親，㓜時尅母，長大傷妻子。賦云：倒食者名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1737","lineNum":1375,"lineType":1,"content":"為偏印，號曰梟神，值身旺而財豐福厚，遇刑煞則夀夭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1738","lineNum":1376,"lineType":1,"content":"身貧。財星若見，披星帶月不停留；煞星若生，弛擔息肩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1739","lineNum":1377,"lineType":1,"content":"無定日。身弱重逢偏印，須愁顔子之傷；正食若遇梟神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1740","lineNum":1378,"lineType":1,"content":"未免韓信之禍。始遇者精神慵懶，重犯者容貌欹斜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1741","lineNum":1378,"lineType":1,"content":"萬","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_156","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1742","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506123702698011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1743","lineNum":1381,"lineType":1,"content":"祺賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_156","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1744","lineNum":1381,"lineType":1,"content":"云：梟神見官煞，多成多敗。偏印遇財曜，反辱為榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1745","lineNum":1382,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺為貴。身弱乃常有傷官而平生豐潤，值食神則處","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1746","lineNum":1383,"lineType":1,"content":"世伶仃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1747","lineNum":1383,"lineType":1,"content":"元理賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_157","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1748","lineNum":1383,"lineType":1,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1749","lineNum":1383,"lineType":1,"content":"丁逢卯日，遇己土，饕貪之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1750","lineNum":1383,"lineType":1,"content":"相心賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_158","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1751","lineNum":1384,"lineType":1,"content":"云：梟神當權，使心機而始勤終怠，好學藝而多學少成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1752","lineNum":1385,"lineType":1,"content":"奥㫖賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_159","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1753","lineNum":1385,"lineType":1,"content":"云：年時月令有偏印，㓙吉未明；大運嵗君逢夀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1754","lineNum":1386,"lineType":1,"content":"星，災殃立至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1755","lineNum":1386,"lineType":1,"content":"絡繹賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_160","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1756","lineNum":1386,"lineType":1,"content":"云：梟居祖位，破祖之基。古詩云：印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1757","lineNum":1387,"lineType":1,"content":"星偏者是梟神，柱内最喜見財星。身旺遇此方為福，身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1758","lineNum":1388,"lineType":1,"content":"衰梟旺更無情。如丙戌、丙申、甲戌、壬申，甲見丙食，又見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1759","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506127028781082"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1760","lineNum":1391,"lineType":1,"content":"壬倒食。甲生申，月受煞制，無氣；二丙竊氣，壬水制丙，煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1761","lineNum":1392,"lineType":1,"content":"得施行，故無名利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1762","lineNum":1392,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1763","lineNum":1392,"lineType":1,"content":"如壬申、壬子、甲戌、丙寅，會印歸禄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1764","lineNum":1393,"lineType":1,"content":"水精火神之妙，木火通明之象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1765","lineNum":1393,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1766","lineNum":1393,"lineType":1,"content":"己未、壬申、甲子、丙寅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1767","lineNum":1394,"lineType":1,"content":"以煞化印，歸禄得秀，木火通明，水木清竒，二命俱大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1768","lineNum":1395,"lineType":1,"content":"前忌倒食，逢制合反貴。切不可一見倒食，便以㓙論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1769","lineNum":1396,"lineType":1,"content":"論雜氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1770","lineNum":1396,"lineType":2,"content":"喜身旺，忌壓伏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1771","lineNum":1397,"lineType":2,"content":"刑衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1772","lineNum":1398,"lineType":1,"content":"雜氣者，乃辰、戌、丑、未。辰中有乙、戊，癸為水土庫；戌中有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1773","lineNum":1399,"lineType":1,"content":"辛，戊，丁為火庫；丑中有癸，辛，己為金庫；未中有丁，己，乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1774","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506125103497279"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1775","lineNum":1402,"lineType":1,"content":"為木庫。各隨所藏之氣而言。看我日干，或為官，或為財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1776","lineNum":1403,"lineType":1,"content":"或為印。官係福身之物，財是養命之源，印乃資身之本，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1777","lineNum":1404,"lineType":1,"content":"在人最為切要。四庫各藏三件，乃天地不正之氣，故以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1778","lineNum":1405,"lineType":1,"content":"雜言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1779","lineNum":1405,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_161","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1780","lineNum":1405,"lineType":1,"content":"云財官印綬全備，藏蓄於四季之中是也。此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1781","lineNum":1406,"lineType":1,"content":"格喜透露衝刑，忌壓伏，其餘喜忌消詳，與前正氣財官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1782","lineNum":1407,"lineType":1,"content":"印同。假令六甲日生得丑月，以丑中辛金為官，己土為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1783","lineNum":1408,"lineType":1,"content":"財，癸水為印，看天干透出何字為福，次分節氣淺深，何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1784","lineNum":1409,"lineType":1,"content":"物當令大槩，透財者富，透官者貴，印綬享父祖見成之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1785","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506167310680099"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1786","lineNum":1412,"lineType":1,"content":"福，受宣勅䕃庇之貴。如無透出衝刑少許，兼身旺為妙，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1787","lineNum":1413,"lineType":1,"content":"忌身弱衝刑太過，則福聚之氣散矣。如柱元有破害之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1788","lineNum":1414,"lineType":1,"content":"物，再不可遇，此等運再行，則為太過，衝壊秀氣，反不為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1789","lineNum":1415,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。元無破害，喜衝刑運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1790","lineNum":1415,"lineType":1,"content":"景鑑","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_162","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1791","lineNum":1415,"lineType":1,"content":"云：雜氣財官身旺有衝而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1792","lineNum":1416,"lineType":1,"content":"發，若太過，反受孤貧是也。又云：雜氣財官格，要四柱財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1793","lineNum":1417,"lineType":1,"content":"星多，便為好命，若四柱别入他格，依他格斷。又云：雜氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1794","lineNum":1418,"lineType":1,"content":"財官有正官格、偏官格、正財格、偏財格，雜氣印綬，有正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1795","lineNum":1419,"lineType":1,"content":"印格、偏印格，須分偏正，若偏官旺，亦要少許制伏則可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1796","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506127028797466"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1797","lineNum":1422,"lineType":1,"content":"若墓庫重叠，元無刑衝，不透貴氣，兼有戊己壓其上，最","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1798","lineNum":1423,"lineType":1,"content":"難發於少年，故曰財官鎻閉，少年不發，墓中人是也。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1799","lineNum":1424,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：四庫亦是衰養冠帶之鄉，若時上見為時墓格，與月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1800","lineNum":1425,"lineType":1,"content":"上同論，但發較晚。如丁亥、戊子、丙申、己丑，丙用丑墓為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1801","lineNum":1426,"lineType":1,"content":"財庫，行未運衝丑庫發財。見壬辰為官庫，至戌運衝辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1802","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"庫發官。倘柱中别有戊辰己丑壓伏庫上，則不能發財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1803","lineNum":1428,"lineType":1,"content":"發官，難作好命看。若有衝見合，則又不能衝矣。又曰：月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1804","lineNum":1429,"lineType":1,"content":"臨庫地，東西南北四隅之氣，如未木行東方，戌火行南","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1805","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506166299852812"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1806","lineNum":1432,"lineType":1,"content":"方，辰水行北方，丑金行西方，臨庫墓運行生旺之地，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1807","lineNum":1433,"lineType":1,"content":"發。如月臨辰，水氣運轉南方，不見會合，只以土論。又曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1808","lineNum":1434,"lineType":1,"content":"古人以五行墓處為倉庫，若命中帶倉庫，遇太嵗所尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1809","lineNum":1435,"lineType":1,"content":"之五行加之，如木人得辛未，火人得庚戌，土人得壬辰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1810","lineNum":1436,"lineType":1,"content":"水人得甲辰，金人得癸丑，是謂庫中有財，其人必豐厚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1811","lineNum":1437,"lineType":1,"content":"若命帶墓絶，而反值太嵗所畏之五行加之，如木人得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1812","lineNum":1438,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未，火人 {"lines":[{"lineId":"1819","lineNum":1446,"lineType":1,"content":"有庫頭鬼，乃甲乙人見辛未，忌丁巳。丙丁人見壬戌，忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1820","lineNum":1447,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅。戊己人見甲辰，忌庚寅。庚辛人見丁丑，忌癸巳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1821","lineNum":1448,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸人見戊辰，忌甲寅。一名軒車煞。若犯所忌，主車","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1822","lineNum":1449,"lineType":1,"content":"破輛，馬折足，婦人疾厄，常人致盗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1823","lineNum":1449,"lineType":1,"content":"神白經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_163","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1824","lineNum":1449,"lineType":1,"content":"云，生日犯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1825","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506125103513663"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1826","lineNum":1452,"lineType":1,"content":"之得用。若遇時不犯忌，多主富貴，君子早年科甲，常","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1827","lineNum":1453,"lineType":1,"content":"人藝業出衆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1990","lineNum":1557,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_173","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1991","lineNum":1557,"lineType":1,"content":"云傷官無財可倚，雖巧必貧是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1992","lineNum":1558,"lineType":1,"content":"也。傷官格用財亦有用印者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1993","lineNum":1558,"lineType":1,"content":"天玄賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_174","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1994","lineNum":1558,"lineType":1,"content":"云：傷官用印宜去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1995","lineNum":1559,"lineType":1,"content":"財，用財宜去印，倘使財印兩全，將何發福？身旺者用財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1996","lineNum":1560,"lineType":1,"content":"身弱者用印。用印者須去財，方能發福，用財者不論印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1997","lineNum":1561,"lineType":1,"content":"亦主亨通。傷官用印，不忌官煞，去財方發。元犯傷官，須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1998","lineNum":1562,"lineType":1,"content":"要見財則發。傷官最喜行財運，印綬身旺次之，不喜行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1999","lineNum":1563,"lineType":1,"content":"官鄉。四柱傷官多，而見官者不宜復行傷運，一位無妨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2000","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506127028879386"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2001","lineNum":1566,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：傷官格務要傷盡，若柱見傷官，而官星隠顯，傷之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2002","lineNum":1567,"lineType":1,"content":"不盡。嵗運再見官星，官來乘旺，再見刑衝破害，刃煞尅","logicSentenceId" 6","lineNum":1580,"lineType":1,"content":"尅土，若水泛木浮，不得土止，難以存活，况木得土成栽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2017","lineNum":1581,"lineType":1,"content":"培之力。木以火為傷，以金為官，火雖尅金，若木繁火熄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2018","lineNum":1582,"lineType":1,"content":"不得金削脫，難以通明，况金得火成器物之象，所以金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2019","lineNum":1583,"lineType":1,"content":"水木傷官格，不忌官星。故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2020","lineNum":1583,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_176","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2021","lineNum":1583,"lineType":1,"content":"云傷官火土宜傷盡，金水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2022","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506127028863002"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2023","lineNum":1586,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官要見官，木火見官官要旺，土金官去反成官，惟有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2024","lineNum":1587,"lineType":1,"content":"水木傷官格，財官兩見始為歡是也。又曰：傷官傷盡，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2025","lineNum":1588,"lineType":1,"content":"有不作福者，傷官見官，亦有不作禍者。如一命丁未丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2026","lineNum":1589,"lineType":1,"content":"未，丙午丙午，丙日坐午日主自旺，有二午二丁二未，財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2027","lineNum":1590,"lineType":1,"content":"官俱傷，雖傷官傷盡，奈四柱火氣太旺，竊氣又重，運行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2028","lineNum":1591,"lineType":1,"content":"東南火旺之鄉，無一㸃財氣，身空旺無倚，至貧之人，切","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2029","lineNum":1592,"lineType":1,"content":"不可見傷官傷盡，身旺便作好命看。又如甲日生人 arginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2154","lineNum":1680,"lineType":1,"content":"財透天干作用神。此格傷官官喜旺，只愁身旺反傷身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2155","lineNum":1681,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2156","lineNum":1681,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官傷盡復生財，器識剛明實偉哉。縱使祖財無分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2157","lineNum":1682,"lineType":1,"content":"有，等閒玉帛自天來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2158","lineNum":1682,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2159","lineNum":1682,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官傷盡最為竒，福禄峥嶸亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2160","lineNum":1683,"lineType":1,"content":"夀彌。嵗運更行身旺地，逢財身旺貴無疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2161","lineNum":1683,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2162","lineNum":1683,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官不盡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506166299983884"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2164","lineNum":1686,"lineType":1,"content":"又逢官，斬絞徒流禍百端。月犯父子無全美，日犯自己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2165","lineNum":1687,"lineType":1,"content":"主傷殘。時傷子息多狼狽，須知富貴不周全。若是傷官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2166","lineNum":1688,"lineType":1,"content":"居太嵗，必招横禍逢斯年。合諸說觀之，傷官喜忌盡矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2167","lineNum":1689,"lineType":1,"content":"論食神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2168","lineNum":1689,"lineType":2,"content":"喜身旺，忌身弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2169","lineNum":1690,"lineType":2,"content":"宜行財鄉，比肩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2170","lineNum":1691,"lineType":2,"content":"逢食㸔財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2171","lineNum":1692,"lineType":2,"content":"一名進神，三名夀星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2172","lineNum":1693,"lineType":2,"content":"二名爵星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2173","lineNum":1694,"lineType":1,"content":"食神者，日干所生，順數第三位，乃甲食丙、乙食丁之例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2174","lineNum":1695,"lineType":1,"content":"甲生丙本為泄氣，丙生戊為甲偏財。偏財是天禄自然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2175","lineNum":1696,"lineType":1,"content":"之財，不勞己之心力，享見成福禄。甲丙有父子之道，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2176","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506166299951116"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2177","lineNum":1699,"lineType":1,"content":"子旺相，生起財禄，以奉其父母，豈不安享？又甲見庚為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2178","lineNum":1700,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，見戊為財，其食神丙火，能制伏庚煞，使不得尅傷。甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2179","lineNum":1701,"lineType":1,"content":"木能生戊財，使為甲木所用。凡命遇財煞之地，食神旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2180","lineNum":1702,"lineType":1,"content":"相，煞被食制，不敢為禍，財被食生，充裕不竭。故食神一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2181","lineNum":1703,"lineType":1,"content":"名夀星，一名爵星，良有以也。此格要日主食神俱生旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2182","lineNum":1704,"lineType":1,"content":"無衝破，主人財厚食豐，福量寛弘，肌體肥大，優游自足，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2183","lineNum":1705,"lineType":1,"content":"有子息，有夀考。四柱見財，食在嵗月上，祖父䕃業豐隆；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2184","lineNum":1706,"lineType":1,"content":"在日時，妻男獲福。怕母子俱衰絶，兩皆無成。故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2185","lineNum":1706,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_188","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2186","lineNum":1706,"lineType":1,"content":"云食","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2187","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506167310909475"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2188","lineNum":1709,"lineType":1,"content":"神宜食生食旺，不可食衰食絶。又云食神生旺，勝似財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2189","lineNum":1710,"lineType":1,"content":"官是也。又曰食神大忌偏印為倒食，主為人有始無終，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2190","lineNum":1711,"lineType":1,"content":"容貌欹邪，身材瑣小，心性局促，多慾無成。假如甲見丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2191","lineNum":1712,"lineType":1,"content":"為食柱，中有壬作甲木偏印尅制，丙火不能生戊土，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2192","lineNum":1713,"lineType":1,"content":"能制庚金，使甲木受制退財，豈不窘乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2193","lineNum":1713,"lineType":1,"content":"元理賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_189","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2194","lineNum":1713,"lineType":1,"content":"云食神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2195","lineNum":1714,"lineType":1,"content":"制煞逢梟，不貧則夭。一行云五行休廢遇竒救，災禍必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2196","lineNum":1715,"lineType":1,"content":"輕；四柱消息值平和，福徳増重。若逢倒食之神，决主財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2197","lineNum":1716,"lineType":1,"content":"多耗散是也。又曰陽日食神暗合官星，隂日食神暗合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2198","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506150667862068"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2199","lineNum":1719,"lineType":1,"content":"正印，官印不要明顯，但得食神純粹，主貴而有禄，富而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2200","lineNum":1720,"lineType":1,"content":"有夀。食神只宜一位，不宜太多，恐竊本元之氣。經云一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2201","lineNum":1721,"lineType":1,"content":"木叠逢火位，名為散氣之文是也。食神多者，宜行印運，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2202","lineNum":1722,"lineType":1,"content":"食少者，不宜是梟神奪食。故食喜旺禄相助，月令建禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2203","lineNum":1723,"lineType":1,"content":"最佳，時禄次之，更逢貴人運行食神生旺之地，大發福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2204","lineNum":1724,"lineType":1,"content":"禄，忌身衰梟旺，柱中雖喜見財，亦不宜多，多則不清，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2205","lineNum":1725,"lineType":1,"content":"過一富翁而已。食神重見，變為傷官，令人少子。縱有或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2206","lineNum":1726,"lineType":1,"content":"帶破抝性，又不可入墓，即是傷官入墓，住夀難延。大忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2207","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506167310876707"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2208","lineNum":1729,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡，更有官煞顯露，為太醫、師巫、術數、九流之士。若食","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2209","lineNum":1730,"lineType":1,"content":"神逢尅，又遇空亡，則不貴。再行死絶或梟運，則因食上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2210","lineNum":1731,"lineType":1,"content":"氣上生災，翻胃噎食，缺衣食，忍饑寒而已。又曰：甲日食","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2211","lineNum":1732,"lineType":1,"content":"丙，柱中無壬癸，亥子方好，如有水氣，丙自受制，屈伏於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2212","lineNum":1733,"lineType":1,"content":"人，己身不能卓立，豈能生物以養其父？如無此制，又要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2213","lineNum":1734,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺向禄，如丙生夏月，運厯東南，火土俱旺，其甲用財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2214","lineNum":1735,"lineType":1,"content":"必厚。若生三春，甲旺，丙火雖得生，不知戊己氣薄，須厯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2215","lineNum":1736,"lineType":1,"content":"南方，火土俱旺，方許發福。又如庚以壬為食，運厯北方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2216","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506182196297765"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2217","lineNum":1739,"lineType":1,"content":"水旺之地，發財必厚，東方木旺之鄉，發福必𦂳。細論之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2218","lineNum":1740,"lineType":1,"content":"庚以壬為食，長生於申，當㫁申地福重，暴敗在酉，壬水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2219","lineNum":1741,"lineType":1,"content":"至酉，便不為佳。以壬生甲木為庚之財，即自生分發身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2220","lineNum":1742,"lineType":1,"content":"之財，非婚配正妻之財。甲至酉地，為木困金鄉，壬水自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2221","lineNum":1743,"lineType":1,"content":"敗，木豈能助養其父？當斷此運平平。行至戌運，如干遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2222","lineNum":1744,"lineType":1,"content":"壬甲，亦只㫁其半吉半㓙，逢戊可㫁其有災，見庚可㫁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2223","lineNum":1745,"lineType":1,"content":"其㣲福，亥運當言其大吉。子運癸水，傷官傷重，泄本身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2224","lineNum":1746,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣，又庚死於子，甲敗於子，當㫁生禍身災。運至丑，庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2225","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506150667878452"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2226","lineNum":1749,"lineType":1,"content":"金之庫，水旺之鄉，又有己丑助庚甲冠帶成人之地，可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2227","lineNum":1750,"lineType":1,"content":"㫁此十年發寅運亦吉，卯運有災，餘例此推。又曰：食神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2228","lineNum":1751,"lineType":1,"content":"忌梟，亦有不畏者，如己亥不畏丁，倒食丁與壬合化木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2229","lineNum":1752,"lineType":1,"content":"而壬禄在亥。丙午不畏甲，倒食甲與己合化土，而己禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2230","lineNum":1753,"lineType":1,"content":"在午。乙己不畏癸，倒食戊癸化火，乙己亦火。癸己不畏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2231","lineNum":1754,"lineType":1,"content":"辛，倒食丙辛化水，癸貴在己。庚為衆陽之首，不畏戊，倒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2232","lineNum":1755,"lineType":1,"content":"食戊陽氣歸源之數，見戊作喜神論。己不倒食辛隂氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2233","lineNum":1756,"lineType":1,"content":"初發散之源，庚不倒食壬，陽氣初發散之源。辛有丁不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2234","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506182196363301"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2235","lineNum":1759,"lineType":1,"content":"畏己，倒食為丁養育辛金也。况有丁處，便有己土，陰陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2236","lineNum":1760,"lineType":1,"content":"干渉，得清福之助，故六辛人切要丁，但從寅遁至辛，人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2237","lineNum":1761,"lineType":1,"content":"本禄位，方知用丁為禄。更月是金家己土，火裏長生，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2238","lineNum":1762,"lineType":1,"content":"知要火為文貴。金無父母，借火處有父母之氣故也。或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2239","lineNum":1763,"lineType":1,"content":"問：十干以隔一位為食神，何也？希尹曰：甲己化土，故食","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2240","lineNum":1764,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛；丙辛化水，故食戊癸；戊癸化火，故食庚乙；庚乙化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pi pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2324","lineNum":1821,"lineType":1,"content":"食神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2325","lineNum":1822,"lineType":1,"content":"食退好烟霞，食馬心馳别立家。或食貴人併食禄，名髙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2326","lineNum":1823,"lineType":1,"content":"爵重福無涯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2327","lineNum":1823,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2328","lineNum":1823,"lineType":1,"content":"食神印綬不宜逢，惟見財官福更隆。食","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2329","lineNum":1824,"lineType":1,"content":"神喜行身旺地，逢梟逢比總成空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2330","lineNum":1824,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2331","lineNum":1824,"lineType":1,"content":"食神生旺最堪誇，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2332","lineNum":1825,"lineType":1,"content":"惟行水木土金佳，官煞更無來混雜，平生衣禄足榮華。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2333","lineNum":1826,"lineType":2,"content":"叉","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_204","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2334","lineNum":1826,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2335","lineNum":1826,"lineType":1,"content":"食神居先煞居後，衣禄平生福最厚。煞近食神却有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2336","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506167310942243"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2337","lineNum":1829,"lineType":1,"content":"殃，終日塵寰慢奔走。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2338","lineNum":1829,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2339","lineNum":1829,"lineType":1,"content":"夀元合起最為竒，七煞何憂在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2340","lineNum":1830,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗時。禁㓙制暴干頭旺，此是人間富貴兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2341","lineNum":1830,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2342","lineNum":1830,"lineType":1,"content":"甲人見丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2343","lineNum":1831,"lineType":1,"content":"本盗氣，丙去生財號食神，心廣體胖衣禄厚，若臨偏印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2344","lineNum":1832,"lineType":1,"content":"主孤貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2345","lineNum":1832,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2346","lineNum":1832,"lineType":1,"content":"食神有氣勝財官，先要他强旺本干，若也反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2347","lineNum":1833,"lineType":1,"content":"傷來奪食，忙忙辛苦禍千般。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2348","lineNum":1833,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2349","lineNum":1833,"lineType":1,"content":"食神生旺無刑尅，命逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2350","lineNum":1834,"lineType":1,"content":"此格勝財官。更得身旺逢財地，青春年少步金鑾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2351","lineNum":1834,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2352","lineNum":1834,"lineType":1,"content":"食","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2353","lineNum":1835,"lineType":1,"content":"神無損夀綿長，庻母逢之不可當，若無偏財來救䕶，命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2354","lineNum":1836,"lineType":1,"content":"如秋草帶冬霜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2355","lineNum":1836,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2356","lineNum":1836,"lineType":1,"content":"食神月上號天厨，人命逢之富有餘，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2357","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506166300065804"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2358","lineNum":1839,"lineType":1,"content":"切忌梟來明減福，最嫌衝去暗消除。生財化鬼兼無病，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2359","lineNum":1840,"lineType":1,"content":"制煞為祥信有儲。士子如逢利甲第，官封要職領天書。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2360","lineNum":1841,"lineType":1,"content":"合諸說觀，食神喜忌盡矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2363","lineNum":1843,"lineType":1,"content":"内有倒禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2364","lineNum":1844,"lineType":1,"content":"飛衝，忌官星，亦嫌羈絆。此格惟有四日，庚子、壬子、辛亥、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2365","lineNum":1845,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥生，十月、十一月，冬水純隂，柱無財，官方用。又須月、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2366","lineNum":1846,"lineType":1,"content":"時或年，與日同支，方能併衝。忌官星顯露，禄難飛衝，合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2367","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506182196396069"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2368","lineNum":1849,"lineType":1,"content":"神覊絆，不能飛衝。要柱中有一字合住禄馬，方不走了","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2369","lineNum":1850,"lineType":1,"content":"貴氣。喜傷官食神及干文本運。假令庚子日，庚以丁火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2370","lineNum":1851,"lineType":1,"content":"為官，在子月生，是傷官月建，可謂㓙處。若子字多衝出","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2371","lineNum":1852,"lineType":1,"content":"午中丁火，則庚日得官星，未可便以㓙論。柱要有未或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2372","lineNum":1853,"lineType":1,"content":"寅戌，但得一字合午為妙。若有丑覊絆子去貪合，不能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2373","lineNum":1854,"lineType":1,"content":"衝午中之禄。見丁字為官，露丙為煞，顯午字填實戊吞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2374","lineNum":1855,"lineType":1,"content":"㗖，則减分數，嵗運同。壬子日，壬以己土為官，要柱中子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2375","lineNum":1856,"lineType":1,"content":"字多衝午中己土，則壬日得官星。其喜忌與庚子日同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2376","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506182196412453"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2377","lineNum":1859,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥日，辛用丙火為官；癸亥日，癸用戊土為官；俱要四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2378","lineNum":1860,"lineType":1,"content":"柱。亥字多衝出巳中丙戊，則辛癸得官，星柱有申或酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2379","lineNum":1861,"lineType":1,"content":"丑，但得一作合為妙，多則不中。有寅覊絆，則亥貪合，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2380","lineNum":1862,"lineType":1,"content":"能衝巳中之禄，見丙戊己為官星顯露，減分數，嵗運同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2381","lineNum":1863,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：庚子、壬子二日，不但忌上所犯。庚子不喜水太旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2382","lineNum":1864,"lineType":1,"content":"為金沉水泛，僧道貧苦之命。或坐丑月，得酉字合丑，運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2383","lineNum":1865,"lineType":1,"content":"行西方，如意，却不貴。壬子不宜見財，為壬遇丁而太過，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2384","lineNum":1866,"lineType":1,"content":"必犯淫訛之亂。辛癸二日，不論支下，但見亥字多，便能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2385","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506168040505354"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2386","lineNum":1869,"lineType":1,"content":"衝官。辛日惟怕己丙，癸日惟怕己戊，餘忌稍輕。又曰：飛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2387","lineNum":1870,"lineType":1,"content":"天無合，乃漂流之人，有衝，多是九流技藝之輩，近貴而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2388","lineNum":1871,"lineType":1,"content":"已。既衝又合，若犯前忌，亦不入格，嵗運逢之，甚者遭横","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2389","lineNum":1872,"lineType":1,"content":"逆，辛亥癸亥見之稍輕。古歌曰：正衝之格是庚壬，子去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2390","lineNum":1873,"lineType":1,"content":"衝官禄自亨。四柱更逢寅戌未 lineId":"2421","lineNum":1889,"lineType":1,"content":"飛天禄馬最難窮，正要庚壬坐子重。壬暗午中邀己禄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2422","lineNum":1890,"lineType":1,"content":"庚虚離位就丁功。䑕中同伴子難動，戊要相牽午共寅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2423","lineNum":1891,"lineType":1,"content":"庚忌丁神壬忌巳，若無此犯禄豐隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2424","lineNum":1891,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2425","lineNum":1891,"lineType":1,"content":"辛癸生人喜亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2426","lineNum":1892,"lineType":1,"content":"重，己中丙戊得逢衝。戊來合癸三元喜，丙去伏辛四柱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2427","lineNum":1893,"lineType":1,"content":"雄。煞刃官空皆畏忌，刑衝破害總朦朧。若無填實虚有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2428","lineNum":1894,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹，豪傑英雄逈不同。按此格止庚子辛亥是傷官，壬子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2429","lineNum":1895,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥則非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2431","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506125103644735"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2432","lineNum":1899,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官。月建内有倒衝禄馬格，喜忌與飛天同，惟時不論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2433","lineNum":1900,"lineType":1,"content":"此格止有二日，丙午丁巳。夏月純陽，丙以癸水為官，要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2434","lineNum":1901,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中午多有力，衝出子中癸水，則丙日得官星。丁以壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2435","lineNum":1902,"lineType":1,"content":"水為官，要柱中巳多有力，衝出亥中壬水，則丁日得官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2436","lineNum":1903,"lineType":1,"content":"星。更得丑寅或申辰卯未，但有一字合住禄馬為妙，多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2437","lineNum":1904,"lineType":1,"content":"則不中。丙午日怕未，丁巳日怕申辰等字覊絆，則巳午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2438","lineNum":1905,"lineType":1,"content":"貪合，不能衝子。亥中之禄。柱有亥壬子癸為煞官顯露，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2439","lineNum":1906,"lineType":1,"content":"則减分數，嵗運同。又曰：丙午丁巳，不論合禄，只嫌覊絆，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2440","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506151473201206"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2441","lineNum":1909,"lineType":1,"content":"年月併衝為上，只月上有，月内無，則不能衝禄取貴；日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2442","lineNum":1910,"lineType":1,"content":"下無，月時有，亦可取用。但丙午是刃，雖貴終㓙，一見合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2443","lineNum":1911,"lineType":1,"content":"刃，便為㓙命。若月令亥子，官煞合格，或透官煞有氣旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2444","lineNum":1912,"lineType":1,"content":"相，反取合煞，為大貴格。不可専以日刃論，不可全拘填","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2445","lineNum":1913,"lineType":1,"content":"實論。丁巳日或見辛亥時柱中有己亥，不妨格以丁生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2446","lineNum":1914,"lineType":1,"content":"四月，巳旺，亥無氣，三月亦取。喜行水鄉，見火則福，只宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2447","lineNum":1915,"lineType":1,"content":"己火，餘火不宜。又曰：此格有六日：丙午、丙寅、丙戌、丁巳、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2448","lineNum":1916,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未、丁卯。陽日為倒衝，隂日為正衝。丙日只有午字，却","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2449","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506150667976756"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2450","lineNum":1919,"lineType":1,"content":"用三合，寅午戌全。或三丙字喜印生助，忌煞混雜。古歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2451","lineNum":1920,"lineType":1,"content":"云：丙日無官局午多，倒衝禄馬癸官和。不逢未字來羈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2452","lineNum":1921,"lineType":1,"content":"絆，癸子俱無福嵯峩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2453","lineNum":1921,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2454","lineNum":1921,"lineType":1,"content":"倒衝貴氣不同倫，丙午飛衝子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2455","lineNum":1922,"lineType":1,"content":"禄神。癸水尅來為貴禄，刑傷填實是常人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2456","lineNum":1922,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2457","lineNum":1922,"lineType":1,"content":"倒衝禄馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2458","lineNum":1923,"lineType":1,"content":"貴非常，丙日多逢午位良。七煞不逢并惹絆，白衣平歩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId {"lines":[{"lineId":"2513","lineNum":1966,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申時逢戊日，名食神干旺之方。嵗月犯甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2514","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506150667993140"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2515","lineNum":1969,"lineType":1,"content":"丙卯寅，此乃遇而不遇。戊以庚為食神，庚禄在申，食神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2516","lineNum":1970,"lineType":1,"content":"健旺，戊以乙為官，庚能虚合，卯中乙木為貴氣，庚申二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2517","lineNum":1971,"lineType":1,"content":"字，合乙卯二字，要無甲木傷戊土，卯字填實，寅字衝提，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2518","lineNum":1972,"lineType":1,"content":"丙字傷庚，則庚申方能轉合嵗月，若犯甲丙卯寅，壊了","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2519","lineNum":1973,"lineType":1,"content":"貴氣，故皆不宜。喜秋冬生日旺，愛財星印綬，怕衝刑破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2520","lineNum":1974,"lineType":1,"content":"害，與食格同，純粹者貴，填實減半。戊午、戊寅二日，難作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2521","lineNum":1975,"lineType":1,"content":"此格。月令若值財官，當以財官論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2522","lineNum":1975,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_207","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2523","lineNum":1975,"lineType":1,"content":"云搢笏垂紳事聖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2524","lineNum":1976,"lineType":1,"content":"王，専食合禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2525","lineNum":1976,"lineType":1,"content":"景鑑","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_208","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2526","lineNum":1976,"lineType":1,"content":"云：格局合禄，戊日申時，畏寅卯而失","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2527","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506168040587274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2528","lineNum":1979,"lineType":1,"content":"貴氣，逢酉未福禄非輕，填實兮官居寂寞，純粹兮位至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2529","lineNum":1980,"lineType":1,"content":"公卿，喜財星而怡印綬，怕刑衝七煞官星。古歌曰：合神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2530","lineNum":1981,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申戊日强，食神干旺貴非常。官星乙戊天元喜，六害","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2531","lineNum":1982,"lineType":1,"content":"刑衝定主傷。寅卯敗，甲丙戕，無衝無破坐朝堂。運行丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2532","lineNum":1983,"lineType":1,"content":"戊生災害，䘮子刑妻不可當。詩曰：戊日庚申時上逢，要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2533","lineNum":1984,"lineType":1,"content":"無官印喜秋冬。甲丙卯寅兼四字，四營嵗運怕同宫。按","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2534","lineNum":1985,"lineType":1,"content":"此格即天厨食神，不必作合禄看。王崇古尚書不犯甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2535","lineNum":1986,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅卯，錄於前。髙燿尚書：甲戌、庚午、戊辰、庚申，年雖透","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2536","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506173639884800"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2537","lineNum":1989,"lineType":1,"content":"甲月庚制之，不犯寅卯、丙字皆純粹。二命較之，髙、甲、戊、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2538","lineNum":1990,"lineType":1,"content":"庚三竒為禄馬同鄉，又天關地軸，乾坤清夷，所以官皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2539","lineNum":1991,"lineType":1,"content":"一品，而王有邊功，享用優裕。又張光逺長史與王公止","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2540","lineNum":1992,"lineType":1,"content":"月癸未不同，是食格。惟建禄身旺最貴，不専秋冬生，王","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2541","lineNum":1993,"lineType":1,"content":"公得之，所以功名逺甚。然張有學善詩，亦美士也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2547","lineNum":2000,"lineType":1,"content":"謂辛巳得癸巳、癸亥，如陳朝議辛巳、壬辰、癸巳、癸亥是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2548","lineNum":2001,"lineType":1,"content":"也。推此類，丙寅愛戊寅，戊申愛庚申、己巳愛辛亥，庚午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2549","lineNum":2002,"lineType":1,"content":"愛壬申、甲戌愛丙寅，壬辰愛甲申，皆同此格，主文貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2551","lineNum":2004,"lineType":1,"content":"乃六癸日申時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2552","lineNum":2004,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_209","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2553","lineNum":2004,"lineType":1,"content":"云：暗合愁刑擊，明逢怕尅衝，正朝丹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2554","lineNum":2005,"lineType":1,"content":"闕趨，専印合禄宫。葢癸日見庚申時，庚與戊同宫，虚合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2555","lineNum":2006,"lineType":1,"content":"己中戊土。癸日得官星庚，暗合乙木，為癸日之爵星，丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2556","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506173639901184"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2557","lineNum":2009,"lineType":1,"content":"戊同宮，為癸之財。三竒俱全，忌戊己、巳午，及丙尅庚寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2558","lineNum":2010,"lineType":1,"content":"衝申，則减分數。歲運同喜行身旺印旺，金水之運大發，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2559","lineNum":2011,"lineType":1,"content":"忌入火鄉，格純無壊，朝官宰輔之命，如胡懋功叅將丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2560","lineNum":2012,"lineType":1,"content":"酉、甲辰、癸酉、庚申，是此格也。歌曰：專印是逢癸日，庚申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2561","lineNum":2013,"lineType":1,"content":"暗合蛇宫，財官隠隠在其中，禄運時臨發動，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2562","lineNum":2013,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2563","lineNum":2013,"lineType":1,"content":"時運庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2564","lineNum":2014,"lineType":1,"content":"申癸日生，此為專印合官星。官煞不逢無丙火，印身食","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2565","lineNum":2015,"lineType":1,"content":"運顯功名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2566","lineNum":2015,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2567","lineNum":2015,"lineType":1,"content":"日干癸水時庚申，生在秋冬富貴人。大忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2568","lineNum":2016,"lineType":1,"content":"寅來衝貴氣，若生春夏惹灾迍。按：專印合禄，雖非食傷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2569","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506168040620042"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2570","lineNum":2019,"lineType":1,"content":"分出與食同格，故並論之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2571","lineNum":2020,"lineType":1,"content":"論陽刃：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2572","lineNum":2020,"lineType":2,"content":"前論羊刄煞，與此參㸔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2573","lineNum":2021,"lineType":1,"content":"陽者，陰陽之陽；刃者，刀刃之刃，即禄前一位。言旺越其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2574","lineNum":2022,"lineType":1,"content":"分，故險。竊詳甲人見卯，卯中有乙木，乙為甲弟，能刼其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2575","lineNum":2023,"lineType":1,"content":"兄之財，衝去酉中辛官，合其庚妻。庚乃甲之七煞，刼財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2576","lineNum":2024,"lineType":1,"content":"衝官合煞，所以至㐫。惟甲、丙、戊、庚、壬五陽干有刃，乙、丁、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2577","lineNum":2025,"lineType":1,"content":"己、辛、癸五陰干無刃，故曰陽刃。惟見傷官，與陽刃同禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2578","lineNum":2026,"lineType":1,"content":"故乙見丙亦謂之刃，以丙傷其庚官，合辛煞尅其乙木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2579","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506182196494373"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2580","lineNum":2029,"lineType":1,"content":"陰金尅陰木，至毒，所以㓙與陽刃同。陽刃有三：有刼財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2581","lineNum":2030,"lineType":1,"content":"刃，甲見乙是也，不利財官格。有䕶禄刃，甲見卯是也，大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2582","lineNum":2031,"lineType":1,"content":"利歸禄格。有背禄刃，乙丙是也，大利去官留煞局","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2583","lineNum":2031,"lineType":1,"content":"喜忌","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_210","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2584","lineNum":2032,"lineType":1,"content":"篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_210","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2585","lineNum":2032,"lineType":1,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2586","lineNum":2032,"lineType":1,"content":"刼財陽刃，切忌時逢，歳運併臨，災殃立至。獨陽刃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2587","lineNum":2033,"lineType":1,"content":"以時言，重於年月日也。假令甲日生人時，上見乙卯，此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2588","lineNum":2034,"lineType":1,"content":"是真刃。命中既逢陽刃，傷妻破財，災殃已胚胎矣。流年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2589","lineNum":2035,"lineType":1,"content":"歳運，再遇羊刄，是謂併臨。見己酉，是衝歳君；見亥未戌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2590","lineNum":2036,"lineType":1,"content":"是合歳君。陽刃，㓙煞也。太歲，㓙神也。太歲得吉，神相扶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2591","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506161858248754"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2592","lineNum":2039,"lineType":1,"content":"合則吉。若陽刃㓙煞，來衝合歲君，是謂攅㓙聚煞，其禍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2593","lineNum":2040,"lineType":1,"content":"難免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2594","lineNum":2040,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_211","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2595","lineNum":2040,"lineType":1,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2596","lineNum":2040,"lineType":1,"content":"陽刃衝合歲君，勃然禍至。此之謂也。中間亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2597","lineNum":2041,"lineType":1,"content":"要詳辨。命元淺薄，遇此誠然。若命旺，秉氣深厚，或有天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2598","lineNum":2042,"lineType":1,"content":"月徳及赦文解救，止有浮災，亦無大咎。或曰：柱原有刃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2599","lineNum":2043,"lineType":1,"content":"見衝，或合歲運再臨衝合，大㓙若歲衝合而運不衝合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2600","lineNum":2044,"lineType":1,"content":"運衝合而歲不衝合，其禍减半。論又曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2601","lineNum":2044,"lineType":1,"content":"日干無氣，時逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2602","lineNum":2045,"lineType":1,"content":"陽刃，不為㓙言。生日天元，臨死絶、衰病暴敗之地，不通","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2603","lineNum":2046,"lineType":1,"content":"月氣，不能勝任財官。若逢陽刃，能刼財化煞，譬如兄力","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2604","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506193235918902"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2605","lineNum":2049,"lineType":1,"content":"弱財重，得弟分任，則可勝其財而為我用，所以不作㓙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2606","lineNum":2050,"lineType":1,"content":"論。夫身弱，見財官，固喜陽刃分財合煞；若見食傷，身弱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2607","lineNum":2051,"lineType":1,"content":"脫氣，亦喜陽刃扶持；若見印綬，則非日干無氣矣。先言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2608","lineNum":2052,"lineType":1,"content":"忌陽刃者，身強力能任財，故不喜刼奪；後言喜陽刃者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2609","lineNum":2053,"lineType":1,"content":"身弱力不任財，故不忌刼奪。義各有取。此格與傷官相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2610","lineNum":2054,"lineType":1,"content":"似。凡命值之主，眼大鬚黄，性剛心髙，無惻隠慈惠之心，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2611","lineNum":2055,"lineType":1,"content":"有刻剥不恤之意，多帶宿疾，貪暴不足，進退狐疑，偏生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2612","lineNum":2056,"lineType":1,"content":"庻出，離祖過房，尅父傷妻，或見三刑，或自刑，魁罡全發，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2613","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506182196510757"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2614","lineNum":2059,"lineType":1,"content":"跡邉疆，如更無情，或臨財旺主，㓙若刑害俱全，類皆得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2615","lineNum":2060,"lineType":1,"content":"地，又有救神，貴不可言。又曰：陽刃格大槩不宜財鄉，怕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2616","lineNum":2061,"lineType":1,"content":"衝起。如戊日刃在午，忌行子正財運；壬日刃在子，忌行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2617","lineNum":2062,"lineType":1,"content":"午正財運；庚日刃在酉，忌行卯正財運。獨甲日刃在卯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2618","lineNum":2063,"lineType":1,"content":"行巳、午，並辰、戌、丑、未財運，不妨忌酉運；丙日刃在午，行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2619","lineNum":2064,"lineType":1,"content":"申、酉、庚、辛、丑財運，不妨忌子運。是陽刃所忌之財，戊刃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2620","lineNum":2065,"lineType":1,"content":"午，見子財；壬刃子，見午財；庚刃酉，見卯財。皆衝之財，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2621","lineNum":2066,"lineType":1,"content":"忌之。至甲刃卯，不忌戊、己、巳、午之財，且忌酉官矣；丙刃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2622","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506125103710271"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2623","lineNum":2069,"lineType":1,"content":"午，不忌庚、辛、申、酉之財，且忌子官矣。可槩謂忌財乎？若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2624","lineNum":2070,"lineType":1,"content":"天干生官之財，正為用神，方且喜之，豈可為忌？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2625","lineNum":2070,"lineType":1,"content":"心鏡","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_212","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2626","lineNum":2070,"lineType":1,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2627","lineNum":2071,"lineType":1,"content":"陽刄重重又見財，富貴饒金帛。此之謂也。或曰：甲、戊、庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2628","lineNum":2072,"lineType":1,"content":"見刄，逢衝，發禍多騐。壬、丙逢刄，見子午衝，多無禍。以丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2629","lineNum":2073,"lineType":1,"content":"見子，壬見午，俱為正官，反作貴氣論也。又曰：甲以己為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2630","lineNum":2074,"lineType":1,"content":"妻財，四柱却有卯乙己土受傷，不能扶甲，故主剥喪妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2631","lineNum":2075,"lineType":1,"content":"子。歲運復臨刼刃，旺相誠所不免。如别位逢庚、辛、酉、申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2632","lineNum":2076,"lineType":1,"content":"庚能邀乙為妻，即成眷屬，不為甲之七煞。辛輔甲為貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2633","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506168040652810"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2634","lineNum":2079,"lineType":1,"content":"能尅破乙煞，反㓙為吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2635","lineNum":2079,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_213","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2636","lineNum":2079,"lineType":1,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2637","lineNum":2079,"lineType":1,"content":"甲以乙妹妻庚，㓙為吉兆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2638","lineNum":2080,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。餘干例此。又曰：六甲日逢乙卯，㓙辛卯吉。甲申、丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2639","lineNum":2081,"lineType":1,"content":"卯不為刃。申中有庚，合卯中乙木為財。若有財露，亦㓙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2640","lineNum":2082,"lineType":1,"content":"丁火傷官，乙木奪財，歲運併臨，災禍不免。乙酉日見庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2641","lineNum":2083,"lineType":1,"content":"辰時非刃乙坐庚下，酉中辛金，制辰中乙木。丙子日見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2642","lineNum":2084,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午時非刄子中癸水，尅午中丁火。丁亥日見丁未時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2643","lineNum":2085,"lineType":1,"content":"非刄亥中午水合丁。庚午日見乙酉時非刃午中丁火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2644","lineNum":2086,"lineType":1,"content":"制辛。壬午日見庚子時非刃午中己土制癸。辛巳日見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2645","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506168040636426"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2646","lineNum":2089,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌時非刄巳中丙火合辛。癸巳日見癸丑時非刄巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2647","lineNum":2090,"lineType":1,"content":"中戌土合癸。以上諸日遇者，不宜見刑、衝、破、害，無則以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2648","lineNum":2091,"lineType":1,"content":"好命斷之。又曰：陽刄者，天上之㓙星，人間之悪煞。喜偏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2649","lineNum":2092,"lineType":1,"content":"官、印綬，忌反吟、伏吟。魁罡三合，大率與七煞相似。故陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2650","lineNum":2093,"lineType":1,"content":"刃喜見七煞，七煞喜見陽刃，兩㓙互相制伏，猶正官喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2651","lineNum":2094,"lineType":1,"content":"正印，善類合善類為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2652","lineNum":2094,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_214","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2653","lineNum":2094,"lineType":1,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2654","lineNum":2094,"lineType":1,"content":"煞無刃不顯，刃無煞不威。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2655","lineNum":2095,"lineType":1,"content":"煞刃俱全，常人無有，更身旺不見傷官為妙。若命元有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2656","lineNum":2096,"lineType":1,"content":"煞刄，歲運又逢，或有刃無煞，歲運逢煞運之鄉，俱發大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2657","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506193235935286"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2658","lineNum":2099,"lineType":1,"content":"禍。如命有刃，有印無煞，歲運逢煞，反轉成厚福。若柱無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2659","lineNum":2100,"lineType":1,"content":"刃煞，命合財官，歳運復遇刃煞，主一歳蹇滯，因財争競，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2660","lineNum":2101,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟分居，離妻去妾。若元無刃行，刃運雖不妨，亦主有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2661","lineNum":2102,"lineType":1,"content":"尅妻之事。元有刃歳運，切不宜再見及傷官財地原帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2662","lineNum":2103,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官財星，歳運再逢，禍害極重，身弱尤㓙。又曰：日刄止","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2663","lineNum":2104,"lineType":1,"content":"有三日，戊午、丙午、壬子，與陽刃同法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2664","lineNum":2104,"lineType":1,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_215","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2665","lineNum":2104,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：赤黄馬獨卧，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2666","lineNum":2105,"lineType":1,"content":"黒䑕守空房，男妨妻，女妨夫。指此三日也。不喜刑、衝、破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2667","lineNum":2106,"lineType":1,"content":"害、三㑹六合，要有七煞相制，再行官印鄉，便為好命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2668","lineNum":2106,"lineType":1,"content":"賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_216","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2669","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506168040669194"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2670","lineNum":2109,"lineType":1,"content":"云：日刄大忌衝合，喜官煞相制，合刑者㓙，遇印者吉。有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2671","lineNum":2110,"lineType":1,"content":"煞無刃，施為有勇無威；有刄無煞，作事濁而不顯；無煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2672","lineNum":2111,"lineType":1,"content":"遇煞，竊恐禍患相侵。有刄遇刄，須忌災危相犯。刄生身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2673","lineNum":2112,"lineType":1,"content":"死，其年難作吉。推財旺官傷，此歲不作㓙㫁。又曰：戊午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2674","lineNum":2113,"lineType":1,"content":"日，歲月見火多，則以印綬論；壬子日，月時見子多，則以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2675","lineNum":2114,"lineType":1,"content":"飛天禄馬論；丙午見午多，亦以倒衝禄馬論。取財官入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2676","lineNum":2115,"lineType":1,"content":"格，故日刄不為大㓙，此格當推提綱。若月令合財官印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2677","lineNum":2116,"lineType":1,"content":"綬，或合他格，或從化類，當以他格斷，不可拘以陽刃。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2678","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506152211300387"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2679","lineNum":2119,"lineType":1,"content":"自刄有三日，癸丑、丁未、己未，因坐下比肩陽刄。飛刃有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2680","lineNum":2120,"lineType":1,"content":"四日，丙子、丁丑、戊子、己丑，因坐下衝
