{"lines":[{"lineId":"2836","lineNum":2224,"lineType":1,"content":"建禄者，乃甲日寅月，乙日卯月，五行臨官之位是也。甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2837","lineNum":2225,"lineType":1,"content":"用金為官，金絶在寅；用土為財，土病於寅。以身旺太過，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2838","lineNum":2226,"lineType":1,"content":"財官俱不得。若别無財官可取，再遇刼奪，馬既不扶，禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2839","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506200311742473"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2840","lineNum":2229,"lineType":1,"content":"又不養，多主貧賤。頗宜時帶偏官偏財，或食神，更㸔年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2841","lineNum":2230,"lineType":1,"content":"時上露多者取用。若略見財官，反爭奪不吉。凡命月令","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2842","lineNum":2231,"lineType":1,"content":"建禄，難招祖業，必主平生見財不聚，却病少夀長。行運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2843","lineNum":2232,"lineType":1,"content":"再見比肩，尅妻妨父損子，或官非破財，或因妻孥財帛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2844","lineNum":2233,"lineType":1,"content":"争奪。如八字内外元有財官，引旺得地，官星有助，運臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2845","lineNum":2234,"lineType":1,"content":"官星有氣之地，亦貴。財星有助，運臨財旺之地，亦富。財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2846","lineNum":2235,"lineType":1,"content":"官俱旺，乃富貴之命。若時逢財庫，運至財鄉，必主晚年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2847","lineNum":2236,"lineType":1,"content":"大富，年上財官有助，必享祖蔭。若四柱元無財官，縦運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2848","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506193722310696"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2849","lineNum":2239,"lineType":1,"content":"行財官之地，亦止虚花而已。命無財官，嵗運乂行比肩，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2850","lineNum":2240,"lineType":1,"content":"一生貧蹇。賦云根在苗先，實在花後，言先有根然後長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2851","lineNum":2241,"lineType":1,"content":"苗，有花然後結果。若當生嵗，元無財官，雖遇財官吉運，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2852","lineNum":2242,"lineType":1,"content":"發福不大。假如甲日寅月，柱中乙卯未字多主無祖財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2853","lineNum":2243,"lineType":1,"content":"尅妻，一世孤貧，作事虚詐，為人大模様。乙日生卯月，柱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2854","lineNum":2244,"lineType":1,"content":"有庚辛巳酉丑申，及戊己巳午辰戌等字，財官多則貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2855","lineNum":2245,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸申子辰亥，水印成局，亦佳，更運逢之尤妙。若柱不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2856","lineNum":2246,"lineType":1,"content":"見財官印食，同前㫁。丙生巳月，嵗時干支，水金成局，運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2857","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506193722294312"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2858","lineNum":2249,"lineType":1,"content":"歴財官旺地，亦主富貴。丁生午月，金敗水絶，財官俱背，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2859","lineNum":2250,"lineType":1,"content":"順運尅妻，逆運尅三妻。若柱有己酉丑庚辛壬癸亥申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2860","lineNum":2251,"lineType":1,"content":"子辰，運臨財官旺地，亦發用煞或印，以多為貴，若止建","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2861","lineNum":2252,"lineType":1,"content":"禄，亦同前㫁。戊日巳月，年日時無水，主尅妻，無祖業，子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2862","lineNum":2253,"lineType":1,"content":"多不肖，柱中多有官，則吉，如見偏官，主尊貴。歳月若是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2863","lineNum":2254,"lineType":1,"content":"火多，及或印綬，雖無財官，主吉。若柱内隠顯，壬癸亥申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2864","lineNum":2255,"lineType":1,"content":"子辰水局，晚子一二有甲寅乙卯亥未木局，運至財官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2865","lineNum":2256,"lineType":1,"content":"旺地，亦發。己生午月，以壬水為財，五月水囚，主無祖業，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2866","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506161858281522"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2867","lineNum":2259,"lineType":1,"content":"尅妻，子亦不多。嵗時透出寅甲，為正官，五月甲死，官必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2868","lineNum":2260,"lineType":1,"content":"卑小。喜見亥卯未乙，身旺見官煞為妙，偏財亦美。庚日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2869","lineNum":2261,"lineType":1,"content":"申月，上旬生近木餘氣，畧無祖財，雖節氣臨水絶之鄉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2870","lineNum":2262,"lineType":1,"content":"尚有三四分庫財為福運，至丙戌財盡矣。若年日時多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2871","lineNum":2263,"lineType":1,"content":"帶財，好命㸔見丙丁巳午寅戌火局，則有官，以煞化官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2872","lineNum":2264,"lineType":1,"content":"也，官小亦不清顯，怕壬癸亥子，尅官不成。辛日酉月，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2873","lineNum":2265,"lineType":1,"content":"祖財，柱中多見分奪，孤貧無妻，或尅妻無財，若帶木火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2874","lineNum":2266,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺，又當富貴，原無財官，又行生地，其刼禍尤重。或見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2875","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506186730340363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2876","lineNum":2269,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉，則為専禄，更有財官印食之神，嵗運再逢尤好，逆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2877","lineNum":2270,"lineType":1,"content":"運南方則吉，順運北方，百事無成。若辛卯辛未日，身自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2878","lineNum":2271,"lineType":1,"content":"坐財，可許衣禄，辛巳日有貴官，禄亦輕。壬日亥月，癸日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2879","lineNum":2272,"lineType":1,"content":"子月，俱無祖業，柱中多見火土，主自成立有官，如見水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2880","lineNum":2273,"lineType":1,"content":"多泛濫無成，尅妻貧薄。又曰：甲日寅月宜壬申時，乙日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2881","lineNum":2274,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月宜辛巳時，丙日己月宜己亥時，丁日午月宜庚子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2882","lineNum":2275,"lineType":1,"content":"時，戊日己月宜甲寅時，己日午月宜乙丑時，庚日申月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2883","lineNum":2276,"lineType":1,"content":"宜丙戌時，辛日酉月宜丁酉時，壬日亥月宜戊申時，癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2884","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506151473299510"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2885","lineNum":2279,"lineType":1,"content":"日子月宜己未時，是見煞取貴，然亦不可太多，嵗運再","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2886","lineNum":2280,"lineType":1,"content":"逢煞地，主夭折。如一命丙戌、丁酉、辛酉、乙未，月令建禄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2887","lineNum":2281,"lineType":1,"content":"又是専禄日，主夀止四十八。壬寅運、壬申年不禄，嵗運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2888","lineNum":2282,"lineType":1,"content":"衝，且㑹傷官煞也。建禄用財官，傷去丙火，故夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2889","lineNum":2282,"lineType":1,"content":"獨歩","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_236","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2890","lineNum":2282,"lineType":1,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2891","lineNum":2283,"lineType":1,"content":"月令建禄，多無祖屋，一見財官，自然成福。又云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2892","lineNum":2283,"lineType":1,"content":"建禄生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2893","lineNum":2284,"lineType":1,"content":"提月，財官喜透天。不宜身再旺，惟喜茂財元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2894","lineNum":2284,"lineType":1,"content":"百章歌","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_237","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2895","lineNum":2284,"lineType":1,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2896","lineNum":2285,"lineType":1,"content":"提綱建禄將何取，須㸔年時多透露。局中六格自分明，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2897","lineNum":2286,"lineType":1,"content":"莫泥提綱反為悮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2898","lineNum":2286,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2899","lineNum":2286,"lineType":1,"content":"癸禄居子生冬月，天干最喜透財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2900","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506193235968054"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2901","lineNum":2289,"lineType":1,"content":"官。如行火土興財禄，水取堤防破貴元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2902","lineNum":2289,"lineType":1,"content":"明通賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_238","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2903","lineNum":2289,"lineType":1,"content":"云：建禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2904","lineNum":2290,"lineType":1,"content":"坐禄或居禄，獨遇財官印綬，富貴長年。合諸說觀之，子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2905","lineNum":2291,"lineType":1,"content":"平論建禄，與古人論禄，其取用逈不同矣。余按，陽刃、比","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2906","lineNum":2292,"lineType":1,"content":"肩、敗財、建禄，名雖不同，實一家同氣之神。在地支者，曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2907","lineNum":2293,"lineType":1,"content":"刄、曰禄，在天干者，曰比、曰刼，其取用大畧相同，故以建","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2908","lineNum":2294,"lineType":1,"content":"禄繼陽刄之後。建禄舊無格，近亦取，以月支無可取之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2909","lineNum":2295,"lineType":1,"content":"格，而天干倘有財官貴氣，故取建禄。若比刼，特發明其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2910","lineNum":2296,"lineType":1,"content":"義耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2911","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506161858314290"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2912","lineNum":2299,"lineType":1,"content":"三命通㑹","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00006_0_239","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2913","lineNum":2299,"lineType":1,"content":"卷五。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"480","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"此格乃辛未、癸未二日，以二三未字合起，亥字衝出，已","logicSentenceId":"7634122300429746230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"中丙戊為辛癸之官柱，有酉丑一字合住貴氣為妙，怕","logicSentenceId":"7634122300429746230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506199564992538"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"填實衝刑。","logicSentenceId":"7634122300429746230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲戍辛未、癸未、癸丑、庚申癸未、辛未、乙未","logicSentenceId":"7634122300429762614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"二命合格俱貴。","logicSentenceId":"7634122300429762614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":489,"lineType":2,"content":"詩日：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"羊擊猪蛇格最强，日逄辛癸未相當。","logicSentenceId":"7634122300429778998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中再遇酉申字，合禄無傷入廟堂。","logicSentenceId":"7634122300429795382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"以上諸格，湏柱中","logicSentenceId":"7634122300429811766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"無財官方用，有則不取。","logicSentenceId":"7634122300429811766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":493,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭子云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"無合有合，後學難知；得一","logicSentenceId":"7634122300429828150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"分三，前賢不載。","logicSentenceId":"76341223004 Id":"7634122300430221366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"此格只宜生申、辰、亥、卯、未、酉月。","logicSentenceId":"7634122300430237750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"若生四季，以印","logicSentenceId":"7634122300430254134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"綬論，丙午、丙寅、丙戍月；以財官論，甲寅、乙卯月；只以財","logicSentenceId":"7634122300430254134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"論。","logicSentenceId":"7634122300430254134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"月令為主，行運不拘南北，身旺為妙，若成此格，多名","logicSentenceId":"7634122300430270518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"勝於財，為人高亢，傷妻害子，如犯上忌，貧薄。","logicSentenceId":"7634122300430270518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":551,"lineType":2,"content":"又日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"午一隂","logicSentenceId":"7634122300430286902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"生，至亥六隂畢，辛金坐亥，或生亥月，乃為六隂之地。","logicSentenceId":"7634122300430286902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"時","logicSentenceId":"7634122300430303286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"得子時，取子中一陽生，乃隂還陽，故名。","logicSentenceId":"7634122300430303286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未、辛酉亦是，","logicSentenceId":"7634122300430319670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506212596744211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554" {"lines":[{"lineId":"612","lineNum":607,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"隂木獨遇子時，為六乙䑕貴之地。","logicSentenceId":"7634122300430729270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"乙以子申為貴","logicSentenceId":"7634122300430745654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"神，獨遇子者，用䑕不用猴也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122300430745654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"乙用庚金為官星，得丙子","logicSentenceId":"7634122300430762038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506211174973474"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"時，以子上丙火遥歸，已中本禄，已來合申，申來動子，是","logicSentenceId":"7634122300430762038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"謂申子辰三合。","logicSentenceId":"7634122300430762038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹貴，謂申中帶將庚來。","logicSentenceId":"7634122300430778422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"乙日得官星，用","logicSentenceId":"7634122300430794806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"申時則官星顯露，所以不取。","logicSentenceId":"7634122300430794806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"若子字多，謂之聚貴，尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"7634122300430811190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"年月中有午衝丑絆，則子不能遥禄。","logicSentenceId":"7634122300430827574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"申庚為官露，酉辛","logicSentenceId":"76 {"lines":[{"lineId":"690","lineNum":677,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"日禄歸時，沒官星號青雲得路。","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088219172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"此格有七日，甲寅、","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088235556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"丁午、戊巳、已午、庚申、壬亥、癸子日主之。","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088235556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"禄歸於時位，喜","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088251940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"日干坐旺，印綬生，月透財，元傷、食，天月二德，主大富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088251940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506217327820851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"忌刑衝破害、空、亡死、絶，及刼財分禄，倒食作合，官煞尅","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088268324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"制，雖可取用，亦不純粹。","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088268324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"歳運同。","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088284708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"如乙日見巳，卯時，是時","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088301092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"上偏財，丙日見癸，巳時，是官星顯露，辛日見丁，酉時，是","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088301092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"時上偏官，不作歸禄格。","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088301092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"㸔四柱何如？","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088317476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"若月有官星，或天","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088333860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"干透財官，只作財官論。","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088333860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"若時支歸禄，年月時支亦有禄，","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088350244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之聚福歸禄，又謂五行歸禄。","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088350244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"若日禄歸時，時禄歸日，","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088366628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之互換禄。","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088366628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"若年禄歸時，時禄歸年，如甲申見庚寅，乙","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088383012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"酉見辛卯，壬午見丁亥，癸亥見壬子等𩔖，俱主大貴享","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088383012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506199565090842"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"福。","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088383012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"若重見禄位，如甲日寅時又生正月，財官俱弱，只作","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088399396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"建禄㸔。","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088399396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"若月日天元同，而止有時禄，謂之分禄，便為無","logicSentenceId":"7634122301088415780","marginNoteIdLi {"lines":[{"lineId":"802","lineNum":799,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"拱禄拱貴，填實則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7634122301089038372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"拱，向也，夾也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122301089054756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"禄，是臨官之禄。","logicSentenceId":"7634122301089071140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，是官星之貴，或指天乙貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7634122301089087524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"拱禄有五日五時：癸亥、","logicSentenceId":"7634122301089103908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑、癸丑、癸亥拱子禄，丁巳、丁未、巳未、已巳拱午禄，戊","logicSentenceId":"7634122301089103908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、戊午拱巳禄。","logicSentenceId":"7634122301089103908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"拱貴有五日五時：甲申，甲戍拱酉，乙未、","logicSentenceId":"7634122301089120292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉拱申，是官貴。","logicSentenceId":"7634122301089120292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅、甲子拱丑，戊申、戊午拱未，辛丑、","logicSentenceId":"7634122301089136676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506212596793363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯拱寅。","logicSentenceId":"7634122301089136676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"官貴兼天乙貴。","logicSentenceId":"76 {"lines":[{"lineId":"2506","lineNum":2507,"lineType":1,"content":"如六甲生人，以庚辛為官，戊已為財，生寅、卯、午、亥、子月，","logicSentenceId":"7634122305630928937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2507","lineNum":2509,"lineType":1,"content":"金絶敗病死，不能為官。","logicSentenceId":"7634122305630928937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2508","lineNum":2509,"lineType":1,"content":"土神春死冬囚，不足為財。","logicSentenceId":"7634122305630945321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2509","lineNum":2509,"lineType":1,"content":"縱遇","logicSentenceId":"7634122305630961705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2510","lineNum":2511,"lineType":1,"content":"八字，元有辰、戌、丑、未、申、酉，財官福禄亦薄，運行財官旺","logicSentenceId":"7634122305630961705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2511","lineNum":2513,"lineType":1,"content":"地轉吉，忽遇比肩，或財官衰地，有始無終。","logicSentenceId":"7634122305630961705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2512","lineNum":2513,"lineType":1,"content":"夫日時見財","logicSentenceId":"7634122305630978089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2513","lineNum":2515,"lineType":1,"content":"官，聞喜也，年月損尅，不喜也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122305630978089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2514","lineNum":2515,"lineType":2,"content":"經云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2515","lineNum":2515,"lineType":1,"content":"見官背官，反為貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7634122305630994473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2516","lineNum":2515,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7634122305631010857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2517","lineNum":2517,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌、庚午、巳丑、丙寅、巳，用甲為官，時逄寅位，禄旺本好，","logicSentenceId":"7634122305631010857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2518","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506262542368787"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2519","lineNum":2521,"lineTy {"lines":[{"lineId":"2574","lineNum":2581,"lineType":1,"content":"建禄乃甲生寅月，乙生卯月之類。","logicSentenceId":"7634122305631469609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2575","lineNum":2581,"lineType":1,"content":"月為父母，人從父母","logicSentenceId":"7634122305631485993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2576","lineNum":2583,"lineType":1,"content":"生身，如人從宅中而出，故月令為門戸。","logicSentenceId":"7634122305631485993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2577","lineNum":2583,"lineType":1,"content":"大運離了月令，","logicSentenceId":"7634122305631502377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2578","lineNum":2585,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰出門行限運高低。","logicSentenceId":"7634122305631502377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2579","lineNum":2585,"lineType":1,"content":"甲生寅月，禄旺寅中，甲木比肩","logicSentenceId":"7634122305631518761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2580","lineNum":2587,"lineType":1,"content":"先禄旺。","logicSentenceId":"7634122305631518761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2581","lineNum":2587,"lineType":1,"content":"占財如人，財物在父母家內，先有大哥收管，其","logicSentenceId":"7634122305631535145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2582","lineNum":2589,"lineType":1,"content":"弟不能别求名利，外又不遇財禄，專用見成有數之物，","logicSentenceId":"7634122305631535145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2583","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506251557617664"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2584","lineNum":2593,"lineType":1,"content":"日漸支消，豈能豐富？","logicSentenceId":"7634122305631535145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2585","lineNum":2593,"lineType":1,"content":"運再遇比刼，如人再有弟兄有分","logicSentenceId":"7634122305631551529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2586","lineNum":2595,"lineType":1,"content":"之人，𥮅分家財在前，我已過用，無財分與，必致詞訟爭","logicSentenceId":"7634122305631551529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2587 {"lines":[{"lineId":"2641","lineNum":2653,"lineType":1,"content":"背禄者，甲以辛為官為禄，甲生春夏，金絶則無官矣，故","logicSentenceId":"7634122305631977513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2642","lineNum":2655,"lineType":1,"content":"為背禄。","logicSentenceId":"7634122305631977513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2643","lineNum":2655,"lineType":1,"content":"逐馬者，甲以巳土為財為馬，被乙及亥卯未刼","logicSentenceId":"7634122305631993897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2644","lineNum":2657,"lineType":1,"content":"奪，甲無財矣，故為逐馬。","logicSentenceId":"7634122305631993897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2645","lineNum":2657,"lineType":1,"content":"餘例推。","logicSentenceId":"7634122305632010281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2646","lineNum":2657,"lineType":1,"content":"如壬子、壬子、丁未、乙巳，","logicSentenceId":"7634122305632026665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2647","lineNum":2659,"lineType":1,"content":"丁取壬為官禄，壬亥月建禄，丁生子月，癸旺是煞，壬禄","logicSentenceId":"7634122305632026665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2648","lineNum":2661,"lineType":1,"content":"已過為背。","logicSentenceId":"7634122305632026665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2649","lineNum":2661,"lineType":1,"content":"向者有禄，背者無禄。","logicSentenceId":"7634122305632043049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2650","lineNum":2661,"lineType":1,"content":"丁取庚為財為馬，子月","logicSentenceId":"7634122305632059433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2651","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506261833629722"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2652","lineNum":2665,"lineType":1,"content":"庚死，此為背禄逐馬逄煞運行刼地，亦不發福，無根元","logicSentenceId":"7634122305632059433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2653","lineNum":2667,"lineType":1,"content":"故也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122305632059433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2654","lineNum":2667 {"lines":[{"lineId":"2740","lineNum":2767,"lineType":2,"content":"壺中子云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2741","lineNum":2767,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱之中逄暗帶，有榮有辱。","logicSentenceId":"7634122305886994474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2742","lineNum":2767,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子年，丙寅月，暗","logicSentenceId":"7634122305887010858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2743","lineNum":2769,"lineType":1,"content":"帶乙丑，為正印，為貴人，為引進神，為偏禄元，是以有榮。","logicSentenceId":"7634122305887010858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2744","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506266656964618"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2745","lineNum":2773,"lineType":1,"content":"若甲子年，壬戌月，暗帶癸亥，為亡神，為正空，是以有辱。","logicSentenceId":"7634122305887027242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2746","lineNum":2775,"lineType":1,"content":"日時同㸔，四柱暗帶，切於正帶，即憑暗帶以言貴賤吉","logicSentenceId":"7634122305887043626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2747","lineNum":2777,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7634122305887043626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2748","lineNum":2777,"lineType":1,"content":"若夾煞持墓，决主㐫死。","logicSentenceId":"7634122305887060010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3007","lineNum":3055,"lineType":1,"content":"夫鬼者，煞也，乃干逄煞尅之意也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122306626175039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3008","lineNum":3055,"lineType":1,"content":"湏明上下干支，或鬼","logicSentenceId":"7634122306626191423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3009","lineNum":3057,"lineType":1,"content":"旺身衰，或身旺鬼衰。","logicSentenceId":"7634122306626191423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3010","lineNum":3057,"lineType":1,"content":"如乙木以庚金為官，天干化合，又","logicSentenceId":"7634122306626207807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3011","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506262588555327"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3012","lineNum":3061,"lineType":1,"content":"見辛酉七煞，則為鬼旺。","logicSentenceId":"7634122306626207807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3013","lineNum":3061,"lineType":2,"content":"經云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3014","lineNum":3061,"lineType":1,"content":"已身臨鬼，湏明天地之中，象","logicSentenceId":"7634122306626224191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3015","lineNum":3063,"lineType":1,"content":"旺象衰，要識榮枯貴賤。","logicSentenceId":"7634122306626224191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3016","lineNum":3063,"lineType":1,"content":"身衰鬼旺，應湏肢體傷殘；身旺","logicSentenceId":"7634122306626240575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3017","lineNum":3065,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼衰，定作兇徒之命。","logicSentenceId":"7634122306626240575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3018","lineNum":3065,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼身皆衰，男子飄蓬，女作尼姑。","logicSentenceId":"7634122306626256959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3019","lineNum":3065,"lineType":2,"content":"玉井","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3020","lineNum":3067,"lineType":2,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNote {"lines":[{"lineId":"3451","lineNum":3523,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子生人得乙丑時，丙寅生人得甲戌時之𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577004075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3452","lineNum":3523,"lineType":1,"content":"若無","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577020459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3453","lineNum":3525,"lineType":1,"content":"衝破、空、亡、死、絶，更有福神互為之助。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577020459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3454","lineNum":3525,"lineType":1,"content":"五行入庫，取為上","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577036843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3455","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506261833809946"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3456","lineNum":3529,"lineType":1,"content":"格。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577036843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3457","lineNum":3529,"lineType":1,"content":"若甲乙未、丙丁戌之類，年月日時皆有，謂五行逄庫，","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577053227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3458","lineNum":3531,"lineType":1,"content":"主兩府台輔之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577053227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3459","lineNum":3531,"lineType":1,"content":"或落空亡，亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577069611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3461","lineNum":3535,"lineType":1,"content":"歳干之墓處，謂之禄庫。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577102379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3462","lineNum":3535,"lineType":1,"content":"禄庫中得帶地財，或納音為財，","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577118763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3463","lineNum":3537,"lineType":1,"content":"不惟貴而主富，如無，則職雖顯，家貧。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577118763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3464","lineNum":3537,"lineType":2,"content":"經云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3465","lineNum":3537,"lineType":1,"content":"禄庫空虛，囊空","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577135147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3466","lineNum":3539,"lineType":1,"content":"職重是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577135147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3468","lineNum":3543,"lineType":1,"content":"此十干所生及所尅。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577167915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3469","lineNum":3543,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲生丙尅戊之類，乃食神逄財","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577184299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3470","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506271639896098"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3471","lineNum":3547,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577184299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3472","lineNum":3547,"lineType":1,"content":"不犯他干，仍帶貴氣。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577200683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3473","lineNum":3547,"lineType":1,"content":"若人胎月日時遇之，主衣食豐","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577217067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3474","lineNum":3549,"lineType":1,"content":"足，官爵崇高，大小運行年至此，亦有遷官進財之喜。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577217067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3476","lineNum":3553,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚辰辛巳、庚午辛巳、甲戌乙亥、甲子乙亥、壬寅癸卯、","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577249835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3477","lineNum":3555,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰、癸卯、丙申、丁酉、丙戌、丁酉，是陽死隂生，如甘苦同","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577249835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3478","lineNum":3557,"lineType":1,"content":"受之意。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577249835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3479","lineNum":3557,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂庚生於巳，辛死於巳，甲生於亥，乙死於亥，","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577266219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3480","lineNum":3559,"lineType":1,"content":"壬死於卯，癸生於卯，丙死於酉，丁生於酉，是不相離也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577266219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3481","lineNum":3561,"lineType":1,"content":"若金則金生，木則木生，貴賤不相入則否。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577282603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3484","lineNum":3567,"lineType":1,"content":"乃甲子見癸酉，甲寅見癸亥之𩔖，月日胎俱包，年時中","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577315371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3485","lineNum":3569,"lineType":1,"content":"尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577315371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3486","lineNum":3569,"lineType":1,"content":"若四位、五位、七位包俱同旬，二十四統三十六位，","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577331755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3487","lineNum":3571,"lineType":1,"content":"大衍虛一中間干支得用，與年時財官印食，或禄馬貴","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577331755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3488","lineNum":3573,"lineType":1,"content":"人者，皆大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577331755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3492","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506271166021651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3493","lineNum":3583,"lineType":1,"content":"謂年月日時胎共出一旬，如甲子、丙寅、巳已、庚午之類，","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577397291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3494","lineNum":3585,"lineType":1,"content":"帶生旺六合，無破敗則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577397291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3495","lineNum":3585,"lineType":1,"content":"又年月日時胎各占一旬，謂","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577413675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3496","lineNum":3587,"lineType":1,"content":"之五福集祥，亦大格也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577413675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3497","lineNum":3587,"lineType":1,"content":"湏福神遞互相乘，無破敗方吉。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577430059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3499","lineNum":3591,"lineType":1,"content":"謂戊已二字而帶辰戌丑未全，如戊戌、巳未、巳丑、戊辰，","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577462827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3500","lineNum":3593,"lineType":1,"content":"或貴集丑位，而此日生為入格。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577462827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3501","lineNum":3593,"lineType":2,"content":"古歌曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3502","lineNum":3593,"lineType":1,"content":"四鎮之宫福自强，","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577479211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3503","lineNum":3595,"lineType":1,"content":"更㸔權煞在何方。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577479211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3504","lineNum":3595,"lineType":1,"content":"數重貴禄𠔥生旺，不作公侯便作王。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577495595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3505","lineNum":3597,"lineType":1,"content":"如明太祖戊辰、壬戌、丁丑、丁未，土居四季，辰戌丑未順","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577511979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3506","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506272252313634"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3507","lineNum":3601,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽貴全，所以為創業天子。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577511979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3509","lineNum":3605,"lineType":1,"content":"四衝得位與四位純全㣲不同，謂寅申巳亥欲自生，或","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577544747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3510","lineNum":3607,"lineType":1,"content":"互換生，子午卯酉欲自旺，辰戌丑未欲自墓方取。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577544747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3511","lineNum":3607,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577561131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3512","lineNum":3609,"lineType":1,"content":"申、丙寅、辛巳、巳亥四位，皆自生旺，加丁巳胎，五行足乂，","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577561131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3513","lineNum":3611,"lineType":1,"content":"是詞舘學堂，所以封侯。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577561131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3514","lineNum":3611,"lineType":1,"content":"如辛卯、庚子、癸酉、戊午，乃胎生","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577577515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3515","lineNum":3613,"lineType":1,"content":"元命，又為自旺四仲局如乙丑、癸未、丙辰、壬辰、甲戌胎，","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577577515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3516","lineNum":3615,"lineType":1,"content":"四印秀局，五行數足，故皆大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577577515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3517","lineNum":3615,"lineType":1,"content":"考柱史韓平原壬申、辛","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577593899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3518","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506249137455156"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3519","lineNum":3619,"lineType":1,"content":"亥、已巳、丙寅，","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577593899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3520","lineNum":3619,"lineType":2,"content":"楊良講云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3521","lineNum":3619,"lineType":1,"content":"申為金位，有坤土以厚之，金之剛者","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577593899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3522","lineNum":3621,"lineType":1,"content":"莫加焉，故取象劒鋒，是金不畏他火，惟丙寅能制之。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577593899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3523","lineNum":3621,"lineType":1,"content":"以","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577610283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3524","lineNum":3623,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅干支納音俱火，而履於木，木實生火，生生不窮，雖","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577610283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3525","lineNum":3625,"lineType":1,"content":"百鍊剛金，終被消爍，天理之自然也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577610283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3526","lineNum":3625,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人生時主永主，","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577626667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3527","lineNum":3627,"lineType":1,"content":"今乃遇之。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577626667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3528","lineNum":3627,"lineType":1,"content":"年運丁卯，火為沐浴，氣㣲而敗，灰燼鎔竭，自","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577643051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3529","lineNum":3629,"lineType":1,"content":"不能支。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577643051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3530","lineNum":3629,"lineType":1,"content":"歳遇丙寅，火炎金液，外强中乾，以剛遇烈，赫赫","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577659435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3531","lineNum":3631,"lineType":1,"content":"然天地一爐鞴，萬物一槖籥，孰可嚮邇？","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577659435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3532","lineNum":3631,"lineType":1,"content":"然受物也大，非","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577675819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3533","lineNum":3633,"lineType":1,"content":"盡其用弗可，一陽將萌，亶其時乎？","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577675819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3534","lineNum":3633,"lineType":1,"content":"葢四孟全備，二氣交","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577692203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3535","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506271639912482"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3536","lineNum":3637,"lineType":1,"content":"戰，雖以致莫大之福，亦以招衝擊之灾。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577692203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3537","lineNum":3637,"lineType":1,"content":"吳江丞𡊮韶登","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577708587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3538","lineNum":3639,"lineType":1,"content":"科有雋才，其命辛巳、丙申、丁亥、壬寅，亦全四孟。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577708587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3539","lineNum":3639,"lineType":1,"content":"天干丁","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577724971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3540","lineNum":3641,"lineType":1,"content":"壬丙辛真化，地支巳申亥寅六合，於格為鴛鴦德合，或","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577724971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3541","lineNum":3643,"lineType":1,"content":"天地德合，四柱大分明，所以非韓之比，喜二化氣俱生，","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577724971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3542","lineNum":3645,"lineType":1,"content":"韓自此却不及，此講得之。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577724971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3543","lineNum":3645,"lineType":1,"content":"或以巳用甲為官，丙為印，歸","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577741355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3544","lineNum":3647,"lineType":1,"content":"禄，時下甲木，亥月長生，申欲衝刑，為受巳刑，寅與亥合，","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577741355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3545","lineNum":3649,"lineType":1,"content":"申自受刑，不能衝寅。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577741355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3546","lineNum":3649,"lineType":1,"content":"運至寅卯，官星得地，貴為經畧。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577757739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3547","lineNum":3649,"lineType":1,"content":"一","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577774123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3548","lineNum":3651,"lineType":1,"content":"交丙辰，水旺傷印，無火制傷官，丁卯年遂遭極刑，夀止","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577774123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3549","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506231857119242"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3550","lineNum":3655,"lineType":1,"content":"五十六，亦是一説。","logicSentenceId":"7634122307577774123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3792","lineNum":3915,"lineType":1,"content":"凡禄馬、官貴、六合、華葢、金轝、文星、貴人、正印、庫食、竒德","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358193193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3793","lineNum":3917,"lineType":1,"content":"之類，皆謂之福神，遞互相還為格。","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358193193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3794","lineNum":3917,"lineType":1,"content":"若無死絶、衝、破、空亡，","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358209577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3795","lineNum":3919,"lineType":1,"content":"有五行旺氣，福神助之，主為將相。","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358209577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3796","lineNum":3919,"lineType":1,"content":"如此而又有煞神，即","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358225961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3797","lineNum":3921,"lineType":1,"content":"少逹歴重任。","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358225961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3798","lineNum":3921,"lineType":1,"content":"若有死絶，無衝破、空亡，只在格上㸔之，又","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358242345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3799","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506271166119955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3800","lineNum":3925,"lineType":1,"content":"湏尊者吉方可。","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358242345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3801","lineNum":3925,"lineType":1,"content":"干神主本為重，凡干神作生旺，臨官或","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358258729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3802","lineNum":3927,"lineType":1,"content":"作福神，皆是吉位。","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358258729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3803","lineNum":3927,"lineType":1,"content":"而納音死絶，兹為尊吉𤰞㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358275113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3804","lineNum":3927,"lineType":1,"content":"若納音","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358291497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3805","lineNum":3929,"lineType":1,"content":"既死絶，更有衝破、空亡，即不成就，不過一簿尉州縣。","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358291497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3806","lineNum":3929,"lineType":1,"content":"縱","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358307881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3807","lineNum":3931,"lineType":1,"content":"他位有福助之，亦不過一多難京朝官耳。","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358307881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3808","lineNum":3931,"lineType":1,"content":"若空亡衝破，","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358324265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3809","lineNum":3933,"lineType":1,"content":"更有三刑六害，必是一孤獨貧夭，或僧道併無成舉。","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358324265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3810","lineNum":3933,"lineType":1,"content":"人","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358340649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3811","lineNum":3935,"lineType":1,"content":"更觀五行輕重消息，乘生旺氣者，特逹之士，只消一件，","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358340649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3812","lineNum":3937,"lineType":1,"content":"可作大乘生旺之氣，湏兩件可也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358340649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3831","lineNum":3957,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人得抱一之真，則無所不逹。","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358520873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3832","lineNum":3957,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼神含得一之靈，則變","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358537257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3833","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506288442212390"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3834","lineNum":3961,"lineType":1,"content":"化無窮。","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358537257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3835","lineNum":3961,"lineType":1,"content":"而隂陽之理，精神之運，歛散抑揚於一者，所以","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358553641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3836","lineNum":3963,"lineType":1,"content":"為致一之命，乃間世賢輔，出羣大貴人也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122308358553641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3837","lineNum":3963,"lineType":1,"content":"如年月日時","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137072171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3838","lineNum":3965,"lineType":1,"content":"胎五位納音，四木一水四金一土之𩔖，一見於時；或一","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137072171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3839","lineNum":3967,"lineType":1,"content":"金四水土，一水四金土，一見於年。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137072171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3840","lineNum":3967,"lineType":1,"content":"各有旺氣發越一路","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137088555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3841","lineNum":3969,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137088555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3842","lineNum":3969,"lineType":1,"content":"五位中，年胎月俱丑，而日上或時上見一寅之類。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137104939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3843","lineNum":3971,"lineType":1,"content":"年胎月時俱是戊已，而日上見一丙之類。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137121323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3844","lineNum":3971,"lineType":1,"content":"或天乙天官、","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137137707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3845","lineNum":3973,"lineType":1,"content":"文星天德徃來見於四位，為福貴之氣，獨胎一位，無福","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137137707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3846","lineNum":3975,"lineType":1,"content":"貴之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137137707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3847","lineNum":3975,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬官印、貴徳會於帝座，三合於日時上帶本","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137154091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3848","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506249137537076"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3849","lineNum":3979,"lineType":1,"content":"家一位禄馬。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137154091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3850","lineNum":3979,"lineType":1,"content":"四位俱乘旺氣，獨於時上帶一路死絶之","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137170475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3851","lineNum":3981,"lineType":1,"content":"氣；或四位俱帶死絶之氣，獨於日或時上帶一路生旺","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137170475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3852","lineNum":3983,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣，四位或甲乙、或丙丁、或庚辛、或壬癸，而日上或時","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137170475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3853","lineNum":3985,"lineType":1,"content":"上見一真官，諸如此𩔖，湏徃來㑹合歸於一者，方成此","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137170475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3854","lineNum":3987,"lineType":1,"content":"格。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137170475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3855","lineNum":3987,"lineType":1,"content":"若自生旺一路見福貴，自死絶一路見福貴，亦是","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137186859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3857","lineNum":3991,"lineType":1,"content":"人之年時上下，如天地覆載，而運日月於太虛之中，此","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137219627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3858","lineNum":3993,"lineType":1,"content":"虛中精實之格，最為竒妙。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137219627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3859","lineNum":3993,"lineType":1,"content":"雖美惡相雜，喜憎相半，無不","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137236011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3860","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506262588686399"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3861","lineNum":3997,"lineType":1,"content":"併包而𠔥容之，真大器遠業之命。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137236011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3862","lineNum":3997,"lineType":1,"content":"年與時上下乘生旺","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137252395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3863","lineNum":3999,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣，惟日一路帶衰敗死絶之氣，或上下乘金玉剛柔","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137252395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3864","lineNum":4001,"lineType":1,"content":"之德，惟月日上一路建水火變通之氣，或上下俱帶天","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137252395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3865","lineNum":4003,"lineType":1,"content":"乙、天官、文星、禄馬，並互換見諸吉神，獨日位無禄馬貴","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137252395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3866","lineNum":4005,"lineType":1,"content":"氣。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137252395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3867","lineNum":4005,"lineType":1,"content":"或年月時得寅午戌生旺庫，三合純全，獨日上一位","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137268779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3868","lineNum":4007,"lineType":1,"content":"帶三合衰敗死絶之氣是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137268779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3869","lineNum":4007,"lineType":1,"content":"入此格者，曠世無忌，休休","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137285163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3870","lineNum":4009,"lineType":1,"content":"有容，富貴不能滛，威武不能屈。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137285163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3871","lineNum":4009,"lineType":1,"content":"如陳以勤閣老，辛未、戊","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137301547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3872","lineNum":4011,"lineType":1,"content":"戌、丁卯、辛亥，申時行狀元，乙未、乙酉、甲辰、乙亥，其説註","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137301547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3873","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506271639994402"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3874","lineNum":4015,"lineType":1,"content":"蘭臺妙選，是此格也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137301547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3876","lineNum":4019,"lineType":1,"content":"年月日胎，俱在死絶無氣之鄉，而得一時在自生自旺","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137334315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3877","lineNum":4021,"lineType":1,"content":"之地是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137334315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3878","lineNum":4021,"lineType":1,"content":"假令本命屬金，年月日胎俱無氣，而得癸酉，","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137350699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3879","lineNum":4023,"lineType":1,"content":"屬火而得戊午，屬水而得丙子，屬土而得庚子，屬木而","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137350699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3880","lineNum":4025,"lineType":1,"content":"得辛卯，皆納音自旺之地。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137350699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3881","lineNum":4025,"lineType":1,"content":"或辛巳、丙寅、巳亥、甲申、戊申，","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137367083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3882","lineNum":4027,"lineType":1,"content":"皆納音自生之地。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137367083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3883","lineNum":4027,"lineType":1,"content":"若大小二運行年太歳，只以生時較","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137383467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3884","lineNum":4029,"lineType":1,"content":"量灾福，葢不生不旺，則不能成人故也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137383467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3887","lineNum":4035,"lineType":1,"content":"本命納音生居無氣之地，却得救助，而徃來復旺於本","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137416235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3888","lineNum":4037,"lineType":1,"content":"位是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137416235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3889","lineNum":4037,"lineType":1,"content":"假令辛酉人得癸卯，癸卯人得辛酉，葢辛酉之","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137432619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3890","lineNum":4039,"lineType":1,"content":"木困於金鄉，却得癸卯，金復旺於酉，而木復旺於卯，徃","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137432619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3891","lineNum":4041,"lineType":1,"content":"來互換，故為吉㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137432619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3892","lineNum":4041,"lineType":2,"content":"又云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3893","lineNum":4041,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉失位之木，惟對以癸卯，則剛","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137449003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3894","lineNum":4043,"lineType":1,"content":"柔相濟，得之者文明俊敏，决取巍科。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137449003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3895","lineNum":4043,"lineType":1,"content":"如前朝穆宗丁酉、","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137465387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3896","lineNum":4045,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯、癸卯、辛酉，嚴嵩閣老庚子巳卯、癸卯辛酉，是此格","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137465387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3897","lineNum":4047,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137465387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3905","lineNum":4061,"lineType":1,"content":"鼎足之義，謂之三合見三竒。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137563691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3906","lineNum":4061,"lineType":1,"content":"三合見一馬合，三合見本","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137580075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3907","lineNum":4063,"lineType":1,"content":"干，三合帶本家，俱以得生旺為貴。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137580075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3908","lineNum":4063,"lineType":1,"content":"切忌以金當寅午戌","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137596459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3909","lineNum":4065,"lineType":1,"content":"之類，湏旺中損夀。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137596459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3910","lineNum":4065,"lineType":1,"content":"三合見三竒，乃乙丙丁，或甲戊庚，在","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137612843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3911","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506271640010786"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3912","lineNum":4069,"lineType":1,"content":"年月日時，而地支三合之類。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137612843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3913","lineNum":4069,"lineType":1,"content":"三合見一馬，乃申子辰而","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137629227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3914","lineNum":4071,"lineType":1,"content":"得寅馬，巳酉丑亥馬之類。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137629227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3915","lineNum":4071,"lineType":1,"content":"三合見馬合，乃寅午戌見巳","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137645611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3916","lineNum":4073,"lineType":1,"content":"合申之類。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137645611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3917","lineNum":4073,"lineType":1,"content":"三合見本干，乃甲乙人得亥卯未，丙丁人得","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137661995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3918","lineNum":4075,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌之𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137661995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3919","lineNum":4075,"lineType":1,"content":"三合帶本家，如寅午戌火命得丙寅戊午、","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137678379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3920","lineNum":4077,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌，帶本家火。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137678379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3921","lineNum":4077,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未得巳亥辛卯癸未，帶本家木之","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137694763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3922","lineNum":4079,"lineType":1,"content":"𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137694763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3923","lineNum":4079,"lineType":1,"content":"又三合寅午戌馬在申，有申而缺寅。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137711147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3924","lineNum":4079,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未馬在巳，","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137727531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3925","lineNum":4081,"lineType":1,"content":"有巳而缺亥。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137727531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3926","lineNum":4081,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰馬在寅，有寅而缺申；巳酉丑馬在","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137743915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3927","lineNum":4083,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，有亥而缺巳，名三合馬，換頭支也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137743915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"3930","lineNum":4089,"lineType":1,"content":"闕門乃年對處。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137776683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3931","lineNum":4089,"lineType":1,"content":"本命甲子，以巳巳辛未為拱揖，虛午為","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137793067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3932","lineNum":4091,"lineType":1,"content":"闕門；本命乙丑，以庚午壬申為拱揖，虛未為闕門。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137793067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3933","lineNum":4091,"lineType":1,"content":"餘皆","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137809451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3934","lineNum":4093,"lineType":1,"content":"倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137809451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3935","lineNum":4093,"lineType":1,"content":"考諸書，尤重子午，餘稍輕，以子午為端門帝座故","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137825835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3936","lineNum":4095,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137825835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3937","lineNum":4095,"lineType":1,"content":"陽命見天官合，隂命見天官印綬。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137842219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3938","lineNum":4095,"lineType":1,"content":"在日時拱揖二位","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137858603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3939","lineNum":4097,"lineType":1,"content":"者，如甲以巳為天合，辛以丙為天官，壬為印綬之類。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137858603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3940","lineNum":4097,"lineType":1,"content":"或","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137874987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3941","lineNum":4099,"lineType":1,"content":"二天合、二天官、二印綬，夾輔闕門，亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137874987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3942","lineNum":4099,"lineType":1,"content":"資以天德、天乙，","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137891371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3943","lineNum":4101,"lineType":1,"content":"尤貴。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137891371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3944","lineNum":4101,"lineType":1,"content":"凡拱二位，虛夾一位，兩干同𩔖，方為真拱。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137907755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3945","lineNum":4101,"lineType":1,"content":"有拱將、","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137924139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3946","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506266657243146"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3947","lineNum":4105,"lineType":1,"content":"拱官、拱座、拱貴、拱印不同，不特拱門已也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137924139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3948","lineNum":4105,"lineType":1,"content":"拱將乃月將，","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137940523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3949","lineNum":4107,"lineType":1,"content":"拱官乃官星，拱座乃時，為帝座，拱貴乃天乙貴神，拱印","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137940523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3950","lineNum":4109,"lineType":1,"content":"乃甲戌乙丑壬辰癸未，為本家印，只湏不破為貴。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137940523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3951","lineNum":4109,"lineType":2,"content":"林開云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3952","lineNum":4111,"lineType":1,"content":"坐實不如拱虚，明合不如暗㑹是也。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137956907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3953","lineNum":4111,"lineType":1,"content":"拱有七十二格：拱","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137973291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3954","lineNum":4113,"lineType":1,"content":"刄、拱害、拱馬、拱學堂、拱飛刄、拱刼煞、拱亡神、拱鬼、拱旺、","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137973291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3955","lineNum":4115,"lineType":1,"content":"拱破、拱、孤辰拱、寡宿拱、岩廊拱、合拱、君臣合。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137973291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3956","lineNum":4115,"lineType":1,"content":"凡拱湏詳","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137989675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3957","lineNum":4117,"lineType":1,"content":"煞神輕重，分高低，言禍福貴賤。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309137989675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3958","lineNum":4117,"lineType":1,"content":"若甲子見甲寅，乙丑見","logicSentenceId":"7634122309138006059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3959","lineNum":4119,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯，丙寅見丙辰，丁卯見丁巳，戊辰見戊午，巳巳見巳","logicSentenceId":"7634122309138006059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3960","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506249137651764"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3961","lineNum":4123,"lineType":1,"content":"未，庚午見庚申，辛未見辛酉，壬申見壬戌，癸酉見癸亥。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309138006059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3962","lineNum":4125,"lineType":1,"content":"命前二辰有用必貴，無用平常。","logicSentenceId":"7634122309138022443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3963","lineNum":4125,"lineType":2,"content":"一名金章格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"8","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"今之談命者，動以子平為名。子平何所取義？以天開於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"子，子乃水之專位，為地支之首。五行之元，生於天一，合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"於北方，遇平則止，遇坎則流，此用子之意也。又如人世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"用秤稱物，以平為準，稍有重輕，則不平焉。人生八字為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506293823520803"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"先天之氣，譬則稱也。其年為鈎，時為權，月為提綱，日為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"銖兩。八字以日為主，中有財官印食旺相，日干亦坐旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"相之地，如鈎綰物，與權相應，其命則富而貴。如財官印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"食旺相，日干乃值於休囚，如以鈎綰重物，與權自不相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"應，其秤則不平，其命賤而貧。如財官印食休囚，日干值","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"於旺相，亦若鈎綰輕物，與權自不相應，其秤自不平，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"命亦蹇滯。設使三物無氣，日主休囚，非貧賤則夭亡，此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"用平之意也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":22,"lineType":2,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_2","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0"
