ineType":1,"content":"應天歌","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_13","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"等書，與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"淵源淵海","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_14","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"不同。葢觀文察變，治歴明時，皆隨其時而改","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"革。故雖百年之間，數術之説，亦不能不異。矧自大升之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"時，上距子平已三百餘年，其法不知經幾變矣。或謂大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"升得子平之真傳。觀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"繼善","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_15","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"等篇，不外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"明通賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_16","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"，但更易其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"詞，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"元理消息","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_17","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"一賦，則大升之獨得也。今人推命之術，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506276832526374"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"又元人復推子平、大升二家之法，而演繹為之者。顧今","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"之談命者，動稱子平，而莫知其原，余故解子平二字而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"詳辯之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506293823471651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506295824154660"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":72,"lineType":8,"content":"論性情相貌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"95","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"夫貴賤觀乎八字，性情應乎五行。善惡仁義禮智信，心","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"之所主；喜怒哀樂愛惡欲，情之所生。東方震位，木號青","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"龍，名曰曲直，五常主仁，其色青，其味酸，其性直，其情和。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相主有博愛惻隠之心，慈祥愷悌之意，濟物利人，恤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"孤念寡，直朴清髙，行藏慷慨，丰姿秀麗，骨格修長，手足","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"纎膩，口尖髮美，面色青白，語句軒昻，此則木盛多仁之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"義。休囚，主痩，長髮少，抝性偏心，嫉妬不仁，此則木衰情","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506290853969930"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"寡之義也。死絶，則眉眼不正，慳吝鄙嗇，肌肉乾燥，項長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"喉結，行坐不穏，身多欹側。遇火色帶赤，見土則色帶黄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"逢金則色帶白，見水則色帶黒。其餘四行例見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"106","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"火屬南方，名曰炎上，五常主禮。其色赤，其味苦，其性急，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"其情恭。旺相，主有辭讓端謹之風，恭敬謙和之義，威儀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"凛烈，淳朴尊崇，面貌上尖下濶，形體頭小脚長，印堂窄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"而眉濃，鼻凖露而耳小，精神閃爍，語言急速，性燥無毒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"聰明有為。太過則聲焦面赤，摇膝好動。不及則黄痩尖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506271640109090"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"楞，詭詐妬毒，言語妄誕，有始無終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"113","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"土屬中央，名曰稼穡，五常主信。其色黄，其味甘，其性重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"其情厚。旺相，主言行相顧，忠孝至誠，好敬神佛，不爽期","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"信。背圓腰濶，鼻大口方，眉清目秀，面肥色黄，度量寬厚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"處事有方。太過則執一古朴，愚拙不明。不及則顔色憂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"滯，面偏鼻低，聲音重濁，事理不通，狠毒乖戾，不得衆情，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"顛倒失信，慳嗇妄為。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"119","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"金屬西方，名曰從革，五常主義。其色白，其味辛，其性剛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506290853953546"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"其情烈。旺相則英勇豪傑，仗義疎財，知㢘耻，識羞惡，骨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"肉相應，體徤神清，面方白淨，眉髙眼深，鼻直耳紅，聲音","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"清亮，剛毅果决。太過則好勇無謀，貪欲不仁。不及則慳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"吝貪酷，事多挫志，有三思少决斷，尅薄内毒，喜滛好殺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"身材痩小。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"水屬北方，名曰潤下，五常主智。其色黑，其味鹹，其性聰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"明，其情良善。旺相則機關深逺，足智多謀，學識過人，詭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"詐無極，面黑光彩，語言清和。太過則是非好動，飄蕩貪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506290853986314"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"滛。不及則人物矮小，行事反覆，情性不常，膽小無畧。此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"雖五行之喻，實與人事相干。以上五行情性，叅以命中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"所遇吉凶神然斷之。大抵生旺者主長大，死絶者主矮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"小。若有煞臨，不在此限。又從煞上斷。若有尅，則從所尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"之五行斷。又槩取日時上納音，看有尅無尅，并神煞所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"臨有氣無氣，斷其形狀性情，無有不驗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":118,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"推人性行，只在日時上看本五行，不論納音。命若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"入格而逢生旺，主天性明白，遇物不逆，動必應機，言語","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506288442277926"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"聲髙，豁達大度，臨事能斷，公平不疑，犯難不畏，平生不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"以財物為吝，好施與，不私己，奢㤗歡樂，多情尚義，防有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"不善終之患。若命入貴格而逢死絶者，主為性寡合，機","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"深意宻，多疑多忌，動拘禮節，謹顧行止，修餙儀貌，常自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"檢約，不妄設施，防有隂謀之患。若小人之命已入賤局","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"而逢生旺者，主性氣無常，不自檢束，為事不顧危亡，好","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"鬪爭，恃强壓弱，親近惡黨，不事家業，必竟不得善終。死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"絶則為性滛邪，動必巧偽，畜縮執抝，舉動修飾，專弄言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506295790665782"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"詞，好自矜衒，臨事無斷，少是多非，一生無立。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"宰公要訣","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_18","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"云：志髙量逺，葢因水處深源；篤信守仁，祇為土成山岳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"仁慈敏厚，木成甲乙之方；性速辨明，火應丙丁之位；譽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"髙義重，因金歸合庚辛，處於中者，正性不移，或盛或衰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"性情變易。水乘衰敗，性昏無頼；土力太微，蔽執寡用。木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"歸蹇地，太柔而治事無規；火數未興，小辨而太傷無决；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"金當淺薄，雖義而有始無終。是五行得地失地，太過不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"及，皆能為凶也。子平賦云：美姿貌者木生於春夏之時；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506293823553571"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"無智識者水，困於丑未之日。性質聰明，葢為水象之秀；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"臨事果决，皆因金氣之剛。五行氣足，體必豐肥；四柱無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":144,"lineType":1,"content":"情，性多頑鄙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":144,"lineType":1,"content":"指迷賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_19","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":144,"lineType":1,"content":"云：文章明敏兮，定須火盛；威武剛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"烈兮，乃是金多。木盛則懷惻隠之心，水多則抱機巧之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"智。至土之性，最重為貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"廣信集","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_20","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"云：凡命五行生旺者，好","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"事華飾，胷中無物，亦主好色。火命尤𦂳，死絶相尅墓者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"多好禪道，歸根復本也。張白先生云：自絶五位五般情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"金主義，自絶則寡義。木主仁，自絶則不仁。水主智，自絶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506324265893951"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"則失智。火主禮，自絶則無禮。土主信，自絶則寡信。凡五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"行，如先生旺，後死絶，則為多鄙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"壺中子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_21","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"云：言詞狡猾，誕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"時合值六虛。六虛住處曰謾語神。凡人得之，心好撰飾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"虛詞，重併遇者，必狡猾。平生妨尅尊親，漂流他國，作事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"多虛聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":157,"lineType":8,"content":"論疾病先知五臟六腑所屬干支","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"180","lineNum":158,"lineType":2,"content":"歌曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"甲膽乙肝丙小腸，丁心戊胃己脾鄉。庚是大腸辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"屬肺，壬係膀胱癸腎藏。三焦亦向壬中寄，包絡同歸入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506272252428322"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":162,"lineType":1,"content":"癸鄉。又曰：甲頭乙頂丙肩求，丁心戊脇己屬腹。庚是臍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"輪辛屬股，壬脛癸足一身由。又曰：子屬膀胱水道耳，丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"為胞肚及脾鄉。寅膽髮脉并兩手，卯本十指内肝方。辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"土為皮肩胷類，己面咽齒下尻肛。午火精神司眼目，未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"土胃腕膈脊梁。申金大腸經絡肺，酉中精血小腸藏。戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"土命門腿踝足，亥水為頭及腎囊。若依此法推人病，岐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"伯、雷公也播揚。又曰：午頭巳未兩肩均，左右二膞是。辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"申卯酉雙脇寅戌腿，丑亥屬脚，子為隂。又曰：乾首坤腹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506324265861183"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"坎耳儔，震足巽股艮手留，兊口離目分。八卦。凡看疾病","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"此推求。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"195","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"夫疾病皆因五行不和，即人身五臟不和也。葢五行通","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"於五臟，六腑通於九竅。凡十干受病屬六腑，十二支受","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"病屬五臟。丙丁巳午火局，南離主病在上。壬癸亥子水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"局，北坎主病在下。甲乙寅卯屬震，主病在左。庚辛申酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"屬兊，主病在右。戊己辰戌丑未屬坤艮，主病在脾胃及","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"中脘。諸風暈掉、眼光日昏、血不調暢，早年落髪、䈥青、爪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506293823537187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"枯，屬肝家，甲乙寅卯木，受虧主病故也。諸痛、膿血、瘡疥、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"舌苦、瘖瘂者，屬心家，丙丁己午火，受虧主病故也。浮腫、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"脚氣、黄腫、口臭、翻胃、脾寒、膈熱者，屬脾家，戊己辰戌丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"未土，受虧主病故也。鼻塞、酒齄、語蹇、氣結，咳嗽、喊者，屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"肺家。庚辛、申酉，受虧主病故也。白濁、白帶、霍亂、瀉痢、疝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"氣、小腸，屬腎家。壬癸、亥子，受虧主病故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"208","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙見庚辛、申酉多者，内主肝膽驚悸、勞瘵，手足頑麻，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"䈥骨疼痛，外主頭目眩暈，口眼歪斜，左癱右瘓，跌撲損","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506295824187428"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"傷。遇丙丁火多，無水相濟，則痰喘咯血，中風不語，皮膚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"乾燥，内熱口乾。女人主血氣欠調，有孕者墮胎；小兒主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"急慢驚風，夜啼咳𠻳，面色青黯是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁見壬癸、亥子多者，内主心氣疼痛，顛癎舌强，口痛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"咽啞，急慢驚風，語言蹇澁，外主潮熱發狂，眼暗失眀，小","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"腸疝氣，瘡痍膿血，小便淋濁。婦女主乾血氣，經脉不調；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":198,"lineType":1,"content":"小兒主痘疹疥癬，面色紅赤是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"218","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己見甲乙、寅卯多者，内主脾胃不和，翻胃隔食，氣噎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506288442327078"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"蠱脹，泄瀉黄腫，擇揀飲食，嘔吐惡心，外主右手沉重，濕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"毒流注，胷腹痞塞。婦人主飲食不甘，吞酸虛弱，呵欠困","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"倦。小兒主五疳五軟，内熱好唾，面色痿黄是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"223","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛見丙、丁、巳、午多者，内主膓風痔漏，糞後下血，痰火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"咳𠻳，氣喘吐血，魍魎失魂，虛煩勞症；外主皮膚枯燥，肺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"風鼻赤，疽腫發背，膿血無力。婦女主痰𠻳血産；小兒主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"膿血痢疾，面色黄白是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"227","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸見戊、己、辰、戌、丑、未多者，内主遺精盗汗，夜夢鬼交，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506276832591910"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"白濁虛損，寒戰咬牙，耳聾睛盲，傷寒感冒；外主風䖝牙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"痛，偏墜腎氣，腰痛膝痛，淋瀝吐瀉，怕冷惡寒。女人白帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼胎，經水不調。小兒主耳中生瘡，小腸疼痛，夜間作炒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"面色黧黑是也。賦云：筋骨疼痛，葢因木被金傷；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"233","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"眼目暗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":216,"lineType":1,"content":"昏，必是火遭水尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":216,"lineType":1,"content":"金弱遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"火炎之地，血疾無疑。又云：木逢金尅，定主腰脇之灾；火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"被水傷，必主眼目之疾。心肺喘滿，亦干金火相刑；脾胃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"損傷，葢因土水戰尅。攴水干頭有火，遭必腹病心懞；支","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506276832608294"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"火干頭有水，遇則内障睛盲，炎上煩焦蒸土曜，頭禿眼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"昏。潤下純濕無土制，腎虛耳閉。熒惑乗旺臨離巽，風中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"失音；太白堅利合兊坤，兵前落魄。又云：心受病，口不能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"言；肝受病，目不能視；脾受病，口不能食；肺受病，鼻不能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"嗅；腎受病，耳不能聼。各從所主，以證虛實。金鬼不宜針","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"刺，火鬼切忌艾傷。土不用丸，木須忌散。金為福，西地求","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"醫；木來生，東方用藥。水絶須當針刺，藥宜金石回生，土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"弱欲得火灸尋醫，徴姓無厄。火鬼煎劑能治，水鬼丸散","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506272252444706"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"偏宜。噫！人病百端，理無二焉。望聞問切，乃醫家之妙用；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"生尅制化，為術士之玄微。若能叅究根源，標本不離斯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":234,"lineType":1,"content":"法。論曰：康泰生於和合，疾病起於刑傷。究五行衰旺之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"理，推百病表裏之詳，内應五臟，外屬四肢。且如木氣休","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"囚，兩鬂消疎而不髮；火臨死絶，雙瞳昏暗而無光。火中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"隠土，少水制則心神恍惚；木下藏金，無水收則腿足損","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"傷。甲乙兊生，逢壬癸醉鄉而死；丙丁坎育，遇庚辛溝港","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"而亡。水盛木浮，多生泄痢；土重金埋，常病氣髙，諸風掉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506288442359846"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"眩。乙木旺而辛金衰，疼癢瘡瘍；丁火盛而癸水弱，痞塞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"腫滿。只因己土太過，憤鬱病痿。葢為辛金不及，耳目聰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"明；癸水旺，寒邪拘縮腎經虛。甲乙能傷，戊己無救而缺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"唇；丙丁善尅，庚辛少制而瘖瘂。火中有土，項生瘰癧之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"灾；水中有上，腹患蠱腫之病。用神受制而被刑，亡於棒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"杖；上下逢鬼而無救，死作懸梁。四柱重衝，多凶而他鄉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"喪體；五行衰敗，不足而瘟疫亡身。水敗腰駝，莫用軒岐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"之法；金刑龜背，安施盧扁之方。庚辛氣秀西方，見木而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506295790747702"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":252,"lineType":1,"content":"亡於兵刃；甲乙敗絶坤南，無水而骨飛肉颺；辛巳、丙申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"遇刑，臂虛而人生六指；己卯、戊寅逢敵，胃弱而常病瘡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"疽；乙未甲午逢金，人多鱉頭；癸卯、己丑相刑，病生腰膝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申、乙酉，㓜年多病肝經；辛卯、庚寅，晚年勞傷䈥骨。丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"火上炎，丈夫每忌於身心；丁火下濕，女人虛癆而血産；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"金土臨寅卯，病肺喘脾寒。戊己值敗火患脾因宿塊。庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"辛見火相刑，女人須憂白帶；丙丁俱向離方，婦人切忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"血崩。羊刃則砭肱而炙股，懸針則刺面以文身。日時衰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506295790731318"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"敗，大患難瘳；干支刑害，小疾不療。氣相得而安和，氣相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"逆而灾殄。病症不離於六脉，死生難越乎五行。細究興","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"衰，萬不失一。古歌曰：戊己生時氣不全，月時兩處見傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"官。必當頭面有虧損，膿血之瘡苦少年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":265,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"日主加臨戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"己生，支辰火局氣薰蒸。衝刑尅破當殘疾，髪禿那堪眼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"不明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":267,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁日干五行衰，七煞加臨三合來。升合日求","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"衣食缺，耳聾殘疾面塵埃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":268,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸重重叠叠排，時辰設","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"若見天財。縱然頭面無㿀癩，定主其人眼目灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":269,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506296948228131"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"火旺疾難防，四柱休囚辰巳方；木火相生來此地，啞中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"風疾暗中亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":274,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"人之生也，受氣於父，成形於母，五臟和平者無疾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"尅戰太過不及者主疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"内經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_22","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"云：東方實，西方虛，瀉南方，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"補北方。東方實者，木太過也；西方虚者，金不及也；瀉南","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"方者，火太過也；補北方者，水不及也。是以五行太過不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"及，皆主疾也。若水升而火降，火降而金清，金清而木平，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"木平而上不及尅。五臟各得中和之氣，疾病何自生焉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506295790764086"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"人之四柱，内外上下，五行和者無疾，或相戰尅，太過不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"及，皆為疾也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽書","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_23","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"：金剛火强，自刑其方，木落歸本，水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"流趨東。所以論三刑，刑則殘害，言太過而身疾也。若只","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"取不及為疾，必有一偏之失。凡五行有死絶而成疾者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"水死絶，多腎氣，腰足攻注滑泄，便溺不利之疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"火死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"絶。主膓氣結塞，驚悸徤忘，精神不安之疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"木死絶，虛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"風目濇，眩暈筋急，爪甲枯顇，喜怒顛倒，擇飲擇食之疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"金死絶主氣虚，喘急咳𠻳，皮毛焦燥乾嗇，骨節疼痛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506296948244515"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"涕泪，大腸泄痢，便血之疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"土死絶主面黄减食，隔噻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"吐逆，肢體怠惰，喜卧嗜睡，多思足慮，耳聾神濁，徤㤀少","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"喜，動作之疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"323","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"有相尅而成疾者，金火相尅，生旺則瘍瘡癱瘇，死絶則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"癆瘵嘔血。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"土木相尅，生旺主疲悶，昏眩，風麻，小腸疾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"痛。瘇死絶主吐食癥塊，疽癖積滯之疾，或主中風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"328","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"木相尅，生旺主肢足骨節不完，眼目之疾，死絶主氣虚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"精脫，癆瘵癱瘓之疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"水土相尅，主脾濕泄瀉，中滿痰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506324265943103"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"𠻳，不利之疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"有相生而生疾者，火木相生，生旺則上盛隔壅，目赤頭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"風，死絶則傷寒，作狂悶亂疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"火土相生，生旺則胃實，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"死絶則唇焦紅，氣熱結，大便不利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"金水相生，生旺則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"氣滯，死絶則精滑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"水木相生，生旺則嘔吐胃虚，死絶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"則精敗，傷寒痁瘧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"金土相生，生旺則多虚無肌肉，死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"絶腸鳴䖝作。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"343","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"凡水土木相逢於無氣之處，主蠱氣腸脹，吐逆之疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506276832641062"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"凡金水火相逢於無氣之地，主痢疾。金主大膓，水火守","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"之，隂陽不和也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":324,"lineType":1,"content":"凡水逢土多，主翻胃疾。土多而無木氣疏之，主聾瞶疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"葢腎水不流則為翻，胃氣不通則為瞶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":326,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"凡論殘疾病症，先論日干，次詳月令，然後通年時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"看之。傷官主殘疾，煞重亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_24","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"卦在亥，亥為天門，六辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"生人，得此日此時，多主盲聾。亥屬腎，腎通耳，丙火遭水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"尅也。子位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"坎","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_25","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，傷官，煞重相刑，主下部疾。寅宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"艮","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_26","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"土，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506302518362112"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"脾胃，面色痿黄之疾。若戊己生人，甲乙為刑旺之煞，二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"月乙木，子卯相刑，刑起子中，卯木為煞者，亦主下部疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"辰屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"震","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_27","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"，此月帶傷官，少年主多驚疾。葢震者動也，輕則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"主驚脾胃疾，重則主足疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"震","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_28","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"長男子，二月水生木者，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"如此。巳為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"巽","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_29","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"，傷官，煞重，主婦人血氣不調，勞疾。午為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"離","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_30","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"為目，傷官煞重，主失明、頭風之症。申屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_31","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"，為衆隂，傷官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"煞重，主腰脚、䈥骨之疾。傷官傷盡者，不在此論。酉為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"兊","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_32","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"屬口齒不全之疾。戌為火庫，主下血、痔漏之疾。丑未傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506324265959487"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"官，亦主脾胃。傷官煞旺者，年年病瘟。主用上下戰尅，五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"行無救助，主身體不完，頭面殘傷。賦云：申中無氣遇寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"戰，頭目偏斜；乙丙有刑遇辛傷，每朝發禍炎。火盛水而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"滅，眼目多昏虚；土旺水而崩，肚腸蠱腫。丙中藏土，人多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"火眼。已到","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"震","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_33","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"方，定主缺唇；土受木制，乃多脾胃之灾；木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"被金傷，筋骨疼痛之患。水土相刑無救助，定有失步之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"虞；金火相刑為鬼煞，多應上喘之疾。壬癸戊己相扶，難","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"聼音樂。丙丁壬癸相隨，乍辨青黄。時來尅日，肢體難完；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506295824252964"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"水若遇刑，頭面易損。若上下鬼尅，都臨死墓。土臨甲乙，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"死於嘔吐之中；火局庚辛，絶在心氣之病。水東腎虚，臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"身金北骨癆加體，木南風氣為災。更看空亡五墓，元辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"七煞，如遇死絶，難保性命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":356,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"凡一切諸煞，亦有主疾者。刼煞主小腸，又主耳聾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"咽喉疾。官符主腰脚疾。咸池主酒色、勞瘵、膿血便溺疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"大耗主暗昧，或贅疣疾。飛㢘名天瞽。支干無氣，主無目。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"凡禄主因食致疾，須帶煞尅身方是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506324265975871"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命見真衝氣散，或真刑氣散，多是廢疾之人。甲辰、甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"戌、乙丑、乙未，土木交加，主癱瘓之疾。丙申、丁酉，金火交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"加，主血筋所傷。戊子、己亥，水土交加，主脾胃之疾。庚寅、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯，金木交加，主䈥骨勞𠻳之疾。癸巳、壬午、丙子、丁亥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"水火交加，主頭面目疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"408","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"燭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":367,"lineType":2,"content":"神經曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"日被時尅莫相對，終是艱辛病禍纒。金木戰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"兮憂病骨，水凌火氣眼生煙。金水死兮為風癩，土多水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"少敗丹田。土遭木尅脾胃弱，火勝金殘血裏眠。水深金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506290854051850"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"重逢水厄，遇水定敎落深淵。水少火多應受渴，火多土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"少語狂顛。水若深兮火若明，水滿火明夀難延。金絶切","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"忌四肢損，土多帶火受憂煎。木若盛時應蹇塞，更須仔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"細辨根源。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":376,"lineType":2,"content":"廣信集","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_34","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":376,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命禄對衝一辰，如坐命宫，或疾厄宫，主人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"手足有缺，身體不完。六厄亦係，名曰互戰。辛卯日時名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":378,"lineType":1,"content":"曰白虎閉目。火年必損眼，其餘辛與卯字者，亦忌之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":378,"lineType":2,"content":"壺","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_35","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":379,"lineType":2,"content":"中子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_35","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":379,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"金衰火盛，嘔血不爾脫肛。水竭土盈，病癖忽然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506296948260899"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"耳瞶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":382,"lineType":2,"content":"沈芝云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"破碎羊刃招痕疾，疾宫六害還非吉，日時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"累犯旺鬼凌。無氣空亡纒病卒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":383,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"月隂滛泆忌相逢，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"隂命須憂帶下通。月水不調縁好事，男兒痔漏及腸風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":385,"lineType":2,"content":"月隂，月煞也，即寅午戌在卯之例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"436","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"凡欲推疾病灾厄，先看禄命身三等，大小運如何。若三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"命無氣，禄馬敗絶，但得禄財，命財旺相，亦不至死。若父","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"病，推其子命。如子命遇孤辰寡宿，䘮門弔客，及白衣煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"臨命，其父必有不可救之疾。夫妻亦准此推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"凡貧賤之命，多無貴氣。或五行死絶，支干閒慢，不相干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"渉。或禄空亡，大耗尅身，天中臨日。或五行死絶，又落空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"亡。或一位上聚諸禄馬，生旺，却天中臨之。或有他位來","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"刑害，至於氣散。或福聚處不能獨立，被衆位分擘其福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"或驛馬尅身。或刼多逢尅制。或辰戌丑未相尅，五行無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"氣而不激揚，位位逢合。或不合不衝，上下相異其氣。或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"干支錯亂，隂陽偏枯，八字無格扶持，九命有刑駁雜。或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506290854084618"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"先逢生旺，繼逢死絶。或化氣失時，本命無氣。或假音殃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"尅，主本倒亂，父子乖違。以上此等之命，俱主貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":404,"lineType":2,"content":"又云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"貧賤之命，常用建禄食神為救神。命中有此二救，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"雖貧不至困餓，雖賤不至奴婢。一遇運發，却小小稱意，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"運過仍貧賤也。鬼谷遺文有刑聚敗極甲，甲得丁巳己、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"卯己巳之類。四柱不收，甲子得丙寅、丁巳、辛亥、壬申之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"類。五形未備，甲子得庚子、己卯、癸卯之類。一方前後，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"木命人得己丑之類。柱得隔角，如辛丑得辛卯、甲子得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506288442408998"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌之類。皆主貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"461","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"凡凶惡之命，乃命與五行無氣，而又相尅。或支干乖戾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":414,"lineType":1,"content":"刑衝互相凌戰帶煞。或真衝刑氣散；或官符大耗，刑尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"本命，五行死絶，全然無救。或官符尅身，兩木相刑衝。或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"見辰戌魁罡相衝，全無貴人驛馬相助。或五行死絶相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"尅處，見天火水溺，白虎自縊等惡煞。或五行皆旺，却位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"位相尅氣散。或交互見空亡孤寡；或歲破白虎羊刃等","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"煞；或見天中大耗，刼煞亡神同宫重叠相尅；或柱多隔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506296948277283"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"角帶煞；或日時刼亡，並煞尅年；或懸針倒戈，金神七煞、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃等煞，重重尅本命。或刑聚敗極，四柱不救。或四柱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"相刑，更臨虚廢之地。以上此等之命，俱主凶惡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":425,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"凶惡之命，常以貴人三竒、華葢夾貴為救神，有此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"雖見凶神，不至加害。大忌五行閒慢，而無建禄食神；三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"才刑尅帶煞，而無貴氣相禦，則其貧賤凶惡也無疑矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":428,"lineType":8,"content":"論夀夭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"477","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"夫修短之數，大抵生旺則夀長，死絶則夭折。譬如根深","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506312714649637"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":432,"lineType":1,"content":"者蒂固，源濬者流長，亦理之自然也。凡命月日上逢生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"旺時上雖有死氣不妨。如月上死絶日，時上雖生旺，氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"不甚雄，葢生承死絶故也。月日生旺，時上死絶，夀不過","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"四十五歲。月日死絶，時上生旺，死在三十歲前。更有凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"煞五行凌犯，必為殤子。常以月管一歲至三十歲，日管","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"三十一歲至四十五歲，時管四十五歲至一百歲，或生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，或死絶，逐限詳之。夫人氣聚則生，氣散則死。若氣遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"二運，太歲㑹集，在死絶衰息之鄉，更太歲刑尅與灾限","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506295824302116"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"相應者，定死。各發在身，無氣月日時上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"489","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命中有生旺多，又不犯煞，應是少疾病善終，死於一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"念之間。若死絶多帶刑煞重，主憔悴苦楚之灾，或久淹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"歲月，難瘳之疾。凡旺運中死，或禄上死者，主稱意中卒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"老人行年生旺，死於苦楚。葢生旺則尫羸淹久，少者則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"死於善疾。命中是亡神，大耗重叠，死須破屍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"494","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"凡天干生旺，不損尅者，夀。天干敗死，有救助者，尤夀。天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"干敗死，相賊者，夭。天干生旺，中有破尅者，尤夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506293823635491"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":452,"lineType":2,"content":"命鈴","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_36","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":452,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"凡欲知人夀命長短，但以本年納音觀其刑尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"若生月尅命，即多夭折。命尅生月，主夀算延長。假令癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"亥水命人四月生，即無夀。以戊癸之年四月見丁巳，納","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"音屬土，土能尅水，是生月尅命。又癸亥人四月生，為禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"命絶處，故無夀。如癸丑木命三月生即有夀。以三月建","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰，納音土，木尅土，是命尅生月。設如凶煞下生，亦為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"身制煞。又癸丑人三月生，為禄命庫墓，中生多主有夀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"但三十歲以前，常有患難。縁前有絶鄉運，後有死病。歴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506295824285732"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"盡衰鄉，運到旺處，故主晚福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":463,"lineType":2,"content":"玉門關集","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_37","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":463,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"凡夀以生月定之，生月居支干納音旺處，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"及五音相生，不逆日時，並胎皆得數，不相刑尅者，主上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"夀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":465,"lineType":2,"content":"玉霄寳鑑","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_38","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":465,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"人命有夭夀朝元乃納音，居死絶之地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"而有真五行與納音比合，居於生旺之位是也。假如乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"酉人，納音水巳敗，若得辛亥丙申，則丙申真水復生於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":468,"lineType":1,"content":"申，此類主享眉夀。如乙亥人得癸亥戊寅之類亦是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"子平以印綬重逢者夀，八字停均者夀，六格犯增嫌者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506288442441766"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"不夀。余驗人命信然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":473,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_39","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":473,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"525","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"若乃身旺鬼絶，雖破命而長年。鬼旺身衰，逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"建命而夭夀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"就中裸形夾煞，魄散鄷都，所犯有傷，魂歸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"岱府，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":476,"lineType":2,"content":"壺中子云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"死絶依前。生旺命曰返魂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":476,"lineType":2,"content":"乃死而復生，絶而復旺，於本命之位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"丘墓坐於本命，其名絶體，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":477,"lineType":2,"content":"墓處為丘，丘處與本命同一方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":478,"lineType":2,"content":"又云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"夀處傷殘，本命必逢三合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":478,"lineType":2,"content":"如本命金而逢己酉丑之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":479,"lineType":2,"content":"壺中子云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"顔囘夭折，只因四大空亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":479,"lineType":2,"content":"甲子、甲午旬命無水，甲申、甲寅旬命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506295790813238"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":482,"lineType":2,"content":"無金。若只見兩重流年，大運遇一重，圓之亦是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":48
