eId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":527,"lineType":2,"content":"歌云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"人命歸前次一支，子生須與丑為期。三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"逢必定遭凶死，兩見須憂血漬衣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":528,"lineType":2,"content":"若子生人見丑，各於本命前一辰是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"推命煞","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_45","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":529,"lineType":2,"content":"歌云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"命後一辰不宜見，兩重見者渉疑猜。三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506293823651875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"重在外中年夭，五百年前禍必來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":532,"lineType":2,"content":"若子生人見己亥，各於本命後一辰是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"五行滿數","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_46","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":533,"lineType":2,"content":"歌曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"五行生處定隂陽，日月平分兩位當。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":534,"lineType":2,"content":"凡月一至十五日為陽，十六日至三十日為隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"六日初生名甲乙，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":534,"lineType":2,"content":"初六日木生至初十日滿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁依次火為强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":535,"lineType":2,"content":"十六日火生至二十日滿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸水流相註定，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":535,"lineType":2,"content":"二十六日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":536,"lineType":2,"content":"水生三十日滿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"從兹生死不乖張。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":536,"lineType":2,"content":"假如己亥年九月三十日己酉丁卯時，其日值水滿，年是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":537,"lineType":2,"content":"己亥，日是己酉，其水被兩土所尅，此人夭夀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"655","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"有隂陽二極：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":538,"lineType":2,"content":"歌曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽二極。君知否，男女皆從本命數。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":539,"lineType":1,"content":"男逢九位女三雙，位位相逢兼順去。大小兩運氣全無，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506302518411264"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"到此須知身死處。兩運有氣則無妨，合致一年災運苦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":543,"lineType":2,"content":"男以本命順數至九辰為陽極，女以本命數至六辰為隂極。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":544,"lineType":2,"content":"源髓歌","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_47","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":544,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"木水遇巳金逢寅，生火生金傷本身。五行命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"裏皆防此，遇者知非鶴髮人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"666","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"以上諸説，須盡詳之。先以五行生旺死絶，次以格局有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"無損壞，然後考諸神煞，而以流年太歲參之，蔑不中矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":548,"lineType":2,"content":"或曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"人之夀夭禀父母，父精母血，盛衰不同，故人之夀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"亦異。其有生之初，受氣之兩盛者，當得上中之夀。受氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506295824334884"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"之偏盛者，當得中下之夀。受氣之兩衰者，能保養，僅得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"下夀。不然多夭折。雖然，又不可以常理拘泥論也。或風","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"寒暑濕之感於外，饑飽勞役之傷乎内，豈能一一盡乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"所禀之元氣，而終其天年也耶？知命君子，要在修身以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"俟之而已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"677","lineNum":557,"lineType":8,"content":"論女命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"678","lineNum":558,"lineType":1,"content":"或問婦人何利？利在夫星。夫利，其婦必利，夫困，其婦必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"困。婦人從夫，先觀夫星，以定出身之貴賤，再㸔子星，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506295790862390"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"察晚年之榮辱。官、煞財得地，夫利也；食神得地，子利也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"夫利則出身富貴，一生享福；子利則晚年厚養，褒寵誥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"封。然亦有旺夫者，以食生財，財生官故耳，反是則否。女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"命以尅我者為夫，我生者為子，皆要得時，乘生旺之氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"若旺氣只聚於時，亦可用官為夫，不要見煞，用煞為夫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"不要見官。一位為好，有兩位官星無煞以雜之，四柱純","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"煞無官以混之，俱為良婦。更得本身自旺尤佳，但旺不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"可太過，食為子息引歸，時逢旺，再得二徳扶身，乃夫貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506296948326435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"子榮之命。不宜身旺重叠，暗藏夫神，及傷官七煞，魁罡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"相刑，羊刃太重，合多有情，皆主不美。歲運亦然。看有八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"法八格，須細詳之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"693","lineNum":575,"lineType":8,"content":"純","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"694","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"純者一也。如純一官星，或純一煞星，有財有印，不值刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"衝，不相混雜是也。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":577,"lineType":2,"content":"一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳、戊午、辛酉、丙申，本身專","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"禄，旺不從化，辛用丙官為夫星，五月火旺夫徤，丙用癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"為官，坐貴，見戊為食，同歸禄於己，辛金生壬水為子，引","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506296948342819"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"入申時長生之地，天干癸戊辛丙，水火既濟，地支己午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"酉申，拱夾財庫，所以嫁夫為官，而食天禄，夫榮子貴之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":584,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥、甲寅、丙戌、甲午，丙用癸為夫，臨官在亥，甲為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"印，坐寅建禄，自身坐庫，己土為子，歸禄於午，居時子息","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"之位，甲木為己土之官，四柱純一不雜，故主子貴䕃，餘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"倣此。推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"709","lineNum":588,"lineType":8,"content":"和","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"710","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"和者，恬靜也。如身柔弱，獨有一位夫星，柱無衝破攻擊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506293823684643"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"之神，禀其中和之氣，則為和也。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":592,"lineType":2,"content":"一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰、辛亥、己卯、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳，己用甲為夫，亥乃長生之地，得天時地利，甲以辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":594,"lineType":1,"content":"為官，金生於己，己以金為子，亦生於己，謂之夫得官星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"子得長生，故主益夫旺子，雖自坐卯支為煞，有己中庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"制，為去煞留官之論，女命之貴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":596,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑、壬寅、丁酉、己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"酉，丁用壬為夫，甲為印，乃夫之食禄。丁酉日貴，生己酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"之子，壬水得己土為官，主夫貴。己土得甲為官，主子貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"酉中財旺，榮夫䕃子之造，餘倣此。推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"726","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"清者，潔淨之稱。女命或一官一煞，不相混雜，謂之清要。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"夫星得時柱，有財生，官有印助，身無一㸃混濁之氣，方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"為清貴。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":605,"lineType":2,"content":"一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"己未、壬申、乙未、甲申，乙以庚為夫，庚䘵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"到申，以丁為子，丁旺於未，以壬為印，壬生於申，又坐下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"支神，為乙木之財，財旺則能生官。四柱無刑衝破敗，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":607,"lineType":2,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_48","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":608,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"財官印綬三般物，女命逢之必旺夫，故為夫人之命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":609,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅、癸酉、丙寅、戊子，丙用癸為夫，坐酉自生，癸得戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506312714731557"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":612,"lineType":1,"content":"為官，癸禄居子，夫得禄者貴。丙火得戊土為子，坐財逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"煞印，主子貴。餘倣此。推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"742","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"貴者，尊榮之號。命中有官星，得財氣以相資，三竒得其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"宗。四柱不植鬼病，乃女命堯舜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":616,"lineType":2,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_49","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":616,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"746","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"無煞，女人之命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"一貴可作良人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":617,"lineType":2,"content":"又云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"女命無煞，逢二德可兩國之封。二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"德者，非獨天月二德，即財為一德，官為一德，加之印食，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"愈為貴也。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":619,"lineType":2,"content":"一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午、丙寅、丁未、壬寅，丁以壬為官，壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506295824367652"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"食甲為印，壬用丙為財，壬以亥為禄，得壬寅暗合，雖夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"星失時，喜行西北夫旺之運，故主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":623,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥、丙戌、辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"卯、癸巳，辛用乙為財，旺於亥，丙為夫星坐庫，歸禄已上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"癸水為夫之官，辛金生癸為子坐，巳上與夫禄同位，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"是貴神，又為財官雙美，乃得夫子俱貴，兩遇褒封，餘倣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"此。推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"763","lineNum":628,"lineType":8,"content":"濁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"764","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"濁者混也，乃五行失位，水土互傷，其身太旺，正夫不顯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506302518427648"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"偏夫叢雜，柱多分别，無財官印食，為下賤村濁，或娼妓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"婢妾滛巧之人。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":633,"lineType":2,"content":"一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥、乙亥、癸丑、己未，癸水生十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"月大泛，癸以戊為夫，不顯時引己未，是偏夫，嫌丑未皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"有土混雜，柱中無財，乙木為食神干旺，己土受尅，鬼敗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"臨身，五行失位，主先清後濁，不能享福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":636,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未、甲寅、辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"酉、乙未、辛酉，八專自旺，用丙火為夫，長生為寅，夫旺本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"好，但辛貪乙未庫中財，惹起未中丁火為暗夫，兩庫暗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"夫，重過明夫，明暗交集，雖有正夫，未免暗中偷夫得財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506295790895158"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"乃濁亂之象，餘倣此。推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"780","lineNum":643,"lineType":8,"content":"濫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"781","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"濫者，婪也。謂柱中明有夫多，暗中財旺，干支又多帶煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"必因酒色私暗得財。此等之命，或為奴婢，或尅夫再嫁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":646,"lineType":2,"content":"一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅、丙戌、庚申、丁亥、庚申，八專自旺，丙火為夫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"寅戌㑹局，時干又丁，愛重火情，庚申金暗尅寅，亥木為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"財，亥中壬水為食生財，其人雖美貌有福，不免濫而得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":649,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子、甲寅、己未、丁卯，正月甲木旺，卯未㑹局，偏正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506324266025023"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"夫多，子上又有旺財，己合甲官，隂陽匹配，故雖聰明秀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"麗，不免失之於濫。况倒揷桃花，上坐娣妹，不是官星，豈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"為良婦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":654,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉、丁丑、癸丑、壬戌，柱中明有己夫，二丑一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"戌，三夫暗藏，丁為財，歸庫於戌，與丑相刑，二陽得令，火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"亦進氣，是夫多財旺。丁壬太過：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":656,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰、癸酉、丙子、辛卯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子日犯隂陽煞，主男子挑誘，丙以癸為夫，辰子㑹水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"夫多日，時丙辛合子卯刑支刑干，合犯荒滛滚浪，酒色","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"昏迷。酉中財旺，癸夫專坐，二命俱妓，賣奸得財，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506290854150154"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":662,"lineType":1,"content":"推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"807","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"娼者妓也，乃身旺夫絶，官衰食盛，或柱中不見官煞，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"有而傷官傷盡，或官煞混雜而食神盛旺，此必娼妓之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"命，否則為師尼婢妾，尅夫滛奔。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":666,"lineType":2,"content":"一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥、庚戌、戊辰、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申。戊以甲為夫，九月失時無氣，又被庚尅，絶時引入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"申，以庚為食，建禄在申，戊辰魁罡生申太旺，亥中壬財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"亦旺，謂之身旺逢生，貪食貪財，夫絶而為秀麗，娼也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":669,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506293823717411"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥、丙戌、甲子、丙寅。甲以庚辛為夫，九月金衰氣退，時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"引食神長生木地，㑹局甲木歸禄身旺，庚金引至寅地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":674,"lineType":1,"content":"絶而無氣，二丙食神太旺，傷其金夫，謂之自旺食盛，衣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"食雖好，不免風塵娼妓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":675,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑、庚申、戊辰、庚申，戊用己，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"夫絶在申，戌日得庚申為食神，月時重見，謂之食旺夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"絶，故主為娼。凡陽干女命，食神多者為娼，隂干女命，食","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"神多者為妓，餘倣此。推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
