{"lines":[{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506312714747941"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"滛者沃也，乃本身得地。夫星明暗交集，謂日干自旺，柱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"中皆官煞是也。在干者為明，在支者為暗。四柱太過，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"一丁見三壬，及辰子多之例，謂之交集，於人無所不納","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"也。如戊辰、壬辰、壬戌、癸亥、丙辰、癸亥，本自得地，明有戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"土為正夫，暗有辰戌為偏夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":686,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌、戊子、乙酉、甲申，乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"以庚為明夫，而身坐酉支，時又引申為暗夫，運行西方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"金旺之地，二命俱夫星，明暗交集，滛不可言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":688,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥、壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"子、丁丑、壬寅，丁火純於衆水之中，明暗夫多，滛亂無恥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506295790911542"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":692,"lineType":2,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_50","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":692,"lineType":2,"content":"曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"843","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"丁遇壬而太過，必犯滛訛之亂是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":692,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯、甲子、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯、乙亥，己用甲為夫，甲敗在子，卯為暗夫，坐於支下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"又亥卯多明暗交集，正夫不能主張禁制，暗夫得勢而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"入，正夫反廻避也。餘倣此。推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"849","lineNum":696,"lineType":8,"content":"旺夫傷子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"850","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"夫女人有旺夫傷子者何？此法皆時上推之，時為歸宿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":698,"lineType":1,"content":"之地，夫子二星引歸於時，夫星生旺，子星衰敗是也。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":699,"lineType":2,"content":"一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌、丙申、丁巳、辛亥，丁坐巳自旺，以壬水為夫，時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506308612587558"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"上乃是夫星臨官之地，月支申金，乃夫星長生之地，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"辛金為財，七月金旺，二丙相比，皆坐夫之財印，故主夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"聰秀富貴。丁以戊為子息之垣，引至時上見亥，亥中甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"木能尅戊土，乃子星被尅而難得也，故主旺夫傷子。餘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"倣此。推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"860","lineNum":707,"lineType":8,"content":"旺子傷夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"861","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"有旺子傷夫者何？此法專以月時推之，謂尅我者為官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"為夫，有氣得時，則夫發福。若支干失位，不得月氣，柱中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506326757146636"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"又逢衝尅，時上又無旺氣，而己生之子，引至時上，逢長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"生臨官帝旺之地，又無刑尅，是旺子傷夫也。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":713,"lineType":2,"content":"一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":714,"lineType":1,"content":"卯、甲戌、乙卯、戊寅，乙用庚為夫，九月庚金無氣，乙用丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"為子，丙火長生於寅，與戌㑹局，皆屬火，月令既無金氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"時引絶地，又被火尅，是傷其夫星，旺其子息，故曰旺子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"傷夫，餘倣此。推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"872","lineNum":718,"lineType":8,"content":"傷夫尅子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"873","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"傷夫尅子者，乃夫星干支失位，生月失時，柱中又逢衝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506290854182922"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":722,"lineType":1,"content":"尅，時支亦不生扶，兼且印綬重逢，盗夫之氣，尅子之甚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"夫子不能旺，反絶於時是也。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":723,"lineType":2,"content":"一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子、庚子、乙亥、丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"子，乙木以庚金為夫星，十一月金寒水冷，又金死子地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"支亥子，水盗金氣盡，柱無土生助，傷官木多，故傷其夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"乙木以丙火為子，引至子時，乃水旺火滅之地，雖年時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"干二火，被羣水相尅，夫子皆亡，故曰傷夫尅子，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":728,"lineType":1,"content":"推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"884","lineNum":729,"lineType":8,"content":"安靜守分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506296948375587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"安靜守分者，乃夫星有氣，日干自旺，相停無尅，不值刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"衝，財食得所者是也。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":733,"lineType":2,"content":"一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳、庚申、乙卯、丁亥，乙坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":734,"lineType":1,"content":"卯，專禄自旺，又得時支亥字合局，是本身旺也。以庚金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"為夫，七月庚禄到申，又得年支己火，為金長生之地，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"夫星旺也。亥中壬水，夫之食神天厨，故主夫食天禄，此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"乃自己夫星，兩不相傷，各乗旺氣，無混雜相侵，夫婦偕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":738,"lineType":1,"content":"和安靜守分格也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"895","lineNum":739,"lineType":8,"content":"横夭少年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506295824465956"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"夫横夭少年者，造化之窮絶，格局之變異也。有懸梁溺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"水，血産少亡，被人殺死，若此者何？乃身弱而遇煞重，煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":744,"lineType":1,"content":"多尅身，又帶刑衝破敗之類；或命中元有官星受傷，行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"運復遇官鄉，或無官見傷，運復臨官之類；或帶刃無制，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"運行合刃之地，及亡神刼煞等類，此皆横夭類也。不獨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"女命有之，男命亦同。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":747,"lineType":2,"content":"一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯、癸丑、庚辰、丙子，庚用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":748,"lineType":1,"content":"丁為官，被癸水子辰傷官叠遇，尅之太重，水多金沉，一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"交丁巳運，傷官見官，又㑹丙煞尅身，故有溺水之害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":749,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506324266041407"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":752,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉、戊子、丙寅、己亥，日干丙火，長生於寅，冬生亥子，官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"煞太重，謂之旺火投於盛水，故生産而亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":753,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子、癸卯、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":754,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌、丁卯。月令羊刃時，丁卯傷官，羊刃子刑戌，合柱中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"又無夫星、財星。癸酉年、乙丑月，己卯日，犯姦殺死。凡女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":756,"lineType":1,"content":"命官煞太重，羊刃無情，非滛濫則凶亡。餘倣此。推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"916","lineNum":757,"lineType":8,"content":"福夀兩備","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"917","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"夫福夀兩備者，造化之中和，格局之純粹也。有享用一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"生，永錫難老。若此者何？乃身坐旺鄉，通於月氣，支干相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506295824449572"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":762,"lineType":1,"content":"輔，更帶財官印綬，各得其位，不行脫財壞印傷官之局，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"尤喜食神天厨。若身旺而運行財食之鄉，此皆福夀兩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":764,"lineType":1,"content":"備之命也。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":764,"lineType":2,"content":"一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":764,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午、庚子、辛酉、癸巳，辛坐酉支，專禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"自旺。時癸歸禄於子，為食神、夀星，子星得地，辛用丙火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"為官，丙禄歸於己，為夫星得地。又十一月生人，乃金白","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"水清之象，兼支干上下相輔，俱無傷損，身不從化，故主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":768,"lineType":1,"content":"為人美貌端正，夫子相停，福夀兩備也。餘倣此。推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"929","lineNum":769,"lineType":8,"content":"正偏自處","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506295824433188"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":772,"lineType":1,"content":"夫正偏自處者，何也？乃夫婦相合，復遇比肩分爭。如一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":773,"lineType":1,"content":"位夫星，有兩位妻星相合，謂之爭合。若本身自旺，彼身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":774,"lineType":1,"content":"值衰，四柱不衝，則我正而彼為偏。若彼旺我衰，四柱衝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"我，則彼正而我為偏矣。葢我身旺有氣，則夫從我為正；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"我身衰而别位旺，則夫從别位，我反為偏。謂之彼旺爭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"去我夫，我只得為偏。或自旺太過，柱無夫星者，亦為偏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":778,"lineType":1,"content":"或官煞混雜，或傷官太重，亦為偏。更滛濫如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":778,"lineType":2,"content":"一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":778,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午、辛酉、辛卯，辛用丙為夫星，我坐酉支，專禄自旺，雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506308612685862"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"時引辛卯之金，彼却無力，故我為正而彼為偏。此為二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"女爭夫，正偏自處。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":783,"lineType":2,"content":"又。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未、壬戌、癸巳、壬子，癸用土為夫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳水弱，壬子水旺，弱不能勝旺，被壬水爭去，戊土正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"夫，乃彼勝我衰，我只得為偏。但壬水重而太泛，又帶桃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"花，不能自處。餘倣此。推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"949","lineNum":787,"lineType":8,"content":"招嫁不定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"950","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"夫招嫁不定者，何也？乃月令中有夫星透干，與己相合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"己身從伏其夫星却無氣，時引夫星或煞星却乘旺地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506337679114281"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":792,"lineType":1,"content":"來尅己身，又從伏偏夫，故謂之招嫁不定。若夫星不旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"或受尅制，必嫁夫遲，或嫁夫不明，或夫不濟事，或有外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":794,"lineType":1,"content":"情。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":794,"lineType":2,"content":"一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":794,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉、甲子、己未、乙亥，巳用甲為夫，生於十一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"月，失時不旺，時逢亥字，乃甲木長生，是夫旺也，却不合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"又被乙木制己未，未為乙木庫地，甲生子月，夫坐敗地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"不顯。時上乙亥，亥中又有長生之甲，欲甲而又招乙也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"此為招嫁不定，餘倣此推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"962","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"論曰：凡觀隂命，先推夫子興衰；欲究榮枯，次辨日時輕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506312714813477"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"重。官為夫，財為父，財旺夫榮；食為子，印為母，印盛子衰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"日干不宜太旺，月氣務禀中和。日主旺相，奪夫權而孤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"苦；月令休囚，安本分而持家。官星得地，夫主榮華，傷官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"無尅，子當貴顯。有官而不可見煞，有煞而不可逢官，設","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"使官煞混雜，為人安得禎祥。官星無尅，值二德可兩國","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"之封；七煞有制，遇三竒為一品之貴。喜食神而制煞生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"財，惡傷官而尅夫盗氣。貪財壞印，豈是良人；用煞逢官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"非為節婦。孤貧下賤，葢因子死休囚；富貴崢嶸，只為夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506290854199306"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"興子旺。官太旺，公夀難延；財重叠，婆年早䘮。身居旺地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"雖富足，夫子刑傷；日值衰鄉，縱貧寒，夫子完聚。自旺而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":814,"lineType":1,"content":"巧於婦業，日衰而拙於女工。貴神一位，不富即榮；合神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"數重，非尼即妓。貴人乘驛馬，决主風塵之美妓；官星帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花，定為深院之良人。食神獨者，安和而有子有夀；合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"貴重者，嬌媚而多賤多情。桃花不宜倒挿，沐浴最忌裸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"形，犯之者多為侍婢，值之者定作師尼。四仲全，乃酒色","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"荒滛之女；四孟備，乃聰明生發之人。未丑刑而不忌，戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506302518493184"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"辰衝處非良。大抵夫星要值徤旺，巳身須禀中和。食神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"不可刑傷，子星要臨生地。印綬生身，一位則可。財神發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":824,"lineType":1,"content":"福，多見無傷。財强身弱，不能發福；身强財弱，安得為良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官叠遇，尅夫星而再嫁之人；印綬重逢，不死别即生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":826,"lineType":1,"content":"離之婦。刑衝羊刃，惡狠無知。破害金神，血光産難。四柱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":827,"lineType":1,"content":"無夫，不偏房定為續室。八字空亡，非寡鵠决是孤鸞。大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":828,"lineType":1,"content":"槩貴賤觀其夫位，榮枯究其財官。此為天依乎地，地附","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"乎天。故貴者隨夫而貴，貧者隨夫而貧。前八法以泄其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506308612653094"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"玄機，後八格仍明其奥㫖。倘有缺誤，俟知者擇焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":833,"lineType":2,"content":"又云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"乾道成男，坤道成女。隂陽剛柔，各有其體。故女命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":834,"lineType":1,"content":"以柔為本，以剛為刑，以清為竒，以濁為賤。故三竒得位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"良人萬里封侯；二德歸垣，貴子九秋步月。一官一貴，烏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"雲兩鬢擁金冠；四煞四空，皓月滿懷啼玉筯。官行官運，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"鏡破釵分。財入財鄉，夫榮子貴。衣錦藏珍，官星有氣。堆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":838,"lineType":1,"content":"金積玉，財庫無傷。大抵官多不榮，財多不富。用正印而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"逢梟，蘭階夜冷。用梟神而遇印，玉樹春榮。金清水冷，日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506312714829861"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"鎻鸞臺。土燥火炎，夜寒鴛帳。羣隂羣陽，清燈自守。重官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"重印，緑鬢孤眠，田園廣置。食神得位，不逢官，粟帛盈餘；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":844,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬失時，還遇煞。傷官不見官星，猶為貞潔；無食多逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":845,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬，反作刑傷。窮梟見食，坐産花枯；惡煞混官，臨春葉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":846,"lineType":1,"content":"落。逺合勾情，背夫尋主。衝官破食，棄子從人。財衰運絶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"㓜出娘門。身旺印强，早刑夫主。五煞簮花，日夜迎賔送","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"客；三刑帶鬼，始終尅子傷夫。楊妃貌美，禄傍桃花。謝女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"才髙，身乘詞舘。華葢臨官，情通僧道。孤神坐印，身受尼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506308612669478"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"姑。胞胎常墮，食旺身衰，鸞鵠頻分，官輕比重。娣妹剛强，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"乃作填房之婦；財官死絶，當招過繼之兒。官臨財地必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"榮夫，身入財鄉須尅子。煞梟破禄連根，墮氷肌於水火；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"比刃遭刑䘮局，掩玉骨於塵沙。交馳逢驛馬，母氏荒凉；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":856,"lineType":1,"content":"差錯對孤神，夫家零落。五馬六財，窮敗比肩之地；八官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"七煞，分離刑害之鄉。刑空官煞，幾臨嫁而罷濃粧；衝尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"印財，縱得家難成厚福。不若藏財，不露明煞，無傷重印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"行財，多財遇印。四敗，匪佳人之有幸；四衝，豈良婦而無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506296948424739"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"嫌。水聚旺鄉，花街之女；金成秀麗，桃洞之仙。四生馳四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":863,"lineType":1,"content":"馬，背井離鄉；三合帶三刑，傷夫敗業。暗煞逢刑，藁砧不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":864,"lineType":1,"content":"善。明官誇馬，夫主增榮。黄金滿籯，一財得所；紅顔失配，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"兩貴無家。先比後財，自貧至富。衝官合食，靠子刑夫。死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":866,"lineType":1,"content":"絶胞胎，花枯寂寂。長生根本，瓜瓞綿綿。合貴合財，珠盈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"金屋；破財破印，衾冷蘭房。吕后名馳天下，只縁隂併陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":868,"lineType":1,"content":"剛。緑珠身墮樓前，葢是梟衝煞位。秋水通源，剔眸立節；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"冬金坐局，斷臂流芳。娣妹同宫，未適而先抱恨；命財有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506302518525952"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，配夫到老無憂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":873,"lineType":2,"content":"通明賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_51","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":873,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"女人之命，一貴為良，食重孤孀，貴多滛賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":873,"lineType":2,"content":"貴指","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":874,"lineType":2,"content":"官煞言。食傷官煞，孤尅之星也；官煞叠見，滛亂之象也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"二徳真貴，封贈可知；三竒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"真良，國號自至。金木有堅心之淑德，水火生亂性之虛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"花。五行偏喜休囚，四柱不宜生旺。富貴貧寒，全憑夫子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":877,"lineType":2,"content":"二德，即天月德也，女命得之，更有財官，純粹不雜，必受封贈。三竒，甲戊庚之類。財官印食，亦為三竒。女命中有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":878,"lineType":2,"content":"此，必受國號。德者，純一不雜之謂。金木性純，本為女人之所守。水流主滛，火炎主暴，水火多則亂性，為人虚花","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":879,"lineType":2,"content":"不純而暴惡矣。隂主柔，陽主剛，女隂也，與男相反，故喜休囚，而忌生旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506326757179404"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":882,"lineType":2,"content":"繼善篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_52","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":882,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":882,"lineType":1,"content":"女人無煞，一貴可作良人；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":882,"lineType":1,"content":"貴衆合多，必是師","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"尼娼婢。傷官尅，則食絶孤苦；夫徤旺，則子秀身榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":884,"lineType":2,"content":"玉振賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_53","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":884,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":884,"lineType":1,"content":"隂命印重，本絶嗣。運行官煞反吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":884,"lineType":2,"content":"夫旺子生，此理之常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"女犯傷官須尅配，運入財旺亦佳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":885,"lineType":2,"content":"傷生財，財生官，所謂能使無情更有情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"棄命就煞，必配名家；專禄食神，斷受誥命。孤鸞最利於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"七煞，桃花喜帶乎官星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":887,"lineType":2,"content":"此四格皆主富貴，益夫旺子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"官貴太多，非偏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"房即為舞妓；㑹合過盛，不媒妁則是尼姑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":888,"lineType":2,"content":"女命雖不嫌官貴，多則不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":889,"lineType":2,"content":"吉。天干地支，三合六合，帶得多者，必為此等之人。葢媒妁聨二姓以成親，尼姑受萬人之施捨，参之人事，章章","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506308612735014"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":892,"lineType":2,"content":"明矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":892,"lineType":1,"content":"甲木坐申透庚金，子都西子；丙火坐申時壬水，大喬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"小喬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":893,"lineType":2,"content":"言此二日專用煞，苟無混雜，其女必有傾國傾城之色矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":894,"lineType":2,"content":"賦云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":894,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅戊寅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":894,"lineType":2,"content":"或云戊申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":894,"lineType":1,"content":"縱遇破敗猶得；己卯癸未，休教紅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"艶相侵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":895,"lineType":2,"content":"此四日俱自坐長生臨官之夫，如庚得寅，戊得申，乃上人之妻，己得乙，癸得己，亦不失為佳婦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":896,"lineType":2,"content":"但五隂日不宜紅艶，桃花二煞五陽遇之縦為不堪，亦可養身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":896,"lineType":1,"content":"官臨墓絶之地，老困嬌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"娘；夫居雜氣之中，最宜佳婦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":897,"lineType":2,"content":"如庚用丁為夫，十一月生，辛用丙，為夫八月生，雖名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":898,"lineType":2,"content":"為夫，實則不時，縱有貌，必然受困，所謂紅顔多薄命是也。如癸日生於未月，雜氣之中，有丁乙巳，夫星子息財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":899,"lineType":2,"content":"帛全，雖居雜，見之不忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":899,"lineType":1,"content":"官得令而逢傷，反作奴婢；煞當權而有制，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506296948441123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":902,"lineType":1,"content":"當為正室。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"日刃逢煞，不偏則尼；月傷叠刃，非奴則婢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":904,"lineType":2,"content":"日刃逢煞，如壬子日、戊申時之例；月傷叠刃，如丁卯月、甲辰日之例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官奪夫之柄，化煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"助夫之資。桃花喜共官星，紅艶休同煞伴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"寒衾少怨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"命值孤鸞獨枕早孀；日臨寡鵠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":907,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中絶無官煞，值此日為忌。如有官煞等項倚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":908,"lineType":2,"content":"靠，雖犯孤鸞，隂陽差錯等日反吉。寡鵠即孤鸞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":908,"lineType":1,"content":"孤鸞，若遇夫星，必多子女。天德","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢煞化，定盛婢奴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":910,"lineType":1,"content":"一片比肩，官地爭夫擬定；渾身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"泄氣，印星望嗣堪求。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":912,"lineType":1,"content":"旺夫傷子，乃官令而梟强；旺子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"傷夫，因食時而官絶。印重盈盤，遇富夫而多得子。食清","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506308612702246"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":916,"lineType":1,"content":"值令，得壯妹必許夫榮；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":916,"lineType":2,"content":"富夫乃官星帶財之論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":916,"lineType":1,"content":"印重官輕，奪夫權，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":917,"lineType":1,"content":"鳳舞鸞飛。坑婢命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":917,"lineType":2,"content":"孤鸞日，乃旺毒之辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":917,"lineType":1,"content":"天月二德，無他亂衣錦冠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":918,"lineType":1,"content":"金羊刃七煞無善降，身塵髮垢。一逢隂煞，非守志，必也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"無兒；兩透陽傷，且榮身而不尅壻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":919,"lineType":2,"content":"五隂日見五隂煞，為凶陽傷。官得印重，反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":920,"lineType":2,"content":"榮身而不尅壻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":920,"lineType":1,"content":"日刃同刃，最忌生産；食神反破，難與留胎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":920,"lineType":2,"content":"日刃同刃，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":921,"lineType":2,"content":"是逢衝也。如丙午、庚寅、壬子、癸卯，是年刃與日刃相衝。食神犯破，是逢梟也，如丙申、庚子、戊戌、丙辰月，丁庚食","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":922,"lineType":2,"content":"被時丙尅之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":922,"lineType":1,"content":"官臨死絶知夫䘮，梟遇驅除斷子來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"何知夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":924,"lineType":1,"content":"得貴，孰知子得官。食附官而可知，官即食而可見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":924,"lineType":2,"content":"如己未日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506312714846245"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":927,"lineType":2,"content":"辛亥時，甲與己合，辛附甲官。食神健旺，子貴，逢破則子不肖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"先後興衰，倚夫星之好","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":928,"lineType":1,"content":"惡；始終盛替，察子運之榮枯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":928,"lineType":2,"content":"如一命戊日生春甲寅時，偏官乃戊之天睢狀，不見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":929,"lineType":2,"content":"財星行至東方，又無金制其木，其夫無名無利。交到午運，夫星正值食得所，却是甲木死地，故尅之再嫁。未申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":930,"lineType":2,"content":"二運，財帛馳至大發。運至酉，又五年，至胎始夀。戊上丙火，至此俱死，七煞見傷，官思無倚而亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":931,"lineType":2,"content":"壺中子云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"登明足艶，太乙多滛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":931,"lineType":2,"content":"亥為入夜之時，己為迎夜之候。女命而得亥多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":932,"lineType":2,"content":"者有姿，巳多者好色。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":932,"lineType":1,"content":"木盛則妖妍，水澄則清潔，金多夭折，火致剛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"强，土則富厚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":934,"lineType":1,"content":"負天月二德，則霞帔金冠；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":935,"lineType":1,"content":"得祿命身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":936,"lineType":1,"content":"三財，則夫榮子貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":936,"lineType":2,"content":"歲干所尅者祿財，歲支所尅者命財，納音所尅者身財。其三財所屬之五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506302518558720"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":939,"lineType":2,"content":"行，在命中一財不乏而得之全者，夫必榮，子必貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"切嫌者隂刃，妨害尊親；最忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":940,"lineType":1,"content":"者純隂，不宜子息。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":940,"lineType":2,"content":"禄後一辰曰隂刃，男得之妨妻族親，女得之妨夫族親。又命年月日時干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":941,"lineType":2,"content":"支俱屬隂，或生五月之後，十一月之前者，乃隂極而陽不生，是為純隂，多無子息。葢獨隂不生，獨陽不成故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":942,"lineType":1,"content":"骨髓破，殃罹内外，薦枕星，招涉是非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":942,"lineType":2,"content":"骨髓破即白衣煞，得之者刑及内外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":943,"lineType":2,"content":"二族。薦枕星乃冠帶位，得之者一生多涉是非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"鴛鴦憚於女未，傾國傾城；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":943,"lineType":2,"content":"凡三支一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":944,"lineType":2,"content":"干，鳯凰、麒麟、鳳沼之格，在女命則受為鴛鴦煞，主滛穢。命中又見水，多主風塵，多艶質。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":944,"lineType":1,"content":"官鬼旺於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"貴垣，鳳冠霞帔。花釵與桃花相犯，暮雨朝雲；貴人共天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":946,"lineType":1,"content":"喜爭窠，穿垣騫牖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":946,"lineType":2,"content":"命前一辰為花釵煞，後一辰為桃花煞，本生上見之，全而不偏，是為同犯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506337679179817"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":949,"lineType":2,"content":"主為娼優。得三竒不在此論。天乙住處曰貴人，旺氣住處曰喜神，本生上帶之，而又同宫，是為爭窠，主為滛奔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":950,"lineType":2,"content":"之妾。落空亡，不在此論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":951,"lineType":2,"content":"賦云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"女人無煞，一貴何妨。喜逢天月德神，忌見煞官混","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":952,"lineType":1,"content":"雜，貴衆則舞裙歌扇，合多則暗約偷期。五行健旺，不遵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":953,"lineType":1,"content":"禮法而行，冠帶互逢，定是風聲之醜。廻眸倒挿，泛水桃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":954,"lineType":1,"content":"花，沐浴裸形，螟蛉重見，多為婢妾娼尼，少有三貞九烈，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"雙魚雙女號滛星，不宜多犯官星。七煞曰夫主，忌見重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":956,"lineType":1,"content":"逢，寅申互見性荒唐，己亥相逢心不已。或有傷官之位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506337649770546"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"不逺嫁定見尅夫；重臨梟印之神，匪生離終須死别。四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":960,"lineType":1,"content":"柱有官鬼入墓，使夫星已入黄泉；歲運臨夫絶之宫，俾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"鴛配分飛異路。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":962,"lineType":2,"content":"又云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":962,"lineType":1,"content":"欲觀女命，先看官星。官帶煞而貧賤，官得令以安","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"榮。傷官太重必妨夫，且是為人性重。倒食重逢須减福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":964,"lineType":1,"content":"那堪更犯孤神。煞重須從貴室，合多定損貞名。坐禄乘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"轝而穏重，逢衝遇馬以輕浮。桃花浪滚，滛奔之恥不堪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":966,"lineType":1,"content":"言；日禄歸時，貴重人欽尤堪羡。天月二德以為本命，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506341584044066"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":969,"lineType":1,"content":"逢印綬，貴當兩國之封。時日羊刃，本是剛神，不利夫宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":970,"lineType":1,"content":"損壞平生之性。時犯金神健旺，要觀八字之强。專食子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":971,"lineType":1,"content":"榮，切忌偏印，守閨門而正靜；必由隂日得中和代夫壻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":972,"lineType":1,"content":"以經營，此乃陽干支旺甚。欣逢正禄，怕犯咸池。清秀得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":973,"lineType":1,"content":"長生之輔，濁雜值暴敗之歸。四柱敗多，大忌衝身而逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":974,"lineType":1,"content":"合；一生忙甚，若是非妓即為媒。印重與公姑相妬，食專","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"得子息之宜。官煞重逢，須防滛亂；娣妹透出，便是爭夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":976,"lineType":1,"content":"魁罡有靈變之機，日貴得安常之福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506293823782947"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":979,"lineType":2,"content":"又云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"若觀女命，則異乎男。富貴者一生官旺，純粹者四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":980,"lineType":1,"content":"柱休囚，濁濫者五行衝旺，娼滛者官煞交差。無官多合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"此為不良；滿柱煞多，不為尅制。印綬多而老無子，傷官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":982,"lineType":1,"content":"旺而㓜傷夫。四柱不見夫星，未為貞潔；五行多遇子曜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":983,"lineType":1,"content":"難免荒滛。食神一位逢生旺，招子須當拜聖明。官煞不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":984,"lineType":1,"content":"雜遇印扶，嫁夫定知登雲路，守寒房而清潔。金猪木虎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"相逢，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":985,"lineType":2,"content":"此二日雖尅夫而守正。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"對空帳而孤眠。土猴火蛇相遇，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":985,"lineType":2,"content":"此二日尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":986,"lineType":2,"content":"夫不正。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":986,"lineType":1,"content":"財旺生官，輔食無傷，而夫榮子貴。官食禄旺，一印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506302518575104"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":989,"lineType":1,"content":"有助，而后寵妃褒。傷官叠見，無財印，敗室刑夫。官煞重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":990,"lineType":1,"content":"逢遇三合，荒滛無恥。合多官重，貪滛好色之人，官雜氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"衰，嗜慾刑夫之妾。身旺官囚，非師尼而為娼婢。食神變","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":992,"lineType":1,"content":"德，先貧賤而後榮華。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":993,"lineType":2,"content":"口訣","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_54","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":993,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":993,"lineType":1,"content":"凡論女命，只用月支中財官印三件為竒。第一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":994,"lineType":1,"content":"論印，無財損印，如得天月二德在日干上者，决主此婦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"得父母家資財，福德廣盛，為人溫厚，逢凶不凶，招名望","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":996,"lineType":1,"content":"之夫，生賢貴之子，受封之命。歲運同論休咎，忌財喜官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506337679196201"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"第二論官，亦看何支中所藏一位為竒，一忌官多，二忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":1000,"lineType":1,"content":"傷重，三忌帶合，四忌煞混，五忌日主柔弱。除此五忌外，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"畧要些小微財，决主此婦生於富貴之家，夫富子賢，並","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":1002,"lineType":1,"content":"無尅剥之患，為人精明伶俐，尊重有福。第三論財，取月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":1003,"lineType":1,"content":"支中為要，財不宜多，只宜一位，畧得歲中一位官星。此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":1004,"lineType":1,"content":"命招父母力氣，得見成金寳之福，益夫益子，善於持家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"除此三格外，以下一十五格，皆非婦命所宜。葢十五格","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":1006,"lineType":1,"content":"莫非傷官，七煞羊刃建禄，衝動遥合，多無官星，有傷財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506341584011298"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":1009,"lineType":1,"content":"印，所以不取。婦人用官星為夫，見傷官為傷夫，用生出","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":1010,"lineType":1,"content":"為子，如甲日生人屬木，用丙丁巳午寅戌為子，火得時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"令，便作多子之命言之。火臨墓絶之地，或臨水局，壬癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":1012,"lineType":1,"content":"相尅，方斷無子。若火居絶墓之地，四柱有衝，晚年得嗣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"終不為孤。又六壬日壬寅時，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":1013,"lineType":2,"content":"三命","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_55","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":1013,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":1013,"lineType":1,"content":"陽干産陽為子，産","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":1014,"lineType":1,"content":"隂為女，隂干産隂為子，陽為女。寅乃木之分野，甲木臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"官之地，當生榮貴福夀之兒。若木在午未申酉之時，火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":1016,"lineType":1,"content":"土分野，木墓死絶之地，主子息寡少，縱有亦多貧疾，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506308612751398"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"然僧道過房螟蛉之類。又乙木生人，用庚為夫，庚用丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":1020,"lineType":1,"content":"為官星，丁却為乙，食神即子星也。丁生旺得時，即夫之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"名分，是取食旺相，官明朗，不但夫榮，亦且子貴，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":1022,"lineType":1,"content":"推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":1023,"lineType":2,"content":"又云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":1023,"lineType":1,"content":"女人之命，見七煞即為偏夫，因㑹正官，偏正交集，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":1024,"lineType":1,"content":"所以不喜。若偏官只一位柱，有制伏，無滛亂之説，但主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":1025,"lineType":1,"content":"欺夫奪權，㑹持家性剛。若日主健旺，或背禄，或月時無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":1026,"lineType":1,"content":"所倚，或夫星死絶，或孤神六害，多出家師姑之命，不然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId": {"lines":[{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":1074,"lineType":1,"content":"凡女命怕臨官帝旺，全主夫妻相傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":1074,"lineType":2,"content":"源髓歌","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_59","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":1074,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":1074,"lineType":1,"content":"臨官帝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"旺未為好，再嫁重婚傷亦早。若逢相敵作夫妻，頭男頭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":1076,"lineType":1,"content":"女當見天。若犯羊刃及朝元羊刃，皆主産厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":1076,"lineType":2,"content":"源髓歌","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_60","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":1076,"lineType":2,"content":"曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506337888829455"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":1079,"lineType":1,"content":"或時藏刃入於胎日，刃或朝時上來。更若支干相尅刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":1080,"lineType":1,"content":"妻，身當産姙憂灾。此言夫命犯之，當主妻有産厄。婦人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":1081,"lineType":1,"content":"之命若如此敢斷，定憂生産厄。更加卯酉二時生，若免","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":1082,"lineType":1,"content":"墮胎應尅子。所謂朝元羊刃者，喻如卯年生人，見甲日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":1083,"lineType":1,"content":"與甲時之類，或辰日而時干見乙，皆謂之朝元羊刃。餘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":1084,"lineType":1,"content":"倣此推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":1085,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"凡女命以年為翁父，胎為婆母，月為妯娌，日為夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":1086,"lineType":1,"content":"己身，時為子孫。女命是子午卯酉日生，合嫁子午卯酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506296948539427"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":1089,"lineType":1,"content":"命夫，四孟四季日亦同。若嫁日干合，或支神三合六合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":1090,"lineType":1,"content":"者，俱不諧老。四柱宜納音上尅下，主有殊福。不宜下尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":1091,"lineType":1,"content":"上，主欺詐僣越。若年之納音尅時之納音，不宜子若尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":1092,"lineType":1,"content":"戰刑破，主少子多女。若絶中有生，旺中有死，空亡中有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":1093,"lineType":1,"content":"破，五行無情乃吉，刑衝無情為上，只無情次之。日坐年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":1094,"lineType":1,"content":"禄榮神者，郡國之封，日帶夫禄，仍有實庫次之。榮神，春","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙、夏丙丁之例。若生中有絶，死中有旺，空亡有合，更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":1096,"lineType":1,"content":"犯孤寡元辰者賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506344234844214"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":1099,"lineType":1,"content":"凡女命印若虛，庫要實，五行恬靜無情，不相帶惹，為上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":1100,"lineType":1,"content":"等清㢘之格。若貴人天月德，日上有官，主賢淑，大忌禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"衰身旺，日在冠帶，臨官帝旺為不吉。一云庫要虛，貴要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":1102,"lineType":1,"content":"不落空，印有氣則奪夫權，庫有氣則蓄夫財，不戰爭，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"情理則無妬忌。奴婢宫有浮沉煞，主打死奴婢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":1104,"lineType":1,"content":"凡女命生日在官鬼死墓絶上，主尅夫。若官鬼落空亡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"或日落空亡，又生日無氣者，主無夫，縱有如無，帶旺氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":1106,"lineType":1,"content":"刑煞者，尅夫下賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":1106,"lineType":2,"content":"古歌云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":1106,"lineType":1,"content":"五行夫位落空亡，更值身低","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506349280575528"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"豈有郎。不是風塵須婢妾，縱有卑夫身亦娼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":1109,"lineType":2,"content":"天壁云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"納","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":1110,"lineType":1,"content":"音金命火為夫，重重臨寡又臨孤。戌亥二官夫死絶，徒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"然出嫁是塲虛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":1112,"lineType":1,"content":"凡女命，生年生日同一位者尅夫，嫁同音同年者庶幾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":1113,"lineType":1,"content":"生年生日帶六甲者，名曰帶甲，主尅夫。月共日俱帶者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":1114,"lineType":1,"content":"亦然。如甲午年生，再遇甲午日，十有九尅夫，謂之金神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":1115,"lineType":1,"content":"帶甲，此例尤𦂳。若生日帶旺氣，如丙子、庚子、戊午、癸酉、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":1116,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯等日，名曰承旺，夫不下賤，多尅夫。若帶十分福德，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506337679294505"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"則是内人，五六分則貴官，左右三五分則近貴，上游娼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":1120,"lineType":1,"content":"次則尼妾，甚者尅夫滛蕩。或曰，戊午多貴，癸酉、辛卯次","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"之，丙子、庚子下賤。又云，戊午、癸酉、辛卯，大美小疵。若壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":1122,"lineType":1,"content":"癸生人，見丙子癸亥申子辰人，重重見壬癸，名曰流水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，主下賤不貞潔。多水而無土，主滛。多火而無水，主滛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":1124,"lineType":1,"content":"犯八專胎月日時，主滛亂及虚勞之疾。犯九醜多者，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"滛蕩及産厄惡死。犯沐浴咸池，乃酒色神，主滛亂。犯十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":1126,"lineType":1,"content":"惡大敗，主滛惡破家。犯桃花刼者，主少入娼門，老為貧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506341584060450"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"丐。寅午戌生人在冬三月亥時，巳酉丑生人在春三月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":1130,"lineType":1,"content":"寅時，申子辰生人在夏三月巳時，亥卯未生人在秋三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"月申時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":1131,"lineType":2,"content":"古詩云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花與刼兩相侵，不為盗賊犯姦滛，忽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":1132,"lineType":1,"content":"然女子遭逢着，少入娼門老至貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":1133,"lineType":1,"content":"凡女命合多更帶貴人，是上游官妓，不然貴人左右。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":1134,"lineType":1,"content":"生日無氣，却坐貴人。四柱有天月德，或日禄歸時，主賤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":1135,"lineType":1,"content":"中生貴子，或有因而受封者，福在日時故也。其始終下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":1136,"lineType":1,"content":"賤，多是咸池自敗，大耗天中凌尅，刑衝氣散，自刑帶煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506326757244940"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":1139,"lineType":1,"content":"為性塵賤滛蕩，縱有貴格，亦有風聲。魁罡交衝，多狠戾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":1140,"lineType":1,"content":"不順，或飄蕩。生旺太過，中見刼煞往來相衝，為性多烈，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":1141,"lineType":1,"content":"不睦六親，却清貞不滛，動招患禍。若咸池與大耗同宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":1142,"lineType":1,"content":"則滛媚讒毒。天中與暴敗相承，則情性多訛，招滛私玷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1362","lineNum":1143,"lineType":1,"content":"辱，更刑衝，必主滛私官事發覺。日時上死絶帶煞，主貧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1363","lineNum":1144,"lineType":1,"content":"困下賤，或自營於街市，風塵庸劣之婦，見無禮刑。或天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1364","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"中印，或合墓中大耗者，多是媒巫術藥之軰。中有建禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1365","lineNum":1146,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人者，市㕓牙販狼藉婦人也。若生日帶大耗咸池，夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1366","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506337679343657"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1367","lineNum":1149,"lineType":1,"content":"妻外心相撓，見官符多適凶暴俗惡之夫，棄逐凌辱，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1368","lineNum":1150,"lineType":1,"content":"即妨尅於夫，一生因夫煩惱。生時帶刼煞、大耗、空亡者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1369","lineNum":1151,"lineType":1,"content":"生子少成，憂煎為撓，或生悖逆之子，見咸池，多損孕。日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1370","lineNum":1152,"lineType":1,"content":"時犯勾絞，有繫絆意，多難産，或子掛綆。生歲運見大耗，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1371","lineNum":1153,"lineType":1,"content":"為凶，夫子不祥之撓，更或尅身，往往死矣。八數者，隂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1372","lineNum":1154,"lineType":1,"content":"終，所以大凶。若日時犯華葢正印，主無夫無子，亦有臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1373","lineNum":1155,"lineType":1,"content":"終年尅盡，犯刑害空亡、衝破、飛刃、陽刃、刼亡、破碎、大敗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1374","lineNum":1156,"lineType":1,"content":"等煞，主尅夫害子。更以五行加减輕重言之，有一生不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1375","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506312714911781"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1376","lineNum":1159,"lineType":1,"content":"産兒女，或多損胎，亦有不嫁者，縱有兒女，多不和孝。犯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1377","lineNum":1160,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡、元辰、咸池、華葢攀鞍，乃惡婦人也，主尅夫少子，多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1378","lineNum":1161,"lineType":1,"content":"病妬忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1379","lineNum":1162,"lineType":1,"content":"凡女命帶六箇自刃日時，主無夫無子，便是十分好命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1380","lineNum":1163,"lineType":1,"content":"也。須有尅犯羊刃及朝元羊刃多主産厄，月經過多之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1381","lineNum":1164,"lineType":1,"content":"疾，中年後主冷病。犯卯酉多主墮胎尅子，脇疼血刺。四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1382","lineNum":1165,"lineType":1,"content":"柱俱陽不生男，俱隂不生女。時是陽干，頭胎多生男。是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1383","lineNum":1166,"lineType":1,"content":"隂干，頭胎多生女。是仲，主生仲子。孟季同帶寅申巳亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1384","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506337679310889"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1385","lineNum":1169,"lineType":1,"content":"多者，主雙生。亥字多者，雙生男。巳字多者，雙生女。有三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":1170,"lineType":1,"content":"年一胎，二年一胎，一年一胎者，皆以時之納音，取水一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":1171,"lineType":1,"content":"火二木三金四土五之數驗。仍以日時納音，定夫子之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":1172,"lineType":1,"content":"數。犯火氣多者，主一世不生長。五行燥氣同犯返伏吟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":1173,"lineType":1,"content":"時，不利子，中年縱有晚年，必退伏。寅日主尅夫，惟同歲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":1174,"lineType":1,"content":"者方可免。月是伏吟，不宜妯娌娣妹。胎是伏吟，不利骨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1391","lineNum":1175,"lineType":1,"content":"肉。返吟同此論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1392","lineNum":1176,"lineType":1,"content":"凡女命欲得恬和，中有貴格，更帶祿馬貴人，自生自旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1393","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506326757261324"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1394","lineNum":1179,"lineType":1,"content":"六合者，主性巧賢德，姿貌殊麗。不可傷於太盛，恐乏柔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1395","lineNum":1180,"lineType":1,"content":"順，不可過於死絶，則滛媚而性卑。苟得五行恬和，又𦂳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1396","lineNum":1181,"lineType":1,"content":"要福氣聚集於日時上乃佳。葢日為夫，時為子，一切福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1397","lineNum":1182,"lineType":1,"content":"神加於日時上，須因夫子而貴。女人之福，在夫與子，當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1398","lineNum":1183,"lineType":1,"content":"重封貴號，早適賢夫。若日時二位福力不𦂳，乃常命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1399","lineNum":1184,"lineType":1,"content":"如福聚月胎之上，只是生於富貴之家，終不為夫之福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1400","lineNum":1185,"lineType":1,"content":"凡女命最喜金轝，六合自旺，則福厚而利骨肉。見印綬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1401","lineNum":1186,"lineType":1,"content":"禄鬼，或水火既濟，或金水相生，姿質美麗，自生自旺。帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1402","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506337679360041"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1403","lineNum":1189,"lineType":1,"content":"官符，或五行支干不相，徃來無情，内政清白，嚴毅有守，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1404","lineNum":1190,"lineType":1,"content":"不喜滛雜。若禄死絶，則儉素不華。印綬帶煞，則權能任","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1405","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"重。六合相生，則骨肉茂盛，周全和美。時上見貴人驛馬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1406","lineNum":1192,"lineType":1,"content":"多生賢孝之子，孕産無虞。日上見之，得賢美聰明之夫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1407","lineNum":1193,"lineType":1,"content":"一生快樂。夫負隂抱陽者為男，負陽抱隂者為女。是以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1408","lineNum":1194,"lineType":1,"content":"男命生則利旺不利衰，女命生則利衰不利旺。男旺則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1409","lineNum":1195,"lineType":1,"content":"福衰則否，女衰則福旺則否。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1410","lineNum":1196,"lineType":2,"content":"古歌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":1196,"lineType":1,"content":"財官印綬三般物，女命逢之必旺。夫不犯煞，多無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506308612800550"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1413","lineNum":1199,"lineType":1,"content":"混雜，身强制伏有稱呼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1414","lineNum":1200,"lineType":1,"content":"女命傷官福不真，無財無印守孤貧。局中若見傷官透，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1415","lineNum":1201,"lineType":1,"content":"必作堂前使喚人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1416","lineNum":1202,"lineType":1,"content":"有夫帶合還須正，有合無夫定是偏。官煞犯重成下格，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1417","lineNum":1203,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官重合不須言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1418","lineNum":1204,"lineType":1,"content":"官帶桃花福夀長，桃花帶煞少禎祥。合多最忌桃花犯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1419","lineNum":1205,"lineType":1,"content":"比刼桃花大不良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":1206,"lineType":1,"content":"女命傷官格内嫌，帶財帶印福方堅。傷官旺處傷夫主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506350446657546"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":1209,"lineType":1,"content":"破了傷官損夀元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1423","lineNum":1210,"lineType":1,"content":"飛天禄馬井欄义，女命逢之最不佳。只好為偏併作妓，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1424","lineNum":1211,"lineType":1,"content":"有財方可享榮華。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1425","lineNum":1212,"lineType":1,"content":"眉拖翠栁臉如花，禄馬長生貴氣賖。紫木太陽臨四正，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1426","lineNum":1213,"lineType":1,"content":"益夫䕃子㑹持家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1427","lineNum":1214,"lineType":2,"content":"禄馬㑹於長生，或帶墓庫及一重貴，所謂馬上禄馬貴人時，子貴夫榮貌必竒是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1428","lineNum":1215,"lineType":1,"content":"一重亡刼及逢羊，天乙同生禄馬鄉。色絶過人貞且潔，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1429","lineNum":1216,"lineType":1,"content":"榮夫益子熾而昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1430","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506344234926134"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1431","lineNum":1219,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬多逢無禮刑，臨官帝旺更惱人。柱中再有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1432","lineNum":1219,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_61","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1433","lineNum":1219,"lineType":1,"content":"遇，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1434","lineNum":1220,"lineType":1,"content":"此等佳人不要尋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1435","lineNum":1221,"lineType":1,"content":"亡刼孤刑寡隔雙，平頭華葢一般詳。寳香薰被成孤宿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1436","lineNum":1222,"lineType":1,"content":"忍對珠簾月半床。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1437","lineNum":1223,"lineType":2,"content":"亡神刼煞、孤辰寡宿、隔角平頭、雙辰華葢，六害三刑，所謂切忌五行神煞重是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
