{"lines":[{"lineId":"1438","lineNum":1224,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃刼亡休合動，合動髙堂雲雨夢。合貴合馬合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1439","lineNum":1224,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_62","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1440","lineNum":1224,"lineType":1,"content":"，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1441","lineNum":1225,"lineType":1,"content":"必定其人假尊重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1442","lineNum":1225,"lineType":2,"content":"如庚申、己丑、丁亥、壬寅是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1443","lineNum":1226,"lineType":1,"content":"生月那堪合上宫，更兼時合衆凶同。外容尊重非真實，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1444","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506326757277708"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1445","lineNum":1229,"lineType":1,"content":"内亂尤妨不善終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1446","lineNum":1229,"lineType":2,"content":"如乙亥、甲申、己巳、乙亥是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1447","lineNum":1230,"lineType":1,"content":"命值咸池洗日星，為人性巧更多能。男人得此多相識，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1448","lineNum":1231,"lineType":1,"content":"女子逢之犯衆僧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1449","lineNum":1232,"lineType":1,"content":"上宫切忌帶廉貞，已不淫兮妻必淫。設使夫妻皆正大，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1450","lineNum":1233,"lineType":1,"content":"官事因妻及女人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1451","lineNum":1233,"lineType":2,"content":"上宫日干所坐是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1452","lineNum":1234,"lineType":1,"content":"女子咸池日上加，聰明守義不奸邪。却愁夫婿多顛倒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1453","lineNum":1235,"lineType":1,"content":"賭博呼遊也破家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1454","lineNum":1236,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲戌、乙亥、乙卯、丁亥，有丁亥之旺土，制乙卯之敗水，却生大族，自己不淫，其夫遊蕩破家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1455","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506344234909750"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1456","lineNum":1239,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池一煞最乖戾，尅我生我皆不利。比和也是賤星名，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1457","lineNum":1240,"lineType":1,"content":"好色貪財難致貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1458","lineNum":1241,"lineType":2,"content":"如癸酉、己未、丙午、庚寅，自貪色，妻亦淫，又甲戌、癸卯日者，夫多學無成，淫蕩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1459","lineNum":1242,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池盡道主淫邪，須看其中有淺深。有制尅他方作福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1460","lineNum":1243,"lineType":1,"content":"惺惺不得衆人情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1461","lineNum":1244,"lineType":1,"content":"孛與桃花四正臨，那堪驛馬更同音。巧言令色難和衆，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1462","lineNum":1245,"lineType":1,"content":"小智奸邪枉用心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1463","lineNum":1246,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子重逢不可當，公姑妯娌致参商。男子丈母應重拜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1464","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506350446608394"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1465","lineNum":1249,"lineType":1,"content":"方免妻家敗一塲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1466","lineNum":1250,"lineType":1,"content":"上宫亡刼更刑衝，男女逢之一例凶。寳月修真非一度，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1467","lineNum":1251,"lineType":1,"content":"朱絃再續必重逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1468","lineNum":1251,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲子、丙寅、己巳、丁卯，再醮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1469","lineNum":1252,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃亡刼落上宫，尅妻生病最為凶。進神若也同來到，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1470","lineNum":1253,"lineType":1,"content":"死别生離疾似風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1471","lineNum":1254,"lineType":1,"content":"孤寡雙辰併隔宿，時日逢之刑骨肉。假子招郎何足言，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1472","lineNum":1255,"lineType":1,"content":"仍忌男女遭恥辱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1473","lineNum":1255,"lineType":2,"content":"如丁未、戊申、戊申、丙辰，其男為盗，其女淫奔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":1256,"lineType":1,"content":"女人羊刃不宜多，合尅羅紋帶倒戈。禍起蕭墻流粉黛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506337679376425"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":1259,"lineType":1,"content":"華容難避馬嵬坡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1477","lineNum":1260,"lineType":2,"content":"如丙戌、壬辰、戊午、壬子，因訟奔出，流落風塵。又戊午、己卯、癸未、戊午，是合羊刃，竟凶死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1478","lineNum":1261,"lineType":1,"content":"一重羊刃為權柄，三兩重來凶最甚。荒淫奸妬多為娼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1479","lineNum":1262,"lineType":1,"content":"凶暴惡亡仍短命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1480","lineNum":1263,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人亡刼最非祥，時日逢之性必剛。死絶常多兼尅主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1481","lineNum":1264,"lineType":1,"content":"合起相生亦禍殃。妯娌公姑皆寡合，官司内起醜聲揚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":1265,"lineType":1,"content":"年月日時分戰降，命宫全帶喜風光。男如崔子尋花栁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":1266,"lineType":1,"content":"女似楊妃睡海棠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":1266,"lineType":2,"content":"子午卯酉全帶准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506350446641162"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":1269,"lineType":1,"content":"女人天乙兩三重，多貴番成吉作凶。絃管叢中為活計，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":1270,"lineType":1,"content":"死絶休囚又不同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":1271,"lineType":1,"content":"一座貴人為好命，兩座貴人心不定。三座貴人定作娼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":1272,"lineType":1,"content":"晚年或作豪家正。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":1273,"lineType":2,"content":"如丙子、己亥、己亥、乙亥，娼也。又丁酉、辛亥、己亥、乙亥，年過不嫁，老而無子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":1274,"lineType":1,"content":"色因傾國是登明，期我桑中太乙星。驛馬更兼逢六合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":1275,"lineType":1,"content":"一生不免有淫聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1493","lineNum":1275,"lineType":2,"content":"如乙亥、甲申、己巳、乙亥有色而淫，死三夫，又犯服内之奸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1494","lineNum":1276,"lineType":1,"content":"紫木羅陽四正排，貴人兼印煞衝開。夫榮子貴人端厚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1495","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506308612882470"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1496","lineNum":1279,"lineType":1,"content":"兩國誥封天上來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1497","lineNum":1280,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬咸池夾貴來，太陽紫木併三台。聰明性巧人和順，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1498","lineNum":1281,"lineType":1,"content":"卷耳","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_63","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1499","lineNum":1281,"lineType":1,"content":"情懷栁絮才。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1500","lineNum":1282,"lineType":1,"content":"牡丹自古號花王，占斷風流艶一方。堪笑好花難結子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1501","lineNum":1283,"lineType":1,"content":"年年虚度好時光。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1502","lineNum":1284,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人禄馬定分毫，時上逢之産鳳毛。卓犖英豪皆異衆，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1503","lineNum":1285,"lineType":1,"content":"惟岐惟嶷福堅牢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1504","lineNum":1286,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人禄馬在生時，定主多男有白眉。或有乾生來凑足，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1505","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506350446690314"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1506","lineNum":1289,"lineType":1,"content":"増光宗祖好男兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1507","lineNum":1290,"lineType":1,"content":"五行恬澹福星臨，重厚溫恭必至誠。天使嘍囉無半㸃，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1508","lineNum":1291,"lineType":1,"content":"却交頑福重千斤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1509","lineNum":1292,"lineType":1,"content":"滿盤印綬得夫星，運向夫行子息生。造化夫星無刼奪，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1510","lineNum":1293,"lineType":1,"content":"興夫旺子兩宜情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":1294,"lineType":2,"content":"印綬多，主無子，運行財官，子息反多，隂干梟印重，亦莫言無子，行洩尅之運，亦主子多而秀。如癸未、癸亥、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":1295,"lineType":2,"content":"乙酉、癸未，此命行南方火土運，財食之地，以財制梟，食神無損，生七子顯達，夫妻偕老。一命壬午時，亦生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":1296,"lineType":2,"content":"五子，刑夫失節。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506350446624778"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":1299,"lineType":1,"content":"雜氣格中禄最佳，干頭便混也堪誇。運行財地無傷刼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":1300,"lineType":1,"content":"嫁得才郎享福遐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":1300,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙丑月之例，俱藏夫星干頭，不忌混雜，此以月言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":1301,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰壬戌坐中夫，庚戌庚寅亦自殊。壬午甲申戊寅日，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":1302,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人得此福偏俱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":1303,"lineType":2,"content":"此數日坐下夫星，只宜一位為福，此以日言也。一命庚申、己丑、庚寅、庚辰大富，八子夀五十餘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":1304,"lineType":1,"content":"丙庚子午各分推，己土偏於卯未宜。乙日更堪己酉丑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"癸臨巳未亦當時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":1305,"lineType":2,"content":"此數日亦坐下夫星，不宜破支，獨見乃吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":1306,"lineType":1,"content":"煞星獨印格中清，身主清髙富貴成。不有官星來混格，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506308612866086"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":1309,"lineType":1,"content":"號封恭淑重呼名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":1310,"lineType":2,"content":"女命煞印最吉，如上己卯、己未、癸丑、乙丑、乙酉、癸未、辛未、甲申、庚寅、戊寅、壬戌、壬辰、丙寅等日，不宜再混","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":1311,"lineType":2,"content":"夫星為貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":1312,"lineType":1,"content":"五行婦女要身衰，若遇剛强灾病來。歲運再行身旺地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":1313,"lineType":1,"content":"花前風雨恨相摧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":1313,"lineType":2,"content":"五隂日，宜弱强，多生灾。行建禄㑹旺地柱無官煞傷夫害子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":1314,"lineType":1,"content":"孤鸞日犯本無兒，一見官星得子竒。運遇旺鄉多姊妹，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":1315,"lineType":1,"content":"臨風惆悵緑樓時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":1316,"lineType":2,"content":"孤鸞日，柱中若見官星，反得其子，隂日更好，不可混以無兒斷之。運行身旺及比肩爭奪真孤鸞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506349280690216"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":1319,"lineType":1,"content":"夫星得地子多餘，姊妹交加反是虚。財旺更逢兒位吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":1320,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官相見又如初。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":1321,"lineType":2,"content":"婦人以夫為主，夫星得時，必多子息，若見比肩分奪，反孤無子，故又喜財生之，再見傷官，又作初論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":1322,"lineType":1,"content":"一位夫星娣妹多，傷官歲運便難過。縱遇有夫也傷尅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":1323,"lineType":1,"content":"寒衾獨枕柰如何。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":1324,"lineType":2,"content":"官星只一位，是怕比肩分奪，况歲運又逢傷官，其害夫也必矣。若原是傷官格，柱中不見官無害怕行運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":1325,"lineType":2,"content":"見官戰鬪讐，傷尅夫無疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":1326,"lineType":1,"content":"格用傷官亦兩猜，若逢食旺益夫財。財星旺處生官旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506337888862223"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":1329,"lineType":1,"content":"無食無財印喜來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":1330,"lineType":2,"content":"傷官得時者無害，但怕旺印破用。食神為用，得時尤竒，却宜見印，但不宜印多，惟中則吉。一命癸未乙卯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":1331,"lineType":2,"content":"庚子庚辰，傷官用財嫁貴夫，受封一子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":1332,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人格局要清和，夫氣休囚困苦多。運逢財官重旺相，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":1333,"lineType":1,"content":"着羅衣錦笑呵呵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":1334,"lineType":2,"content":"假如辛日生子，酉月干頭虚見丙火，雖官無用，主巧而貧。再辛壬互見尅夫，若得行煞官及財運，生起火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":1335,"lineType":2,"content":"木則吉，餘照此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":1336,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官性重有權輿，比刼重逢禮不疎。印綬日尋清慎獨，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506337649819698"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":1339,"lineType":1,"content":"丁壬化合曉詩書。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":1339,"lineType":2,"content":"此言傷官性情乖覺女中丈夫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":1340,"lineType":1,"content":"金水相涵秀麗佳，比肩也作金水誇。丙逢壬制顔如玉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":1341,"lineType":1,"content":"甲逢金尅貌比花。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":1342,"lineType":2,"content":"金水涵秀，故多美貌，若壬尅丙，甲見金，一煞清獨，其貌亦美，性情亦静，混雜者淫賤貌亦醜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1559","lineNum":1343,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬生身遇煞良，傷官財旺坐髙堂。如行死絶陽肩墓，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1560","lineNum":1344,"lineType":1,"content":"獨守空閨哭子䘮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1561","lineNum":1345,"lineType":2,"content":"煞印相生，傷官生財，皆為上格。若行財煞死絶、陽刃比肩，及傷官入墓之地，傷夫尅子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1562","lineNum":1346,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽自旺日平常，身健無依未是良。運向夫鄉爭競起，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506363176288293"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":1349,"lineType":1,"content":"改容再醮補填房。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":1350,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花紅艶兩交差，頻向粧䑓理鬢斜。若有官星藏與透，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":1351,"lineType":1,"content":"却歸良室福無涯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":1351,"lineType":2,"content":"二煞不吉，婦人最忌，如見官星，則有倚頼，反主有福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":1352,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花與煞怕同途，官見桃花却旺夫。金水相逢雖貌美，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":1353,"lineType":1,"content":"無官貴室亦多汚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":1354,"lineType":2,"content":"官星桃花不害於良人，煞星桃花則多為娼婦。桃花之煞雖一，而逢官遇煞逈異。金水傷官無官煞，其志","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":1355,"lineType":2,"content":"不定。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":1356,"lineType":1,"content":"食神獨旺勝諸祥，金水傷官得火康。受氣不宜逢姐妹，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506349280739368"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":1359,"lineType":1,"content":"煞星一位便為良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":1360,"lineType":2,"content":"一食遇生旺金水，見火胞胎無比肩。煞星一位得時比數格，婦命遇之皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":1361,"lineType":1,"content":"官星得禄知夫貴，食遇臨官子便賢。福位青龍格煞食，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":1362,"lineType":1,"content":"驅奴使婢奪夫權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":1363,"lineType":2,"content":"如己遇甲，夫得寅月，甲食丙，嗣得巳月，主夫子俱好。若煞格食格用遇禄神，帶青龍福位者，主奪夫權，聰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":1364,"lineType":2,"content":"明標致。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":1365,"lineType":1,"content":"食神暗合乙夫來，食旺無淆富貴胎。透出財星分等第，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":1366,"lineType":1,"content":"梟煞合處起疑猜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506349280706600"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":1369,"lineType":2,"content":"食神不宜財輕，又不宜太過，清者第一，見官次之，梟煞相見不吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":1370,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚夏月正金疲，運向西方夫得時。丙子不來金水好，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":1371,"lineType":1,"content":"東方遇乙貴分之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":1372,"lineType":2,"content":"乙以庚為夫，夏月金失時，行西扶起為吉，見丙傷庚，見乙爭合，故皆不喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":1373,"lineType":1,"content":"辛官金水月夫輕，再遇辛壬兩度新。運行木火難勝福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":1374,"lineType":1,"content":"不傷自己也傷人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":1375,"lineType":2,"content":"辛干以丙為官，辛生秋冬，遇丙則輕，時又見辛壬分尅，則丙愈輕。運行火木，夫雖得時，恐不勝其福，未免","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":1376,"lineType":2,"content":"傷人害己。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506349280804904"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":1379,"lineType":1,"content":"巳夫秋甲暗傷支，乙見干頭兩度期。除是東方逢木旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":1380,"lineType":1,"content":"擊傷金木又交持。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1594","lineNum":1381,"lineType":2,"content":"己秋月遇甲夫，支有傷官為害，再見乙未，去彼從此，乃甲與己合，被乙戰尅，不能就官，而從煞主，兩度成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1595","lineNum":1382,"lineType":2,"content":"婚。行東方木旺之地，有火驅金，雖好亦不免傷夫再嫁，或多寡居。辛未、甲午、己未、甲戌王妃。丙午、辛丑、己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1596","lineNum":1383,"lineType":2,"content":"未、甲子、子進士，女王妃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1597","lineNum":1384,"lineType":1,"content":"庚夫金水月逢丁，壬丙干頭兩見爭。富貴春風衾枕冷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1598","lineNum":1385,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官支上怕分情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1599","lineNum":1386,"lineType":2,"content":"庚以丁為官，秋冬遇壬，金水得時，乃前夫被尅，又從丙火，若丙戌時其夫入墓，子時其夫被傷，雖居富貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1600","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506350446706698"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1601","lineNum":1389,"lineType":2,"content":"終是寡居子亦少。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1602","lineNum":1390,"lineType":1,"content":"甲夫己午及寅宮，遇丙合辛被火鎔。身旺食神家富足，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1603","lineNum":1391,"lineType":1,"content":"獨眠孤枕怨春風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1604","lineNum":1392,"lineType":2,"content":"甲日以辛為夫，辛生春夏，失時，又遇丙火，難以吉論。葢婦人以夫為主，官既受害，雖財食嬴餘，不免傷夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1605","lineNum":1393,"lineType":2,"content":"若柱無辛，見丙丁，運行見辛亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1606","lineNum":1394,"lineType":1,"content":"丙夫夏癸月藏傷，若遇庚辛西地祥。木火透干能泄水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1607","lineNum":1395,"lineType":1,"content":"夫財雖旺發難長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1608","lineNum":1396,"lineType":2,"content":"丙干以癸為夫，夏月癸水休囚，内藏土為傷官，如不透戊己，得辛金佐之，運行西吉，柱有木火，泄竊癸氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1609","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506341584093218"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1610","lineNum":1399,"lineType":2,"content":"終是不久。不見癸，用食神更吉，傷見則非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1611","lineNum":1400,"lineType":1,"content":"癸水生於寅卯月，合戊經行南地宜。只恐干中明見甲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1612","lineNum":1401,"lineType":1,"content":"自憐衾枕與誰依。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1613","lineNum":1402,"lineType":2,"content":"癸日生春，遇戌為夫，行南方及申地，不為利害。若甲透及癸，分奪便傷夫不見戊，但見甲，行至戊運亦如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1614","lineNum":1403,"lineType":2,"content":"之。若原無戌，用食神傷官，行火地皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1615","lineNum":1404,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸如生季月中，夏間土旺亦論同。不宜寅甲連相見，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1616","lineNum":1405,"lineType":1,"content":"重犯作傷反無功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1617","lineNum":1406,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸生辰戌丑未月，及夏中伏夫星，得時最吉，但不宜太過。若寅甲並見食神，重犯作傷官論，单見甲或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1618","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506349280772136"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1619","lineNum":1409,"lineType":2,"content":"寅，則吉。一命庚辰、癸未、癸酉、戊午，嫁富貴俊雅之夫，生四子受封。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1620","lineNum":1410,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙秋生夫正時，煞官若混細分之。舒配去留成格吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1621","lineNum":1411,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丙引强困乂離。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1622","lineNum":1412,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙用金為夫星，庚辛秋令得時，若官煞重見，分配去留，不相混雜，聰明富貴。見丁丙重時引强地，則又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1623","lineNum":1413,"lineType":2,"content":"傷金為害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1624","lineNum":1414,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己春生木正青，煞官多處便為情。支干遇合方成吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1625","lineNum":1415,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹水重金又一評。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1626","lineNum":1416,"lineType":2,"content":"戊己春生有二論，己日雖官煞混雜，有甲合為貴，戊日宜清乃貴，都利煞為用，皆怕金，水多，水渗其土，金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1627","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506363176304677"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1628","lineNum":1419,"lineType":2,"content":"多害木，行南運不忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1629","lineNum":1420,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛夏月丙丁藏，不透干頭便是良。只恐煞官交互見，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1630","lineNum":1421,"lineType":1,"content":"非為不吉也爭强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1631","lineNum":1422,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辛己未月，或寅卯戌月，俱有財官，不宜。丙丁多透煞官，混雜相傷，二丙一辛爭合，俱為不吉，葢金生春","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1632","lineNum":1423,"lineType":2,"content":"夏，已失之柔，再透則太過故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1633","lineNum":1424,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁冬月與秋同，獨遇為竒亂則空。煞正官清居富貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1634","lineNum":1425,"lineType":1,"content":"不堪混雜日臨凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1635","lineNum":1426,"lineType":2,"content":"水，冬旺秋相。丙丁生秋冬，夫星得地，官煞皆美。見官只論官，見煞只論煞，不宜混雜，清者富貴，亂者濁淫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1636","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506363176321061"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1637","lineNum":1429,"lineType":1,"content":"財旺生官格最稀，財官相遇十分竒。夫榮子貴因財旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1638","lineNum":1430,"lineType":1,"content":"貞潔賢良五福宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1639","lineNum":1431,"lineType":2,"content":"一命丁丑、癸丑、己未、甲子嫁貴夫，三子受封夀不永。一命丁酉、癸丑、己巳、甲子，受封生子，與上大同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1640","lineNum":1432,"lineType":2,"content":"總歌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1641","lineNum":1432,"lineType":1,"content":"正氣官星第一格，財官兩旺亦同説。官星帶合兼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1642","lineNum":1433,"lineType":1,"content":"坐禄，女命逢之真有福。官星桃花是良人，帶合兼煞便","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1643","lineNum":1434,"lineType":1,"content":"不同。印綬天德惟最妙，日貴財官亦相肖。獨煞有制羊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1644","lineNum":1435,"lineType":1,"content":"刃同，傷官生財亦不凶。歸禄逢財准此斷，食神生旺尤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1645","lineNum":1436,"lineType":1,"content":"堪羡。煞化印綬格局純，二德扶身貴無倫。三竒合局真","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1646","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506349280755752"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1647","lineNum":1439,"lineType":1,"content":"造化，拱禄拱貴也不怕。煞官混雜兼無制，此等女人不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1648","lineNum":1440,"lineType":1,"content":"堪娶。傷官太重又見官，貪財破印俱不堪。比肩重犯多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1649","lineNum":1441,"lineType":1,"content":"爭妬，財官遇刼决不富。財多身弱亦如然，羊刃衝刑尸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1650","lineNum":1442,"lineType":1,"content":"不全。金神帶刃凶惡斷，桃花帶合淫亂看。無官見合多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1651","lineNum":1443,"lineType":1,"content":"官合，倒揷桃花亂閨閣。身旺無依夫子傷，此等女人大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1652","lineNum":1444,"lineType":1,"content":"不祥。倒食重犯須减福，更犯寡宿主獨宿。孤鸞紅艶隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1653","lineNum":1445,"lineType":1,"content":"陽差，此等神煞俱不佳。若是貴命合官印，小小神煞不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1654","lineNum":1446,"lineType":1,"content":"為病。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1655","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506344235040822"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1656","lineNum":1449,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1657","lineNum":1449,"lineType":1,"content":"擇婦須沉靜，細説與君聼。夫星要強健，日干當柔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1658","lineNum":1450,"lineType":1,"content":"順。二德坐正財，富貴自然來。四柱帶休囚，增名又增夀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1659","lineNum":1451,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人一位正，兩三作寵娉。金水若相逢，必招美麗容。四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1660","lineNum":1452,"lineType":1,"content":"貴一位煞，權家富貴説。財官若藏庫，衝開無不富。寅申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1661","lineNum":1453,"lineType":1,"content":"巳亥全，孤淫腹便便，子午並卯酉，定是隨人走。辰戌兼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1662","lineNum":1454,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未，婦道必大忌。有辰怕見戌，有戌怕見辰。辰戌若相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1663","lineNum":1455,"lineType":1,"content":"見，多是淫破人。有煞不怕合，無煞却怕合。合神若是多，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1664","lineNum":1456,"lineType":1,"content":"非妓亦嘔歌。羊刃帶傷官，駁雜事多端。滿盤却是印，損","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1665","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506337888927759"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1666","lineNum":1459,"lineType":1,"content":"子必須定。天千一字連，孤破禍綿綿。地支連一字，兩度","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1667","lineNum":1460,"lineType":1,"content":"成婚事。此是婦命訣，千金莫輕視。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1668","lineNum":1461,"lineType":8,"content":"論小兒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1669","lineNum":1462,"lineType":1,"content":"夫觀小兒之命，如種花木之法。善培養者，則根苗茂盛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1670","lineNum":1463,"lineType":1,"content":"花菓興隆；不善培養者，反是。何以言之？凡人種花木，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1671","lineNum":1464,"lineType":1,"content":"以上栽培其根，根實則苗盛；必以水澆灌其體，體壯則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1672","lineNum":1465,"lineType":1,"content":"花茂。頼陽火温照其花，花實則菓成；假金刃修伐其枝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1673","lineNum":1466,"lineType":1,"content":"枝清則本固。設若土虚根淺，水少苖枯，日爆花焦，風摧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1674","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506344235024438"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1675","lineNum":1469,"lineType":1,"content":"菓落，是皆失中和培養之氣，其花木安有不枯之理乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1676","lineNum":1470,"lineType":1,"content":"人之八字，以年為根，月為苗，日為花，時為菓，其理皆然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1677","lineNum":1471,"lineType":1,"content":"故推小兒之命，要日千有氣，月令生扶，年上栽根，印綬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1678","lineNum":1472,"lineType":1,"content":"無傷，財官有制，七煞得化，傷官遇合，氣禀中和，不值刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1679","lineNum":1473,"lineType":1,"content":"衝破害，此則易養長夀之命。如煞重身輕，財多身弱，傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1680","lineNum":1474,"lineType":1,"content":"官叠遇，食神重逢，日干或旺甚無依，或太柔少印，氣失","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1681","lineNum":1475,"lineType":1,"content":"中和，柱中有刑衝破害，此則難養促夀之命。二者類如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1682","lineNum":1476,"lineType":1,"content":"栽培之法耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1683","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506344235057206"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1684","lineNum":1479,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1685","lineNum":1479,"lineType":1,"content":"小兒之命，當論時辰為正，先看關煞，次看格局。日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1686","lineNum":1480,"lineType":1,"content":"主强，財官旺，有關無煞。日主弱，財官少，常病易養。日千","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1687","lineNum":1481,"lineType":1,"content":"弱，財官多，有煞，有關難養。夫關者何也？即偏官為關，偏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1688","lineNum":1482,"lineType":1,"content":"財為煞，專以日干為主，取生成之數斷之。關者，譬如今","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1689","lineNum":1483,"lineType":1,"content":"之關隘，乃險阻之地，人至關，非明文不敢私渡，違者必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1690","lineNum":1484,"lineType":1,"content":"致其禍。小兒命犯此關，則為不利。柱中日干强健，制伏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1691","lineNum":1485,"lineType":1,"content":"純粹，印綬無傷，如有明文之類，通達順遂，易養長夀，反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1692","lineNum":1486,"lineType":1,"content":"之則否。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1693","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506349280854056"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1694","lineNum":1489,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1695","lineNum":1489,"lineType":1,"content":"古往今來，只有三命，有關最𦂳，不應者多。五星家","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1696","lineNum":1490,"lineType":1,"content":"有種關煞，猶三命關之説也。子平之關，只以煞論。假如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1697","lineNum":1491,"lineType":1,"content":"初生小兒，甲日者庚為關柱，有戊土黨煞，此為關重無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1698","lineNum":1492,"lineType":1,"content":"財。日主健旺，得印生解化者，關輕無害。甲日見庚為九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1699","lineNum":1493,"lineType":1,"content":"歲關，丁見癸為六歲關，戊見甲為三歲關，丙見壬為一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1700","lineNum":1494,"lineType":1,"content":"歲關，壬見戊為五歲關，癸見巳為半歲關。四柱原有者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1701","lineNum":1495,"lineType":1,"content":"為是，運及太歲流年遇者則非。陽干見陽煞，隂干見隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1702","lineNum":1496,"lineType":1,"content":"煞。陽忌单年单數，隂忌雙年雙數。如一六屬水之數，壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1703","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506326757408780"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1704","lineNum":1499,"lineType":1,"content":"屬陽，為一數，丙人見之為一週半闗。癸屬隂，為六數，丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1705","lineNum":1500,"lineType":1,"content":"人見之為六歲關。非特干頭七煞為關中隠者亦𦂳，餘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1706","lineNum":1501,"lineType":1,"content":"干倣此推之。小兒犯關，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1707","lineNum":1501,"lineType":1,"content":"河","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_64","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1708","lineNum":1501,"lineType":1,"content":"洛","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_65","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1709","lineNum":1501,"lineType":1,"content":"生成數為斷，若夫百日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1710","lineNum":1502,"lineType":1,"content":"關、鐵蛇關、鷄飛關、閻王關、深水關、鬼門關、四季關、四柱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1711","lineNum":1503,"lineType":1,"content":"關、将軍箭，其説見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1712","lineNum":1503,"lineType":1,"content":"百中經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_66","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1713","lineNum":1503,"lineType":1,"content":"可考，然多不驗，故不錄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1714","lineNum":1504,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1715","lineNum":1504,"lineType":1,"content":"小兒犯關，如甲子、壬子、戊子三旬生人，俱從申上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1716","lineNum":1505,"lineType":1,"content":"數起。庚子、丙子兩旬生人，俱從寅上數起。假如辛未命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1717","lineNum":1506,"lineType":1,"content":"是甲子旬中生人，用甲子從申上數起，順行一位一辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1718","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506337888944143"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1719","lineNum":1509,"lineType":1,"content":"至卯上，本年辛未，此是關也。却看命宫在何宫。若是兄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1720","lineNum":1510,"lineType":1,"content":"弟、奴僕、遷移、相貌四宫為犯關，餘宫非在三宫，不過三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1721","lineNum":1511,"lineType":1,"content":"歲、六十二宫依次言之，惟第九宫不出三十歲死。若行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1722","lineNum":1512,"lineType":1,"content":"年太歲大小運衝併，决不能免，謂之大關。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1723","lineNum":1513,"lineType":1,"content":"又如辰戌年生，關在辰、子、亥、酉年亥、午、丑、未年卯、寅年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1724","lineNum":1514,"lineType":1,"content":"巳年未，卯年子，看命宫在何宫。若煞在三、六、九、十二宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1725","lineNum":1515,"lineType":1,"content":"是死關也。六、九不過三百日，三、五週同十二宫，更兼惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1726","lineNum":1516,"lineType":1,"content":"煞來臨定凶，謂之小關。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1727","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506337649868850"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1728","lineNum":1519,"lineType":1,"content":"又一例，子、卯、丑未、寅巳卯子、辰辰巳、申午、午未、丑申、寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1729","lineNum":1520,"lineType":1,"content":"酉、酉戌、未亥亥即三刑也。假令子生人，卯上起煞，其煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1730","lineNum":1521,"lineType":1,"content":"在三、六、九、十二宫，主夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1731","lineNum":1522,"lineType":1,"content":"又春丑巳，夏辰申，秋未亥，冬戌寅，即孤辰寡宿。又正、七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1732","lineNum":1523,"lineType":1,"content":"月巳亥，二、八月辰戌，三、九月卯酉，四、十月寅申，五、十一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1733","lineNum":1524,"lineType":1,"content":"月丑未，六、十二月子午，正月巳，七月亥，即六衝。犯此時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1734","lineNum":1525,"lineType":1,"content":"者，主難養。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1735","lineNum":1526,"lineType":1,"content":"又生時納音不可尅年，如生年納音屬金，忌午時屬火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1736","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506337888960527"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1737","lineNum":1529,"lineType":1,"content":"名曰鬼關，犯者多不過三十天。金木不可犯巳酉時，火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1738","lineNum":1530,"lineType":1,"content":"不可犯辰申時，水土不可犯午戌時，名曰三關煞，主夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1739","lineNum":1531,"lineType":1,"content":"若生月乘旺氣，或鬼自絶，無傷元氣，亦主中夀。若四柱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1740","lineNum":1532,"lineType":1,"content":"帶父母，四柱一位二位，雖犯關不死。又有從戌上起正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1741","lineNum":1533,"lineType":1,"content":"月，逆行至本生月住，却向日上起子，順行至本生時住，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1742","lineNum":1534,"lineType":1,"content":"遇辰戌丑未上，是關煞。又寅申巳亥月見子午卯酉時，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1743","lineNum":1535,"lineType":1,"content":"子午卯酉月見辰戌丑未時，辰戌丑未月見寅申巳亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1744","lineNum":1536,"lineType":1,"content":"時，犯之必應。以上諸説，亦不盡驗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1745","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506349280837672"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1746","lineNum":1539,"lineType":1,"content":"又有小兒運例，陽男隂女。寅至卯，寅上一歲，卯上二歲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1747","lineNum":1540,"lineType":1,"content":"辰上三歲。隂男陽女。申至未，申上起一歲，未上二歲，午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1748","lineNum":1541,"lineType":1,"content":"上三歲，一年行一位。凡接辰巳戌亥年，定有灾殃，號名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1749","lineNum":1542,"lineType":1,"content":"孩兒運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1750","lineNum":1543,"lineType":1,"content":"又一法，一命、二財、三疾厄，四妻五福，順行流數到本年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1751","lineNum":1544,"lineType":1,"content":"十五歲，若遇凶煞定可憂。此星盤中看小兒法也。古有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1752","lineNum":1545,"lineType":1,"content":"占男女生時之日隂晴貴賤法，如金命天隂生，主官貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1753","lineNum":1546,"lineType":1,"content":"相，昏暗，貧賤，不問大小，風起，不長夀，有雪雨，主心善孝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1754","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506344235073590"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1755","lineNum":1549,"lineType":1,"content":"順。木命天隂生，大富，晴朗，有官，長夀；天昏，衣食平微，短","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1756","lineNum":1550,"lineType":1,"content":"命，有雪雨，身貴孝順。水命天隂生，心惡，倘來衣食明朗，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1757","lineNum":1551,"lineType":1,"content":"大貴；昏暗，短命貧賤，有風起，久後貴人提携。火命天隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1758","lineNum":1552,"lineType":1,"content":"生，大富，晴朗，雖富夀夭，昏暗，有官分，不問大小，風起，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1759","lineNum":1553,"lineType":1,"content":"衣食，大雪，短命，微雪雨，年至五十左右有病。土命天隂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1760","lineNum":1554,"lineType":1,"content":"不過十五死；微雨，不過三十大富，昏暗，富貴，有官分，夀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1761","lineNum":1555,"lineType":1,"content":"却夭，大風忤逆，短命，雨雪，有外財；晴朗，富貴久逺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1762","lineNum":1556,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1763","lineNum":1556,"lineType":1,"content":"凡小兒生時是辰戌丑未，又四柱中多墓，主過房。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1764","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506341584125986"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1765","lineNum":1559,"lineType":1,"content":"帶午未多者，名執抝煞，主為性執抝，戌多者亦然。帶子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1766","lineNum":1560,"lineType":1,"content":"亥多，主疝氣偏墜。是子時者無不應，壬子丙子尤𦂳。生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1767","lineNum":1561,"lineType":1,"content":"時與胎同在辰上者亦然。帶火多，主少年濃血之灾。帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1768","lineNum":1562,"lineType":1,"content":"丁午多，有未字者，主頭大害瘡癤，或疤痕，或秃瘡，大人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1769","lineNum":1563,"lineType":1,"content":"腦疽。四孟月上帶金火相尅，多瘡癤驚疾。金水火相尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1770","lineNum":1564,"lineType":1,"content":"制，主剥皮瘡灾。金水多，主晚語，見木主早言。五行一位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1771","lineNum":1565,"lineType":1,"content":"生三四位，㓜失乳。犯戊寅戊申癸巳日時，主與父母不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1772","lineNum":1566,"lineType":1,"content":"相保守。帶四孟或四季多者，背父生方不尅䧟，四孟母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1773","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506364912746535"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1774","lineNum":1569,"lineType":1,"content":"先亡。辰戌丑未尅父母，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1775","lineNum":1569,"lineType":2,"content":"尺壁","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_67","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1776","lineNum":1569,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1777","lineNum":1569,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌尅父，丑未尅母。犯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1778","lineNum":1570,"lineType":1,"content":"巳午多者，主十八九前尅父母，巳午時尤𦂳。胎年同位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1779","lineNum":1571,"lineType":1,"content":"及胎生元命者，主先尅母。五行全者，主少便清俊伶俐，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1780","lineNum":1572,"lineType":1,"content":"是夙有靈骨。五行自生月至時上，以次求生旺少刑衝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1781","lineNum":1573,"lineType":1,"content":"者吉，主長夀成器人也，反是則夭，縱使福神多有救，少","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1782","lineNum":1574,"lineType":1,"content":"年當十生九死，及至成人，亦非上夀。葢禀五行生旺則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1783","lineNum":1575,"lineType":1,"content":"氣實，氣實則夀長。五行死絶則氣薄，氣薄則短夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1784","lineNum":1576,"lineType":1,"content":"凡月日時枝幹錯亂，而重見太歲，曰重元星，主過房寄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1785","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506344235089974"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1786","lineNum":1579,"lineType":1,"content":"生。螟蛉之子初生或食神重叠，或偏印太旺，皆主無乳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1787","lineNum":1580,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱財多，主偏生庶出，或過房螟蛉，或妨尅父母。若㓜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1788","lineNum":1581,"lineType":1,"content":"年運行財旺之鄉，亦如此類。帶生旺氣者，是嫡母所生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1789","lineNum":1582,"lineType":1,"content":"胎元命有氣，更年與時支刑尅衝破胎元者，母不正。帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1790","lineNum":1583,"lineType":1,"content":"四水生船中，三金生逆旅，或聞鍾皷金革哭聲，或有孝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1791","lineNum":1584,"lineType":1,"content":"子着白衣婦人相看。見三木，聞喧呼驚怪，或不在正堂，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1792","lineNum":1585,"lineType":1,"content":"或近園林村庄庭舎。見三土生時近塜堤堰積土處，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1793","lineNum":1586,"lineType":1,"content":"有土工動作之事。三火，隣家有䘮禍事，或家中有憂恐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1794","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506326757343244"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1795","lineNum":1589,"lineType":1,"content":"離别事。若胎元坐生年驛馬，主在胎中頻頻動躍。生時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1796","lineNum":1590,"lineType":1,"content":"有臍帶纏頭，時帶刼煞，主頂有雙旋，或縱頂旋。帶亡神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1797","lineNum":1591,"lineType":1,"content":"主母有驚恐，或家中有訟及難産。帶月煞，主背父而生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1798","lineNum":1592,"lineType":1,"content":"及偏頂帶正印者，少驚哭。自襁褓無驚恐，易養。犯五重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1799","lineNum":1593,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃，名曰滿盤刃，多養不成。更時帶刑害者，决死，女兒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1800","lineNum":1594,"lineType":1,"content":"差慢，終不免産厄而死。生時見官符，父有公訟，母有驚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1801","lineNum":1595,"lineType":1,"content":"恐。咸池重合，不得親父母養育，或非嫡母所生。重叠見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1802","lineNum":1596,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡，主驚顛失墜。尅父母，生時犯空亡，及自死絶者，七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1803","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506337649885234"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1804","lineNum":1599,"lineType":1,"content":"歲前羸疾，七歲後陡肥。胎犯空亡，主左眼圓小。見前䘮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1805","lineNum":1600,"lineType":1,"content":"後弔，名曰䘮弔，直帳多湯火灾。見䘮門弔客，初生時有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1806","lineNum":1601,"lineType":1,"content":"白懵尿草之性。生時見䘮門，母氏難産，及生則母多疾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1807","lineNum":1602,"lineType":1,"content":"病。凡俗推小兒正否，命見孤辰寡宿，多隔房異宅。勢不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1808","lineNum":1603,"lineType":1,"content":"行，氣不轉，㓜離父母，如戊辰木得庚辰金，木為金尅，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1809","lineNum":1604,"lineType":1,"content":"勢不行。如庚辰金見己巳火，金氣轉於十二支，則有火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1810","lineNum":1605,"lineType":1,"content":"截，所以氣不轉，餘依此推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1811","lineNum":1606,"lineType":1,"content":"胎中帶㢘貞，兩位衝一位，隂陽不正，為庶子。或六害相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1812","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506349280870440"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1813","lineNum":1609,"lineType":1,"content":"刑帶煞，主過房。胎月生時，大小墓空刑絶同處，不是雙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1814","lineNum":1610,"lineType":1,"content":"生異母，必是寄姪。抱歸日。時犯勾絞尅身多，主驚弔。生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1815","lineNum":1611,"lineType":1,"content":"時若逢禄，少年乳粗口有角，或少時就好酒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1816","lineNum":1611,"lineType":2,"content":"古詩曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1817","lineNum":1611,"lineType":1,"content":"時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1818","lineNum":1612,"lineType":1,"content":"逢年害臨華葢，四季胎空加六害，若非寄養外人家，庶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1819","lineNum":1613,"lineType":1,"content":"出倚親多此軰。如戊寅戊午得戊戌時生，時與年同為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1820","lineNum":1614,"lineType":1,"content":"華葢之例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1821","lineNum":1614,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1822","lineNum":1614,"lineType":1,"content":"時入空亡子拗性，天元受尅多剛勁。或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1823","lineNum":1615,"lineType":1,"content":"加辰戌等宫中庶出，不然身兩姓。如辰戌丑未四時生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1824","lineNum":1616,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡中多是庶出，又性執拗。生産定時：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1825","lineNum":1616,"lineType":2,"content":"歌云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1826","lineNum":1616,"lineType":1,"content":"子午卯酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1827","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506364912762919"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1828","lineNum":1619,"lineType":1,"content":"面向天，寅申巳亥側身眠。辰戌丑未定是覆，此是人間","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1829","lineNum":1620,"lineType":1,"content":"定時仙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1830","lineNum":1621,"lineType":1,"content":"或問：偶然同産，一母所生，何以别貴賤榮枯？答曰：凡一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1831","lineNum":1622,"lineType":1,"content":"時有八刻十二分，故有淺深前後，吉凶不同。其有同時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1832","lineNum":1623,"lineType":1,"content":"一母所生，須分淺深及日時之隂陽。如陽日時兄勝，隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1833","lineNum":1624,"lineType":1,"content":"日時弟勝。淺則占先時之氣，深則占後時之氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1834","lineNum":1624,"lineType":2,"content":"古歌云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1835","lineNum":1625,"lineType":1,"content":"雙生之法有竒門，欲驗榮枯視日辰。隂日弟強兄必弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1836","lineNum":1626,"lineType":1,"content":"陽時兄貴弟須貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1837","lineNum":1626,"lineType":2,"content":"李九萬云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1838","lineNum":1626,"lineType":1,"content":"凡小兒帶四生，多主雙生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1839","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506326757392396"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1840","lineNum":1629,"lineType":2,"content":"神白經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_68","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1841","lineNum":1629,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1842","lineNum":1629,"lineType":1,"content":"陽命後生者死，隂命先生者死，不以男女論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1843","lineNum":1630,"lineType":1,"content":"又一説一時分方向，如木命向東方者，受生氣，向西方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1844","lineNum":1631,"lineType":1,"content":"者，受尅氣。貴賤夀夭，以是别之。余聞三河王氏兄弟雙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1845","lineNum":1632,"lineType":1,"content":"生，弟先中，兄後中，功名夀夭，大率相似，而兄竟不如弟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1846","lineNum":1633,"lineType":1,"content":"穎州李氏，兄弟雙生，因差一時，故弟登甲科，兄止秀才。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1847","lineNum":1634,"lineType":1,"content":"考其八字日時，果如前説。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1849","lineNum":1636,"lineType":1,"content":"或問隂陽何所配合為夫婦而成六親？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1850","lineNum":1636,"lineType":2,"content":"答云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1851","lineNum":1636,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲以乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1852","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506363176402981"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1853","lineNum":1639,"lineType":1,"content":"為妹，配與庚金為妻。丙以丁為妹，配與壬水為妻。戊以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1854","lineNum":1640,"lineType":1,"content":"己配甲，庚以辛配丙，壬以癸配戊。一隂一陽，配成夫婦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1855","lineNum":1641,"lineType":1,"content":"有夫婦，然後有父子；有父子，然後有兄弟。六親者，父母、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1856","lineNum":1642,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟、妻子也。六甲娶己為妻，甲己合而生庚辛為子。男","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1857","lineNum":1643,"lineType":1,"content":"取尅干為嗣，女取干生為息，則己者，庚辛之母，庚辛者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1858","lineNum":1644,"lineType":1,"content":"己之子也。庚娶乙木為妻，乙庚合而生丙丁，則乙庚者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1859","lineNum":1645,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁之父母。庚為父，乙為母，故謂隂干生我者為母，我","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1860","lineNum":1646,"lineType":1,"content":"尅陽干者為父。尅我者，為官為子。我尅者，為財為妻。比","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1861","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506364912795687"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1862","lineNum":1649,"lineType":1,"content":"和者，為兄弟娣妹。生我妻隂干為丈母，妻尅陽干為丈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1863","lineNum":1650,"lineType":1,"content":"人，尅我女者為女壻，食神為孫。其餘六親，俱於十千變","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1864","lineNum":1651,"lineType":1,"content":"化取用。且如六甲生人，以癸水為母，癸為正印。如遇己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1865","lineNum":1652,"lineType":1,"content":"土正財，戊土為父，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1866","lineNum":1652,"lineType":2,"content":"戊合癸也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1867","lineNum":1652,"lineType":1,"content":"戊是偏財，如遇比刼，則父有傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1868","lineNum":1653,"lineType":1,"content":"六乙生人，亦以癸為母，癸是偏印，以戊為父，戊是正財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1869","lineNum":1654,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙俱以庚辛為子，庚金為男，在甲則為七煞，在乙則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1870","lineNum":1655,"lineType":1,"content":"為正官也。辛金為女，在乙則為七煞，在甲則為正官也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1871","lineNum":1656,"lineType":1,"content":"己土為妻，戊土為妾，謂乙木尅己土也。雖云隂見隂不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1872","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506364912779303"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1873","lineNum":1659,"lineType":1,"content":"成配合，然隂木尅不得陽土，且婦人以隂為正也。故云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1874","lineNum":1660,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙俱以己為妻，戊為妾。如女人則甲遇庚七煞，乙遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1875","lineNum":1661,"lineType":1,"content":"庚正官，皆夫星也。謂庚是陽男，為正夫，屬陽不可以辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1876","lineNum":1662,"lineType":1,"content":"隂為夫也。但陽見陽多無情，隂見陽則夫婦和鳴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1877","lineNum":1662,"lineType":2,"content":"或云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1878","lineNum":1663,"lineType":1,"content":"取正財為妻，偏才為妾。女甲則辛為正夫，取隂陽之正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1879","lineNum":1664,"lineType":1,"content":"合也。甲乙生人，俱以甲為兄姊，乙為弟妹，以丁為婆。生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1880","lineNum":1665,"lineType":1,"content":"我父者為祖母，丁生戊也。壬水為公，壬與丁合也。又以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1881","lineNum":1666,"lineType":1,"content":"丁火為丈母，生我妻者為我外母，丁生己配與甲作正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1882","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506326757457932"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1883","lineNum":1669,"lineType":1,"content":"妻也。壬為丈人，壬與丁合也。妻之兄弟為妻舅，己土為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1884","lineNum":1670,"lineType":1,"content":"妻，戊土則為妻兄妻舅，癸水則是舅之妻為妗也。其餘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1885","lineNum":1671,"lineType":1,"content":"八干俱以類推。女人取用與男不同，我生者為子，尅我","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1886","lineNum":1672,"lineType":1,"content":"者為夫，生我夫者為姑，尅我姑者為公，其餘父母兄弟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1887","lineNum":1673,"lineType":1,"content":"皆與男同斷，但須辨其隂陽耳。如甲乙干則以丙為男，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1888","lineNum":1674,"lineType":1,"content":"丁為女，庚為夫，辛為夫之兄弟，己為姑，甲為公也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1889","lineNum":1674,"lineType":2,"content":"或曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1890","lineNum":1675,"lineType":1,"content":"食神為子，傷官為女，取隂陽之各生也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1891","lineNum":1675,"lineType":2,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_69","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1892","lineNum":1675,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1893","lineNum":1675,"lineType":1,"content":"以年為祖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1894","lineNum":1676,"lineType":1,"content":"業，月為父母兄弟門户，日為妻妾己身，時為子息。須看","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1895","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506363176435749"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1896","lineNum":1679,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱之中，父母兄弟妻子星居何地。論旺相休囚而言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1897","lineNum":1680,"lineType":1,"content":"其吉凶。如父母星坐長生旺庫、禄馬貴人之地，則主父","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1898","lineNum":1681,"lineType":1,"content":"母富貴、福夀榮耀。如坐空刑尅煞、死亡衰敗交併之地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1899","lineNum":1682,"lineType":1,"content":"則主父母貧薄、破傷刑夭，或死於外及不善終。若帶刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1900","lineNum":1683,"lineType":1,"content":"帶破害，雖居於生旺庫之地，主父母有夀而貧賤。兄弟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1901","lineNum":1684,"lineType":1,"content":"星若生得時得令，坐長生庫旺禄馬貴人之地，則主兄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1902","lineNum":1685,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴，榮華成羣。如坐刑尅煞刃死絶衰敗之地，兄弟不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1903","lineNum":1686,"lineType":1,"content":"得力。如坐長生旺庫，而遇刑衝破害者，雖有兄弟而仇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1904","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506350446755850"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1905","lineNum":1689,"lineType":1,"content":"敵及不得力。如妻妾星坐生旺庫禄馬貴人之地，或有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1906","lineNum":1690,"lineType":1,"content":"物以生之，主妻妾富貴榮華，美貌多才。如坐空刑尅煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1907","lineNum":1691,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃死絶衝敗之地，則主妻妾貧薄，醜貌刑夭，淫亂殘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1908","lineNum":1692,"lineType":1,"content":"疾，或産亡不得力。如坐生旺禄馬之地，被刑衝破害，妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1909","lineNum":1693,"lineType":1,"content":"雖有夀，亦主破相貧薄。如禄馬貴人財庫之地，帶刑衝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1910","lineNum":1694,"lineType":1,"content":"尅煞，主妻雖富貴亦夭。如子息星坐生旺禄馬貴人官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1911","lineNum":1695,"lineType":1,"content":"印之地，有物以相生，主子息榮華聰明多得送老。如坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1912","lineNum":1696,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬貴人，居於死絶之地，雖有聰明俊秀，不送老也。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1913","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506326757425164"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1914","lineNum":1699,"lineType":1,"content":"居生旺之地，被刑衝破害，有子，主愚頑或殘疾送老。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1915","lineNum":1700,"lineType":1,"content":"居死絶又刑衝破害刼財之地，不得子之力，縱有子，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1916","lineNum":1701,"lineType":1,"content":"殘疾破相，或不才女命。如子居生旺之地，主多子，如坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1917","lineNum":1702,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬貴人，主子富貴福夀。如坐空刑尅煞，併衝羊刃死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1918","lineNum":1703,"lineType":1,"content":"絶之地，主子不得力。若妾位居生旺，則宜主偏生之子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1919","lineNum":1704,"lineType":2,"content":"賦云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1920","lineNum":1704,"lineType":1,"content":"論其眷屬，憂其死絶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1921","lineNum":1704,"lineType":2,"content":"三命","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_70","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1922","lineNum":1704,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1923","lineNum":1704,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱觀其九族，三元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1924","lineNum":1705,"lineType":1,"content":"辨其六親是也。或問甲乙日主以戊癸為父母，四柱干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1925","lineNum":1706,"lineType":1,"content":"支並無癸水，只戊壬二字顯於干頭，或藏於地支，則論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1926","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506376208023604"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1927","lineNum":1709,"lineType":1,"content":"何者為父母？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1928","lineNum":1709,"lineType":2,"content":"答曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1929","lineNum":1709,"lineType":1,"content":"本經所謂明干有時明干取，明干無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1930","lineNum":1710,"lineType":1,"content":"時暗中求是也。如柱無癸字，只有戊字，是甲乙之父将","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1931","lineNum":1711,"lineType":1,"content":"父求其母，如無母，只将壬為母，亦須論戊為父，其戊壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1932","lineNum":1712,"lineType":1,"content":"不得係婚配，非兒女嫁娶，必是服内成親，或母多父歲，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1933","lineNum":1713,"lineType":1,"content":"或失婚而再配也。或又問甲日主月支，年支是乙木，時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1934","lineNum":1714,"lineType":1,"content":"支是甲木，乙先甲後，何為兄，何為弟？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1935","lineNum":1714,"lineType":2,"content":"答曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1936","lineNum":1714,"lineType":1,"content":"不論先後，只","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1937","lineNum":1715,"lineType":1,"content":"以強為兄，弱為弟。夫人之生也，上父母，下妻子，中兄弟，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1938","lineNum":1716,"lineType":1,"content":"其聨屬離合，命之為也。言命不及六親，自是偏見，但世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1939","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506344235122742"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1940","lineNum":1719,"lineType":1,"content":"人不達正理，以五陽干取為母、為妻、為女，五隂干取為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1941","lineNum":1720,"lineType":1,"content":"父、為夫、為男，謬戾甚矣。此法教人，甲取己為妻，乙亦取","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1942","lineNum":1721,"lineType":1,"content":"己為妻，不當取戊，戊乃陽也。甲以庚為嗣，以戊為父，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1943","lineNum":1722,"lineType":1,"content":"癸為母，乙亦如之。不拘偏正，惟辨隂陽，陽男隂女，理之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1944","lineNum":1723,"lineType":1,"content":"大順也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1945","lineNum":1723,"lineType":2,"content":"神白經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_71","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1946","lineNum":1723,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","lo :"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2029","lineNum":1785,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官坐煞，如丙日見己亥時之類，亦有子，但不和順。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2030","lineNum":1786,"lineType":1,"content":"論生子，歲運官煞重，則在傷官，食神官煞輕，則在財年，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2031","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506364912828455"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2032","lineNum":1789,"lineType":1,"content":"或官煞年官煞輕，食傷重，須是偏印正印，年官煞重，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2033","lineNum":1790,"lineType":1,"content":"財又多，須得比刼羊刃，或天地合，三合六合年分，以此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2034","lineNum":1791,"lineType":1,"content":"活法叅之，蔑不中矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
