{"lines":[{"lineId":"2036","lineNum":1793,"lineType":1,"content":"父以偏財論，母以印綬論，無傷則少年無妨害。假庚日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2037","lineNum":1794,"lineType":1,"content":"用甲為父，如柱中再見庚字，或合己酉丑金局，即傷父。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2038","lineNum":1795,"lineType":1,"content":"若命帶七煞，則不妨。如日干健旺，甲字在亥卯未寅，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2039","lineNum":1796,"lineType":1,"content":"冬令，主父母和順，或父受官封，皆可類推。又戊日生者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2040","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506367710625818"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2041","lineNum":1799,"lineType":1,"content":"取丁火為母，忌柱中正財太重，轉尅印綬，如貪財壞印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2042","lineNum":1800,"lineType":1,"content":"之説。元帶天地之財，運行財鄉，則尅早。只有地財運未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2043","lineNum":1801,"lineType":1,"content":"行財鄉，則尅遲。四柱有正官一位，不妨。如戊日生，四柱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2044","lineNum":1802,"lineType":1,"content":"原有二壬，皆得地，主母有二夫，正印為母，偏印為繼庶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2045","lineNum":1803,"lineType":1,"content":"之母。若人命帶父母全，一生得祖業分縁，又無尅剥之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2046","lineNum":1804,"lineType":1,"content":"患。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"2047","lineNum":1805,"lineType":8,"content":"兄弟引例章","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2048","lineNum":1806,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟者，即刼財比肩，甲見乙，乙見甲之類。如庚日坐寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2049","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506395485011978"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2050","lineNum":1809,"lineType":1,"content":"午戌之上，或臨死墓之鄉，却有辛酉自旺之弟，帶財得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2051","lineNum":1810,"lineType":1,"content":"時，主弟自明顯，兄不及弟之福。如兄弟相和，强弱相分，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2052","lineNum":1811,"lineType":1,"content":"其理則一。如不和者，乃四柱帶庚丁辛丙之類，兄之官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2053","lineNum":1812,"lineType":1,"content":"星尅弟之本身，如此五行自然不和、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2054","lineNum":1812,"lineType":2,"content":"本經云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2055","lineNum":1812,"lineType":1,"content":"不仁不義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2056","lineNum":1813,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛與甲乙交差，此之謂也。餘倣此推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2057","lineNum":1814,"lineType":2,"content":"歌云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2058","lineNum":1814,"lineType":1,"content":"煞官混雜帶三刑，更無財曜是偷生。我明他暗從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2059","lineNum":1815,"lineType":1,"content":"他象，父死之時不赴靈。庚金化成火相持，父亡見血不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2060","lineNum":1816,"lineType":1,"content":"須疑。比肩三合族人害，三刑零落及離妻。比肩暗損及","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2061","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506350446837770"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2062","lineNum":1819,"lineType":1,"content":"門房，兄弟無情被罔欺。如帶比肩成别象，兄弟不睦報","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2063","lineNum":1820,"lineType":1,"content":"君知。妻帶三合及坐妻，妻從認得是親支。坐妻透妻成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2064","lineNum":1821,"lineType":1,"content":"别象，定主離妻又娶妻。多透妻財須怕婦，婦歸絶路不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2065","lineNum":1822,"lineType":1,"content":"生兒。化成别象尅正夫，必主欺夫禮義疎。身旺食强亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2066","lineNum":1823,"lineType":1,"content":"如此，食明旺相慬然殂。陽母專位主偏生，母來父上受","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2067","lineNum":1824,"lineType":1,"content":"其驚。天時地利生過月，七煞兼行頂上偏。兒歸煞地母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2068","lineNum":1825,"lineType":1,"content":"有疾，丙丁雙者頂雙靈。日禄歸時須孕夢，小兒無乳食","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2069","lineNum":1826,"lineType":1,"content":"神衝。壬子乙酉時偏生，丙戌丁壬妻䕶靈。背父而生甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2070","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506367710642202"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2071","lineNum":1829,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯，此時須要記分明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2072","lineNum":1830,"lineType":2,"content":"賦云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2073","lineNum":1830,"lineType":1,"content":"過房入舎年月衝，分隨母從夫，財空印旺，早年父","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2074","lineNum":1831,"lineType":1,"content":"䘮。偏財臨死絶煞宫，㓜歲母離。印綬逢財多死地，比肩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2075","lineNum":1832,"lineType":1,"content":"重而兄弟無情，羊刃多而妻宫有損。官逢死絶之地，子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2076","lineNum":1833,"lineType":1,"content":"招難得；若見傷官太甚，兒亦難留。如遇衝破提綱，定主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2077","lineNum":1834,"lineType":1,"content":"離於祖業，再見空亡，三番四廢。印綬逢生，母當賢貴，偏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2078","lineNum":1835,"lineType":1,"content":"財歸禄，父必崢嶸。官星臨禄旺之鄉，子當榮顯。七煞遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2079","lineNum":1836,"lineType":1,"content":"長生之位，女招貴夫。自身借宫所生，多主依人過活，妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2080","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506337889042447"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2081","lineNum":1839,"lineType":1,"content":"星失令，半路抛離；若乃借宫所生，亦是他人義女。印綬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2082","lineNum":1840,"lineType":1,"content":"旺而子少息希，七煞强而女多男少。偏財逢敗，父主風","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2083","lineNum":1841,"lineType":1,"content":"流；子曜若臨，破家蕩産。妻入墓，不得妻財。父臨庫，父當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2084","lineNum":1842,"lineType":1,"content":"先死。比肩逢禄，兄弟名髙；印綬被尅，母親䘮早。桃花若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2085","lineNum":1843,"lineType":1,"content":"坐煞星妻宫，决主淫蕩。年衝月者，祖基不守。日衝時者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2086","lineNum":1844,"lineType":1,"content":"妻子難為。若見天元刑戰，父母不全；如遇地支所生，凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2087","lineNum":1845,"lineType":1,"content":"中成吉。七煞能生正印，萱堂暮景精神，傷官喜助偏財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2088","lineNum":1846,"lineType":1,"content":"椿老百年安逸。比肩雖有兄弟，比重而父夀難延；旺財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2089","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506362698154020"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2090","lineNum":1849,"lineType":1,"content":"可以生官，財多而母年不固。食神頻見，難招繼續之人；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2091","lineNum":1850,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃重逢，再配持家之婦。官鬼盛則昆仲消疎；七煞興","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2092","lineNum":1851,"lineType":1,"content":"則己身不利。夫妻偕老，皆因財旺身强；子女盈眸，只為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2093","lineNum":1852,"lineType":1,"content":"官興煞盛。四柱相生值吉曜，三代皆全；五行戰尅遇凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2094","lineNum":1853,"lineType":1,"content":"星，六親不備。若推女命，反此參詳。婆是偏財，若是傷官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2095","lineNum":1854,"lineType":1,"content":"當考夀；公為比刼，如逢七煞命難延。財官興盛，必招富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2096","lineNum":1855,"lineType":1,"content":"貴之夫；食比司權，當生賢孝之子。印綬能傷子息，逢財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2097","lineNum":1856,"lineType":1,"content":"反得安康。同類干頭為娣妹，財上支絶不興夫。此則六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2098","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506376208072756"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2099","lineNum":1859,"lineType":1,"content":"親真妙訣，五行生尅定榮枯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2100","lineNum":1860,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2101","lineNum":1860,"lineType":1,"content":"年逢刃煞，㓜年早䘮爹娘；時遇刃傷，末年却損兒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2102","lineNum":1861,"lineType":1,"content":"女。衝者無兄弟，刑者損六親。外衝六親無力，内衝夫婦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2103","lineNum":1862,"lineType":1,"content":"不協。歲月官印財全，三代祖先富貴；日時煞刃逢梟，半","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2104","lineNum":1863,"lineType":1,"content":"路妻兒虧損。男命傷官多損子，女命傷官多尅夫。傷官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2105","lineNum":1864,"lineType":1,"content":"見財而有子，七煞有制乃多兒。財重刑傷父母，鬼旺後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2106","lineNum":1865,"lineType":1,"content":"代遷榮。刼財重重父早䘮，破印太重母先亡。歲月財官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2107","lineNum":1866,"lineType":1,"content":"旺相，公父顯榮。日時禄馬相生，妻兒賢俊。印伏藏而財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2108","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506362698170404"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2109","lineNum":1869,"lineType":1,"content":"秉令，庶出姦生。正財旺而身失時，母年早䘮。偏官偏印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2110","lineNum":1870,"lineType":1,"content":"偏財叠逢，必然偏庶。正官正印正財獨遇，的是正宗。男","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2111","lineNum":1871,"lineType":1,"content":"旺官，子必多，女重梟，兒必絶。月中刼背絶財官，父終外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2112","lineNum":1872,"lineType":1,"content":"土。歲月背逐更衝害，公葬他鄉。日逢刃，時逢梟，妻妾産","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2113","lineNum":1873,"lineType":1,"content":"亡。歲值煞，月值傷，兄弟難有。月令傷官多奪長，時行神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2114","lineNum":1874,"lineType":1,"content":"煞兄弟無。男命刼叠外家稀，女人煞重親骨絶。專禄兼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2115","lineNum":1875,"lineType":1,"content":"隂錯，外舎伶仃。逐馬見陽差，公姑真假。印旺妨兒女，財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2116","lineNum":1876,"lineType":1,"content":"重妬公姑。歲月叠煞有刑害，公姑遭傷。日時背逐無救","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2117","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506363176484901"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2118","lineNum":1879,"lineType":1,"content":"助，妻兒離尅。正財偏財復見合，雖多妻妾主濫滛。偏官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2119","lineNum":1880,"lineType":1,"content":"正官更衝害，任有丈夫而偷姦。旺夫傷子，乃食位而受","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2120","lineNum":1881,"lineType":1,"content":"傷。旺子傷夫，察官星而䘮絶。女命印旺官輕，夫權在手。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2121","lineNum":1882,"lineType":1,"content":"男命財多身弱，妻語愜心。日下傷官持刃，夫必惡亡。月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2122","lineNum":1883,"lineType":1,"content":"中帶印刑衝，母家零落。刃健煞剛，祖基微薄。官强財旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2123","lineNum":1884,"lineType":1,"content":"後代昌榮。日逢背禄逐馬，多破祖離鄉之客。財遇財旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2124","lineNum":1885,"lineType":1,"content":"生官，有興家助國之男。煞刃月逢，有父無母。偏官叠見， 961,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2211","lineNum":1961,"lineType":1,"content":"隂惆陽悵，亥來子上妨夫；夾角夾維，寅向丑邊尅妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2212","lineNum":1962,"lineType":2,"content":"辰戌丑未，不為惆悵煞，惟隂陽並處，然後有之。亥人向子，乃隂悵其陽，如妻號其夫，故言亥來子，主妨夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2213","lineNum":1963,"lineType":2,"content":"子人得亥，乃陽悵其隂，如夫哭其妻，子來亥上妨妻，不待言而見也。子午卯酉，無隔角寡宿煞，惟方隅四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2214","lineNum":1964,"lineType":2,"content":"處，然後有之。寅人得丑，乃隔角寡宿，則不利妻，故曰寅向丑邊尅婦。丑人得寅，隔角孤辰，則不利夫，丑向","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2215","lineNum":1965,"lineType":2,"content":"寅上尅夫，故不待説也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2216","lineNum":1966,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2217","lineNum":1966,"lineType":1,"content":"凡男於妻絶中生者，不宜生女，生女則䘮妻。如甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2218","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506341584207906"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2219","lineNum":1969,"lineType":1,"content":"子金，男以木為妻，七月生，為妻絶。女於夫絶中生者，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2220","lineNum":1970,"lineType":1,"content":"宜生男，生男即䘮夫。如甲子金，女以火為夫，十月生，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2221","lineNum":1971,"lineType":1,"content":"夫絶也。餘准此推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2222","lineNum":1972,"lineType":2,"content":"癸亥、丙寅、巳巳、乙巳、庚申等日，為皷盆煞，畏其日之旺也，與孤鸞大同。又云：絶宫為皷盆之煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"2223","lineNum":1973,"lineType":1,"content":"金申酉，火巳午，水土亥子、木寅卯，名望鄉煞，惡其命之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2224","lineNum":1974,"lineType":1,"content":"强也，與建禄無異。又亥未戌，春巳子辰，夏寅卯午，冬申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2225","lineNum":1975,"lineType":1,"content":"酉丑，秋，名狼藉煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2226","lineNum":1976,"lineType":2,"content":"百忌歴","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00008_0_80","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2227","lineNum":1976,"lineType":2,"content":"以正月為大敗，二月狼藉，三月入敗，男敗妻家，女敗夫家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

,{"lineId":"2255","lineNum":2001,"lineType":1,"content":"哭子帶刑死位傍，子多復是少年亡。忽若干支","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2256","lineNum":2002,"lineType":1,"content":"並德合，只宜養女得成雙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2257","lineNum":2002,"lineType":2,"content":"如一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2258","lineNum":2002,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未、癸亥、丙辰、戊子，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2259","lineNum":2003,"lineType":1,"content":"是局中無子，又在官鬼死絶地，却癸與戊合，故生女多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2260","lineNum":2004,"lineType":1,"content":"子皆不成。若見甲子，則主有子，以日干論。丙辰以癸為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2261","lineNum":2005,"lineType":1,"content":"子，引歸時上，建録臨官之地，主多子，然却無子，是以納","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2262","lineNum":2006,"lineType":1,"content":"音取年上論亦准。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2263","lineNum":2006,"lineType":2,"content":"又一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2264","lineNum":2006,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未、甲子、辛卯、癸巳，是局中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2265","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506390657548327"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2266","lineNum":2009,"lineType":1,"content":"有子，在死地喜時，引官鬼長生之地，故生數子而少女。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2267","lineNum":2010,"lineType":2,"content":"又一命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2268","lineNum":2010,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰、壬午、戊寅、辛酉，白虎臨庭，五十六不禄，兒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2269","lineNum":2011,"lineType":1,"content":"女俱無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marg
