{"lines":[{"lineId":"8","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡㸔命，先㸔月支有無財官，方㸔其他月令為命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"月取支神，年取天干，日取天干，流嵗取天干，大運取支","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"神。年為本，日為主。如月有正官及偏官，而時又入他格，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"只以月中取。他格無用，如月令全無可用，方㸔他格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":12,"lineType":2,"content":"古","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506604596264986"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":15,"lineType":2,"content":"歌云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"三宫帶格混難詳，不曉憑誰是貴方。一任三宫皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"帶格，除非只得用提綱是也。月令用地支，假如官星，須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"要上下干支透出為妙。或干透出，支中不透，主聰俊。忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"年與時衝，月支日支自衝不妨。大運及嵗君來衝月支，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"則禍。凡正官一位，乃君子貴人，篤厚純粹，剛直亷眀。年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"時有印尤妙，多則反主成敗。四位純官，仕宦虚名。凡七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，一位聰明伶俐；二位、三位先清後濁。四柱純煞，有制","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，無制貧。凡財，一位，務要得時，富貴成家，為人性燥𦂳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506577790664740"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"急。二位性氣减半。三位、四位耗氣身衰。若身旺甚，則可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"成立，弱則勞苦生受。凡印，不論一位二位四位都好，格","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"中不宜見財破印。大凡行好運，日干傷流年嵗君干頭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"禍輕。行不好運，日干傷嵗君干頭禍重。若已發過則死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未，各有三分餘氣，如行午運至未，有三分火氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"行子至丑，有三分水氣之例，不可全作土論。凡陽刃格，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗運最怕衝合，太嵗干合日時干者，為晦氣煞。日時干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"支與流年干支同為轉趾煞。如庚申日見庚申，或庚寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506589983490058"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗之類。輕則逺遷，重則毁屋破財。凡年月日有吉神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":36,"lineType":1,"content":"要時引歸生旺之處。有凶神，要時引歸制伏之鄉。若時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"上帶吉神或凶神，亦要年月日上吉者生之，凶者制之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"月上有用神，得祖宗之力。時上有用神，得子孫之力。反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"此則否。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"38","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"凡㸔命，以日干用為天元，是以干為禄。日支月攴用為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"地元，是以支為命。假如壬癸日己未月，干支透出財官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。財官論原有原無，地支原有財官，天干不露出者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506606236303412"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"不問，若地支無財官，只是天干透出，雖行好運，亦不濟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"事。㸔流年嵗君，只用天元，若行運雖重地支，亦要㸔運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"天元。人命柱中或有官星，或有偏官，有制伏太過，而運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"干見官煞可發。運支無財而運干是財，亦可為福。運支","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"無煞而運干是煞，亦可為禍。人命以當生之月為運元，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"最怕大運並嵗君來衝為禍，以當生官星為禄元，最怕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"衝壞。如丁日生人，以壬為官，而生亥月，亥中有壬，是丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"之禄，若年與時有己字，則衝壞禄元。以當生財星為馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506577790681124"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"元，最怕刼奪。如庚日生人，以甲乙木為財，而生寅卯月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"寅中甲木偏財，卯中乙木正財，若年時有辛字，却有争","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"奪之患。嵗運同論，凡年干上有日之官星，福氣最厚，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"日之七煞，終身不可除去。官星為禄，財星為馬，行官星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"發官，行財星發財，二者不可缺一，各有所用。年月上有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"財官，必生富貴之家，祖父根基，少年便行官禄運，多是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"㓜年拜命，早發功名。年月無財官，日時有之，則是自己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"成立。人命以財官為本，柱中但得其一，亦可發福。若四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506598837485587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"柱原無官星，不入他格。年月日時干支財多，又行財旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"運，亦能成就功名，以財旺自能生官，須身旺方許。年月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"無財官，㓜年又行不好運，多是出身卑微，破祖傷父，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"見成之福。凡命官煞混雜，傷官合神重，男子犯之，躭迷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"酒色，女人逢之，不媒自嫁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"65","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"凡㸔命，專以日干為主，取提綱所用之物為命。譬月令","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"以金木水火土為用，但有一件，取其節氣先後，輕重淺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":72,"lineType":1,"content":"深，成局破衝，細加考究，曰官曰印、曰財曰煞、曰食神、曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506614620618752"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官，以此六法消息之，逢官㸔財，逢煞㸔印，逢印㸔官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"取四者不偏不倚，生剋制化為上，遇破害休囚為下。運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"有生有去為福，有助有剥為禍。亦有用年日時支合成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"格局者，然皆以月令為用。假令月用金只用金，用火只","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"用火，十八格内取六格為重用相生定格合局，却用年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"日時下以推輕重淺深。如逢官用印不怕煞，是煞局印，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"印局身，還作上局取之。逢印㸔煞，但有官煞在，命行官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"煞鄉，亦作貴論。月令通官，柱中遇財，財旺生官，乃富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506589983506442"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中見財，要入財旺運發福，但見一煞，則以煞為重，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"可用財。若行財旺運，乃財生煞黨，作貧賤言。凡格以煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"為重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"81","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命先㸔干神有無尅制，支神有無刑衝，干支納音，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"無戰鬭降伏。如甲以寅為禄，而寅上有何干，甲以辛為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"官，而辛得何支？干不侵支則天乃尊，支不犯干則地乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"卑。五行不相賊，則人乃順，四孟不相害，則馬乃能馳。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"干侵支，犯五行相賊，又當分别主本有氣無氣，有用無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506589983473674"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"用，有救無救、成格不成格，則干支錯綜，五行變化，造化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"在其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":96,"lineType":2,"content":"李淳風云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"五行生旺，觀福氣之往還；五行死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"絶，在吉神之救助。若五行得地，納音相生，吉神無助，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"榮；五行無氣，納音相妨，縱有吉神不用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"93","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命，天元喜地元有禄，如甲己喜四季，乙庚喜申酉，丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"辛喜亥子，丁壬喜寅卯，戊癸喜巳午。地元喜天元有合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"如子丑喜戊，寅喜己，卯，辰喜庚，己喜辛癸，午未喜甲，壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"申喜乙，酉戌喜丙，亥喜丁。天元地元皆有一生福氣高","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506604596281370"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"崇，皆無名利，無成壞。天元者，三十九嵗以前名利難發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"壞地元者，四十嵗福不如前。若天元秀氣坐禄，如癸得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"子、甲得寅之例，不貴即富。地元忌天元相尅，如子丑怕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"己，寅怕庚，卯辰怕辛，巳怕甲，壬午未怕乙，癸申怕丙，酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"戌怕丁，亥怕戊，更㸔喜忌何如，不可執定。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"103","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命取干支，與納音同類，壬子、壬午真木，己酉、己卯真","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"土，丙子、丙午真水，戊子戊午真火，乙丑、乙未、庚辰庚戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"真金。若乙酉日庚辰時為精金，丁巳日丙午時為精火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506549227536418"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥日壬子時為精水，己丑日戊辰時為精土，甲寅日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯時為精木，以上遇者，俱主富貴。若火人丙日辛時、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日丙時，木人甲日己時、己日甲時，土人戊日癸時、癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"日戊時，水人壬日丁時、丁日壬時，金人庚日乙時、乙日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"庚時，雖為五行真貴，重犯减福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"112","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命取五行真氣交互，如辛亥金人得丁巳土，有丁壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"合真木往來，有丙辛合真水往來。丁巳土人得癸亥水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"有戊癸合真火往來，有丁壬合真木往來。如戊戌、癸亥、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506585365413897"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳、辛亥交互真氣全，乃宰相命也。戊午火得壬子木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"中有丁壬真木，戊癸真火。丙申火得乙酉水，中有丙辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"真水，乙庚真金。庚寅得己卯土，中有甲己真土，乙庚真","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"金。如庚寅、己卯、庚寅、己卯交互全，乃兩府命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"120","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命先論化氣，考","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"五運篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_2","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"，以甲丙戊庚壬合五陰干為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"太過，乙丁己辛癸合五陽干為不及。太過不及之間，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"權存焉。考","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"天元變化書","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_3","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"，又分晝夜，如六甲日生木，夜生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"化土，故六戊人得甲，取日生為鬼，夜生為官用。六乙人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506604596248602"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"日生用金，夜生用木，故六己人見之，日生為官，夜生為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼。獨六己、六庚不變，是以五陽干晝生為本體，夜生作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"化㸔；五陰干夜生為本體，晝生作化㸔。六般陽命，男犯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"禄鬼倒食，須取夜生，反凶作吉，呼鬼為官，倒食為喜神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"却以日生為順。六般陰命，男犯禄鬼倒食，須取日主，反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"凶作吉，餘並同前，却以夜生為順。女人皆反此求之。此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"晝夜氣象，是陰陽配合，剛柔體用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"136","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命五行，下生上曰助氣，主一生自享其福；上生下曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506589983522826"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"盗氣，主一生供人之福。上尅下曰順，主有威勢而制人；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"下尅上曰逆，主多沉滯而難發。死絶尤𦂳，生旺差慢。四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"柱納音鬼多，主本當時，名曰官星乘旺。納音財多，主本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"無氣，名曰財多害身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命五行，貴陰陽相等。如兩金見兩木，或兩火兩土兩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"水之類，各自成象方吉。若太過不及，如三水一木，一水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"三木等類，俱不為福。假令金人三金一木，金尅木為財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"三金争一木，是分擘其福，多主財物不遂。若一金三火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506603275304996"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"火多金少，煎熬太過，主一生不閒。又如甲人逢三壬三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"己，謂之三吞三偶，主不吉。若逢兩己兩庚，謂之重偶重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"傷，視三尤凶，不貧即夭，餘以例推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"150","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"凡㸔命傷官，見官而早死。七煞見財，夭亡。財逢刼盡死，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"重財破印凶。水盛木流，終為外鬼。食神逢梟，死於牢獄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"刼重見財死，煞旺掛根休。亡神七煞衝刑，非徒流亦亡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"縲絏。傷官羊刃重併，雖全體而死血光。財星見刃，財散","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":162,"lineType":1,"content":"人亡。生旺死於庫墓，庫墓絶於生旺。晚有吉運行，凶運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506585365446665"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"未入，死卒何分；有凶運來，吉運未來，發福曷論。當究進","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"氣退氣之由，更審已發未發之義。將來而速進，㓛畢以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"先歸。一生嵗運皆凶，年少早死。末旬命星得地，老壽彌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"髙。老怕生旺，少嫌死絶。羊刃逢生多惡死，有根煞旺定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"凶終。春旺火多宜西北，庫是歸期；夏熒金旺利東南，鬼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"鄉夀地。四刃星重，死在正財之下；一官貴淺，終於陽刃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"之中。四柱俱傷人自死，金神入水溺為灾。羊刃倒戈，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"頭之鬼；煞星叠刃，半體之徒。制伏中和，煞極全而氣死；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506577790746660"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"生扶太過，印更旺而身終傷。官入墓死，晚局最宜。觀陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"生而陰死，陰死而陽生。煞逢三合，太過必傾。五行之内，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"宜細消詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"168","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"凡㸔命五行，太過不及，固不為福，中間亦微不同。如水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"土不嫌死絶。以盈天地間皆水土，無分四時，豈有死絶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":180,"lineType":1,"content":"之理？但辨輕重，如㸃水滴衆土之中則乾，撮土壅衆水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"之中則散。當論多寡，分重輕也。金非土不生，木非水不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"長，故金木欲其生旺，怕見死絶。如金死則沉，木死則灰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506603275239460"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"與水土不同。火藏於木，宿於土，故不欲旺，旺則焚；亦不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"欲死，死則滅。惟得其平則佳。五行水土均賴，凡木金火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"之命，尤為要也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"177","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"凡五行取象，本象取本象，如甲乙丙丁，木火象之類。化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"象取化象，如戊癸丁壬，亦木火象之類。金水象不可見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"土，謂土雑水混，金自不清，嵗運遇土亦滯。惟金水不雑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"生於秋月最貴。如明神宗癸亥、辛酉、癸亥、辛酉，干支俱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"金水不雑。水生金月，金助水清，二水二金成象，所謂金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506589983571978"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"白水清，别無夾雜，又合兩干不雑，所以尊為天子。如癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"酉、癸亥、庚子、辛巳，金生水月，金反泄氣，沉於亥子之中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"所以不免水厄。金土象不可見木，謂木尅土，則土不能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":198,"lineType":1,"content":"生金，不成象也。土積成金，土多金少，其福厚實；金重土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"輕，福出艱辛。金火象不可見水。見水則火滅金沉，不能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"成器。金重火輕，發遲益壽；金輕火重，發早退速，或主夀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"虧。金木象不宜見火。生木畏金，見火成秀。死木得金，方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"成造化。金重木輕，令人骨痛；木重金輕，主損錢財，或肺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506598837518355"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"疾相攻。惟金木相宜則吉。水木象秀而清高，不可見卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"巳。以水死絶。木火象秀而豐富，不可見金。以木受尅，流","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"年遇之俱災。水火象成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"既濟","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_4","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"最妙，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"未濟","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_5","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"亦得，不可見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"土。火多性燥，水多眼疾。火怕死，水怕浴。入酉火死，水浴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"主艱難而死。嵗運同此象，日時忌之。水土象不可見火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"土重水輕，秀而不實；水重土輕，却有科名。火土象不可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"見水。火虛土聚，不成物。若同水流，主汨沒。如戊子、戊午、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑、己未、丁巳、丁亥、丙辰、丙戌，丙丁與戊己相夾，乃火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506606236385332"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"虛土聚。李九萬以戊子、己丑、戊午、己未、丙辰、丁巳、丙戌、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":216,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥，皆火土夾雑之象，不可以連珠為貴。時上逢壬癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"水，土滯火滅，平生蹇薄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":217,"lineType":2,"content":"又云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"火，火見土則暗，土，土見火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"則虛，土輕火重則燥，己卯日見丙寅時是也。火輕土重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"不明，丁酉日見戊申時是也。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":219,"lineType":2,"content":"韓學士。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌、丁巳、戊戌、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳，火土成象，又為鳯凰干支格，故貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":220,"lineType":2,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_6","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":220,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"金水多清，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"金、土多厚，以其相生。金、火多剛，金、木多正，以其相尅。火、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"土多毒，火、木多聰，火、水多昧，火金多烈，木、火文彩，木、水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506606236368948"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"清竒，木、金方直，木、土毒害，水、火智慧，水、木智仁，水、金秀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"麗，水、土重濁，各以五行之性推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"223","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命怕同類相破，如己未見甲辰，甲辰見己丑，己丑見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌，甲戌見己未。凡在四衝之地，納音同類，逐両位逆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"數之，寅申、巳亥、子午、卯、酉，亦以此取。主平生不足，多不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"成器。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":230,"lineType":2,"content":"道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":230,"lineType":2,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_7","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":230,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"井欄互破，無藥可醫，遇空亡，庶㡬嵗運，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"忌之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"232","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命主本逢嵗運，不可遇死地。如丙寅火，畏乙卯水；辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506624003276851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"巳金，畏丁酉火；甲申水，畏己卯土；戊申土畏壬午木，己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"亥木畏甲子金，與人生怕死同義，主本生死同途，則不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命最怕鬼尅，而窠鬼最毒。如丙子水見庚子土，丁丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"水見辛丑土之類，窠中就位相尅，所以最毒。有墓中鬼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"如壬辰水見丙辰土，丙辰土見戊辰木之類。有隔壁鬼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚子土見癸丑木之類。有空亡鬼，如甲戌見甲申乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"酉之類。皆主為害。内墓鬼輕於窠鬼，壁鬼輕於墓鬼，空","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506616231231542"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼輕於壁鬼。若木命人，得火月金日時之類，有火尅金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"金不得傷木，是禦鬼也，鬼不為害。如水命人，四柱有火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"土，土尅水，火又生土，是助鬼也，其鬼尤凶。干支通用，納","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"音最𦂳，禦鬼則立身於艱難，助鬼則骨肉多生乎破鬬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"若鬼中有鬼，謂之鬼嘯。如土命人，生木月金日時之類，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"以木尅土，金尅木，根基劣弱，則凶。主本强健，不忌。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":250,"lineType":2,"content":"一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":251,"lineType":2,"content":"命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"己未、乙亥、丙寅、辛卯，逢三合生，更遇寅卯，為己入官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":252,"lineType":1,"content":"鄉，丙與辛合，大貴，奈己隂土，逢乙木作鬼，又遇辛作乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506606236401716"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"木之鬼，變寅卯之官作己土鬼，在亥卯未三合位，通是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼尅，犯鬼嘯也，故主惡死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":256,"lineType":2,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_8","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":256,"lineType":2,"content":"曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"五行切忌下賊上，平生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"不足事相縈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":257,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼嘯分明格局惡，更加刑煞禍不差。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"縱使以前逢富貴，定知日後厭年華。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"263","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"凡㸔命，取胎生旺庫為四貴，死絶病敗為四忌，餘為四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"平。以太嵗干為主，配於五行，取四貴四平、四忌之位，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"分貴賤，遇貴多則貴，遇賤多則賤，四貴之中，又分四旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"庫為上，胎為次。若人命胎月日時遇三貴干皆有輔，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506591501631540"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"正禄正官正印，三公命也。帶正天乙，如丑未生人，月日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"時得甲戊庚之類。帶本家禄，如寅生人，月日時帶甲之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"類。謂之福會。或天乙貴合両重者，亦三公命也。三貴上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"帶上下合，或一官一印，及一正天乙，或一位本家禄，三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"両位貴人合者，宰輔命也。若日時上遇兩貴，而帶上件","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"者，亦然。若一位上遇災煞地煞亡刼羊刃等神，兼主兵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"權、司馬、節鉞之貴。若胎月生月與日時上遇胎庫一貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"却帶正天乙上下合，或天乙貴合本家禄，正官正印本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506603275255844"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"家禄，但有氣，或貴人上亦帶前件禄干者，亦宰輔九卿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"命也。若月在忌神而日遇貴，或日在忌神而時遇貴，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"害為清華侍從之職。若日月俱在貴而時遇忌神，此常","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"調選人也。四忌主貧賤，亦有輕重，死敗絶為重，病為輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"五行各三位，如寅午戌火，丙丁人遇之為貴，與四貴三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"位同，惟闕胎貴一位，其主貴之福，亦與四貴同。陽禄貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"在臨官，隂禄貴在帝旺，若陽禄遇旺，隂禄遇官，雖為本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"位，其福减半。若旺而無禄，如丙寅得戊午日時，更尅本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506591501647924"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"命，又帶刑煞，主淫浪愚賤。有遇一兩位貴，却為凶煞刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"害，破得深重，亦主無禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":286,"lineType":2,"content":"沈芝云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"五行以生旺為君，臨官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"為相，若納音是木月日時遇寅卯両位，金遇申酉，水遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子，火遇巳午，土遇辰戌丑未，皆以貴論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"凡㸔命分五行，生旺死絶，如甲申、丙寅、己亥、辛巳、戊申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"皆五行自長生，不論四時，超然得自生之理。人命稟之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"敏快髙明，貴者得之，其進以漸，富者得之，亦將回榮，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"得其所以生也。丙子、戊午、辛卯、癸酉、庚子，皆五行自旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506616231247926"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"不待四時，而能自致其旺，福力奮發，無與比擬。癸未、壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、丙辰、甲戌、乙丑，皆五行自墓，乃歸根復命之時。凡庫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"之所在，必欲物聚之，則其庫充。如壬辰水，欲得衆水交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"歸，然後為旺。更有金往來相生，當得重權。倘水制火，火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"制金，更天中臨之，是為負印不起，主貧賤。乙卯、丁酉、壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"午、甲子、己卯，此五行自死者也。生則勞，死則息，其理自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"然。不有死之地，其物無自而歸。所謂自死者，得其真歸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"之理焉。凡命遇此，頴特高明，多慧少福，以静默為體，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506591501680692"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"不利有為，以淡薄為事而不利興起，惟可學道訪仙，超","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"生死之門也。癸巳、乙亥、庚申、壬寅、丁巳，此五行自絶者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"也。天之道無可絶焉。干支適㑹已，絶則更生。凡遇此者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"憂喜未定。如癸巳絶水，得癸酉旺金扶之，是謂絶水逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"生，尤為吉慶。凡命帶上死絶生旺庫墓等，不可就以所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"帶言之，須㸔月令以辨清濁。清者有制伏之謂，如水病","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"見土則濁，却非土隄防，則不能止息。旣止息，則清之有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"漸也。濁者無制伏之謂，如水多無土，則泛濫無歸，而水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506614620684288"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"極生木，極則變，變則通也。盖五行尚其變而不尚其常，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"貴其隐而不貴其顯。死絶有救，則為還魂，多以貴論。生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"旺有尅，則為散氣，反主福淺。若夫彼我之相生，順則益","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"本，逆則奪氣。彼此之相尅，順則勢强，逆則有傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":318,"lineType":2,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_9","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":318,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"小凌大，自貽其害。以弱勝强，自掇其殃。一水尅三火，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"以弱勝强。以隂勝陽，雖殃不彰。以陽勝隂，為害不深。兩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"陽相梗，凶禍旋至。兩隂相敵，不安其處。如乙巳火尅壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"申金，是以陰勝陽。壬申金尅己巳木，是以陽勝隂。隂陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506585365512201"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"有情，故無大害。若丁卯見癸酉，是二隂相敵。戊午見甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"子，是兩陽相拒。陽剛隂柔，必勝而後已，故禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":326,"lineType":2,"content":"太乙云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"地隂陽變化之機，未嘗不以陰召陽，陽召隂，則天地合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"正，五行氣融。若乃陽從乎陽，陰從乎隂，則隂陽偏出，動","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"静失序，所以禍福兩途也。大抵隂陽偏出造化，不成五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"行。如火多金少，聚散不得成形。火少金多，既不能銷鑠，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"反有煙㓕之患。餘例推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"336","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"凡㸔命，先論五行體面局勢，然後參以喜忌好惡旺相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506598837567507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"休囚。如金人得庚辛或申酉為體面，得己酉丑三合為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"局勢。喜火制土扶，忌金寒水冷。生三秋四季為旺相，春","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"夏為休囚。餘木火水土以例推之。金人遇庚申辛酉，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"五離煞。若生秋月，逢水則化金之毒，為金白水清造化；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"逢火則制金之剛，為煆成鋒利之器柱無火無水，是謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"頑金，主早年酒色，瘵痢身死。若得戊寅日，時剛處逢生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"主富而夀。木人得土，則根荄藉以栽培；得水，則枝葉賴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"以條暢；得金斵削，便成材也。木逢寅卯，更在春生最吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506603275321380"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"若三合㑹，木局全，不須春生，多主仁夀。木逢金制，金煆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"火伏，則剛柔相制。若火太多則焚，金太多則損，土虚則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"不能培，水泛則不能潤，妙在得其中和。水人以亥子為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"源，以寅卯辰巳為納，千源自北，萬折朝東，故水人喜逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"東方，則浪息波平。水賴土防，若生亥子，土多則吉，既在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"東方，逢土亦吉。不宜土多，更有貴人財禄則貴。若日時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"遇庚申辛酉，水忌西流，恐夀不髙。生於秋冬，生旺清澄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸此時而逢亥子，主有文學。納音更水，則水太過，柱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506598837600275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"無土隄，乃少子之斷，惟藝術空門則吉。更隔角重逢，定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"主刑尅。春月乾渇而涸，夏月渾濁而泛，柱無水助，則不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。火居寅卯，生於春月，木秀火明，榮華富貴；生於夏月，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"則太炎，柱中無水定夭，有水早貴。生於秋月，火死金成，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"藏光内照，時日微逢旺氣則吉。盖水火不嫌死絶，只宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":360,"lineType":1,"content":"恬淡為福。生於冬月，柱中再得火助，則潜消霜雪，温煖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"山河。古人云冬日可愛，夏日可畏，此之謂也。土逢四季","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"全上貴，如納音全土，柱中更得寅字為艮山，亦貴。土能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506624003309619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"厚載，萬物資生，金木水火，皆不可缺，故此四行，咸賴之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"也。夫論五行之用，多則太過，少則不及。其氣其數，有餘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"不足，皆能致凶。抑揚歸中，然後為福。功成者宜於退藏，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"將來者貴於榮振。五行稟旺，謂之成功，旺而能止息，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"謂退藏。五行在冠帶胎養之地，其氣虧而未盈，是謂將","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"來。故欲子母相生，以益其氣，則有榮進振發之道。如木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"非其時，衰則梗介，死則枯槁。金旺太過，則動作多凶。炎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"炎者貴乎熄，不熄則有自焚之灾。滔滔者貴乎止，不止","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506614620700672"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"則有自溺之患。火行南陸而化熱盛，則焚烈而害物。至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"酉亥，則隂能翕之，然後能温煖萬物。水行北陸而化寒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"盛，則嚴冷而殺物。至卯巳，則陽能闢之，然後能滋生萬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":378,"lineType":1,"content":"物。又有生而不生，旺而不旺，此為凶，乃先吉也。有死而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"不死，絶而不絶，此為吉，乃先凶也。如水見戊申土，此生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"而不生；見庚子土，旺而不旺，遇此多成而反敗，因喜而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"反憂。如水見癸卯金，此死而不死。見辛巳金，此絶而不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"絶。五行氣盡，而得父母之徳，以生益之，則其氣復生，遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506603275337764"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"之者危中有福，窮而通，屈而伸也。生旺太過，則福中藏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"禍。死絶太過，則福無可托。若夫死絶逢生，殃變能逃。火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"土最先，金水猶後。火絶得土曰睿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":387,"lineType":2,"content":"火，以土為子。火絶於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":388,"lineType":2,"content":"亥而見丁亥是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"土絶得金，死而不亡，曰歸魂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":388,"lineType":2,"content":"土絶于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":389,"lineType":2,"content":"巳，而得丁巳土是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"金絶得水曰繼體。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":389,"lineType":2,"content":"金絶於寅，得壬寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":390,"lineType":2,"content":"金是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"水絶得木，魂復天遊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":390,"lineType":2,"content":"水絶於巳，得己巳木是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"木絶得火，火出木燼，灰飛煙㓕，故獨為凶。蛇馬無膽，於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"焉足證。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":392,"lineType":2,"content":"木絶於申，得丙申火是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇馬在位巳午，木厯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506624003326003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"巳午而死。木於臟屬肝，於腑屬膽，證木死為凶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":395,"lineType":2,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_10","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":395,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"身土遇火，生而漸利。命水得金，年乃優長。金多須火，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"從革以成名。木重得金，揉曲直而任使。水流不止，須土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"以擁之。火盛無依，惟水以濟之。五行用得其宜，雖相尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"而為福。若用失其宜，雖相生而為灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"408","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"凡五行過多而相忤，如禄多則貧，馬多則病，印多則孤，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"庫多則閉，生旺多無歸宿，死絶多無激揚。五行不可太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"相安，不可太純粹。貴人馬多升擢，常人馬多奔馳。破要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506606236450868"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"傷禍，空要空盡。所愛者不可毁，所畏者不可旺。先畏後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"愛為福，先愛後畏為祸。合多不發而媚，學堂多則無成，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人多則巽懦而無立志。禄馬太顯，不可以貴人論。貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"人表裏足，不可以常人論。四柱俱陽，口惡心善，四柱俱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"陰，狠戾沉毒。拱要拱馬拱禄拱貴拱福神，不要拱刑拱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"祸拱嵗拱時，隂陽貴在均恊，病傷要有尅制。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命丙辛壬癸，見戊戌則戊土當塗，刃傷折挫。壬子、丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"午、丙午、壬子，水木精神，陰陽純粹，餘位無助，亦非常器，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506585365528585"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"加以季秀之氣，則曠世無忌，大徳有容，乃丈夫也。卯酉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"日出入之地，子午陰陽始分之宫，遇之者令人往來不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"定，嵗運亦然。巳亥為兩極之地，地天斡旋，寅申為三停","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"之方，郵逓往來，如人遇之，多不執一。丑未遲遲，辰戌速","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"速，遇之令人執方，性不通變。辰戌有氣，却能建立大事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子人四柱有壬寅，是壬入丙，家就破，不美。庚子見庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"午，是五鬼臨門。戊寅見甲寅，甲尅其戊，戊寅随勢尅甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，是支干納音上下不和，除别有福神，方為福力。癸酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506606236467252"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"見戊寅，戊土尅癸水，又金氣向絶鄉，刼煞元辰居中，除","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"得月令中秀氣，方可為用，亦久而不佳。庚午、丁酉，互旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"互破，乃旺中破也，不可全為福力。己未、辛酉，雖得食，却","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"歸死地，終久不佳。乙丑、乙未、庚辰、庚戌見戊寅，大好運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"亦然，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":429,"lineType":2,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_11","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":429,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"如得庚金濟戊寅，欲絶不絶成福力。乙卯見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅，戊寅見乙卯，是大好命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":430,"lineType":2,"content":"丹陽書","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_12","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":430,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"三奇之際，尚有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"虛聲，死絶之中，尤存生旺。盖三合三竒，不合月分，則不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":432,"lineType":1,"content":"貴。如甲戊庚有子午時方貴，乙丙丁有寅卯時方貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":432,"lineType":2,"content":"天","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_13","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"p pe":1,"content":"房庶出，將來子孫必有過房庶出随母之子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":442,"lineType":2,"content":"古詩云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506604596346906"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"合與三竒，清秀更饒肥。不爲過房子，便是随母兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命前五辰爲宅舎，若遇有氣及吉神臨之，主有好宅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"門閥崇峻，子孫華顯。假令甲申人宅舎在丑，十二月生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"得天乙臨宅爲吉。若居無氣及凶神臨之，主其宅虛耗，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"破壞不完，祖業不守。假令庚午人宅舎在亥，甲子旬亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":450,"lineType":1,"content":"落空亡，又遇刼煞臨之爲凶。餘准此。推命後一辰為破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"宅煞，若在破宅煞中，主無父祖産業，或客死他鄉。又㸔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"宅納音與本命納音相生，則吉。宅尅身，得好宅，身尅宅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506598837633043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"必破散。假令甲子金以己巳木為宅，二月生，雖係宅旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"合有好宅，以身尅宅，後當破落。戊午
