{"lines":[{"lineId":"484","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命後五辰爲田園，若居有氣之鄉，又福神臨之，主田","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"園盈野，倉庫充實。假令甲子人田園在未六月生，土乘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":468,"lineType":1,"content":"旺氣，又逢天乙貴為吉。若遇無氣之鄉，又凶神臨之，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"田園瘠薄，倉庫空虛。假令戊子人田園在癸未六月生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申旬未落空亡。餘准此例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":471,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼谷遺文","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_14","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":471,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"馬無害，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":471,"lineType":2,"content":"刑破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"禄無鬼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":471,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"食無亡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":471,"lineType":2,"content":"空亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"支合無元，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":472,"lineType":2,"content":"元辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"干合無厄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":472,"lineType":2,"content":"六厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"旺無䘮，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":472,"lineType":2,"content":"䘮門。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"衰無弔，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":472,"lineType":2,"content":"弔客。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"妻無刃，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":472,"lineType":2,"content":"羊刃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"財無飛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506606236500020"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"飛亷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"孟無孤，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"孤辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"季無寡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"寡宿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"體重須鬼，禄重須官，夫須尠，妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"須倍，吉須顯然，凶須沉昧，支干太和而塞，夫婦失時而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"凶。四柱主本，禄馬往來，須分建破，天乙扶持，将徳是衝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"更辨尊卑。有根而無苗，實貧而尚可甘食。本氣絶而花","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"繁，縱子成而味拙。至若貴神當位，諸煞伏藏，三元旺相，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"豈專神煞。命中用煞，以五行為本。如五行得地，無貴煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"而亦貴，雖有惡煞，無害於事。若五行不得地，縱有吉煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"亦發不久，如冬月中花耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506591501729844"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"納音者，天地之舞數也。驛馬學堂，居長生之位。才能官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":486,"lineType":1,"content":"職，在旺相之鄉。文章富貴，處印庫之地。如逢衰敗，則减","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"三分之一。更遇死絶，則去十分之半。切忌空亡衝尅，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"宜刑害吞食。故同源相成，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":488,"lineType":2,"content":"順數為上，雜數次之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"則天地舞全，基本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"强壯。同類相傷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":489,"lineType":2,"content":"如丁未刑丁丑之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"則支神氣散，理無復合。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":489,"lineType":2,"content":"管輅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":490,"lineType":2,"content":"曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"五行互旺，雖衝氣完。五行相尅，雖合氣散，此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":491,"lineType":2,"content":"或問。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"人生有始終㓛名富貴，有一旦崛起，忽然驟興。有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"始終剥落，而中間奮發。有半世淹蹇，而晚年成就。其故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506624003391539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":495,"lineType":2,"content":"荅曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"莫非命也。其始終富貴，乃柱中身主專旺，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"所用吉神，或官印財食，俱各帶禄得令，不偏不黨，無刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"衝尅害，出門行運，歩歩皆吉，故能成材，能振耀，紹前人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"之基業，立當代之功名，不招䜛謗，不致傷害，保其終始，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"是命運生旺，體用俱得故也。其一旦崛起，忽然驟興，繇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"柱中所用貴神，悉皆得位乘旺，又且合格，奈日主無力，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"不能勝任其福，所以勞困偃蹇，倐逢好運生扶日干，得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"其强健元命用神方爲我用，我因乘之虎嘯風生，大發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506604596396058"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴，是偏氣乘和，衰以遇旺，故迎吉而發，前後迥異。亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"有日主强旺，五行煞純不雜，奈根本原無制伏，富貴不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"成，惟待運來制伏煞神，化為權柄，功名顯達，出類超羣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"制神力旺，發福非常，所以驟興，繇貧賤而至極品，全繇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"行運得地，方見其興，如運不至，即常人耳。其始終奮發，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"而中間剥落者，乃柱中日主健旺，用神亦旺，各相力停，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"為富室朱門之賢子，及其長大成立，要逢好曜。若大運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"加臨元命，見其財而奪之，因其官而傷之，臨其印而壞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506604596543514"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"之，逢其食而梟之，遭際此運，禍不勝言，所以盛年見傾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"而不發。如其惡運一去，又逢好運扶持，使用神一新，譬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"如枯苗得雨，勃然而興，鴻毛遇風，飄然而舉，不可禦也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"若半世淹蹇，晚年成就，乃四柱身强，羊刃比肩，又各争","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，惟財官煞神等物，虛浮輕少，無力而成功名。出門行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"運，又非作福之地，所以一生饑寒，勞苦剥落，直至晚年，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":521,"lineType":1,"content":"頓逢好運，補起財官煞神等物，假煞為權，制伏羊刄，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":522,"lineType":1,"content":"得權貴而顯揚，或起資財而發福，當随五行清濁，以其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506651870232614"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"所遇之運别之。嗟夫，窮通有命，富貴在天，孔子有是言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"也，豈人智力所能移易乎哉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":527,"lineType":2,"content":"或問。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"興亡生死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":527,"lineType":2,"content":"答曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"凡人命中有煞為用，煞神未制，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"爲白屋窮途之人，或作豪門卓犖之士。要逢制伏運，假","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"煞而興，切不可脱。制伏運一入財鄉，財能黨煞，再遇流","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"年，財煞助旺，併力為殃，身主孤寒尅害，輕則傾家徒流，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"重則刑棄其身。煞神併合，凶亡可畏，如此羊刃同論。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"有柱中月令正氣官星，為一生富貴，惟逢財印則利官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506624003375155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"星，喜財旺以生之，印旺以䕶之，故令其人能行仁布徳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"緯國經邦，權重爵髙。後煞神得位，嵗煞併臨，官化為鬼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"䘮身必矣。不行煞運，或行傷官運，又無印綬制之，傷官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"得地，貴禄遭傷，䘮妻尅子，剥職生灾，更遇流年黨他，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":539,"lineType":1,"content":"致身亡慘惡。如有高見明識，知進退存亡之機，而保其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"身者，不遭非横，亦自己惡疾而終。又有柱中所專用神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"無官煞氣，惟偏正財旺，財神當道，隐隐興隆，積財聚富，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"但少貴耳。再㸔行運何如，如逢官禄旺鄉，富貴雙全，設","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506630345113611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"有不幸，財神脱局，羊刃相逢，更遇流年衝合羊刃，財神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"盡傷，元命衰絶，羊刃生災，敗亡必矣。生死則以格局論，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"如印綬見財，行財運，又兼死絶，必入黄泉，柱有比肩，庶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"㡬有解。正官見煞及傷官，刑衝破害，嵗運相併，必死。正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"財偏財見比肩分奪，羊刃刼財，嵗運衝合，必死。傷官之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"格，財旺身弱，官煞重見，混雜衝刃，嵗運又見必死。制則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"傷殘，拱禄拱貴填實，又見官煞刼亡衝刃，嵗運重見，即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"死。日禄歸時，刑衝破害，見七煞官星空亡衝刃，必死。煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506591501762612"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"官大忌，嵗運相併必死。其餘諸格，並忌煞及填實，嵗運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"併臨必死。㑹諸凶神惡煞、勾絞元辰、亡神、刼煞、弔客、墓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"病、死宫諸煞，九死一生。財官太多身弱，元犯七煞身輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":558,"lineType":1,"content":"如丙丁日干年月時，庚辛加酉運，或庚辛年必死。甲乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"日干、庚辛月時夾雜，年運見庚辛必死。若有救則吉，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"救定凶。五行神煞，金多夭折，水盛飄流，木旺則夭，土多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"痴呆，火多愚頑。太過不及，作此論，一不可拘，二須敢㫁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"求其生死，决定無疑。至若五行生死，如壬日生在二月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506598837649427"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"行申運即死，生在七月行卯運即死。乃遇生怕死，既死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"怕生，造化與人事一也，須並㸔之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"609","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"嘗謂人之生死年月日時俱皆前定，姑舉一二。如定興","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"張易，金嘉熈二年仲秋，以兒婦馬睦閣臨盆，乞靈寳泉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"寺，當境神夢金狗、玉雞、黄羊、青犬次第而至。逮生勇九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"淮王，則戊戌辛酉己未甲戌八字果應。淮王雲孫壅七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"公相亦占胤於江文通祠，夢始出疲赤犬，再見肥黄狗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"在路傍，及白馬立平地木左，復覩赭猪聮咬犬尾入屋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506614620749824"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"上。土公相自忖度，乃丙戌戊戌庚午丁亥年月日時，成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"化嵗次暮秋朔後夜半，甫生子，果驗。又元文式五師生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"大徳丁未嵗正月十七日壬午申時，至明洪武己未元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"旦，夢中得黄羊，觸數七十有三，至斯際果逝。其子式敬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"籌六老，夢數白兎入内姜沉閨懷。及順帝十一年仲春","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰昧爽産淑正，求二者，四柱皆辛卯。后人有記云：厯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"周追憶古人心，仰止髙山直到今。睆兎兩雙生夢兆，四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"重辛卯又逢隂。又白雞銀䑕應辛酉庚子之祥，白雞在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506651870248998"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"酉，值太嵗不起之兆。由上數事觀之，人之生死信前定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"矣哉！若尹子常夢巳達午，厄寅㓕，後見蛇入穴，得金墜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"馬虎嚙，皆符孝介經三叟夢達逵，逢乙巳對局，至成化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"三十一年，遇是干支登耋夀，四月望日進宜義郎秩。孫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"幹父亦同前夢，後復以正徳四年乙巳仲夏，遂陞衛侯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"又古人祈夢，問子孫於土地神，得詩云：犬羊父母青龍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"子，赤馬黄駒與白雞。孫虎曾同翁屬肖，丙隆一氣應多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"齊。解者以其伯子生甲辰，仲子生丙午，叔子生戊午，季","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506614620766208"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"子生辛酉，長孫生寅，曾孫生丙戌，推筭皆驗。是一家祖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"父子孫，其生皆前定也。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"吉人祈祠社廟神示詩","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_15","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceT lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506629531435008"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"局中而可决。陰生四正時旺者身貴家榮，死絶墓衰類","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"傷干尤為不足。化氣入格不破，大顯貴者，十有八九；化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"氣失局有傷，論顯榮者，百無一二。最高最貴者居旺處，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"三位須要相扶；至賤至貧者居衰處，四柱難尋造化。元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"象在地支之中，配合在天干之内。象成旺用，皆生火土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"之中；四柱無傷，直列朝廷之上。支中畏懼，亦須聲譽。非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"貧運至衰鄉，必主灾咎。化成造化，各居於衰墓絶鄉；象","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"成雜局，遇合猶如不遇。夫行旺運，妻乃從夫；妻運扶持，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506598837731347"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"夫從妻論。己身臨鬼，須用天地之中；象旺象衰，要識榮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"枯貴賤。身衰鬼旺，應須肢體傷殘；身旺鬼衰，定作凶徒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"之命。鬼身皆衰，男必飄蓬，女作師尼。伏身潜匿，自居高","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"名。月氣相傷，此乃伏象。官鬼皆全，遐齡不遂。干中破敗，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"乃有技藝以随身；支乃生全，難仗六親而獨立。五行屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":630,"lineType":1,"content":"於其象，皆在十二支中。先分南北與東西，次㸔三合内","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"别認。詳六親者，從象而推之；審富貴者，官禄而兩説。有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"禄盛者，鰥寡孤獨；有官鬼者，殘疾夭夀。身如顯化，自身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506629531402240"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"無氣，本性全虧；假五行成象，平生窘迫，豈得祖宗之財？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"顯福顯盈，因犯别房父母。從象論，引用為氣化象，論天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"地相停，從中有貴有賤，化内有富有貧。從中貴顯，得時，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"而位列朝中，化内成局，運轉而成封帝側。從象衰，而至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"老驅驅，化象伏，而平生碌碌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":640,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"㸔子平之法，專論財官，以月上財官為𦂳要，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"694","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"發覺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"在於日時，要消詳於强弱。論財官不論格局，論格局不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"論財官，入格者非富即貴，不入格者非貧即夭。一格二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506616231297078"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"格，非卿即相；三格四格，財官不純，非刑卒多是九流。官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"怕傷，財怕刼，印綬見財，愈多愈灾。傷官見官，原有者重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"原無者輕，重者遷徙，輕者刑責。年上傷官，父母不全；月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"上傷官，兄弟不完。日上傷官，難爲妻妾。時上傷官，子孫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"無傳。嵗月傷官刼財，生於貧賤之家，或是庶出。日時傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"官刼財，傷損子孫，主無晚福。官煞混雜，為人好色多淫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"作事小巧寒賤。有財印者吉，無財印者凶。刼財敗財，心","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"高下賤，為人貪婪正財，月令勤儉慳吝。柱有刼刃比肩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506598837764115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"多者，刑父母，傷妻妾，不聚財。商賈須觀落地之財，宰相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"須㸔得時正禄。七煞梟重，走遍他鄉之客，傷官刼財，瞞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"心負賴之徒。重犯竒儀者貴，重犯亡刼者夭。七煞宜制，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"獨立為强，鬼中逢官，逼迫太甚。明煞合去，五行和氣春","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"風；暗煞合來，四柱刑傷害己。煞刃無制，女多産厄，男犯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content":"刑傷，二徳無破，女必賢良，男多忠孝。財官印食，定顯慈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"祥之徳，刼傷比梟，難逃寡惡之名。衝官無合，乃飄流之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":662,"lineType":1,"content":"徒；坐馬落空，是落魄之軰。月令逢衝，過房離祖，官印遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506623831343113"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"偏，庶出孽生。干頭滅烈，堪嗟伯牛之疾；時日衝刑，難免","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"卜商之泣。六虛臨於乙亥，孟浩然徒有文章；三才會於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰，石季倫恣情金玉。有文無印，賈誼屈於長沙。有印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"無文，李斯專於上蔡。刑多者，為人不義。合多者，疎背皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"親。合多主晦，衝多主凶。辰多好鬬，戌多好訟。辰戌魁罡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"多凶少吉。時日空亡，難為妻子。背駝驛馬，離别鄉土。混","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"雜官煞，奔走衣食。印綬遭傷，名利成敗。天厨逢梟，食禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"虧盈。傷官遇羊刃，刼財營食，終日區區。正官逢七煞，剥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506629531418624"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"傷，求生一世忙忙。財官招上貴之憐，煞傷慮小人之恥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"官無衝破，爵禄獨顯。財少傷刼，名利雙全。官印在刑囚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"之地，心亂身忙；日時在鬼墓之鄉，憂多樂少。福不福，恐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"吉還遭傷，成不成，是格中帶煞。財官兩旺兮，主持節鉞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"煞刃交顯兮，掌握兵權。官是扶身之本，官在長生須富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"學；財為養命之源，財逢旺處足錢帛。財官印綬三吉，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"可不逢；刼刃傷煞四凶，不可不畏。印臨天乙，受盛世之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"封。財藏官庫，畜希異之寳。三竒貴人見生時，館學清華","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506598837747731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"世所稀。貴人若逢禄馬來，設使金章未為足。官貴若逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"財官助，重犯竒儀須宰輔。不作蓬萊三島客，也須金殿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"玉階行。互禄互馬，共羡黑頭公相；帶刑帶破，終為白面","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"書生。有印無官，發不在迅速之内；有官無印，難求乎榮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"顯之名。財官帶印，積玉堆金，偏正逢財，倉盈庫滿。印綬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"錦鞍勒馬，官貴玉帶金魚。凶莫凶於羊刃，禍莫禍於傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"官。運逢羊刃刼敗，財物耗散。羊刃倘同生氣，閫外持權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官被合，妨妻害子，傷官帶刃，尅爺損娘。官藏煞見，定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506616231362614"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"招非横之灾；煞沒官明，當膺藩輔之柄，少樂多憂，官星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":696,"lineType":1,"content":"又帶刼財，骨肉分離，孤鸞再遇傷煞。三刑六害，衝擊者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"難得峥嶸；孤辰隔角重見者，多主貧夭。享用見成，出門","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":698,"lineType":1,"content":"便行財禄，一生寂寞，行運與命分岐，有官而不食禄，月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"上正官被傷。有財而不得享，柱内正財分奪。禄馬先逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"於生月，隂徳榮華。若日時再見財官，此乃遇而不遇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":701,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"四象之中，隐土而成；五行之内，干秀為榮。亥卯未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"滋榮甲乙，寅午戌聚福丙丁。壬癸喜生潤下。庚辛愛見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506591501844532"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"從革，戊己忻逢四季。水潤下兮文學貴顯；土稼穡兮富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"貴經商。春生甲乙，抱懷仁徳之心；夏遇丙丁，胷藏明辨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"之才。秋金兮性多剛毅，冬水兮智足權謀。木盛無金，雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"仁不成造化；火旺木衰，縱學難得貴顯。水多遇土，成堤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"岸之功；木盛逢金，作棟梁之美。水火相停成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"既濟","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_24","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"，土逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"木旺爲稼穡；金火氣均，煉出鋒鋩之器。五行造化，皆因","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼而成功。木敗不仁而妄作，金衰寡義亦無恩。火㓕無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"禮之軰，水濁失智之人。土遭木尅，言常失信；金鬼好殺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506591501828148"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"水盛多淫。日旺仍須自立，更詳上下吉凶。嵗月相扶，因","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"祖而發；時日相衝，妻子無功。衰墓平生孤立，生旺一世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"崢嶸。上下相合而無害，往來尅戰乃多憂。禄馬時尅日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"破，縱職位終須退剥；日旺時强聚秀，無福亦須横發。月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"為傷害時，得官財運自能成立。月遇絶傷時，對衝門戶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":720,"lineType":1,"content":"定有三遷。年逢衰地，㓜嵗艱難；月在旺鄉，晚年不足。時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"衰日秀，有始無終；月弱時强，晚年榮顯。元氣强旺，雖未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":722,"lineType":1,"content":"達，終顯功名基本。休囚，縱得地，難成富貴。若夫天元羸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506624003440691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"弱，命不再甦。忽值本主休囚，貧寒無地。氣旺遭傷，雖遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"險，終身有救。氣敗逢生，縱得地，一世無成。五行失地，休","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"言禄馬同鄉；四柱無歸，難論財官雙美。以日尅者為妻，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":728,"lineType":1,"content":"妻生者為子。考其生旺，定其死絶。時臨旺處必多兒，時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"在敗鄉必絶嗣。男逢兩位之財，必須置妾。若遇合處逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":730,"lineType":1,"content":"禄，定挾妻榮。財鄉見合，立身倚妻。陽干上下逢合，妻多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"易得。合中更遇生氣，妻妾賢良。四柱逓互相親，多生喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"慶。五行來往相傷，皆主不義。財失地而岐路經商，身旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506634157686796"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"甚則九流術業。火聚水徳相刑，爲僧反覆。水逢土旺相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"殘，為道無終。火明木秀，㓜年顯達朝廷。火炎水涸，終身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"求財市井。金白水清多顯達，鬼位逢官主困窮，財下見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":738,"lineType":1,"content":"財，富而慳吝。羊刃帶煞被刑，男子身遭鞭配。財盛刑傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"父母。鬼旺，後代昌榮。從化忌從返本，平生衰樂無寕。丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"辛化水到水鄉，位列朝廷。丁壬化木臨木位，身居宰輔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"東金西木不從化，一世虛名。離壬坎丙得位時，平生顯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"跡。用神敗衰，帶禄不能為福。禄馬氣旺，遇貴合主顯榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506630345146379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"有官無馬而職微，有馬無官而身賤。四柱生旺，雖無官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"禄亦長年；五行敗衰，縱帶禄馬終夭折。魁罡相逢衝尅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"多遭刑獄。建禄無財刑制定為奴婢。陽火死於墓絶，性","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":748,"lineType":1,"content":"兇頑多為酷吏。隂火生於長養，人豐厚當為富豪。五行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"忌沐浴逢傷，四柱喜生旺制煞，有害而姻親散失，遇戰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"而疾病纒身。木火忌逢申酉，灾病呻吟。衰金畏遇旺火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"苦形悲嘆。時臨鬼地，無制多貧；運至財官，無刑必發。七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":752,"lineType":1,"content":"煞羊刃，名位大顯。正印官星，刑衝乃禍。壬趨艮位，遇之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506616231378998"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"則發資財，變煞為官，㓜嵗功名顯達。戊日午月火多，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":756,"lineType":1,"content":"運喜官鄉。財官敗地，一世貧寒；三竒無傷，平生富貴。日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"雖建禄，不逢財官，主孤貧；日禄歸時，不遇財印亦難發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"時上偏財，運至兄弟之位，主妻灾；時上羊刃，嵗遇偏正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"之財，生凶禍。正官月上旺，富貴雙全；偏官時上逢，無情","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"有禍。財歸旺地，無破家道興隆；印綬生身，無傷門閥光","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"彩。有官無印，即非真官；有印無官，反成厚福。桃花帶合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":762,"lineType":1,"content":"風流儒雅之人；五湖雲擾，餓於首陽之客。干刑支合，樂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506624003457075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"變為憂；干合支刑，喜中不美。若不九流僧道，定須重拜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"爺娘。墓時雜氣，逢局鑰，始得顯榮；羊刃金神，遇七煞必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"為大貴。雙辰夾角，偏生庶出之人；寡宿孤辰，異姓同居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":768,"lineType":1,"content":"之子。壬水騎龍，逢辰多少登天府；乙木捕䑕，遇子多早","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"歩蟾宫。日禄歸時，沒官星錦鞍綉轡。月生日干，無財氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":770,"lineType":1,"content":"玉帶金魚。六隂朝陽，逢季月，只作印㸔。六壬趨艮，逢亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"月，當以貧論。格局無破無刑，名利成就。官印有傷有損，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":772,"lineType":1,"content":"爵位虧停。妻宫羸弱，犯刼財必損其妻。兄弟位柔，見官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506651870314534"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"强必傷昆季。天元羸弱，失時，難獲延年。日主高强，化鬼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"當膺厚福。日旺無依，離祖遷居，若不遷居，死在外地。日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"旺無依，損財傷妻，若不傷妻，外家冷落。正官被合，平生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":778,"lineType":1,"content":"名利皆虛。七煞被合，處世反凶為吉。煞旺更值身衰，衣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"食奔走。官柔又遇煞擾，行藏汨沒。財旺身强，資財疉積。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"假如甲辰甲戌落寅亥，金帛滿屋。丁亥、丁卯到酉亥，珍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"寳盈室。六甲日遇庚辛，若重多，必主災厄。六丙身居亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"子，無制伏，定是貧儒。行運得失，更當詳察。得地失時，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506623831457801"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"田疇得雨。得時失地，如輗損塗泥。得時者，亦能舉躍，失","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"地者難以升遷。故火到南方而榮，水臨北地而盛，土到","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"東而病，木至西而衰，金入北而沉。旺處生而死處滅，死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"處生而旺處脱。嵗運俱傷，日主遇之，命必虧危。氣運與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"神氣傷殘，門户與父母俱損。運神尅嵗，刑訟來臨。嵗尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"運神，官災競起。金主刀刃刑傷，水主江河覆溺。木則懸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":791,"lineType":1,"content":"梁自縊，虎咬龍嗔；火則夜眠壓倒，焚死蛇傷。土乃墻推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":792,"lineType":1,"content":"土䧟。五行煞重，當如此詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506614620798976"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":795,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"有化而不化之繇，聚而不聚之機，合而不合之類，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"秀而不秀之實。化而不化損於貴，聚而不聚損於財，合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"而不合損於官，秀而不秀損於福。又有不化而化之因，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"不聚而聚之機，不合而合之理，不秀而秀之用。不化而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"化者，定居權貴；不聚而聚者，終於富足。不合而合者，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"遷高職。不秀而秀者，須享禄位。定四時有旺無旺，察五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"行有氣無氣。随物而變物，因類而求類。五行俱要中和，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"一物不可偏枯。水不勝火兮，奔波流蕩。火不勝金兮，困","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506629531500544"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"苦恓惶。三辛見丙兮，錢財破散。二壬見丁兮，家道興隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"有秀而無官者，但施巧於技藝；見財而無托者，惟遂志","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"於經商。甲居從革之方，風災困苦；金成潤下之局，萍梗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"他鄉。俱旺則從之所使，俱衰則變為他物。一鬼不能勝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"兩宫，一禄不能勝兩鬼。五行落在本鄉，不貴則富；四柱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":810,"lineType":1,"content":"臨於破地，非賤則貧。生旺為上，徳秀為竒。身坐學堂，文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"藝清高之客；命臨鬼禍，徒流盗賊之人。禄内隠刑，定操","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"兵㦸於戎位；刑中見尅，必主案牘於公門。鬼休母旺，錢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506616231395382"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"財奴馬多豐；鬼旺母衰，父母兄弟分散。官印兩全，秉旌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"旄而居武職；淑秀全偹，應科甲而入文銓。藏暗禄者，官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"居極品；遇真官者，禄位非常。十干臨死絶病衰，賤居塵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"土。五行在三竒庫墓，榮列縉紳；兩位鬼鄉逢倒食必為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"奴婢。一氣有歸遇墓月，定主孤貧。勾陳得位居辰巳，貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"列三台。元武當權逢亥子，官封一品。癸見庚申居右職，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"辛逢戊子中高科。隂水遇秀，失地者身為僧道。陽火無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"歸遇水兮，定作凶徒。金到火鄉，財多聚散；旺水入南，家","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506651870330918"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"道盈昌。庚居三冬，水冷金寒，得火相扶，莫作等閒。破禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":826,"lineType":1,"content":"則亡，氣絶則病。時臨鬼位更逢衝，傷危不誣。臨官復加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":827,"lineType":1,"content":"衰敗地，死絶無疑。最貴者，官星爲命，財得偏正為福；最","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":828,"lineType":1,"content":"凶者，七煞臨身，天赦二徳為祥。官星如遇比刼，雖官無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"貴；七煞若逢滋助，其煞愈凶。三合六合，嵗運合而必榮；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":830,"lineType":1,"content":"七官八官，月建官而為喜。四合四刑，刑合當明邪正；七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"衝八擊，衝擊喜得㑹藏。夾貴夾邱為暗㑹，財庫官庫要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"明衝。官星在生旺之方，逢則何須發見；印綬藏孟仲之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506616231411766"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"下，見而不用露形。印綬得刼財為貴，財元喜傷官為竒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官若見印綬，貴不可言；歸禄若遇食，傷，福無限妙。年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"日互有隂陽二刃，刑法重犯，官煞混逢，天月二徳，禄位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":838,"lineType":1,"content":"高遷。飛刃伏刃，㑹刃多凶。傷官剥官，見官為禍。羊刃若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"逢印綬，雖貴而殘疾在身。七煞無制，逢官為禍，而夀元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":840,"lineType":1,"content":"不久。三偏三正遇三竒，貴居一品之尊。四旺四生全四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"柱，福在衆人之上。煞化為印，早擢巍科。財旺生官，少受","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"貽澤。官煞同來，要知扶官扶煞，偏正相㑹，須知合正合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506623831441417"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":845,"lineType":1,"content":"偏。歸禄月逢羊刃，世事不明。金神運到水鄉，身屍分拆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":846,"lineType":1,"content":"暗中藏煞，須明月下用神見處無財，必受空中禍害。羊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"刃更兼㑹合，千里徒流。用財若遇刼奪，一生貧窘。人生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"前定，窮達已分，須要識其消長，亦當究其始終，當詳流","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"運之源，要察行年之位。身弱如逢七煞，運到制伏必傾；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺若逢福輕，運到衰敗必死。太嵗與命不和，有灾有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"病。四柱與嵗相生，無禍無殃。身弱徒然入格，雖發早亡；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"福輕若遇休囚，必然傾夭。是以用神不可妄求，形迹自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506623831425033"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"然發見。有福則當用彼，無時必是用身。禍害在於五門，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":856,"lineType":1,"content":"福榮存於運氣。福厚人所共同，如或傷原終困。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":857,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"絶不能取生下之財，衰不能敵旺中之鬼。逆制無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"情，順生可救。主無而本有，可救一半。日時俱逢二徳，百","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"事無凶；更值財官，定主豪富。主本有力，鬼可為官；本主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":860,"lineType":1,"content":"無氣，官來作鬼。刑衝之法，仔細推詳。有刑出刑入、刑吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"刑凶，有衝動衝不動、衝合衝不合之辨。衝衰必定動摇，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"來合有情，方為富貴。雜氣藏蓄，要定誰先誰後。提綱專","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506651870347302"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"用，須分氣淺氣深。一陽來復，木火用而水藏；一隂如生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":866,"lineType":1,"content":"火土盛而金伏。將來者進，遇之有功；成功者退，得之何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"益。月建財官印綬，時作分野歸元，或補其不足，或抑其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":868,"lineType":1,"content":"太過，要造化中和為吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":869,"lineType":2,"content":"又曰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"三元定命，先詳四柱有無；五行成格，次論命運强","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"弱。如身弱財旺，須假身强之鄉。若身旺禄衰，却喜禄生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"之地。印生為福，畏見財鄉，煞在柱中，煞不宜旺。命無財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"禄，運逢禄馬則災。原有傷官，再遇官鄉則禍。最忌者日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506630345179147"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"干衝運，所喜者，運干生於日干也。但㸔有情無情，合與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"不合，凶㑹吉㑹消詳。且如原有害刃，則骨肉殘傷；原有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"傷煞，地支死絶，加以運中禄馬俱弱，禍不旋踵。更以流","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗抑揚，禍福無有不准。若逢建禄之地，名為禄馬俱絶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"壽限難逃。内有禄絶而發，比肩而耗。氣有淺深，格有成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":880,"lineType":1,"content":"壞，不可執一推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"919","lineNum":882,"lineType":1,"content":"凡推究造化之理，其法以日為主，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506623831474185"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":885,"lineType":2,"content":"单提作體，要認為主者之端，為化氣，爲本體，入門便要通變，識得主干有本象，有化象，方可消詳。如甲即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":886,"lineType":2,"content":"本象是木，化象是上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"923","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"坐下支神，先求其意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":888,"lineType":2,"content":"乃日干坐下，首先㸔此地支與月支一位，時支一位，年支一位，刑衝破害，生尅比和，何如主干喜忌，何物","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":889,"lineType":2,"content":"得來，不可視爲泛常，不可顧盻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"926","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"月氣淺深，何者主權，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":891,"lineType":2,"content":"月建之下，氣候淺深，五行之氣，是何干神，正當此日天時之令，五日一候之氣。一云徳秀有無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"928","lineNum":892,"lineType":1,"content":"地支至切，黨盛爲强，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506629531533312"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":895,"lineType":2,"content":"地支乃四位支神，至切者，視天干爲尤切也。要㸔何者為主干之宅舍，何者為用神之基業，何者力輕，何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":896,"lineType":2,"content":"者力重。宅舎即得地之方，基業即乘貴之所。一㸔其力勢衝起，是何支神。二㸔其力勢拱起，是何支神。三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":897,"lineType":2,"content":"㸔其力勢刑起，是何支神。四㸔其力勢合起，是何支神。五㸔地支綂攝。此法是空中立有者也。論地支衝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":898,"lineType":2,"content":"拱刑合四件，極切門庭。一法只拿日干作主，取用中間，或吉神有刑衝，凶煞有拱合，其生旺休廢，交差不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":899,"lineType":2,"content":"一，難下手脚，不如只詳四個地支基址，五氣中何物最重，將來品量却能耗散何神，能生扶何神，能衝合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":900,"lineType":2,"content":"何神，能變化何神，然後却㸔日干屬何五氣，與其最重之氣綂攝何如，便拿財官等物，用神之氣，共前五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":901,"lineType":2,"content":"氣，引於時座，參較其物，何者輕，何者重，義理調順爲祥瑞，反則即為乖戾矣。如此已立定，然後㸔其支氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":902,"lineType":2,"content":"各有所喜所忌之端，不可不詳。五氣謂如木火土金水五者，須要各各記住題目。若五氣中，何者黨多為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506629531582464"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":905,"lineType":2,"content":"重？如支干内外明暗木多，則木氣黨盛矣。其喜忌已論，於前五行中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"940","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"專執用神，切詳喜忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":907,"lineType":2,"content":"專執一位用神，為尊長，為權神，為號令，爲本領，為倚托，此非小可。執而推之，未敢縱求其意。外取用神，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":908,"lineType":2,"content":"財，或官，或刃，或煞，或食，或貴，或印，或禄馬等件，各類例取，原無定法。其用神最忌損犯，兼怕分竊，不宜太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":909,"lineType":2,"content":"過與不及。如太過之物，本不好了，或嵗運又來生扶，即是傾覆壞了。如木則折，水則傾，土則崩，火則一發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":910,"lineType":2,"content":"而滅，金則折損。如不及之物，本不好了，或嵗運又來尅竊，壞盡此物，豈獨有禍？用神喜忌，至元至妙，後篇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":911,"lineType":2,"content":"别詳。務要得中和爲貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"946","lineNum":912,"lineType":1,"content":"氣氣切窮盡理物，物至極轉關，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506624003489843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":915,"lineType":2,"content":"金木水火土五氣，一陰一陽，共有十般消息，一件件要㸔衰旺、輕重、明晦、廣狹，窮則究理盡處，生何神，尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":916,"lineType":2,"content":"何神，刑何神，合何神之類。被壞之物，得生之物，主係何事。物物推將去，須要有依倚下落至無可奈何處，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":917,"lineType":2,"content":"便是轉闗。入何格調極處，一轉即是建㓛。圓活參透，却要定見下落，斷成器不成器何如？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"951","lineNum":918,"lineType":1,"content":"有氣者急，有情者切。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":919,"lineType":2,"content":"有氣乃當時也。㸔八字内外明暗干支，如六月中氣，大暑節，土金旺相有氣之類，此爲至急，餘則否。有情","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":920,"lineType":2,"content":"乃合氣也，如甲見己，丙見辛，丁見壬之類，中間干支，明暗有合，皆取此為最切也。一説非特合氣，有情吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":921,"lineType":2,"content":"神生我尅我，亦為有情；虛拱貴氣生我尅我，刑我合我，亦無異也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"955","lineNum":922,"lineType":1,"content":"年干綂攝，次㸔月時。時如權衡，分毫加减，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506614620864512"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":925,"lineType":2,"content":"㸔年干所乘何支，與我如何相攝爲切，亦要引在有氣貴地，體局方大。又㸔用神，却係嵗君，是何吉凶神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":926,"lineType":2,"content":"煞，若更用神與嵗君和，全貴無疑。次㸔月時二干之闗係，不可竟作差慢，不來扳攪。柱中象數變化，五氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":927,"lineType":2,"content":"真假，吉凶神煞，俱當引歸時座，細分輕重，分毫必須比較。  又云：太嵗，一年之領袖，諸神之主宰，極有用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":928,"lineType":2,"content":"處。只因徐子平以日爲主，專取財官，悞了後人多少，錯㑹了義。故曰：年如稱鈎，綰起其物；月如稱繫，提起","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":929,"lineType":2,"content":"綱紐；日如衡身，星兩不差；時如稱錘，輕重加减。其譬可謂切矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"962","lineNum":930,"lineType":1,"content":"随合仍𦂳，遥合不閒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":931,"lineType":2,"content":"随合如丙午氣壯，便知有辛未二字；如影随形，亦㸔辛未，還是我家恩人，却是讐人。遥合，即是支中所藏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":932,"lineType":2,"content":"之神，與彼所藏之氣合也，如申、卯、子、巳、亥、午等類，盖有其氣類，遥合事意，自不放間矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506616231477302"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":935,"lineType":1,"content":"體製須廣大，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":936,"lineType":2,"content":"凡八字要㸔氣象規模，體勢豁達，天地相停，雄健壯實。五氣順尅而有力，倒生逆化而有功。貴氣往來不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":937,"lineType":2,"content":"雜，必非尋常格調。又㸔八字大意體段。過於清，則或寒或薄；過於厚，則或濁或滯；過於華麗，則或輕或浮；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":938,"lineType":2,"content":"過於肆逸，則或流或蕩；過於有情，則或濫或淫；過於孤介，則獨立不能容物。過於剛勇，則或暴或燥，而無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":939,"lineType":2,"content":"涵養。過於柔懦，則或愚或鈍，而無作爲。過於執實，則拘局而只知有巳。過於軒豁，則圖謀廣而秀不能實。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":940,"lineType":1,"content":"字面分先後。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":941,"lineType":2,"content":"𦂳用字様，却逺在後，或被别字閑神占先隔了。若無傷犯，須得嵗運生扶，方爲全美。𦂳用字様，雖近且先，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":942,"lineType":2,"content":"却有閑神字様，逺處在後，動摇得切，妨碍。用神字様，却㸔柱内，何者可以勦除去得。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506629531615232"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"天干專論生尅制化，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":946,"lineType":2,"content":"生則相生，有生不欲生之理；尅則相尅，有尅不欲尅之情。制則如水尅火，而有土制其煞，火能復生之情；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":947,"lineType":2,"content":"化則水本尅火，見木能竊其氣，火轉得生之理。餘皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"978","lineNum":948,"lineType":1,"content":"地支專取刑衝破害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":949,"lineType":2,"content":"刑者如丑日戌時之類，則刑其出；如巳日寅時之類，則刑其歸。惡物宜刑去，好物喜刑歸。衝者，吉象宜衝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":950,"lineType":2,"content":"凶象貴氣宜衝我家破者，大槩破壞其物，中間有吉有凶。如卯破午，乃乙尅午，家巳土受破。若巳土爲煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":951,"lineType":2,"content":"地面有力，嵗運一露，其害無疑。若或不露，亦猶抱虎而眠。又㸔酉字有氣無氣，可能馭服否？又如己爲貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":952,"lineType":2,"content":"氣，露而有力有勢，則亦因破而來爲福。害者，六害之處，若帶忌神凶煞，來尅來竊，真為仇害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506651870412838"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"象成一家，不執貴氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":956,"lineType":2,"content":"人八字中全無財官等件貴氣，有安然奮發富貴者何？盖以相生之氣自立成象也。生意滔滔，有不盡之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":957,"lineType":2,"content":"情，高逺堅實如此。本象配本，如甲乙丙丁之類。化象配化，如戊癸丁壬之類。木火成象，火土成象，土金成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":958,"lineType":2,"content":"象，金水成象，水木成象，及有三象順序者，同此法，如火土金象之類。又有四象和恊生育者，亦然，如水木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":959,"lineType":2,"content":"火土之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"989","lineNum":960,"lineType":1,"content":"根源一氣生物滿盈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":961,"lineType":2,"content":"如金氣正臨天時建旺之序，既無尅竊其氣，一往據生其子者，水神也。水神既顯露於干，或泛濫於支，物","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":962,"lineType":2,"content":"盛不祥，還得㡬多火土能隄防倚賴哉？餘倣此。推則造化盈虧之道，灼然有憑，萬無一失也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506614620897280"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"八法關鍵，五氣開端，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":966,"lineType":2,"content":"八法已論於前。五氣有聚散、完缺、實虚、深淺、敵交、狹廣、輕重、厚薄、寒和之不同。干支俱有力，尅物歸窠，精","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":967,"lineType":2,"content":"神强健，爲聚，喜吉神，忌凶煞，亦要輔佐吉神。衝而無義，刑而不歸，爲散，宜凶煞，忌吉神。金木水火土俱全，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":968,"lineType":2,"content":"順序，爲氣完。五行欠一，以待嵗運補足，爲氣缺。實則如甲戌見丙寅之類，有合有生，局於一象，滯於一方，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":969,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中若無激揚昂藏之類，如此則不過一富翁而已。即有體無用，縱貴亦尸位素飡。如柱中土氣太重，畧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":970,"lineType":2,"content":"見官來即貴，餘倣此。虛則如土入酉寅，木臨乙巳，金到辰亥，水向卯戌，火居丑申，氣虛而不能確固，餘倣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":971,"lineType":2,"content":"此。氣深如木之本象、化象，近清明節。氣淺如木之本象、化象，方得雨水節之例。氣敵如辛酉見乙卯，大概","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":972,"lineType":2,"content":"凶甚。若見己未己丑，轉有憑藉，反吉。如無憑依，乂㸔賔主强弱，主弱則爲鬼象，賔弱則爲財象。交如丁巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506616231526454"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":975,"lineType":2,"content":"見辛亥，丙戌見己丑，庚辰見癸未之類，仍分何者氣旺而言。狹如用神局於一二支，神之情狹，亦有生旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":976,"lineType":2,"content":"引用處，其氣却來不得。廣則引用處，其氣來得生源處，仍有精神，通三合之氣，或通六合氣。輕如木之本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":977,"lineType":2,"content":"象、化象，却入金鄉，又非天時之類。重如木象逢寅卯，乃本象地支之類。薄如木象逢自家死絶之地面，仍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":978,"lineType":2,"content":"非天時之類。厚如木象逢庫墓長生之地，或得天時，或他干來助之類。寒如木枯、火散，金寒、水冷，土凍，天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":979,"lineType":2,"content":"干休囚，地支死絶之類。和則有合、有生、有情、有助，有臨官帝旺，無休廢死絶，或有旺相之神來扶助，或當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":980,"lineType":2,"content":"天時前後，有氣滿而盛，乃物無倚藉隄防者，不久而傾。有氣虧而衰，乃根本不實，仍未得時，氣亦不足，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":981,"lineType":2,"content":"無生扶，此等廢物，何可勝言。有氣衰而久，不得天時，又臨死敗，却有暗干相生，引歸生旺之鄉。有氣旺非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":982,"lineType":2,"content":"長，始則氣𦦨奮發，通舒自若，終則收斂歸藏去處，竟無依靠，易於散漫，盛意無源，殊乏轉生，乘勢無續。有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506629531631616"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":985,"lineType":2,"content":"氣嫩易摧，方來之氣，人皆以爲旺相之象，中間若逢頑厚之氣尅竊者，凶不可言。有氣過耐逺，過去氣候","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":986,"lineType":2,"content":"俱曰休廢，又云成功者退，殊不知餘氣忽被旺處資來，綰動生意，氣返實處，愈耐嵗寒，餘氣即休廢，别化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":987,"lineType":2,"content":"他象故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":988,"lineType":1,"content":"造物須原本體，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":989,"lineType":2,"content":"東方陽散以洩而生風，風生木。西方隂止以收而生燥，燥生金。南方陽極而生熱，熱生火。北方陰極而生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":990,"lineType":2,"content":"寒，寒生水；中央陰陽交而生濕，濕生土。五行體象淵源，已取論於前。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"器完由出根基。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":992,"lineType":2,"content":"凡成象處，是為噐完。凡貴氣歸一，亦為噐完。凡六親致一，我生即子，丙辛見木之類是也。一説妻生者即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506629531648000"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":995,"lineType":2,"content":"子。兩義在活法，而取各有理趣。生我者爲母，合我者爲妻，成其物象相備，亦六親所生，致一而成者也。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":996,"lineType":2,"content":"運中成象，葢由根基原有來意，則成矣。謂木火必無相停，各有輕重，為木重火輕，運上遇火干火支，凑完","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":997,"lineType":2,"content":"真象。若四枝中原帶火之臨官帝旺長生庫墓等字，方是器完。否則不真不實，不完不正，似是而非矣。餘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":998,"lineType":2,"content":"倣此義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"法如搜檢，各禀吉凶，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":1000,"lineType":2,"content":"時與日，月與年，干支八字，要縱横來往勾合，互相取用，不可有一處分毫照瞭不到。如四干乘四支，爲各","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":1001,"lineType":2,"content":"自占貴占煞。或年干乘月支，時支取貴。或年干取日支，日干取月支，月干取年支，有貴有煞。或嵗月二支，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":1002,"lineType":2,"content":"時日二支，自取干神貴氣。如此搜檢，庶不差悞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506616231493686"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"物須提豁，方明輕重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":1006,"lineType":2,"content":"此一段須要先㸔四支，一一將所藏干氣提豁出來，細推何者黨衆，何者力寡，何旺何弱，何輕何重，方明","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":1007,"lineType":2,"content":"得用神吉凶道理不去，一一提豁，大綱昏蔽，難以忖度。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":1007,"lineType":2,"content":"取舍","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_26","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":1007,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":1008,"lineType":1,"content":"榮而易枯，發身暫致；顯而不露，成物嵗寒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":1009,"lineType":2,"content":"凡脆虚浮嫩之氣，休廢敗絶之鄉，得支干夾扶，暫合而發於一時。倘遇嵗運，將贊助之神傷壞，或抑揚其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":1010,"lineType":2,"content":"無氣，則易敗而不長久，如物不顯露。用神有氣，合神成象，相乘一路，運中無破，則耐久逺。縱有嵗君，逐年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":1011,"lineType":2,"content":"駁雜，乃浮雲蔽日，樹影横陰而已，故不在露其干支中隱藏有氣，得生反遠大也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":1012,"lineType":1,"content":"奪胎換骨，意出自然。捨本逐末，原非真義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506623831506953"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":1015,"lineType":2,"content":"本象","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_27","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":1015,"lineType":2,"content":"如有財官貴神，又有别位通氣，有化，有象有類，引用却清，宜乘福地者，非勉强而行，氣類有感，必有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":1016,"lineType":2,"content":"所至也。欲化真象，如丁壬化木之類，萬一妬合争戰未成者，忽至運中，却資助本象具體，乘其本象，財官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":1017,"lineType":2,"content":"等貴，則棄其本象之真，逐其未節之氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":1018,"lineType":1,"content":"大器鎡基，自然遏惡而揚善。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":1019,"lineType":2,"content":"體局若大，本源若重，用神若專，兼帶貴人徳秀，雖有大耗元辰、刃煞等件，爲惡反能助威，則所謂遏惡而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":1020,"lineType":2,"content":"揚其善矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"薄才體局，方知害物更傷人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":1022,"lineType":2,"content":"嵗與日辰力虚薄，不專被吉凶神煞播弄，随氣動盪，精神被其所役，自家主張無定，多是凶煞象内刃煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506614620880896"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":1025,"lineType":2,"content":"亡刼、金刃白虎之類作爲，故非徳秀純厚之氣比也。建業立事，雖有偶成，豈不害物損人也哉！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":1026,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人禄馬交錯，勾絞元亡多端。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":1027,"lineType":2,"content":"貴氣不欲煩雜，用財只用財，用官只用官，如用禄馬、貴人、食神、印綬之類。只宜一件二件，貴氣便當輔佐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":1028,"lineType":2,"content":"如用財以官相輔，官印相承，禄馬兼行之類。三件四件泛濫，便不歸聚。又云：一件貴氣，須要貴人徳神以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":1029,"lineType":2,"content":"助，方可大顯。勾絞、刼煞、元辰、亡神等物，若貴氣重則助身行威，惡煞重則肆害酷切。一説以此等煞多端，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":1030,"lineType":2,"content":"獨宜消息。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
