{"lines":[{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506678709600275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":1565,"lineType":1,"content":"妻遇比肩旺奪，非是良人，財因沐浴强争，難辭淫濁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":1566,"lineType":2,"content":"妻干或隠或顯，而切切遇比肩，相近相親，其位被占奪。又或比肩乘旺，其妻必與外人私通，不然娶婢妾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":1567,"lineType":2,"content":"娼妓為婚，免此醜。五行敗處為沐浴，又名桃花咸池煞，一例同㫁。其神若來，乘勢争財，或財立其上，被他","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":1568,"lineType":2,"content":"神所竊戰者，我身兼與用神之氣，不聚不斂，精神散漫，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":1569,"lineType":1,"content":"娶婚却因服訟。類明六干生子欲别賢愚，體有五法，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":1570,"lineType":2,"content":"日辰，丙子、丁丑、戊寅、辛卯、壬辰、癸巳、丙午、丁未、戊申、辛酉、壬戌、癸亥，犯此日，多因孝服、官訟二事，臨逼結","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":1571,"lineType":2,"content":"婚。或成親百日内决，主一家忽招訟服。或主無外家力，舅氏不諧。或無外家，或兩重父母，或無妻財，或女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":1572,"lineType":2,"content":"命兩重，翁姑半真半假。帶合神桃花，花燭不明，或非良婦，或殘房入舎。此六干柱中，多者尤𦂳尤濫，即陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506634157998092"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":1575,"lineType":2,"content":"錯陽差也。帶桃花在帝旺，多惹婦人官訟，或豪家亦因妻黨婢妾致争，否則兒女官司也。别子賢愚五法：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":1576,"lineType":2,"content":"一、以妻生而尅我者為子，男以偏官為子，女以正官為子。一云女以我生為子，引至時上，逢生旺則好，仍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1559","lineNum":1577,"lineType":2,"content":"以餘神㑹合有情方貴。一云我與妻同化者，如甲人以土為子，引至時上考究。一、化氣所生者為子，如甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1560","lineNum":1578,"lineType":2,"content":"人以金為子，引至時上取用。一、我之本氣所生者即子，如甲人火為子，引至時上詳究。一、但是偏官正官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1561","lineNum":1579,"lineType":2,"content":"有情，引至時上，化得成象即好。子納音長生之氣，贊助妙甚。一云如以我生為子類，以水一火二木三金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1562","lineNum":1580,"lineType":2,"content":"四土五取之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":1581,"lineType":1,"content":"惡攢時日，輕則子抝妻愚，重則空房隻影。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":1582,"lineType":2,"content":"亡刼孤寡三刑，若三煞併而有救者，時上子多不孝，日上妻愚拙或不和。若重犯力猛無救，孤獨貧寒，一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506674410471433"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":1585,"lineType":2,"content":"生自守空房。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":1586,"lineType":1,"content":"刃帶墓刑，吉而夀彌福厚，凶而破㡌單衣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":1587,"lineType":2,"content":"羊刃飛刃犯墓刑二位，須有華盖始吉，及丑未干頭貴者，未有不享福也，與日宜和。若無華盖，帶空亡死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":1588,"lineType":2,"content":"絶孤寒破敗人也，與日不和亦如此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":1589,"lineType":1,"content":"日犯惡神有助，再婚女妻，時臨凶煞仍空，須招義子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":1590,"lineType":2,"content":"日犯年家亡刼，大敗破碎，臨官帝旺者尅妻，却有干音生助日主，必是再娶少年室女，或㓜妾為妻。若帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":1591,"lineType":2,"content":"禄貴贊助者，貌美賢能。一云若年之禄馬貴食六合，在日不獨妻秀，更能掌財。時上帶凶煞落空亡，必主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":1592,"lineType":2,"content":"無子。若生助食神，或日去衝尅者，必是螟蛉之子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506657781792783"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":1595,"lineType":1,"content":"時日咸池帶煞，父命惡亡。休囚大敗臨空，妻家無宅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":1596,"lineType":2,"content":"咸池在日時為嵗煞，主父惡死，更加惡煞無疑，如金主刀兵，火主火厄，水主水厄，土主瘟疫，木主枷杖。以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":1597,"lineType":2,"content":"五象推之。一云帶咸池，若旺犯華盖破碎，及陰錯陽差，因妻醜辱，或離異。若貴豪之家，妻父母兄弟親屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":1598,"lineType":2,"content":"内亂。一云：咸池羊刃，多算多能，亦有宿疾互換，在日時𦂳切日，主宅神陷妻之氣，兼的煞十惡大敗之日，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":1599,"lineType":2,"content":"休廢又落空亡，如甲寅旬癸禄居子，為空神，主妻家無片瓦根基。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":1600,"lineType":1,"content":"胎神尅竊横亡，忌衝局中之字；破碎空孤離祖，因犯禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":1601,"lineType":1,"content":"後之神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":1602,"lineType":2,"content":"胎神白虎煞也，水午金卯之類，衝局中字。如申子辰支，係水命，怕午字之胎神白虎，來尅竊日主，併用神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506672090988571"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":1605,"lineType":2,"content":"主血光横死。以五象推之，禄後一辰，若係空亡孤寡破碎等煞，定主出祖旺相，别立。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":1606,"lineType":1,"content":"支隔合衝二方，此格多應自縊。合兼河井兩位，犯者無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":1607,"lineType":1,"content":"不溺亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":1608,"lineType":2,"content":"自縊煞乃戌人巳、巳人戌之例。若帶金神、白虎、亡刼、鬼墓、空亡、官符、大耗，刃煞領其死絶之地，來尅其身，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":1609,"lineType":2,"content":"廢其用神，犯其太嵗，刑其大運，准上文。丙子旺水，癸未東井，癸丑三河，帶咸池金神、羊刃，亡神多主死於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":1610,"lineType":2,"content":"水中。一云若帶亡神，起端因花酒惹事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":1611,"lineType":1,"content":"目瞶耳盲，用神䧟切，而死敗尅身；腰駝足跛，福氣衰頽，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":1612,"lineType":1,"content":"而刃煞刑主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506672091004955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":1615,"lineType":2,"content":"用神，被死敗等物尅竊，又臨亡刼、空亡、大耗諸煞尅竊身者，准上文。貴氣休囚、勾絞、空亡、大耗，無所倚托，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1594","lineNum":1616,"lineType":2,"content":"死絶之氣，出現沉淪，旺鄉之吉，刃煞仍刑我日主者，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1595","lineNum":1617,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼嘯。應知惡夭本虧，非止貧寒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1596","lineNum":1618,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼嘯如甲人遇庚，庚遇丙，轉轉相尅之類，有辛合其丙，方可貪合忘尅，如無辛来合，不可言甲去生丙。本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1597","lineNum":1619,"lineType":2,"content":"虧乃兇神作黨，尅日家之氣，害年之干，所以貧難，少亡不夀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1598","lineNum":1620,"lineType":1,"content":"天地具包藏之徳，風雷遥激烈之聲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1599","lineNum":1621,"lineType":2,"content":"申亥二字明有力量，酉戌用神得所，正合此格。一云：申亥不露支神，虚夾二位有貴氣者，體局不凡。卯巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1600","lineNum":1622,"lineType":2,"content":"二位内有貴氣，柱中虛拱，嵗運對衝空處，必能變化發越。一云：拱夾穏處，又恐刑衝太迫，走了貴氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1601","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506678709616659"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1602","lineNum":1625,"lineType":1,"content":"拱將拱座并拱印，必是貴人；顧子顧母尤顧身，自非俗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1603","lineNum":1626,"lineType":1,"content":"客。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1604","lineNum":1627,"lineType":2,"content":"拱將謂本支三合，如子人見申辰之例。拱座謂對宫，如子人即午之例。拱印謂印綬正位，如甲人子丑之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1605","lineNum":1628,"lineType":2,"content":"例。一説印乃庫也，又云印即干庫兼。若財官貴氣有用，或財官生旺之鄉，皆富貴造化，生我者為母，我生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1606","lineNum":1629,"lineType":2,"content":"者為子，兼自身三位俱無損壞，往來顧盻有福益者，為有福人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1607","lineNum":1630,"lineType":1,"content":"三位竒寳用官神，流芳英烈。四干天乙臨華葢，曠世清","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1608","lineNum":1631,"lineType":1,"content":"高。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1609","lineNum":1632,"lineType":2,"content":"時座三合，謂之竒寳。若官星居上，無破無忌，世代不絶，芳名勲業人也。古法不獨論嵗日之干乘天乙之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1610","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506657781809167"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1611","lineNum":1635,"lineType":2,"content":"貴為吉，月時干有貴人乘者更妙，況臨本命華盖，生平不止無凶，亦清高竒貴人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1612","lineNum":1636,"lineType":1,"content":"四面宣明旺相，内廷食禄。二煞若臨夾拱，沙塞揚威。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1613","lineNum":1637,"lineType":2,"content":"青龍元武、朱雀勾陳，為四面干禄歸元，各占方位旺相。如甲乙臨寅卯為青龍，丙丁臨巳午為朱雀之類，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1614","lineNum":1638,"lineType":2,"content":"准上文。亡神刼煞，二位俱空閒，而却各有拱夾者，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1615","lineNum":1639,"lineType":1,"content":"金水文華而㧞萃，土金阜富以成高。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1616","lineNum":1640,"lineType":2,"content":"金水二象若清，無其餘之氣，混濁其源者，文采英華，出類之格。金土相生，若各無偏倚，得中和之氣者，似","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1617","lineNum":1641,"lineType":2,"content":"物漸長，生意益高。如此之象，當作富貴之格。或貴氣和恊，亦主功名食禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1618","lineNum":1642,"lineType":1,"content":"榮耀者，木火有發源；清貴者，水木多順序。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1619","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506694065209363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1620","lineNum":1645,"lineType":2,"content":"木火易於煥發，有來處根源，柱中生意，或引嵗運，故能扶引而榮耀。所以人不知其有根氣，但知運上木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1621","lineNum":1646,"lineType":2,"content":"火透發也。水木清竒，若其氣不偏倚，順扶生旺帶貴者，必為翰苑清要，或臺諫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1622","lineNum":1647,"lineType":1,"content":"登金歩玉，貴人頭上帶官星。負笈挑簦，學堂館中逢驛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1623","lineNum":1648,"lineType":1,"content":"馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1624","lineNum":1649,"lineType":2,"content":"天乙頭上有官星顯露，謂之官星坐貴主貴。學堂乃日主生旺之位，學館為官星生旺之方，臨官之位，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1625","lineNum":1650,"lineType":2,"content":"同取用。遇驛馬在中，無甚貴氣者，空有才學無成，即入仕途，亦多奔走道路，落空亡更甚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1626","lineNum":1651,"lineType":1,"content":"翰苑標名，定禀乾坤瑞氣；薇垣秉政，應拱子午端門，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1627","lineNum":1652,"lineType":2,"content":"寅巳二位有力，能合亥申乾坤。又有三合拱者，子辰能拱申，卯未能拱亥，若無雜申亥乘其貴氣，必為出","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1628","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506674410520585"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1629","lineNum":1655,"lineType":2,"content":"羣之造矣。子午一位或有正拱，或有三合外拱，如有貴氣集上，勲業名家，人所未及。丑亥拱子、未巳拱午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1630","lineNum":1656,"lineType":2,"content":"為正。申辰拱子、寅戌拱午，為外。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1631","lineNum":1657,"lineType":1,"content":"魁罡纔逢夾貴。風憲提刑，龍虎得以專職；玉堂拜相，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1632","lineNum":1658,"lineType":2,"content":"辰戌二位逢夾貴為風憲提刑者，謂有威權振作也。如壬癸逢巳卯拱辰，丙丁逢酉亥拱戌是也。又明見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1633","lineNum":1659,"lineType":2,"content":"魁罡重集貴氣，同前㫁。辰寅二位，若遇正拱外拱，有貴氣吉神聚其上者，妙合此格。或見寅辰得氣集貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1634","lineNum":1660,"lineType":2,"content":"旺相扶持，無衝刑尅害，仍得卯處有吉者，同前㫁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1635","lineNum":1661,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽偏用貴崇，奮極品之尊；卯酉正門權輔，領外藩之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1636","lineNum":1662,"lineType":1,"content":"鎮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1637","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506678709633043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1638","lineNum":1665,"lineType":2,"content":"偏陰偏陽，其氣多是奮發，風飛雷厲。貴氣若專旺相力重，驟進極品者多。盖偏氣好争，挺然不配雄豪力","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1639","lineNum":1666,"lineType":2,"content":"大。偏官易於起發，但是退速，或非命爾。若正官則穏，隨分遷擢，無生殺之權。卯酉乃日月出入之門户，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1640","lineNum":1667,"lineType":2,"content":"貴氣拱夾得用者，合此。或明見此二位用神集福，有力無破者，准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1641","lineNum":1668,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗駕禄馬帶財官，英雄超邁；貴局日時乘徳秀，才業峥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1642","lineNum":1669,"lineType":1,"content":"嶸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1643","lineNum":1670,"lineType":2,"content":"凡太嵗禄馬二位，宜係日主，財官居上，豈非英雄超邁。凡貴人局在日時，見徳秀二氣者，合主文章才業","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1644","lineNum":1671,"lineType":2,"content":"大噐，秀㧞英傑之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1645","lineNum":1672,"lineType":1,"content":"用拙而運扶，枯鱗濟水；用强而運拙，曲港行舟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1646","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506652608643072"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1647","lineNum":1675,"lineType":2,"content":"用神力慳，或有氣而被尅竊，或隠藏而無衝合，鈍而不利，運上却引生扶之氣，悠然暢意矣。用神或有力，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1648","lineNum":1676,"lineType":2,"content":"或得時，或情合，若運中阻壞其氣者，東碍西撞，不能順駕，縱有一時風便，其柰何也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1649","lineNum":1677,"lineType":1,"content":"運以支重為基，嵗以干重乘氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1650","lineNum":1678,"lineType":2,"content":"運之支神太過之物則宜抑之，不及之物則宜扶之，須要與當生支神貫穿，㸔其本末乖順何如。若只詳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1651","lineNum":1679,"lineType":2,"content":"用神輕重扶抑者，亦未善。又論生氣尅氣，運支至重，次觀運干戰鬬和諧何似，綂何柱中之物有情而言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1652","lineNum":1680,"lineType":2,"content":"方吉。流年與太嵗干神闗係最𦂳切，一年萬神吉凶之主。日尅嵗則災，合則晦，若有化有情，則有好事。所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1653","lineNum":1681,"lineType":2,"content":"驗灾福遲速，仍察運中相攝如何，須兼用嵗支刑衝破害上言，無偏則可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1654","lineNum":1682,"lineType":1,"content":"運馳行色用，分何弱與何强；嵗攝兵權，勢持情急，而情","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1655","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506672091021339"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1656","lineNum":1685,"lineType":1,"content":"重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1657","lineNum":1686,"lineType":2,"content":"如日為身，貴為用，二者難以偏廢。日主為體，貴氣為用，俱欲中和。一説用神貴氣，如登程行李噐物粮草","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1658","lineNum":1687,"lineType":2,"content":"等件，運即住脚公廨舘宇所泊之所。五氣貴煞何者？引彼地理所宜，或順以參考其否㤗之兆。吉凶二象，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1659","lineNum":1688,"lineType":2,"content":"運元未萌，非嵗則不能激揚其兆。惟嵗君最嚴最切，至威至重，持握特急，勢來則如戰陣鬬敵，迅速險大，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1660","lineNum":1689,"lineType":2,"content":"難以卒然救應議擬也。雖鐵闗金鎻，其能拒哉？亦有貴氣為凶，抑惡揚善，乘機凑濟，莫測。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1661","lineNum":1690,"lineType":1,"content":"禄貴。運欲顯揚，少壯宜兼旺地。凶煞須從沉昧，老人更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1662","lineNum":1691,"lineType":1,"content":"喜衰鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1663","lineNum":1692,"lineType":2,"content":"一胞胎養，沐長生冠帶之地。二十嵗宜行臨官帝旺之運，陽氣强盛。三四十嵗宜行衰病墓絶之運，天癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1664","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506660435181607"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1665","lineNum":1695,"lineType":2,"content":"枯竭。五六十嵗宜行其中合可之義，則造化取舎之道，通變為言者也。運中少壯合體，固宜揚其貴禄。凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1666","lineNum":1696,"lineType":2,"content":"神運欲沉淹，老者宜行死絶等運，仍不要與日主用神表裡生意者，誠為福運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1667","lineNum":1697,"lineType":1,"content":"運氣發源力穏，方易成功；時干化象求情，行當領用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1668","lineNum":1698,"lineType":2,"content":"行運究考，的驗福禍，亦是易事，當逐官消息，審其來意。如運之發源在年月日時上空衝死敗之地，縱發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1669","lineNum":1699,"lineType":2,"content":"不久，發源在穏實住處，可耐患難，可享富貴，福澤悠逺也。行運之法，取時干之化象者，有體象化象二意，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1670","lineNum":1700,"lineType":2,"content":"二者得侣，有情有類，為象成用，或行至運中扶持，或旋造成其噐，第一妙事，乃虛中家傳之秘，有此極論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1671","lineNum":1701,"lineType":2,"content":"引用餘神之氣，最切宜取用生尅强弱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1672","lineNum":1702,"lineType":1,"content":"蜚黄騰踏，運開一路官星；豹變興隆，年統平生財氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1673","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506674410536969"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1674","lineNum":1705,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中帶官星，不若運運統攝，官神得意，歩歩榮耀。八字中有財不旺，雖見無情，行運雖至生旺之處，仍未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1675","lineNum":1706,"lineType":2,"content":"奮發，盖氣或死絶，或滯塞，嵗乃尊嚴之君，吉凶神煞之主。流年或領財元，或生扶財象，或激開財庫，或遥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1676","lineNum":1707,"lineType":2,"content":"合飛衝生旺之所，或拱夾暗包財神禄馬貴人之宫，其財之旺，由此嵗君統繫，豹變勃然興發也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1677","lineNum":1708,"lineType":1,"content":"運凌身弱而適扶用神，運變身强而抑其福氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1678","lineNum":1709,"lineType":2,"content":"當生身旺，或比肩大繁，用神怯弱者，宜凌廢其身之氣，適扶我之用神，反是則不祥矣。當生本體衰弱，用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1679","lineNum":1710,"lineType":2,"content":"神太過，身不勝任，又或錯亂不能歸一，所喜如是，反是則乖。盖當生本末體用相稱，運扶身太過，或困其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1680","lineNum":1711,"lineType":2,"content":"用神，亦不中也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1681","lineNum":1712,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗或運符吉罔凶，嵗或運昧善縱惡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1682","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506674410553353"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1683","lineNum":1715,"lineType":2,"content":"或當生凶煞力重，吉神力輕，財官勢況散漫，嵗運符合福神而抑凶氣者有之。當生吉神力重，凶煞氣薄，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1684","lineNum":1716,"lineType":2,"content":"嵗運失紀綱制馭之道，或至於縱容惡煞，沉昧衆善者有之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1685","lineNum":1717,"lineType":1,"content":"玉井奥訣","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_34","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1686","lineNum":1717,"lineType":1,"content":"，乃安東杜謙所著，其間幽趣妙象數見，而用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1687","lineNum":1718,"lineType":1,"content":"藏氣類，從無立有，倒飛暗合，得一分三，脱胎換骨，入聖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1688","lineNum":1719,"lineType":1,"content":"超凡，誠非易事。欲窮其絶處逢生，要識其旺而退藏。噐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1689","lineNum":1720,"lineType":1,"content":"滿必傾，物過則損。黨盛則隨類，氣衰則托情。用不用，真","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1690","lineNum":1721,"lineType":1,"content":"假宜辨；變不變象類先分。故氣禀有厚薄焉，有清濁焉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1691","lineNum":1722,"lineType":1,"content":"有高卑焉，有晦明焉，萬緒萬端，千變千化。氣有生尅究","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1692","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506678709649427"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1693","lineNum":1725,"lineType":1,"content":"竟，盡燭理外之理，物有造化活法，極參元中之元，誠得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1694","lineNum":1726,"lineType":1,"content":"李虚中餘學一派之正傳也。世之不得覩是書者多矣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1695","lineNum":1727,"lineType":1,"content":"予故表而出之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1696","lineNum":1727,"lineType":2,"content":"育吾記。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1697","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506673529815040"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1698","lineNum":1730,"lineType":1,"content":"三命通㑹","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00011_0_35","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1699","lineNum":1730,"lineType":1,"content":"卷十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":5,"lineType":1,"content":"明","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":6,"lineType":1,"content":"萬民英","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":7,"lineType":1,"content":"撰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"氣象篇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":8,"lineType":2,"content":"醉醒子撰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"9","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"今夫立四柱而取五行，定一運而關十載。清濁純駁，萬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"有不齊；好惡是非，理難執一。故古之論命，研究精微，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"由體而該用；今之論命，拘泥格局，遂執假而失真。是必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"先觀氣象規模，乃富貴貧賤之綱領；次論用神出處，盡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506673529864192"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"死生窮達之精微。不須八字繁華，只要五行和氣，浪指","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"三元六甲，誰知萬緒千端。學者務要鈎玄索隠，發表歸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"根，向實尋虛，從無取有。雖曰命之理微，於此思過半矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"然大海從於勺水，少陰産於老陽，成乃敗之機，變乃化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"之漸，此又所當深察。乃若一陽解凍，三伏生寒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":19,"lineType":2,"content":"此註已引前。冬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":20,"lineType":2,"content":"逢炎熱，夏草遭霜，下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"21","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"陽剛不中，亢則害也。剛而能柔，吉之道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":22,"lineType":2,"content":"此象亢陽無制，更不包藏陰物，而運又行東南，則陽剛失中，必主於害。用此者，孤貧凶暴，死於水火之間。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506662494601225"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":25,"lineType":2,"content":"乃若五陽生於陰月，干支夾合陰柔之物，運道又行陰柔之鄉，乃謂吉也。用此者，雖出寒賤，終必榮華。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"25","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"柔弱偏枯，小人之象。剛健中正，君子之風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":27,"lineType":2,"content":"此象不中之道也。四柱中但見陰柔而不入格，干支又不包陽，則終日柔懦，用此者，機心陰毒，無所不至，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":28,"lineType":2,"content":"乃若剛健，君子之體也；中正，君子之德也。四柱中陽而藏陰，剛柔得制，不犯破尅刑衝，用此者，德行過人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":29,"lineType":2,"content":"中直葢世，故曰君子之風。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"29","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"過於寒薄，和煖處終難奮發。過於燥烈，水激處反有凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":32,"lineType":2,"content":"四柱純陰生於十月，空絶五行之根，日干又見衰弱，而無强旺之氣，縱遇和煖之卿，終難發達。四柱純火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506678709682195"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":35,"lineType":2,"content":"生於夏至之前，火性燥烈，歲運中乍遇水激，不惟不能制，而反致害矣。用此者，夭折孤貧，多犯刑憲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"34","lineNum":36,"lineType":1,"content":"過於執實，事難顯豁。過於清冷，思有凄凉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":37,"lineType":2,"content":"執實者，用一而不通也。假如用官無財，用印無煞，多合少成者，遇事終無豁達。若金水過於清寒，不遇和","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":38,"lineType":2,"content":"煖之運，如庚辛生於十月，柱中純水，運又行西北，平生獨食孤眠，生涯寂寞，人不堪其憂矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"37","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"過於有情，志無遠達。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":40,"lineType":2,"content":"局中之物，不可過於有情，若過有情，則牽迷不能自脱，外無所見矣。如甲木以己土為妻，情固宜有，若甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":41,"lineType":2,"content":"己支下，又乘子丑，内外加合，而外無財官印綬動甲之心，則甲常處於己土之下，其志安能遠達哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"40","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"過於用力，成亦多難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506674410618889"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":45,"lineType":2,"content":"凡柱中得自然之物為妙，若用力扶持，終不為美。且如用財，局中不見，必求傷官食神所生，如食傷失時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":46,"lineType":2,"content":"無氣，又求比肩轉助，或外衝遥合，皆謂過於用力，其成就必艱難矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"44","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"過於貴人，逢灾自愈；過於惡煞，遇福難享。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":48,"lineType":2,"content":"八字中原多貴人二德扶用，財官不有刑破，雖居顛沛之中，亦無危矣。原多惡煞三刑六衝，又與財官反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":49,"lineType":2,"content":"背，縱遇財官之地，将何為享福之基。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"47","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"五行絶處，祿馬扶身；四柱竒中，比肩分福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":51,"lineType":2,"content":"凡遇絶處，不可便指為凶，葢凶處亦有福神相扶。假如木絶於申，申有壬水為印，庚戊為財官，皆我所用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":52,"lineType":2,"content":"之物，必能扶身進福，只愁有神尅害所用之宮，則所用絶矣，如此乃凶。言以官為貴，以財為竒，局中得遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506660435247143"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":55,"lineType":2,"content":"財官，乃為吉矣。如見比肩，無憚争官刼財，則無全美。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"52","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽固有剛柔，干支豈無顛倒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":57,"lineType":2,"content":"陽剛陰柔，天地之道也。顛之倒之，反覆之謂也。所以啟下文之端。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"雖聘妻不識其夫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":59,"lineType":2,"content":"夫婦既入其宮，豈有不識，但情隔而不通，則不見其夫矣。如乙木用庚金為夫，中間丙火隔斷，庚被火傷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":60,"lineType":2,"content":"或坐子午敗死之地，使其妻終不能見其夫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"本有子不顧其母。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":62,"lineType":2,"content":"子之顧母，理也，情也。身有所覊，則不得終養。如甲用丙為子，却被辛金合之，但戀妻之情，而易母之愛矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506662494633993"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":65,"lineType":2,"content":"故局中雖有丙火，不可用也。凡命中議論，至此庶㡬無悞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"61","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"父無子而不獨，子有父而反孤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":67,"lineType":2,"content":"木以火為子息，四柱中如無丙丁巳午之位，則無子矣。若地支暗畜有火，或天干制化得用，亦不為無子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":68,"lineType":2,"content":"木以水為父母，若被損尅，則不得其所生。如甲乙日生於亥子之年，月值四季，水被土傷，所生之人失矣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":69,"lineType":2,"content":"豈不孤哉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"65","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"生尚可以再生，死不可以復死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":71,"lineType":2,"content":"局中之物，原有長生，先被尅損，歳運復遇生旺之地，身力復强，如再生也。死者終也。凡四柱之物，原值死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":72,"lineType":2,"content":"絶之官，後來歲運再遇此地，不為更凶之論。葢死無二也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506652608692224"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"既死亦非為鬼，逢生又不成人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":76,"lineType":2,"content":"木值春生，得時乃旺，柱中雖遇死絶之宮，若運行生旺之鄉，亦不為之死也。木值秋生，失時乃弱，柱中雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":77,"lineType":2,"content":"遇生旺之宫，若運行衰絶之地，終不為之生也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"72","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"子多母病，如佃甫田；母多子病，如臨深淵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":79,"lineType":2,"content":"子者母之所生，多則泄母之氣，正謂子能令母虚也。若母再加衰病，則精力不及，决不能以撫其子，其佃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":80,"lineType":2,"content":"甫田之謂歟？母無二尊，其恩乃全。若母氏衆多，陰聚妬生，邪謀興矣。即五星二母争權，姑息太過，母失所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":81,"lineType":2,"content":"愛，子何所倚？如更臨病死之宮，申生之變，必起朝夕也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"76","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"不正不衝，不偏不合，不横不刑，不直不破。其為衝也，啟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506694375342134"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"六極之岐門；其為合也，闢萬物之形跡。其為刑也，變而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"改正；其為破也，敵而有傷。是以棘地生金，不若藍田種","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"玉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":88,"lineType":2,"content":"以上四端，乃戰尅擊剝之象也，内有刑虛鈎遠之用。若倒亂中而取用神為貴為福者，不若用財生官，用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":89,"lineType":2,"content":"印得煞，自然之妙。此子平之所以專論財印食也歟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"83","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"吉神相我，功求相吉之神；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":91,"lineType":2,"content":"凡人命衰弱，或刑傷破害，不能成用者，必欲吉神扶佐，成我之福。又觀相我之神勢力輕重何如。若無根","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":92,"lineType":2,"content":"失令，或自受傷，先用求助相吉之神何如。假如甲日夏生，遭火焚化，得壬癸亥子相我為救，但水先受火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506660435230759"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":95,"lineType":2,"content":"土耗尅，不能為我之福，必欲求金轉生水旺，使水有顧我之情，如此之功，不在水而在金矣。又如午破子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":96,"lineType":2,"content":"衝，頼未合我而與子穿，則為相我之神。如未受傷，不能為用，必求生助未土之神有力，而未土方得成用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"89","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"凶物傷身，解用傷凶之物。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":98,"lineType":2,"content":"人命中若遇凶神，尅我身宮，必求柱中何物能制傷我之神，則彼自解不暇，焉能及我哉？如甲木原被金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":99,"lineType":2,"content":"傷，禍所不免，得火尅，危自遠矣。又如卯被酉衝，柱中見午，亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"92","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"五行各得其所者，歸聚成福；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":101,"lineType":2,"content":"凡五行不可虚名失位，但要得令歸垣，方能為貴。若歸聚一局，妙不可言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"94","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"一局皆失其垣者，流蕩無依。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506662494584841"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":105,"lineType":2,"content":"凡日主用神，俱要着落之處。如四柱中不得通根有靠，又遇空亡死絶沐浴刑衝，則終無成立，必然流蕩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":106,"lineType":2,"content":"失所矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"98","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"大運折除成歲，小運逆順由時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":108,"lineType":2,"content":"二註已引首卷論大運小運中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"100","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"文庫衝而文明盛，武庫掩而干戈寧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":110,"lineType":2,"content":"戌為文庫，葢火為文明，八字中原無財官印綬食神生氣，則無文章所學之機，徒得火庫，又被關鎖，此無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":111,"lineType":2,"content":"文之人也。若暗有傷官，或印綬隠而不明者，亦主聰明。柱中得辰未丑字，衝刑戌庫，更入東南運道，發火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":112,"lineType":2,"content":"光明，文章必由此而盛也。高擢翰苑者，子見多矣。丑為武庫，葢金為干戈，八字中如帶秋氣，申酉庚辛為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506674410651657"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":115,"lineType":2,"content":"煞，偏官羊刄，又見同宫，此無懼好戰之人也。柱中如得子巳酉神合局，兼行東南木火，制其頑金，則掩其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":116,"lineType":2,"content":"武，而干戈寜矣。壯士於此棄甲投閒者，子嘗見之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"107","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"飛龍離天，隨雲入淵。潛龍在淵，隨雲上天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":118,"lineType":2,"content":"龍者，辰也。天者，亥也；雲，壬也。龍得其雲即飛。若年見亥，月建辰，歲月干頭有壬，則龍在天矣。若日時水旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":119,"lineType":2,"content":"與龍㑹局，龍必隨雲入淵。葢龍以水為家，故上離於天，下潛於水。得斯象者，文章葢世，平生有塞有通，功","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":120,"lineType":2,"content":"名雖出於臺閣，事業終歸於林泉。柱中有巳午二字者，貧薄下流之命也。若年見亥，時見辰，日月㑹水，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":121,"lineType":2,"content":"龍下潛於淵。若干支有刑衝尅破，龍不能安。要日時上有壬字，龍必隨雲上天矣。此象如年無亥用巳反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":122,"lineType":2,"content":"衝亦吉。但出寒賤，祖父無依，後必有人借力奮發，功名主近侍之貴。運行己酉敗絶之鄉，喪家罷職。即壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506674410635273"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":125,"lineType":2,"content":"騎龍背格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"115","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"大林龍出值天河，四庫土全居九五；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":127,"lineType":2,"content":"大林龍者，即戊辰也。要四柱之中，納音得天河水，則龍飛在天，更全四庫，則四海俱備，所以天下皆沾雨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":128,"lineType":2,"content":"澤，必為九五之大人也。明太祖命戊辰、壬戌、丁丑、丁未，此亦有因而言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"118","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"長流龍復歸大海，五湖水聚掌羣黎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":130,"lineType":2,"content":"長流龍者，即壬辰也。龍值長流，地支得亥，名曰龍歸大海，又曰龍躍天門。妙在納音得大海水。四柱俱帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":131,"lineType":2,"content":"水者，則五湖之水既備且深，龍所益喜。要有庚辛以生之，則出入動摇山岳，非貴象乎。如王陽明封新建","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":132,"lineType":2,"content":"伯，壬辰辛亥癸亥癸亥，此亦因陽明而立論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506694375358518"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"六合有功，權尊六部；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":136,"lineType":2,"content":"凡四柱中有刑衝尅害破象，本為凶。論得神挽合有力者，即反為祥，其福高逺。年月成用，大貴。日時成用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":137,"lineType":2,"content":"者，次之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"三刑得用，威鎮三邊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":139,"lineType":2,"content":"刑本不吉，得用者富貴聰明，無用者孤貧凶夭。何以為得用。三刑有氣，日主剛强，無用反是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"128","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"子午端門雙拱，岐㠜憑外正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":141,"lineType":2,"content":"子午二位，正而不偏，故曰端門。若得夾拱，無破損者，更有力量，人必聰明，奮立勲業。正拱者，亥丑拱子，巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":142,"lineType":2,"content":"未拱午。外拱者，申辰拱子，戌寅拱午。忌空亡尅破為害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506652608708608"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"巳寅生地，十分秀氣合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_1","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_2","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":146,"lineType":2,"content":"巳寅生有力，能合亥申。亥乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":146,"lineType":2,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_3","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":146,"lineType":2,"content":"也，申乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":146,"lineType":2,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_4","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":146,"lineType":2,"content":"也。若無衝雜，申亥乃乘貴氣，才調出羣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"141","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"天地包藏神得用，顯豁胸襟，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":148,"lineType":2,"content":"亥為天，申為地，明有力量。如八字中不見二字得左右之神拱起，二字兼有貴氣，不落空亡，須當顯豁。或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":149,"lineType":2,"content":"以申亥包酉戌，㸔係天干，何物以有用為貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"144","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"風雷激烈貴無虧。飛揚姓字，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":151,"lineType":2,"content":"巳為風門，卯為雷門。八字中虛拱二位，更有貴人。歲運若逢衝起，必能發達。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"146","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"賊地成家，賊亂家亡身必喪；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506673529929728"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":155,"lineType":2,"content":"此法月支五陰者是也。若歲日中有神争合為妻，月支陷溺其中，欲出而不可得，故曰賊地。更得歲日之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":156,"lineType":2,"content":"神自刑，無暇合我，得時支乘機，與月支為合，是謂賊地成家，富貴不淺。大運去賊則安，再見賊亂則凶。○","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":157,"lineType":2,"content":"一説撫賊則安，勦賊則凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"151","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"梁材就斵，木多金缺用難成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":159,"lineType":2,"content":"木本頼金，斵以成器。若金被神留合，不能來尅其木，却要木與金為隣，就彼雕琢可也。若木盛金弱，則雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":160,"lineType":2,"content":"就金，亦不能斵而有用。假使用木與金作合，彼此兩強，乃為貴論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"純陽地户包陰，兵權顯赫；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":162,"lineType":2,"content":"八字純陽，本為偏黨，殊不知子寅辰午申戌暗拱，丑卯巳亥未酉之陰，二象相濟交感，則反全天地之正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506660435296295"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":165,"lineType":2,"content":"氣矣。更要四柱無空亡，及天干有生意者極妙。此象權施邊塞，位至公侯，發福非小。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"158","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"獨虎天門帶木，臺閣清高。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":167,"lineType":2,"content":"凡歲月得寅一位，却要時見天門，虎必朝天嘯日。柱中更有卯未合局，木盛生風，風從於虎，豈不偉哉。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":168,"lineType":2,"content":"使刑衝尅破，不得印綬財官，則無用矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"學堂逢驛馬，山斗文章；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":170,"lineType":2,"content":"身坐長生，位為學堂，更得驛馬交馳，一衝一合，又得高大氣象，帶財煞貴人者，最貴文章，挺㧞出塵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"163","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"日主坐咸池，江湖花酒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":172,"lineType":2,"content":"咸池又名桃花煞，男女逢之，必然淫亂，多因花酒，流落江湖。若見財官貴德同宫，反得標格清竒，富貴安","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506657781923855"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":175,"lineType":2,"content":"享。大忌刑合，只喜空亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"福滿須防有禍，凶多未必無禎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":177,"lineType":2,"content":"大抵用印生身，乃為我之福也。柱中原有官煞，轉生印旺，不遇財傷，食神泄氣為貴。運行比印旺地，生扶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":178,"lineType":2,"content":"太過，福滿處豈無禍生，是以君子怕處其盛也。局中原多官煞，再行官煞歲運，其凶乃甚。歴盡艱險，後必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":179,"lineType":2,"content":"有制伏身旺之運，否極泰來之象。如甲日原被官煞所困，運神再行申酉，乃凶甚也。順去有亥子印運，逆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":180,"lineType":2,"content":"行有巳午制運，乃有救之物，豈不為佳。此二句言陰陽消長，禍福倚伏，天道人事，相為流通，宜細味之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"172","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"馬頭帶箭，生於秦而死於楚；馬後加鞭，朝乎北而暮乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"南。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506657781874703"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":185,"lineType":2,"content":"此言驛馬在日時之下者，必要帶合，謂之聨韁，聚大財福，幹事過人。若馬前見有刑衝，謂之帶箭，斷韁之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":186,"lineType":2,"content":"象也。若來衝者屬金，受尅者屬木，其禍尤甚，主人他鄉喪亡。凡取用驛馬，順則年取其日時，逆則時用其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":187,"lineType":2,"content":"日主，馬無隄攔，則縱肆而無可遏。如後再加刑衝，馬必疾行，終無安頓之地。主人一生勞碌，奔競四方，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":188,"lineType":2,"content":"刑衝之神，遇有三合六合，則不為加鞭矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"性靈形寢，多因濁裏流清；貌俊心蒙，葢是清中涵濁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":190,"lineType":2,"content":"凡取用神，錯亂刑衝，未可便言濁而無用，當審其中有暗藏之物，如濁中流出，一㸃孤清，則人雖朴陋，多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":191,"lineType":2,"content":"見性情穎悟，機謀異常。若用神清竒特立，不為混雜刑傷，未可便言清也。但中間有暗藏之物，與所用之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":192,"lineType":2,"content":"物有傷，其病終不可去。故人雖貌美，必然失學無成，昏迷酒色。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506674410700809"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"一將當關，羣邪自服；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":196,"lineType":2,"content":"將者，貴重之神也。關者，𦂳要之處也。邪者，妬我之物也。假如甲乙日生於金旺，年月皆來尅我，得丙透出","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":197,"lineType":2,"content":"月上，制煞為權，而煞自服矣。又如壬癸遇戊己及支土亂尅，身不能敵，𦂳要處却要庚辛為印化煞，不敢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":198,"lineType":2,"content":"為亂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"188","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"衆凶尅主，隻力難勝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":200,"lineType":2,"content":"此言煞重身輕，孤獨無助者，葢無當關可救之神，則不能勝所尅矣，决主夭疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"脱此輩忌見此輩，化斯神喜見斯神。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":202,"lineType":2,"content":"從化之妙，遽不可窮，務要用心詳察。如甲己化土，脱木氣而從妻家，若見甲乙寅卯未亥，皆我比肩，則有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506662494650377"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":205,"lineType":2,"content":"原旺之藉，豈無戀哉。况比刃又能争合我財，使甲己不能相成，反有離間之恨也。又如乙庚化金，喜見金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":206,"lineType":2,"content":"旺，而妻得倚其夫。丁壬化木，喜見木旺，而女得倚其母。丙辛化水，喜要水旺，而母得倚其子。戊癸化火，喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":207,"lineType":2,"content":"要火旺，而主得倚其財。大怕空亡見煞，比肩争妬，不成名卿巨公，則為孤兒異姓矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"驛馬無韁，南北東西之客；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":209,"lineType":2,"content":"無韁，馬無合也。南北東西，無所不至矣。如人命遇此，必主飄零。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"198","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花帶煞，娼優隸卒之徒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":211,"lineType":2,"content":"桃花，日時上見是也。不惟忌刑合有情，尤忌五煞同處。凡遇此者，不受禮義亷耻之敎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"200","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"母子有終始之靠，夫妻得生死相依。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506660435312679"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":215,"lineType":2,"content":"母子夫妻者，專言體用兩端，惟在月日為要。假如戊日坐辰，生於申月，然土以金為子，金養於辰，少倚母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":216,"lineType":2,"content":"而自强；土生於申，老得子而有靠。此象甚竒，大忌歲運破而為患。假如丙日坐子，月用酉金，然火以金為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":217,"lineType":2,"content":"妻，辛金生於子，適夫家以養其身，火至酉亡，頼妻財以活其命。此象貴用財官，大怕刑衝㪚局。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"205","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"雙眼無瞳，火土熬乾癸水；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":219,"lineType":2,"content":"癸木，在人屬腎，為一身之基，兩目之本。目關五行，惟瞳屬水，水涸腎虛，則瞳無所倚。若在日干，生於火土，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":220,"lineType":2,"content":"月分日時，坐土塞源，而柱中遇木火耗熬，不成從化者，多患目疾。若在歲月時中，雖得秋氣，不行西北大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":221,"lineType":2,"content":"運，遇木火太炎之地，恐有喪明之苦，即水稍得通根，亦有下元之疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"209","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"大腸有病，丙丁尅損庚金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506693255430196"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":225,"lineType":2,"content":"庚屬大腸，宜臨水土。嫌者，丙丁寅卯，得局無制，庚金雖得掛根，又被衝刑尅破，兼入木火大運，水土衰處，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":226,"lineType":2,"content":"便有此疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"213","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"土行濕地而傾根，伯牛有恨；火值炎天而得局，顔子無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"憂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":229,"lineType":2,"content":"戊土屬脾，四柱中不有生旺通根之位，生遇陰濕之時，又加水浸土虚，運行濕地，歲見土尅，則脾土受傷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":230,"lineType":2,"content":"因而有疾。火乃文明之象，生於九夏，三合寅午戌局，火愈發輝少用。木資其勢，不宜見水拖根遏火之熖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":231,"lineType":2,"content":"人生得此，樂道無憂。火行極處，多遇木生，反主貧夭，至不利也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"218","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"水泛木浮，死無棺槨；火炎土燥，生受孤單。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506678709731347"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":235,"lineType":2,"content":"木從水泛，不遇運土隄攔，更值死絶之鄉，逢衝併煞，是必墮崖落水，横害毒亡，多不為美。土因火燥，萬物","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":236,"lineType":2,"content":"不生，初運南行，廢而無用，後來雖遇財官，不能為用，以致孤貧奔走，無家之命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"222","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"妻多力弱，花粉生涯；馬弱比多，形骸飄泊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":238,"lineType":2,"content":"凡用財為妻，最要得時得位，日主更喜剛强，歲月有倚，陰陽各得其所，良配可知。若財多㪚亂，刑合不齊，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":239,"lineType":2,"content":"日主孤弱，不能任用，必因妻獲利，以養其身也。此又反言。財為養命之物，用不可無。凡遇財旺身强，平生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":240,"lineType":2,"content":"安樂。若見財輕比多，不足其用，終必飄泊江湖，逐財勞苦，安享何能？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"226","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"凡遇凶神交㑹，善以少而難成；吉曜併臨，惡雖多而亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"化。道從理悟，神自心生，熟讀苦求，巨微徵矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506692601118735"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":245,"lineType":8,"content":"六神篇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"230","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"五行妙用，難逃一理之中；進退存亡，要識變通之道。正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"官佩印，不如乘馬；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":248,"lineType":2,"content":"夫用官之法，大要健旺清高，最忌淺薄。官旺宜印，弱則宜財，此不易之理也。今言用印不如用財者，乃有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":249,"lineType":2,"content":"一説。假如身旺官輕，多見印綬，則日主愈强，而官愈弱矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":249,"lineType":2,"content":"壺中子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_5","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":249,"lineType":2,"content":"云：官輕不若煞輕，所以喜財旺之地，生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":250,"lineType":2,"content":"官尅印，表裏方得中和，於此足以發福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"七煞用財，豈宜得祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":252,"lineType":2,"content":"此言煞旺太過，日主無依，又加用財生煞，則日愈弱而煞愈旺矣。當之不能，逺之不可，只得棄命相從，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506674410717193"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":255,"lineType":2,"content":"免侵凌之患。運行財煞旺地，不易始從之心，一遇歲運歸祿，日主恃强，乃與煞戰，以寡敵衆，其能勝乎？凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":256,"lineType":2,"content":"可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"印逢財而罷職，財逢印以遷官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":258,"lineType":2,"content":"印乃清高正大之物，見財則不能保其名位。且如原用印綬，不以官煞為倚者，運行印官之地，仕路清高，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":259,"lineType":2,"content":"一遇財鄉，尅了印綬，柱無比肩為救，不免罷職投閒，傷重者必死於異鄉。水火身旺用財，榮華可知，再行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":260,"lineType":2,"content":"財旺之地，主不能勝，却要印旺流年，助我根本，反能進爵遷官，不為貪財壞印之論也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"246","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"命當夭折。食神孑立逢梟，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":262,"lineType":2,"content":"七煞傷身，原無正印為解，獨以食神一位制煞，壯年運道，喜行制煞之鄉，若遇梟神有力，尅我食神，柱無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506694375391286"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":265,"lineType":2,"content":"偏財，遇敵不免，縱煞傷身，為禍滋烈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"250","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"運至凶危，羊刃重逢破局。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":267,"lineType":2,"content":"専言用財無煞者，大忌羊刄為禍，若歲運重逢羊刄，刼財波局者，必有喪家囚獄之苦，傷妻尅子之悲，水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":268,"lineType":2,"content":"火兵刄，悉有之矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"争正官不可無傷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":270,"lineType":2,"content":"官者祿也，無人不欲，若柱中多見比刃，只有一位官星，必然争奪，一見有禍。不如運至傷官，傷盡官星，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":271,"lineType":2,"content":"比肩無争奪，始可安矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"歸七煞最嫌有制。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506657781891087"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":275,"lineType":2,"content":"此亦因比肩之謂也。葢四柱多見比肩，必然争祿争財，且奪歲運之物為禍。如年月透出一位七煞，比肩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":276,"lineType":2,"content":"知畏，勢必歸之歲運一遇食神制煞，則柱無主張之神，使比肩復亂如初，則散財破業，横死於苟貪之下，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":277,"lineType":2,"content":"端有徵矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"261","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"官居煞地，難守其官；煞在官鄉，豈能變煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":279,"lineType":2,"content":"官為純雅之貴人，煞乃奸邪之暴客，如官居煞黨，其勢不能獨立，必混化而為煞，雖官有純雅之風，安能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":280,"lineType":2,"content":"守乎？煞乃剛暴之人，雖在官星禮義之鄉，終不由禮義而化，故不能變煞為官也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"264","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"貪財壞印擢高科，印分輕重；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":282,"lineType":2,"content":"凡命印重煞輕，終不為貴。要行財旺之運，尅太過之印，生不及之煞，煞印相停，必能超越。若印輕逢財，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506692601135119"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":285,"lineType":2,"content":"為大害，宜消息詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"遇比用財纒萬貫，比得資扶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":287,"lineType":2,"content":"財乃我用之物，得之乃佳。柱中有一七煞専權，日主被制，則無暇用財，若得比刼透露，或歲運生扶，日主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":288,"lineType":2,"content":"不致衰弱，可以敵煞，而財始為我用矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"運到旺鄉身反弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":290,"lineType":2,"content":"此言從財從煞未成之象，日主衰弱，未肯棄命而從財煞。若大運行，遇資扶之地，必與財煞争敵，敵之不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":291,"lineType":2,"content":"勝，反遭財煞之害，愈見弱矣。是必因財搆禍，災病累身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"財逢刼處禍猶輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506693255495732"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":295,"lineType":2,"content":"身弱財多，當之不能。行遇比刼，分財助氣，而禍反輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"277","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"財不有傷，還忌陰謀之賊；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":297,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中用財，無比刄刼奪者，則無所傷，尤忌支庫中有比刄暗藏，或被衝刑，則私竊之害不免矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"279","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"煞無明制，當尋伏敵之兵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":299,"lineType":2,"content":"煞者，頑暴之人也，必欲食神明制，方可為用。如柱中明，無制伏之人，不可便以凶言，要深求四柱支神，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":300,"lineType":2,"content":"有食神暗伏，或遇刑衝，或就三合，亦可為伏敵之兵。大運行制煞鄉，必主成名進祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"282","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人頭上戴財官，門克駟馬；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":302,"lineType":2,"content":"此専言歲日互換，貴人不遇空亡刼害，煞刃同宮者，上戴財官，又居正位，帶合有根，得時進氣，乃為貴富，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506693255512116"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":305,"lineType":2,"content":"權掌兵刑，非常之命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":305,"lineType":2,"content":"玉井","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_6","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":305,"lineType":2,"content":"云：登金歩玉，貴人頭上帶官星。是官視財為尤要也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"288","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺宫中，藏亡刼，勇奪三軍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":307,"lineType":2,"content":"八字中如帶亡神刼煞，得遇真正長生，及年支納音，或得長生臨官帝旺者，主武畧出羣，有舉鼎㧞山之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":308,"lineType":2,"content":"勇也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"291","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"為跨馬以亡身，因得祿而避位。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":310,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中原多比刼，無財用，歲運逢財，日主乃貪其用，比刄必然刼奪，重則損命喪家，輕則休官罷職，原用官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":311,"lineType":2,"content":"星，帶財為貴，運行歸祿之鄉，乃比肩旺地，必然争奪。官正謂遇比肩而争競於此，反失俸祿，故避位也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"294","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"印解兩賢之厄，財勾六國之争。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506693255544884"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":315,"lineType":2,"content":"兩賢者，二煞也。印者，仁也。凡用日主不弱，兩煞透出天干并虐，日主無食為救，縱有，亦被梟神所奪者，最","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":316,"lineType":2,"content":"凶。若能用印化煞，使降於我，如此不獨富貴出人，且能享福。一云兩賢，官與煞也。若止作煞言，重下句衆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":317,"lineType":2,"content":"煞混行意。財者人所共欲之物，因兹而搆禍者多矣。若局有刄伏於柱中，不遇其財，則無争刼。倘有財為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":318,"lineType":2,"content":"用，或歲見財，惹起比肩，混刼為禍，刑耗傷妻，在所不免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"300","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"衆煞混行，一仁可化；一煞倡亂，獨力可擒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":320,"lineType":2,"content":"煞本待制而後服從，若見煞多，力不能制，制之則必致叛，故不若用印。印者仁也，以仁化煞，使煞自降為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":321,"lineType":2,"content":"妙。喜印旺郷，乃益其化，不宜再見制伏，所謂疾之已甚，亂也。獨煞倡亂，勢力有限，一食制之，自可以服，况","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":322,"lineType":2,"content":"食神多制者乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506693255528500"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"印居煞地，化之以德；煞居印地，齊之以刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":326,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲日主用申為煞，尅我無制，其凶可知。殊不知水印長生於申，自能化煞，不使凶暴。若干支多財，乃成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":327,"lineType":2,"content":"下格，比旺財輕者用之更美。如乙木用辛金為煞，遇子栽根，恃强尅我，雖為我之印，乃煞所生之宮。若更","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":328,"lineType":2,"content":"辛金透出，侵凌日主，干無食神為救者，得旺午衝子，去生殺之宮，則辛無所倚，庶免尅身之患。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟破財財得用，煞官欺主主須從。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":330,"lineType":2,"content":"一局比肩。日干専祿柱中，不見財官，則無所用，却要比肩成黨，望空衝破財旺之宮，而財方為我之用，大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":331,"lineType":2,"content":"怕填實衝宮，留合比肩。假如辛酉日，遇酉多衝卯，遇卯多破午，乃合正用。官煞太多，日主無力，四柱更不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":332,"lineType":2,"content":"拖根，運途又行財煞，不如棄命從煞，遇煞旺之鄉，必能發福。大忌身旺食神之運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506694375424054"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"一馬在廐，人不敢逐；一馬在野，人共逐之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":336,"lineType":2,"content":"馬，財也，乃比肩必争之物。若財明透四柱中，特立無遮攔者，譬如馬之在廐，其分素定，比肩不敢争逐，大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":337,"lineType":2,"content":"怕背財運道三合六合之鄉，比肩乘機暗竊，致禍不輕。若用財不見明露，隠於支庫之間，乃人所不知之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":338,"lineType":2,"content":"地，比肩競圗竊取，雖深藏固閉，難保無患。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"318","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"財臨生庫破生宫，兼奉兩家宗嗣；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":340,"lineType":2,"content":"凡命以印為母，以財為父。財固以印為家，印必以財為主。然財貴而印自榮，夫敗斯妻無倚。所以論人根","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":341,"lineType":2,"content":"基父母，必以看財為先。若財有長生之宮，又見墓庫局，却有神破所生之宫，無犯於墓庫者，則為螟蛉過","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":342,"lineType":2,"content":"繼之兒，棄父隨母之子也。葢生乃發蒙之初，庫在收斂之際，棄始由終，故如此也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506678709764115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"身坐比肩成比局，當為㡬度新郎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":346,"lineType":2,"content":"凡命無傷官食神者，必然用財為妻。妻所屬之宮，日下一位是也。却被比肩占了。又見三合成局，歲月時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":347,"lineType":2,"content":"中見財，必奪柱。若無財，歲運見亦為患。尅妾傷妻，豈止一二而已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"父母一離一合，須知印綬臨財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":349,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中財印，乃為父母之神所處不許同宮，雖為父母之名，實有尅剝之意，豈能免離間之恨哉。若印與財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":350,"lineType":2,"content":"相連一宮，而財印皆有着脚，生祿同鄉者，終得聚合成家而無間矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"夫妻隨娶隨傷，葢為比肩伏馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":352,"lineType":2,"content":"凡論財為妻室，財逢旺用之年，或有生助進氣，當得一妻。若財下原伏比肩，因被煞神制伏，不遂可奪之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506691464544292"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":355,"lineType":2,"content":"機，一遇其財，又見食神制煞，則縱志奪財，妻難久處。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"子位子填，孤嗟伯道；妻宫妻守，賢齊孟光。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":357,"lineType":2,"content":"子者，官煞也。子位者，生時也。時上要財，及用官煞生旺之氣，不逢刑害孤虛，不失用神時候，則有子矣。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":358,"lineType":2,"content":"官失其令，更有傷官食神為妬，徑來時上填實，反有伯道之嘆。妻者，財也。妻宫者，日支也。本宫若見其妻，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":359,"lineType":2,"content":"乃得位矣。不逢比刄，不遇刑衝，不有桃花惡煞，仍得天月二德，貴人同處者，不惟過道韞之才，且有孟光","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":360,"lineType":2,"content":"之德也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"338","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"入庫傷官，陰生陽死；幇身羊刃，喜合嫌衝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":362,"lineType":2,"content":"傷官本有陰陽，生死當較其是否。凡傷官歸庫，歲運逢之，多見喪亡横禍。殊不知五陰傷官，於此返䰟無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506657781940239"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":365,"lineType":2,"content":"咎。刃乃幇身之物，大怕身旺逢之，得一重煞，與刃作合，化為權星，若見官與刃衝戰，乃成惡煞，用者當審","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":366,"lineType":2,"content":"其輕重好惡何如耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"343","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"權刃復行權刃，刀藥亡身。財官再遇財官，貪汚罷職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":368,"lineType":2,"content":"權，煞也，刄，兵也。身旺用此兩端，乃兵刑首出之人也。煞旺喜行制鄉，刃旺喜行煞地，若原煞旺復行煞旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":369,"lineType":2,"content":"之鄉，立業建功處，不免死於刀劍之下。刃多再逢羊刃之地，進祿得財處，必然終於藥食之間，數使然也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":370,"lineType":2,"content":"財，俸也，官，祿也。身强遇此兩端，乃名利出羣之士。凡官弱喜行旺鄉，財旺喜行印地，皆發福成立之時也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":371,"lineType":2,"content":"若有印逢官，則祿過矣，財旺逢財，則俸餘矣。君子祿過俸餘，必見貪汚罷職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"348","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"祿到長生原有印，清任加官；馬行帝旺舊無傷，宦途進","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506672091185179"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"爵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":376,"lineType":2,"content":"原用官星，衰弱不能稱印綬之榮，若官遇長生，便見清竒特立，且有顧印之情，印乃扶身之本，三者之用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":377,"lineType":2,"content":"既周，於此必然進爵。原用偏正之財，雖得位而失其時，居官亦未顯要，必待帝旺臨官，歲運財已足用，馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":378,"lineType":2,"content":"必健馳。舊無比刃傷刼，於此加官進爵立業，餘財可徵矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
