{"lines":[{"lineId":"354","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"財旺身衰，逢生即死；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":380,"lineType":2,"content":"財旺身衰，力不能任意，若與之相忘，反見所守安然。一遇長生之地，即便倚强，苟圖財未得，而禍隨至矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"356","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"刃强財薄，見煞生官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":382,"lineType":2,"content":"兹言用官微眇，而財又淺薄，葢因羊刃刼財，不能生官，則官無倚矣。如見一位七煞合刃，棄財以甦財病，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506692601167887"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":385,"lineType":2,"content":"足以生官，官自旺矣。學者於此，又不可有見煞混官之嫌也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"360","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"兹法玄玄之妙，今頗習而成章，少助愚蒙，開明萬一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"361","lineNum":387,"lineType":8,"content":"憎愛賦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"362","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"富莫富於純粹，貧莫貧於戰争。貴莫貴於秀實，賤莫賤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"於反傷。文章錦繡，貴馬㑹於學堂；襟度宏濶，水火合於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"情性。深謀遠慮，徳星居沉靜之宫；術業玄微，帝座守文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"章之舘。魁罡有靈變之機，離坎乃聰明之户。貴人祿馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"宜逢，刼刃空亡可遠。長生招貴人之可愛，衰敗遇小人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506662494683145"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"之憎嫌。四宫潰亂兮，不仁不義；五行相生兮，為孝為忠。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"印祿在刑衝之位，心亂身忙；日時居鬼庫之中，憂多樂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"少。日干旺而災咎寡，財命衰而惆悵多。衣食奔波，旺處","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"遭尅；利名成敗，貴地逢傷。平生禍福，頼於日時；一歲吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"凶，憑於氣運。福星有氣，而變動陞遷；歲尅運凶而人離","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"財㪚。大運危而生百禍，流年吉以除千殃。無絶至絶，財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"命傾危；求生得生，名利稱遂。三合六合，逢之吉重凶輕；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"七煞四凶，遇之禍深福淺。職遷官進，定因祿㑹之年；産","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506672091168795"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"置田增，必是合財之地。歲君衝壓主凶災，大運受傷殊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"少吉。歲宜生運，運喜生身。三位相生，一年稱遂。財官俱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，應顯達於仕途；財食均榮，豈淹留於白屋。祿入聚生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"之地，富貴可知；馬奔祿旺之鄉，榮華可斷。欲取交關利","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"息，須要六合相逢。時干帶祿朝元，定主安然獲福。月衰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"時旺，早歲豐肥；本重主輕，終身飄蕩。慣取市㕓之利，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"因旺處逢財。忽然顯達成家，定是刑中見貴。主本當時，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"得女士以扶持；貴祿有情，因君子而叶吉。南商北旅，定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506691464560676"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"知馬道之通；東販西馳，必是車運之利。日干困弱，伯牛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"敢怨蒼穹；祿馬衰微，顔子難迯短命。凶莫凶於支刄，吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"莫吉於干強。馬劣財微，男逃女走。天羅地網，非禍横灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"窮途逢刼，危疑必犯自刑；絶處逢財，妻子應難諧老。大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"耗小耗，多因博戲亡家；官符死符，必主獄訟時有。或再","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱遇絶，三命刑傷，難免徒絞之刑，終受黔面之苦。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"逢五鬼，雷傷虎咬無疑；更值羣凶，惡殃横死，定斷女多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"淫賤，男必猖狂。或問人之性情，賢愚善惡，先推貴煞旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506707780321317"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"衰，方究機巧靈變。心高者魁罡為禍，性順者，六合為祥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"觀幽閒瀟灑之人，遇華葢孤虛之宿，好恃勢霸道之輩，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"犯偏官刼刃之權。刼刄生鄙吝之慳，更出機關之險。謀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"畧多因於壬癸，威猛必本於丙丁。甲乙順而仁慈大量，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛虧而果斷無剛。孤囚遇之無精神，破敗逢之多疎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"脱。刑戰者愚頑，靜安者賢俊。躁敗者火盛，隠忍者金多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"金水司令而相生，火土逢時而相助。不勞心而衣食自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":432,"lineType":1,"content":"足，不費力而家計自成。更若德神相扶，定是推尊鄉里；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506691464609828"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"貴祿拱位，必然臺省揚名。其所憂者福不福，其所慮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"者成不成。福不福者吉處遭凶；成不成者格局見破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"傷其格則傷福，破其局則招禍。譬若苗逢秋旱而冬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"廪空虛，花被春霜而夏果無成。智謀雖裕，措用無成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有囘天轉軸之機，而無建功立業之遂。豈不見酈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"生烹鼎，范増背疽；淵明東歸，子美西去；孟輿不遇，馮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"衍空囘；買臣負薪而行歌，江革苦寒而坐讀。葢苗而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"不秀者有之，秀而不實者有之。更值傷敗太過，一福","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506678709780499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"不過。蒭蕘縱有，百藝多能，難免饑寒疾苦，困於溝壑，命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"使其然。欲問富貴雙勝，何由得之？莫大於鎡基，莫竒於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"秀實。達聖達賢者，無時不有；至富至貴者，自古皆然。或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"生煞局之中，文高武顯；或居冠帶之下，業大才竒。若此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"玄微，如何推測？先論學堂之内，三竒四福；次察格局之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":450,"lineType":1,"content":"外，一吉二宜。若己未見甲子為祥，壬辰見丁巳為瑞。壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"子丙午，主風光儒雅之人；辛酉丙申，乃俊秀榮華之士。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽全憑純美，造化最喜相生。難辨者，日精月華；莫測","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506691464626212"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"者，玉堂金匱。得之者榮，遇之者貴。若論賢愚顯晦，無非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"造化鈞陶。假若鳯生於䲭，蛇化為龍，芳蘭不斷於蓬蒿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"枯木猶生於山野。少貴老賤，初屯後亨，葢由大運之衰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，以致富貴之變更。格局純而反雜，惆悵殘春；運行老","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"而得時，優游晚景。是以時有春秋，月有圓缺。嘗觀貨廕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"之子，親一喪定無聊；復見畊釣之人，運一通而殊顯。多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"年爵祿，一旦俱休。時運至者，與時相遇；值生旺者，未必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"無凶。有情者通，無情者滯；有令者吉，有衝者凶。官印歲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506691464658980"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"臨，仕途定知進擢；食財運遇，庶民亦許榮昌。或有少依","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"祖父之榮，長借兒孫之貴。又有垂髫難苦，至老無依。葢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"因四柱之旺衰，所由大運之亨否。豈不見枯槁之木，縱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":468,"lineType":1,"content":"逢春而不榮；茂盛之標，雖經霜而不敗。時日更虧，年月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"定無下稍；生時旺氣朝元必有晚福。古有琢磨之玉，價","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"值連城；世有孤立之人，自成家計。如烹煉之餘而不損，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"歲寒之後而不凋。消息妙在變通，禍福當察衰旺庶㡬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"知命。君子共評。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506707780436005"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"消息賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_7","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭子註育吾子解。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"443","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"元一氣兮先天，禀清濁兮自然。著三才以成象，播四氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"以為年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":478,"lineType":2,"content":"此原造化之始，三命之所由生也。三命以干為祿，謂之天元；以支為命，謂之人元；以納音為身，謂之地元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":479,"lineType":2,"content":"此古人窺見造化，所以法天地而體陰陽，配四柱而成八字。此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":479,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_8","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":479,"lineType":2,"content":"首言之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"449","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"以干為祿，向背定其貧富；以支為命，詳逆順以循環。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":481,"lineType":2,"content":"干猶木之幹，支猶木之校。綂言之，干陽而支陰也。分言之，干支各有陰陽也。十干之祿，寄十二支中，陽道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":482,"lineType":2,"content":"順行，陰道逆轉，皆自長生而數遇本音臨官以寓焉。此陽生陰死，陰生陽死，自然之理也。○以干為祿，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506694375473206"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":485,"lineType":2,"content":"推之則有向背。如甲祿在寅，遇丑則謂之向，見卯則謂之背。故祿前一辰曰羊刃，祿後一辰曰祿庫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":485,"lineType":2,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_9","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":485,"lineType":2,"content":"云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":486,"lineType":2,"content":"向祿則生，背祿則死。此所謂向背定其貧富者歟！○以支為命，而詳之則有逆順。如陽男陰女，從生月順","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":487,"lineType":2,"content":"行。陰男陽女，從生月逆行。人禀受陰陽逆順之氣，在乎支干之中，周而復始，徃來循環，如寒暑之運四時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":488,"lineType":2,"content":"而無窮者也。故曰以支為命，詳逆順以循環。○曇瑩曰：干祿推之有向背，吉凶究之有淺深。背而逆者，可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":489,"lineType":2,"content":"定其貧；向而順者，以知其富。然而不在一途取軌，亦有逢背祿而不貧。於是支作人元，運商徒而得失。男","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":490,"lineType":2,"content":"迎女送，否泰交居，㑹吉㑹凶，作用定矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"461","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"運行則一辰十歲，折除乃三日為年。精休旺以為妙，窮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"通變以為玄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506707780403237"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":495,"lineType":2,"content":"先言干支，則八字定矣。行運乃三命之最要者，故首舉其法以示人焉。運行則一辰十載，折除乃三日為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":496,"lineType":2,"content":"年。此古人立運之法也。折除要明實歴之數。命有節氣淺深不同，運有就生就節互異。中間或休或旺，要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":497,"lineType":2,"content":"與八字符協。有喜生旺而惡休敗，有宜休敗而嫌生旺，千變萬化，非達玄通幽消息以盡造化之妙，其孰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":498,"lineType":2,"content":"能與於斯？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"468","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"其為氣也，將來者進，成功者退。如蛇在灰，如鱔在塵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":500,"lineType":2,"content":"氣，五行之氣也。播於四時，如春則木旺、火相、土死、金囚、水休。迎之以臨官帝旺，將來者進；背之以休廢死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"絶，成功者退。五行之氣，循環進退。人之行運，每居一辰，相者既進，旺者則退。當權者用之為福，不當權者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":502,"lineType":2,"content":"用之無益。若五行氣過則退。蛇鱔皆屬火類，火至囚死為土，休廢為灰。已中三獸，為蛇、為鱔、為蚓，故知蛇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506703208513536"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":505,"lineType":2,"content":"鱔為火。至囚死休廢，則在塵在灰，是土進而火退也。○瑩和尚曰：鱔蚓為水土之屬，居塵必憂。騰蛇乃灰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":506,"lineType":2,"content":"火之神，處灰為樂。方以類聚，物以羣分。順其所欲則吉，乖其所趨則凶，即物可以觀造化也。人之行運，雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":507,"lineType":2,"content":"同一宫，而氣有進退，所處不異，而命有生死，見其不可不精休旺，窮通變也。此説得之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"其為有也，是從無而立有。其為無也，天垂象以示文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":509,"lineType":2,"content":"此正明五行之氣，是從無而立有，故借天象五星以明之。葢播物之初，孰為之有？太極之後，誰為之無？有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":510,"lineType":2,"content":"出於無，無生於有。在氣成象，在地成形，變化見矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"479","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"其為常也，立仁立義。其為事也，或見或聞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":512,"lineType":2,"content":"五行在天為五星，在地為五嶽，在人為五臟。推而行之，則為五常，常有可久之道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":512,"lineType":2,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_10","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":512,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：立天之道，曰陰與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506691464675364"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":515,"lineType":2,"content":"陽。立地之道，曰柔與剛。立人之道，曰仁與義。人之道，非仁與義，則不能立也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":515,"lineType":2,"content":"書","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_11","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":515,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：二，五事。一曰貌，二曰言，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":516,"lineType":2,"content":"三曰視，四曰聽，五曰思。五常五事，皆五行之變化，與人事相通。人之性情去就，見聞動靜，皆不逃乎此數。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":517,"lineType":2,"content":"或見或聞，如金木水火土則見，而宫商角徵羽則聞。貌言視聽思則見，而肅又哲謀聖則聞。葢五行之用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":518,"lineType":2,"content":"至不可勝窮，非圓機明智之士，孰能精察而黙識之哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"490","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"崇為寶也，竒為貴也。將星扶德，天乙加臨。木主休囚，行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"藏汨沒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":521,"lineType":2,"content":"崇者，卑之反；竒者，耦之對。物以積而高，高之為崇，在五行上生下是也。物以無與耦之為竒，在五行異而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":522,"lineType":2,"content":"乃羣是也。將星，月将也。德，天月德也。天乙，貴神也。生年為本，生日為主，休囚對生旺言。人命年月日時，四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506707780419621"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":525,"lineType":2,"content":"柱有五行，上生下有三竒，乙丙丁更帶將星德貴，主本生旺得地，所謂吉將交臨，而福臻成慶，此為至貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":526,"lineType":2,"content":"之命。賦先言崇竒為寳貴，後言主本忌休囚，見崇竒為難遇，以主本為切要，而諸方神煞則次而言之，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":527,"lineType":2,"content":"知命以五行為先，生旺為上，將星德貴，又神煞之最吉者歟。○徐曰：崇以主本言，凡命中掌夀、掌財、掌災","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":528,"lineType":2,"content":"福之辰，亦謂之崇。竒以祿馬言，凡命中財官印食，亦謂之竒。德者，日交德辰，即六合也。如壬寅年、庚戌月、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":529,"lineType":2,"content":"癸卯日、乙卯時，九月將在卯，扶其生日。五行九月金土六合，卯戌合，乙庚合，戊癸合，如此五行，各不居休","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":530,"lineType":2,"content":"敗之地，則貴，似非賦義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"501","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"至若勾陳得位，不虧小信以成仁；真武當權，知是大才","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"而分瑞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506691464642596"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":535,"lineType":2,"content":"此舉水土以例其餘。勾陳為土之將，其於常也為信。真武乃水之神，其於常也為智。信也者，足以達於聖；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":536,"lineType":2,"content":"智也者，足以撰其道。五行之用，獨善於兹。得位者，戊己生七月，母在子鄉；當權者，壬癸生七月子居母家，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":537,"lineType":2,"content":"二物同源，俱生於申故也。徐以戊己坐臨寅卯，並亥卯未，壬癸坐臨午巳及辰戌丑未，下冇官印祿馬旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":538,"lineType":2,"content":"相庫墓，為得位當權，似與賦義有背，不若只以土生四季，水遇三冬為是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"508","lineNum":539,"lineType":1,"content":"不仁不義，庚辛與甲乙交差；或是或非，壬癸與丙丁相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"畏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":541,"lineType":2,"content":"上言當權得位，則不交差，不相畏也。若甲見庚，乙見辛，丙見壬，丁見癸，猶二女同居，兩男並處，陰陽不合，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":542,"lineType":2,"content":"不成慶也。庚辛主義，甲乙主仁，以交差，故不仁不義。丙丁主禮，壬癸主智，以相畏，故或是或非。若庚合於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506672091234331"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":545,"lineType":2,"content":"乙，辛合於甲，則剛柔相乘，仁義兼濟，非交差也。若丙見癸官，丁合壬祿，則陰陽相配，水火既濟，非相畏也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":546,"lineType":2,"content":"或以甲申乙酉為不仁，庚寅辛卯為不義，緣寅申庚甲之交差，卯酉乙辛之暗戰。丙與壬則丙非壬是，丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":547,"lineType":2,"content":"逢癸則癸是丁非。子午同然，己亥一揆。凡命遇此一辰，始可言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"516","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"故有先賢謙己，處俗求仙。崇釋則離宫修定，歸道乃水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"府求玄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":550,"lineType":2,"content":"仁義每乖於得失，是非常絆於榮枯。於是日用不知，曽無休息。故有先賢謙己處俗，求仙割愛，少私寡慾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":551,"lineType":2,"content":"或崇釋以滅心之火，或歸道以益腎之精。内守精神，外除幻妄，達物我非有，明色空究竟者，莫非是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"520","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"是知五行通道，取用多門。理於賢人，亂於不肖。成於妙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506707780452389"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"用，敗於不能。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":556,"lineType":2,"content":"道無乎不在，物無乎非道。五行變化，通乎大道，何所不該？其取用不一，故謂多門。如識者取之以修定，仙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":557,"lineType":2,"content":"者取之則求玄，自非頓悟之士，豈能與此？是故賢者得之，能窮理盡性，達五行之妙用；愚者失之，終亦自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":558,"lineType":2,"content":"昧而無所得。能者養之以取福，不能者敗之以取禍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":558,"lineType":2,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_12","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":558,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：苟非其人，道不虛行。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"528","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"見不見之形，無時不有；抽不抽之緒，萬古聨綿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":560,"lineType":2,"content":"見不見之形，如十干祿寄十二支，有見不見之形存焉。甲祿寅，寅為顯見之祿。不見寅而見戌，以五子元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":561,"lineType":2,"content":"遁至戌，見甲戌，戌為甲之祿堂，此所謂不見之祿。甲以辛為官，辛祿酉，甲受金雞，酉為明見之官。不見酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":562,"lineType":2,"content":"而見未，以天官遁甲入羊羣，未上有辛，此所謂不見之官。  抽不抽之緒，如陽氣生子，旺卯終午；陰氣生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506707780468773"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":565,"lineType":2,"content":"午，旺酉終子。陽生則陰死，陰變則陽化，子午乃陰陽化生之始終無極也。陰極則陽生，陽極則陰生，氣自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":566,"lineType":2,"content":"子午中孚甲抽扎而出，出入無疾，徃來不窮，如絲緒之聨綿，萬古不斷之義。○","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":566,"lineType":2,"content":"太玄","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_13","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":566,"lineType":2,"content":"云：見不見之形，抽不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":567,"lineType":2,"content":"抽之緒，則日遷月變，暑徃寒來，代廢代興，更休更旺，一顯一晦，一縮一抽，綿綿若存，無時不有。葢陰陽五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":568,"lineType":2,"content":"行，有見不見，有抽不抽，其理玄妙，其機發泄，無物不有，無時不然。自有天地人以來，便如此，要頓悟何如？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"539","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"是以河公懼其七煞，宣父畏其元辰。峨眉闡以三生，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"全士庶；鬼谷播其九命，約以星觀。今集諸家之要，略其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"偏見之能，是以未解曲通，妙須神悟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":572,"lineType":2,"content":"元辰七煞，煞之最凶，命禀五行，斯患孰逃？上古聖賢，如河上公，仙之流也，文宣王，聖之至也，猶俱畏二煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506693255577652"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":575,"lineType":2,"content":"况其他乎？於是著書濟世，吉凶禍福，告在未萌。峨眉仙闡以三生，非不精也；鬼谷子播其九命，非不通也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":576,"lineType":2,"content":"指陳玄言，幽奥難測，故云約以星觀，無全士庶。三生，祿命身也。九命，身命兩宫，祿馬二位，生年胎月日時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":577,"lineType":2,"content":"也。珞琭子參集諸家之要旨，略其偏見之能，獨發心得之見，著為是文，大解玄義，曲通妙機，在學者神悟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":578,"lineType":2,"content":"而變通之，斯為善矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"548","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"臣出自蘭野，㓜慕真風。入肆無懸壺之妙，游衢無化杖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"之神。息一氣以凝神，消五行而通道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":581,"lineType":2,"content":"臣者，對君之稱。蘭野，地名，自敘所出，㓜慕真風，則其志大矣。懸壺、化杖，乃壺公費長房故事。稱前人之至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":582,"lineType":2,"content":"妙，悔在己之無能。外絶所欲，内無所思，息一氣以凝神，消五行而通道，故著此賦名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":582,"lineType":2,"content":"消息","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_14","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":582,"lineType":2,"content":"焉。葢造化有消","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506672091267099"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":585,"lineType":2,"content":"有息，故云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"556","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤立其牝牡，金木定其剛柔。晝夜互為君臣，青赤時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"為父子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":588,"lineType":2,"content":"此消息造化之大規模也。乾屬陽，為天道、君道、夫道。坤屬陰，為地道、臣道、婦道。乾以動為體，曰闢户。坤以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":589,"lineType":2,"content":"靜為體，曰闔户。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":589,"lineType":2,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_15","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":589,"lineType":2,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_16","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":589,"lineType":2,"content":"立陰陽牝牡之合，兩者交通，斯五行變化在其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":589,"lineType":2,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_17","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":589,"lineType":2,"content":"首","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":589,"lineType":2,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_18","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":589,"lineType":2,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_19","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":589,"lineType":2,"content":"，正此義也。仁柔義剛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":590,"lineType":2,"content":"金木性之所司。一陰一陽，剛柔相推。獨剛而無柔，則不能生變，獨柔而無剛，則不能生化。晝為剛，生變以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":591,"lineType":2,"content":"進；夜為柔，生化以退。積剛柔而成變化，積晝夜而成進退。晝為陽，以象君；夜為陰，以象臣。晝夜之道，其微","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":592,"lineType":2,"content":"有消息，其著有盈虛，其分有幽明，其數有生死。一泰一否，一損一益，終始之相因，新故之相代，榮辱之所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506672091283483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":595,"lineType":2,"content":"至，福祿之自來，莫不本諸此也。五行之神曰帝，東方青帝之父；生，南方赤帝之子。青赤之理，父傳子道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":596,"lineType":2,"content":"言陰陽五行之中，有君臣、父子、夫婦之道存焉，是造化之大指，通乎人倫也歟！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"574","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"不可一途而取軌，不可一理而推之。時有冬逢炎熱，夏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"草遭霜；類有陰䑕棲氷，神龜宿火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":599,"lineType":2,"content":"此言陰陽五行之道，微妙難通，隠奥難測，不可只一途取軌，一理而推之。如冬寒夏熱，此理之常，時之正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":600,"lineType":2,"content":"也。若冬逢炎熱，夏草遭霜，則非其時矣。非其時而行其令，是可以常理拘乎？䑕火龜氷，此理之有，類之宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":601,"lineType":2,"content":"也。陰䑕棲氷，神龜宿火，則非其類矣。非其類而居其所，是可以一途論乎？常者易究，不常者難窮，造化豈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":602,"lineType":2,"content":"易言哉？鄒子吹律而寒谷囘春，孝婦含寃而六月飛霜。古今紀灾異，此類甚多，不可謂非陰陽五行之變","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506694375489590"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":605,"lineType":2,"content":"也。火䑕之毛，績而為布；氷蠶之脂，登而為爼。此世之所知也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":605,"lineType":2,"content":"神異經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_20","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":605,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：北方有層氷萬里，厚百丈，有䑕重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":606,"lineType":2,"content":"萬斤，毛長尺餘，在中藏焉。是陰䑕之棲氷也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":606,"lineType":2,"content":"爾雅","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_21","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":606,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：一曰神龜，十曰火龜。郭璞讚云：天生神物，十朋之龜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":607,"lineType":2,"content":"或游於火。是神龜之宿火也。徐子平指冬至一陽生，夏至一陰生為冬逢炎熱，夏草遭霜，以癸祿在子為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":608,"lineType":2,"content":"人元丙，以癸為官印；戊祿在己為人元癸，以戊為官印。為陰䑕棲氷，神龜宿火，恐非賦義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"589","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"是以陰陽罕測，志物難窮。大抵三冬暑少，九夏陽多。禍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"福有若禨祥，術士希其八九。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":611,"lineType":2,"content":"上文言冬熱夏霜、氷䑕火龜，非陰陽常理，物類相感，故云罕測、難窮。此反照破上文，言時有冬逢炎熱，大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":612,"lineType":2,"content":"抵三冬暑必少也；夏草遭霜，大抵九夏陽必多矣。寒暑既有其常，陰陽可窺其奥；禍福當以理推，禨祥顯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506678709846035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":615,"lineType":2,"content":"以類應。術士專門論三命五行行年歲運，遇旺相得位之運則泰，遇休囚失位之運則否，只道其常，可希","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":616,"lineType":2,"content":"冀八九中足矣。人命行年歲運，禍福之應，如禨祥之變異，志物之難窮。挾術之士，十分之中，此理亦難希","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":617,"lineType":2,"content":"其八九。葢天地無全功，而况於人乎？亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"597","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"或若生逢休敗之地，早歲孤窮；老遇建旺之鄉，臨年偃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"蹇。若乃初凶後吉，以源濁而流清；始吉終凶，類根甘而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"裔苦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":621,"lineType":2,"content":"身雖逐運，必假運以資身；勢須及時，亦假時而乘勢。生逢壯歲，運宜處於旺鄉；晚遇衰年，運恰宜於困地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":622,"lineType":2,"content":"是乃隨宜消息，休旺自如。初生歇滅，而晚歲興隆者，源濁流清之謂也。㓜年建旺，而臨老蛉□者，裔苦根","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506678709829651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":625,"lineType":2,"content":"甘之謂也。其乃較量運氣，窮究根源，先察根基厚薄，兼明運限始終，雖未百發百中，亦可希其八九。大抵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":626,"lineType":2,"content":"人命立年為尊，其胎月日時，資以次之。故曰作四柱之君父，為吉凶之主宰，而立其年也。明運氣之本，推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":627,"lineType":2,"content":"虚實之基，而取其月。觀安危之兆，察苦樂之原，而取其日。定貴賤之本，決生死之期，而取其時。辨㓜蔭之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":628,"lineType":2,"content":"始，究未立之前，而取其胎。月管初主日，管中主時，管末主年，則總綂之。須要終始兼濟，前後相應，則富貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":629,"lineType":2,"content":"兩全，財祿雙顯，無初吉終凶，始凶終吉之異矣。然而不易得也，或只中下興隆，亦可為成實之命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"608","lineNum":630,"lineType":1,"content":"觀乎萌兆，察以其原，根在苗先，實從花後。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":631,"lineType":2,"content":"談命之説，以胎為根，以月為苗，以日為花，以時為實，窮根可以知苗，見花然後知實。是以聖人觀乎先兆，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":632,"lineType":2,"content":"見乎未萌，即察其根源，則知其苗裔也。徐曰：欲知運内吉凶，先看根元勝負。根元有貴，則運臨貴而必貴；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506692601364495"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":635,"lineType":2,"content":"根元有財，則運臨財而發財；根元有灾，則運臨灾而生灾。其説亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"613","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"胎生元命，三獸定其門宗；律吕宫商，五虎論其成敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":637,"lineType":2,"content":"禽分三十六位，支列一十二辰。次而布之，一辰三獸：子人䑕、蝠、鶯。丑人牛、蟹、鱉。寅人虎、狸、豹。卯人兎、狐、貉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":638,"lineType":2,"content":"辰人龍、蛟、魚。巳人蛇、鱔、蚓。午人馬、鹿、麋。未人羊、鷹、鴈。申人猴、猿、猱。酉人雞、烏、雉。戌人，狗、狼、豺。亥人，猪、豕、㺄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":639,"lineType":2,"content":"凝神","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_22","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":639,"lineType":2,"content":"：子云象神者，即天祿，主大富貴。不象神者，天云不祿，具以形神性氣斷之。胎生元命：只如甲子生人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":640,"lineType":2,"content":"生月癸酉，胎逢甲子，元命是同。又如乙丑金人，月若己卯，胎逢庚午，以土生金。二説並詳，其意不遠。或曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":641,"lineType":2,"content":"以年取月，以月取胎，觀三處承屬，謂之三獸，有無吞啖傷形，則可以定宗門之出處。陽六為律，陰六為吕，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":642,"lineType":2,"content":"五音總於律吕，律吕相合，分支定干，五行合為五音。是故甲己宫土，遁起丙寅；乙庚商金，遁起戊寅；丙辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506703208595456"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":645,"lineType":2,"content":"羽水，遁起庚寅；丁壬角木，遁起壬寅；壬癸徵火，遁起甲寅。五音皆自寅起，寅為十二月之初，二六時之首","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":646,"lineType":2,"content":"也。人之成敗吉凶，由此而始。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"624","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"無合有合，後學難知；得一分三，前賢不載。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":648,"lineType":2,"content":"道立於兩，成於三，變於五，而天地之數具其十也，耦之而已。無合有合，如甲與己合，柱，不見巳而得午，緣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":649,"lineType":2,"content":"午中有巳祿。寅與亥合，柱，不見亥而得壬，緣亥上有壬祿。又如寅午戌合，柱，不見寅而得甲，緣寅中有甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":650,"lineType":2,"content":"祿。得一分三，如甲得巳為一合，得午為二合，得亥為三合。此乃得一祿而分三祿，與前見不見之形，抽不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":651,"lineType":2,"content":"抽之緒，理相貫穿。李虛中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":651,"lineType":2,"content":"論支干合全格","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_23","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":651,"lineType":2,"content":"：年、月、日、時、胎五位，能合干支全。言子則丑在，言寅則亥在，言甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":652,"lineType":2,"content":"則巳在，言乙則庚在。祿干五位，如帶甲乙丙丁戊，自然合起巳庚辛壬癸。十二支如帶寅卯辰巳午，自然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506693255675956"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":655,"lineType":2,"content":"合起未申酉戌亥。或於子丑位有祿馬加之，則十干十二支皆合全矣。徐曰：無合有合，即刑合丑子遥巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":656,"lineType":2,"content":"等格。得一者既見有寅刑巳，丑破巳，而丙戊被刑破而出，則便分三而行，是三合巳酉丑也。古歌曰虎生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":657,"lineType":2,"content":"奔巳猪猴走，羊擊猪蛇自然榮，此解亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"636","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"年雖逢於冠帶，尚有餘灾；運初至於衰鄉，猶披尠福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":659,"lineType":2,"content":"年，太歲也。運，大運也。年雖逢於冠帶，猶披暴敗之餘灾。運雖至於衰鄉，猶帶旺官之尠福。此行運所以有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":660,"lineType":2,"content":"前後五年之説，二句互文見義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"639","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"大段天元羸弱，宫吉不及以為榮；中下興隆，卦凶不能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":662,"lineType":1,"content":"成其咎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506693255643188"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":665,"lineType":2,"content":"天元，十干也。干以生旺為榮，若衰病死墓絶，則天干羸弱，雖所臨官分之吉，如得財官將星天乙之類，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":666,"lineType":2,"content":"不及以為榮。中地，支也。下，納音也。中下俱臨五行興旺之地，雖八卦定分為凶，亦不能致灾。徐曰：凡命天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":667,"lineType":2,"content":"元臨財官之地，而生不得時，本氣羸弱，上下五行休旺，又不相輔，雖官遇祿馬之吉，亦不及以為榮。如庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":668,"lineType":2,"content":"辛生於春月，别位有火尅金，金見寅卯甲乙為財，緣木中旺火害金，而金又不得其令，雖宫屬財，吉而反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":669,"lineType":2,"content":"發凶禍之例是也。中者人元，下者支元，如丁以壬為官印，中下祿馬，建旺成慶，雖火臨絶地，却乘中下之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":670,"lineType":2,"content":"貴。成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":670,"lineType":2,"content":"鑑","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_24","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":670,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：祿雖絶而建貴，陶朱云絶祿亡財，不為凶兆是也。或以一吉三生屬九官，五鬼絶命屬八卦，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":671,"lineType":2,"content":"通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"651","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇尊凶卑吉，救療無功；尊吉卑凶，逢灾自愈。祿有三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506710364012582"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹，灾有五期。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":676,"lineType":2,"content":"立年為尊，其胎月日時，資以次之；大運為尊，其太歲小運，資以次之。若遇本命與大運德合於建旺之鄉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":677,"lineType":2,"content":"其歲運日時凶，而不能為咎；大運與本命争戰於死囚之地，其歲運日時吉，而未足為救，故曰云云。○祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":678,"lineType":2,"content":"有三㑹者，長生帝旺庫也，其為至吉之地。灾有五期者，衰病死敗絶，其為至凶之地。葢祿對灾言，非干祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":679,"lineType":2,"content":"之祿，當以活看。今之學者，但舉三合，而以金逢巳酉丑，木居亥卯未，火得寅午戌，水遇申子辰，便是祿有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":680,"lineType":2,"content":"三㑹，非也。徐言以八字中内外三元，有最得力者為尊，即用神也。用神不可損傷，若有損傷，則雖别位之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":681,"lineType":2,"content":"吉不能救。若年月日時内外三元，雖有尅戰，但不損於尊者，即逢灾自愈也。更切消息所損之神，主何吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":682,"lineType":2,"content":"凶？害命則身灾，害妻則妻灾，害官則官失。其説有理，但尊卑字灾通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506703208611840"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"凶多吉少，類","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"大過","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_25","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"之初爻；福淺禍深，喻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"同人","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_26","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"之九五。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":686,"lineType":2,"content":"凶多吉少之命，以其休囚無氣，故不宜於進用，有類","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":686,"lineType":2,"content":"大過","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_27","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":686,"lineType":2,"content":"初爻。其爻辭云：初六，藉用白茅，无咎。六陰柔無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":687,"lineType":2,"content":"過人之才，初在下，非有為之時，可以遯世而避位，戒人以慎之道也。夫子曰：慎斯術也以徃，其无所失矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":688,"lineType":2,"content":"正此意也。福淺禍深之命，以其五行相尅而無氣，亦非謀望進用之宜。喻如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":688,"lineType":2,"content":"同人","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_28","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":688,"lineType":2,"content":"卦中之五，爻辭云：同人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":689,"lineType":2,"content":"先號咷而後笑，大師克相遇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":689,"lineType":2,"content":"象","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_29","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":689,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：同人之先，以中直也。可見直道難行，戒人以自克之意也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"677","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"聞喜不喜，是六甲之虧盈；當憂不憂，頼五行之救助。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":691,"lineType":2,"content":"聞喜以盈為言，盈者益也；不喜以虧為言，虧者損也。損益之道，由六甲而推之。或以空亡為天地虛脱之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":692,"lineType":2,"content":"辰，六陽命畏於陽宫，六陰命畏於陰位。歲運行年，遇祿馬貴人而在空亡，五行之虧盈相制，是聞喜不喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506703208628224"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":695,"lineType":2,"content":"也。○當憂不憂，是五行休廢之處逢生，如木得甲申、癸巳之例。假如戊申人得丁酉，暴敗破碎自刑，丁酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":696,"lineType":2,"content":"死火已化為土，子傳母道。甲寅人運至申上，衝刑反吟，祿馬俱絶，為旺金所制，遁見壬申，是干救神，術云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":697,"lineType":2,"content":"絶處逢父母，變灾為福是也。余見六甲五行，其説圓活。或元命八字，有虧有盈，有救有助；或行運流年，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":698,"lineType":2,"content":"虧有盈，有救有助，不可執定。虧盈者，或吉或凶之謂也；救助者，制凶扶吉之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"685","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"八孤臨於五墓，戌未東行；六虛下於空亡，自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_30","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"南首。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":700,"lineType":2,"content":"甲子旬中，戌亥為空亡，對衝為六虚，乃辰巳也。戌亥是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":700,"lineType":2,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_31","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":700,"lineType":2,"content":"金之位，在西極之北隅，迤邐甲戌、甲申，自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":700,"lineType":2,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_32","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":700,"lineType":2,"content":"南","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":701,"lineType":2,"content":"首，故寅申巳亥，四孤之地，辰戌丑未，五墓之鄉。向戌未而東行，順空亡而逆轉。或以八孤者，除辰戌丑未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":702,"lineType":2,"content":"乃五行之墓，其餘八音孤虚之辰，孤臨於墓。如申酉人孤辰在亥，而寡宿居未。五行之墓，寄於四氣之中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506693255659572"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":705,"lineType":2,"content":"其氣皆隨月建而來行。東之戌與未，乃火木之墓。木自亥生，火從寅起，火木之氣皆自寅首之東行，而鍾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":706,"lineType":2,"content":"藏於戌未之墓。如乙丑生人，以亥為六陰，正空亡。亥衝巳為六虚。亥為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":706,"lineType":2,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_33","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":706,"lineType":2,"content":"天，巳為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":706,"lineType":2,"content":"巺","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_34","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":706,"lineType":2,"content":"地，巳乃南方之首神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":707,"lineType":2,"content":"故云六虚下於空亡。孤既東行，虚則西迴，二者嘗相對。此總論十二支中神煞之名。順逆循環，孤虚、空亡、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":708,"lineType":2,"content":"五墓，為人命之最要者歟！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"704","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"天元一氣，定侯伯之遷榮；支作人元，運商徒而得失。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":710,"lineType":2,"content":"以干為祿，故天元清秀，吉將加臨，人得之而貴也。以支為命，故支元純粹，四柱比和，人得之而富也。此天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":711,"lineType":2,"content":"地之分，干支之别也。天元一氣，不是一様，如今談命者所指，以其象天，故云一氣，天祿之所司也。須祿帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":712,"lineType":2,"content":"天德，官印貴食五行。四柱中兼得生旺氣者，至貴○商賈之徒。詳以人元定財物之得失，須觀有氣無氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506691464708132"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":715,"lineType":2,"content":"當究進神退神。故下文云：財命有氣，財絶命衰。運對定而言，定則决定，運則流轉，義各有所取也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"710","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"但看財命有氣，逢背祿而不貧；若也財絶命衰，縱建祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"而不富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":718,"lineType":2,"content":"人生以財命為主，五行所尅者，謂之財有氣，謂財與命皆得寓於五行生旺之地，雖四柱背祿，使之無官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":719,"lineType":2,"content":"亦不至貧賤。若命與財俱無氣，雖得月建坐祿，使有小官，亦不能致富貴。假如庚寅木尅丙戌土為財，土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":720,"lineType":2,"content":"旺在戌，身命二木至東南戌，雖背申之庚祿，以其財命有氣，故不貧。又如甲辰生人，得丙寅火，以金為財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":721,"lineType":2,"content":"絶在寅辰土，至寅為命鬼，兼遇空亡，財絶命衰，雖月建坐祿，以財命無氣，故不富。前云以干為祿，向背定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":722,"lineType":2,"content":"其貧富，葢指財命兩宫，各宜旺地，不但八字，行運皆然。徐説以財命有氣，如甲乙見巳午等月；建祿不富，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506697231630363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":725,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲乙生寅卯等月，當並詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"719","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"若乃身旺鬼絶，雖破命而長年；鬼旺身衰，逢建命而夭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"夀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":728,"lineType":2,"content":"破命長年，以其本命旺，宫逢絶鬼者是也。如火在巳宫值水，木居寅地逢金，土向申鄉遇木，金歸亥中逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":729,"lineType":2,"content":"火，○逢建命而夭夀，以其本命衰，鄉逢旺鬼是也。以土到寅中見木，火歸亥地逢水；金在巳鄉得火，火居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":730,"lineType":2,"content":"申位逢金，俱以納音取之。五行之理，受制則天，制物則夀。舊云：建命主長夀，破年主夭殤。故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":730,"lineType":2,"content":"竹輪經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_35","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":730,"lineType":2,"content":"云：建","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":731,"lineType":2,"content":"命未必延長，破命未必天夀。此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":731,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_36","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":731,"lineType":2,"content":"所以消息也。天元論貴，人元論富，財命論貧富，身鬼論夀夭，各指","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":732,"lineType":2,"content":"其重者言之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506712792498187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"背祿逐馬，守窮途而恓惶；祿馬同鄉，不三台而八座。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":736,"lineType":2,"content":"祿者，爵祿之謂也。馬者，車馬之謂也。人命重祿馬，故先言之。祿馬皆可以致富貴。若祿背之而去，馬逐之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":737,"lineType":2,"content":"而㪚，二者俱失，所以守窮途而恓惶。背如陰陽之相背，非所謂向也。逐如㪚逐之逐，非所謂追也。如癸亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":738,"lineType":2,"content":"人得正月甲寅。癸祿在子，寅以背之；驛馬在巳，寅以刑之。前因刑而逐去其馬，後因背而不能及祿。馬在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":739,"lineType":2,"content":"面前，祿在背後。向前趂馬，祿又不來。囘住待祿，馬又漸遠。此正與趕祿攔馬相反。同鄉用日干遁祿，時干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":740,"lineType":2,"content":"遁馬，五子元求之，則可知。假令庚午人得壬辰日、丁未時，便以丁壬庚子遁至戊申。緣庚祿午馬同在申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":741,"lineType":2,"content":"上，與本命相得尤佳。又如甲申人，丁丑月、己酉日、丙寅時命生時於帝座上㑹同祿馬，兼甲申、己、亥、丙寅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":742,"lineType":2,"content":"皆禀五行清旺生氣。故應晚年有非常之遇。所以位至三公，夀踰七十。徐説以祿為官，馬為財，見傷官為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506703208644608"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":745,"lineType":2,"content":"背祿，見比刼為逐馬。如甲人生三春九夏，天元更帶丙丁甲乙，或亥卯未之例；同鄉乃壬午、癸巳等，日柱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":746,"lineType":2,"content":"有丁巳丙戊，歸祿午巳之例，並當詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"742","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"官崇位顯，定知夾祿之鄉；小盈大虧，恐是刼財之地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":748,"lineType":2,"content":"夾祿即拱祿，如癸丑得癸亥之例。刼，刼煞，如丁丑得丙寅。歲水以尅火為財，丙寅乃自生之火，可謂小盈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":749,"lineType":2,"content":"丑人以孤刼在寅，丑土受寅木之制，為財化鬼，斯所謂大虧也。三命以財旺為吉，人以有財為福，若值劫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":750,"lineType":2,"content":"地，縱祿命有一二吉處，亦不免大虧。徐論夾祿，如癸丑日、癸亥時，不可本祿位為歲月所占别位，又不可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":751,"lineType":2,"content":"尅壊天干，衝動地支，夾貴不住，走了貴氣。所以福聚之地，不可被傷；禍聚之地，不可無救。五陽干見五陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":752,"lineType":2,"content":"為刼財，五陰干見五陽為敗財。刼凶於敗，其解尤善。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506740344881187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"生月帶祿，入仕居赫奕之尊；重犯竒儀，藴藉抱出羣之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":756,"lineType":1,"content":"器。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":757,"lineType":2,"content":"王廷光解：生月帶祿，以生月為運元，帶天祿生旺之氣而行運者，主平生温厚，為福最多。舉生月而生日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":758,"lineType":2,"content":"生時可知，或四柱五行，互相帶祿，兼乘生旺之氣為貴。瑩和尚解：本命祿元，與生月，同用日干求之，如庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":759,"lineType":2,"content":"子人，甲申月，但得乙庚日，便用丙丁推之，甲申是也。徐子平解：甲乙人秋生，丙丁人冬生，即正氣官星，生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":760,"lineType":2,"content":"月帶之，則父子之氣，近為祿相需。更生日支内，天元自旺，生時不居休敗，行年復在祿鄉，為生月帶祿。余","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":761,"lineType":2,"content":"見以戊日逢乙巳月，壬日逢己亥月，癸日逢戊子月，干支帶官祿，或年日時所坐之支，得坐月干，以壬寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":762,"lineType":2,"content":"日得甲辰月，辛酉日得辛巳月之例，入仕定居赫奕之尊。○重犯竒儀。王廷光解：乙丙丁為三竒，戊己、庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506692601430031"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":765,"lineType":2,"content":"辛、壬癸為六儀，十干用九而遁去其甲者之謂儀。如乙巳生得辛巳月，日，辛為儀，乙為竒，乙以辛巳為生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":766,"lineType":2,"content":"成官，又坐官祿長生學堂。二巳乃重犯竒儀。竒儀者，天地陰陽耦合英秀之氣也。瑩和尚則以甲戊庚乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":767,"lineType":2,"content":"丙丁法天地二儀。李仝則以子加寅，順數至年月見本命。余觀遁甲論三竒六儀，王廷光之解為是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":768,"lineType":2,"content":"此以上論貴命根基，此以後説運中會遇，故下文云云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"762","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"陰男陽女，時觀出入之年；陰女陽男，更看元辰之歲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":770,"lineType":2,"content":"男女之别，男尊女卑，陽位本男，陰位本女。今言陰男陽女，失其序矣。既失其序，則運有逆順。大運出入之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":771,"lineType":2,"content":"年，慮招不測之咎，陽男陰女，各得其宜。大運遷變之年，更看元辰等煞。是故吉凶悔吝，生乎動者也。行運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":772,"lineType":2,"content":"為三命之最要乎？徐子平解此最詳。元辰是當生元有害官印之辰，前云出入之年，此論元辰之歲，其理","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506697231712283"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":775,"lineType":2,"content":"無二。至於論節氣之淺深，財官之向背，皆前人所未發也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"768","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"與生地之相逢，宜退身而避位。凶㑹吉㑹，伏吟反吟，陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"錯陽差，天衝地擊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":778,"lineType":2,"content":"此説運中所遇吉凶禍福，生地相逢。瑩和尚則以本年長生中逢鬼旺，如金逢乙巳火，土遇庚申木，火見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":779,"lineType":2,"content":"甲寅水，木逢辛亥金。王廷光則以五行有父子相繼之道，父壯則子㓜，子强則父衰，子父同處，子既來矣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":780,"lineType":2,"content":"父已成功，自當告退，是知他生我而休，子代父位也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":780,"lineType":2,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_37","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":780,"lineType":2,"content":"震","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_38","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":780,"lineType":2,"content":"為長男用事，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":780,"lineType":2,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_39","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":780,"lineType":2,"content":"父退居西北，亦是此理。徐子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":781,"lineType":2,"content":"平則以庚辛生人，運到申酉，以火為官祿，火至申酉病死；木為財帛，木到申酉死絶，官財俱無，即建祿不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":782,"lineType":2,"content":"富之説也，恐非賦義。行年歲運祿馬五處皆在生旺之地，共來扶我元命，謂之吉㑹；共尅我元命，謂之凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506707780501541"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":785,"lineType":2,"content":"㑹。伏吟者，大運與元命相對，以陰遇陰曰錯，以陽過陽曰差。人命有陰陽錯雜，人運有陰陽交差。元命與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":786,"lineType":2,"content":"運在東南，而遇太歲在西北，謂之天衝；元命與運在西北，而遇太歲在東南，謂之地擊。吉㑹凶㑹，言運遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":787,"lineType":2,"content":"伏吟反吟，陰錯陽差，天衝地擊，其間亦有吉㑹凶㑹，未必皆凶也。如甲子金命，伏吟庚子土為吉，戊子火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":788,"lineType":2,"content":"為凶；反吟戊午火為凶，庚午土為吉。西北衝東南，主動改出入，是内衝外也。東南衝西北，雖衝而不動，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":789,"lineType":2,"content":"外衝内也。遇此者皆主不寧，其間吉凶兩存，陰陽錯差，則純陰純陽，不生不成，所作多竒而不耦。或曰：天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":790,"lineType":2,"content":"衝地擊，乃天干地支，大運與元命相衝擊，非專指五行陰陽絶滅之地也。歲運得此，更在反伏吟上，則其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":791,"lineType":2,"content":"為凶㑹可知。四柱寓於其上，縱貴不夀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"788","lineNum":792,"lineType":1,"content":"或逢四煞五鬼，六害七傷，地網天羅，三元九宫。福臻成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506712792514571"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"慶，禍併危疑。扶兮速速，抑乃遲遲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":796,"lineType":2,"content":"此皆言行運所遇之神煞也。命前四辰曰四煞，乃寅申巳亥四衝之刼煞也。命前五辰曰五鬼，乃子人見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":797,"lineType":2,"content":"辰，亥人見卯也。或指辰戌丑未為四煞，五行遇尅為五鬼、六害，寅巳之例，七傷、亡煞等神。或以一吉、二宜、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":798,"lineType":2,"content":"三生、四煞、五鬼、六害、七傷、八難、九厄，皆是三元九宫内諸神煞之名，歲運逢之，故多為凶。若元命三元九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":799,"lineType":2,"content":"宫，五行生旺，為福之臻，尚可以成吉慶，以五行為神煞之先也。若三元九宫、五行四柱在衰敗之地，歲運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":800,"lineType":2,"content":"又值諸凶煞，所謂禍併危疑者歟。煞扶乃速，速成灾；福抑乃遲，遲為慶。余以二句併兼禍福言，扶禍則速，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":801,"lineType":2,"content":"扶福則遲；抑福則速，抑禍則遲。徐説元命犯辰戌丑未，大運又行到其上，謂之四煞。大運干為鬼制，財尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":802,"lineType":2,"content":"官，運與太歲同，謂之五鬼。丑未生人，柱中元有丑未，更大運在辰戌丑未，却遇太歲在子午卯酉者，謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506694375538742"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":805,"lineType":2,"content":"六害。運中逢七煞，為之七傷。如甲乙人用庚辛為宫，運在南方，或逢寅午戌巳與未，太歲是也。四煞輕，五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":806,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼重；六害輕，七傷重。運逢之輕，歲遇之重。地綱天羅。戌人不得見亥，亥人不得見戌，謂之正天羅。辰人不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":807,"lineType":2,"content":"得見巳，巳人不得見辰，謂之真地網。中間又分亥見戌，辰見巳為尤重，遇之者災病連綿。大凡推運，須看","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":808,"lineType":2,"content":"生年太歲，與運生尅，生尅已定，然後參諸神煞，則吉凶無不驗矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"803","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"歴貴地而待時，遇比肩而争競。至若人疲馬劣，猶託財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":810,"lineType":1,"content":"旺之鄉；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":811,"lineType":2,"content":"孟子云：雖有鎡基，不如待時。若運入貴神之地，待時數符合，則有福慶。最忌者，比肩也。如比肩並行之運，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":812,"lineType":2,"content":"必有争競，弱者伏强，在吉凶神煞升降言之。若祿馬氣衰，但得祿財，命財旺相，亦可扶持。或曰比肩争競，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506694375555126"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":815,"lineType":2,"content":"如兩庚奪一丁，兩丙食一戊，分擘其福，如此者交相是非人疲馬劣。本命支曰人元兼驛馬，皆在五行衰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":816,"lineType":2,"content":"敗無氣之地，其所以不為灾者，以財旺。如戊午火命，驛馬在申，申中金旺火衰是也。徐解歴貴地而待時，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":817,"lineType":2,"content":"如壬辰、癸巳生人，用土為官祿，用火為財帛，而生月不居九夏，不在四季，雖歴貴地，猶待四時，基本元有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":818,"lineType":2,"content":"元無也。遇比肩而争競，如壬辰、癸巳，更在九夏四季，得其官祿之時，大運又在火上，分野却遇太歲，是壬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":819,"lineType":2,"content":"癸年，亥子丑亦同，或為衝刑，或為破害，主稱意中夭横。人疲者，人元疲乏也。馬劣者，所合之辰馬弱也。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":820,"lineType":2,"content":"甲午生人，運行西方，午為人元，屬火，火到西方死絶，人疲也。甲以己為巳，午内有己土，己到西方亦自衰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":821,"lineType":2,"content":"敗，馬劣也。午雖疲乏，猶頼西方金旺為財，秋金懷壬癸，亦可與己破鬼生財。此説得之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"815","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"或乃財旺祿衰，建馬何避掩衝。歲臨尚不為灾，年登故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506697231745051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"宜獲福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":826,"lineType":2,"content":"尅者之謂財，寓者之謂祿，乘者之謂馬。馬是扶身之本，祿為養命之源。祿乘貴而遷官，馬運財而獲福。祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":827,"lineType":2,"content":"財驛馬兼得之，則富貴兩全；偏得之，則次或天祿雖衰，而身財猶旺，兼遇驛馬來乘，縱使揜伏衝擊，歲運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":828,"lineType":2,"content":"尚不為灾，况後歲運更在五行生旺㑹合豐登之處，故宜獲福之多矣。掩者伏吟，衝者反吟也。假令癸亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":829,"lineType":2,"content":"生得乙巳，歲遇祿，水雖絶在己，而以水人尅火為財，火旺在己，兼己上乘馬，雖己亥相衝，臨於反吟之上，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":830,"lineType":2,"content":"以身旺之財，不為灾咎。若歲運不相衝臨，在三合六合五行生旺之地，又逢財遇馬，可謂年歲豐登，故宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":831,"lineType":2,"content":"獲福者歟。徐曰：此節與前意同而理異也。如丙午人運至西方，雖財旺而祿衰，下元建馬為助，言酉中有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":832,"lineType":2,"content":"辛合丙，則不畏掩衝，此與中下興隆不殊。前説財運掩衝固不為忌，此論歲臨運位，亦未可便言凶咎。太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506697231761435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":835,"lineType":2,"content":"歲為造化之主，百煞之尊，來臨壓運，多凶少吉。若三元内外五行官印有用，亦可以利見大人而成吉㑹；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":836,"lineType":2,"content":"財帛有用，亦可以因貴人而發財帛。且如生日是壬午，大運是庚午，歲是戊午，此言歲運並臨，亦為吉㑹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":837,"lineType":2,"content":"次年交辛未，其氣不殊，官印財帛有用，其獲福宜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"829","lineNum":838,"lineType":1,"content":"大吉生逢小吉，反夀長年；天罡運至天魁，寄生續夀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":839,"lineType":2,"content":"丑為大吉，未為小吉。如癸未日生人行丑運，或丁丑日生人行未運，不得謂之反吟，皆謂之生氣。癸受氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":840,"lineType":2,"content":"於巳，而成形於未，丁受氣於亥，而成形於丑，故曰生逢。如六壬課發用丁，課在未，癸在丑，亦此意也。丑未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":841,"lineType":2,"content":"為陰陽之中㑹，天乙貴神所臨，主與本逢之，則有長年之夀。辰為天罡，戌為天魁。如庚戌生人行辰運，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":842,"lineType":2,"content":"甲辰生人行戌運，不得謂之反吟。庚受氣於寅而成形於辰，甲受氣於申，而成形於戌，皆是生氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":842,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼谷子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_40","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506712792530955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":845,"lineType":2,"content":"云罡中有乙，魁裏㐲辛是也。前云生逢，後云寄生，義不殊也。或曰：此後八句，再明反吟吉凶，無固必之義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":846,"lineType":2,"content":"假令乙丑陰命，男在六月生，遁見癸未木，雖本命生月相尅，合主夭傷，却為乙丑納音金，尅癸未納音木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":847,"lineType":2,"content":"反夀長年。歌云便將生月用為身，却以納音囘作命。身衰尅命短天年，命徃尅身長夀命是也。假令戊辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":848,"lineType":2,"content":"陽命男在三月生，計五歲起運，順行五十六運至壬戌納音水，來生戊辰木，又三月天月德俱在壬，寄在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":849,"lineType":2,"content":"戌上又生木，故曰寄生續夀。瑩和尚曰：以下四節並用真印，始得其詳。乙丑金印癸未木印壬辰水印甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":850,"lineType":2,"content":"戌火印戊辰土印。長生續夀，惟寄與反，除此五干，未有知其然也。緣丑中有乙木，未上有癸水，癸水生其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":851,"lineType":2,"content":"乙木，増長祿元，反夀長年，莫非是也。戌中有甲，辰中有壬，壬水生其甲木，續其丙火，故曰天罡。運至天魁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":852,"lineType":2,"content":"寄生續夀。大要十干為祿，定人修短故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506697231728667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"從魁抵蒼龍之宿，財自天來；太衝臨昴胃之鄉，人元有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":856,"lineType":1,"content":"害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":857,"lineType":2,"content":"酉為昴胃之鄉，從魁是也。卯曰蒼龍之宿，太衝是也。支元取財，今言天來者，緣酉上有辛，卯中有乙，辛金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":858,"lineType":2,"content":"制其乙木，故云財自天來。以其酉金尅其卯水，乙木畏於辛金，祿既被傷，人元受尅。若然，酉人遇卯為吉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":859,"lineType":2,"content":"卯人逢酉為凶，位列尊卑，剛柔斷矣。徐曰：蒼龍屬辰，酉生人逢辰，是酉中辛金，尅辰中乙木為財用支内","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":860,"lineType":2,"content":"天元為財也。卯人運至，酉金尅木，而反相刑，支作人元，故曰有害。害者是七煞，不犯衝刑尅制，亦偏陰偏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":861,"lineType":2,"content":"陽也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
