{"lines":[{"lineId":"852","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"金祿窮於正首，庚重辛輕；木人困於金鄉，寅深卯淺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506697231794203"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":865,"lineType":2,"content":"陰極生陽，陽極生陰，陰陽自然之理也。陽金生於巳，而死於子，絶於寅；陰金生於子，而死於巳，絶於卯。正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":866,"lineType":2,"content":"死正生之謂重，偏生偏死之謂輕。次以陽木生亥絶申，陰木生午絶酉，陽木申深而酉淺，陰木申淺而酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":867,"lineType":2,"content":"深。葢寅卯指羣木之情，庚辛舉衆金之類。申是水生之地，木曰困；寅是生火之宫，金云窮也。一云丙辛有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":868,"lineType":2,"content":"合故辛輕；乙庚有合，故卯淺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"858","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"妙在識其通變，拙説猶神；巫瞽昧於調絃，難希律吕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":870,"lineType":2,"content":"凡命運吉凶禍福，如上所云，賦特言其大槩，妙在識其通雙。賦辭雖拙，而理妙應如神。設若不能通變，譬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":871,"lineType":2,"content":"之巫瞽昧於調絃，希律吕之和，難矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"861","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛臨於甲乙，君子可以求官；北人運在南方，貿易獲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506740344913955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"其厚利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":876,"lineType":2,"content":"金木有相得之理，水火有既濟之道，故特舉而言之曰：庚辛臨於甲乙，則餘八千可知也；北人運在南方，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":877,"lineType":2,"content":"則餘東西可知也。言君子見小人則不然。言北人須亥子方為是。甲以辛為官，乙以庚為官，如庚辛之運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":878,"lineType":2,"content":"歲來臨甲乙之人，故曰君子可以求官，在小人反以為鬼也。亥子，北方之水；巳午，南方之火。以水行運至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":879,"lineType":2,"content":"火我尅之為財，所以貿易獲其厚利。或謂壬癸之位，其卦屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":879,"lineType":2,"content":"坎","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_41","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":879,"lineType":2,"content":"；丙丁之位，其卦屬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":879,"lineType":2,"content":"離","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_42","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":879,"lineType":2,"content":"。水歸火地，運至財鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":880,"lineType":2,"content":"不知壬癸是祿，己牛是命，干支不相入，如壬癸得丙丁，止可謂之祿財而已，不可以貿易言也。談命者，須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":881,"lineType":2,"content":"當分祿命身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"874","lineNum":882,"lineType":1,"content":"聞朝歡而夕泣，為盛火之炎陽。觀禍福之賖遲，則多因","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506710364045350"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"於水土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":886,"lineType":2,"content":"此論五行之性，明禍福之遲速也。火之性暴而多傷，故鑽木而烟飛，撃石而光發。朝歡旋泣，今是昨非，由","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":887,"lineType":2,"content":"火傳薪，莫知其極也。水土為物，其性柔和，致於禍福之端，得其遲緩之意，葢智與信也。火木性快，易發易","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":888,"lineType":2,"content":"休。水土性遲，難成難敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"880","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"金木未能成器，聽哀樂以難名。似木盛而花䌓，狀密雲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"而不雨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":891,"lineType":2,"content":"言金者則尚木，金得用而木乃成，是以剛濟柔也。言木者則尚金，木成器而金得著。仁者必有勇也，若有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":892,"lineType":2,"content":"金無木，勇而無禮則亂；有木無金，庚辛虧而義寡。金者，西方之器也，主哀。木者，東方之物也，主樂。樂而不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506693255708724"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":895,"lineType":2,"content":"淫者，木遇金也；哀而不傷者，金得木也。凡此者，皆大人之命也。若明水火之歸中，用乎金木之間隔，由是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":896,"lineType":2,"content":"哀樂不能動其心，乃外方難名之人。若偏陰偏陽，似木盛花繁，偏陽之謂伏；密雲不雨，偏陰之謂見。人命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":897,"lineType":2,"content":"要陰陽兩停，則為應格之命，故下文云云。又曰：金不能成器，藉火以陶鎔；木未能成功，假金以削刻。故樂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":898,"lineType":2,"content":"必以哀為主，益必以損為先。木盛花繁，秀而不實；密雲不雨，晦而難明。兩在未測之間，擬議生矣。是故旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":899,"lineType":2,"content":"而不可無制，衰而不可無生。得處比和，復歸純粹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"890","lineNum":900,"lineType":1,"content":"乘軒衣冕，金火何多？位劣班卑，陰陽不定。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":901,"lineType":2,"content":"前論水火，以相濟而成慶；次論金木而為官鄉。是知水貴升，火貴降，木要濟柔為剛，金要損剛益柔，則互","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":902,"lineType":2,"content":"用為慶。其間獨有金剛火强，不可不知也。金至堅之物，非盛火則不能革化；火至暴之物，非金無以顯諸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506712792629259"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":905,"lineType":2,"content":"用。金火兩停，方為鑄印之象。故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":905,"lineType":2,"content":"賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_43","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":905,"lineType":2,"content":"云：乘軒衣冕，此君子之器也，須金火兩停者當之。若火多金少，金多火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":906,"lineType":2,"content":"輕，皆為凶暴之命。金旺於西方，火旺於南方，各恃其勢，則為自刑之刑。如此之命，雖日時有用，終歸於位","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":907,"lineType":2,"content":"劣旺卑而已，是陰陽不能定分故也。金陰也。火陽也。既陰陽兩偏，則貴賤高卑無所定著。况有金而無火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":908,"lineType":2,"content":"有火而無金，其為凶徒，又可知也。或曰人命四柱五行，金火多者不足貴。以金剛不能順物，火暴而難益","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":909,"lineType":2,"content":"其生，為氣不常，故君子之道鮮矣。庚人得丙，辛人得丁，純陰純陽，為尅為鬼，是為陰陽不定。雖有出身，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":910,"lineType":2,"content":"位劣班卑，不能大顯，亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"902","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"所以龍吟虎嘯，風雨助其休祥；火勢將興，故先煙而後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":912,"lineType":1,"content":"熖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506697231810587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":915,"lineType":2,"content":"此為上文五行相尅。或未成器，合貴不貴。此又言相尅相生之性，因以龍虎煙熖為喻。若五行各得其所，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":916,"lineType":2,"content":"則如龍行雨降，虎嘯風生。又如火旺，先有其煙，後有其熖。或以龍吟虎嘯二句，喻人年吉而歲運又吉。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":917,"lineType":2,"content":"初凶後吉者，必不然。譬若火之始然，先煙而後熖也。葢煙生於火而能欝火，煙以有氣未通為義，豈非火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":918,"lineType":2,"content":"外景而内晦，煙達而後生，不猶人之始凶終吉者哉？徐解龍吟虎嘯，當以戊辰、甲寅，其義甚詳。不然，但遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":919,"lineType":2,"content":"寅與辰相得，亦是先煙後熖，明陰陽氣順有次序，與其為氣也不殊，終非賦義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"910","lineNum":920,"lineType":1,"content":"每見凶中有吉，吉乃先凶。吉中有凶，凶為吉兆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":921,"lineType":2,"content":"此本上文，言吉凶相為倚伏，如前論從魁抵蒼龍之宿，財自天來，吉也。是酉中辛尅辰中乙木為財，辰乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":922,"lineType":2,"content":"水鄉，復能奪辛金之官，論財却不缺，而失官為凶。太衝臨昴胃之鄉，人元有害，凶也。却木用金為官，酉則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506740344963107"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":925,"lineType":2,"content":"不背官祿，凶中反吉。賦意始於説運，次議五行，之後再詳言之。又如火人行水運，則是七煞，凶也。或用水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":926,"lineType":2,"content":"為官，吉也。水行巳午運，南方獲利，為財，吉也。却下有戊己七煞，凶也。如此極多，要學人深造變通，以根本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":927,"lineType":2,"content":"取最重者言之。曇瑩曰：吉凶之相仍，禍福之相因，陰陽之常理也。世固有吉人凶於吉，凶人吉於凶者，君","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":928,"lineType":2,"content":"子所不道也，亦道其常而已。凶若勝吉，吉藴凶中；吉若勝凶，凶藏吉内。駁雜生於純粹，比和出於戰争，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":929,"lineType":2,"content":"曰吉中有凶，凶為吉兆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"919","lineNum":930,"lineType":1,"content":"禍自向末，言福可以迎推；纔入衰鄉，論灾宜其逆課。男","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"迎女送，否泰交居。陰陽二氣，逆順折除。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":932,"lineType":2,"content":"此言灾福吉凶，由於行運。禍旬向末，如見凶運，十年終滿。前交吉運，若當生年月氣深，或行年太歲扶助，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506733348782121"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":935,"lineType":2,"content":"向祿臨財，更不須待交運，只在此運末，便可迎祥。而推之，纔入衰鄉，人命久歴福地，方交背祿財絶之運，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":936,"lineType":2,"content":"然未可便以凶言，是論灾於逆課也。男迎女送，陽男陰女，運順行也。一運十年，更分前後，各五年。凡入吉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":937,"lineType":2,"content":"運，得節氣深。男迎者前五年發福，女送者後五年發福。或曰：男詳大運初入之年，迎何灾福，故云迎。女詳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":938,"lineType":2,"content":"大運将出之年，送何灾福，故云送。男迎女送，否泰交居。作一義看。迎吉送凶，迎凶送吉，是否泰交居也。陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":939,"lineType":2,"content":"男陽女，陽男陰女，依逆順行運折除。即前折除三歲為年也。看新舊運上，有何吉凶，以運數言。曇瑩曰：此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":940,"lineType":2,"content":"論行運，各指長生，次於衰地。如金生於巳而衰於戌，戌上男順行於死囚休廢，女逆行於帝旺臨官已上。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":941,"lineType":2,"content":"男順旺於申酉之鄉，女逆困於寅卯之地，故云禍旬云云。陰陽二氣，葢言小運乃年之氣也，大運是月之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":942,"lineType":2,"content":"氣也。日干為運，月支為氣。小運則從生日後交，大運則論其氣而過。二氣運行，由我命者也，故曰陰陽二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506712792645643"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":945,"lineType":2,"content":"氣云云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"933","lineNum":946,"lineType":1,"content":"占其金木之内，顯於方所分野；標其南北之間，恐不利","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"於徃來。一旬之内，於年中而問干；一歲之中，求月中而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":948,"lineType":1,"content":"問日。向三避五，指方面以窮通；審吉量凶，述歲中之否","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"泰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":950,"lineType":2,"content":"此言運行東西南北，金木水火之鄉，有利不利，兼歲中否泰言也。王氏曰：木火金水，乃四方專一之氣，各","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":951,"lineType":2,"content":"擅方所分野。如春之辛卯，夏之戊午，秋之癸酉，冬之丙子，四方各抱自旺之氣，而不可相犯。故五行旺氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":952,"lineType":2,"content":"取仲一辰，謂之白虎煞。如東方之木，徃西方逢金。南方之火，來北地遇水。所謂煞忌四仲，物禁失道。曰君","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506712792662027"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":955,"lineType":2,"content":"曰父，不可兩亡。以其相尅，徃必不利。若五行衰絶無氣，逢相衝徃來，則反互用為福。如乙亥火得癸巳水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":956,"lineType":2,"content":"火至巳而旺，水至亥而旺。互換逢旺，徃來何傷。壬寅之金，為臣不强。庚申之木，事君不暴。獨占一隅，奚有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":957,"lineType":2,"content":"造化。葢祿旺貴其自亨，患難欲得相救故也。一旬之内，於年中而問干。以年之干，則有以知甲之所寓，於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":958,"lineType":2,"content":"是同旬之生也。一歲之中，求月中而問日。謂一歲之中，則有異者，陰陽男女之命也。求於月而問日者，欲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":959,"lineType":2,"content":"知節氣日數，以定㡬歲，為行大運之法也。運之行也，宜向三元生氣，避五鬼絶路，指陳方面，窮通陰陽，觀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":960,"lineType":2,"content":"祿馬之向背，大運之盛衰。由此以審吉凶，不出指顧間，能述歲中之否泰。或以生氣福德天醫為向三，絶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":961,"lineType":2,"content":"體遊魂五鬼絶命本官為避五。徐曰：占讀作去聲，看當生歳月所占。如木用金為官，在陽命男運，出未入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":962,"lineType":2,"content":"申，陰命男運，出亥入戌，是向祿臨財於金木分野之際。如金用木為財，陽命男運，出丑入寅，陰命男運，出","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506712792694795"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":965,"lineType":2,"content":"巳入辰，是向祿臨財在木火方所之中。更加太歲月令氣候扶同言之標對本言，又有標准之義，則是命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":966,"lineType":2,"content":"基本也。南者，向明而徃也。北者，向北而來也。此言運氣出入動靜，或吉或凶，不可駁雜。或遇交運之年，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":967,"lineType":2,"content":"可輕舉。一旬之内，於年中問干，是月中求日也。一歲之中，求月中問日，是年中求月也。向三避五，是歲中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":968,"lineType":2,"content":"求吉利方所也。凡坐作進退，向吉避凶，莫大於此矣。一旬，十日也，年中生日也。凡在一月之中，一旬之内，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":969,"lineType":2,"content":"將生日天元配合而言，則知其日中休祥，定立生日為主也。一歲之中，取月令，以生尅配合而言，則知其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":970,"lineType":2,"content":"月中休咎也。且如人生得地，須太歲為尊，是一歲之中，求生月帶祿，或官印原有原無，是月而問日，乃看","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":971,"lineType":2,"content":"命總法也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"957","lineNum":972,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸乃秋生而冬旺，亥子同途；甲乙乃夏死而春榮，寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506740344979491"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"卯一揆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":976,"lineType":2,"content":"此言人命有生旺死絶，而行運所值，有宜與不宜，通指五行言也。庚為衆金之主，故居申而生水，水歸亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":977,"lineType":2,"content":"子，冬天而旺。壬為聚水之源，故居亥而生木，水歸寅卯，春天而旺。甲為羣木之首，故居寅而生火，火歸巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":978,"lineType":2,"content":"午，夏天而旺。戊為衆土之尊，故居巳而生金，金歸申酉，秋天而旺。壬癸亥子，一類水也，水生於申而旺於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":979,"lineType":2,"content":"子。甲乙寅卯，一類木也，木旺於卯而死於午。故壬癸秋生而冬旺，甲乙夏死而春榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"964","lineNum":980,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅丁卯，秋天宜以保持；己巳戊辰，度乾宫而脱厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":981,"lineType":2,"content":"此指納音言也。丙寅丁卯爐中火，火之旺也，至秋宜以保持。以火至秋而死，况他火乎？己巳戊辰大林木，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":982,"lineType":2,"content":"木之盛也，度乾宫而脱厄。以木至亥而生也，况别木乎？又丙寅丁卯，舉火之類，火既尅金，秋天保持者何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506740344995875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":985,"lineType":2,"content":"也？言水生於秋故也。己巳戊辰，舉木之類，木既生亥，乾宫脱厄者何也？言亥有乾金故也。明五行休旺之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":986,"lineType":2,"content":"道，造化自然之理，或元命，或行運，或流歲，皆宜慎之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"970","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"值病憂病，逢生得生，旺相崢嶸，休囚滅絶。論其眷屬，憂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":988,"lineType":1,"content":"其死絶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":989,"lineType":2,"content":"值病憂病，以休囚滅絶為言；逢生得生，以旺相崢嶸為義。值病憂病者，五行病中逢鬼是也。木值辛巳金，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":990,"lineType":2,"content":"火值甲申水，土遇庚寅木，金逢乙亥火，如此之類，休囚滅絶。逢生得生者，五行生處逢生是也。木臨癸亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":991,"lineType":2,"content":"水，火得庚寅木，水值壬申金，金逢丁巳土，如此之類，旺相崢嶸。或值之於當生，或逢之於歲運，更看始終，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":992,"lineType":2,"content":"隨宜消息。五行生我者，父母；我生者，子孫；尅我者，官鬼；我尅者，妻財；比和者，兄弟。忌在空亡死絶之地，憂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506703208759296"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":995,"lineType":2,"content":"居休囚衰敗之鄉，隨眷屬所得言之。此總論五行，生乎天地之間，寓於十二支内有長生、沐浴、冠帶、臨官、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":996,"lineType":2,"content":"帝、旺、衰、病、死、墓絶、胎養，内有四吉、四凶、四平也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"979","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"墓在鬼中，危疑者甚。足下臨喪，面前可見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":998,"lineType":2,"content":"墓在鬼中，乃五行墓中逢鬼。如金畏己丑火，木防乙未金，水愁丙辰土，土忌戊辰木，火怕壬戌水，如此之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":999,"lineType":2,"content":"格，或行乎歲運，主危疑之甚。足下臨喪，以命前二辰為喪門。如辛亥人見己丑，既入墓，又臨喪，乃足下同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":1000,"lineType":2,"content":"為禍。面前可見，言其凶速也。若太歲諸煞，大小運臨之，憂其不測之灾，防有外服之象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"983","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"憑陰察其陽禍，歲星莫犯於孤辰；恃陽鑒以陰灾，天年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":1002,"lineType":1,"content":"忌逢於寡宿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506703208742912"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":1005,"lineType":2,"content":"寅卯辰人，巳為孤辰，丑為寡宿。其寅辰為陽之位，丑巳為陰之位。故曰憑陰察其陽禍，歲星莫犯於孤辰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":1006,"lineType":2,"content":"巳午未人，以申為孤辰，辰為寡宿，未巳為陰之位，申辰為陽之位。故曰恃陽鑑以陰灾，天年忌逢於寡宿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":1007,"lineType":2,"content":"天年猶小運也，歲星猶太歲也。陽以孤辰為重，陰以寡宿為重。徐曰：陰以陽為對，陽以陰為耦。言陽則未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":1008,"lineType":2,"content":"嘗無陰，言陰則未嘗無陽。故憑陰可以察陽，恃陽可以鑒陰。歲星者，太歲也，不可在孤辰之上。假令寅卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":1009,"lineType":2,"content":"辰人，遇太歲在巳，寅人勾絞，卯人喪弔，辰人謂之控神煞，又謂之邀神煞，主阻礙抑塞。天年亦太歲，不可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":1010,"lineType":2,"content":"在寡宿之上。如寅卯辰人遇太歲在丑，辰人勾絞卯人喪弔，寅人謂之窺神煞，又謂之迫神煞，主人窺竊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":1011,"lineType":2,"content":"逼迫䧟害。其或三元刑戰，歲運不和，是五行祿馬為害之年，則為凶尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"993","lineNum":1012,"lineType":1,"content":"先論二氣，次課延生。父病推其子祿，妻灾課以夫年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506703208775680"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":1015,"lineType":2,"content":"五行相生為父子，其為傳受之氣，青赤等類是也。陰陽相制為夫妻，其為交合之辰，支干等類是也。假令","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":1016,"lineType":2,"content":"金病無疑畏火，急求水以救之，以金生水為子，能尅火故也。又如金之灾者，恐值火也，且看火之休旺何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":1017,"lineType":2,"content":"如。此乃救解二法，最為詳要。徐曰：二氣者，陰陽也。延生者，命運也。先别陰陽，次分命運。父病二句，是明陰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":1018,"lineType":2,"content":"陽進退之象也。假令庚辰人十月生，庚金病於亥，是父病也。庚生壬為子，壬祿在亥，是子有祿也。庚以乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":1019,"lineType":2,"content":"為妻，大運到巳，乙木病於巳，是妻灾也。而庚金復得延年，五行俱如此類。如壬癸日生人，以庚辛為父，行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":1020,"lineType":2,"content":"亥子運，金病死亥子，主父母灾，或丁憂。丙丁日生人，以庚辛為妻，行寅卯運，金絶寅卯，主妻灾或喪偶。又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":1021,"lineType":2,"content":"如丙寅人，大運至戊申，火雖病，而丙寅為戊申之父，土至申長生，子祿既生，父承子祿之蔭，雖病亦不至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":1022,"lineType":2,"content":"死。如丁卯人行運至甲午，火尅金為妻，金至午而敗，可謂妻灾。丁卯火旺於午，又逢天祿，金火相得，陰陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506712792711179"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":1025,"lineType":2,"content":"相合，雖五行妻灾，以夫年旺而不為凶。葢父子天合，夫妻人合，是人之至親骨肉也。故觀其夫子之命，遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":1026,"lineType":2,"content":"凶神惡煞，當刑傷父母妻子，則父病必深，妻灾必重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"三宫元吉，禍逢可以延推。始末皆凶，灾忽來而迅速。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":1028,"lineType":2,"content":"三宫乃祿、命、身三元長生之宫，四柱寓居，是宫逢祿馬貴人，五行生旺，謂之元吉。雖行年歲運，逢凶神惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":1029,"lineType":2,"content":"煞，欲為之禍，亦遲延而不至於夭折。三元五行無氣，加以歲運凶神惡煞來臨，是始末皆凶，其禍之至，迅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":1030,"lineType":2,"content":"速而不可救。徐曰：前論陰陽始終，此説人命吉凶。如命内天元、人元、支元内外歲月時中值貴祿，不居休","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":1031,"lineType":2,"content":"敗，是根基主本，三元元吉。或值行年太歲，運命乖危之地，然亦可以推禍以遲延也。若三元内外，雖有祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":1032,"lineType":2,"content":"馬貴氣，却八字中衝刑破害，不唯有貴而不貴，又終為凶人之命。如遇吉運，則防因福生禍；遇凶運，則灾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506694375620662"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":1035,"lineType":2,"content":"忽來而迅速。二解同一義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":1036,"lineType":1,"content":"宅墓受煞，落梁塵以呻吟；喪弔臨人，變宫商為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":1036,"lineType":1,"content":"薤露","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_44","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":1036,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":1037,"lineType":2,"content":"命前五辰為宅，命後五辰為墓。煞、刼煞、灾煞，歲煞也。命前二辰為喪門，命後二辰為弔客。人，人元也。古之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":1038,"lineType":2,"content":"善歌者，有遶梁之聲；善唱者，合宫商之曲。今易以呻吟愁嘆，變為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":1038,"lineType":2,"content":"薤露","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_45","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":1038,"lineType":2,"content":"挽歌，則喪弔臨門，宅墓受煞故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":1039,"lineType":2,"content":"其或太歲凶煞臨併，大小運限刑衝，必致凶禍，切宜預偹。或宅墓二位，若遇逐年太歲、喪門、弔客、黄旛、豹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":1040,"lineType":2,"content":"尾、太陰、大耗、将軍諸惡煞入宅，一主呻吟，二主忍痛，三主分離，四主哭泣，此為四聲入宅。或云移居避舍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":1041,"lineType":2,"content":"可免。此言流歲所遇之凶煞也。人命原有尤重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":1042,"lineType":1,"content":"干推兩重，防灾於元首之間；支拆三輕，慎禍於股肱之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506733348798505"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":1045,"lineType":1,"content":"内。下元一氣，周居去住之期；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":1046,"lineType":2,"content":"干推兩重者，干為天元，以象元首，遇德見貴者吉，逢煞值鬼者凶。天元兩值受尅，如甲子生得庚午月，加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":1047,"lineType":2,"content":"以庚午日，謂之重者，干不勝重尅故也。防灾於頭目胸背之間；支拆三輕，支猶人之支節，主之於命，帶三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":1048,"lineType":2,"content":"合、六合者吉，逢四衝、三刑者凶。支辰三刑逢傷，如辛酉人得庚寅月、丁巳日、戊申時，謂之輕者，刑不至於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":1049,"lineType":2,"content":"本命故也。慎禍於腹臟股肱之内，或以三合逢傷亦通。下元一氣，納音是也。其主宰五行，逐干支遷變而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":1050,"lineType":2,"content":"成否泰，其灾禍不拘元首股肱，故云周居去住之期。天干推兩重，况三乎？支拆三輕，况兩乎？此干支輕重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":1051,"lineType":2,"content":"之别也。或曰：此論十干，遇大運，在本年上值干，反尅太歳，干尅名為鬼臨頭，患頭而之疾。十二支辰，若身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":1052,"lineType":2,"content":"命逢生死旺五鬼，須有四肢腰脚之疾，比於干為輕也。復言氣運，陶隠居歌曰：甲己五年乙庚四，丙辛三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506712792727563"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":1055,"lineType":2,"content":"歲丁壬二，戊癸須從一歲推。又有納音行運氣相生，福德相尅凶，五行恭順皆如意。金人遇金犯凶禍，木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":1056,"lineType":2,"content":"人見木營求遂，水人值水主動摇，運順逆氣須還記。假令癸酉男命三月生，三月建丙辰，便従丙辰起三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":1057,"lineType":2,"content":"歲。丁己土二歲，此五年，納音是土，别無刑尅。戊午住一年，己未住五年，此六年，納音是火，金遇火凶。庚申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":1058,"lineType":2,"content":"上四年，辛酉三年，此七年，納音是木。自十二至十八，主營求稱遂。餘倣此。循環數之，或一宫住五年，或住","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":1059,"lineType":2,"content":"一年，故云去住之期。大運住在旺鄉，設使氣有相制，則不能為害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":1060,"lineType":1,"content":"仁而不仁，慮傷伐於戊己。至於寢食侍衛，物有鬼物，人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":1061,"lineType":1,"content":"有鬼人，逢之為灾，去之為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":1062,"lineType":2,"content":"甲乙本五常為仁，今反言不仁，以其尅戊己凶也。如甲見戊，乙見己，偏陰偏陽，為尅，為伐，為孤，為背，則五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506710364094502"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":1065,"lineType":2,"content":"行為不仁也。若甲見己，乙見戊，剛柔相乘，兩得其所，未可以不仁言也。賦中舉甲乙戊己為例，其餘五行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":1066,"lineType":2,"content":"可以例求。五行變化與人事相通，至於寢食侍衛，皆不外於仁而已。五行我尅之謂財，尅我之謂鬼。譬之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":1067,"lineType":2,"content":"辛卯人遇丁酉，辛祿在酉，逢丁為辛之鬼，是之謂祿頭逢鬼，物有鬼物；命支屬木，酉支屬金，金來尅木，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":1068,"lineType":2,"content":"之謂人元受尅，人有鬼人。格局中類此者，運逢之則為灾，去之則為福。或曰：君子晨興暮寢，常宜攝衛䕶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":1069,"lineType":2,"content":"持，其或食息弗調，動過生灾，於是合中逢鬼，吉内藏凶。雖或人情所為，亦被陰陽所宰然也。寢食言調養","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":1070,"lineType":2,"content":"之至切也，侍衛言左右之至近也，此二者甚不可輕忽，以物中有鬼物，人中有鬼人，吉凶之變，自近及遠，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":1071,"lineType":2,"content":"為速之甚也。且如戊見甲為不仁，或歲月時中見庚辛則為仁，謂戊食庚，庚來制甲；或見己亦為仁，謂己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":1072,"lineType":2,"content":"合甲，能侍衛甲也。戊逢甲本不仁，為灾，有庚己寢食侍衛，是謂去之為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506740345028643"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"就中裸形俠煞，魄徃酆都；所犯有傷，魂歸岱嶺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":1076,"lineType":2,"content":"就中是本上文鬼物鬼人言。就中所遇極重者，五行沐浴之地，謂之裸形。如本音沐浴，大運逢之者，灾。水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":1077,"lineType":2,"content":"土，人運在酉，木，人運在子，火，人運在卯，金，人運在午，鬼谷子謂之波浪限。俠煞者，元辰七煞也。如人運在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":1078,"lineType":2,"content":"沐浴之上，與太歲併者，灾。或當生歲時，原有所犯之神，則魂歸岱嶺，魄徃酆都，此至凶之名也。或云俠煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":1079,"lineType":2,"content":"拱七煞也，裸形見煞，尤為不吉。午乃辛煞，酉乃乙煞，子乃丁煞，卯乃己煞。假如辛巳日乙未時是裸形俠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":1080,"lineType":2,"content":"煞，餘倣此。或以甲子金人得戊午歲金，裸形在午，加以戊午旺火夾帶自刑，反吟灾煞，破甲子之命，如此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":1081,"lineType":2,"content":"則所犯有傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":1082,"lineType":1,"content":"或乃行來出入，抵犯凶方；嫁娶修營，路登黄黒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506691464757284"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":1085,"lineType":2,"content":"行來出入，動作施為也。嫁娶修營，乃動作施為中之大者。吉凶悔吝生乎動，故君子慎焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":1085,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_46","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":1085,"lineType":2,"content":"既談三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":1086,"lineType":2,"content":"命五行，又述出人方所當避四魔五鬼六害七傷八難九厄為凶方，一徳二生為吉方。取逐年太歲神煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":1087,"lineType":2,"content":"看之，行黄道為吉，黒道為凶也。○或曰：此論人運氣，自運元而行來出入吉凶之地，遇五行相尅相生，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":1088,"lineType":2,"content":"嫁娶修營之理。五行我尅之謂妻，妻在五行生旺之地則可娶，娶之則為助。尅我之謂夫，夫在五行生旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":1089,"lineType":2,"content":"之地則可嫁，嫁之則為福。言出於夫婦，可以成嫁娶之義也。修營者，言五行雖有正性，兩間有不常之變，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":1090,"lineType":2,"content":"是以君子修德營生，以待時而已。路登黄黒，指運元月建，上行黒道，十年順行至除滿，上行黄道。如運到","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":1091,"lineType":2,"content":"黄道，凡百皆利；運至黒道，凡百抑塞。凡人修為動作，進退向背，莫不本乎陰陽，體合運氣，吉凶俱不能逃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":1092,"lineType":1,"content":"灾福在歲年之位内，發覺由日時之擊揚。五神相尅，三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506691464773668"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"生定命。每見貴人食祿，無非祿馬之鄉；源濁伏吟，惆悵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":1096,"lineType":1,"content":"歇宫之地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":1097,"lineType":2,"content":"凡説歲中休祥，専看日時與太歲生尅刑衝言之。生日為妻，生時為子，日時與太歲和合，及財物有用，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":1098,"lineType":2,"content":"諸壞者，依事物而言之。如太歲與日時相刑，或六合、三合中有元辰七煞者，凶，亦看類而言之，故下文云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":1099,"lineType":2,"content":"云。○或曰：歲年指太歲行年言。凡人命遇流年歲君，凶則為灾，吉則為福，皆由五行中日時之激揚響應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":1100,"lineType":2,"content":"於歲位。五神者，五行也。三生者，三元也。凡觀人命，須究根基，用三元定宫，以五行相配。此法以日時祿馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":1101,"lineType":2,"content":"五子元求之，或相生於本命建旺之鄉，或駁尅於當生滅絶之地。至若運限加臨，必有吉凶之兆。凡遇五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":1102,"lineType":2,"content":"行而造化滅絶空亡，更逢運限刑衝，惡星交併，主多憂少樂，必招天殞，惆悵呻吟，故號歇宫之地。或指惆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506707780567077"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":1105,"lineType":2,"content":"悵為煞名，子人見亥，卯人見寅，午人見巳，酉人見申。指五神為絶體、遊魂、五鬼、絶命、本宫。三生為生氣、天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":1106,"lineType":2,"content":"醫、福徳。此以上謂出入嫁娶修營之法，非三命之説。謂用太歲五行之位内看其灾福，亦須擇吉日吉時，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":1107,"lineType":2,"content":"乃可用事，其説亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":1108,"lineType":1,"content":"狂横起於勾絞，禍敗發於元亡。宅墓同處，恐少樂而多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"憂；萬里囘還，乃是三歸之地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":1110,"lineType":2,"content":"神煞者，天地五行精氣也，各有所主吉凶。談命者先推五行休旺格局，然後參以神煞。觀其事類，陽命以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":1111,"lineType":2,"content":"前三辰為勾，後三辰為絞；陰命以前三辰為絞，後三辰為勾。或交臨運限，乃招狂横之灾。元辰、亡神二煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":1112,"lineType":2,"content":"名，更值當生凶煞，歲運刑星，多因官事勾連，無端縈絆，加以宅墓同處於勾絞、元亡之上，尤凶。譬癸亥生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506751753420834"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":1115,"lineType":2,"content":"前五辰見戊辰，乃水之墓，流年歲運若帶煞來同處其中，是宅墓同處也。三歸者，乃辰戌丑未，此云三丘，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":1116,"lineType":2,"content":"亦云五墓。萬物歸根復命，反本還元。凡此四辰，以應囘環之象。或以三元五行歸宿之地為三歸，如甲子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":1117,"lineType":2,"content":"人得亥年為木祿之一歸，得申月是水命之二歸，巳運是身金之三歸，皆指三元本音長生之位而言。雖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":1118,"lineType":2,"content":"身客萬里長途，将有迴還之理也。徐曰：勾絞不可在元命日時二運之上，更或與元辰七煞併者，尤凶。宅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":1119,"lineType":2,"content":"墓如戊子生遇辛未太歲，亦須未子日上有日時，或大運同宫者，則重主不利陰人小口家宅。此言大運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":1120,"lineType":2,"content":"在十二辰之間，順逆囘環，在三元本祿本財終宿之地，遇此者優安享福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"四煞之父，多生五鬼之男；六害之徒，命有七傷之事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":1122,"lineType":2,"content":"此專論骨肉。四煞指刼灾天地言。或以辰戌丑未為四陰煞。五鬼乃子人見辰，丑見卯，寅見寅，卯見丑，辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506707780599845"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":1125,"lineType":2,"content":"見子，巳見亥，午見戌，未見酉，申見申，酉見未，戌見午，亥見巳是也。三元受傷，於年養子，乃是五鬼之男。反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":1126,"lineType":2,"content":"制受尅，不和順也。六害子穿未等例。十二支不順，命值一兩重六害或展轉凶煞併衝。如此之人，命有七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":1127,"lineType":2,"content":"傷之事决矣。七傷乃害六親及本身也。或以四煞専指四刼。五行生於四孟，生者萬物之父，五行尅我為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":1128,"lineType":2,"content":"鬼，人所遇生敗旺死絶五變者是也。譬之甲申，自生之水為木，人刼煞之父而生庚申，木為子，甲乃庚之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":1129,"lineType":2,"content":"父，至申而絶，逢庚為鬼，加以丁亥，因為甲申之六害。如此則命有七傷之事矣。七傷亦神煞名，觀賦前云","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":1130,"lineType":2,"content":"或逢四煞、五鬼、六害、七傷可見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"眷屬情同水火，相逢於沐浴之鄉；骨肉中道分離，孤宿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":1132,"lineType":1,"content":"尤嫌於隔角。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506751753388066"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":1135,"lineType":2,"content":"此合上文言也。沐浴煞長生第二位，子午卯酉是也。孤辰寡宿，巳論於前隔角，寅申巳亥是也。有人命逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":1136,"lineType":2,"content":"沐浴相尅，又孤辰寡宿，臨於隔角之位，如卯日丑時、丑日卯時之例。丑者北方之氣，卯者東方之神，其趣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":1137,"lineType":2,"content":"不同。眷屬情同。水火言不相合也，分離則又甚矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":1138,"lineType":1,"content":"須要明其神煞，輕重較量，身尅煞而尚輕，煞尅身而尤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":1139,"lineType":1,"content":"重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":1140,"lineType":2,"content":"五行所司者，命也。論命必先之以五行四柱格局，次論神煞吉凶，可以較量禍福之輕重而已。先論五行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":1141,"lineType":2,"content":"見根基之厚薄，分格局之高下，二者相叅，庶不差悞。神煞，上文勾絞、元亡、孤辰、寡宿、隔角、沐浴、宅墓、喪弔、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":1142,"lineType":2,"content":"伏吟、反吟、三歸、四煞、五鬼、六害、七傷等名是也。祿馬、財官、印綬、食神，乃五行生尅正理，不可以神煞名之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506707780583461"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":1145,"lineType":2,"content":"身，指歲干言，或以歲干支納音言。吉凶神煞，或得於日時之間，或逢於歲運之内，但以煞尅身而重，身尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":1146,"lineType":2,"content":"煞而輕，更要隨五行四柱格局，詳審消息。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"至於循環八卦，因","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"河","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_47","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"洛","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_48","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"之遺文，畧之定為一端，究之翻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":1148,"lineType":1,"content":"成萬緒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":1149,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_49","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":1149,"lineType":2,"content":"言三命五行，不外九宫八卦，循環推究，便有許多道理出焉。此非臆説，乃因","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":1149,"lineType":2,"content":"河","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_50","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":1149,"lineType":2,"content":"洛","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_51","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":1149,"lineType":2,"content":"遺文而為之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":1150,"lineType":2,"content":"始出一端，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":1150,"lineType":2,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_52","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":1150,"lineType":2,"content":"有太極是也。終成萬緒，變六十四卦，三百八十四爻，吉凶悔吝，不啻萬緒而已。一端萬緒，在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":1151,"lineType":2,"content":"學者畧之究之。或曰：畧之定為一端，即元一氣兮先天也。究之翻成萬緒，即賦中所説五行三元、運氣行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":1152,"lineType":2,"content":"年、祿馬貴德諸吉凶神煞是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506697231876123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":1155,"lineType":1,"content":"若值攀鞍踐祿，逢之則佩印乘軒；馬劣財微，遇之則流","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":1156,"lineType":1,"content":"而不返。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":1157,"lineType":2,"content":"數起於一而終於九。九者，究也，究窮數之終而極於九。九者，九陽太過，窮極生化之數也。人貴賤成敗之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":1158,"lineType":2,"content":"理，莫不由之於數而已。譬癸酉生，壬戌月，丁亥日，庚子時，坐天祿，月日時中，納音水土，得三陽生旺之成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":1159,"lineType":2,"content":"數，陰生命三辰，㑹祿馬攀鞍之上，斯命也，必致身於貴顯，故曰若值云云。如乙酉生，丁亥月，己卯日，丁亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":1160,"lineType":2,"content":"時，命亥月雖乘水馬，遇丁亥土尅之為鬼，卯日雖坐天祿，以水土俱死於卯，而遇身鬼衝破本命，所謂祿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":1161,"lineType":2,"content":"馬返以為鬼灾矣。祿馬既失，必藉身財為資，而水以火財，自絶於亥，生月日時，皆臨三財死絶之地，此五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":1162,"lineType":2,"content":"行之窮數也。雖有祿馬，身財盡為鬼物所奪，縱使得運，以數之終窮休敗，飄蕩無歸，故曰馬劣云云。○或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506710364127270"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":1165,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：馬前一辰為攀鞍，馬後一辰為鞭策，攀鞍有位，與天元帶合者，人得之貴也。須要加臨吉將，歲運資身，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":1166,"lineType":2,"content":"更於旺相之宫，始可言福。驛馬微劣，財命休囚，則塗炭辛勤，終無成立。此以四柱臨之，定主飄蓬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":1167,"lineType":1,"content":"占除望拜，甲午以四八為期；口舌文書，己亥慎三十有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":1168,"lineType":1,"content":"二。善惡相伴，摇動遷移，夾煞持丘，親姻哭送。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":1169,"lineType":2,"content":"此論行年大小運由之於數，數有竒耦之變，吉凶自此以生也。甲午生人三十二小運，丁酉金家旺鄉，乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":1170,"lineType":2,"content":"丑太歲本音正庫，又逢驛馬入宅，天乙加臨，故占除望拜之喜。己亥生人三十二小運，丁酉在弔客，太歲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":1171,"lineType":2,"content":"庚午在死鄉，仍為六厄之宫，三元受尅，故有口舌文書之患。又歲運交宫，當須意㑹，吉凶相伴，禍福交攻，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":1172,"lineType":2,"content":"未有不因遷變而興，故云善惡相伴，摇動遷移，則吉凶悔吝生乎動者也。辰戌丑未，謂之四煞，亦云三丘","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506697231859739"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":1175,"lineType":2,"content":"之地，各以五行五墓。假令己巳木命，得乙未日生，此是本家三丘，又加以羊刃，故曰夾煞持坵，危疑者甚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":1176,"lineType":2,"content":"自行來出入，止夾煞持丘。此一節文，亦備陰陽地理、三元九宫之例，用遊年太歲决其灾福，非盡三命之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":1177,"lineType":2,"content":"理，兹不盡述。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":1178,"lineType":1,"content":"兼須詳其操執，觀其秉持，厚薄論其骨狀，成器藉於心","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":1179,"lineType":1,"content":"源。木氣盛而仁昌，庚辛虧而義寡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":1180,"lineType":2,"content":"此言雖用五行定命，見其貴賤灾福，慮有特傑非常之人，似氷䑕火龜，難窮罕測之資，則三元五行不足","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":1181,"lineType":2,"content":"以盡之也。兼須詳其操執、秉持、骨狀心源，則視其所以，觀其所由，察其所安。心術制行，兩得之矣，相貌德","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":1182,"lineType":2,"content":"行，互見之矣。人焉廋哉，人焉廋哉！此珞琭子觀人之法，而有合於吾儒之論也。麻衣有心無相，相逐心生；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506733348847657"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":1185,"lineType":2,"content":"有相無心，心隨相滅，亦是此義。甲乙木主仁，丙丁火主禮，戊己土主信，庚辛金主義，壬癸木主智。木盛則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":1186,"lineType":2,"content":"仁昌，金虧則義寡。餘皆象事知器，占事知來。此以五行配五常，定人之器量也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":1187,"lineType":1,"content":"惡曜加而有喜，擬其大器；福星臨而禍發，以表凶人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":1188,"lineType":2,"content":"修之於身，其德乃真，故曰忠孝仁義，德之順也。雖臨諸煞，反為權星，富貴而驕，自貽厥咎，故曰悖傲無禮，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":1189,"lineType":2,"content":"德之逆焉。善不失善報為惡自招殃。此珞琭子深戒之也。擬表二字最有味。惡曜宜加禍而反有喜，非大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":1190,"lineType":2,"content":"器之君子不能也。葢器識遠大之人，忠孝仁義，慎禮守法，禍焉能干？故曰擬其。福星臨，宜喜而反有禍，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":1191,"lineType":2,"content":"小人恃命而妄作也。不忠不孝，不仁不義，悖逆無禮，禍焉能迯？故曰以表。語曰：凶人凶其吉，吉人吉其凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":1192,"lineType":2,"content":"此之謂也。此承上文操執、秉持、骨狀、心源而言，君子小人見矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506751753404450"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":1195,"lineType":1,"content":"處定求動，尅未盡而難遷；居安問危，可凶中而卜吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":1196,"lineType":2,"content":"此珞琭子敎人求名謀動，趨吉避凶之道也。天命在德，亦當論尅我尅彼。我尅彼則為權，彼尅此則為鬼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":1197,"lineType":2,"content":"是尅是財，不尅不食。處定求動，尅未盡而難遷。行年歲運，五行來尅，本命為官，不能遷動，宜守靜以待之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":1198,"lineType":2,"content":"不衝不尅，則難以發越。居安問危，可凶中而卜吉者，君子居則觀其象而玩其詞，動則觀其變而玩其占。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":1199,"lineType":2,"content":"是以自天祐之，吉無不利。且吉凶禍福之興也，非聖人孰能察於未萌之前哉？若能趨吉避凶，居安慮危，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":1200,"lineType":2,"content":"亦庶乎其無咎矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":1201,"lineType":1,"content":"貴而忘賤，灾自奢生；迷而不返，禍從惑起。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":1202,"lineType":2,"content":"君子見天命而不敢求福於天，小人慢天命而不知正福於己。貴而忘賤，迷而不返，不能居安問危，而轉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506710364160038"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":1205,"lineType":2,"content":"處定求動。是以灾自奢生，禍從惑起。至於亡身敗家而不悔，不亦深可哀哉！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":1206,"lineType":1,"content":"殊常易舊，變處為萌；福善禍淫，吉凶異兆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":1207,"lineType":2,"content":"動靜為利害之樞機，智慮乃禍福之門户。術不可不慎，機不可不察。小人不知天命，不中常道，輕生易物，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":1208,"lineType":2,"content":"則禍淫由此而始也。君子得時而動，失時而守，體天行道，畏於輕動，則福善由此而生也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":1208,"lineType":2,"content":"易","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_53","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":1208,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：吉凶悔吝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":1209,"lineType":2,"content":"生乎動者也。又曰：吉凶者，得失之象也。積善之家，必有餘慶。積不善之家，必有餘殃。又曰：知進退存亡之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":1210,"lineType":2,"content":"道者，其唯聖人乎！此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":1210,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_54","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":1210,"lineType":2,"content":"篇終之大戒也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":1211,"lineType":1,"content":"至於公明、季主，尚無識變之文；景純、仲舒，不載比形之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":1212,"lineType":1,"content":"妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506747349401651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":1215,"lineType":2,"content":"管公明、司馬季主、郭景純、董仲舒，此四賢者，探天人之奥，原性命之理，窮陰陽象數，知未來吉凶，尚無識","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":1216,"lineType":2,"content":"變之文，不載比形之妙，言造化深隠，不易度量。珞琭子不言姓氏，不知何時人。觀其賦中自云出入蘭野，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":1217,"lineType":2,"content":"又稱及於郭景純，疑六朝時人。梁昭明其近之。昭明所居，乃蘭陵之野也。或以為周靈王太子子晉，則誣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":1218,"lineType":1,"content":"詳其徃聖，鑒以前賢，或指事以陳謀，或約文而切理，多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":1219,"lineType":1,"content":"或少剩，二義難精。今者叅詳得失，補綴遺蹤，規為心鑑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":1220,"lineType":1,"content":"永掛清臺，引列終編，千希得一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":1221,"lineType":2,"content":"凡論五行，離道者非也，離世法者非也，離人物者亦非也。或約文而切理，或指事以陳謀。於中神煞交叅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":1222,"lineType":2,"content":"吉凶互體。是知五行通道，志物難窮，流布其間，豈云小補。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":1222,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_55","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":1222,"lineType":2,"content":"終於此，談言是賦之作，詳徃聖之遺文，鑒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506747349418035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":1225,"lineType":2,"content":"前賢之得失。文博而言約，道妙而義深。顯仁藏用，乃五行三命之指南也。後學者繼此而發明之，使聵者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":1226,"lineType":2,"content":"聰，瞽者明，歴百世而無窮，統一性之常在。觀其始末，通神合變。縦横之諭，皆不溺於他術；戒諭之言，多有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":1227,"lineType":2,"content":"合於至道。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":1227,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_56","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":1227,"lineType":2,"content":"者，豈非圓機之士，高尚之流也歟？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":1228,"lineType":8,"content":"通玄子撰集珞琭子賦註","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":1229,"lineType":1,"content":"金逢寅午戌方吉，丙戊巳午喜慶德，甲乙寅卯是財神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":1230,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸潤下為傷尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":1231,"lineType":2,"content":"庚用丁官，辛用丙官，喜丙丁，愛寅午戌，利巳午、未火旺之地，向祿臨官，辛巳、庚午為貴。假如庚申、辛酉庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":1232,"lineType":2,"content":"午、辛未庚寅、辛卯、庚子、辛丑、庚辰、辛巳庚戌、辛亥，此十二宫命，金家以火為官，木為財，火到申酉亥子丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506740345094179"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":1235,"lineType":2,"content":"無氣，木到申酉戌子丑氣衰，是財命無氣，貧賤之命也。若生月日時遇旺相，坐午巳寅位之地，可為貴命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":1236,"lineType":2,"content":"若不遇火，則非貴命。見壬癸亥子水者，為背官背祿，不成慶也。得寅午戌，全為官神入局，天元戊癸，全為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":1237,"lineType":2,"content":"化火官局，地支巳午，全為暗官局，更遇木神補助，並為上局。柱有壬癸亥申、子辰水，喜遇戊己尅水為救，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":1238,"lineType":2,"content":"又為印貴。見甲乙、寅卯，亥為財，未為財庫，無刑害，財庫受實，可作發財斷之。背祿不逢官印貴地，只遇木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":1239,"lineType":2,"content":"旺商徒發財之命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":1240,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸四季巳午榮，戊己榮官財丙丁，甲乙曲直皆凶地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":1241,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛印顯附龍鱗，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":1242,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸者，真水也，喜戊己、辰戌、丑未巳午方吉。葢壬用己官，癸用戊官，巳午官祿之地，四位之土，皆歴自旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506744522473491"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":1245,"lineType":2,"content":"之鄉。四五月上旬、六月中上旬，及三月下旬，生官有氣，乃能成慶。水以土為官位，若遇甲乙、亥卯、未寅，木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":1246,"lineType":2,"content":"破其官，尅害輕者，則官卑名㣲。尅害重者，不得其官。得庚辛金神旺相，可為助救，反主貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":1247,"lineType":1,"content":"火喜辰申亥子宫，壬癸官旺土孤窮。戊己退神甲乙進，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":1248,"lineType":1,"content":"金財榮顯祿興隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":1249,"lineType":2,"content":"火見壬癸，葢丙用癸官，丁用壬官，真造化既濟之道。見亥子為正官位，丁猪丙䑕為貴神，辰申亥子以為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":1250,"lineType":2,"content":"貴。逢土為六害，無救則貧。再逢甲乙旺相為救，庚辛己酉丑為財祿命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":1251,"lineType":1,"content":"土值寅卯未亥局，甲乙榮官金破祿，庚辛背祿愛丙丁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":1252,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸辰中長享福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506733348864041"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":1255,"lineType":2,"content":"戊己值亥卯未為貴，戊尋玉兎己猪頭，為貴命。又旺祿旺官之方，遇庚辛己酉丑辛戌，則破祿不貴。四月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":1256,"lineType":2,"content":"八月尤重，得丙丁為救神，且如戊見丙，己見丁，未不能救，謂之偏陰偏陽。若戊見丁，己見丙，方是救神。或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":1257,"lineType":2,"content":"生七月八月火死囚無氣，不能救。見亥子辰為財庫，主發財○少。木一宫亦可例見。喜己酉丑申辛庚，惡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":1258,"lineType":2,"content":"丙丁炎上火局變壬癸亥子為印，救助戊己辰戌丑未為財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":1259,"lineType":1,"content":"賢達之人明此訣，愚昧之人迷轉盛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":1260,"lineType":2,"content":"凡論命，先明天干，後論地支，并納音為九官，三元分為天地人，三才論五行四柱遇一陰一陽之謂道，偏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":1261,"lineType":2,"content":"陰偏陽之謂疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":1262,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己甲乙木格停，生旺官貴帝王臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506744522489875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":1265,"lineType":2,"content":"戊己若逢支干，木氣旺相，或見己亥癸亥真長生，官星主極品貴。生月再旺無刑衝，富貴雙全，看輕重言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":1266,"lineType":2,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":1267,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸戊己土旺方，大材分瑞上格詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":1268,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸。見戊己辰戌丑未土。己午月生土，旺相為貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":1269,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛冬至一陽生，丙丁生氣福如林。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":1270,"lineType":2,"content":"庚辛生人，冬至後一陽生火有煖氣，木漸到旺，能生丙丁之火，為官為祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":1271,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子夏生一陰長，亥子壬癸偏官鄉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":1272,"lineType":2,"content":"此明木火有功，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":1272,"lineType":2,"content":"既濟","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_57","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":1272,"lineType":2,"content":"之象。如夏氣淺則發早，夏至一陰長，水漸旺，故官祿生旺也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506740345110563"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":1275,"lineType":1,"content":"六甲生人在寅月，建祿不富無差别。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":1276,"lineType":2,"content":"六甲生人，正月建丙寅，是生月帶祿，為尅妻絶嗣，貧賤之命。甲以己為妻月，辛為官星為子，皆絶於寅，謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":1277,"lineType":2,"content":"之金絶土囚之地，祿馬妻子皆絶，不為貴氣。若用丙寅為食神有氣，須是甲人見庚申。乙人見辛或酉戌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":1278,"lineType":2,"content":"却在七煞旺鬼之地，得寅生火鬼降伏，化官為貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":1279,"lineType":1,"content":"乙人辛多酉月生，鬼旺身衰帶疾侵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":1280,"lineType":2,"content":"乙人見辛，為干頭見鬼，名為七煞。乙人見酉，身居白虎無氣之地，又遇七煞尅身，豈無疾患？甲人見庚與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":1281,"lineType":2,"content":"同，其人若不帶疾，須夀夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":1282,"lineType":1,"content":"詞舘學堂主科名，若無官貴定虛名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506710364192806"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":1285,"lineType":2,"content":"命逢詞舘學堂，詞舘是官祿長生之地，學堂是本主長生之地。有官貴者有科名，作貴命看，無官貴，則虛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":1286,"lineType":2,"content":"名之人前文有印，甲見癸亥子是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":1287,"lineType":1,"content":"魁星若也逢官位，定是神童腹隠貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":1288,"lineType":2,"content":"魁星者，乃甲辰旬中至癸丑十日是也。若遇本命官星，位逢官貴，學堂則應神童科。譬之癸丑人見戊申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":1289,"lineType":2,"content":"同在甲辰一旬是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":1290,"lineType":1,"content":"臨官逢處人欽敬。天馬財庫為貴命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":1291,"lineType":2,"content":"命犯臨官，人多欽重。天馬為妻財論之，如甲見己，為妻為財，辰為財庫，可作發財顯達命看。若妻臨旺相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":1292,"lineType":2,"content":"二運，或太歲再遇，多主婚姻出入修造之事。假如甲午人，己土為妻為馬，運到申酉、戌，午為人元，到西方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506740345126947"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":1295,"lineType":2,"content":"火絶死之地，己土自敗，有金旺土為財祿，人元財皆無氣。又如丙午生運至西方，丙見癸為官，癸水敗西","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":1296,"lineType":2,"content":"方，是官衰，丙以辛為馬、為財，酉戌有辛金，金為丙財旺，辛為馬到酉，建馬本畏衝，不衝掩藏，亦作發財命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":1297,"lineType":2,"content":"斷之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":1298,"lineType":1,"content":"命犯貴地得亨通，命衰遇旺福不迎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":1299,"lineType":2,"content":"命坐貴地，行向祿向財運，可言榮顯。元命逢官貴旺相，運雖凶，未必為灾。如壬癸生人，行巳午未運可發，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":1300,"lineType":2,"content":"北人運至南方貿易，獲其厚利。命遇休囚無官貴，運行貴地，不能成慶。命旺原有官星在命運，併背祿太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":1301,"lineType":2,"content":"歲衝害，有官休。官行主本長生運，亦罷官失職。與生地休囚者，如甲乙人見亥，葢官病地，故言休囚。生地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":1302,"lineType":2,"content":"相逢，亦言官星病絶，主為官之人，宜退身避位。若二運太歲併臨，喪弔丘墓俠煞，主哭聲祼形，俠煞自主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506744522539027"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":1305,"lineType":2,"content":"嗚呼！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":1306,"lineType":1,"content":"八孤五墓為僧道，破祖飄蓬孤獨人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":1307,"lineType":2,"content":"假甲子旬中，戌亥為空亡，為六虛，乾屬亥戍，戌南行三位是未，未東行三位是辰，辰北行三位是丑，丑西","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":1308,"lineType":2,"content":"行三位是戌，辰戌丑未四位，為孤寡五墓，多為破祖、孤獨、飄蓬之人。九流之命，三元尅害，為孤單命尅害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":1309,"lineType":2,"content":"若輕入舍命，如遇真孤神，尅妻害子之命。通玄子解，非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1286","lineNum":1309,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_58","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":1309,"lineType":2,"content":"本真，乃自撰集，與徐子平同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":1310,"lineType":1,"content":"明通賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_59","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":1310,"lineType":1,"content":"：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":1310,"lineType":2,"content":"東海徐子平撰。易水萬育吾解。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":1311,"lineType":1,"content":"太極判為天地，一氣分為陰陽。流出五行，化生萬物。為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":1312,"lineType":1,"content":"人禀命，貧富貴賤由之。術士知機，吉凶禍福定矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506747349467187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":1315,"lineType":8,"content":"此原造化之始","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":1316,"lineType":1,"content":"凡看命以日干為主，綂三元而配合八字干支。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":1317,"lineType":2,"content":"天有四時，造化萬物；屋有四柱，各立規模；命有四柱，注定榮枯。論者専以日辰天干為命元之主，支為地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":1318,"lineType":2,"content":"元祿，支内所藏者為人元夀。八字即四柱天干地支共八字也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":1318,"lineType":2,"content":"繼善篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_60","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":1318,"lineType":2,"content":"云：四柱排定，三才次分。専以日干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":1319,"lineType":2,"content":"天元配合八字干支是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":1320,"lineType":1,"content":"論運者，以月支為首，分四時而提起五行消長，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":1321,"lineType":2,"content":"大運以月支起，故月為提綱。看月支節氣淺深。四時得何節，如春木、夏火、秋金、冬水、季土，初氣、中氣，消長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":1322,"lineType":2,"content":"不同，所行之運，或順或逆，或旺或衰，與八字或助或泄，或尅或生者，本乎此。先言日干，次言月支，舉其所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506747349450803"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":1325,"lineType":2,"content":"要者以示人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":1326,"lineType":1,"content":"向官旺以成功，入格局而致貴。官印財食為吉，平定遂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":1327,"lineType":1,"content":"良；煞傷梟敗為凶，轉用為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":1328,"lineType":2,"content":"五行臨官，帝旺在四柱，為本宫成功之地，入格局則貴，破格局則賤。如官印財食，本是吉神，須無傷尅衝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":1329,"lineType":2,"content":"刑破敗，則為平定遂良，乃入格也。煞傷梟敗，本為凶煞，若有制伏，去留合化，是謂轉用為福，亦入格也。觀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":1330,"lineType":2,"content":"下取用諸格局，其喜忌自可見矣。四吉四凶，格局之最重者，故首言之。賦云：日主最宜健旺，用神不可損","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":1331,"lineType":2,"content":"傷是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":1332,"lineType":1,"content":"全備藏蓄於辰戌丑未，長生鎮居於巳亥寅申。子午則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506710364209190"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":1335,"lineType":1,"content":"成敗相逆，卯酉乃出入交互。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":1336,"lineType":2,"content":"此言十二支包藏十干，各有生死成敗，出入交互。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":1336,"lineType":2,"content":"獨歩","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_61","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":1336,"lineType":2,"content":"云：辰戌丑未，四庫之局；寅申巳亥，四生之局；子午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":1337,"lineType":2,"content":"卯酉，四敗之局。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":1337,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_62","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":1337,"lineType":2,"content":"云：財官印綬全備，藏蓄於四季之中；官星財氣長生，鎮居於寅申巳亥是也。或以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":1338,"lineType":2,"content":"子午為天地之基柱，卯酉為日月之門户，是指其地而遺其理也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":1339,"lineType":1,"content":"支干有不見之形，無中取有；節氣存有餘之數，混處求","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":1340,"lineType":1,"content":"分。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":1341,"lineType":2,"content":"此總言造化之妙。支干不見之形，節氣有餘之數，即上十二支中所包藏人元，乃無中取有，混超求分，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":1342,"lineType":2,"content":"遥已拱夾等格，是以天干而取地支之物，非無中取有而何？如子初三刻分屬壬水；丑初三刻分屬癸水；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506744522620947"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":1345,"lineType":2,"content":"寅初三刻分屬艮土，是節氣藏於一字，而各有所主，非混處求分而何？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":1345,"lineType":2,"content":"賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_63","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":1345,"lineType":2,"content":"云：無合有合，後學難知；得一分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":1346,"lineType":2,"content":"三，前賢不載。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":1346,"lineType":2,"content":"繼善篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_64","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":1346,"lineType":2,"content":"云見不見之形，無時不有是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":1347,"lineType":1,"content":"善惡相交，却喜化惡崇善；吉凶混雜，至怕害吉添凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":1348,"lineType":2,"content":"此下轉言看命之法，本上文取有求分而言。如甲日見丙丁背祿，為惡為凶；見戊己財星，為善為吉。而丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":1349,"lineType":2,"content":"丁化木助財，是謂化惡崇善；怕乙木尅害財星，是謂害吉添凶。觀下文財印交差，喜官煞化之；官煞混雜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":1350,"lineType":2,"content":"喜印綬化之，無印喜財，馬資化之，無財印喜羊刃合之，或食神傷官制之。又如制煞受破，煞制不住，印化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":1351,"lineType":2,"content":"見財，破化為凶之類皆是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
