{"lines":[{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":1352,"lineType":1,"content":"是故得局朝元，非富則貴；犯垣破局，非天則貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506742899277824"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":1355,"lineType":2,"content":"局者，三合四雜，正局之宫，如亥卯未木局，辰戌丑未土局之類。甲乙見亥卯未為本局；丙丁見亥卯未為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":1356,"lineType":2,"content":"印局；戊己見亥卯未為官局；庚辛見亥卯未為財局；壬癸見亥卯未為傷局之類。元即本元垣廟如子宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":1357,"lineType":2,"content":"癸朝元，丑未己土朝元之類。凡元垣得之，或用為命元則夀，為官印則貴，為財則富，為背祿生財益富。但","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":1358,"lineType":2,"content":"得其一，無衝刑尅破者，功名富貴，反之則否。犯垣，如子貴，忌丑未尅破，午衝破，卯刑破之類。一子二午，破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":1359,"lineType":2,"content":"盡一半，得半福。破局如申子辰，忌寅午戌衝破之類，大凶。若用星虛，成飛天祿馬格，反貴。餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":1360,"lineType":1,"content":"得失均兼，進退仍復，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":1361,"lineType":2,"content":"得朝。犯破，此造化之有得有失，有進有退，此得則彼失，强進則弱退，中間均兼，仍復變化難測，非精察詳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":1362,"lineType":2,"content":"辨，不能分也。如甲朝垣於寅，忌申衝破，若有二寅一申，二甲一庚，亦無害，以甲有力而進也。又寅被申衝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506742899245056"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":1365,"lineType":2,"content":"有亥可救，亥字堅盛，為福十全，亥或受戊尅己衝，則敗。若亥字多，不怕，亦强而進也。進退相仍，一成一敗，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":1366,"lineType":2,"content":"只看歲運助起何邊，為福為禍可知。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":1367,"lineType":1,"content":"神煞相絆，輕重較量。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":1368,"lineType":2,"content":"神煞，凡財官印食、傷煞刃敗，皆是。中間喜忌不同，愛憎互異，如下諸格所論是也。須輕重較量，何者當時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":1369,"lineType":2,"content":"而重為用，何者失令而輕不用，重者留之，輕者去之。此與上二句總言其理，當如此詳較。考","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":1369,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_65","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":1369,"lineType":2,"content":"，須要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":1370,"lineType":2,"content":"明其神煞，輕重較量，身尅煞而尚輕，煞尅身而尤重，是指諸吉凶神煞也。徐子平専以官印祿馬貴賤之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":1371,"lineType":2,"content":"别名解之。如甲申、丙寅、乙卯、辛巳，乙用庚為官，辛為煞，庚官在申，得寅衝去，丙合辛煞，乙木生旺，故貴。甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":1372,"lineType":2,"content":"寅、丁卯、癸丑、丁巳，是身尅煞，身弱財旺，力不能任其財官，故夭。如乙丑、辛巳、丁巳、己酉，身旺財亦旺，可任","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506742899261440"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":1375,"lineType":2,"content":"其財，所以止富。如甲子、辛未、乙卯、甲申，乙日用庚官，以辛為煞，庚在申内，六月生，官旺煞衰，此是正官得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":1376,"lineType":2,"content":"位，七煞失所，又喜身旺，變鬼為官，故貴。辛丑、庚寅、乙巳、甲申，官衰煞盛，乙木無力，化官為煞，一生嗜酒落","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1362","lineNum":1377,"lineType":2,"content":"魄，至乙酉運，第五年丙申歲八月十九日死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1363","lineNum":1378,"lineType":1,"content":"内有雜氣財官相兼偏正兩印，同宫祿馬，號為内外三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1364","lineNum":1379,"lineType":1,"content":"竒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1365","lineNum":1380,"lineType":2,"content":"此正指神煞相絆，乃八字中有財有官，有偏正二印，或同宫，或異位、或包藏、或透出相絆，難論吉凶，要輕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1366","lineNum":1381,"lineType":2,"content":"重較量用之，故曰内有三竒。歌曰：寅午戌酉是三竒，兎蛇隨猴不可移。巳酉丑中逢子妙，馬猴見猪好光","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1367","lineNum":1382,"lineType":2,"content":"輝。辰巳子逢即竒處，午亥見寅是貴墀。猪來趕兔馬當歡，寅酉見巳喜相宜，猪逐馬兒蛇後援，水䑕未人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1368","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506744522588179"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1369","lineNum":1385,"lineType":2,"content":"火龜池。又曰：神祿飛來就馬騎，資財官職兩相宜，旺中更得本元助，上格榮華第一竒。如己丑、丁卯、壬午、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1370","lineNum":1386,"lineType":2,"content":"癸卯，壬用己為官，丁為財，丁巳歸祿於午，是此格也，故主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1371","lineNum":1387,"lineType":1,"content":"真官時遇命强，早受金紫之封；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1372","lineNum":1388,"lineType":2,"content":"此月令正官格也。以下詳言格局，如戊申、甲寅、己丑、丙寅，翁仲益進士。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1373","lineNum":1389,"lineType":1,"content":"良馬月乘時健，末遷銀青之職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1374","lineNum":1390,"lineType":2,"content":"此月令正財格也。財官二格，官當取貴，財當取富，今俱以貴言，是獨日干取得月内支干之財，無所衝尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1375","lineNum":1391,"lineType":2,"content":"者言之，其福與正官同。詩云日干愛取月支財，金玉家藏看積堆。更看天干財馬貴，紛紛金帛自天來是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1376","lineNum":1392,"lineType":2,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1377","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506751753453602"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1378","lineNum":1395,"lineType":1,"content":"月印附日，無財氣，為黄榜招賢；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1379","lineNum":1396,"lineType":2,"content":"此月令正印格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1380","lineNum":1396,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_66","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1381","lineNum":1396,"lineType":2,"content":"云：月生日干無天財，乃印綬之名。又云：印綬生月，歲時忌見財星運入財鄉，却","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1382","lineNum":1397,"lineType":2,"content":"宜退身避職。印綬畏財，須天干歲時無財方取。又月印難得十全，如甲日亥月，透出癸字，變偏為正，方為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1383","lineNum":1398,"lineType":2,"content":"十全。主招恩寵遇貴，又得祖父之財，然亦不免先遭耻辱，或偏生以賤至貴，以微至富，自婢為婦，以吏為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1384","lineNum":1399,"lineType":2,"content":"官，以卒補将，皆偏印之所致也。偏正俱有，又有淺灾，或重拜父母，或僧俗相雜，或過房寄養，或偏生正養，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1385","lineNum":1400,"lineType":2,"content":"或正生偏養。又忌比肩爭寵分恩。羊刃多，或合去，或印微，遇而不遇，雖有薦舉，亦不能㧞萃超羣。賦云印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":1401,"lineType":2,"content":"旺官生，必掌鈞衡之任是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":1402,"lineType":1,"content":"日祿歸時沒官星，號青雲得路。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506742899310592"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":1405,"lineType":2,"content":"此日歸祿時格也。大抵印綬第一，最好行傷官食神，財運亦發，忌官刑衝羊刃。以上真官真財真印真祿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":1406,"lineType":2,"content":"皆十干天地陰陽正氣生尅至理，惟月分得之無破，唯經文有破壞者，隨輕重言之，時得發福較晚，然皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1391","lineNum":1407,"lineType":2,"content":"自致，可以創業垂綂。歸祿一格，只喜時上見之，若月支重見，名為建祿，不富。月單見時上，却喜財食見官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1392","lineNum":1408,"lineType":2,"content":"是别格。論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1393","lineNum":1409,"lineType":1,"content":"月令七煞，而煞身俱强，當為黒頭宰相；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1394","lineNum":1410,"lineType":2,"content":"此月令七煞格也。大抵月令煞，要身煞兩强，方主大貴。若身强煞淺，須財以生，煞强身弱，須印以助，或羊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1395","lineNum":1411,"lineType":2,"content":"刃合之，皆為貴命。若印合與制星相攻，身弱必夭，不然殘疾。如癸卯、乙卯、己巳、乙丑、○癸卯、丁巳、壬寅、甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1396","lineNum":1412,"lineType":2,"content":"辰、○壬寅、乙巳、庚寅、丙子，俱身强煞旺有制，所以大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1397","lineNum":1412,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_67","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1398","lineNum":1412,"lineType":2,"content":"云：五行遇月支偏官，歲時中亦宜制伏，所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1399","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506740345176099"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1400","lineNum":1415,"lineType":2,"content":"以救賦之偏也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1401","lineNum":1416,"lineType":1,"content":"時上偏財，而財命並旺，須出白屋公卿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1402","lineNum":1417,"lineType":2,"content":"此時上偏財格也。只一位為吉，見合不為福，忌比肩兄弟争奪，刑衝尅破，如丙戌、戊戌、戊子、壬子，戊尅癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1403","lineNum":1418,"lineType":2,"content":"為正財，重有子字壬字，為偏財透露；又如丁亥、戊申、壬申、丙午，雖年有丁火，喜有合制，又陰火能奪陽火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1404","lineNum":1419,"lineType":2,"content":"權，故貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1405","lineNum":1419,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_68","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1406","lineNum":1419,"lineType":2,"content":"云：時上偏財，别宫忌見，所以補賦未備之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1407","lineNum":1420,"lineType":1,"content":"建祿坐祿或歸祿。遇財官印綬，富貴長年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1408","lineNum":1421,"lineType":2,"content":"建祿以月言，坐祿以日言，歸祿以時言，此建祿格。本身健旺，故獨遇財則富，獨遇官則貴，獨遇印則秀，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1409","lineNum":1422,"lineType":2,"content":"其干旺，又主長命，安享福祿。若三者兼有，亦妙。如丁亥、己酉、壬午、辛亥，是日祿歸時，午中亦有官星，却得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1410","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506733348945961"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":1425,"lineType":2,"content":"酉月為印合格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":1426,"lineType":1,"content":"日刃月刃及時刃。逢官煞榮神，功名葢世。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1413","lineNum":1427,"lineType":2,"content":"此三刃格，要官煞印綬相制化，榮神印綬異名，有官煞無印，有煞無官，俱得，有印化煞尤佳，只怕覊絆，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1414","lineNum":1428,"lineType":2,"content":"有官不可見傷，有印不可見財，有煞不可見食傷壓之，或制去、合去，皆不成正格。如壬申、壬子、戊午、乙卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1415","lineNum":1429,"lineType":2,"content":"日，刃，有乙卯制伏；丙戌、癸巳、戊午、丁巳日刃，有印綬變化，故皆貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1416","lineNum":1430,"lineType":1,"content":"月令專制七煞，身健鷹揚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1417","lineNum":1431,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_69","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1418","lineNum":1431,"lineType":2,"content":"云：若乃時逢七煞，見之未必為凶，月制干强，其煞反為權印。即解此義也。一云時上偏官通月氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1419","lineNum":1432,"lineType":2,"content":"主旺鷹揚。與此少異。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506740345192483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":1435,"lineType":1,"content":"運元生發三財，命强豹變。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":1436,"lineType":2,"content":"運元，月令也；三財，祿命身也。此是日干背祿，即傷食格也。喜逢財星，如甲日逢巳午月，須干頭透出戊字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1423","lineNum":1437,"lineType":2,"content":"丑戌未日，時日主健旺，行東方運，必然大發財祿，白手成家。一云月中正祿㑹財元，身强豹變，與此少異。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1424","lineNum":1438,"lineType":1,"content":"年見正祿正印正財無破，必承祖蔭傳芳；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1425","lineNum":1439,"lineType":2,"content":"重在無破有破，不以此論。年為祖宗，故云云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1426","lineNum":1440,"lineType":1,"content":"日坐真宫真貴真印有成，號曰福神治世。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1427","lineNum":1441,"lineType":2,"content":"重在有成，有成即無破，真即正義，若參之以偏，為所假借，非真正也。如丙子、丁亥、辛巳、庚午等日，為真官；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1428","lineNum":1442,"lineType":2,"content":"丁酉、癸巳、癸卯、丁亥等日，為真貴，甲子、乙亥時日為真印。柱中無破，有助為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1429","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506744522637331"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1430","lineNum":1445,"lineType":1,"content":"月内偏財，而無敗無煞，富出人間；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1431","lineNum":1446,"lineType":2,"content":"此月令偏財格，與時上偏財大同，怕比刼相尅，七煞泄氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1432","lineNum":1447,"lineType":1,"content":"日下正馬，而有助有生，名揚天下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1433","lineNum":1448,"lineType":2,"content":"乃甲午、戊子等日，甲戌、乙丑等日，則偏與日坐真貴格同論，有助是别支財，有生是别支食，傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1434","lineNum":1449,"lineType":1,"content":"身淺坐煞，運行身旺之鄉，發財發福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1435","lineNum":1450,"lineType":2,"content":"坐煞乃甲申、乙酉等日，柱中無土為身清，行寅卯運，大發財祿。此格喜印綬，忌正官，食神犯之，非身清，下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1436","lineNum":1451,"lineType":2,"content":"等命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1437","lineNum":1452,"lineType":1,"content":"獨主臨官，運至主貴之地，加職加封。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1438","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506744522686483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1439","lineNum":1455,"lineType":2,"content":"獨主臨官，乃丁巳、癸亥等日，又遇貴人衝官星為貴，歲運逢己亥重併者，倍加封職。或以日遇官星，行運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1440","lineNum":1456,"lineType":2,"content":"再遇官地為解，亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1441","lineNum":1457,"lineType":1,"content":"食神生旺，無印綬刑衝，乃母食子祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1442","lineNum":1458,"lineType":2,"content":"此食神格也。如戊辰、丁巳、壬辰、甲辰，貴而且夀。丁未、丙午、甲午、丙寅，食神化作脱局，丁傷辛官，飛來不得，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1443","lineNum":1459,"lineType":2,"content":"故貧夭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1444","lineNum":1460,"lineType":1,"content":"主本臨官，沒官星煞敗，為弟襲兄班。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1445","lineNum":1461,"lineType":2,"content":"乃丁巳、癸亥日，得寅戌月類也。無官煞比肩，兄弟本身自旺，必得高長之班，興家立業。何者？丁之祿在午，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1446","lineNum":1462,"lineType":2,"content":"癸之祿在子。癸亥為水正旺之鄉，乃壬家之祿也。丁巳為火臨官之地，乃丙家之祿也。得此格者，謂丁癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1447","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506742899326976"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1448","lineNum":1465,"lineType":2,"content":"乃丙壬之弟而己。亥為丙壬之祿位，故曰弟就兄班，必因兄有為高兄一班。又丙午壬子日，亦是純粹尤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1449","lineNum":1466,"lineType":2,"content":"貴。駁雜者不入格。若有兄弟比肩，干支駁雜，為兄星填實，便為下矣。或官星填實，兄弟比肩争差，身無容","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1450","lineNum":1467,"lineType":2,"content":"處，又作凶斷。若官星不實，單露天干，雖分星擘祿，亦可再成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1451","lineNum":1468,"lineType":1,"content":"倒食本宫臨官旺，乃侍臣叨祿之名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1452","lineNum":1469,"lineType":2,"content":"如庚子見戊子，歲月偏印在我本宫之上，名倒食，乃我之君父也。是偏印所坐，與日干同宫，臨於官旺之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1453","lineNum":1470,"lineType":2,"content":"地，則受我命，生我福氣。侍臣叨祿，言近君之寵也。如庚子戊子、庚子、丙子，是此格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1454","lineNum":1471,"lineType":1,"content":"胎生元命無財星，為赤子承恩之寵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1455","lineNum":1472,"lineType":2,"content":"此庚寅、辛卯、甲申、乙酉等日，皆本主天元，自坐絶地，為胎生之宫，即胞胎格也。其生甚微，所以喜印綬，怕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1456","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506733348962345"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1457","lineNum":1475,"lineType":2,"content":"財尅，主少年招受皇恩，大槩與印格同論。如乙酉乙酉、乙酉甲申，是此格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1458","lineNum":1475,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_70","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1459","lineNum":1475,"lineType":2,"content":"云云同義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1460","lineNum":1476,"lineType":1,"content":"歲月正官七煞混淆人下賤。時日獨强專制，職重權高。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1461","lineNum":1477,"lineType":1,"content":"月時七煞，正官雜亂病交侵。歲運衝開合去官清名顯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1462","lineNum":1478,"lineType":1,"content":"猶嫌過制，最忌争强。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1463","lineNum":1479,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_71","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1464","lineNum":1479,"lineType":2,"content":"云：四柱純煞有制，定居一品之尊，畧見一位正官，官煞混雜反賤，類有去官留煞，亦有去煞留官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1465","lineNum":1480,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：四柱煞旺，運純身旺，為官清貴。又云：月令雖逢建祿，切忌㑹煞為凶，官星七煞交差，却有合煞為貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1466","lineNum":1481,"lineType":2,"content":"是也。此二格各有所主，歲月正官，以官為主，嫌煞混之；月時七煞，以煞為主，嫌官亂之；時日獨强専制，歲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1467","lineNum":1482,"lineType":2,"content":"運衝開合去，互文見義也。過制則七煞不顯，争强則難以去留，其理當細詳之。如壬子、甲辰、己卯、壬申，月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1468","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506710364258342"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1469","lineNum":1485,"lineType":2,"content":"時正官日下，卯為七煞，得申内庚金，合卯中乙木之煞為貴。又如張侍郎八字，乙日，以庚為正官，申内庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1470","lineNum":1486,"lineType":2,"content":"金，近七月生，庚旺辛衰，六月丁火旺，為去煞留官，故貴。又如丙午、丙申、甲寅、丁卯，丙丁雖多，不敵月令之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1471","lineNum":1487,"lineType":2,"content":"煞，又行官旺運，身旺變鬼為官，故貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1472","lineNum":1488,"lineType":1,"content":"天元無氣，却宜中下興隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1473","lineNum":1489,"lineType":2,"content":"此印綬格也。如甲乙生於冬月，天元無氣，地支有亥子，水生木，為興隆之類。又如丁亥、丁丑等日，丁火無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":1490,"lineType":2,"content":"氣，又有壬癸來尅，亥子得之為黨，反能生出甲木，為地支興隆，喜土來尅財，丑中得之為財，亦利之類。古","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":1491,"lineType":2,"content":"人論中下，以日時支言，如日干月令無氣，若所坐之支及時得地，亦為成實之命；若無氣，而日時又在衰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":1492,"lineType":2,"content":"敗之鄉，則終身偃蹇可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1477","lineNum":1492,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_72","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1478","lineNum":1492,"lineType":2,"content":"云，凡見天元太弱，内有弱處復生，是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1479","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506763061493801"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1480","lineNum":1495,"lineType":1,"content":"年本偏官，須忌始終尅害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1481","lineNum":1496,"lineType":2,"content":"此歲德格也。如甲日逢庚申太歲，為年上偏官，一名元神，一名孤辰，其煞最重，終身不可除去，故主始終","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":1497,"lineType":2,"content":"尅害。尅害非専指祖父六親，本身亦在其中矣。如丁巳、丁未、辛巳、壬辰，喜一壬合二丁為制，乙卯、丙子、己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":1498,"lineType":2,"content":"卯、丁卯，喜丁丙化去三乙，皆主貴，但尅害終不能免。或云七煞多根，切忌始終尅害，亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":1499,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刃極喜偏官，削平禍亂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":1500,"lineType":2,"content":"此羊刃格也。大抵羊刃忌財，以刃破財，財生煞，煞尅身及刑衝。三合六合，喜煞制伏，而煞自制者，又作凶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":1501,"lineType":2,"content":"斷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":1502,"lineType":1,"content":"金神只宜制伏，降肅奸雄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506763061477417"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":1505,"lineType":2,"content":"此金神格也。大抵金神不畏過制，只忌破制與失制。歲運同甲己日得此三時，惟甲日得之為正。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":1506,"lineType":1,"content":"陽德陰貴，旺則榮顯，而弱可保名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":1507,"lineType":2,"content":"陽徳，天月二德及日徳；陰貴，天乙貴神及日貴格也。弱雖不如强，亦可自守。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":1508,"lineType":1,"content":"天罡地魁，衰則貧寒，而强當絶世。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1493","lineNum":1509,"lineType":2,"content":"即罡魁格也。喜强惡衰忌。財官要併踏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1494","lineNum":1510,"lineType":1,"content":"官庫財庫，衝開則榮封爵祿，塞閉則貧乏貲財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1495","lineNum":1511,"lineType":2,"content":"此雜氣財官格也。如甲見丑為官庫，見辰為財庫，見未為本庫，見戌為食庫，官為上，財次之，本庫又次之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1496","lineNum":1512,"lineType":2,"content":"若庫在年月之中，管事太早，難發少年，喜在日下，及時之中，雖晚發不失為富貴。造化要見衝刑破害，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1497","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506760444018715"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1498","lineNum":1515,"lineType":2,"content":"開局鑰，怕有星閉塞，如丁用辰為官庫，或戊字僭之，或戊辰壓之，是閉塞也，如此則丁不能官，須柱有甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1499","lineNum":1516,"lineType":2,"content":"戌，或歲遇之方吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1500","lineNum":1517,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官正官，傷盡則獨握權高，半殘則必遭蹇難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1501","lineNum":1518,"lineType":2,"content":"此傷官格也。半殘言傷不盡，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1502","lineNum":1518,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_73","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1503","lineNum":1518,"lineType":2,"content":"云四柱傷官，運入官鄉必破，是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1504","lineNum":1519,"lineType":1,"content":"日月倒衝，官祿無填無絆，而祿馬飛來；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1505","lineNum":1520,"lineType":2,"content":"此飛天祿馬格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1506","lineNum":1521,"lineType":1,"content":"天地制合，煞神不過不失，而名利驟發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1507","lineNum":1522,"lineType":2,"content":"天地制合，煞神乃天干地支，或是食神制煞，或是羊刃合煞，但制合不宜太過，如一煞二食二羊刃，則過","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1508","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506733348995113"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1509","lineNum":1525,"lineType":2,"content":"而失也。身煞兩停，制合不過，煞乃凶神，故主驟發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1510","lineNum":1525,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_74","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":1525,"lineType":2,"content":"云偏官制伏太過，乃是貧儒，見不可過也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":1526,"lineType":1,"content":"惟官印最宜相㑹，德政加封，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":1527,"lineType":2,"content":"此官印格也。如甲日得辛為官，又有癸為印，或地支有酉子字，皆是官印於身，二尅一生，陰陽配合，而又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":1528,"lineType":2,"content":"自相生焉。故主為相有王佐之才，為將有運籌之智，為守宰著循良之政。要本身與官印相等，乃極品貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":1529,"lineType":2,"content":"也，否則隨力量升降輕重言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":1530,"lineType":1,"content":"有祿馬極喜同居，官能稱職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":1531,"lineType":2,"content":"此財官格也。如甲日見己丑己酉，及壬午癸巳等日之類是。祿馬同居，與上官印相㑹，皆為三竒格也。須","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":1532,"lineType":2,"content":"要本身力旺，或遇時氣，可稱此格。祿身强弱不等，降下論之，身弱難夀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506733348978729"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":1535,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬逢煞則發，逢合則晦，逢財則灾，破合去財亦發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":1536,"lineType":2,"content":"此總論印綬喜忌。逢煞謂之印頼煞生，功名顯達，若遇偏財合去，正財尅去，皆主灾晦柱中日干健旺，或","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":1537,"lineType":2,"content":"有比肩破合去財，則印煞可以雙收，亦王發達，但不清也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":1537,"lineType":2,"content":"詩","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_75","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":1537,"lineType":2,"content":"云忽逢甲己加金局，丙火尋常便可嗟，運行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":1538,"lineType":2,"content":"旺火生身地，功名何處不光華是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":1539,"lineType":1,"content":"建祿遇官則貴，遇財則富，遇印則秀，敗財破印尤吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":1540,"lineType":2,"content":"建祿則身旺，故用官用印用財皆吉。有敗財羊刃比肩，則身太旺，皆足以刼我之財，分我之官，奪我之印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":1541,"lineType":2,"content":"建祿尤喜印與財，故見敗財破印，則偏枯不成造化，財印俱見混雜，不富不秀，無成之命也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":1542,"lineType":1,"content":"官煞兩停，喜者存之，憎者去之。武能去正留偏，化官為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506710364291110"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":1545,"lineType":1,"content":"煞。文能去偏留正，化煞為官。運逢身旺必加封，財印交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":1546,"lineType":1,"content":"差，欲其進也，忌其退也。貴能見義忘利，取印捨財；富則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":1547,"lineType":1,"content":"見利忘義，取財捨印。歲遇命强而進爵，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":1548,"lineType":2,"content":"官煞不可並用，財印難以交留，故喜憎存棄，或去煞留官，或去官留煞，欲忌進退，或取印捨財，或捨財取","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":1549,"lineType":2,"content":"印，各從其有力而重者用之。文武富貴，亦推言其類，未必盡然。四格皆以身旺命强為主，歲運生扶為妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":1550,"lineType":2,"content":"通融論之，身與財旺力停，得官煞來，亦可化財助印，為福益厚；身弱無官煞乘化，不惟不勝官煞，而財印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":1551,"lineType":2,"content":"交差，身制不䕶，無可為倚，必定貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":1552,"lineType":1,"content":"十干背祿，喜見財豐，敗逢比肩逐馬，官煞俱有，猶如去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506760443985947"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":1555,"lineType":1,"content":"煞留官，印助身强，必定收功拜職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":1556,"lineType":2,"content":"此言傷官格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":1556,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_76","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":1556,"lineType":2,"content":"云：十干背祿，歲時喜見財星，運至比肩，號曰背祿逐馬是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":1557,"lineType":1,"content":"五行食神，許乘馬盛，禍生正印梟神。官煞一來，誤致反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":1558,"lineType":1,"content":"賢敗德；梟神印旺，立見破敗傷身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":1559,"lineType":2,"content":"此言食神格也。此因上文背祿逐馬，窮極將官煞而轉為福，故此章言因財致富，被官煞助印為禍，而反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":1560,"lineType":2,"content":"大壞。互文見義，不可不詳察之。葢食神喜財怕梟，官煞生印，則梟愈旺，傷喜見印，食怕見印，故並言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":1561,"lineType":1,"content":"戊日午月，勿作刃看；時歲火多，轉為印綬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":1562,"lineType":2,"content":"此羊刃與印同官，火多則印强，故能轉弱從强。然刃助身强，又得印助，則文理高致，可以隠惡而揚善。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506751753502754"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":1565,"lineType":2,"content":"有巳字透出，仍以刃斷，印刃俱有，其人不免性毒，有好運來成功，運退刃來，或被財衝起，亦凶，喜正官制","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":1566,"lineType":2,"content":"中為妙，如癸亥戊午戊午、戊午，此命正合此論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":1567,"lineType":1,"content":"丙日丑時，非為背祿；支干金旺，反作貲財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":1568,"lineType":2,"content":"時當時，指月令也。丙日生逢丑月，丑中己土傷官背祿，主貧。得干支庚辛金氣旺盛，土能生金，却為財斷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":1569,"lineType":2,"content":"須丙日健，或寅午戌火局亦旺，可在其財時。支是丑支中己酉合庚辛，透出丙火生旺者，亦合此格。如丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":1570,"lineType":2,"content":"日本身自旺，單見丑月，無庚辛透露，及己酉丑局，真背祿矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":1571,"lineType":1,"content":"官坐刃頭，終被刑；貴壓三刑，須執政。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":1572,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲日見辛卯月，及辛卯時，官不得令，反被卯中丁火傷尅，歲運又見，定然遭刑。若官煞制伏得道，雖以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1559","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506757742854194"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1560","lineNum":1575,"lineType":2,"content":"貴論，遇刃年終凶，是羊刃最壞造化也。貴壓三刑，乃命中犯三刑，雖凶，若得一個天乙貴人正照，生旺得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1561","lineNum":1576,"lineType":2,"content":"時，反主掌典刑政，可専征伐。貴人不生旺者，亦可作從政斷，是貴神最為吉煞也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1562","lineNum":1577,"lineType":1,"content":"德葢七煞，必是安禪之士；花迎六合，豈非淫蕩之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":1578,"lineType":2,"content":"徳即天月德，乃慈善神也；七煞乃孤辰煞也。徳葢七煞，主人有道徳，因道德而生富貴。花即桃花煞，乃淫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":1579,"lineType":2,"content":"蕩煞也。六合乃多情煞也。花迎六合，主好色歌唱，大非端士。又如戊子生人見癸丑之類，乃支干交合，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":1580,"lineType":2,"content":"滚泿。桃花四柱，子午卯酉，為遍野桃花，主男不媒而婚，女不媒而嫁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":1581,"lineType":1,"content":"孤寡雙全，帶官印當膺住持；無則只為道行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":1582,"lineType":2,"content":"孤辰寡宿，二煞怕雙逢叠見，只一位不論。帶官印在上，雖為僧道亦貴；如無，只平常僧道而已。如甲戌、戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506760444035099"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":1585,"lineType":2,"content":"辰、庚辰、丙子、○甲戌、戊辰、庚辰、丁丑，○俱是清高長老之命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":1586,"lineType":1,"content":"控邀。隔角逢生旺必過房舍；絶則終守鰥孀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":1587,"lineType":2,"content":"控神、邀神，是孤寡煞也。假令寅卯辰人，見巳辰人，謂之控神煞，又謂之邀神煞；見丑寅人，謂之窺神煞，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":1588,"lineType":2,"content":"謂之迫神煞。餘倣此。更值歲運不和，三元刑戰，為凶尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":1589,"lineType":1,"content":"吞㗖全排，家人消㪚；空亡徧見，親屬離傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":1590,"lineType":2,"content":"吞㗖、空亡二煞，乃尅害孤寡之辰也。須全排徧見，方如經斷。若食遇吞㗖、財食貴祿等格，見空亡尤為不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":1591,"lineType":2,"content":"吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":1592,"lineType":1,"content":"財印雙傷，斷其必無上下；官煞俱去，知其少失爺娘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506760444084251"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":1595,"lineType":2,"content":"此二節専論骨肉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":1596,"lineType":1,"content":"純耗純刃交差，牛羊類斷；純陰純陽排尅，猪狗徒看。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":1597,"lineType":2,"content":"大耗。羊刃，乃神煞之最惡者；孤陰孤陽，乃干支之不調者。耗刃攢聚，交至四柱上，主賤之極，作牛羊之類","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":1598,"lineType":2,"content":"斷之。天干皆是一偏地支，衝刑破害，必是無正性之人，作猪狗之徒論之。若驛馬、六害、華葢、刼煞、亡神、年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":1599,"lineType":2,"content":"月等煞，見偏陰偏陽尤凶。如甲子、庚午、甲子、庚午，甲用辛為官，庚煞透出，又不得令；甲用己為財發祿，午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":1600,"lineType":2,"content":"月子午對衝，財又不成，作不仁不義斷之。又如甲午、甲戌、甲午、甲子，三甲並見，用官官不顯，財印俱衝，並","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":1601,"lineType":2,"content":"無所托，當是貪圖無厭，不認六親，薄情背禮之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":1602,"lineType":1,"content":"衰受衆梟，乃是寄食長工；絶逢重食，宜作屠行牙儈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506751753535522"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":1605,"lineType":2,"content":"梟與食相反，故並舉之，其身嫌衰絶一也。衰而逢梟，難作偏印，絶而逢食，難作夀星，故皆不吉。寄食長工，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":1606,"lineType":2,"content":"因梟難得飽食。屠行、牙儈，因食雖得飽而賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":1607,"lineType":1,"content":"若也純官純煞、純馬純財，身旺無雜，則官居極品。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":1608,"lineType":2,"content":"凡命以純粹不雜為上，偏枯混亂為下。且如甲日以辛為官，柱中只有酉辛字，是謂純官。以庚為煞，柱中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":1609,"lineType":2,"content":"只有申庚字，是謂純煞；以正財為馬，柱中只有丑未己字，以偏財為財，柱中只有辰戌戊字，謂之純馬。純","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":1610,"lineType":2,"content":"財值身旺，為大富貴格，建祿得格，出門便是富足，日下次之，時下又次之。建祿遇正官第一，正財次之，惟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":1611,"lineType":2,"content":"煞夀不永。若羊刃之月，純煞第一財格，則防横事。癸卯、乙卯、己巳、乙丑，此命純煞，乃能盡善，亦貴為極品。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1594","lineNum":1612,"lineType":2,"content":"又如甲戌、丁卯、己巳、乙亥，官煞混雜，頼甲己合化為貴，因雜化力過，不得善終。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1595","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506764919324672"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1596","lineNum":1615,"lineType":1,"content":"全印全衝，全制全食，命强無破，則祿受千鍾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1597","lineNum":1616,"lineType":2,"content":"全印如甲日見子癸壬亥，或正或偏，無所駁雜。全衝，如地支純亥、純巳、純子、純午之類，衝出祿馬，或寅申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1598","lineNum":1617,"lineType":2,"content":"巳亥、子午卯酉，辰戌丑未，皆是。全制，如甲日見丁字，或午字傷盡官星，虚空生出土來為財。全食，如甲見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1599","lineNum":1618,"lineType":2,"content":"丙，柱中純寅之類。須得日主生旺，正庫臨官月日時者，皆貴人也。如己未、乙亥、丙寅、辛卯，此全印剝雜，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1600","lineNum":1619,"lineType":2,"content":"有辛財尅刑，運行身旺則貴顯，行身衰則刑䧟。如辛亥、己亥、辛亥、己亥，四柱純亥，衝出己中丙戊，全衝為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1601","lineNum":1620,"lineType":2,"content":"貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1602","lineNum":1621,"lineType":1,"content":"日干太旺無依，若不為僧，固宜為道。天元羸弱無輔，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1603","lineNum":1622,"lineType":1,"content":"不為技，則當為巫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1604","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506744522719251"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1605","lineNum":1625,"lineType":2,"content":"此言太過不及，皆不為吉也。太過則財官死絶，所以主孤；不及則財官難任，所以主藝。見造化，貴中和也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1606","lineNum":1626,"lineType":2,"content":"若有依有輔，則不可以是論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1607","lineNum":1626,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_77","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1608","lineNum":1626,"lineType":2,"content":"云：柱中官星太旺，天元羸弱之名，日干旺甚無依，若不為僧，即道是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1609","lineNum":1627,"lineType":2,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1610","lineNum":1628,"lineType":1,"content":"身弱有生必發，忌財馬以相傷；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1611","lineNum":1629,"lineType":2,"content":"此身弱用印，忌財傷印，為貪財壞印之説，須分財印輕重言之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1612","lineNum":1629,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_78","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1613","lineNum":1629,"lineType":2,"content":"云：日干無氣，時逢羊刃不為凶。羊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1614","lineNum":1630,"lineType":2,"content":"刃所以刼財，柱中財多身弱，故羊刄不忌，須並論之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1615","lineNum":1631,"lineType":1,"content":"食神逢梟則夭，喜財星而生救。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1616","lineNum":1632,"lineType":2,"content":"此食神怕梟，要財制梟，為用神有救，須分財梟輕重言之，印則忌財，食則要財，義各有所當也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1617","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506747349549107"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1618","lineNum":1635,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子日逢子，時沒庚辛，申酉丑午，謂之祿馬飛來；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1619","lineNum":1636,"lineType":2,"content":"此子遥己格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1620","lineNum":1636,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_79","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1621","lineNum":1636,"lineType":2,"content":"文義同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1622","lineNum":1637,"lineType":1,"content":"庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1623","lineNum":1637,"lineType":2,"content":"申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1624","lineNum":1637,"lineType":1,"content":"時逢戊，日無甲丙，卯寅午丁，名曰食神明旺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1625","lineNum":1638,"lineType":2,"content":"此専食合祿格也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1626","lineNum":1638,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_80","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1627","lineNum":1638,"lineType":2,"content":"云：庚申時逢戊日，名食神干旺之方，月犯甲丙卯寅，此乃遇而不遇是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1628","lineNum":1639,"lineType":1,"content":"庚壬子衝午祿，切忌丙丁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1629","lineNum":1640,"lineType":2,"content":"此正衝祿馬格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1630","lineNum":1641,"lineType":1,"content":"辛癸。丑合己宫，須嫌子巳；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1631","lineNum":1642,"lineType":2,"content":"此丑遥己格也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1632","lineNum":1642,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_81","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1633","lineNum":1642,"lineType":2,"content":"云：辛癸日多逢丑地，不喜官星，歲時逢子巳二宫，虚名虚利是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1634","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506760444051483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1635","lineNum":1645,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午、丁巳准此。最忌刑衝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1636","lineNum":1646,"lineType":2,"content":"此倒衝祿馬格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1637","lineNum":1647,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子、癸亥例同。亦防填實，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1638","lineNum":1648,"lineType":2,"content":"以上正衝、倒衝、遥合、通融，互文見義。舉丙丁與己，忌填實也；舉子，忌刑衝也。如丙子、庚寅、丙午、癸巳、○庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1639","lineNum":1649,"lineType":2,"content":"寅、壬午、丙午、戊戌，○二命，喜寅午戌全，如辛酉、癸巳、丁巳、乙巳、○癸卯、丁巳、丁巳、乙巳○二命喜巳字多，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1640","lineNum":1650,"lineType":2,"content":"不論有合無合，皆吉，惟忌辰字絆住，則不能衝，却喜巳酉丑全，是正衝格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1641","lineNum":1650,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_82","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1642","lineNum":1650,"lineType":2,"content":"云，若逢傷官月建，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1643","lineNum":1651,"lineType":2,"content":"凶處未必為凶，内有正倒祿，飛忌官星，亦嫌覊絆。是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1644","lineNum":1652,"lineType":1,"content":"六辛日而無午字，得戊子時，辛合丙官為貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1645","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506778991198247"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1646","lineNum":1655,"lineType":2,"content":"此六陰朝陽格也。如戊辰、辛酉、辛丑、戊子、○戊辰、辛酉、辛酉、戊子、○乙丑、庚辰、辛酉、戊子，是此格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1647","lineNum":1655,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_83","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1648","lineNum":1656,"lineType":2,"content":"篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_83","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1649","lineNum":1656,"lineType":2,"content":"云，六辛日時逢戊子，嫌午位，運喜西方。是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1650","lineNum":1657,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸日而無干土，得甲寅時，寅刑巳格尤竒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1651","lineNum":1658,"lineType":2,"content":"此刑合格也。此格主性氣剛，而見快太察，如乙未、甲申、癸酉、甲寅，嫌申中庚傷甲木，寅申對衝，故雖貴而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1652","lineNum":1659,"lineType":2,"content":"減分數，利厚名低。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1653","lineNum":1659,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_84","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1654","lineNum":1659,"lineType":2,"content":"云，六癸日時逢寅位，歲月怕己戊二方是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1655","lineNum":1660,"lineType":1,"content":"癸無丙火，戊己庚申，時合一巳之財官；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1656","lineNum":1661,"lineType":2,"content":"此専印合祿格也，與専食同。看。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1657","lineNum":1662,"lineType":1,"content":"壬有子午卯酉正氣，柱兼四季之土祿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1658","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506747349581875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1659","lineNum":1665,"lineType":2,"content":"午，乙亥、丙子，此命貴破午破兩亥，自刑本身，既在死地，又見自刑，兩無所依，故主貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1660","lineNum":1666,"lineType":1,"content":"陽水叠逢，辰位無衝尅，壬騎龍背非常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1661","lineNum":1667,"lineType":2,"content":"此壬騎龍背格也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1662","lineNum":1667,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_85","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1663","lineNum":1667,"lineType":2,"content":"文義同。如壬辰、甲辰、壬辰、壬寅，壬用巳為正官，丁為正財，辰字多，衝出戌中官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1664","lineNum":1668,"lineType":2,"content":"庫，虚合午中財官。寅午戌三合火局，壬人得之為貴。如壬寅、壬寅，壬辰、壬寅，壬人見丙火，生在寅巳，是財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1665","lineNum":1669,"lineType":2,"content":"了。又寅字多，合起午戌財官，故利勝於名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1666","lineNum":1670,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日全逢潤下，忌壬癸巳午之方，時遇子申，其福減半。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1667","lineNum":1671,"lineType":2,"content":"此井欄乂格也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1668","lineNum":1671,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_86","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1669","lineNum":1671,"lineType":2,"content":"文義同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1670","lineNum":1672,"lineType":1,"content":"合官合財作公卿，防休囚尅害之辱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1671","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506757742870578"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1672","lineNum":1675,"lineType":2,"content":"合官，如乙日見庚之例；合財，如甲日見己之例，乃十干變化之道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1673","lineNum":1675,"lineType":2,"content":"賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_87","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1674","lineNum":1675,"lineType":2,"content":"云：化之真者，名公巨卿；化之假者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1675","lineNum":1676,"lineType":2,"content":"孤兒異姓。乙庚化金，見水地則休囚，見火地則尅害。凡帶合，或獨旺不肯自就，或合中見衝破，或一邊破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1676","lineNum":1677,"lineType":2,"content":"尅，皆合不成。或化在休囚死絶之地，失誤與合，必然䧟滯不利，是化之假也。如己見甲，見己未為得地，己，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1677","lineNum":1678,"lineType":2,"content":"旺庫也。丙見辛，見辛卯為失地，丙火敗於卯也。戊與癸合，見戊午為得地，戊癸化火，午為火旺之地故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1678","lineNum":1679,"lineType":2,"content":"亦須癸水先得地，方合得申，若失地不得時，則損夀。葢化為貴旺，身弱不能勝，縦貴亦失。又丙與辛合，見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1679","lineNum":1680,"lineType":2,"content":"辛未陽火氣弱於未，多夭折。或因色傷柱有壬尅丙，或壬居申上，自生對衝寅宫火生之地，夭折無疑。亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1680","lineNum":1681,"lineType":2,"content":"有貪合忘官，如丁日見二三壬字，丁獨壬衆，一人不能勝衆，乃汙合之士，無所卓立，豈能成功。丁有力，僅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1681","lineNum":1682,"lineType":2,"content":"得半吉。又如甲與己合，甲木無通氣之宫，己土有正義之位，雖合而失其正，亦同上論。若甲己兩皆得位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1682","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506747349532723"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1683","lineNum":1685,"lineType":2,"content":"壬日為主，既無官煞，却得子午卯酉為四正，能合出辰戌丑未為官祿，不須四正俱㑹，但得四字全為妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1684","lineNum":1686,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日同上。土曜莫侵，得之者，利害交併，官高身病；遇之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1685","lineNum":1687,"lineType":1,"content":"者，刑惠確實，職重家貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1686","lineNum":1688,"lineType":2,"content":"癸日為主，却嫌土祿，見子午卯酉，與壬日同，吉凶相伴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1687","lineNum":1689,"lineType":1,"content":"甲曲直，丙炎上，官高尅妻而不富。戊從革，庚潤下，職重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1688","lineNum":1690,"lineType":1,"content":"嗣少而自貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1689","lineNum":1691,"lineType":2,"content":"甲見亥卯未，曰曲直；丙見寅午戌，曰炎上；戊見己酉丑，曰從革；庚見申子辰，曰潤下。甲丙見木火，局則太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1690","lineNum":1692,"lineType":2,"content":"旺，能三合义出官局，故主官高，然有羊刃刼財，故尅戊。庚見金水，局則脱氣，能三合义出官局，故主職重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1691","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506778991231015"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1692","lineNum":1695,"lineType":2,"content":"然柱中原無官煞，故少子。要之此四格皆偏黨，所以福祿不全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1693","lineNum":1696,"lineType":1,"content":"身犯休囚之地，併衝官貴何嗟；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1694","lineNum":1697,"lineType":2,"content":"如辛亥日，既無官煞，身又不旺，豈不惆悵。不知亥字多，亦能勾出己中官印為貴，故曰何嗟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1695","lineNum":1698,"lineType":1,"content":"自専官旺之支，同釣祿子猶貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1696","lineNum":1699,"lineType":2,"content":"此即丁巳、癸亥、丙午、壬子等日，自坐臨官，帝旺之官，支神多能衝出對宫官祿，與上文義同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1697","lineNum":1700,"lineType":1,"content":"陰木獨遇子時；沒官星乙鎮䑕窠，最貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1698","lineNum":1701,"lineType":2,"content":"此六乙䑕貴格也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1699","lineNum":1701,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_88","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1700","lineNum":1701,"lineType":2,"content":"文義同，如甲寅、戊辰、乙亥、丙子，四柱别無他格，動摇丙子，亦不動摇，安然為貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1701","lineNum":1702,"lineType":2,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_89","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1702","lineNum":1702,"lineType":2,"content":"云用神不可動摇是也。如甲寅、癸酉、乙亥、丙子，月令偏官傷身，頼日下印旺，亦不失為衣祿。如辛亥甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1703","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506751753617442"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1704","lineNum":1705,"lineType":2,"content":"貴顯高極，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1705","lineNum":1705,"lineType":2,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_90","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1706","lineNum":1705,"lineType":2,"content":"云：甲己木盛於土鄉，發揚仁義佐明君；丙辛合丙旺辛生，鎮守威權之職；乙庚入金局，兼木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1707","lineNum":1706,"lineType":2,"content":"自旺，文仁武義雙全。戊癸得火旺，更水獨旺，禮律智勇俱備。丁壬水火既濟兮，魚水和同；陰陽干支相合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1708","lineNum":1707,"lineType":2,"content":"兮，君臣慶會，聽鳯鳴於高崗，必鷹揚於疆場是也。如甲辰、戊辰、己巳、辛未，己日得甲為正官，三月通氣，引","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1709","lineNum":1708,"lineType":2,"content":"於未上，兼為正印，故主極貴。如戊申、庚申、癸亥、戊午，癸生七月，印旺天德之地，合戊為官，引於午時火旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1710","lineNum":1709,"lineType":2,"content":"之地，又能資戊土之官，官身俱旺，故主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1711","lineNum":1710,"lineType":1,"content":"拱貴。拱祿為將相。忌刑衝填實之凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1712","lineNum":1711,"lineType":2,"content":"此拱貴拱祿格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1713","lineNum":1711,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_91","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1714","lineNum":1711,"lineType":2,"content":"文義同。如丁巳、丙午、甲寅、甲子拱丑貴。壬子、丁未、丁巳、丁未，年支子字衝出午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1715","lineNum":1712,"lineType":2,"content":"字，故大貴。癸卯、庚申、戊辰、戊午，拱己祿。如辛丑、辛丑、甲寅、甲子，有丑字填實，却以辛為正官論。己未、戊辰、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1716","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506742899376128"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1717","lineNum":1715,"lineType":2,"content":"戊寅、戊午，官煞多寅字衝申，為衝開，則拱不成。如壬辰、戊申、己未、己巳，是此格也，故大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1718","lineNum":1716,"lineType":1,"content":"官印暗合天地，其貴可知；福德隠在支中，其德尤萃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1719","lineNum":1717,"lineType":2,"content":"官印暗合，即食神暗合正官，偏財暗合正印。如甲用辛官，丙盛，能暗合辛未為官。用癸為印，戊旺，能暗合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1720","lineNum":1718,"lineType":2,"content":"癸丑為印。更得地支有子合丑，有午合未，方是福徳隠藏。福即福星貴德，即天月德，或指福德秀氣，或指","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1721","lineNum":1719,"lineType":2,"content":"天乙貴人，以藏在支中為妙。如甲戊庚不見丑未，但得巳字即是見巳，在丑未宫尤妙。柱無卯乙破，更生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1722","lineNum":1720,"lineType":2,"content":"四季月，己土得令，主貴人見喜，前程尊顯，妻貌及得妻財。又云：甲人見丑，喜坐羊刃，為天乙當職，見未夜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1723","lineNum":1721,"lineType":2,"content":"生得力，為福十全，反此一半論。四柱帶甲戊庚全得乙丑為聚貴，更加福力。若一庚一甲，見支神三四，丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1724","lineNum":1722,"lineType":2,"content":"未為㑹貴，亦加福力。若本主與貴人俱生旺，只消一字，其福自全。喜三合六合，忌休囚空破，詩曰：貴人帝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1725","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506751753601058"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1726","lineNum":1725,"lineType":2,"content":"座見生成，官旺之鄉名早成，若遇休囚並破制，虚名踪跡遠三公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1727","lineNum":1726,"lineType":1,"content":"五行正貴，怕刑衝尅害之神；四柱吉神，喜官旺生合之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1728","lineNum":1727,"lineType":1,"content":"地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1729","lineNum":1728,"lineType":2,"content":"五行正貴，乃正氣官星，如甲生酉月之例。最怕酉刑卯，衝丁尅戌，害傷了貴氣。或以貴為貴神，如甲見丑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1730","lineNum":1729,"lineType":2,"content":"丑中有辛，又為甲正官之類。柱有卯，乙尅壊丑貴，喜己酉三合，乙木尅，衝丑不入，或有子合丑，亦可隔木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1731","lineNum":1730,"lineType":2,"content":"之尅。如有乙卯，子卯相刑，不能尅丑未，為天乙之貴。四柱吉神，乃官印、財、食、竒貴、福德等星皆是。但得一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1732","lineNum":1731,"lineType":2,"content":"星臨長生帝旺，臨官正庫、三合、六合之位，無不富貴。詩曰：人命生時得一强，日時或臨祿馬鄉。須看前後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1733","lineNum":1732,"lineType":2,"content":"扶助合，必然衣錦入中堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1734","lineNum":1732,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌篇","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_92","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1735","lineNum":1732,"lineType":2,"content":"云：五行正貴，忌刑衝、破害之宫；四柱干支，喜三合、六合之地。又云：地支","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1736","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506733349027881"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1737","lineNum":1735,"lineType":2,"content":"天干合多，亦云貪合忘宫，二義須並論之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1738","lineNum":1736,"lineType":1,"content":"若也沐浴逢煞，魄徃酆都；元犯再傷，魂歸岳府。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1739","lineNum":1737,"lineType":2,"content":"此因上文刑衝尅害而言。怕裸形逢煞，以生之者微，而尅之者重。命元犯之，已為不吉，歲運再犯，决死無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1740","lineNum":1738,"lineType":2,"content":"疑。如元犯官煞，去配不清，柱無食神可解，歲運再見則死。若元犯破印，流年再犯則死。凡用神有損者皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1741","lineNum":1739,"lineType":2,"content":"是此四句，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1742","lineNum":1739,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_93","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1743","lineNum":1739,"lineType":2,"content":"本文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1744","lineNum":1740,"lineType":1,"content":"畏煞逢煞則夭，憂關落關即亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1745","lineNum":1741,"lineType":2,"content":"此亦因上而申明之也。柱中原怕關煞，如甲見庚申為煞，歲運再見，柱無救解者，夭。年煞尤重，有印則化，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1746","lineNum":1742,"lineType":2,"content":"有食則制，有刃則合，身旺則敵，若行煞旺運，亦夭。又如甲日見辰，為陽數極，又為鐵蛇關。壬見丑，庚見戌，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1747","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506742899408896"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1748","lineNum":1745,"lineType":2,"content":"丙見未申，皆陽關，曰重。乙見辰，癸見丑，辛見戌，丁見未申，為陰關，稍輕。四柱犯流年，又犯運行休囚，主死，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1749","lineNum":1746,"lineType":2,"content":"或被神煞鬼賊。或曰關煞之名甚多，非直言七煞陽關也，其詳見前。論夀夭及小兒關煞下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1750","lineNum":1747,"lineType":1,"content":"引合關煞悞傷身，中下滅絶横夭夀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1751","lineNum":1748,"lineType":2,"content":"引合關煞，如丙火既弱，又見辛未，丙辛既合，丙就辛官未位，乃丙極陽關，再被壬來尅，即亡。或是辛亥煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1752","lineNum":1749,"lineType":2,"content":"地尤𦂳，犯之横罹其咎。一命丙戌，丁酉、辛酉、乙未，壬申年死是也。中下滅絶，如壬戌日為坐財，又坐煞，日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1753","lineNum":1750,"lineType":2,"content":"支能有之，是則夀。若行壬辰運，壬癸水聚於辰，尅破戌中火土，别無可救，即夭，此名倒衝命元，土旺則水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1754","lineNum":1751,"lineType":2,"content":"旺，土身自崩壞，何暇救之。水旺則火滅，故云中下絶滅。中下者，即地元人元中下之分也，餘倣此推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1755","lineNum":1752,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官見官，禍患百端；逐馬逢馬，勞苦千般。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1756","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506760444100635"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1757","lineNum":1755,"lineType":2,"content":"此言獨犯所忌，故不吉。傷官見官，惟有財星可以解傷之毒，勸官之怒，轉禍為祥。逐馬逢馬，惟有官煞可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1758","lineNum":1756,"lineType":2,"content":"以制刃之刼，雖勞亦得其財，若比肩多，他强我弱，雖減耗亦得其財，不得均平，止三四分之一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1759","lineNum":1757,"lineType":1,"content":"財逢羊刃以多傷，印見妻財而不破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1760","lineNum":1758,"lineType":2,"content":"此亦同上文之義。凡命最忌羊刄，財格被破，印格被奪，官格衝怒，只喜七煞制之，陰刃力微，無妨印見妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1761","lineNum":1759,"lineType":2,"content":"財，是貪財壞印之説也。歲運又見，主破財傷妻，或因妻致訟。若原無財星，或財星力㣲，歲運見之稍輕，惟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1762","lineNum":1760,"lineType":2,"content":"官煞進生解勸，反得舉薦成名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1763","lineNum":1761,"lineType":1,"content":"食神遇梟，無財則夭。身弱有財，重逢正印亦凶。制煞逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1764","lineNum":1762,"lineType":1,"content":"印，有衝則誅。命强無官，單遇七煞尤勝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1765","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506747349598259"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1766","lineNum":1765,"lineType":2,"content":"喜忌","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_94","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1767","lineNum":1765,"lineType":2,"content":"云柱中七煞全彰，身弱極貧無地，是此義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1768","lineNum":1766,"lineType":1,"content":"三刑對衝横禍生，羊刃對合非殃至。沐浴從生無家客，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1769","lineNum":1767,"lineType":1,"content":"休囚見煞不埋人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1770","lineNum":1768,"lineType":2,"content":"沐浴休囚，皆身衰也。從生則泛，見煞則傷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1771","lineNum":1769,"lineType":1,"content":"月下刼財主無財，喜煞無印而有獲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1772","lineNum":1770,"lineType":2,"content":"煞能制刃，印能化煞，化則不能制刄，故喜煞而去印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1773","lineNum":1771,"lineType":1,"content":"暗中破印親壞印，喜官無食以加封。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1774","lineNum":1772,"lineType":2,"content":"財能破印，官能生印，有食則壞官生財，印愈受傷，故喜官而去食。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1775","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506778991263783"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1776","lineNum":1775,"lineType":1,"content":"官煞混雜，賤患兮。兄弟太多分㪚兮。喜印無制能文，喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1777","lineNum":1776,"lineType":1,"content":"制無印能武。制印俱有，碌碌難成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1778","lineNum":1777,"lineType":2,"content":"印能化煞，食能制煞，有化莫制，有制莫化，制化太多，則煞無氣，反為不吉。羊刃全頼煞制，或化作印綬，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1779","lineNum":1778,"lineType":2,"content":"戊日午月之類是。制化止用其一，皆能有成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1780","lineNum":1779,"lineType":1,"content":"祿馬背逐饑寒兮。財印相破括囊兮。喜官帶煞為權，愛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1781","lineNum":1780,"lineType":1,"content":"煞帶官為貴。官煞單見，瑣瑣不遂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1782","lineNum":1781,"lineType":2,"content":"祿馬背逐，財印相破，須官煞叠見，方能制比刼而生財，生印綬而化財，單見則力薄弱，豈能遂意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1783","lineNum":1782,"lineType":1,"content":"梟印相雜寵辱兮。財馬太多盜氣兮。喜身旺而為福，忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1784","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506751753633826"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1785","lineNum":1785,"lineType":1,"content":"運弱以生灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1786","lineNum":1786,"lineType":2,"content":"偏正二印相雜。偏正二財俱有，若身弱不能雙成其生，並受其財，中間要分偏正強弱，若偏印、偏財强，身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1787","lineNum":1787,"lineType":2,"content":"旺運强，驟然發福。正印、正財亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1788","lineNum":1788,"lineType":1,"content":"官祿尅破夭死兮。庫墓衝㪚無食兮。忌重破而無依，喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1789","lineNum":1789,"lineType":1,"content":"比肩而可救。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1790","lineNum":1790,"lineType":2,"content":"官官星祿正祿。如甲見辛寅，又見庚申，及巳與午之類，歲運再見即夭。若身旺有比肩，亦可作旺論。又如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1791","lineNum":1791,"lineType":2,"content":"甲以丑為官庫，要得未字衝開，用未不可見二丑，有丑不可見二未。又忌丁丑、丁未，丁傷辛官之類。見癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1792","lineNum":1792,"lineType":2,"content":"未、癸丑，癸水能制丁火。己丑、己未，己土能生辛官，己為甲財，癸為甲印，丙為甲食。支干生旺無破者，富貴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1793","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506763061542953"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1794","lineNum":1795,"lineType":2,"content":"稍見衝尅，則減分數，衝尅太甚，反為貧窘。以上雜舉財官印綬食神傷官，官煞羊刃比肩梟神相忌相須，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1795","lineNum":1796,"lineType":2,"content":"相制相合，交互言之，看所用之神何如，日干强弱如何。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1796","lineNum":1796,"lineType":2,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_95","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1797","lineNum":1796,"lineType":2,"content":"云：日主最宜健旺，用神不可損傷。斯言簡而盡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1798","lineNum":1797,"lineType":2,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1799","lineNum":1798,"lineType":1,"content":"刼財羊刃，切忌時逢，歲運併臨，灾殃立至。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1800","lineNum":1799,"lineType":1,"content":"歲衝運則崩，運衝嵗則晦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1801","lineNum":1800,"lineType":2,"content":"此下専論歲運。歲者，天之所葢。運者，地之所載。歲運不可兩相衝激，重則崩，輕則晦。命中最要相和，則天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1802","lineNum":1801,"lineType":2,"content":"地亨泰，福祿自臻。太歲衝運其禍重，運尅太歳則禍輕。考","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1803","lineNum":1801,"lineType":2,"content":"淵源","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_96","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1804","lineNum":1801,"lineType":2,"content":"淵海","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_97","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1805","lineNum":1801,"lineType":2,"content":"諸説，俱以運尅歲為重，歲尅運為輕，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1806","lineNum":1802,"lineType":2,"content":"即日犯歲君之義也。驗余命行丁巳運，遇癸亥流年癸傷，丁亥衝己，是歲衝運也。其年罷官喪母，受禍最","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1807","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506742899425280"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1808","lineNum":1805,"lineType":2,"content":"慘，可以例觀矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1809","lineNum":1806,"lineType":1,"content":"陰氣終而陽氣斷，未死堪嗟。陽數極而陰命追，不殂何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1810","lineNum":1807,"lineType":1,"content":"待。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1811","lineNum":1808,"lineType":2,"content":"甲見辰，丙見未，戊見丑，庚見戌，壬見丑，為陽氣極。乙見戌，丁見丑己，癸見未，辛見辰，為陰數終。歲運見之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1812","lineNum":1809,"lineType":2,"content":"尤凶。又云：乙辰丁未，己丑辛戌，亦是陰符來追，陽數先斷。若止當生，四柱無害。最怕生，既犯歲運，又見立","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1813","lineNum":1810,"lineType":2,"content":"死。又云：陰干遇陽極，為隂遇陽關。陽干遇陰終，為陽遇陰關。身弱隻力皆夭，身旺得比肩黨助則無害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1814","lineNum":1811,"lineType":1,"content":"五行有救，當憂不憂。四時逢空，聞喜不喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1815","lineNum":1812,"lineType":2,"content":"言人命遇歲運之凶。以上衝尅、氣終、數極之類。如五行有救，則當憂不憂；四時逢空，是流年太歲，遇吉神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1816","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506764919390208"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1817","lineNum":1815,"lineType":2,"content":"却值空亡，則聞喜不喜。或曰：甲憂庚得乙可救，春無土，不怕土為凶，不喜土為福之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1818","lineNum":1815,"lineType":2,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00012_0_98","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1819","lineNum":1815,"lineType":2,"content":"云：庚辛來傷，甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1820","lineNum":1816,"lineType":2,"content":"乙丙丁，先見無危。又云：春無土，夏無金，秋無木，冬無火是也。  以下有論婦人二十句，已引專論婦人門，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1821","lineNum":1817,"lineType":2,"content":"故不重錄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
