{"lines":[{"lineId":"449","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"離","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_13","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"歳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"巽","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_14","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"，日隂金透，甲乙為三台之貴；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506776932106292"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"午時生人，年支得己字，日得辛金為主，金用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"巽","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_15","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"木為財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"離","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_16","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"火為官，名曰内得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"巽","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_17","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"順，而外得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"離","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_18","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":475,"lineType":2,"content":"眀之象。柔進","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":476,"lineType":2,"content":"而上行，得中而應乎剛。若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":476,"lineType":2,"content":"巽","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_19","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":476,"lineType":2,"content":"居月令，則非入格大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"467","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"木秀火眀，春秉令入，斯象奪榜眼之魁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":478,"lineType":2,"content":"重在春生，即前火眀木秀，逢土現而早占鰲頭之義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"469","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"食神帶刃，結局而位至三公；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":480,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲人食丙，要火局；己人食辛，要金局。但得一字，更有刃助，大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"食神帶刃，坐官而勲髙一品。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":482,"lineType":2,"content":"日主坐下官星，歳月時中，又有刃食之現，大貴。所嫌者，偏印衝刑，若行財官二運，勃然驟發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506809513148456"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"官星帶刃，班超萬里封侯；歳月得時，周勃特然入相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":486,"lineType":2,"content":"正官之格，用神要當。時柱有刼，刃為正官妻財，則剛柔相濟，却得財星為貴。官星刼刃，兩現天干之上，尤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":487,"lineType":2,"content":"貴。賦又云官星帶刃，貴不可言。歳月透露，周勃特然入相是也。得時以官星乘旺言，帶刃以不拘干支言；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":488,"lineType":2,"content":"透露則直指所重者言之也。刃為㓙煞，官食帶之，皆作權貴㸔如李邦珍都憲，癸酉己未，壬子庚子合格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"478","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"財官雙美，透財印而居臺省之尊；運至比肩，更刑衝抱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"守株之拙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":491,"lineType":2,"content":"癸巳日坐向四月，壬午日坐向午月。天干透財印，貴不宜北方，運又怕刑衝，宜斟酌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"481","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"財官生旺，天干透露為竒，而曵紫拖朱；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506786889351187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":495,"lineType":2,"content":"四柱財星旺，不必正官透財，自生官絶竒。或財官兩透，居生旺之地，皆主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"484","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"財旺生官，印刃相扶為妙，而三台八座。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":497,"lineType":2,"content":"柱中，財星旺得令，又印劫扶持，大貴。再莫行財鄉，運。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"486","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"干食神而時騎禄馬，初年題虎榜之榮名；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":499,"lineType":2,"content":"庚日見壬午時，辛日見癸巳時是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"488","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"透印綬而格得財官，早歳鎮邉隅之重任。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":501,"lineType":2,"content":"財官之格，要歳時透印干為妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"490","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"日干健旺而印刃相扶，龔勝盡漢家之死節；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506797844742156"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":505,"lineType":2,"content":"賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_20","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":505,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：煞旺而得印刃之扶。龔勝死節於西漢，是四柱純煞。或官星從煞得印刃，透出天干，乃忠節之良","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":506,"lineType":2,"content":"臣也。前言日干旺而印刃相扶，則太過，焉得好處，當以後為正。考龔勝，漢之處士，而能死節，豈非五行太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":507,"lineType":2,"content":"過之傷歟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"496","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"官星帶刃而印綬帶煞，元齡歩唐代之瀛洲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"497","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"三公之任，在乎煞刃司權；各遇長生，更得財資極貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":510,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲用庚為煞，乙用辛為煞，柱有巳子則煞。長生甲見乙，乙見甲為刃，柱有亥午為刃，長生更得財資，煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":511,"lineType":2,"content":"印化刃極貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"500","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"司要樞，總戎政，因刼帶印以資官；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506793319120947"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":515,"lineType":2,"content":"月令時上正官，要羊刃資之，如甲用辛為官，有乙字資官是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"503","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"伸枉抑，理寃愆，為財生煞而助印。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":517,"lineType":2,"content":"四柱七煞重叠，又得財官資助，則煞得勢復生乎印矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"505","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"進直言，趨金闕，因煞刃兩露於天干；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":519,"lineType":2,"content":"此是煞格，而煞刃並現。歳月時中，主言路。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"507","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"居翰苑而掌絲綸，為正官歸禄於四柱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":521,"lineType":2,"content":"歸禄乃正官，如丙用癸為官，有子字，則癸禄居子，在冬三月生妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":521,"lineType":2,"content":"賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_21","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":521,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：掌絲綸之命，列玉堂之職，因貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":522,"lineType":2,"content":"禄而得清竒是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506779001323558"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"年正印而月正官，居國監翰林之任。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":526,"lineType":2,"content":"正官喜現於月令之中，正印要露於歳元之上，不見衝尅之神。准上文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"515","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"格清竒而時得令，唱鴻臚玉殿之名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":528,"lineType":2,"content":"格局純和，不雜用神，得令有氣，無刑衝破害，大貴之造。賦又云格清局正，玉殿傳臚是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"517","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"平邦國，綂六師，賴官星變為天徳；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":530,"lineType":2,"content":"解見前。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"理隂陽，登宰輔，因禄馬又帶長生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":532,"lineType":2,"content":"正財正官俱有長生，得刃生食，食生財，財生官，官生印，印生身，有周流不息之妙，必主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":532,"lineType":2,"content":"賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_22","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":532,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：財官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506809513164840"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":535,"lineType":2,"content":"有蒂，調和燮理之權，有蒂長生是也。只財官長生就貴，長生指所居長生之地言，不必要刃食相生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":535,"lineType":2,"content":"解","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_23","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":535,"lineType":2,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"格局純和而日干自弱，覧泉石而好幽棲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":537,"lineType":2,"content":"用神雖得時日，主衰不勝，却為林泉晦迹之人，遇運扶身亦發。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"529","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"格局薄弱而用神輕㣲，縱資生而無過小職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":539,"lineType":2,"content":"如其所用之神不得時令，縱得資益之字，不過小官，比前格局純和者不同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"531","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"土重而支神厚載，畏元武而喜青龍。格局苟逢，必膺大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"532","lineNum":541,"lineType":8,"content":"貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"533","lineNum":542,"lineType":2,"content":"且如戊己日柱中又重戊己字，或得一申字在地支，是純柔順之道，賦形有定之方，徳合無疆，坤之大也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506809513181224"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":545,"lineType":2,"content":"值此象大貴。忌壬癸，喜甲乙，運同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"536","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"木盛而土厚逢熒，順東方而行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_24","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"地，柱運順和，定顯功","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"名；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":548,"lineType":2,"content":"天干甲乙一氣，地支戊己重叠，却得寅午戌一字。順東方，木得地也，行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":548,"lineType":2,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_25","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":548,"lineType":2,"content":"地，土得位也。如是則木愈盛而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":549,"lineType":2,"content":"土愈厚矣。四九上下應之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"544","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"土多而居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_26","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"艮","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_27","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"之上，則天道下濟而光眀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":551,"lineType":2,"content":"戊己居於歳月時干地支又有其根，得提綱在寅，土為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":551,"lineType":2,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_28","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":551,"lineType":2,"content":"為地，寅為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":551,"lineType":2,"content":"艮","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_29","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":551,"lineType":2,"content":"為山，止乎内而順乎外，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":551,"lineType":2,"content":"謙","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_30","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":551,"lineType":2,"content":"之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":552,"lineType":2,"content":"山至髙而地至卑，乃屈山於地之下，值此象貴顯亨通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506790605226018"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"刃逢禄馬三竒，得令透財，為公侯一品之貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"558","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"柱會水火二局，露金藏土，為龜蛇持劒之形。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":557,"lineType":2,"content":"即前龜蛇持劔兼金刃而賈復名髙之義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"560","lineNum":558,"lineType":1,"content":"財星變徳而坐煞，李靖兼文武全材；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":559,"lineType":2,"content":"如丙申日以辛金為正財，要在四月中生，自坐申中壬水為煞；己卯以壬水為正財，要在申子辰月生，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":560,"lineType":2,"content":"天月徳之類。二者俱變為徳秀，又是財星變徳，值生旺無劫奪，武則鋤強殄暴，文則胙土分茅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":560,"lineType":2,"content":"賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_31","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":560,"lineType":2,"content":"又云：財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":561,"lineType":2,"content":"星變徳，登樞要而任股肱是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"566","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"煞刃得印以相資，汲黯作朝廷之耳目","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506757743034418"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":565,"lineType":2,"content":"煞生卬刃，合煞全者大貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"569","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"傷帶財印兼生旺而持綱持紀；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":567,"lineType":2,"content":"傷官用財用印之義也，須財印生旺方妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"571","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"柱均火土，逢木氣而為國為民，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":569,"lineType":2,"content":"火生土為食，傷木為火印，為土官故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"573","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"王曽魁衆士，因官印帶食以相扶；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"574","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"葉正占鰲頭，賴印星自官而自禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"575","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺無財官之輔，非技藝而必僧流；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506786889383955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"女人犯二徳之純，受寵章而沾鳳誥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":576,"lineType":2,"content":"余觀此賦，不外子平，但多重七煞羊刃，傷官食神，而財官印綬兼資，並取成格，合局作黨，制化變徳者，皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":577,"lineType":2,"content":"作大權大貴。萬公耳聞目擊，故以子平之法而推廣之，萬公其亦識㣲之士耶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"580","lineNum":578,"lineType":8,"content":"金聲玉振賦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"581","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"受命之不同也，有如受形；測理之難精也，過於測海。隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"慘陽舒，知盈虚之有數；天髙地迥，極覆載之無疆。或升","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"之雲漢兮而非有所私；或墜之淵泉兮而非有所惡。其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"氣數定於太初，其培覆譬諸草木。妙訣不在於多言，至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506793319153715"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"人奚事於強聒。且如類屬從化，格判旺衰，照伏拱遥，局","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"分眀暗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":587,"lineType":2,"content":"見。類屬要旺，從化要衰。照伏二者，皆取局於明；遥拱二者，乃取局於不見之形，故謂之暗。已詳註前","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":587,"lineType":2,"content":"㸔命","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_32","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":588,"lineType":2,"content":"八法","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_32","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":588,"lineType":2,"content":"下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"592","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"論用神，論日主，各有所宜；取地脉，取天元，是或一道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":590,"lineType":2,"content":"此泛舉談造化者之非一端也。或曰：此六句是申眀以上八格之意，於義亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"594","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"游心於去留舒配，决意於喜忌愛憎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":592,"lineType":2,"content":"此約言造化者之無多術也。中間妙理，則不能一言盡。如論用神，用日干，取地脉，取天元，喜忌愛憎，萬有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506793319170099"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":595,"lineType":2,"content":"不同。若不去留舒配，何以成造化而分貴賤，談性命而决生死？所以當游心詳玩，决意專察也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"598","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"亦有源濁而流清，豈無根甜而裔苦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":597,"lineType":2,"content":"如水生於土，令其源夲濁；運行西北，土化金，金化水，其流不亦清乎？若此者，先主㓙，後主吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":597,"lineType":2,"content":"洪範","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_33","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":597,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：稼穡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":598,"lineType":2,"content":"作甘，炎上作苦。木生土，令行南方，根甘裔苦之謂也。雖傷官能生財，然水不南奔，何以任之？或謂此二句","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":599,"lineType":2,"content":"總喻五行命運，不專指水火，亦通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":599,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_34","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":599,"lineType":2,"content":"有初㓙後吉，始吉終㓙，則是譬喻。此則直言其理耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"606","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"鴛鴦比翼，見江湖必遂平生；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":601,"lineType":2,"content":"如丙戌辛丑丁巳壬寅，丙辛合，丁壬合，寅戌合，丑巳合，若鴛鴦之比翼聮飛也。有壬水在柱，而又丙辛化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":602,"lineType":2,"content":"水，是江湖之象，可以遂其棲遲之情矣。或曰：鴛鴦比翼，只取其兩兩相合，即徳合雙鴦格也。江湖字不必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506793319186483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":605,"lineType":2,"content":"拘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"611","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"蝴蝶雙飛，逢園囿方為得所。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":607,"lineType":2,"content":"如辛未戊戌，辛未戊戌，未為木庫，戊戌納音又為平地，木乃園囿之所，故合格而貴。若無一㸃木氣，豈非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":608,"lineType":2,"content":"虚名虚利之人乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"614","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"採精金於青沙黄磧，别利器於錯節盤根。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":610,"lineType":2,"content":"甲午日見己巳時，乙未日見戊寅時。盖甲午乙未是是沙中金，而戊寅則青沙，己巳乃黄磧也。甲乙生卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":611,"lineType":2,"content":"月木旺之時，柱帶壬申癸酉劔鋒之金，正合此格。餘金則非。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"617","lineNum":612,"lineType":1,"content":"我生者，豈若生我之為安；尅我者，曾如我尅者之為顯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506773253668876"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":615,"lineType":2,"content":"此言傷官不及印綬，用煞不如用財也。葢傷官七煞，雖或大貴，然多有得其禍者，弗若純用財印，為享自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":616,"lineType":2,"content":"然之福也。或謂用財似止於富，不曰財旺生官耶？故用財者制人，用官煞者制於人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"621","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"既濟","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_35","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"未濟","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_36","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"，休疑衝併，休疑無依。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":618,"lineType":2,"content":"如壬子、丙午，壬子、丙午，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":618,"lineType":2,"content":"既濟","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_37","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":618,"lineType":2,"content":"之格也。丁卯、丙午、丙戌、甲午，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":618,"lineType":2,"content":"未濟","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_38","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":618,"lineType":2,"content":"之格也。二者俱太貴，如令俗眼觀之，則前","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":619,"lineType":2,"content":"一命嫌於衝併，後一命嫌於無依矣。或以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":619,"lineType":2,"content":"未濟","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_39","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":619,"lineType":2,"content":"以火在上，水在下，柱中太旺為解，即聚精㑹神之格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"634","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"内有三正三偏，不必生扶，不必透露，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":621,"lineType":2,"content":"六壬生四月己中，戊為偏官，丙為偏財長生，金為偏印，故謂之三偏。癸生巳月，則為正官、正財、正印，乃三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":622,"lineType":2,"content":"正也。水雖絕己金長生，則水不終絶，是以不必生扶也。翕聚則氣專發散，是以不必透露也。或以生扶指","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506773253685260"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":625,"lineType":2,"content":"財官印言，若日干衰弱，則不可不生扶耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"639","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"奔道途而喪生。葢因秀氣繁亂，坐囹圄以亡命；只為比","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"肩争鬭，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":628,"lineType":2,"content":"如一甲三寅一丙三戌一辛三丙，禄庫官星太多，無秀氣也。如三壬一亥、三庚一丑、三己一甲，秀氣不勝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":629,"lineType":2,"content":"其分奪也。餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"643","lineNum":630,"lineType":1,"content":"刃重官輕，業屠沽於市井；馬疲印破，弄刀筆於公堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":631,"lineType":2,"content":"官星帶刃夲吉，官煞失時而刃用事，兹其所以賤也。凡遇此格，斷為屠沽無疑。如寅午戌馬居申，有刑衝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":632,"lineType":2,"content":"破害，則馬疲。甲木以壬癸為印，無庚辛金生之，而有戊己破壞，乃吏胥之徒也。或云馬指財言，疲，病也。財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506803762774028"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":635,"lineType":2,"content":"臨病地，謂之馬疲。考","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":635,"lineType":2,"content":"珞琭子","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_40","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":635,"lineType":2,"content":"馬疲註，王廷光以前説為是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"650","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"三竒再犯戌辰，作斵削裁縫之匠；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":637,"lineType":2,"content":"地三竒，甲戊庚。天三竒，乙丙丁。人三竒，辛壬癸。干得三竒地支有辰戌相衝，乃貴反為賤之造，遇此者，可","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":638,"lineType":2,"content":"斷為木匠及裁衣匠矣。遇寅辰則不然，或戌有合，辰有合，各分二局，則水火既濟，亦不然也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"653","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱盡歸禄位，享眉夀景福之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":640,"lineType":2,"content":"如丙寅、甲午、乙巳、己卯，丙禄居巳，甲禄居寅，乙禄居卯，己禄居午，天干各有所歸，此人一生富而且夀，即","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":641,"lineType":2,"content":"消息賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_41","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":641,"lineType":2,"content":"享福五行，歸禄眉夀八字均停之意。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"657","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"木衰火旺復行西，天年夭折；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506790605307938"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":645,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲午日生，四五月，木不南奔，又見金砍伐夭折，固宜行東北運則否。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"660","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"水冷金寒兼拱北，身世浮沉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":647,"lineType":2,"content":"金水傷官，只宜東南運行吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"662","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"甲春乙秋，偏宜官煞重叠；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":649,"lineType":2,"content":"甲生春，木旺，賴金斵削方成器。乙生秋，或化或煞皆吉，是以宜多煞。假若甲生秋而重受尅，必主大㓙；乙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":650,"lineType":2,"content":"生春而煞多，亦不宜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"665","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"丙火卯月，難資印綬生扶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":652,"lineType":2,"content":"濕木不生無𦦨火，理固然也。乙卯癸卯尤甚，丅卯庶幾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506784062291983"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"水繁而不制，病生於膀胱；金繁而不化，疾在於喉舌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":656,"lineType":2,"content":"水屬精，金屬聲，水失隄防而無土制，則其人淫，水多太泛也。金太堅剛而無火化，則其人啞，金實無聲也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"670","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"財官雙美，透露極榮；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":657,"lineType":2,"content":"一云遇印極榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"火木通眀，見土則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"673","lineNum":658,"lineType":8,"content":"貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"674","lineNum":659,"lineType":2,"content":"財官雙美，是辰、戌、丑、未月生，或壬午、癸巳等日，固宜財官透天為妙。木火通眀，須春生最吉，土所以宿火","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":660,"lineType":2,"content":"培木，故須見之方貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"676","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"壬趨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"艮","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_42","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"，甲趨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_43","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"，須以財印助福；子遥己，丑遥巳，亦以財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":662,"lineType":1,"content":"印相成。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506807189504039"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":665,"lineType":2,"content":"以上四格，皆頼則印輔佐而始大貴。不宜見官煞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"684","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"三竒伏歳支之下，少入翰林；三竒在時位之間，晚歸臺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"閣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":668,"lineType":2,"content":"如六甲日主見己丑年者，是己丑中辛金、癸水、己土為財、官、印之三竒也。如六丁日見辛亥時，亥中壬水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":669,"lineType":2,"content":"為官，甲木為印，又辛金乃財也，遇之豈不居極品乎？夫三竒一也，而貴有老少之分，以年先而時後，年近","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":670,"lineType":2,"content":"而時逺耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"689","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"官星得令，制伏諸㓙；貴人扶身，解脱百厄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":672,"lineType":2,"content":"此言命中有官星貴神，不忌㓙神惡煞，葢邪不勝正也。須得令扶身，方准賦文。若官失令受傷，貴散漫生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506790605291554"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":675,"lineType":2,"content":"嗔則否。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"693","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"煞刃兩現干頭，定受言責之寄；一遇刑衝歳運，恐蹈不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"測之危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":678,"lineType":2,"content":"煞刃為權星，刑衝最忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"696","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"丙臨子申，戊當頭而貴擬王謝；辛騎羊兎，乙透出而富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"比陶朱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":681,"lineType":2,"content":"貴以食神生旺言，富以財星禄庫言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"699","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"八月官星見子辰，合來暗煞；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506784062324751"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":685,"lineType":2,"content":"假如甲生酉月為正官，歳時下有子辰，則會出申金，斯為官煞混雜矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"702","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"三春丙火逢猴鼠，化作正官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":687,"lineType":2,"content":"丙火辰土，本是食神，有子申會成水局，非官而何？此二句乃不見之形。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"704","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"金水固聰眀，有土反成頑懦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":689,"lineType":2,"content":"土能濁水埋金故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"706","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"梟食雖貧夭，得財忽變亨通。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":691,"lineType":2,"content":"食神乃財源，又為夀星，梟印破之，貧夭無疑。一經財地，逐去梟神，㓙中反吉。此等命多依他人取富。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"708","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"六乙鼠貴，愛見食神；六隂朝陽，何妨肩劫。金神帶煞入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506803762790412"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"烏臺，偏官帶刃居憲府。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":696,"lineType":2,"content":"金神、羊刃皆惡星，喜官煞制伏，人命得之為除奸去弊之象，故斷居此之職。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"712","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"戊土叠臨寅宫，喜財而不喜印；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":698,"lineType":2,"content":"戊寅雖坐煞，實長生地也。見火勿泥煞印是火蒸焦上喜財者，財生偏官，官為有氣耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"714","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"壬水坐下陽土，透煞切勿透官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":700,"lineType":2,"content":"水固頼土，止亦惡混雜也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"716","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"偏財見官兼食神，榮華有凖；身主用神或入墓，進取無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"縁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506773253701644"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"木火相照，胸中萬斛珠璣；金水相涵，筆下千篇錦綉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":706,"lineType":2,"content":"格見前，重舉之，以明其才華之卓越。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"721","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"三刑失合，破相傷軀；六害多逢，辜恩負義。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":708,"lineType":2,"content":"凡三刑若有合，則不成刑，如人争鬬而有和解之者，不然寜免此患。帶六害多者，為人必以薄為道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"723","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡却損於妻子，隔角難為乎兄弟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":710,"lineType":2,"content":"空亡如甲子，旬中無戌亥，隔角如丑寅，乃隔角方位也。日時見者，重。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"725","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"壬騎龍背，帶刃者類烏獲、孟賁；庚坐戌支，火多者是邢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"侯、雍子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506807189520423"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":715,"lineType":2,"content":"辰中有龍，陽剛之物也，更逢羊刃，膂力絕人矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":715,"lineType":2,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_44","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":715,"lineType":2,"content":"云辰多好鬪。戌為火庫，庚日坐之，再經火則煆煉太過，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":716,"lineType":2,"content":"其為無情甚矣。况其中藏娄金狗，此宿乃狡猾之物。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":716,"lineType":2,"content":"經","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_45","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":716,"lineType":2,"content":"云：戌多好訟。邢侯雍子，在春秋時争鄐田者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"734","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"滿路異香，富而好禮；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":718,"lineType":2,"content":"年月日時之天干見地支，四位貴人者是也。如壬申、辛亥、己巳、丙寅，壬以己為貴，辛以寅為貴，己以申為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":719,"lineType":2,"content":"貴，丙以亥為貴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"737","lineNum":720,"lineType":1,"content":"一旬和氣，樂以忘憂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":721,"lineType":2,"content":"年月日時，共出一旬，如甲子、壬申、己巳、癸酉，俱出甲子旬中也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"739","lineNum":722,"lineType":1,"content":"歸禄愛財星，見官則損夀；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506757743149106"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":725,"lineType":2,"content":"財為養命之源，歸禄之格，身旺愛財，直忌官星竊財氣故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"742","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"正官得時令，有印不如財。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":727,"lineType":2,"content":"官印固妙兩全，苟無財星，官失其生意，印亦何用焉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"744","lineNum":728,"lineType":1,"content":"從革復出乎三竒，血食迄千年而未艾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":729,"lineType":2,"content":"日干庚辛，地支巳酉丑，或申酉戌，全者，乃從革之象。庚日干頭再有甲戊，辛日干頭再有壬癸，其人死當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":730,"lineType":2,"content":"廟食於百世矣。何以言之？夫金之為用也剛，而其為質也固。剛者，義氣之發；固者，可久之道。人之仗義者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":731,"lineType":2,"content":"生為忠臣，死必為明神矣。此理可與達士論之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"748","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"曲直兼資乎印綬，仁聲播九有以無窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506784062341135"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":735,"lineType":2,"content":"曲直者，木象也。甲乙日主，倘見地支寅卯辰，或亥卯未全者，是更逢印綬之相生，其人必有仁心仁聞矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":736,"lineType":2,"content":"以理推之，仁者，天地生物之心，於時為春，於五行為木。是木者有生意之物，而仁者實好生之徳。更逢印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":737,"lineType":2,"content":"綬，則生生而不息矣。得之者澤被羣生，恩沾黎庶，故曰仁聲播九有而無窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"753","lineNum":738,"lineType":1,"content":"地天泰故斯人挺生；雲雷屯則經綸顯設。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":739,"lineType":2,"content":"此指上兩格之人，其生也，既有所自而不虚生；其出也，必有所為而不空出也。或云：地天泰乃戊申見辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":740,"lineType":2,"content":"亥，雲雷屯乃壬子見乙卯，即妙選地天交泰、雷雨迎春二格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"756","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"是知術數無窮，實則不遺一理；言辭難悉，吾特舉其一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"隅。顯㣲闡幽，遵彼往哲；引伸觸類，存乎人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506790605340706"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"金鼎神秘賦","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_46","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":745,"lineType":2,"content":"育吾著。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"762","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"人生有命，得失頓殊。富貴貧賤，那能一體。紅光滿室，五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"行都聚於貴鄉；佳氣充廬，四柱並集於福地。先貧後富，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":748,"lineType":1,"content":"生時值禄馬同鄉；始吉終㓙，日時犯空破之處，平生坎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"坷；基薄與㓙運交雜，一世榮華；命髙逢好運叠至；剛；金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"遇火方成噐，决定超羣；旺火得水為既濟，必然出衆。木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"須金而不繁，水賴土而不散。戊己見寅卯，得位於勾陳；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":752,"lineType":1,"content":"壬癸坐巳午，當權於元武。貴神入命，遇竒儀，必是公卿；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506757743165490"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"華葢臨時，值孤寡，定為僧道。玉堂拜相，炎炎火秀在離","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":756,"lineType":1,"content":"宫；金闕朝元，洋洋水徳宅坎位。重逢水位，斷為雲水之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"仙；累犯純陽，定作空門之子。遇長生而聰眀智慧，逢死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"敗而䝉蠢愚頑。父母難靠，年月俱䧟空亡；妻子易虧，日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"時併臨孤寡。卯酉生逢尅戰，敗門户而多灾；子午全居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"死墓，走他鄉而為客。子午最嫌巳亥，卯酉切忌寅申。宅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"墓受煞，門户多破。時落天中子少，合逢干頭妻多。年中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":762,"lineType":1,"content":"無氣，㓜而散失元基；月内逢空，門户消索不立。日臨絶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506784062357519"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"位，縱妻無恙亦多離；時在墓中，後嗣有時也不順。合地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"秀者貴，得天時者榮。五行無氣者，貧；四柱有傷者，賤。隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"陽純一者，孤；支干刑害者，疾。用神休囚者，難求富貴。秀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":768,"lineType":1,"content":"氣淺薄者，多是藝術。刑尅互見，身旺定作軍徒；辰戌相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"加，有損斷為獄吏。金水閒慢，落魄清貧之人；驛馬衝擊，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":770,"lineType":1,"content":"馳驅紅塵之客。魁罡重犯，生於屠宰之家；酉戌重逢，身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"作奴僕之下。柱中子午雙包，尊居垣省。命内干支一氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":772,"lineType":1,"content":"貴至王侯；一片純陽獨尅，命不死也傷；滿盤印綬俱生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506757743132722"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"身不貴即富。年月併傷父母，妻妾難為；年時併傷怙恃，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"繼嗣不保。年衝日兮父母旺，妻妾難存。時衝年兮兒女","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，父母易損。破命者，少失雙親。破月者，長尅昆季。破日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":778,"lineType":1,"content":"者，一身獨立。破時者，老無結果。破胎者，母氏獨當。此則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"論其大畧，尚未及乎精細。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"793","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"先提官貴，廻異常流。甲戊庚，引至丑未，貴神有氣。乙丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"丁，出於酉亥，天乙加臨，巳逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"坎","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_47","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"位，乙在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_48","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"方。六辛喜乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午，壬癸宜於巳卯。此謂暗中得貴，更㸔官印弱強。甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506795181211675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"逢酉位，乙到","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"坤","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_49","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"方。丙得子宫必顯，丁加亥上榮昌。戊見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"卯而能秀，己臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"艮","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_50","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"而聲揚。庚到","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"離","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_51","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"宫得氣，辛臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"巽","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_52","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"位安","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"然。壬投午上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"既濟","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_53","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"，癸向巳内財官。此為正官正印，更㸔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬朝元。若無刑衝尅破，必作鼎鼐神仙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"815","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"次論財富養命之源。先㸔財命有氣，次觀禄馬不貧。木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"臨四季，向禄自然充裕。水到午上，財旺必定豐隆。土逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":791,"lineType":1,"content":"潤下，金遇曲直。火遭金局，三合逢禄庫，食神。五行值天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":792,"lineType":1,"content":"厨財氣，四柱無傷。日時得地，身旺有氣，逢財化作官星；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506779001356326"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"身衰失時，財多翻為貧漢。若居煞地，多是兇徒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"821","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"人有公吏、軍戎、商賈、藝術，四者不同，各有所居。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"822","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"公吏之命，多帶尅刑。東西戰鬪，南北衝擊，長生處破了，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"死絶處生起。五行錯雜，象不純一。倒食逢財，夾貴逢破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"財印相刑，引用無氣。秀中帶鬼，貴氣損傷。干支重會，提","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"網懸針。此等之命，不離公門。至若帶官禄而可獲福，遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"貴神而可進歩，則又有出仕顯達者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"827","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"兵卒之命，與吏大同。局中煞重而干支不等，象内貴輕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506795181244443"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"而主夲破傷。甲見卯支，丙臨三丁之地；辛向亥地，壬家","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"二癸之鄉。乙丁逢蛇，戊土奔馬，此乃懸針羊刃，更犯尅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"破刑衝。又帶福氣，㓙中有吉。懸針遇吉煞相扶，羊刃有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"貴神相助。由是從行伍而有權禄，自兵卒而任總戎。然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"以煞為重，則不可誣焉者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"834","lineNum":810,"lineType":1,"content":"再㸔商賈，其命何慿？日時併臨子午，三元都值寅申。馬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"前無轡，劫上逢財。或偏財身旺，復行財運；或六合會財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"更坐馬鄉。壬人運南，丙人運北。經營買賣之人，甲人行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506807189553191"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"西，庚人行東。貿遷有無之軰，甲乙居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"坎","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_54","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"犯壬癸，未免萍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"梗他鄉；元武遇亥無戊己，諒必龍斷外主。至於得利不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"得利，則專論財之旺不旺而决之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"843","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"再看藝術，又非商賈。命遇徳秀，犯刑衝，小道可觀；時逢學堂，見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡，多能可鄙。乙庚化金於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"坎","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_55","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"艮","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_56","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"，丁壬化木於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"兑","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_57","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"乾","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_58","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"，辛丙臨乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"四季，戊癸居乎一宫。此乃秀而不秀，化而不成，格局破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"損，禄馬不全。原夫秉賦聰眀，多因生遇學堂；至於成就","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"淡薄，乃是命無根本。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":822,"lineType":2,"content":"無根夲，如水人無金，火人無木之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"若四柱不相往","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506790605373474"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"來，更五行再無氣象，天乙閒漫，華葢叠逢，不作飄蓬尋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":826,"lineType":1,"content":"幽之士，必為九流藝業之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":826,"lineType":2,"content":"天乙閒慢，如甲戊庚，上半年以未為貴人不閒，下半","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":827,"lineType":2,"content":"年以丑為貴人不閒。與六壬反㸔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"861","lineNum":828,"lineType":1,"content":"再㸔僧道，又非藝術。五行在無氣之鄉，十干臨死墓之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"地。年月盡逢孤寡，日時全見元辰。累犯空亡，重臨華葢，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":830,"lineType":1,"content":"妻子衰絶，身旺無依。火盛而身心禪定，水多而自在逍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"遥。若命合貴格而死絶，心樂清虚；命無貴氣而生旺，性","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"好空門。月上五行恬和，道行髙潔而教門增重。時上五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506837082308634"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"行安静，行果相輔而徒衆數多。月上福神得助，則善和","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"法眷而同衣賛美。日上刑衝帶煞，則求化無縁而行脚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"飄流，見煞印則當權服衆，遇䘮弔則苦行傷身。華葢夾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":838,"lineType":1,"content":"貴與三竒雖云吉煞，自死自絶自生，旺則無吉助。若生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"旺太過而兼帶干鬼，則名利之心不㤀。值尅害太甚而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":840,"lineType":1,"content":"更遇㓙煞，則凡俗之還不免。咸池為酒色之星，犯之則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"躭迷不檢。羊刃乃㓙惡之物，遇之則財利是圖。歳運見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"䘮弔伏返，在俗人則㓙，而僧道則吉。元命遇孤寡亡劫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506803762855948"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":845,"lineType":1,"content":"在常人有妨，而僧道無害。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":845,"lineType":2,"content":"古歌云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":845,"lineType":1,"content":"兩般父母見星孤，四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":846,"lineType":1,"content":"季天上禄也無。辰戌丑未加臨著，多是道士及僧徒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":846,"lineType":2,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":847,"lineType":2,"content":"云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"三合生人辰戌時，定為僧道不須疑。若還華葢併臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"墓，囊槖豐隆定紫衣。凡論僧道，又當以是質之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"884","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"又有先貧後富，先富後貧，二者隔别，全㸔月日。日時生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"旺聚福兮，晚景榮華。月令有氣儲財兮，早年富貴。若月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"吉而引用多輕，先富後貧；日強而夲根不利，先貧後富，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"生來受䕃。年月在財官之鄉，末主孤寒；日時犯空破之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506837082325018"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"地，年月逢財無氣，㓜年窘廹。日時遇食有氣，老景歡忻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":856,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱衰㣲，平生不遂。背禄逐馬，一世恓惶。若夫干頭財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"露，支内不藏，傷劫實地，禄馬虚浮，身旺印助，一生破敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"不聚財身弱財多，外似有餘内不足。或四柱原無財官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"遇歳運忽然發跡。似此之命，有名無實。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"894","lineNum":860,"lineType":1,"content":"又有抛鄉去井，失土離家，乃年尅月兮相制伏，日衝時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"兮在子午。四煞若衝身命，定應逰走他鄉；三限再臨死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"絶，未免飄泊外處。重重鬼害，纍纍刑空。運拙時乖兮，别","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506793319252019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"閭里而跋踄程途；命蹇日衰兮，辭親戚而往來岐路。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":866,"lineType":1,"content":"再論兄弟以及妻子：木人春降，到寅亥卯，昆仲必多，若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"生西南必少。金命秋生，臨巳申酉，兄弟盈門，若逢東地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":868,"lineType":1,"content":"不靠。水居潤下，遇乾坎，同氣多榮，往來辰戌消洒；火向","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"炎上居離巽，連枝共美，到於酉亥彫零。土臨四季，伯叔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"成行。若論得力不得力：三元不落空亡，四柱不犯孤寡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍作子，休婚白虎之妻；火徳成男，莫娶亥子為婦。水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"生子嗣，母忌中央。年合日時犯戊癸，决主三妻。甲逢二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506797844791308"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"巳，到巳午，不止兩婦。丙逢重辛，居酉子，多招寵妾。庚與","logicSentenceId":"0","margin
