{"lines":[{"lineId":"910","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"又有子多榮貴，亦有子少愚頑。是理何説，要當詳論。金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"離","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_59","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"位，逢炎火，兒孫滿前；火臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"坎","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_60","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"戸，遇順下，後代克昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":880,"lineType":1,"content":"木逢庚辛到巳申，土生甲乙見寅卯；水臨四季，喜見戊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":881,"lineType":1,"content":"己。時日生逢無尅制，子孫多榮；官煞重逢，見財生，嗣繼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":882,"lineType":1,"content":"必貴。若夫日臨衰墓，死敗，男女須傷；時犯空亡，有尅，兒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506790605422626"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"孫必少。木為後代，忌逢申午之方；火若為男，休逢酉亥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"之地。金為子位，怕見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"坎","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_61","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"寅；水作男宫，忌見卯巳。土為後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"嗣，怕臨震東。男取尅干為嗣，女取干生為子。四柱歸於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"敗絶，五行都在傷官。雖有干支暗合，也須螟蛉作嗣。縱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"有偏出，實難定姓。古有借妻安子，其理甚玄。木兒見鬼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"得北方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"坎","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_62","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"女多存；水子遇煞，頼西方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"兑","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_63","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"妻可養。水制火，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"男，借青龍為妳母；木損土，兒覓朱雀為繼娘。五行有損，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":892,"lineType":1,"content":"須借相生；四柱雖尅，亦多無害。若不借母安子，豈能後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506790605439010"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"嗣不乏？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"936","lineNum":896,"lineType":1,"content":"至論女命，最怕刑夫。日生木蛇，難成婚配之期；巳用金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"鷄，定是失夫之婦。土為夫婿，寅卯多寡；木作婚期，離宫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":898,"lineType":1,"content":"須害。再犯孤鸞尤甚，更遇八專何説。至於為婦清潔，生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":899,"lineType":1,"content":"而不犯貴合，若要秉性堅貞，長而不逢煞傷。丁壬無氣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":900,"lineType":1,"content":"必犯娼淫。戊癸休囚，多有濁濫。四柱禄合，三元純一，日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"時有合，有夫不離私情。桃花劫煞，五行居墓。財祿沐浴，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":902,"lineType":1,"content":"背夫别成暗約。隂遇陽干，合多不娼即妓。比劫分争，身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506803762872332"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"弱匪妾即奴。至有五行失位，四柱休囚，十干上下交戰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"運行無氣空亡。三元在沐浴之中，五行居死墓之地，生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"為奴婢，將誰怨尤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"947","lineNum":908,"lineType":1,"content":"間有命犯，倒食而無食，能與别人作福。偏財遇比而身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，甘為富家幹僕。男子舍居，異姓入贅。金居金位遇卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":910,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，木到木鄉逢丑未，日時犯月鬼破門，丙寅别祖宗入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"墓。魁罡臨命見華葢，一生就妻為活。丑未重犯遇寡宿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":912,"lineType":1,"content":"半世從婦入舍。四柱往来，有情携手為婚。三元重犯，隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506795181277211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"合不媒作室。陽衰隂旺，女招别姓。子為男命配成婚，休","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":916,"lineType":1,"content":"敗尅滯。後㸔相生，多招外婿。支多尅滯，定應知汝。波濤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":917,"lineType":1,"content":"下上無生一户，豈能堅守。身如顯化，自無氣，本姓全虧，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":918,"lineType":1,"content":"若是假合别成，象孤兒異姓，平生窘廹，豈能得祖宗之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"財？若得興豐，因托别房父母。此只論其大槩，尚未得其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":920,"lineType":1,"content":"精㣲。命之理㣲，悟在心得。若夫疾病、死絶、貧賤、㓙惡，歳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"運晦顯，各有道理，已著以前，兹不重賦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"960","lineNum":922,"lineType":8,"content":"元機賦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506795181293595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"太極判為天地一氣，分有隂陽。日干為主，專論財官；月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":926,"lineType":1,"content":"支取格，乃分貴賤。有格不正者敗，無格有用者成。有官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"莫尋格局，有格不喜官星。官印、財食，無破清髙。煞傷、梟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":928,"lineType":1,"content":"刃，用之最吉。善惡相交，喜去惡而崇善。吉㓙混雜，忌害","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"吉而向㓙。有官有煞，宜身旺制煞為竒；有煞有印，畏財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":930,"lineType":1,"content":"興，助煞為禍。身強煞淺，煞運無妨；煞重身輕，制鄉為福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺印多，喜行財地。財多身弱，畏入財鄉。男逢比劫傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":932,"lineType":1,"content":"官，尅妻害子。女犯傷官偏印，䘮子刑夫，㓜失雙親。財星","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506790605488162"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":935,"lineType":1,"content":"太重，為人孤尅，身旺無依。年衝月令，離祖成家。日被提","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":936,"lineType":1,"content":"衝，弦斷再續。時日對衝，傷妻尅子。日通月氣，得祖安身。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":937,"lineType":1,"content":"是以木歸春，長遇庚辛，反假為權。火居夏，生見壬癸，能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":938,"lineType":1,"content":"為福厚。土逢辰戌丑未，木重成名。金生申酉巳丑，火鄉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"發福。水居亥子，戊己難侵。身坐休囚，平生未濟。身旺者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":940,"lineType":1,"content":"喜行祿馬；身弱者，忌見財官。得時俱為旺論，失令更作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"衰㸔。四柱無根，得時為旺。日干無氣，遇刼為強。身弱喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":942,"lineType":1,"content":"印，主旺宜官。甲乙秋生金透露，水木火運榮昌。丙丁冬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506803762888716"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"降水汪洋，火土木方貴顯。戊己春生，西南方有救。庚辛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":946,"lineType":1,"content":"夏長，水土運無妨。壬癸逢於土旺，金木宜榮。身弱有印，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"煞旺無妨。身强煞淺，用財亦可。身强用財，宜有煞。身弱用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":948,"lineType":1,"content":"印，宜去財傷官。身弱無印，何所依頼。身旺無財，將何發福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺者用財，身弱者用印。用財去印，用印去財，方發彌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":950,"lineType":1,"content":"福。正所謂喜者存之，憎者去也。財多身弱，身旺運以為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"榮；身旺財衰，財旺鄉而發福。重犯官星，只宜制伏。食神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":952,"lineType":1,"content":"叠至，須忌官鄉。頑金無火，大用不成。強木無金，清名難","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506797844807692"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":955,"lineType":1,"content":"著。木多得土財帛厚，火熖逢水官爵榮。有官有印，無破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":956,"lineType":1,"content":"為榮。無印無官，有格取貴。羊刄不畏偏官，金神最宜制","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"伏。雜氣財官刑衝則發。官財太盛，旺處必傾。身太旺喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":958,"lineType":1,"content":"見財官，主太柔，不宜禄馬。旺官旺印與旺財入墓，有禍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官。食神併身旺遇庫興灾。運貴在於支取，歳重向乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":960,"lineType":1,"content":"干求。印多者行財而發，財旺者遇比無妨。格清局正，富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"貴榮華。印旺官明，聲名特達。合官非為貴取，合煞莫作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":962,"lineType":1,"content":"㓙推。桃花帶煞喜淫奔，華葢重逢多尅剥。平生不發，八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506790605537314"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"字休囚。一世無權，身衰遇鬼。身旺則宜泄宜傷，身衰則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":966,"lineType":1,"content":"喜扶喜助。務禀中和之氣，莫令太過不及。若遵此法，推","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"詳禍福，驗如影響，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":969,"lineType":1,"content":"恭造化之元機，測五行之妙理。判人命之得失，决一世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":970,"lineType":1,"content":"之榮枯。法則取於日干，興衰論乎月支。甲乙屬木，最喜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":971,"lineType":1,"content":"春生。壬癸屬水，偏宜冬旺。丙丁火而夏眀，庚辛金而秋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":972,"lineType":1,"content":"鋭。戊己兩干之土，要旺四季之期。日乃自身，須究強弱；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506807189602343"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":975,"lineType":1,"content":"年為夲主，宜細推詳。年干父兮支母，日干己兮支妻。月","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":976,"lineType":1,"content":"干兄兮支弟，時支女兮干兒。後煞尅年，父母早喪。前煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":977,"lineType":1,"content":"尅後，子息必虧。馬入妻宫，必得能家之婦。煞臨子位，當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":978,"lineType":1,"content":"招悖逆之兒。禄入妻宫，食妻之禄。印臨子位，受子之榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":979,"lineType":1,"content":"梟居祖位，破祖之基。財官月旺，得父資財。所忌財傷禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":980,"lineType":1,"content":"薄，最嫌鬼旺身衰。食神暗見，人物豐肥。梟印重生，祖財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":981,"lineType":1,"content":"漂蕩。咸池財露，主淫奢㓙。煞合年防自刃。桃花重帶合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":982,"lineType":1,"content":"神，花街栁巷。驛馬若逢衝物，暮楚朝秦。金火交争，斷無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506779001421862"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":985,"lineType":1,"content":"禮義。印財兩失，少損爺娘。桃花會禄，酒色亡身。財旺梟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":986,"lineType":1,"content":"衰，因財䘮命。身臨沐浴之年，恐遭水厄；主入戰鬭之地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":987,"lineType":1,"content":"必逢火傷。財生官者，用賄求官。財壞印者，貪財卸職。財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":988,"lineType":1,"content":"旺生官，白身榮顯。財生煞黨，天折童年。獨煞衝破，廢閑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":989,"lineType":1,"content":"人。諸煞逢刑，兇狠軰。天干多煞，遇干年須當夭折。地支","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":990,"lineType":1,"content":"多鬼，遇支年必見㓙灾。財生官，官生印，印生身，富貴雙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":991,"lineType":1,"content":"全。傷黨財，財黨煞，煞尅身，㓙窮兩逼。酉寅刑害繼傷婚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":992,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯風雷多性急。煞官混逢，乃技藝之流；財禄坐馬，為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506779001405478"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":995,"lineType":1,"content":"經商之客。馬落空亡，遷居漂泊；祿遭衝破，離鄉萍梗。隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":996,"lineType":1,"content":"多利於女人，陽盛宜於男子。隂盛於陽，女主興家；陽盛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":997,"lineType":1,"content":"於隂，男當建府。純陽男必孤寡，純隂女必困窮。官貴生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":998,"lineType":1,"content":"年，化㓙煞而名垂萬古；胞胎臨日，遇印綬而禄享千鐘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":999,"lineType":1,"content":"一氣為根，秀出羣英之表；兩干不雜，名出衆彦之先。木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":1000,"lineType":1,"content":"秀火眀，擬作塩梅調鼎客；水深土厚，當為舟楫巨川才。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":1001,"lineType":1,"content":"命元生煞進，身旺必主加權；臨官歳，遇值貴人，重宜進","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":1002,"lineType":1,"content":"秩。傷官最要去官盡，制煞無如化煞髙。倘若化神弱，制","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506809513295912"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":1005,"lineType":1,"content":"神強，施恩有不足之怨；化神旺，制神衰，臨事無决斷之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":1006,"lineType":1,"content":"能。有煞無印欠文彩，有印無煞少威風。煞印兩全，文武","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":1007,"lineType":1,"content":"兼備。衰運發而旺運止，旺運發而衰運終。此乃春秋代","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":1008,"lineType":1,"content":"謝，天運循環，萬古不易之理也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":1010,"lineType":1,"content":"搜尋八字，專論財官；次究五行，須求氣候。論財官之向","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":1011,"lineType":1,"content":"背重輕，察氣候之淺深生死。他來尅我為官鬼，身旺必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":1012,"lineType":1,"content":"權；我去尅他為妻財，干強則富。年傷日主，乃父與子而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506790605504546"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":1015,"lineType":1,"content":"不親；時尅日辰，是子不遵於父命。年尅日兮，上能凌下，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":1016,"lineType":1,"content":"日尅年兮下去犯上。若得有物制日干，則可化惡為祥；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":1017,"lineType":1,"content":"更要本主逢喜神，則將變㓙為吉。喜神慶會，當知資産","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":1018,"lineType":1,"content":"豐隆；四柱無情，定見禍端並作。或見本主相衝，三刑重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":1019,"lineType":1,"content":"叠；歳運欺凌，必招横事。純粹五行入格，臺閣風清；身強","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":1020,"lineType":1,"content":"七煞逢伏，藩垣鎮守。無財官而有格局，青雲得路；無格","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":1021,"lineType":1,"content":"局而有財官，黄甲成名。財官格局俱損，不貧寒，乃功名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":1022,"lineType":1,"content":"蹭蹬之夫；日干月令俱強，非困窮，必草茅隠逸之士。丙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506809513263144"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":1025,"lineType":1,"content":"丁坐南離而無制，是不遵禮法兇暴之徒；壬癸遇戊己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":1026,"lineType":1,"content":"之相應，乃懐徳抱材聰慧之士。辛逢乙木於南墓，雖富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":1027,"lineType":1,"content":"而不仁；丙逢辛金於北鎮，縱貧而有徳。年月時令有偏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":1028,"lineType":1,"content":"印，吉㓙未萌；大運歳君逢夀星，灾殃立至。㓜年失乳，食","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":1029,"lineType":1,"content":"神遭刑尅之宫；壯歳峥嶸，財官居純粹之位。陽日食神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":1030,"lineType":1,"content":"得地，無衝損，則暗合官星；隂日食神無破虧，須契合則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":1031,"lineType":1,"content":"身親印綬。偏財能益筭延年，羊刃善奪財化鬼。財星有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":1032,"lineType":1,"content":"破，棄祖風别立他鄉；印綬被傷，失祖業抛離故里。人命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506837082374170"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":1035,"lineType":1,"content":"以貴神為福，遭尅䧟則㓙禍不祥；五行會㓙曜為灾，逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":1036,"lineType":1,"content":"合煞併食神為貴。命虧煞旺，要天赦二徳呈祥；身弱財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":1037,"lineType":1,"content":"豐，喜羊刃兄弟為助。月令值食神健旺，善飲食而姿質","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":1038,"lineType":1,"content":"豐盈。四柱有吉曜相扶，堆金積玉；五行無㓙煞侵犯，名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":1039,"lineType":1,"content":"顯聲揚。寅申巳亥叠犯，有聰眀生發之心。子午卯酉重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":1040,"lineType":1,"content":"逢，耽酒色荒淫之志。桃花帶煞，心意猖狂。二徳逢印，徳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":1041,"lineType":1,"content":"性慈祥。食神多而好貪飲食，正官旺而畧沾滋味。梟神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":1042,"lineType":1,"content":"興，早年夭折，爵星旺，老夀彌髙。要知女命難婚，定入背","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506807189618727"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":1045,"lineType":1,"content":"夫之位。欲識男兒早娶，定是運合財鄉。子尅重重煞没","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":1046,"lineType":1,"content":"官衰傷食重傷妻叠叠，財輕身旺兄弟多，若不如斯，定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":1047,"lineType":1,"content":"是刑衝妻妾位，暗合財星妻妾衆，虚朝財位主妻多，財","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":1048,"lineType":1,"content":"星入墓，必定刑妻。支下伏財，偏房寵妾。妻星眀朗，喬木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":1049,"lineType":1,"content":"相求。大運流年，三合財鄉，必主紅鸞吉兆，或臨財敗之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":1050,"lineType":1,"content":"官，家資凌替，傷妻損妾，婚配難成。妻星夫位在何宫，要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":1051,"lineType":1,"content":"求端的。官禄天厨居甚位，須察根源。有格局純粹，忽遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":1052,"lineType":1,"content":"惡物相衝，亦主死亡。有財禄淺薄，或逢歳運旺相，亦當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506809513312296"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"驟發，日求升合。食神旺處刼財多，生來貧夭。財食得地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":1056,"lineType":1,"content":"梟印重，官弱煞強，無制則夭；日衰財重，黨煞則窮。更㸔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":1057,"lineType":1,"content":"歳運何㓙何吉？寅申巳亥，互依倚，不遷徙，必出他鄉。乾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":1058,"lineType":1,"content":"坤艮巽，遇互換，好馳騁，心無定主。柱中若逢華葢，遇二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":1059,"lineType":1,"content":"徳，乃清貴之人。官星七煞，或落空亡，在九流，任虚閒之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":1060,"lineType":1,"content":"職。五行尅戰，非傷日主不為灾。歳運併臨，若損用神，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":1061,"lineType":1,"content":"有禍。財星入墓，少許刑衝，必發傷官傷盡。或見官星，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":1062,"lineType":1,"content":"㓙有十八格，當從善惡推求，總係五行，各取衰旺消息。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506803762921484"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":1065,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺何勞印綬，干衰不喜財官，中和為福，偏黨為禍。但","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":1066,"lineType":1,"content":"見貴神朝拱，禄馬飛天，遥合虚格，不得刑衝，逢合皆忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":1067,"lineType":1,"content":"七煞官星，各嫌覊絆。填實則㓙忽然運到官鄉，當以退","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":1068,"lineType":1,"content":"身避職，馬疲官破，困守窮途，禄旺財豐，峥嶸仕路。如臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":1069,"lineType":1,"content":"喜處以得禍，是三合而隠㓙星；或逢㓙處而返祥，乃九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":1070,"lineType":1,"content":"宫而露吉曜。要知職品髙低，當求運神向背。清竒則早","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":1071,"lineType":1,"content":"歳成名，玷缺則晚年得地。津路通亨，權髙爵顯；程途偃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":1072,"lineType":1,"content":"蹇，禄薄官卑。推尋子位，先㸔妻宫。死絶者嫡庻難存，太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506797844905996"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":1075,"lineType":1,"content":"旺者别門求覓。子星顯露，子息必多；刑害嗣宫，男女罕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":1076,"lineType":1,"content":"得。若問兄弟多寡，細簡四柱干支。月令雖強，更㸔運神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":1077,"lineType":1,"content":"向背。死絶刑傷，鴈行失序。相生慶會，棣萼聮榮。兄弟身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":1078,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，父母有虧；財帛宫多，母年早䘮。若見官鬼出見，母反","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":1079,"lineType":1,"content":"長年；如逢脫氣排連，父還有夀。壬臨午位，癸坐巳宫，禀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":1080,"lineType":1,"content":"中和兮祿馬同鄉，遇休囚也胎元絶地。丙臨申位，庚坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":1081,"lineType":1,"content":"燕寅；已入巽乾，乙臨雙女；金乘火位，甲坐坤宫。名曰休","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":1082,"lineType":1,"content":"囚，最嫌尅制。七煞忌逢言䘮魄，夀星欣遇曰還魂。天命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506837082406938"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":1085,"lineType":1,"content":"能施，智力難出，綱維造化，隂功可奪。貧寒將盡，能令白","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":1086,"lineType":1,"content":"屋出公卿；奢侈大過，還使朱門 {"lines":[{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":1091,"lineType":8,"content":"心鏡五七賦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":1161,"lineType":1,"content":"兩儀肇闢，六甲攸生，將三元而作三才，建四時而為四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":1162,"lineType":1,"content":"柱。干為禄夲，定一生職位髙低；支作命基，布三限夀元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506825686401036"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":1165,"lineType":1,"content":"終始。年生為根，月建為苖。日管經營，斷中年之休咎；時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":1166,"lineType":1,"content":"為結果，定晚歳之榮枯。先推胎息之由，次入變通之道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":1167,"lineType":1,"content":"為官為貴，緣上下以咸和；多滯多危，本根元而相尅。是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":1168,"lineType":1,"content":"故格清局正，當為臺閣之臣；印旺官生，必秉鈞衡之任。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":1169,"lineType":1,"content":"馬頭帶劔，威鎮邉疆；印綬逢華，尊居翰苑。禄雖多而有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":1170,"lineType":1,"content":"害，福不為祥；煞雖重而無傷，㓙不為禍。三竒弗遇，才髙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":1171,"lineType":1,"content":"難解成名；六合正逢，家富。又能増業。空亡親於寡宿，孤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":1172,"lineType":1,"content":"獨躘踵；長生䧟於空亡，貧寒偃蹇。桃花若逢帝座，因色","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506807189651495"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":1175,"lineType":1,"content":"亡身；咸池更會日宫，縁妻致富。根元淺薄，逢生旺而不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":1176,"lineType":1,"content":"榮；本主興隆，遇休囚而反吉。羊刃臨於五鬼，定須重犯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":1177,"lineType":1,"content":"徒流；勾絞叠於三刑，應是頻遭編配。是以登仕途者，莫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":1178,"lineType":1,"content":"逢吞㗖，爵禄虧停；當兵權者，勿遇天中，身權退失。胸襟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":1179,"lineType":1,"content":"澄徹，葢因水濟江湖；學問淵源，本是水居壬癸。慈祥愷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":1180,"lineType":1,"content":"悌，木乘甲乙之鄉；焦燥暴惡，火盛丙丁之地。名髙禄重，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":1181,"lineType":1,"content":"乾金早會庚辛；貫朽粟陳，鎮土重親戊己。木繁而無金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":1182,"lineType":1,"content":"斵削，縱榮而末歳孤窮；火炎而無水陶鎔，雖發而早年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506837082472474"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":1185,"lineType":1,"content":"夭折。學若水之浮泛，惟慿土以隄防。土重而無木疏通，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":1186,"lineType":1,"content":"遂歸愚濁；金堅而無火鍜鍊，終是㓙頑。至若金脆火炎，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":1187,"lineType":1,"content":"多則損己；木柔金重，利則傷身。水清不假土多，土弱不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":1188,"lineType":1,"content":"禁木盛。火強燥而㣲眇，水既濟以寛和，須將匀配為佳，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":1189,"lineType":1,"content":"亦以均調為上。大顯者貴乎深隠，大屈者貴乎卑伸。夀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":1190,"lineType":1,"content":"永年髙，皆是禄臨帝旺；職崇位顯，為縁馬㑹官星。華葢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"逢空，偏宜僧道；學堂遇貴，惟利師儒。五行若也蕭索，三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":1192,"lineType":1,"content":"命因而低弱。日逢空寡，其妻多致生離；時值空虚，其子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506795181342747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":1195,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有不肖。絕宫為鼓盆之煞，胎宫為白虎之神；天空臨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":1196,"lineType":1,"content":"嗣續之官，永歳損成家之子。運逢吉宿，無本主則未足","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":1197,"lineType":1,"content":"歡娯；限守㓙神，有根苗則不須畏懼。歳君若臨惡弱，一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":1198,"lineType":1,"content":"歳迍邅；生時若遇休囚，一生愁嘆。源清者其流必逺，本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":1199,"lineType":1,"content":"濁者所作無成。八字超羣，不貴即當大富；五行駁雜，居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":1200,"lineType":1,"content":"安可不慮危？休囚者身性卑㣲；旺相者名利壯寔。先強","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":1201,"lineType":1,"content":"後弱，必先吉而後㓙；始弱終強，亦始㓙而終吉。乃若初","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":1202,"lineType":1,"content":"逢貴吉，未可便作貴推；中遇㓙強，豈可便作㓙兆？大抵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506779001487398"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":1205,"lineType":1,"content":"文貴要長生之地，刑煞宜死絶之宫，是以當憂不憂，聞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":1206,"lineType":1,"content":"喜不喜，詳其本末，察其盈虚，榮辱窮通，不言而喻，吉㓙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":1207,"lineType":1,"content":"悔吝，可考而知。名曰造㣲，豈云小補？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":1209,"lineType":1,"content":"洪濛肇判，甲子攸生，二十二字之用無窮，百萬千人之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":1210,"lineType":1,"content":"命可考。日生為主，年長為君，先論根本虚實，次論歳運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":1211,"lineType":1,"content":"強弱。森列三才，妙在權衡輕重；包羅八卦，自存規矩方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":1212,"lineType":1,"content":"圓。天道尚有盈虧，人事豈無反覆？或始貧而終富，或先","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506779001520166"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":1215,"lineType":1,"content":"敗而後興，當捨短而從長，勿取彼而棄此。四柱俱嫌一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":1216,"lineType":1,"content":"字，大醇亦求小疵，詳察其源，勿輕以斷。官在禄鄉，伊尹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":1217,"lineType":1,"content":"負阿衡之位；時居貴地，傅説興作相之臣。生逢貴格，入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":1218,"lineType":1,"content":"仕為臺閣之尊；重遇鬼局，樂道有山林之興。是知居官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":1219,"lineType":1,"content":"居貴，五行醇而不疵；多滯多憂，八字雜而又戰。根甘裔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":1220,"lineType":1,"content":"苦，賈誼屈於長沙；源濁流清，太公興於渭水。禄馬同鄉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":1221,"lineType":1,"content":"而㑹登台鼎；煞印重旺，而早入科名。比肩重遇，宜嗟范","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":1222,"lineType":1,"content":"子之貧；印綬叠逢，可比老彭之夀。夾官夾貴，日時值而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506844128870415"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":1225,"lineType":1,"content":"峻宇雕梁；劫財奪馬，歳時逢而蓬門甕牖。嗣位逢尅，絶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":1226,"lineType":1,"content":"鵲之巢而鳩之居；妻位犯煞，傷鸞之孤而鵠之寡。運行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":1227,"lineType":1,"content":"背禄，昔日富而今日貧；命遇旺財，昨日悲而今日笑。四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":1228,"lineType":1,"content":"柱坐學堂之上，回也不愚；三元助墓庫之中，子之好學。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":1229,"lineType":1,"content":"年傷官貴，才髙那解成名；時值偏官，家富又添好子。庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":1230,"lineType":1,"content":"行丙地，禱爾于祗；壬入戊鄉，胡不遄死？伯牛有疾，縁戰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":1231,"lineType":1,"content":"尅以交差；司馬何憂，葢比和而無位。身中衰弱，逢吉運","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":1232,"lineType":1,"content":"以為㓙。命坐堅實，遇禍年而反福。煞雖重而多合，何傷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506803762970636"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":1235,"lineType":1,"content":"日月之眀；禄雖顯而有失，難際風雲之會。遇而不遇，庚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":1236,"lineType":1,"content":"辛在壬癸之鄉；憂而不憂，甲乙行丙丁之地。或若生逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":1237,"lineType":1,"content":"絶敗，鄭谷歸耕；禄馬病衰，馮唐皓首。九官旺相，難逃邀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":1238,"lineType":1,"content":"我於桑中；四柱合和，未免題詩於葉上。西施貌美，自身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":1239,"lineType":1,"content":"多帶長生；緑珠墜樓，㓙惡又逢七煞。孤鸞入命。夫哭婦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":1240,"lineType":1,"content":"而婦哭夫；烟花絆身，女求男而男求女。頭目䧟而肢體","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":1241,"lineType":1,"content":"相虧，財帛耗而田宅有害。生時若遇刑衝，一生屢空；歳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":1242,"lineType":1,"content":"月若臨刼奪，百歳孤寒。財入財窠，不貴即當大富；煞居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506779001536550"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":1245,"lineType":1,"content":"太歳，居安可不慮危。乃若官星透露，未可便作貴推；煞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":1246,"lineType":1,"content":"星下攻，曷可便為㓙斷？大抵貴禄喜逢於印綬，刑煞宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":1247,"lineType":1,"content":"值於制合，是以當憂不憂，聞喜不喜，考其根而明其實，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":1248,"lineType":1,"content":"論其始而究其終。是以妻宫有尅，少年無早娶之人；兒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":1249,"lineType":1,"content":"位逢傷，末歳損成家之子。平生不吉，而夀算椿松；財禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":1250,"lineType":1,"content":"帶多，而福姿蒲栁。源清者其流必逺，本壯者其葉必榮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":1251,"lineType":1,"content":"三命冠羣，不至貴即當大富；九宫䧟溺，怕㓙運又怕㓙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":1252,"lineType":1,"content":"年。千條萬緒，當求不見之形；百𣲖一源，貴得彌身之地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506795181391899"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":1255,"lineType":1,"content":"詳陳夲末，偹察盈虧，後之君子，幸勿忽諸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":1257,"lineType":1,"content":"嘗聞分二氣以定三才，播四時而成萬物。人命榮枯得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":1258,"lineType":1,"content":"失，盡在五行生尅之中；富貴榮華，不越八字中和之外。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":1259,"lineType":1,"content":"先觀節氣之淺深，次㸔財官之向背。凡人命内，難得實","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":1260,"lineType":1,"content":"有財官。余觀格中，只要虛邀禄馬。先賢已有成式，後學","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":1261,"lineType":1,"content":"須要變通。太過無尅制者，貧賤；不及失生扶者，刑夭。宜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":1262,"lineType":1,"content":"向之而運背，决知貧賤；宜背之而運向，定是困窮。喜生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506837082488858"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":1265,"lineType":1,"content":"而逢生，貴而可取；愛尅而受尅，吉而堪言。木盛逢金，斷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":1266,"lineType":1,"content":"作棟梁之任；水多遇土，妙為堤岸之功。火煉秋金，鑄出","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":1267,"lineType":1,"content":"劔鋒之器；木疎季土，培成稼穡之禾。火炎有水，名為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":1267,"lineType":1,"content":"既","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_65","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":1268,"lineType":1,"content":"濟","objectRef":{"refId":"SK1610_00013_0_65","refType":4,"paragraphs":[],"sourceType":3,"fromAi":false},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":1268,"lineType":1,"content":"之佳；水淺金多，號曰體全之象。亥卯未逢於甲乙，富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":1269,"lineType":1,"content":"貴無疑；寅午戌逢於丙丁，榮華有准；庚辛局全，己酉丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":1270,"lineType":1,"content":"位重權髙；壬癸格得，申子辰禄優財足。戊己局全四季，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":1271,"lineType":1,"content":"榮冠諸曹。更值徳秀三竒，名揚四岳。木全寅卯辰之方，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":1272,"lineType":1,"content":"功名自有；金備申酉戌之地，富貴無虧。水歸亥子丑之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506784062390287"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":1275,"lineType":1,"content":"源，利名之客；火臨巳午未之域，顯達之人。木旺宜火之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":1276,"lineType":1,"content":"交輝，秋闈可試；金堅愛水之相涵，文學堪誇。用火愁水，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":1277,"lineType":1,"content":"用木怕金。春木重重，休為太旺無依；夏火炎炎，莫作太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":1278,"lineType":1,"content":"燥有𡒦。秋金鋭鋭最為奇，冬水洋洋專可美。生我扶我","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1286","lineNum":1279,"lineType":1,"content":"為忌，尅我制我有功。五行有配，曰化曰治曰和；四柱無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":1280,"lineType":1,"content":"情，為亂為傷為禍。合中逢戰，如大治之遇亂離；死地逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":1281,"lineType":1,"content":"生，若極否更以盛世。一治一亂，柱中滚浪刑衝；乍旺乍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":1282,"lineType":1,"content":"衰，命裏交横破害。劉蕡不第，只因文學年衰；李廣非侯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506825686433804"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":1285,"lineType":1,"content":"葢為人強馬劣。欲知平生貴賤，當推科甲之星；要問職","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":1286,"lineType":1,"content":"分髙低，細察財官之位。求官未就，衝傷命貴便登科；功","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":1287,"lineType":1,"content":"名已成，不可覆臨傷以破。魁勝官則終身不第，官勝印","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":1288,"lineType":1,"content":"而唾手成名。木相火眀，此軰宜登甲第；金寒水冷，斯人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":1289,"lineType":1,"content":"終是貧寒。胎元日主提綱，印旺奪魁元聚貴。歳苗髙，坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":1290,"lineType":1,"content":"玉堂榮翰苑；病乃魁星，病去方能成就。文為甲首，官来","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":1291,"lineType":1,"content":"始見升騰。元武格而比刼多，太乙玉堂真甲第。朱雀賦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":1292,"lineType":1,"content":"而食神旺。官年四歳擬登科，比肩多見官煞。印是魁星，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506803762987020"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":1295,"lineType":1,"content":"合歳衝官及第。官煞重遇印傷，便是甲宿食年；印歳題","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":1296,"lineType":1,"content":"名，木魁若臨年月旺，狀頭解首屬斯人；火宿如值歳干","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":1297,"lineType":1,"content":"炎，甲膀狀元歸此軰。數科不第，只因財破文書；一舉成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":1298,"lineType":1,"content":"名，乃是魁星帶甲。五行消長，皆因鬼以成功；四柱興隆，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":1299,"lineType":1,"content":"若無病而不貴。雖用鬼病為竒，終是去之為福。更尋三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":1300,"lineType":1,"content":"合禄馬之年，須㸔玉堂天乙之歳。丙丁生於冬月，貴於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":1301,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己當頭；庚辛産在夏間，妙乎壬癸得局。甲乙秋生，貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":1302,"lineType":1,"content":"宜元武；庚辛夏長，妙用勾陳。丙丁水多嫌北地，逢戊己","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506835165511730"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"反作貴推；庚辛火盛怕南方，遇戊己翻為貴斷。甲乙秋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":1306,"lineType":1,"content":"生透丙丁，莫作傷㸔；戊己夏産露庚辛，當為貴論。火帶","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":1307,"lineType":1,"content":"水多，貴行木運。土逢木旺，榮入火鄉；庚逢水重，水冷金","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":1308,"lineType":1,"content":"寒，最喜炎熱。戊遇酉多，身衰氣脫，偏愛熒煌。不及要生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":1309,"lineType":1,"content":"扶，太過宜剥削。青龍全從革之金，且貧且賤；白虎備潤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":1310,"lineType":1,"content":"下之水，曰富曰榮。春木多而水淺，補衲之僧；夏火炎而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":1311,"lineType":1,"content":"金衰，簮冠之道。勾陳局全，潤下奔波之徒；朱雀三合，元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":1312,"lineType":1,"content":"武困弱之軰。金堅火弱，行商販賣之人；土敗水凝，破祖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506795181424667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":1315,"lineType":1,"content":"淹留之客。金生秋月土重重，貧無寸鐡。火長夏天金叠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":1316,"lineType":1,"content":"叠，富有千鍾。春木專遇水多，貧賤之流；冬水獨逢金盛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":1317,"lineType":1,"content":"寒弱之軰。辰戌丑未遇刑衝，無人不發；子午卯酉帶刑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":1318,"lineType":1,"content":"合，犯者多淫。夏金叠火，秋水重金，太偏黨，非貧即賤。春","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":1319,"lineType":1,"content":"金多火，冬水盛金，無制伏，不天則貧。秋木無根從婦福，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":1320,"lineType":1,"content":"禄貴崇髙。夏金失地配夫榮，功名顯達。火向春林逢木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":1321,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，好去求名。土臨季地見金多，堪來出仕。甲乙夏榮土","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":1322,"lineType":1,"content":"星厚，功名半，喜足田庄。丙丁冬盛水源清，爵禄全欣榮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506795181441051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":1325,"lineType":1,"content":"錦綉。專禄帶食傷，權持外閫；羊刃入官煞，威鎮邉疆。拱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":1326,"lineType":1,"content":"禄拱貴夾丘，爵禄豐饒；倒衝遥合欄义，功名顯達。壬趨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":1327,"lineType":1,"content":"艮而甲趨乾，清名之士；辛朝陽而乙鼠貴，文學之官。局","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":1328,"lineType":1,"content":"全風虎，良將之材；柱備雲龍，大人之徳。四庫全備龍變","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":1329,"lineType":1,"content":"化，逢大海為九五之尊；三竒局秀鳳騰翔，遇天門乃臺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":1330,"lineType":1,"content":"閣之貴。旺財官之貴富，暗禄馬以榮華。入格以貴而推，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":1331,"lineType":1,"content":"破局不貴而斷。究一理而察百端，明片言而通萬類。後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":1332,"lineType":1,"content":"學君子，勿忽於斯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":1336,"lineType":1,"content":"凡㸔人命，專論六格。逢官㸔財，見財而富貴；逢煞㸔印，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":1337,"lineType":1,"content":"遇印以榮華。逢印㸔官而遇官，十有七貴；逢財忌煞，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":1338,"lineType":1,"content":"有煞，十有九貧。官喜露，露則清髙；財要藏，藏則豐厚；官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":1339,"lineType":1,"content":"煞混雜，身弱則貧；官煞相停，合煞為貴。年月官星，早年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":1340,"lineType":1,"content":"出仕；日時正貴，晚歳成名。胞胎逢印綬，禄享千鍾；財氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":1341,"lineType":1,"content":"逢長生，田肥萬頃。秋冬官星防刃傷存全元武貴無疑；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":1342,"lineType":1,"content":"臘月傷官喜見。官破印傷，重禍而死。財旺生官者，乃貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506844128903183"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":1345,"lineType":1,"content":"少而富多；傷官見財者，又官髙而財足。無傷不貴，有病","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":1346,"lineType":1,"content":"為竒。始雖用之為竒，終須去之為福。理妙於斯，何須外","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":1347,"lineType":1,"content":"求。如火炎水少，遇庚辛休作，身旺官輕而取；或土重木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":1348,"lineType":1,"content":"絕，逢壬癸難當，官旺身輕而决。財輕莫逢刼地，印多最","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":1349,"lineType":1,"content":"妙財鄉。財逢生官，因賄取貴；煞星制刃，刼寳圖名。身旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":1350,"lineType":1,"content":"偏財可取，必得横財。主健正財被刼，頻見妻灾。刼財羊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":1351,"lineType":1,"content":"刃入官，煞臺閣之臣；歸禄衝食逢刃，傷廊廟之貴。身旺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":1352,"lineType":1,"content":"有煞逢印綬，權斷之官；主弱逢印見財星，尋常之客。羊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506844128935951"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":1355,"lineType":1,"content":"刃偏官有制，膺職掌於兵刑；正官正印無傷，牧黎庶為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":1356,"lineType":1,"content":"守令。財旺稼穡，給餉之官；飛禄朝陽，侍從之職。乾坤本","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":1357,"lineType":1,"content":"清氣經國之榮；子午為尊，極黄門之貴。癸日癸時兼丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":1358,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，魁名及第入翰林；壬日壬時叠寅辰，髙爵承恩登御","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":1359,"lineType":1,"content":"問。日徳見魁罡，縱吉遇貧寒之士。魁罡值財，官任得地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":1360,"lineType":1,"content":"衣禄之人。傷官見官，妙遇財印之地；財星破印，貴行比","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":1361,"lineType":1,"content":"刼之鄉。命重財運，逢煞吉而堪言；命重煞運，逢財㓙而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":1362,"lineType":1,"content":"可决。甲乙運入西方，身旺功名可許；壬癸路經南地，主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1362","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506825686515724"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1363","lineNum":1365,"lineType":1,"content":"健財禄堪圖。刼煞不宜行旺地，食神最妙偏財鄉。女命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1364","lineNum":1366,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官，歸禄得之極吉。男造羊刃，身弱遇之為竒；金神建","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1365","lineNum":1367,"lineType":1,"content":"禄欄义，女命逢之最忌。羊刃傷官七煞，男子遇之得權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1366","lineNum":1368,"lineType":1,"content":"金神入火，逢煞刃貴而無疑；煞重有印，逢食傷榮而有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1367","lineNum":1369,"lineType":1,"content":"凖。正官正印，官居不顯；羊刃七煞，出仕馳名。身旺無依，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1368","lineNum":1370,"lineType":1,"content":"僧道之軰；桃花滚浪，娼婢之流。金弱火強，土木銷鎔之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1369","lineNum":1371,"lineType":1,"content":"匠；土多水淺，行閒針線之工。五湖雲擾，始榮終辱，已身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1370","lineNum":1372,"lineType":1,"content":"貧；遍野桃花，一世風流多酒色。亡神拱煞，賊盗之徒；秀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1371","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506807189766183"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1372","lineNum":1375,"lineType":1,"content":"氣失時，清貧之士。印旺身強多嗜酒，丁壬妬化犯淫訛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1373","lineNum":1376,"lineType":1,"content":"身印俱旺，平生少病；天月徳助，處世無灾。食神生旺勝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1374","lineNum":1377,"lineType":1,"content":"似財，官貴全財煞。有棄命就財，就煞就官者，有餘富貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1375","lineNum":1378,"lineType":1,"content":"無依；專旺絕食，絕財絕官者，無限貧窮。身弱棄命要無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1376","lineNum":1379,"lineType":1,"content":"根，官居宰府。干衰身化，得其時，位近天廷。男命類屬從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1377","lineNum":1380,"lineType":1,"content":"化，照返鬼伏，宜細詳之；女命純和清貴，濁濫娼淫，當深","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1378","lineNum":1381,"lineType":1,"content":"究也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1380","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506825686482956"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1381","lineNum":1385,"lineType":1,"content":"五行生旺，朝中榮貴之人；四柱休囚，林下清修之客。鬼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1382","lineNum":1386,"lineType":1,"content":"旺身衰，少年難得榮華；禄破身刑，早歳失其怙恃。男少","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1383","lineNum":1387,"lineType":1,"content":"女多，只為隂神太重；男多女少，定是純陽有托。逆尅懸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1384","lineNum":1388,"lineType":1,"content":"針，雕靣打鐡之軰；魁罡煞刃，役身軍伍之流。官遇亡刼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1385","lineNum":1389,"lineType":1,"content":"兼七煞當為武將；貴填財印，遇二徳，得作忠臣。財衝禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":1390,"lineType":1,"content":"破，市井屠兒；禄旺身強，豪門貴客。孤辰值華葢，道士僧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":1391,"lineType":1,"content":"尼；刼煞遇魁罡，巫醫術士。咸池坐旺，帶刃因色亡身；驛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":1392,"lineType":1,"content":"馬臨刑，帶禄為牙致富。命長富貴，葢縁天徳遇長生，衣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506795181473819"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":1395,"lineType":1,"content":"食豐盈，乃是財星無尅破。日居專禄，支神全合貴無疑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1391","lineNum":1396,"lineType":1,"content":"支刃干官，時月重逢官必顯。戊午戊午，貴因化刃生身；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1392","lineNum":1397,"lineType":1,"content":"拱禄拱貴，禍為歳来填實。財多露顯，有敗有成；財少暗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1393","lineNum":1398,"lineType":1,"content":"藏，爛錢朽貫。早年無子，皆因時日刑身；晚後添嬰，知縁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1394","lineNum":1399,"lineType":1,"content":"時得日貴。丙申、庚寅、甲己，真是貴人；甲子、己巳壬辰，業","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1395","lineNum":1400,"lineType":1,"content":"專醫卜。日逢刃煞，妻必産亡；時值孤虚，子當不肖。子卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1396","lineNum":1401,"lineType":1,"content":"之中逢一癸，富且不貧。干支刑合帶咸池，娼門幇客。時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1397","lineNum":1402,"lineType":1,"content":"上偏官有制，晚子英竒；柱中財旺生官，早年清選。咸池","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1398","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506844128952335"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1399","lineNum":1405,"lineType":1,"content":"華葢，月時相犯主伶仃。弔客䘮門，歳運併臨方孝服。水","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1400","lineNum":1406,"lineType":1,"content":"多則泛濫之軰，作事無成；土多乃愚濁之徒，化生須福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1401","lineNum":1407,"lineType":1,"content":"馬多則終年奔走，禄多則活計難停，刑多則終有殘疾，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1402","lineNum":1408,"lineType":1,"content":"破多則一生苦恨。馬多禄少，奔馳詭詐之徒；財旺身強，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1403","lineNum":1409,"lineType":1,"content":"良顯忠正之士。咸池帶合遇鬼賊，家敗人離刼亡。煞刃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1404","lineNum":1410,"lineType":1,"content":"會傷官，兇頑招禍。偏財身旺，趂求商賈之人；六合會財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1405","lineNum":1411,"lineType":1,"content":"興販經營之軰。拱印拱貴，三島玉階金殿客。拱禄拱財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1406","lineNum":1412,"lineType":1,"content":"萬頃桑田。朱履賔。有印無官，享見成清髙之命。金神遇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1407","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506837082521626"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1408","lineNum":1415,"lineType":1,"content":"水，乃貧寒帶疾之徒。愚痴無知，皆因泄氣傷身。知武能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1409","lineNum":1416,"lineType":1,"content":"文，天徳貴人生印；風流破蕩。印多干弱坐咸池，圓頂方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1410","lineNum":1417,"lineType":1,"content":"袍；孤寡二星臨華葢。滿盤羊刃，决定分屍。時日俱空，妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":1418,"lineType":1,"content":"兒不力。干支重犯剰官來，痼疾纒身。天乙一字遇長生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":1419,"lineType":1,"content":"利名兼享。跛足駝腰，只為煞神逢曲脚，侏儒殘疾，葢由","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1413","lineNum":1420,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼旺日衰柔。支旺干衰家穏實，支衰干旺外虚花。四柱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1414","lineNum":1421,"lineType":1,"content":"連珠，官印助一品之尊；五行連茹，財禄享千鍾之富。身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1415","lineNum":1422,"lineType":1,"content":"若剛強，不怕鬼來尅我。日干柔弱，喜逢比刼相扶。身弱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1416","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506795181490203"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1417","lineNum":1425,"lineType":1,"content":"食多則天，金神帶火則貴。慷慨者，偏財刼刃；慳吝者，正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1418","lineNum":1426,"lineType":1,"content":"官正財。七煞無制，乃為㓙惡之徒。傷官咸池，定作岐路","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1419","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"之客。凡見日干太弱，内有弱處復生。若見旺相相生，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":1428,"lineType":1,"content":"有旺中尅破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":1429,"lineType":8,"content":"明津先生骨髓歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":1430,"lineType":1,"content":"欲知五行生死訣，容易豈與凡人説。五星只在限為慿，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1423","lineNum":1431,"lineType":1,"content":"子平專以運中决。生知富貴問前程，死時未審如何截。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1424","lineNum":1432,"lineType":1,"content":"格局只以用神推，用不受傷人不滅。運行先布十二宫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1425","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506835165544498"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1426","lineNum":1435,"lineType":1,"content":"㸔於何宫受某節。財官印綬與食神，當知輕重審分明。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1427","lineNum":1436,"lineType":1,"content":"官星怕行七煞運，偏官尤畏正官臨。官煞混行當知審，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1428","lineNum":1437,"lineType":1,"content":"去煞留官仔細評。留官去煞莫逢煞，留煞去官官莫逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1429","lineNum":1438,"lineType":1,"content":"官煞受傷人自絕，更㸔財格定前程。日時偏正問何財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1430","lineNum":1439,"lineType":1,"content":"又怕干頭帶煞来。煞運重逢人亦夭，孰知偏正是為灾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1431","lineNum":1440,"lineType":1,"content":"自專偏正皆為福，兄弟同分是禍媒。運到正財必争競，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1432","lineNum":1441,"lineType":1,"content":"各宜偏正兩分推。有財官運須榮發，官運財鄉是福胎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1433","lineNum":1442,"lineType":1,"content":"只怕日干元自弱，財多生鬼趕身衰。財多身弱行財運，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1434","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506829427720232"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1435","lineNum":1445,"lineType":1,"content":"此處方知入泉臺。官不受傷財不刼，夀山髙聳豈能頺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1436","lineNum":1446,"lineType":1,"content":"第一難推印綬鄉，運行身旺必榮昌。官鄉會合逢官職，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1437","lineNum":1447,"lineType":1,"content":"死地當知是禍殃。若是逢財來害印，懸梁落水惡中亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1438","lineNum":1448,"lineType":1,"content":"官居在任他鄉死，經紀逢之在路傍。印不逢財人不死，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1439","lineNum":1449,"lineType":1,"content":"如前逐一細推詳。財官印綬分明説，更有食神非易訣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1440","lineNum":1450,"lineType":1,"content":"食神有氣勝財官，只怕殘傷前後截。倒食運遇反傷年，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1441","lineNum":1451,"lineType":1,"content":"須知早下泉臺歇。前格教君説短長，後格也來前路截。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1442","lineNum":1452,"lineType":1,"content":"却分輕重細推詳，大怕財官臨死絕。傷官命運再逢官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1443","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506844128985103"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1444","lineNum":1455,"lineType":1,"content":"斷是徒流禍百端。日貴日徳逢衝戰，此命危亡可立㸔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1445","lineNum":1456,"lineType":1,"content":"飛天拱禄嫌填實，更㸔絆神來犯干。若依喜忌篇中斷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1446","lineNum":1457,"lineType":1,"content":"格局逢傷作夭㸔。後格死生無異兆，第一財官為𦂳要。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1447","lineNum":1458,"lineType":1,"content":"運行若不遇財官，既遇財官無長少。問夀須知問用神，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1448","lineNum":1459,"lineType":1,"content":"用神受制定尅身。受傷勿以便為禍，輕重須教認取真。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1449","lineNum":1460,"lineType":1,"content":"用神健旺定無慮，運若逢傷實蹇迍。退職卸官依例斷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1450","lineNum":1461,"lineType":1,"content":"亡家敗業損兒孫。六親眷屬還遭累，禮服親䘮百事臨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1451","lineNum":1462,"lineType":1,"content":"何以知其能住夀，但宜運上細推尋。日干同運如逢煞，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1452","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506807189798951"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1453","lineNum":1465,"lineType":1,"content":"逢煞逢刑禍來侵。外敵仍還逢内敵，其餘宫分外方尋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1454","lineNum":1466,"lineType":1,"content":"内逢外敵為灾重，外逢内敵禍㣲侵。戊己土須分四季，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1455","lineNum":1467,"lineType":1,"content":"雜氣中間難又易。逐年分定數中分，受制受傷隨歳氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1456","lineNum":1468,"lineType":1,"content":"指定吉㐫此運中，何年何月殃灾至。子運歳逢辰子癸，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1457","lineNum":1469,"lineType":1,"content":"克應太歳及月位。寅運丙申逢年同，己丙一同禍福類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1458","lineNum":1470,"lineType":1,"content":"卯運乙木怕相逢，巳中戊庚丙雜會。午運年上午戊㐫，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1459","lineNum":1471,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未年中須是畏。申宫庚亥莫相逢，酉逢辛丑皆為忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1460","lineNum":1472,"lineType":1,"content":"亥運壬甲怕申宫。只是八宫包四季，四季從頭混八宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1461","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506845374447651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1462","lineNum":1475,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵循環如指示，不知去處是無窮。配合干支同一位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1463","lineNum":1476,"lineType":1,"content":"便分輕重定灾㐫。運重歳輕宜併論，吉㐫歳隨運一同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1464","lineNum":1477,"lineType":1,"content":"此是千金不傳秘，予因濟世寫遺蹤，術人且莫妄輕議。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1465","lineNum":1478,"lineType":8,"content":"搜髓歌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1466","lineNum":1479,"lineType":1,"content":"造化先須㸔日主，後把提綱分次第。四柱專一論財官，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1467","lineNum":1480,"lineType":1,"content":"身旺財官多富貴。若還身旺財官損，只是朝求暮討兒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1468","lineNum":1481,"lineType":1,"content":"財官旺時日主旺，紫袍金帶有何疑。財官旺而日主弱，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1469","lineNum":1482,"lineType":1,"content":"運行身旺最為竒。日主旺而財官弱，運入財官利名馳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1470","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506825686532108"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1471","lineNum":1485,"lineType":1,"content":"日主坐下有財官，月令相逢貴不難。總把財官為𦂳要，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1472","lineNum":1486,"lineType":1,"content":"早年富貴禄髙攀。財官㣲薄身太旺，太旺無依受孤寒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1473","lineNum":1487,"lineType":1,"content":"更有印來比刼助，傷妻尅子可立㸔。官煞太重身更強，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":1488,"lineType":1,"content":"一逢制伏作賢良。煞官拱印貴不小，烜赫威名定振揚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":1489,"lineType":1,"content":"生居九夏火土多，利逢水濟貴中和。水火原來要既濟，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":1490,"lineType":1,"content":"𬋩教名利鎮山河。火熱炎炎如無水，運行水鄉亦是美。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1477","lineNum":1491,"lineType":1,"content":"水勢滔滔若無土，運入土鄉真可喜。東方木多宜西運，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1478","lineNum":1492,"lineType":1,"content":"西方金旺愛東行。五行相濟成造化，人命逢之福不輕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1479","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506829427753000"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1480","lineNum":1495,"lineType":1,"content":"三丘五墓怕見重，骨肉參商損六親。提綱刑衝尅父母，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1481","lineNum":1496,"lineType":1,"content":"日時對衝妻子屯。比刼傷官若再旺，不但傷妻更損兒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":1497,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有一子亦不孝，或者乞養總非宜。身旺比肩坐驛馬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":1498,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟飄蓬好瀟洒。八字驛馬紛交馳，身榮勞苦東西也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":1499,"lineType":1,"content":"倘得身閒心不定，動則風流静則愁。若是財星坐驛馬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":1500,"lineType":1,"content":"妻賢無處不悠悠。財星入庫主聚財，謹守資財不做人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":1501,"lineType":1,"content":"妻兒慳吝善持助，只怕暗藏羊刃嗔。官煞重重不帶財，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":1502,"lineType":1,"content":"妻能内助不和諧。公姑不敬全無禮，奪却夫權命所排。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506803763036172"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":1505,"lineType":1,"content":"官星若也逢生旺，更得長生旺在時。子息聰明多俊秀，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":1506,"lineType":1,"content":"兒孫個個着緋衣。日主七煞帶梟食，妻主虚胎小産多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":1507,"lineType":1,"content":"經脉不調成血疾，更㸔行運又如何。男子梟食重重見，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":1508,"lineType":1,"content":"身弱多應癆病隨。女人梟食非為吉，産難驚人病亦危。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1493","lineNum":1509,"lineType":1,"content":"女命官旺兼財旺，招得賢夫更好兒。若是財官俱受損，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1494","lineNum":1510,"lineType":1,"content":"傷夫尅子有何疑。印綬生身身更旺，為人刑尅主貧孤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1495","lineNum":1511,"lineType":1,"content":"若得官顯財又顯，亦為超邁貴人扶。女命若也傷官旺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1496","lineNum":1512,"lineType":1,"content":"坐下傷官會罵夫。朝暮喃喃口不絕，百年終是見刑枯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1497","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506851691085843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1498","lineNum":1515,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳庚午與辛未，日干帶之最為美。再㸔四柱又何如，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1499","lineNum":1516,"lineType":1,"content":"定主夫賢己亦貴。丙丁子丑戊己春，此日生人定不同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1500","lineNum":1517,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午甲申共乙酉，坐下財官富貴榮。丁亥戊子並庚寅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1501","lineNum":1518,"lineType":1,"content":"日主逢之福不輕。辛卯丙申丁酉位，財官内隠顯聲名。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1502","lineNum":1519,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥甲申見庚戌，印綬財官暗裏藏。更得丙辰壬戌至，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1503","lineNum":1520,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱扶印不尋常。甲子丙寅與丁卯，己巳壬辰癸巳同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1504","lineNum":1521,"lineType":1,"content":"若是身同強月令，虚名虚利任飄蓬。辛亥庚申並己丑，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1505","lineNum":1522,"lineType":1,"content":"坐下財官並無有。妻宫子女帶虚花，東西南北是身家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1506","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7424506865070899215"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1507","lineNum":1525,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅戊戌并庚子，女尅丈夫男尅子。己巳丙午丁未同，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1508","lineNum":1526,"lineType":1,"content":"重重壬子主孤窮。辛酉乙卯與戊午，支干同類妻不足。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1509","lineNum":1527,"lineType":1,"content":"己未庚申及癸亥，月令更旺成禍害。日主財官印綬全，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1510","lineNum":1528,"lineType":1,"content":"月時符合福綿綿。干支同類並身旺，尅子刑妻破祖田。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":1529,"lineType":1,"content":"好將四柱分強弱，莫把隂陽只一言。此是五行真妙訣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":1530,"lineType":1,"content":"不逢知者莫虚傳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":1531,"lineType":8,"content":"四言獨歩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
